```solidity
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { CreateProxyLib } from "./libraries/CreateProxyLib.sol";
     8	import { ERC721, ERC721TokenReceiver } from "../lib/solmate/src/tokens/ERC721.sol";
     9	import { FactoryErrors } from "./libraries/Errors.sol";
    10	import { FactoryGuardian } from "./guardians/FactoryGuardian.sol";
    11	import { IAccount } from "./interfaces/IAccount.sol";
    12	import { IFactory } from "./interfaces/IFactory.sol";
    13	import { IRegistry } from "./interfaces/IRegistry.sol";
    14	import { MerkleProofLib } from "../lib/solmate/src/utils/MerkleProofLib.sol";
    15	import { Strings } from "./libraries/Strings.sol";
    16	
    17	/**
    18	 * @title Factory
    19	 * @author Pragma Labs
    20	 * @notice The Factory manages the deployment, upgrades and transfers of Arcadia Accounts.
    21	 * @dev The Factory is an ERC721 contract that maps each id to an Arcadia Account.
    22	 */
    23	contract Factory is IFactory, ERC721, FactoryGuardian {
    24	    using Strings for uint256;
    25	
    26	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    27	                                STORAGE
    28	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    29	
    30	    // The latest Account version, newly deployed Account use the latest version by default.
    31	    uint88 public latestAccountVersion;
    32	    // The baseURI of the ERC721 tokens.
    33	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-variable)
    34	    string public baseURI;
    35	
    36	    // The Merkle root of the Merkle tree of all the compatible Account versions.
    37	    bytes32 public versionRoot;
    38	
    39	    // Array of all Arcadia Account contract addresses.
    40	    address[] public allAccounts;
    41	
    42	    // Map accountVersion => blocked status.
    43	    mapping(uint256 => bool) public accountVersionBlocked;
    44	    // Map accountAddress => accountIndex.
    45	    mapping(address => uint256) public accountIndex;
    46	    // Map accountVersion => version information.
    47	    mapping(uint256 => VersionInformation) public versionInformation;
    48	
    49	    // Struct with additional information for a specific Account version.
    50	    struct VersionInformation {
    51	        // The contract address of the Registry.
    52	        address registry;
    53	        // The contract address of the Account implementation.
    54	        address implementation;
    55	        // Arbitrary data, can contain instructions to execute when updating Account to new implementation.
    56	        bytes data;
    57	    }
    58	
    59	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    60	                                EVENTS
    61	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    62	
    63	    event AccountUpgraded(address indexed accountAddress, uint88 indexed newVersion);
    64	    event AccountVersionAdded(uint88 indexed version, address indexed registry, address indexed implementation);
    65	    event AccountVersionBlocked(uint88 version);
    66	
    67	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    68	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    69	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    70	
    71	    /**
    72	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    73	     */
    74	    constructor(address owner_) ERC721("Arcadia Account", "ARCADIA") FactoryGuardian(owner_) { }
    75	
    76	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    77	                          ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT
    78	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    79	
    80	    /**
    81	     * @notice Function to create a new Account.
    82	     * @param userSalt A salt, provided by the user, to generate the Account address.
    83	     * @param accountVersion The Account version.
    84	     * @param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
    85	     * @return account The contract address of the Proxy of the newly deployed Account.
    86	     * @dev If accountVersion == 0, the newest version will be used.
    87	     * @dev createAccount() uses the CREATE2 opcode, which can lead to address collision vulnerabilities,
    88	     * as described in: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3607.
    89	     * To decrease the probability of finding an address collision, the number of possible account addresses is limited to 2**64.
    90	     * We use a salt with 64 bits, the 32 right most bits of the address of the tx.origin, and 32 bits provided by the user.
    91	     */
    92	    function createAccount(uint32 userSalt, uint256 accountVersion, address creditor)
    93	        external
    94	        whenCreateNotPaused
    95	        returns (address account)
    96	    {
    97	        accountVersion = accountVersion == 0 ? latestAccountVersion : accountVersion;
    98	
    99	        if (accountVersion > latestAccountVersion) revert FactoryErrors.InvalidAccountVersion();
   100	        if (accountVersionBlocked[accountVersion]) revert FactoryErrors.AccountVersionBlocked();
   101	
   102	        // Hash tx.origin with the user provided salt to avoid front-running Account deployment with an identical salt.
   103	        // We use tx.origin instead of msg.sender so that deployments through third party contracts are not vulnerable to front-running.
   104	        // 64 bit salt: 32 bits from tx.origin and 32 bits provided by the user.
   105	        uint256 salt = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(userSalt, uint32(uint160(tx.origin)))));
   106	        account = CreateProxyLib.createProxy(salt, versionInformation[accountVersion].implementation);
   107	
   108	        allAccounts.push(account);
   109	        accountIndex[account] = allAccounts.length;
   110	
   111	        _mint(msg.sender, allAccounts.length);
   112	
   113	        IAccount(account).initialize(msg.sender, versionInformation[accountVersion].registry, creditor);
   114	
   115	        // unsafe cast: accountVersion <= latestAccountVersion, which is a uint88.
   116	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   117	        emit AccountUpgraded(account, uint88(accountVersion));
   118	    }
   119	
   120	    /**
   121	     * @notice View function returning if an address is an Account.
   122	     * @param account The address to be checked.
   123	     * @return bool Whether the address is an Account or not.
   124	     */
   125	    function isAccount(address account) public view returns (bool) {
   126	        return accountIndex[account] > 0;
   127	    }
   128	
   129	    /**
   130	     * @notice Returns the owner of an Account.
   131	     * @param account The Account address.
   132	     * @return owner_ The Account owner.
   133	     * @dev Function does not revert when a non-existing Account is passed, but returns zero-address as owner.
   134	     */
   135	    function ownerOfAccount(address account) external view returns (address owner_) {
   136	        owner_ = _ownerOf[accountIndex[account]];
   137	    }
   138	
   139	    /**
   140	     * @notice This function allows Account owners to upgrade the implementation of the Account.
   141	     * @param account Account that needs to be upgraded.
   142	     * @param version The accountVersion to upgrade to.
   143	     * @param proofs The Merkle proofs that prove the compatibility of the upgrade from current to new account version.
   144	     * @dev As each Account is a proxy, the implementation of the proxy can be changed by the owner of the Account.
   145	     * Checks are done such that only compatible versions can be upgraded to.
   146	     * Merkle proofs and their leaves can be found on https://www.github.com/arcadia-finance.
   147	     */
   148	    function upgradeAccountVersion(address account, uint256 version, bytes32[] calldata proofs) external {
   149	        if (_ownerOf[accountIndex[account]] != msg.sender) revert FactoryErrors.OnlyAccountOwner();
   150	        if (accountVersionBlocked[version]) revert FactoryErrors.AccountVersionBlocked();
   151	
   152	        uint256 currentVersion = IAccount(account).ACCOUNT_VERSION();
   153	        bool canUpgrade =
   154	            MerkleProofLib.verify(proofs, versionRoot, keccak256(abi.encodePacked(currentVersion, version)));
   155	
   156	        if (!canUpgrade) revert FactoryErrors.InvalidUpgrade();
   157	
   158	        IAccount(account)
   159	            .upgradeAccount(
   160	                versionInformation[version].implementation,
   161	                versionInformation[version].registry,
   162	                version,
   163	                versionInformation[version].data
   164	            );
   165	
   166	        // unsafe cast: accountVersion <= latestAccountVersion, which is a uint88.
   167	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   168	        emit AccountUpgraded(account, uint88(version));
   169	    }
   170	
   171	    /**
   172	     * @notice Function used to transfer an Account between users based on Account address.
   173	     * @param from The sender.
   174	     * @param to The target.
   175	     * @param account The address of the Account that is transferred.
   176	     * @dev This method transfers an Account on Account address instead of id and
   177	     * also transfers the Account proxy contract to the new owner.
   178	     * @dev The Account itself cannot become its owner.
   179	     */
   180	    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, address account) public {
   181	        if (to == account) revert FactoryErrors.InvalidRecipient();
   182	
   183	        uint256 id = accountIndex[account];
   184	        IAccount(allAccounts[id - 1]).transferOwnership(to);
   185	        super.safeTransferFrom(from, to, id);
   186	    }
   187	
   188	    /**
   189	     * @notice Function used to transfer an Account between users based on Account id.
   190	     * @param from The sender.
   191	     * @param to The target.
   192	     * @param id The id of the Account that is about to be transferred.
   193	     * @dev This method overwrites the safeTransferFrom function in ERC721.sol to
   194	     * also transfer the Account proxy contract to the new owner.
   195	     * @dev The Account itself cannot become its owner.
   196	     */
   197	    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 id) public override {
   198	        address account = allAccounts[id - 1];
   199	        if (to == account) revert FactoryErrors.InvalidRecipient();
   200	
   201	        IAccount(account).transferOwnership(to);
   202	        super.safeTransferFrom(from, to, id);
   203	    }
   204	
   205	    /**
   206	     * @notice Function used to transfer an Account between users based on Account id.
   207	     * @param from The sender.
   208	     * @param to The target.
   209	     * @param id The id of the Account that is about to be transferred.
   210	     * @param data additional data, only used for onERC721Received.
   211	     * @dev This method overwrites the safeTransferFrom function in ERC721.sol to
   212	     * also transfer the Account proxy contract to the new owner.
   213	     * @dev The Account itself cannot become its owner.
   214	     */
   215	    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 id, bytes calldata data) public override {
   216	        address account = allAccounts[id - 1];
   217	        if (to == account) revert FactoryErrors.InvalidRecipient();
   218	
   219	        IAccount(account).transferOwnership(to);
   220	        super.safeTransferFrom(from, to, id, data);
   221	    }
   222	
   223	    /**
   224	     * @notice Function used to transfer an Account between users based on Account id.
   225	     * @param from The sender.
   226	     * @param to The target.
   227	     * @param id The id of the Account that is about to be transferred.
   228	     * @dev This method overwrites the transferFrom function in ERC721.sol to
   229	     * also transfer the Account proxy contract to the new owner.
   230	     * @dev The Account itself cannot become its owner.
   231	     */
   232	    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 id) public override {
   233	        address account = allAccounts[id - 1];
   234	        if (to == account) revert FactoryErrors.InvalidRecipient();
   235	
   236	        IAccount(account).transferOwnership(to);
   237	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(erc20-unchecked-transfer)
   238	        super.transferFrom(from, to, id);
   239	    }
   240	
   241	    /**
   242	     * @notice Function used to transfer an Account, called by the Account itself.
   243	     * @param to The target.
   244	     * @dev Adaptation of safeTransferFrom from the ERC-721 standard, where the Account itself triggers the transfer.
   245	     * @dev The Account must do the transferOwnership() before calling this function.
   246	     * @dev The Account itself cannot become its owner.
   247	     */
   248	    function safeTransferAccount(address to) public {
   249	        if (to == address(0)) revert FactoryErrors.InvalidRecipient();
   250	        if (to == msg.sender) revert FactoryErrors.InvalidRecipient();
   251	
   252	        uint256 id = accountIndex[msg.sender];
   253	        if (id == 0) revert FactoryErrors.OnlyAccount();
   254	
   255	        address from = _ownerOf[id];
   256	
   257	        // Underflow of the sender's balance is impossible because we check for
   258	        // ownership above and the recipient's balance can't realistically overflow.
   259	        unchecked {
   260	            _balanceOf[from]--;
   261	            _balanceOf[to]++;
   262	        }
   263	
   264	        _ownerOf[id] = to;
   265	
   266	        delete getApproved[id];
   267	
   268	        if (
   269	            to.code.length != 0
   270	                && ERC721TokenReceiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, id, "")
   271	                    != ERC721TokenReceiver.onERC721Received.selector
   272	        ) revert FactoryErrors.UnsafeRecipient();
   273	
   274	        emit Transfer(from, to, id);
   275	    }
   276	
   277	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   278	                    ACCOUNT VERSION MANAGEMENT
   279	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   280	
   281	    /**
   282	     * @notice Function to set a new Account version with the contracts to be used for new deployed Accounts.
   283	     * @param registry The contract address of the Registry.
   284	     * @param implementation The contract address of the Account implementation.
   285	     * @param versionRoot_ The Merkle root of the Merkle tree of all the compatible Account versions.
   286	     * @param data Arbitrary data, can contain instructions to execute when updating Account to new implementation.
   287	     * @dev Changing any of the contracts does NOT change the contracts for existing deployed Accounts,
   288	     * unless the Account owner explicitly chooses to upgrade their Account to a newer version.
   289	     */
   290	    function setNewAccountInfo(address registry, address implementation, bytes32 versionRoot_, bytes calldata data)
   291	        external
   292	        onlyOwner
   293	    {
   294	        if (versionRoot_ == bytes32(0)) revert FactoryErrors.VersionRootIsZero();
   295	        if (implementation == address(0)) revert FactoryErrors.ImplIsZero();
   296	
   297	        uint256 latestAccountVersion_;
   298	        unchecked {
   299	            // Update and cache the new latestAccountVersion.
   300	            latestAccountVersion_ = ++latestAccountVersion;
   301	        }
   302	
   303	        versionRoot = versionRoot_;
   304	        versionInformation[latestAccountVersion_] =
   305	            VersionInformation({ registry: registry, implementation: implementation, data: data });
   306	
   307	        if (IAccount(implementation).ACCOUNT_VERSION() != latestAccountVersion) revert FactoryErrors.VersionMismatch();
   308	        if (IAccount(implementation).FACTORY() != address(this)) revert FactoryErrors.FactoryMismatch();
   309	        if (IRegistry(registry).FACTORY() != address(this)) revert FactoryErrors.FactoryMismatch();
   310	
   311	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   312	        emit AccountVersionAdded(uint88(latestAccountVersion_), registry, implementation);
   313	    }
   314	
   315	    /**
   316	     * @notice Function to block a certain Account implementation version from being created as a new Account.
   317	     * @param version The Account version to be phased out.
   318	     * @dev Should any Account implementation version be phased out,
   319	     * this function can be used to block it from being created for new Accounts.
   320	     * @dev Although possible to block an Account version through the versionRoot,
   321	     * that would require verifying the Merkle tree on account creation, which is expensive.
   322	     */
   323	    function blockAccountVersion(uint256 version) external onlyOwner {
   324	        if (version == 0 || version > latestAccountVersion) revert FactoryErrors.InvalidAccountVersion();
   325	        accountVersionBlocked[version] = true;
   326	
   327	        // unsafe cast: accountVersion <= latestAccountVersion, which is a uint88.
   328	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   329	        emit AccountVersionBlocked(uint88(version));
   330	    }
   331	
   332	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   333	                        HELPER FUNCTIONS
   334	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   335	
   336	    /**
   337	     * @notice Function returns the total number of Accounts.
   338	     * @return numberOfAccounts The total number of Accounts.
   339	     */
   340	    function allAccountsLength() external view returns (uint256 numberOfAccounts) {
   341	        numberOfAccounts = allAccounts.length;
   342	    }
   343	
   344	    /**
   345	     * @notice Computes the address of a new Account.
   346	     * @param user The address of the user (tx.origin) creating the Account.
   347	     * @param userSalt A salt, provided by the user, to generate the Account address.
   348	     * @param accountVersion The Account version.
   349	     * @return account The contract address of the Proxy of the new Account.
   350	     * @dev Does not verify if the account version exists or is blocked.
   351	     */
   352	    function getAccountAddress(address user, uint32 userSalt, uint256 accountVersion)
   353	        external
   354	        view
   355	        returns (address account)
   356	    {
   357	        accountVersion = accountVersion == 0 ? latestAccountVersion : accountVersion;
   358	
   359	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   360	        uint256 salt = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(userSalt, uint32(uint160(user)))));
   361	        account = CreateProxyLib.getProxyAddress(salt, versionInformation[accountVersion].implementation);
   362	    }
   363	
   364	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   365	                        ERC-721 LOGIC
   366	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   367	
   368	    /**
   369	     * @notice Function that stores a new base URI.
   370	     * @param newBaseURI The new base URI to store.
   371	     * @dev tokenURIs of Arcadia Accounts are not meant to be immutable
   372	     * and might be updated later to allow users to choose/create their own Account art,
   373	     * as such no URI freeze is added.
   374	     */
   375	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function,mixed-case-variable)
   376	    function setBaseURI(string calldata newBaseURI) external onlyOwner {
   377	        baseURI = newBaseURI;
   378	    }
   379	
   380	    /**
   381	     * @notice Function that returns the token URI as defined in the ERC721 standard.
   382	     * @param tokenId The id of the Account.
   383	     * @return uri The token URI.
   384	     */
   385	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function,mixed-case-variable)
   386	    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) public view override returns (string memory uri) {
   387	        return bytes(baseURI).length > 0 ? string(abi.encodePacked(baseURI, tokenId.toString())) : "";
   388	    }
   389	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/Proxy.sol
```solidity
     1	// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
     2	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     3	
     4	/**
     5	 * @title Proxy
     6	 * @author Pragma Labs
     7	 * @dev Implementation based on ERC1967: Proxy Storage Slots.
     8	 * See https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1967.
     9	 */
    10	contract Proxy {
    11	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    12	                                CONSTANTS
    13	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    14	
    15	    // Storage slot with the address of the current implementation.
    16	    // This is the hardcoded keccak-256 hash of: "eip1967.proxy.implementation" subtracted by 1.
    17	    bytes32 internal constant IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT = 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc;
    18	
    19	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    20	                                STORAGE
    21	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    22	
    23	    // Storage slot for the Account logic, a struct to avoid storage conflict when dealing with upgradeable contracts.
    24	    struct AddressSlot {
    25	        address value;
    26	    }
    27	
    28	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    29	                                EVENTS
    30	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    31	
    32	    event Upgraded(address indexed implementation);
    33	
    34	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    35	                            CONSTRUCTOR
    36	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    37	
    38	    /**
    39	     * @param implementation The contract address of the Account logic.
    40	     */
    41	    constructor(address implementation) payable {
    42	        _getAddressSlot(IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT).value = implementation;
    43	        emit Upgraded(implementation);
    44	    }
    45	
    46	    /**
    47	     * @dev Fallback function that delegates calls to the implementation address.
    48	     * Will run if call data is empty.
    49	     */
    50	    receive() external payable virtual {
    51	        _delegate(_getAddressSlot(IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT).value);
    52	    }
    53	
    54	    /**
    55	     * @dev Fallback function that delegates calls to the implementation address.
    56	     * Will run if no other function in the contract matches the call data.
    57	     */
    58	    fallback() external payable virtual {
    59	        _delegate(_getAddressSlot(IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT).value);
    60	    }
    61	
    62	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    63	                        IMPLEMENTATION LOGIC
    64	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    65	
    66	    /**
    67	     * @notice Returns the "AddressSlot" with member "value" located at "slot".
    68	     * @param slot The slot where the address of the Logic contract is stored.
    69	     * @return r The address stored in slot.
    70	     */
    71	    function _getAddressSlot(bytes32 slot) internal pure returns (AddressSlot storage r) {
    72	        assembly {
    73	            r.slot := slot
    74	        }
    75	    }
    76	
    77	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    78	                          DELEGATION LOGIC
    79	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    80	
    81	    /**
    82	     * @param implementation The contract address of the logic.
    83	     * @dev Delegates the current call to "implementation".
    84	     * This function does not return to its internal call site, it will return directly to the external caller.
    85	     */
    86	    function _delegate(address implementation) internal virtual {
    87	        assembly {
    88	            // Copy msg.data. We take full control of memory in this inline assembly
    89	            // block because it will not return to Solidity code. We overwrite the
    90	            // Solidity scratch pad at memory position 0.
    91	            calldatacopy(0, 0, calldatasize())
    92	
    93	            // Call the implementation.
    94	            // out and outsize are 0 because we don't know the size yet.
    95	            let result := delegatecall(gas(), implementation, 0, calldatasize(), 0, 0)
    96	
    97	            // Copy the returned data.
    98	            returndatacopy(0, 0, returndatasize())
    99	
   100	            switch result
   101	            // delegatecall returns 0 on error.
   102	            case 0 { revert(0, returndatasize()) }
   103	            default { return(0, returndatasize()) }
   104	        }
   105	    }
   106	}
```

```solidity
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { ICreditor } from "../interfaces/ICreditor.sol";
     8	
     9	/**
    10	 * @title Creditor.
    11	 * @author Pragma Labs
    12	 * @notice See the documentation in ICreditor
    13	 */
    14	abstract contract Creditor is ICreditor {
    15	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    16	                                STORAGE
    17	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    18	
    19	    // The address of the riskManager.
    20	    address public riskManager;
    21	
    22	    // The Account for which a flashAction is called.
    23	    address internal callbackAccount;
    24	
    25	    // Map accountVersion => status.
    26	    mapping(uint256 => bool) public isValidVersion;
    27	
    28	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    29	                                EVENTS
    30	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    31	
    32	    event RiskManagerUpdated(address riskManager);
    33	    event ValidAccountVersionsUpdated(uint256 indexed accountVersion, bool valid);
    34	
    35	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    36	                                ERRORS
    37	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    38	
    39	    // Thrown when caller is not authorized.
    40	    error Unauthorized();
    41	
    42	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    43	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    44	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    45	
    46	    /**
    47	     * @param riskManager_ The address of the Risk Manager.
    48	     */
    49	    constructor(address riskManager_) {
    50	        _setRiskManager(riskManager_);
    51	    }
    52	
    53	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    54	                            ACCOUNT LOGIC
    55	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    56	
    57	    /**
    58	     * @notice Sets a new Risk Manager. A Risk Manager can:
    59	     * - Set risk parameters for collateral assets, including: max exposures, collateral factors and liquidation factors.
    60	     * - Set minimum usd values for assets in order to be taken into account, to prevent dust attacks.
    61	     * @param riskManager_ The address of the new Risk Manager.
    62	     */
    63	    function _setRiskManager(address riskManager_) internal {
    64	        riskManager = riskManager_;
    65	
    66	        emit RiskManagerUpdated(riskManager_);
    67	    }
    68	
    69	    /**
    70	     * @notice Updates the validity of an Account version.
    71	     * @param accountVersion The Account version.
    72	     * @param isValid Will be "true" if respective Account version is valid, "false" if not.
    73	     */
    74	    function _setAccountVersion(uint256 accountVersion, bool isValid) internal {
    75	        isValidVersion[accountVersion] = isValid;
    76	
    77	        emit ValidAccountVersionsUpdated(accountVersion, isValid);
    78	    }
    79	
    80	    /**
    81	     * @inheritdoc ICreditor
    82	     * @dev This function response is used for the Arcadia Accounts margin account creation.
    83	     * This function does not deploy a new Arcadia Account.
    84	     * It just provides the parameters to be used in Arcadia Account to connect to the Creditor.
    85	     */
    86	    function openMarginAccount(uint256 accountVersion)
    87	        external
    88	        virtual
    89	        returns (bool success, address numeraire, address liquidator, uint256 minimumMargin);
    90	
    91	    /**
    92	     * @inheritdoc ICreditor
    93	     * @dev This function checks if the given Account address has an open position. If not, it can be closed.
    94	     */
    95	    function closeMarginAccount(address account) external virtual;
    96	
    97	    /**
    98	     * @inheritdoc ICreditor
    99	     * @dev The open position is the sum of all liabilities.
   100	     */
   101	    function getOpenPosition(address account) external view virtual returns (uint256 openPosition);
   102	
   103	    /**
   104	     * @inheritdoc ICreditor
   105	     * @dev During the callback, the Account cannot be reentered and the actionTimestamp is updated.
   106	     */
   107	    function flashActionCallback(bytes calldata callbackData) external virtual {
   108	        // Only the Account for which the flashAction is initiated is allowed to callback.
   109	        if (callbackAccount != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
   110	
   111	        // Reset callbackAccount, the Account should only callback once during a flashAction.
   112	        callbackAccount = address(0);
   113	
   114	        _flashActionCallback(msg.sender, callbackData);
   115	    }
   116	
   117	    /**
   118	     * @notice Callback of the Account during a flashAction.
   119	     * @param account The contract address of the Arcadia Account.
   120	     * @param callbackData The data for the actions that have to be executed by the Creditor during a flashAction.
   121	     * @dev During the callback, the Account cannot be reentered and the actionTimestamp is updated.
   122	     */
   123	    function _flashActionCallback(address account, bytes calldata callbackData) internal virtual;
   124	
   125	    /**
   126	     * @inheritdoc ICreditor
   127	     * @dev Starts the liquidation process in the Creditor.
   128	     * This function should be callable by Arcadia Account.
   129	     */
   130	    function startLiquidation(address initiator, uint256 minimumMargin) external virtual returns (uint256 openPosition);
   131	}
```

```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { AccountErrors } from "../libraries/Errors.sol";
     8	import { AccountStorageV1 } from "./AccountStorageV1.sol";
     9	import { IAccount } from "../interfaces/IAccount.sol";
    10	import { IAccountsGuard } from "../interfaces/IAccountsGuard.sol";
    11	
    12	/**
    13	 * @title Arcadia Account Placeholder
    14	 * @author Pragma Labs
    15	 * @notice This contract is a placeholder of the logic implementation of a certain version of Arcadia Accounts.
    16	 */
    17	contract AccountPlaceholder is AccountStorageV1, IAccount {
    18	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    19	                                CONSTANTS
    20	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    21	
    22	    // Bools indicating if the function being called can be paused by the AccountsGuard.
    23	    bool internal constant WITH_PAUSE_CHECK = true;
    24	    bool internal constant WITHOUT_PAUSE_CHECK = false;
    25	
    26	    // The Account Version.
    27	    uint256 public immutable ACCOUNT_VERSION;
    28	    // The cool-down period after an account action, that might be disadvantageous for a new Owner,
    29	    // during which ownership cannot be transferred to prevent the old Owner from frontrunning a transferFrom().
    30	    uint256 public constant COOL_DOWN_PERIOD = 5 minutes;
    31	    // Storage slot with the address of the current Implementation.
    32	    // This is the hardcoded keccak-256 hash of: "eip1967.proxy.implementation" subtracted by 1.
    33	    bytes32 internal constant IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT = 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc;
    34	    // The contract address of the Arcadia Accounts Factory.
    35	    address public immutable FACTORY;
    36	    // The contract address of the Accounts Guard.
    37	    IAccountsGuard public immutable ACCOUNTS_GUARD;
    38	
    39	    // Storage slot for the Implementation contract, a struct to avoid storage conflict when dealing with upgradeable contracts.
    40	    struct AddressSlot {
    41	        address value;
    42	    }
    43	
    44	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    45	                                MODIFIERS
    46	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    47	
    48	    /**
    49	     * @param pauseCheck Bool indicating if a pause check should be done.
    50	     * @dev Throws if cross accounts guard is reentered or paused.
    51	     * @dev Locks/unlocks the cross accounts guard before/after the function is executed.
    52	     */
    53	    modifier nonReentrant(bool pauseCheck) {
    54	        ACCOUNTS_GUARD.lock(pauseCheck);
    55	        _;
    56	        ACCOUNTS_GUARD.unLock();
    57	    }
    58	
    59	    /**
    60	     * @dev Throws if called by any address other than the Factory address.
    61	     */
    62	    modifier onlyFactory() {
    63	        if (msg.sender != FACTORY) revert AccountErrors.OnlyFactory();
    64	        _;
    65	    }
    66	
    67	    /**
    68	     * @dev Throws if called by any address other than the owner.
    69	     */
    70	    modifier onlyOwner() {
    71	        if (msg.sender != owner) revert AccountErrors.OnlyOwner();
    72	        _;
    73	    }
    74	
    75	    /**
    76	     * @dev Starts the cool-down period during which ownership cannot be transferred.
    77	     * This prevents the old Owner from frontrunning a transferFrom().
    78	     */
    79	    modifier updateActionTimestamp() {
    80	        lastActionTimestamp = uint32(block.timestamp);
    81	        _;
    82	    }
    83	
    84	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    85	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    86	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    87	
    88	    /**
    89	     * @param factory The contract address of the Arcadia Accounts Factory.
    90	     * @param accountsGuard The contract address of the Accounts Guard.
    91	     * @param version The Account Version.
    92	     */
    93	    constructor(address factory, address accountsGuard, uint256 version) {
    94	        // This will only be the owner of the Account implementation.
    95	        // and will not affect any subsequent proxy implementation using this Account implementation.
    96	        owner = msg.sender;
    97	
    98	        FACTORY = factory;
    99	        ACCOUNTS_GUARD = IAccountsGuard(accountsGuard);
   100	        ACCOUNT_VERSION = version;
   101	    }
   102	
   103	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   104	                          PROXY MANAGEMENT
   105	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   106	
   107	    /**
   108	     * @notice Initiates the variables of the Account.
   109	     * @param owner_ The sender of the 'createAccount' on the Factory
   110	     * @param registry_ The 'beacon' contract with the external logic to price assets.
   111	     * @dev A proxy will be used to interact with the Account implementation.
   112	     * This function will only be called (once) in the same transaction as the proxy Account creation through the Factory.
   113	     * @dev The Registry is not used in the placeholder implementation, but a valid registry must be set to be compatible with V1 Accounts.
   114	     */
   115	    function initialize(address owner_, address registry_, address)
   116	        external
   117	        onlyFactory
   118	        nonReentrant(WITH_PAUSE_CHECK)
   119	    {
   120	        if (registry_ == address(0)) revert AccountErrors.InvalidRegistry();
   121	        owner = owner_;
   122	        registry = registry_;
   123	    }
   124	
   125	    /**
   126	     * @notice Upgrades the Account version and stores a new address in the EIP1967 implementation slot.
   127	     * @param newImplementation The new contract address of the Account implementation.
   128	     * @param newRegistry The Registry for this specific newImplementation.
   129	     * @param data Arbitrary data, can contain instructions to execute when updating Account to new implementation.
   130	     * @dev This function MUST be added to new Account implementations.
   131	     */
   132	    function upgradeAccount(address newImplementation, address newRegistry, uint256, bytes calldata data)
   133	        external
   134	        onlyFactory
   135	        nonReentrant(WITHOUT_PAUSE_CHECK)
   136	        updateActionTimestamp
   137	    {
   138	        // Cache old parameters.
   139	        address oldImplementation = _getAddressSlot(IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT).value;
   140	        uint256 oldVersion = ACCOUNT_VERSION;
   141	
   142	        // Store new parameters.
   143	        _getAddressSlot(IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT).value = newImplementation;
   144	        registry = newRegistry;
   145	
   146	        // Hook on the new logic to finalize upgrade.
   147	        // Used to eg. Remove exposure from old Registry and add exposure to the new RegistryL2.
   148	        // Extra data can be added by the Factory for complex instructions.
   149	        this.upgradeHook(oldImplementation, address(0), oldVersion, data);
   150	
   151	        // Event emitted by Factory.
   152	    }
   153	
   154	    /**
   155	     * @notice Returns the "AddressSlot" with member "value" located at "slot".
   156	     * @param slot The slot where the address of the Logic contract is stored.
   157	     * @return r The address stored in slot.
   158	     */
   159	    function _getAddressSlot(bytes32 slot) internal pure returns (AddressSlot storage r) {
   160	        assembly {
   161	            r.slot := slot
   162	        }
   163	    }
   164	
   165	    /**
   166	     * @notice Finalizes the Upgrade to a new Account version on the new implementation Contract.
   167	     * param oldImplementation The old contract address of the Account implementation.
   168	     * param oldRegistry The Registry of the old version (might be identical to the new registry)
   169	     * param oldVersion The old version of the Account implementation.
   170	     * param data Arbitrary data, can contain instructions to execute in this function.
   171	     * @dev If upgradeHook() is implemented, it MUST verify that msg.sender == address(this).
   172	     */
   173	    function upgradeHook(address, address, uint256, bytes calldata) external {
   174	        // Function must be non-view, we do a sstore to suppress pure/view warning for proxy compatibility.
   175	        owner = owner;
   176	
   177	        // Placeholder implementations are strictly for creating Accounts of a certain version.
   178	        // It should never be possible to upgrade an Account to a Placeholder implementation.
   179	        revert AccountErrors.InvalidUpgrade();
   180	    }
   181	
   182	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   183	                        OWNERSHIP MANAGEMENT
   184	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   185	
   186	    /**
   187	     * @notice Transfers ownership of the contract to a new Account.
   188	     * @param newOwner The new owner of the Account.
   189	     * @dev Can only be called by the current owner via the Factory.
   190	     * A transfer of ownership of the Account is triggered by a transfer
   191	     * of ownership of the accompanying ERC721 Account NFT, issued by the Factory.
   192	     * Owner of Account NFT = owner of Account
   193	     * @dev Function uses a cool-down period during which ownership cannot be transferred.
   194	     * Cool-down period is triggered after any account action, that might be disadvantageous for a new Owner.
   195	     * This prevents the old Owner from frontrunning a transferFrom().
   196	     */
   197	    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyFactory nonReentrant(WITHOUT_PAUSE_CHECK) {
   198	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(block-timestamp)
   199	        if (block.timestamp <= lastActionTimestamp + COOL_DOWN_PERIOD) revert AccountErrors.CoolDownPeriodNotPassed();
   200	
   201	        // The Factory will check that the new owner is not address(0).
   202	        owner = newOwner;
   203	    }
   204	}
```

```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	/**
     8	 * @title Arcadia Accounts Storage
     9	 * @author Pragma Labs
    10	 * @notice This contract is the storage contract for the Accounts.
    11	 * Arcadia Accounts are smart contracts that act as onchain, decentralized and composable margin accounts.
    12	 * They provide individuals, DAOs, and other protocols with a simple and flexible way to deposit and manage multiple assets as collateral.
    13	 * More detail about the Accounts can be found in the AccountsV1.sol contract.
    14	 * @dev Since Accounts are proxies and can be upgraded by the user, all storage variables should be declared in this contract.
    15	 * New account versions must create a new account storage contract and inherit this storage contract.
    16	 */
    17	abstract contract AccountStorageV1 {
    18	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    19	                                STORAGE
    20	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    21	
    22	    // Flag indicating if the Account is in an auction (in liquidation).
    23	    bool public inAuction;
    24	    // Flag Indicating if a function is locked to protect against reentrancy.
    25	    uint8 internal locked;
    26	    // Used to prevent the old Owner from frontrunning a transferFrom().
    27	    // The Timestamp of the last account action, that might be disadvantageous for a new Owner
    28	    // (withdrawals, change of Creditor, increasing liabilities...).
    29	    uint32 public lastActionTimestamp;
    30	    // The contract address of the liquidator, address 0 if no creditor is set.
    31	    address public liquidator;
    32	
    33	    // The minimum amount of collateral that must be held in the Account before a position can be opened, denominated in the numeraire.
    34	    // Will count as Used Margin after a position is opened.
    35	    uint96 public minimumMargin;
    36	    // The contract address of the Registry.
    37	    address public registry;
    38	
    39	    // The owner of the Account.
    40	    address public owner;
    41	    // The contract address of the Creditor.
    42	    address public creditor;
    43	    // The Numeraire (the unit in which prices are measured) of the Account,
    44	    // in which all assets and liabilities are denominated.
    45	    address public numeraire;
    46	
    47	    // Array with all the contract addresses of ERC20 tokens in the account.
    48	    address[] internal erc20Stored;
    49	    // Array with all the contract addresses of ERC721 tokens in the account.
    50	    address[] internal erc721Stored;
    51	    // Array with all the contract addresses of ERC1155 tokens in the account.
    52	    address[] internal erc1155Stored;
    53	    // Array with all the corresponding ids for each ERC721 token in the account.
    54	    uint256[] internal erc721TokenIds;
    55	    // Array with all the corresponding ids for each ERC1155 token in the account.
    56	    uint256[] internal erc1155TokenIds;
    57	
    58	    // Map asset => balance.
    59	    mapping(address => uint256) public erc20Balances;
    60	    // Map asset => id => balance.
    61	    mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) public erc1155Balances;
    62	    // Map owner => approved Creditor.
    63	    // This is a Creditor for which a margin Account can be opened later in time to e.g. refinance liabilities.
    64	    mapping(address => address) public approvedCreditor;
    65	    // Map owner => assetManager => flag.
    66	    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) public isAssetManager;
    67	}
```

```solidity
     1	/**
```
