     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.22;
     6	
     7	import { AccountErrors } from "../libraries/Errors.sol";
     8	import { AccountStorageV1 } from "./AccountStorageV1.sol";
     9	import { ERC20, SafeTransferLib } from "../../lib/solmate/src/utils/SafeTransferLib.sol";
    10	import { AssetValuationLib, AssetValueAndRiskFactors } from "../libraries/AssetValuationLib.sol";
    11	import { IERC721 } from "../interfaces/IERC721.sol";
    12	import { IERC1155 } from "../interfaces/IERC1155.sol";
    13	import { IRegistry } from "../interfaces/IRegistry.sol";
    14	import { ICreditor } from "../interfaces/ICreditor.sol";
    15	import { IActionBase, ActionData } from "../interfaces/IActionBase.sol";
    16	import { IAccount } from "../interfaces/IAccount.sol";
    17	import { IFactory } from "../interfaces/IFactory.sol";
    18	import { IPermit2 } from "../interfaces/IPermit2.sol";
    19	
    20	/**
    21	 * @title Arcadia Accounts
    22	 * @author Pragma Labs
    23	 * @notice Arcadia Accounts are smart contracts that act as onchain, decentralized and composable margin accounts.
    24	 * They provide individuals, DAOs, and other protocols with a simple and flexible way to deposit and manage multiple assets as collateral.
    25	 * The total combination of assets can be used as margin to back liabilities issued by any financial protocol (lending, leverage, futures...).
    26	 * @dev Users can use this Account to deposit assets (fungible, non-fungible, LP positions, yiel bearing assets...).
    27	 * The Account will denominate all the deposited assets into one Numeraire (one unit of account, like USD or ETH).
    28	 * Users can use the single denominated value of all their assets to take margin (take credit line, financing for leverage...).
    29	 * An increase of value of one asset will offset a decrease in value of another asset.
    30	 * Ensure your total value denomination remains above the liquidation threshold, or risk being liquidated!
    31	 * @dev Integrating this Account as means of margin/collateral management for your own protocol that requires collateral is encouraged.
    32	 * Arcadia's Account functions will guarantee you a certain value of the Account.
    33	 * For allowlists or liquidation strategies specific to your protocol, contact pragmalabs.dev
    34	 */
    35	// forge-lint: disable-next-item(all)
    36	contract AccountV1 is AccountStorageV1, IAccount {
    37	    using AssetValuationLib for AssetValueAndRiskFactors[];
    38	    using SafeTransferLib for ERC20;
    39	
    40	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    41	                                CONSTANTS
    42	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    43	
    44	    // The current Account Version.
    45	    uint256 public constant ACCOUNT_VERSION = 1;
    46	    // The maximum amount of different assets that can be used as collateral within an Arcadia Account.
    47	    uint256 public constant ASSET_LIMIT = 15;
    48	    // The cool-down period after an account action, that might be disadvantageous for a new Owner,
    49	    // during which ownership cannot be transferred to prevent the old Owner from frontrunning a transferFrom().
    50	    uint256 internal constant COOL_DOWN_PERIOD = 5 minutes;
    51	    // Storage slot with the address of the current implementation.
    52	    // This is the hardcoded keccak-256 hash of: "eip1967.proxy.implementation" subtracted by 1.
    53	    bytes32 internal constant IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT = 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc;
    54	    // The contract address of the Arcadia Accounts Factory.
    55	    address public immutable FACTORY;
    56	    // Uniswap Permit2 contract.
    57	    IPermit2 internal immutable PERMIT2 = IPermit2(0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3);
    58	
    59	    // Storage slot for the Account implementation, a struct to avoid storage conflict when dealing with upgradeable contracts.
    60	    struct AddressSlot {
    61	        address value;
    62	    }
    63	
    64	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    65	                                EVENTS
    66	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    67	
    68	    event AssetManagerSet(address indexed owner, address indexed assetManager, bool value);
    69	    event MarginAccountChanged(address indexed creditor, address indexed liquidator);
    70	    event NumeraireSet(address indexed numeraire);
    71	
    72	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    73	                                MODIFIERS
    74	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    75	
    76	    /**
    77	     * @dev Throws if function is reentered.
    78	     */
    79	    modifier nonReentrant() {
    80	        if (locked != 1) revert AccountErrors.NoReentry();
    81	        locked = 2;
    82	        _;
    83	        locked = 1;
    84	    }
    85	
    86	    /**
    87	     * @dev Throws if called when the Account is in an auction.
    88	     */
    89	    modifier notDuringAuction() {
    90	        if (inAuction == true) revert AccountErrors.AccountInAuction();
    91	        _;
    92	    }
    93	
    94	    /**
    95	     * @dev Throws if called by any address other than an Asset Manager or the owner.
    96	     */
    97	    modifier onlyAssetManager() {
    98	        // A custom error would need to read out owner + isAssetManager storage
    99	        require(msg.sender == owner || isAssetManager[owner][msg.sender], "A: Only Asset Manager");
   100	        _;
   101	    }
   102	
   103	    /**
   104	     * @dev Throws if called by any address other than the Creditor.
   105	     */
   106	    modifier onlyCreditor() {
   107	        if (msg.sender != creditor) revert AccountErrors.OnlyCreditor();
   108	        _;
   109	    }
   110	
   111	    /**
   112	     * @dev Throws if called by any address other than the Factory address.
   113	     */
   114	    modifier onlyFactory() {
   115	        if (msg.sender != FACTORY) revert AccountErrors.OnlyFactory();
   116	        _;
   117	    }
   118	
   119	    /**
   120	     * @dev Throws if called by any address other than the Liquidator address.
   121	     */
   122	    modifier onlyLiquidator() {
   123	        if (msg.sender != liquidator) revert AccountErrors.OnlyLiquidator();
   124	        _;
   125	    }
   126	
   127	    /**
   128	     * @dev Throws if called by any address other than the owner.
   129	     */
   130	    modifier onlyOwner() {
   131	        if (msg.sender != owner) revert AccountErrors.OnlyOwner();
   132	        _;
   133	    }
   134	
   135	    /**
   136	     * @dev Starts the cool-down period during which ownership cannot be transferred.
   137	     * This prevents the old Owner from frontrunning a transferFrom().
   138	     */
   139	    modifier updateActionTimestamp() {
   140	        lastActionTimestamp = uint32(block.timestamp);
   141	        _;
   142	    }
   143	
   144	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   145	                                CONSTRUCTOR
   146	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   147	
   148	    /**
   149	     * @param factory The contract address of the Arcadia Accounts Factory.
   150	     */
   151	    constructor(address factory) {
   152	        // This will only be the owner of the Account implementation.
   153	        // and will not affect any subsequent proxy implementation using this Account implementation.
   154	        owner = msg.sender;
   155	
   156	        FACTORY = factory;
   157	    }
   158	
   159	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   160	                          ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT
   161	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   162	
   163	    /**
   164	     * @notice Initiates the variables of the Account.
   165	     * @param owner_ The sender of the 'createAccount' on the Factory
   166	     * @param registry_ The 'beacon' contract with the external logic to price assets.
   167	     * @param creditor_ The contract address of the Creditor.
   168	     * @dev A proxy will be used to interact with the Account implementation.
   169	     * Therefore everything is initialised through an init function.
   170	     * This function will only be called (once) in the same transaction as the proxy Account creation through the Factory.
   171	     * @dev The Creditor will only be set if it's a non-zero address, in this case the numeraire_ passed as input will be ignored.
   172	     * @dev initialize has implicitly a nonReentrant guard, since the "locked" variable has value zero until the end of the function.
   173	     */
   174	    function initialize(address owner_, address registry_, address creditor_) external {
   175	        if (registry != address(0)) revert AccountErrors.AlreadyInitialized();
   176	        if (registry_ == address(0)) revert AccountErrors.InvalidRegistry();
   177	        owner = owner_;
   178	        registry = registry_;
   179	
   180	        if (creditor_ != address(0)) _openMarginAccount(creditor_);
   181	
   182	        locked = 1;
   183	    }
   184	
   185	    /**
   186	     * @notice Upgrades the Account version and stores a new address in the EIP1967 implementation slot.
   187	     * @param newImplementation The new contract address of the Account implementation.
   188	     * @param newRegistry The Registry for this specific implementation (might be identical to the old registry).
   189	     * @param data Arbitrary data, can contain instructions to execute when updating Account to new implementation.
   190	     * @param newVersion The new version of the Account implementation.
   191	     * @dev This function MUST be added to new Account implementations.
   192	     */
   193	    function upgradeAccount(address newImplementation, address newRegistry, uint256 newVersion, bytes calldata data)
   194	        external
   195	        onlyFactory
   196	        nonReentrant
   197	        notDuringAuction
   198	        updateActionTimestamp
   199	    {
   200	        // Cache old parameters.
   201	        address oldImplementation = _getAddressSlot(IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT).value;
   202	        address oldRegistry = registry;
   203	        uint256 oldVersion = ACCOUNT_VERSION;
   204	
   205	        // Store new parameters.
   206	        _getAddressSlot(IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT).value = newImplementation;
   207	        registry = newRegistry;
   208	
   209	        // Prevent that Account is upgraded to a new version where the Numeraire can't be priced.
   210	        if (newRegistry != oldRegistry && !IRegistry(newRegistry).inRegistry(numeraire)) {
   211	            revert AccountErrors.InvalidRegistry();
   212	        }
   213	
   214	        // If a Creditor is set, new version should be compatible.
   215	        if (creditor != address(0)) {
   216	            (bool success,,,) = ICreditor(creditor).openMarginAccount(newVersion);
   217	            if (!success) revert AccountErrors.InvalidAccountVersion();
   218	        }
   219	
   220	        // Hook on the new logic to finalize upgrade.
   221	        // Used to eg. Remove exposure from old Registry and add exposure to the new RegistryL2.
   222	        // Extra data can be added by the Factory for complex instructions.
   223	        this.upgradeHook(oldImplementation, oldRegistry, oldVersion, data);
   224	
   225	        // Event emitted by Factory.
   226	    }
   227	
   228	    /**
   229	     * @notice Returns the "AddressSlot" with member "value" located at "slot".
   230	     * @param slot The slot where the address of the Logic contract is stored.
   231	     * @return r The address stored in slot.
   232	     */
   233	    function _getAddressSlot(bytes32 slot) internal pure returns (AddressSlot storage r) {
   234	        assembly {
   235	            r.slot := slot
   236	        }
   237	    }
   238	
   239	    /**
   240	     * @notice Finalizes the Upgrade to a new Account version on the new implementation Contract.
   241	     * @param oldImplementation The old contract address of the Account implementation.
   242	     * @param oldRegistry The Registry of the old version (might be identical to the new registry)
   243	     * @param oldVersion The old version of the Account implementation.
   244	     * @param data Arbitrary data, can contain instructions to execute in this function.
   245	     * @dev If upgradeHook() is implemented, it MUST verify that msg.sender == address(this).
   246	     */
   247	    function upgradeHook(address oldImplementation, address oldRegistry, uint256 oldVersion, bytes calldata data)
   248	        external { }
   249	
   250	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   251	                        OWNERSHIP MANAGEMENT
   252	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   253	
   254	    /**
   255	     * @notice Transfers ownership of the contract to a new Account.
   256	     * @param newOwner The new owner of the Account.
   257	     * @dev Can only be called by the current owner via the Factory.
   258	     * A transfer of ownership of the Account is triggered by a transfer
   259	     * of ownership of the accompanying ERC721 Account NFT, issued by the Factory.
   260	     * Owner of Account NFT = owner of Account
   261	     * @dev Function uses a cool-down period during which ownership cannot be transferred.
   262	     * Cool-down period is triggered after any account action, that might be disadvantageous for a new Owner.
   263	     * This prevents the old Owner from frontrunning a transferFrom().
   264	     */
   265	    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyFactory notDuringAuction {
   266	        if (block.timestamp <= lastActionTimestamp + COOL_DOWN_PERIOD) revert AccountErrors.CoolDownPeriodNotPassed();
   267	
   268	        // The Factory will check that the new owner is not address(0).
   269	        owner = newOwner;
   270	    }
   271	
   272	    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
   273	        // The Factory will check that the new owner is not address(0).
   274	        owner = newOwner;
   275	        IFactory(FACTORY).safeTransferAccount(newOwner);
   276	    }
   277	
   278	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   279	                        NUMERAIRE LOGIC
   280	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   281	
   282	    /**
   283	     * @notice Sets the Numeraire of the Account.
   284	     * @param numeraire_ The new Numeraire for the Account.
   285	     */
   286	    function setNumeraire(address numeraire_) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
   287	        if (creditor != address(0)) revert AccountErrors.CreditorAlreadySet();
   288	        _setNumeraire(numeraire_);
   289	    }
   290	
   291	    /**
   292	     * @notice Sets the Numeraire of the Account.
   293	     * @param numeraire_ The new Numeraire for the Account.
   294	     */
   295	    function _setNumeraire(address numeraire_) internal {
   296	        if (!IRegistry(registry).inRegistry(numeraire_)) revert AccountErrors.NumeraireNotFound();
   297	
   298	        emit NumeraireSet(numeraire = numeraire_);
   299	    }
   300	
   301	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   302	                    MARGIN ACCOUNT SETTINGS
   303	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   304	
   305	    /**
   306	     * @notice Opens a margin account on the Account for a new Creditor.
   307	     * @param newCreditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   308	     * @dev Currently only one Creditor can be set
   309	     * (we are working towards a single account for multiple Creditors tho!).
   310	     * @dev Only open margin accounts for Creditors you trust!
   311	     * The Creditor has significant authorization: use margin, trigger liquidation, and manage assets.
   312	     */
   313	    function openMarginAccount(address newCreditor)
   314	        external
   315	        onlyOwner
   316	        nonReentrant
   317	        notDuringAuction
   318	        updateActionTimestamp
   319	    {
   320	        (address[] memory assetAddresses, uint256[] memory assetIds, uint256[] memory assetAmounts) =
   321	            generateAssetData();
   322	
   323	        // Cache old Creditor.
   324	        address oldCreditor = creditor;
   325	        if (oldCreditor == newCreditor) revert AccountErrors.CreditorAlreadySet();
   326	
   327	        // Remove the exposures of the Account for the old Creditor.
   328	        if (oldCreditor != address(0)) {
   329	            IRegistry(registry).batchProcessWithdrawal(oldCreditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   330	        }
   331	
   332	        // Check if all assets in the Account are allowed by the new Creditor
   333	        // and add the exposure of the account for the new Creditor.
   334	        IRegistry(registry).batchProcessDeposit(newCreditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   335	
   336	        // Open margin account for the new Creditor.
   337	        _openMarginAccount(newCreditor);
   338	
   339	        // A margin account can only be opened for one Creditor at a time.
   340	        // If set, close the margin account for the old Creditor.
   341	        if (oldCreditor != address(0)) {
   342	            // closeMarginAccount() checks if there is still an open position (open liabilities) of the Account for the old Creditor.
   343	            // If so, the function reverts.
   344	            ICreditor(oldCreditor).closeMarginAccount(address(this));
   345	        }
   346	    }
   347	
   348	    /**
   349	     * @notice Internal function: Opens a margin account for a new Creditor.
   350	     * @param creditor_ The contract address of the Creditor.
   351	     */
   352	    function _openMarginAccount(address creditor_) internal {
   353	        (bool success, address numeraire_, address liquidator_, uint256 minimumMargin_) =
   354	            ICreditor(creditor_).openMarginAccount(ACCOUNT_VERSION);
   355	        if (!success) revert AccountErrors.InvalidAccountVersion();
   356	
   357	        minimumMargin = uint96(minimumMargin_);
   358	        if (numeraire != numeraire_) _setNumeraire(numeraire_);
   359	
   360	        emit MarginAccountChanged(creditor = creditor_, liquidator = liquidator_);
   361	    }
   362	
   363	    /**
   364	     * @notice Closes the margin account of the Creditor.
   365	     * @dev Currently only one Creditor can be set.
   366	     */
   367	    function closeMarginAccount() external onlyOwner nonReentrant notDuringAuction {
   368	        // Cache creditor.
   369	        address creditor_ = creditor;
   370	        if (creditor_ == address(0)) revert AccountErrors.CreditorNotSet();
   371	
   372	        creditor = address(0);
   373	        liquidator = address(0);
   374	        minimumMargin = 0;
   375	
   376	        // Remove the exposures of the Account for the old Creditor.
   377	        (address[] memory assetAddresses, uint256[] memory assetIds, uint256[] memory assetAmounts) =
   378	            generateAssetData();
   379	        IRegistry(registry).batchProcessWithdrawal(creditor_, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   380	
   381	        // closeMarginAccount() checks if there is still an open position (open liabilities) for the Account.
   382	        // If so, the function reverts.
   383	        ICreditor(creditor_).closeMarginAccount(address(this));
   384	
   385	        emit MarginAccountChanged(address(0), address(0));
   386	    }
   387	
   388	    /**
   389	     * @notice Sets an approved Creditor.
   390	     * @param creditor_ The contract address of the approved Creditor.
   391	     * @dev An approved Creditor is a Creditor for which no margin Account is immediately opened.
   392	     * But the approved Creditor itself can open the margin Account later in time to e.g. refinance liabilities.
   393	     * @dev Potential use-cases of the approved Creditor might be to:
   394	     * - Refinance liabilities (change creditor) without having to sell collateral to close the current position first.
   395	     * @dev Anyone can set the approved creditor for themselves, this will not impact the current owner of the Account
   396	     * since the combination of "current owner -> approved creditor" is used in authentication checks.
   397	     * This guarantees that when the ownership of the Account is transferred, the approved Creditor of the old owner has no
   398	     * impact on the new owner. But the new owner can still remove any existing approved Creditors before the transfer.
   399	     */
   400	    function setApprovedCreditor(address creditor_) external {
   401	        approvedCreditor[msg.sender] = creditor_;
   402	    }
   403	
   404	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   405	                          MARGIN REQUIREMENTS
   406	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   407	
   408	    /**
   409	     * @notice Calculates the total collateral value (MTM discounted with a haircut) of the Account.
   410	     * @return collateralValue The collateral value, returned in the decimal precision of the Numeraire.
   411	     * @dev Returns the value denominated in the Numeraire of the Account.
   412	     * @dev The collateral value of the Account is equal to the spot value of the underlying assets,
   413	     * discounted by a haircut (the collateral factor). Since the value of
   414	     * collateralized assets can fluctuate, the haircut guarantees that the Account
   415	     * remains over-collateralized with a high confidence level.
   416	     * The size of the haircut depends on the underlying risk of the assets in the Account.
   417	     * The bigger the volatility or the smaller the onchain liquidity, the bigger the haircut will be.
   418	     */
   419	    function getCollateralValue() public view returns (uint256 collateralValue) {
   420	        (address[] memory assetAddresses, uint256[] memory assetIds, uint256[] memory assetAmounts) =
   421	            generateAssetData();
   422	        collateralValue =
   423	            IRegistry(registry).getCollateralValue(numeraire, creditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   424	    }
   425	
   426	    /**
   427	     * @notice Calculates the total liquidation value (MTM discounted with a factor to account for slippage) of the Account.
   428	     * @return liquidationValue The liquidation value, returned in the decimal precision of the Numeraire.
   429	     * @dev The liquidation value of the Account is equal to the spot value of the underlying assets,
   430	     * discounted by a haircut (the liquidation factor).
   431	     * The liquidation value takes into account that not the full value of the assets can go towards
   432	     * repaying the liabilities: a fraction of the value is lost due to:
   433	     * slippage while liquidating the assets,
   434	     * fees for the auction initiator,
   435	     * fees for the auction terminator and
   436	     * a penalty to the protocol.
   437	     */
   438	    function getLiquidationValue() public view returns (uint256 liquidationValue) {
   439	        (address[] memory assetAddresses, uint256[] memory assetIds, uint256[] memory assetAmounts) =
   440	            generateAssetData();
   441	        liquidationValue =
   442	            IRegistry(registry).getLiquidationValue(numeraire, creditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   443	    }
   444	
   445	    /**
   446	     * @notice Returns the used margin of the Account.
   447	     * @return usedMargin The total amount of margin that is currently in use to back liabilities.
   448	     * @dev Used Margin is the value of the assets that is currently 'locked' to back:
   449	     *  - All the liabilities issued against the Account.
   450	     *  - An additional fixed buffer to cover gas fees in case of a liquidation.
   451	     * @dev The used margin is denominated in the Numeraire.
   452	     * @dev Currently only one Creditor at a time can open a margin account.
   453	     * The open liability is fetched at the contract of the Creditor -> only allow trusted audited Creditors!!!
   454	     */
   455	    function getUsedMargin() public view returns (uint256 usedMargin) {
   456	        // Cache creditor
   457	        address creditor_ = creditor;
   458	        if (creditor_ == address(0)) return 0;
   459	
   460	        // getOpenPosition() is a view function, cannot modify state.
   461	        usedMargin = ICreditor(creditor_).getOpenPosition(address(this)) + minimumMargin;
   462	    }
   463	
   464	    /**
   465	     * @notice Calculates the remaining margin the owner of the Account can use.
   466	     * @return freeMargin The remaining amount of margin a user can take.
   467	     * @dev Free Margin is the value of the assets that is still free to back additional liabilities.
   468	     * @dev The free margin is denominated in the Numeraire.
   469	     */
   470	    function getFreeMargin() public view returns (uint256 freeMargin) {
   471	        uint256 collateralValue = getCollateralValue();
   472	        uint256 usedMargin = getUsedMargin();
   473	
   474	        unchecked {
   475	            freeMargin = collateralValue > usedMargin ? collateralValue - usedMargin : 0;
   476	        }
   477	    }
   478	
   479	    /**
   480	     * @notice Checks if the Account is unhealthy.
   481	     * @return isUnhealthy Boolean indicating if the Account is unhealthy.
   482	     */
   483	    function isAccountUnhealthy() public view returns (bool isUnhealthy) {
   484	        // If usedMargin is equal to minimumMargin, the open liabilities are 0 and the Account is always healthy.
   485	        // An Account is unhealthy if the collateral value is smaller than the used margin.
   486	        uint256 usedMargin = getUsedMargin();
   487	        isUnhealthy = usedMargin > minimumMargin && getCollateralValue() < usedMargin;
   488	    }
   489	
   490	    /**
   491	     * @notice Checks if the Account can be liquidated.
   492	     * @return success Boolean indicating if the Account can be liquidated.
   493	     */
   494	    function isAccountLiquidatable() external view returns (bool success) {
   495	        // If usedMargin is equal to minimumMargin, the open liabilities are 0 and the Account is never liquidatable.
   496	        // An Account can be liquidated if the liquidation value is smaller than the used margin.
   497	        uint256 usedMargin = getUsedMargin();
   498	        success = usedMargin > minimumMargin && getLiquidationValue() < usedMargin;
   499	    }
   500	
   501	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   502	                          LIQUIDATION LOGIC
   503	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   504	
   505	    /**
   506	     * @notice Checks if an Account is liquidatable and continues the liquidation flow.
   507	     * @param initiator The address of the liquidation initiator.
   508	     * @return assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets in Account.
   509	     * @return assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets in Account.
   510	     * @return assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets in Account.
   511	     * @return creditor_ The contract address of the Creditor.
   512	     * @return minimumMargin_ The minimum margin.
   513	     * @return openPosition The open position (liabilities) issued against the Account.
   514	     * @return assetAndRiskValues Array of asset values and corresponding collateral and liquidation factors.
   515	     */
   516	    function startLiquidation(address initiator)
   517	        external
   518	        onlyLiquidator
   519	        nonReentrant
   520	        updateActionTimestamp
   521	        returns (
   522	            address[] memory assetAddresses,
   523	            uint256[] memory assetIds,
   524	            uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
   525	            address creditor_,
   526	            uint96 minimumMargin_,
   527	            uint256 openPosition,
   528	            AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory assetAndRiskValues
   529	        )
   530	    {
   531	        inAuction = true;
   532	        creditor_ = creditor;
   533	        minimumMargin_ = minimumMargin;
   534	
   535	        (assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts) = generateAssetData();
   536	        assetAndRiskValues =
   537	            IRegistry(registry).getValuesInNumeraire(numeraire, creditor_, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   538	
   539	        // Since the function is only callable by the Liquidator, we know that a liquidator and a Creditor are set.
   540	        openPosition = ICreditor(creditor_).startLiquidation(initiator, minimumMargin_);
   541	        uint256 usedMargin = openPosition + minimumMargin_;
   542	
   543	        if (openPosition == 0 || assetAndRiskValues._calculateLiquidationValue() >= usedMargin) {
   544	            revert AccountErrors.AccountNotLiquidatable();
   545	        }
   546	    }
   547	
   548	    /**
   549	     * @notice Transfers the asset bought by a bidder during a liquidation event.
   550	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   551	     * @param assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
   552	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   553	     * @param bidder The address of the bidder.
   554	     * @return assetAmounts_ Array with the actual transferred amounts of assets.
   555	     */
   556	    function auctionBid(
   557	        address[] memory assetAddresses,
   558	        uint256[] memory assetIds,
   559	        uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
   560	        address bidder
   561	    ) external onlyLiquidator nonReentrant returns (uint256[] memory assetAmounts_) {
   562	        uint256[] memory assetTypes = IRegistry(registry).batchGetAssetTypes(assetAddresses);
   563	        uint256 balance;
   564	        for (uint256 i; i < assetAddresses.length; ++i) {
   565	            // Skip if amount is 0.
   566	            if (assetAmounts[i] == 0) continue;
   567	
   568	            if (assetTypes[i] == 1) {
   569	                balance = erc20Balances[assetAddresses[i]];
   570	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 2) {
   571	                balance = (address(this) == IERC721(assetAddresses[i]).ownerOf(assetIds[i])) ? 1 : 0;
   572	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 3) {
   573	                balance = erc1155Balances[assetAddresses[i]][assetIds[i]];
   574	            } else {
   575	                revert AccountErrors.UnknownAssetType();
   576	            }
   577	            if (assetAmounts[i] > balance) assetAmounts[i] = balance;
   578	        }
   579	
   580	        _withdraw(assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts, bidder);
   581	
   582	        // Return the actual withdrawn amounts.
   583	        assetAmounts_ = assetAmounts;
   584	    }
   585	
   586	    /**
   587	     * @notice Transfers all assets of the Account in case the auction did not end successful (= Bought In).
   588	     * @param recipient The recipient address to receive the assets, set by the Creditor.
   589	     * @dev When an auction is not successful, the Account is considered "Bought In":
   590	     * The whole Account including any remaining assets are transferred to a certain recipient address, set by the Creditor.
   591	     */
   592	    function auctionBoughtIn(address recipient) external onlyLiquidator nonReentrant {
   593	        _transferOwnership(recipient);
   594	    }
   595	
   596	    /**
   597	     * @notice Sets the "inAuction" flag to false when an auction ends.
   598	     */
   599	    function endAuction() external onlyLiquidator nonReentrant {
   600	        inAuction = false;
   601	    }
   602	
   603	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   604	                       ASSET MANAGER ACTIONS
   605	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   606	
   607	    /**
   608	     * @notice Add or remove an Asset Manager.
   609	     * @param assetManager The address of the Asset Manager.
   610	     * @param value A boolean giving permissions to or taking permissions from an Asset Manager.
   611	     * @dev Only set trusted addresses as Asset Manager. Asset Managers have full control over assets in the Account,
   612	     * as long as the Account position remains healthy.
   613	     * @dev No need to set the Owner as Asset Manager as they will automatically have all permissions of an Asset Manager.
   614	     * @dev Potential use-cases of the Asset Manager might be to:
   615	     * - Automate actions by keeper networks.
   616	     * - Do flash actions (optimistic actions).
   617	     * - Chain multiple interactions together (eg. deposit and trade in one transaction).
   618	     * @dev Anyone can set the Asset Manager for themselves, this will not impact the current owner of the Account
   619	     * since the combination of "stored owner -> asset manager" is used in authentication checks.
   620	     * This guarantees that when the ownership of the Account is transferred, the asset managers of the old owner have no
   621	     * impact on the new owner. But the new owner can still remove any existing asset managers before the transfer.
   622	     */
   623	    function setAssetManager(address assetManager, bool value) external {
   624	        emit AssetManagerSet(msg.sender, assetManager, isAssetManager[msg.sender][assetManager] = value);
   625	    }
   626	
   627	    /**
   628	     * @notice Executes a flash action.
   629	     * @param actionTarget The contract address of the actionTarget to execute external logic.
   630	     * @param actionData A bytes object containing three structs and two bytes objects.
   631	     * The first struct contains the info about the assets to withdraw from this Account to the actionTarget.
   632	     * The second struct contains the info about the owner's assets that need to be transferred from the owner to the actionTarget.
   633	     * The third struct contains the permit for the Permit2 transfer.
   634	     * The first bytes object contains the signature for the Permit2 transfer.
   635	     * The second bytes object contains the encoded input for the actionTarget.
   636	     * @dev This function optimistically chains multiple actions together (= do a flash action):
   637	     * - It can optimistically withdraw assets from the Account to the actionTarget.
   638	     * - It can transfer assets directly from the owner to the actionTarget.
   639	     * - It can execute external logic on the actionTarget, and interact with any DeFi protocol to swap, stake, claim...
   640	     * - It can deposit all recipient tokens from the actionTarget back into the Account.
   641	     * At the very end of the flash action, the following check is performed:
   642	     * - The Account is in a healthy state (collateral value is greater than open liabilities).
   643	     * If a check fails, the whole transaction reverts.
   644	     */
   645	    function flashAction(address actionTarget, bytes calldata actionData)
   646	        external
   647	        onlyAssetManager
   648	        nonReentrant
   649	        notDuringAuction
   650	        updateActionTimestamp
   651	    {
   652	        // Decode flash action data.
   653	        (
   654	            ActionData memory withdrawData,
   655	            ActionData memory transferFromOwnerData,
   656	            IPermit2.PermitBatchTransferFrom memory permit,
   657	            bytes memory signature,
   658	            bytes memory actionTargetData
   659	        ) = abi.decode(actionData, (ActionData, ActionData, IPermit2.PermitBatchTransferFrom, bytes, bytes));
   660	
   661	        // Withdraw assets to the actionTarget.
   662	        _withdraw(withdrawData.assets, withdrawData.assetIds, withdrawData.assetAmounts, actionTarget);
   663	
   664	        // Transfer assets from owner (that are not assets in this account) to the actionTarget.
   665	        if (transferFromOwnerData.assets.length > 0) {
   666	            _transferFromOwner(transferFromOwnerData, actionTarget);
   667	        }
   668	
   669	        // If the function input includes a signature and non-empty token permissions,
   670	        // initiate a transfer from the owner to the actionTarget via Permit2.
   671	        if (signature.length > 0 && permit.permitted.length > 0) {
   672	            _transferFromOwnerWithPermit(permit, signature, actionTarget);
   673	        }
   674	
   675	        // Execute external logic on the actionTarget.
   676	        ActionData memory depositData = IActionBase(actionTarget).executeAction(actionTargetData);
   677	
   678	        // Deposit assets from actionTarget into Account.
   679	        _deposit(depositData.assets, depositData.assetIds, depositData.assetAmounts, actionTarget);
   680	
   681	        // Account must be healthy after actions are executed.
   682	        if (isAccountUnhealthy()) revert AccountErrors.AccountUnhealthy();
   683	    }
   684	
   685	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   686	                        CREDITOR ACTIONS
   687	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   688	
   689	    /**
   690	     * @notice Checks that the increase of the open position is allowed.
   691	     * @param openPosition The new open position.
   692	     * @return accountVersion The current Account version.
   693	     * @dev The Account performs the following checks when an open position (liabilities) are increased:
   694	     *  - The caller is indeed a Creditor for which a margin account is opened.
   695	     *  - The Account is still healthy after given the new open position.
   696	     */
   697	    function increaseOpenPosition(uint256 openPosition)
   698	        external
   699	        onlyCreditor
   700	        nonReentrant
   701	        notDuringAuction
   702	        updateActionTimestamp
   703	        returns (uint256 accountVersion)
   704	    {
   705	        // If the open position is 0, the Account is always healthy.
   706	        // An Account is unhealthy if the collateral value is smaller than the used margin.
   707	        // The used margin equals the sum of the given open position and the minimum margin.
   708	        if (openPosition > 0 && getCollateralValue() < openPosition + minimumMargin) {
   709	            revert AccountErrors.AccountUnhealthy();
   710	        }
   711	
   712	        accountVersion = ACCOUNT_VERSION;
   713	    }
   714	
   715	    /**
   716	     * @notice Executes a flash action initiated by a Creditor.
   717	     * @param callbackData A bytes object containing the data to execute arbitrary logic on the Creditor.
   718	     * @param actionTarget The contract address of the actionTarget to execute external logic.
   719	     * @param actionData A bytes object containing three structs and two bytes objects.
   720	     * The first struct contains the info about the assets to withdraw from this Account to the actionTarget.
   721	     * The second struct contains the info about the owner's assets that need to be transferred from the owner to the actionTarget.
   722	     * The third struct contains the permit for the Permit2 transfer.
   723	     * The first bytes object contains the signature for the Permit2 transfer.
   724	     * The second bytes object contains the encoded input for the actionTarget.
   725	     * @return accountVersion The current Account version.
   726	     * @dev This function optimistically chains multiple actions together (= do a flash action):
   727	     * - A margin Account can be opened for a new Creditor, if the new Creditor is approved by the Account Owner.
   728	     * - It can execute arbitrary logic on the Creditor (e.g. give a flashloan to the actionTarget).
   729	     * - It can optimistically withdraw assets from the Account to the actionTarget.
   730	     * - It can transfer assets directly from the owner to the actionTarget.
   731	     * - It can execute external logic on the actionTarget, and interact with any DeFi protocol to swap, stake, claim...
   732	     * - It can deposit all recipient tokens from the actionTarget back into the Account.
   733	     * At the very end of the flash action, the following checks are performed:
   734	     * - The Account is in a healthy state (collateral value is greater than open liabilities).
   735	     * - If a new margin Account is opened for a new Creditor, then the Account has no open positions anymore with the old Creditor.
   736	     * If a check fails, the whole transaction reverts.
   737	     * @dev This function can be used to refinance liabilities between different Creditors,
   738	     * without the need to first sell collateral to close the open position of the old Creditor.
   739	     */
   740	    function flashActionByCreditor(bytes calldata callbackData, address actionTarget, bytes calldata actionData)
   741	        external
   742	        nonReentrant
   743	        notDuringAuction
   744	        updateActionTimestamp
   745	        returns (uint256 accountVersion)
   746	    {
   747	        // Cache the current Creditor.
   748	        address currentCreditor = creditor;
   749	
   750	        // The caller has to be or the Creditor of the Account, or an approved Creditor.
   751	        if (msg.sender != currentCreditor && msg.sender != approvedCreditor[owner]) {
   752	            revert AccountErrors.OnlyCreditor();
   753	        }
   754	
   755	        // Decode flash action data.
   756	        (
   757	            ActionData memory withdrawData,
   758	            ActionData memory transferFromOwnerData,
   759	            IPermit2.PermitBatchTransferFrom memory permit,
   760	            bytes memory signature,
   761	            bytes memory actionTargetData
   762	        ) = abi.decode(actionData, (ActionData, ActionData, IPermit2.PermitBatchTransferFrom, bytes, bytes));
   763	
   764	        // Callback to execute external logic on the Creditor.
   765	        ICreditor(msg.sender).flashActionCallback(callbackData);
   766	
   767	        // Withdraw assets to the actionTarget.
   768	        _withdraw(withdrawData.assets, withdrawData.assetIds, withdrawData.assetAmounts, actionTarget);
   769	
   770	        if (msg.sender != currentCreditor) {
   771	            // If the caller is the approved Creditor, a margin Account must be opened for the approved Creditor.
   772	            // And the exposures for the current and approved Creditors need to be updated.
   773	            approvedCreditor[owner] = address(0);
   774	
   775	            (address[] memory assetAddresses, uint256[] memory assetIds, uint256[] memory assetAmounts) =
   776	                generateAssetData();
   777	
   778	            // Remove the exposures of the Account for the current Creditor.
   779	            if (currentCreditor != address(0)) {
   780	                IRegistry(registry).batchProcessWithdrawal(currentCreditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   781	            }
   782	
   783	            // Check if all assets in the Account are allowed by the approved Creditor
   784	            // and add the exposure of the account for the approved Creditor.
   785	            IRegistry(registry).batchProcessDeposit(msg.sender, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   786	
   787	            // Open margin account for the approved Creditor.
   788	            _openMarginAccount(msg.sender);
   789	        }
   790	
   791	        // Transfer assets from owner (that are not assets in this account) to the actionTarget.
   792	        if (transferFromOwnerData.assets.length > 0) {
   793	            _transferFromOwner(transferFromOwnerData, actionTarget);
   794	        }
   795	
   796	        // If the function input includes a signature and non-empty token permissions,
   797	        // initiate a transfer from the owner to the actionTarget via Permit2.
   798	        if (signature.length > 0 && permit.permitted.length > 0) {
   799	            _transferFromOwnerWithPermit(permit, signature, actionTarget);
   800	        }
   801	
   802	        // Execute external logic on the actionTarget.
   803	        ActionData memory depositData = IActionBase(actionTarget).executeAction(actionTargetData);
   804	
   805	        // Deposit assets from actionTarget into Account.
   806	        _deposit(depositData.assets, depositData.assetIds, depositData.assetAmounts, actionTarget);
   807	
   808	        if (currentCreditor != address(0) && msg.sender != currentCreditor) {
   809	            // If the caller is the approved Creditor, the margin Account for the current Creditor (if set) must be closed.
   810	            // closeMarginAccount() checks if there is still an open position (open liabilities) of the Account for the old Creditor.
   811	            // If so, the function reverts.
   812	            ICreditor(currentCreditor).closeMarginAccount(address(this));
   813	        }
   814	
   815	        // Account must be healthy after actions are executed.
   816	        if (isAccountUnhealthy()) revert AccountErrors.AccountUnhealthy();
   817	
   818	        accountVersion = ACCOUNT_VERSION;
   819	    }
   820	
   821	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   822	                          ASSET MANAGEMENT
   823	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   824	
   825	    /**
   826	     * @notice Deposits assets into the Account.
   827	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   828	     * One address for each asset to be deposited, even if multiple assets of the same contract address are deposited.
   829	     * @param assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
   830	     * When depositing an ERC20 token, this will be disregarded, HOWEVER a value (eg. 0) must be set in the array!
   831	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   832	     * When depositing an ERC721 token, this will be disregarded, HOWEVER a value (eg. 1) must be set in the array!
   833	     * @dev All arrays should be of same length, each index in each array corresponding
   834	     * to the same asset that will get deposited. If multiple asset IDs of the same contract address
   835	     * are deposited, the assetAddress must be repeated in assetAddresses.
   836	     * Example inputs:
   837	     * [wETH, DAI, BAYC, SandboxASSET], [0, 0, 15, 2], [10**18, 10**18, 1, 100]
   838	     * [SandboxASSET, SandboxASSET, BAYC, BAYC, wETH], [3, 5, 16, 17, 0], [123, 456, 1, 1, 10**18]
   839	     */
   840	    function deposit(address[] calldata assetAddresses, uint256[] calldata assetIds, uint256[] calldata assetAmounts)
   841	        external
   842	        onlyOwner
   843	        nonReentrant
   844	        notDuringAuction
   845	    {
   846	        // No need to check that all arrays have equal length, this check will be done in the Registry.
   847	        _deposit(assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts, msg.sender);
   848	    }
   849	
   850	    /**
   851	     * @notice Deposits assets into the Account.
   852	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   853	     * @param assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
   854	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   855	     * @param from The assets deposited into the Account will come from this address.
   856	     */
   857	    function _deposit(
   858	        address[] memory assetAddresses,
   859	        uint256[] memory assetIds,
   860	        uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
   861	        address from
   862	    ) internal {
   863	        // Transfer assets to Account before processing them.
   864	        uint256[] memory assetTypes = IRegistry(registry).batchGetAssetTypes(assetAddresses);
   865	        for (uint256 i; i < assetAddresses.length; ++i) {
   866	            // Skip if amount is 0 to prevent storing addresses that have 0 balance.
   867	            if (assetAmounts[i] == 0) continue;
   868	
   869	            if (assetTypes[i] == 1) {
   870	                if (assetIds[i] != 0) revert AccountErrors.InvalidERC20Id();
   871	                _depositERC20(from, assetAddresses[i], assetAmounts[i]);
   872	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 2) {
   873	                if (assetAmounts[i] != 1) revert AccountErrors.InvalidERC721Amount();
   874	                _depositERC721(from, assetAddresses[i], assetIds[i]);
   875	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 3) {
   876	                _depositERC1155(from, assetAddresses[i], assetIds[i], assetAmounts[i]);
   877	            } else {
   878	                revert AccountErrors.UnknownAssetType();
   879	            }
   880	        }
   881	
   882	        if (erc20Stored.length + erc721Stored.length + erc1155Stored.length > ASSET_LIMIT) {
   883	            revert AccountErrors.TooManyAssets();
   884	        }
   885	
   886	        // If no Creditor is set, batchProcessDeposit only checks if the assets can be priced.
   887	        // If a Creditor is set, batchProcessDeposit will also update the exposures of assets and underlying assets for the Creditor.
   888	        IRegistry(registry).batchProcessDeposit(creditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   889	    }
   890	
   891	    /**
   892	     * @notice Withdraws assets from the Account to the owner.
   893	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   894	     * One address for each asset to be withdrawn, even if multiple assets of the same contract address are withdrawn.
   895	     * @param assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
   896	     * For ERC20 assets, the id must be 0.
   897	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   898	     * For ERC721 assets, the amount must be 1.
   899	     * @dev All arrays should be of same length, each index in each array corresponding
   900	     * to the same asset that will get withdrawn. If multiple asset IDs of the same contract address
   901	     * are to be withdrawn, the assetAddress must be repeated in assetAddresses.
   902	     * Example inputs:
   903	     * [wETH, DAI, BAYC, SandboxASSET], [0, 0, 15, 2], [10**18, 10**18, 1, 100]
   904	     * [SandboxASSET, SandboxASSET, BAYC, BAYC, wETH], [3, 5, 16, 17, 0], [123, 456, 1, 1, 10**18]
   905	     * @dev Will fail if the Account is in an unhealthy state after withdrawal (collateral value is smaller than the used margin).
   906	     * If the Account has no open position (liabilities), users are free to withdraw any asset at any time.
   907	     */
   908	    function withdraw(address[] calldata assetAddresses, uint256[] calldata assetIds, uint256[] calldata assetAmounts)
   909	        external
   910	        onlyOwner
   911	        nonReentrant
   912	        notDuringAuction
   913	        updateActionTimestamp
   914	    {
   915	        // No need to check that all arrays have equal length, this check is will be done in the Registry.
   916	        _withdraw(assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts, msg.sender);
   917	
   918	        // Account must be healthy after assets are withdrawn.
   919	        if (isAccountUnhealthy()) revert AccountErrors.AccountUnhealthy();
   920	    }
   921	
   922	    /**
   923	     * @notice Withdraws assets from the Account to the owner.
   924	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   925	     * @param assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
   926	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   927	     * @param to The address to withdraw to.
   928	     * @dev (batch)ProcessWithdrawal handles the accounting of assets in the Registry.
   929	     */
   930	    function _withdraw(
   931	        address[] memory assetAddresses,
   932	        uint256[] memory assetIds,
   933	        uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
   934	        address to
   935	    ) internal {
   936	        // Process assets before transferring them out of the Account.
   937	        // If a Creditor is set, batchProcessWithdrawal will also update the exposures of assets and underlying assets for the Creditor.
   938	        uint256[] memory assetTypes =
   939	            IRegistry(registry).batchProcessWithdrawal(creditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   940	
   941	        for (uint256 i; i < assetAddresses.length; ++i) {
   942	            // Skip if amount is 0 to prevent transferring 0 balances.
   943	            if (assetAmounts[i] == 0) continue;
   944	
   945	            if (assetTypes[i] == 1) {
   946	                if (assetIds[i] != 0) revert AccountErrors.InvalidERC20Id();
   947	                _withdrawERC20(to, assetAddresses[i], assetAmounts[i]);
   948	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 2) {
   949	                if (assetAmounts[i] != 1) revert AccountErrors.InvalidERC721Amount();
   950	                _withdrawERC721(to, assetAddresses[i], assetIds[i]);
   951	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 3) {
   952	                _withdrawERC1155(to, assetAddresses[i], assetIds[i], assetAmounts[i]);
   953	            } else {
   954	                revert AccountErrors.UnknownAssetType();
   955	            }
   956	        }
   957	    }
   958	
   959	    /**
   960	     * @notice Internal function to deposit ERC20 assets.
   961	     * @param from Address the tokens should be transferred from. This address must have approved the Account.
   962	     * @param ERC20Address The contract address of the asset.
   963	     * @param amount The amount of ERC20 assets.
   964	     * @dev Used for all asset type == 1.
   965	     * @dev If the token has not yet been deposited, the ERC20 token address is stored.
   966	     */
   967	    function _depositERC20(address from, address ERC20Address, uint256 amount) internal {
   968	        ERC20(ERC20Address).safeTransferFrom(from, address(this), amount);
   969	
   970	        uint256 currentBalance = erc20Balances[ERC20Address];
   971	
   972	        if (currentBalance == 0) {
   973	            erc20Stored.push(ERC20Address);
   974	        }
   975	
   976	        unchecked {
   977	            erc20Balances[ERC20Address] = currentBalance + amount;
   978	        }
   979	    }
   980	
   981	    /**
   982	     * @notice Internal function to deposit ERC721 tokens.
   983	     * @param from Address the tokens should be transferred from. This address must have approved the Account.
   984	     * @param ERC721Address The contract address of the asset.
   985	     * @param id The ID of the ERC721 token.
   986	     * @dev Used for all asset type == 2.
   987	     * @dev After successful transfer, the function pushes the ERC721 address to the stored token and stored ID array.
   988	     * This may cause duplicates in the ERC721 stored addresses array, but this is intended.
   989	     */
   990	    function _depositERC721(address from, address ERC721Address, uint256 id) internal {
   991	        IERC721(ERC721Address).safeTransferFrom(from, address(this), id);
   992	
   993	        erc721Stored.push(ERC721Address);
   994	        erc721TokenIds.push(id);
   995	    }
   996	
   997	    /**
   998	     * @notice Internal function to deposit ERC1155 tokens.
   999	     * @param from The Address the tokens should be transferred from. This address must have approved the Account.
  1000	     * @param ERC1155Address The contract address of the asset.
  1001	     * @param id The ID of the ERC1155 tokens.
  1002	     * @param amount The amount of ERC1155 tokens.
  1003	     * @dev Used for all asset type == 3.
  1004	     * @dev After successful transfer, the function checks whether the combination of address & ID has already been stored.
  1005	     * If not, the function pushes the new address and ID to the stored arrays.
  1006	     * This may cause duplicates in the ERC1155 stored addresses array, this is intended.
  1007	     */
  1008	    function _depositERC1155(address from, address ERC1155Address, uint256 id, uint256 amount) internal {
  1009	        IERC1155(ERC1155Address).safeTransferFrom(from, address(this), id, amount, "");
  1010	
  1011	        uint256 currentBalance = erc1155Balances[ERC1155Address][id];
  1012	
  1013	        if (currentBalance == 0) {
  1014	            erc1155Stored.push(ERC1155Address);
  1015	            erc1155TokenIds.push(id);
  1016	        }
  1017	
  1018	        unchecked {
  1019	            erc1155Balances[ERC1155Address][id] = currentBalance + amount;
  1020	        }
  1021	    }
  1022	
  1023	    /**
  1024	     * @notice Internal function to withdraw ERC20 assets.
  1025	     * @param to Address the tokens should be sent to.
  1026	     * @param ERC20Address The contract address of the asset.
  1027	     * @param amount The amount of ERC20 assets.
  1028	     * @dev Used for all asset type == 1.
  1029	     * @dev The function checks whether the Account has any leftover balance of said asset.
  1030	     * If not, it will pop() the ERC20 asset address from the stored addresses array.
  1031	     * Note: this shifts the order of erc20Stored!
  1032	     * @dev This check is done using a loop:
  1033	     * gas usage of writing it in a mapping vs extra loops is in favor of extra loops in this case.
  1034	     */
  1035	    function _withdrawERC20(address to, address ERC20Address, uint256 amount) internal {
  1036	        erc20Balances[ERC20Address] -= amount;
  1037	
  1038	        if (erc20Balances[ERC20Address] == 0) {
  1039	            uint256 erc20StoredLength = erc20Stored.length;
  1040	
  1041	            if (erc20StoredLength == 1) {
  1042	                // There was only one ERC20 stored on the contract, safe to remove from array.
  1043	                erc20Stored.pop();
  1044	            } else {
  1045	                for (uint256 i; i < erc20StoredLength; ++i) {
  1046	                    if (erc20Stored[i] == ERC20Address) {
  1047	                        erc20Stored[i] = erc20Stored[erc20StoredLength - 1];
  1048	                        erc20Stored.pop();
  1049	                        break;
  1050	                    }
  1051	                }
  1052	            }
  1053	        }
  1054	
  1055	        ERC20(ERC20Address).safeTransfer(to, amount);
  1056	    }
  1057	
  1058	    /**
  1059	     * @notice Internal function to withdraw ERC721 tokens.
  1060	     * @param to Address the tokens should be sent to.
  1061	     * @param ERC721Address The contract address of the asset.
  1062	     * @param id The ID of the ERC721 token.
  1063	     * @dev Used for all asset type == 2.
  1064	     * @dev The function checks whether any other ERC721 is deposited in the Account.
  1065	     * If not, it pops the stored addresses and stored IDs (pop() of two arrays is 180 gas cheaper than deleting).
  1066	     * If there are, it loops through the stored arrays and searches the ID that's withdrawn,
  1067	     * then replaces it with the last index, followed by a pop().
  1068	     * @dev Sensitive to ReEntrance attacks! SafeTransferFrom therefore done at the end of the function.
  1069	     */
  1070	    function _withdrawERC721(address to, address ERC721Address, uint256 id) internal {
  1071	        uint256 tokenIdLength = erc721TokenIds.length;
  1072	
  1073	        uint256 i;
  1074	        if (tokenIdLength == 1) {
  1075	            // There was only one ERC721 stored on the contract, safe to remove both lists.
  1076	            if (erc721TokenIds[0] != id || erc721Stored[0] != ERC721Address) revert AccountErrors.UnknownAsset();
  1077	            erc721TokenIds.pop();
  1078	            erc721Stored.pop();
  1079	        } else {
  1080	            for (; i < tokenIdLength; ++i) {
  1081	                if (erc721TokenIds[i] == id && erc721Stored[i] == ERC721Address) {
  1082	                    erc721TokenIds[i] = erc721TokenIds[tokenIdLength - 1];
  1083	                    erc721TokenIds.pop();
  1084	                    erc721Stored[i] = erc721Stored[tokenIdLength - 1];
  1085	                    erc721Stored.pop();
  1086	                    break;
  1087	                }
  1088	            }
  1089	            // For loop should break, otherwise we never went into the if-branch, meaning the token being withdrawn
  1090	            // is unknown and not properly deposited.
  1091	            // i + 1 is done after loop, so i reaches tokenIdLength.
  1092	            if (i == tokenIdLength) revert AccountErrors.UnknownAsset();
  1093	        }
  1094	
  1095	        IERC721(ERC721Address).safeTransferFrom(address(this), to, id);
  1096	    }
  1097	
  1098	    /**
  1099	     * @notice Internal function to withdraw ERC1155 tokens.
  1100	     * @param to Address the tokens should be sent to.
  1101	     * @param ERC1155Address The contract address of the asset.
  1102	     * @param id The ID of the ERC1155 tokens.
  1103	     * @param amount The amount of ERC1155 tokens.
  1104	     * @dev Used for all asset types = 3.
  1105	     * @dev After successful transfer, the function checks whether there is any balance left for that ERC1155.
  1106	     * If there is, it simply transfers the tokens.
  1107	     * If not, it checks whether it can pop() (used for gas savings vs delete) the stored arrays.
  1108	     * If there are still other ERC1155's on the contract, it looks for the ID and token address to be withdrawn
  1109	     * and then replaces it with the last index, followed by a pop().
  1110	     * @dev Sensitive to ReEntrance attacks! SafeTransferFrom therefore done at the end of the function.
  1111	     */
  1112	    function _withdrawERC1155(address to, address ERC1155Address, uint256 id, uint256 amount) internal {
  1113	        uint256 tokenIdLength = erc1155TokenIds.length;
  1114	
  1115	        erc1155Balances[ERC1155Address][id] -= amount;
  1116	
  1117	        if (erc1155Balances[ERC1155Address][id] == 0) {
  1118	            if (tokenIdLength == 1) {
  1119	                erc1155TokenIds.pop();
  1120	                erc1155Stored.pop();
  1121	            } else {
  1122	                for (uint256 i; i < tokenIdLength; ++i) {
  1123	                    if (erc1155TokenIds[i] == id) {
  1124	                        if (erc1155Stored[i] == ERC1155Address) {
  1125	                            erc1155TokenIds[i] = erc1155TokenIds[tokenIdLength - 1];
  1126	                            erc1155TokenIds.pop();
  1127	                            erc1155Stored[i] = erc1155Stored[tokenIdLength - 1];
  1128	                            erc1155Stored.pop();
  1129	                            break;
  1130	                        }
  1131	                    }
  1132	                }
  1133	            }
  1134	        }
  1135	
  1136	        IERC1155(ERC1155Address).safeTransferFrom(address(this), to, id, amount, "");
  1137	    }
  1138	
  1139	    /**
  1140	     * @notice Transfers assets directly from the owner to the actionTarget contract.
  1141	     * @param transferFromOwnerData A struct containing the info of all assets transferred from the owner that are not in this account.
  1142	     * @param to The address to withdraw to.
  1143	     */
  1144	    function _transferFromOwner(ActionData memory transferFromOwnerData, address to) internal {
  1145	        uint256 assetAddressesLength = transferFromOwnerData.assets.length;
  1146	        address owner_ = owner;
  1147	        for (uint256 i; i < assetAddressesLength; ++i) {
  1148	            if (transferFromOwnerData.assetAmounts[i] == 0) {
  1149	                // Skip if amount is 0 to prevent transferring 0 balances.
  1150	                continue;
  1151	            }
  1152	
  1153	            if (transferFromOwnerData.assetTypes[i] == 1) {
  1154	                ERC20(transferFromOwnerData.assets[i])
  1155	                    .safeTransferFrom(owner_, to, transferFromOwnerData.assetAmounts[i]);
  1156	            } else if (transferFromOwnerData.assetTypes[i] == 2) {
  1157	                IERC721(transferFromOwnerData.assets[i]).safeTransferFrom(owner_, to, transferFromOwnerData.assetIds[i]);
  1158	            } else if (transferFromOwnerData.assetTypes[i] == 3) {
  1159	                IERC1155(transferFromOwnerData.assets[i])
  1160	                    .safeTransferFrom(
  1161	                        owner_, to, transferFromOwnerData.assetIds[i], transferFromOwnerData.assetAmounts[i], ""
  1162	                    );
  1163	            } else {
  1164	                revert AccountErrors.UnknownAssetType();
  1165	            }
  1166	        }
  1167	    }
  1168	
  1169	    /**
  1170	     * @notice Transfers assets from the owner to the actionTarget contract via Permit2.
  1171	     * @param permit Data specifying the terms of the transfer.
  1172	     * @param signature The signature to verify.
  1173	     * @param to_ The address to withdraw to.
  1174	     */
  1175	    function _transferFromOwnerWithPermit(
  1176	        IPermit2.PermitBatchTransferFrom memory permit,
  1177	        bytes memory signature,
  1178	        address to_
  1179	    ) internal {
  1180	        uint256 tokenPermissionsLength = permit.permitted.length;
  1181	        IPermit2.SignatureTransferDetails[] memory transferDetails =
  1182	            new IPermit2.SignatureTransferDetails[](tokenPermissionsLength);
  1183	
  1184	        for (uint256 i; i < tokenPermissionsLength; ++i) {
  1185	            transferDetails[i].to = to_;
  1186	            transferDetails[i].requestedAmount = permit.permitted[i].amount;
  1187	        }
  1188	
  1189	        PERMIT2.permitTransferFrom(permit, transferDetails, owner, signature);
  1190	    }
  1191	
  1192	    /**
  1193	     * @notice Skims non-deposited assets from the Account.
  1194	     * @param token The contract address of the asset.
  1195	     * @param id The ID of the asset.
  1196	     * @param type_ The asset type of the asset.
  1197	     * @dev Function can retrieve assets that were transferred to the Account but not deposited
  1198	     * or can be used to claim yield for strictly upwards rebasing tokens.
  1199	     */
  1200	    function skim(address token, uint256 id, uint256 type_) public onlyOwner nonReentrant updateActionTimestamp {
  1201	        if (token == address(0)) {
  1202	            (bool success, bytes memory result) = payable(msg.sender).call{ value: address(this).balance }("");
  1203	            require(success, string(result));
  1204	            return;
  1205	        }
  1206	
  1207	        if (type_ == 1) {
  1208	            uint256 balance = ERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));
  1209	            uint256 balanceStored = erc20Balances[token];
  1210	            if (balance > balanceStored) {
  1211	                ERC20(token).safeTransfer(msg.sender, balance - balanceStored);
  1212	            }
  1213	        } else if (type_ == 2) {
  1214	            bool isStored;
  1215	            uint256 erc721StoredLength = erc721Stored.length;
  1216	            for (uint256 i; i < erc721StoredLength; ++i) {
  1217	                if (erc721Stored[i] == token && erc721TokenIds[i] == id) {
  1218	                    isStored = true;
  1219	                    break;
  1220	                }
  1221	            }
  1222	
  1223	            if (!isStored) {
  1224	                IERC721(token).safeTransferFrom(address(this), msg.sender, id);
  1225	            }
  1226	        } else if (type_ == 3) {
  1227	            uint256 balance = IERC1155(token).balanceOf(address(this), id);
  1228	            uint256 balanceStored = erc1155Balances[token][id];
  1229	
  1230	            if (balance > balanceStored) {
  1231	                IERC1155(token).safeTransferFrom(address(this), msg.sender, id, balance - balanceStored, "");
  1232	            }
  1233	        }
  1234	    }
  1235	
  1236	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
  1237	                        HELPER FUNCTIONS
  1238	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
  1239	
  1240	    /**
  1241	     * @notice Returns the total value (mark to market) of the Account in a specific Numeraire
  1242	     * @param numeraire_ The Numeraire to return the value in.
  1243	     * @return accountValue Total value stored in the account, denominated in Numeraire.
  1244	     * @dev Fetches all stored assets with their amounts.
  1245	     * Using a specified Numeraire, fetches the value of all assets in said Numeraire.
  1246	     */
  1247	    function getAccountValue(address numeraire_) external view returns (uint256 accountValue) {
  1248	        (address[] memory assetAddresses, uint256[] memory assetIds, uint256[] memory assetAmounts) =
  1249	            generateAssetData();
  1250	        accountValue = IRegistry(registry).getTotalValue(numeraire_, creditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
  1251	    }
  1252	
  1253	    /**
  1254	     * @notice Generates three arrays of all the stored assets in the Account.
  1255	     * @return assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
  1256	     * @return assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
  1257	     * @return assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
  1258	     * @dev Balances are stored on the contract to prevent working around the deposit limits.
  1259	     * @dev Loops through the stored asset addresses and fills the arrays.
  1260	     * @dev There is no importance of the order in the arrays, but all indexes of the arrays correspond to the same asset.
  1261	     */
  1262	    function generateAssetData()
  1263	        public
  1264	        view
  1265	        returns (address[] memory assetAddresses, uint256[] memory assetIds, uint256[] memory assetAmounts)
  1266	    {
  1267	        uint256 totalLength;
  1268	        unchecked {
  1269	            totalLength = erc20Stored.length + erc721Stored.length + erc1155Stored.length;
  1270	        } // Cannot realistically overflow.
  1271	        assetAddresses = new address[](totalLength);
  1272	        assetIds = new uint256[](totalLength);
  1273	        assetAmounts = new uint256[](totalLength);
  1274	
  1275	        uint256 i;
  1276	        uint256 erc20StoredLength = erc20Stored.length;
  1277	        address cacheAddr;
  1278	        for (; i < erc20StoredLength; ++i) {
  1279	            cacheAddr = erc20Stored[i];
  1280	            assetAddresses[i] = cacheAddr;
  1281	            // Gas: no need to store 0, index will continue anyway.
  1282	            // assetIds[i] = 0;
  1283	            assetAmounts[i] = erc20Balances[cacheAddr];
  1284	        }
  1285	
  1286	        uint256 j;
  1287	        uint256 erc721StoredLength = erc721Stored.length;
  1288	        for (; j < erc721StoredLength; ++j) {
  1289	            cacheAddr = erc721Stored[j];
  1290	            assetAddresses[i] = cacheAddr;
  1291	            assetIds[i] = erc721TokenIds[j];
  1292	            assetAmounts[i] = 1;
  1293	            unchecked {
  1294	                ++i;
  1295	            }
  1296	        }
  1297	
  1298	        uint256 k;
  1299	        uint256 erc1155StoredLength = erc1155Stored.length;
  1300	        uint256 cacheId;
  1301	        for (; k < erc1155StoredLength; ++k) {
  1302	            cacheAddr = erc1155Stored[k];
  1303	            cacheId = erc1155TokenIds[k];
  1304	            assetAddresses[i] = cacheAddr;
  1305	            assetIds[i] = cacheId;
  1306	            assetAmounts[i] = erc1155Balances[cacheAddr][cacheId];
  1307	            unchecked {
  1308	                ++i;
  1309	            }
  1310	        }
  1311	    }
  1312	
  1313	    /*
  1314	    @notice Returns the onERC721Received selector.
  1315	    @dev Needed to receive ERC721 tokens.
  1316	    */
  1317	    function onERC721Received(address, address, uint256, bytes calldata) public pure returns (bytes4) {
  1318	        return this.onERC721Received.selector;
  1319	    }
  1320	
  1321	    /*
  1322	    @notice Returns the onERC1155Received selector.
  1323	    @dev Needed to receive ERC1155 tokens.
  1324	    */
  1325	    function onERC1155Received(address, address, uint256, uint256, bytes calldata) public pure returns (bytes4) {
  1326	        return this.onERC1155Received.selector;
  1327	    }
  1328	
  1329	    /*
  1330	    @notice Called when function selector doesn't match any other.
  1331	    @dev No fallback allowed.
  1332	    */
  1333	    fallback() external {
  1334	        revert AccountErrors.NoFallback();
  1335	    }
  1336	}

   145	    function upgradeAccount(address newImplementation, address newRegistry, uint256, bytes calldata data)
   146	        external

   150	    {

   167	    /**

   178	    /**
   179	     * @notice Finalizes the Upgrade from a different Account version to this version.

   185	     * @dev We delete the deprecated AccountStorageV1 variables.

   187	    function upgradeHook(address, address, uint256, bytes calldata) external {
   188	        if (msg.sender != address(this)) revert AccountErrors.OnlySelf();
   189	        if (registry == address(0)) revert AccountErrors.InvalidRegistry();
   190	
   191	        // Require that no creditor is set and no auctions are ongoing.

   199

   202	        for (uint256 i = 0; i < erc20StoredLength; ++i) {

   250	     * @dev Potential use-cases of the Asset Manager might be to:

   264	    /**
   265	     * @notice Executes a flash action.
   266	     * @param actionTarget The contract address of the actionTarget to execute external logic.
   267	     * @param actionData A bytes object containing three structs and two bytes objects.
   268	     * The first struct contains the info about the assets to withdraw from this Account to the actionTarget.
   269	     * The second struct contains the info about the owner's assets that need to be transferred from the owner to the actionTarget.
   270	     * The third struct contains the permit for the Permit2 transfer.
   271	     * The first bytes object contains the signature for the Permit2 transfer.
   272	     * The second bytes object contains the encoded input for the actionTarget.
   273	     * @dev This function optimistically chains multiple actions together (= do a flash action):
   274	     * - It can optimistically withdraw assets from the Account to the actionTarget.
   275	     * - It can transfer assets directly from the owner to the actionTarget.
   276	     * - It can execute external logic on the actionTarget, and interact with any DeFi protocol to swap, stake, claim...
   277	     * - It can deposit all recipient tokens from the actionTarget back into the Account.
   278	     */
   279	    function flashAction(address actionTarget, bytes calldata actionData)
   280	        external
   281	        payable
   282	        onlyAssetManager
   283	        nonReentrant
   284	        updateActionTimestamp
   285	    {
   286	        // Decode flash action data.
   287	        (
   288	            ActionData memory withdrawData,
   289	            ActionData memory transferFromOwnerData,
   290	            IPermit2.PermitBatchTransferFrom memory permit,
   291	            bytes memory signature,
   292	            bytes memory actionTargetData
   293	        ) = abi.decode(actionData, (ActionData, ActionData, IPermit2.PermitBatchTransferFrom, bytes, bytes));
   294	
   295	        // Withdraw assets to the actionTarget.
   296	        _withdraw(
   297	            withdrawData.assets, withdrawData.assetIds, withdrawData.assetAmounts, withdrawData.assetTypes, actionTarget
   298	        );
   299	
   300	        // Transfer assets from owner (that are not assets in this account) to the actionTarget.
   301	        if (transferFromOwnerData.assets.length > 0) {
   302	            _transferFromOwner(transferFromOwnerData, actionTarget);
   303	        }
   304	
   305	        // If the function input includes a signature and non-empty token permissions,
   306	        // initiate a transfer from the owner to the actionTarget via Permit2.
   307	        if (signature.length > 0 && permit.permitted.length > 0) {
   308	            _transferFromOwnerWithPermit(permit, signature, actionTarget);
   309	        }
   310	
   311	        // Execute external logic on the actionTarget.
   312	        ActionData memory depositData = IActionBase(actionTarget).executeAction(actionTargetData);
   313	
   314	        // Deposit assets from actionTarget into Account.
   315	        _deposit(
   316	            depositData.assets, depositData.assetIds, depositData.assetAmounts, depositData.assetTypes, actionTarget
   317	        );

   329	     * @param assetTypes Array of the asset types.
