   331	    function deposit(
   332	        address[] memory assetAddresses,
   333	        uint256[] memory assetIds,
   334	        uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
   335	        uint256[] memory assetTypes
   336	    ) external payable onlyOwner nonReentrant {
   337	        _deposit(assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts, assetTypes, msg.sender);
   338	    }
   339	
   340	    /**
   341	     * @notice Deposits assets into the Account.
   342	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   343	     * @param assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
   344	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   345	     * @param assetTypes Array of the asset types.
   346	     * @param from The assets deposited into the Account will come from this address.
   347	     */
   348	    function _deposit(
   349	        address[] memory assetAddresses,
   350	        uint256[] memory assetIds,
   351	        uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
   352	        uint256[] memory assetTypes,
   353	        address from
   354	    ) internal {
   355	        for (uint256 i; i < assetAddresses.length; ++i) {
   356	            // Skip if amount is 0 to prevent transferring addresses that have 0 balance.
   357	            if (assetAmounts[i] == 0) continue;
   358	
   359	            if (assetTypes[i] == 1) {
   360	                ERC20(assetAddresses[i]).safeTransferFrom(from, address(this), assetAmounts[i]);
   361	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 2) {
   362	                IERC721(assetAddresses[i]).safeTransferFrom(from, address(this), assetIds[i]);
   363	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 3) {
   364	                IERC1155(assetAddresses[i]).safeTransferFrom(from, address(this), assetIds[i], assetAmounts[i], "");
   365	            } else {
   366	                revert AccountErrors.UnknownAssetType();
   367	            }
   368	        }
   369	    }
   370	
   371	    /**
   372	     * @notice Withdraws assets from the Account to the owner.
   373	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   374	     * @param assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
   375	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   376	     * @param assetTypes Array of the asset types.
   377	     */
   378	    function withdraw(
   379	        address[] memory assetAddresses,
   380	        uint256[] memory assetIds,
   381	        uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
   382	        uint256[] memory assetTypes
   383	    ) public onlyOwner nonReentrant updateActionTimestamp {
   384	        _withdraw(assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts, assetTypes, msg.sender);
   385	    }
   386	
   387	    /**
   388	     * @notice Withdraws assets from the Account.
   389	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   390	     * @param assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
   391	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   392	     * @param assetTypes Array of the asset types.
   393	     * @param to The address to withdraw to.
   394	     */
   395	    function _withdraw(
   396	        address[] memory assetAddresses,
   397	        uint256[] memory assetIds,
   398	        uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
   399	        uint256[] memory assetTypes,
   400	        address to
   401	    ) internal {
   402	        for (uint256 i; i < assetAddresses.length; ++i) {
   403	            // Skip if amount is 0 to prevent transferring addresses that have 0 balance.
   404	            if (assetAmounts[i] == 0) continue;
   405	
   406	            if (assetAddresses[i] == address(0)) {
   407	                (bool success, bytes memory result) = payable(to).call{ value: assetAmounts[i] }("");
   408	                require(success, string(result));
   409	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 1) {
   410	                ERC20(assetAddresses[i]).safeTransfer(to, assetAmounts[i]);
   411	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 2) {
   412	                IERC721(assetAddresses[i]).safeTransferFrom(address(this), to, assetIds[i]);
   413	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 3) {
   414	                IERC1155(assetAddresses[i]).safeTransferFrom(address(this), to, assetIds[i], assetAmounts[i], "");
   415	            } else {
   416	                revert AccountErrors.UnknownAssetType();
   417	            }
   418	        }
   419	    }
   420	
   421	    /**
   422	     * @notice Transfers assets directly from the owner to the actionTarget contract.
   423	     * @param transferFromOwnerData A struct containing the info of all assets transferred from the owner that are not in this account.
   424	     * @param to The address to withdraw to.
   425	     */
   426	    function _transferFromOwner(ActionData memory transferFromOwnerData, address to) internal {
   427	        uint256 assetAddressesLength = transferFromOwnerData.assets.length;
   428	        address owner_ = owner;
   429	        for (uint256 i; i < assetAddressesLength; ++i) {
   430	            // Skip if amount is 0 to prevent transferring 0 balances.
   431	            if (transferFromOwnerData.assetAmounts[i] == 0) continue;
   432	
   433	            if (transferFromOwnerData.assetTypes[i] == 1) {
   434	                ERC20(transferFromOwnerData.assets[i])
   435	                    .safeTransferFrom(owner_, to, transferFromOwnerData.assetAmounts[i]);
   436	            } else if (transferFromOwnerData.assetTypes[i] == 2) {
   437	                IERC721(transferFromOwnerData.assets[i]).safeTransferFrom(owner_, to, transferFromOwnerData.assetIds[i]);
   438	            } else if (transferFromOwnerData.assetTypes[i] == 3) {
   439	                IERC1155(transferFromOwnerData.assets[i])
   440	                    .safeTransferFrom(
   441	                        owner_, to, transferFromOwnerData.assetIds[i], transferFromOwnerData.assetAmounts[i], ""
   442	                    );
   443	            } else {
   444	                revert AccountErrors.UnknownAssetType();
   445	            }
   446	        }
   447	    }
   448	
   449	    /**
   450	     * @notice Transfers assets from the owner to the actionTarget contract via Permit2.
   451	     * @param permit Data specifying the terms of the transfer.
   452	     * @param signature The signature to verify.
   453	     * @param to_ The address to withdraw to.
   454	     */
   455	    function _transferFromOwnerWithPermit(
   456	        IPermit2.PermitBatchTransferFrom memory permit,
   457	        bytes memory signature,
   458	        address to_
   459	    ) internal {
   460	        uint256 tokenPermissionsLength = permit.permitted.length;
   461	        IPermit2.SignatureTransferDetails[] memory transferDetails =
   462	            new IPermit2.SignatureTransferDetails[](tokenPermissionsLength);
   463	
   464	        for (uint256 i; i < tokenPermissionsLength; ++i) {
   465	            transferDetails[i].to = to_;
   466	            transferDetails[i].requestedAmount = permit.permitted[i].amount;
   467	        }
   468	
   469	        PERMIT2.permitTransferFrom(permit, transferDetails, owner, signature);
   470	    }
   471	
   472	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   473	                        HELPER FUNCTIONS
   474	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   475	
   476	    /*
   477	    @notice Returns the onERC721Received selector.
   478	    @dev Needed to receive ERC721 tokens.
   479	    */
   480	    function onERC721Received(address, address, uint256, bytes calldata) public pure returns (bytes4) {
   481	        return this.onERC721Received.selector;
   482	    }
   483	
   484	    /*
   485	    @notice Returns the onERC1155Received selector.
   486	    @dev Needed to receive ERC1155 tokens.
   487	    */
   488	    function onERC1155Received(address, address, uint256, uint256, bytes calldata) public pure returns (bytes4) {
   489	        return this.onERC1155Received.selector;
   490	    }
   491	
   492	    /*
   493	    @notice Called when function selector doesn't match any other.
   494	    @dev No fallback allowed.
   495	    */
   496	    fallback() external {
   497	        revert AccountErrors.NoFallback();
   498	    }
   499	
   500	    /*
   501	    @notice Called on a plain ETH transfer.
   502	    */
   503	    receive() external payable { }
   504	}

   205	    /**

   213	    function upgradeAccount(address newImplementation, address newRegistry, uint256 newVersion, bytes calldata data)

   333	    /**
   334	     * @notice Opens a margin account on the Account for a new Creditor.

   338	     * @dev Only open margin accounts for Creditors you trust!
   339	     * The Creditor has significant authorization: use margin, trigger liquidation, and manage assets.
   340	     */
   341	    function openMarginAccount(address newCreditor)
   342	        external
   343	        onlyOwner
   344	        nonReentrant(WITH_PAUSE_CHECK)
   345	        notDuringAuction
   346	        updateActionTimestamp
   347	    {
   348	        (address[] memory assetAddresses, uint256[] memory assetIds, uint256[] memory assetAmounts) =
   349	            generateAssetData();
   350	
   351	        // Cache old Creditor.
   352	        address oldCreditor = creditor;
   353	        if (oldCreditor == newCreditor) revert AccountErrors.CreditorAlreadySet();
   354	
   355	        // Remove the exposures of the Account for the old Creditor.
   356	        if (oldCreditor != address(0)) {
   357	            IRegistry(registry).batchProcessWithdrawal(oldCreditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   358	        }
   359	
   360	        // Check if all assets in the Account are allowed by the new Creditor
   361	        // and add the exposure of the account for the new Creditor.
   362	        IRegistry(registry).batchProcessDeposit(newCreditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   363	
   364	        // Open margin account for the new Creditor.
   365	        _openMarginAccount(newCreditor);
   366	
   367	        // A margin account can only be opened for one Creditor at a time.
   368	        // If set, close the margin account for the old Creditor.
   369	        if (oldCreditor != address(0)) {
   370	            // closeMarginAccount() checks if there is still an open position (open liabilities) of the Account for the old Creditor.
   371	            // If so, the function reverts.
   372	            ICreditor(oldCreditor).closeMarginAccount(address(this));
   373	        }
   374	    }
   375	
   376	    /**
   377	     * @notice Internal function: Opens a margin account for a new Creditor.
   378	     * @param creditor_ The contract address of the Creditor.
   379	     */
   380	    function _openMarginAccount(address creditor_) internal {
   381	        (bool success, address numeraire_, address liquidator_, uint256 minimumMargin_) =
   382	            ICreditor(creditor_).openMarginAccount(ACCOUNT_VERSION);
   383	        if (!success) revert AccountErrors.InvalidAccountVersion();
   384	
   385	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   386	        minimumMargin = uint96(minimumMargin_);
   387	        if (numeraire != numeraire_) _setNumeraire(numeraire_);
   388	
   389	        emit MarginAccountChanged(creditor = creditor_, liquidator = liquidator_);
   390	    }
   391	
   392	    /**
   393	     * @notice Closes the margin account of the Creditor.
   394	     * @dev Currently only one Creditor can be set.
   395	     */
   396	    function closeMarginAccount() external onlyOwner nonReentrant(WITHOUT_PAUSE_CHECK) notDuringAuction {
   397	        // Cache creditor.
   398	        address creditor_ = creditor;
   399	        if (creditor_ == address(0)) revert AccountErrors.CreditorNotSet();
   400	
   401	        creditor = address(0);
   402	        liquidator = address(0);
   403	        minimumMargin = 0;
   404	
   405	        // Remove the exposures of the Account for the old Creditor.
   406	        (address[] memory assetAddresses, uint256[] memory assetIds, uint256[] memory assetAmounts) =
   407	            generateAssetData();
   408	        IRegistry(registry).batchProcessWithdrawal(creditor_, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   409	
   410	        // closeMarginAccount() checks if there is still an open position (open liabilities) for the Account.
   411	        // If so, the function reverts.
   412	        ICreditor(creditor_).closeMarginAccount(address(this));
   413	
   414	        emit MarginAccountChanged(address(0), address(0));
   415	    }
   416	
   417	    /**
   418	     * @notice Sets an approved Creditor.
   419	     * @param creditor_ The contract address of the approved Creditor.
   420	     * @dev An approved Creditor is a Creditor for which no margin Account is immediately opened.
   421	     * But the approved Creditor itself can open the margin Account later in time to e.g. refinance liabilities.
   422	     * @dev Potential use-cases of the approved Creditor might be to:
   423	     * - Refinance liabilities (change creditor) without having to sell collateral to close the current position first.
   424	     * @dev Anyone can set the approved creditor for themselves, this will not impact the current owner of the Account
   425	     * since the combination of "current owner -> approved creditor" is used in authentication checks.
   426	     * This guarantees that when the ownership of the Account is transferred, the approved Creditor of the old owner has no
   427	     * impact on the new owner. But the new owner can still remove any existing approved Creditors before the transfer.
   428	     */
   429	    function setApprovedCreditor(address creditor_) external nonReentrant(WITH_PAUSE_CHECK) {
   430	        approvedCreditor[msg.sender] = creditor_;
   431	    }
   432	
   433	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   434	                          MARGIN REQUIREMENTS
   435	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   436	
   437	    /**
   438	     * @notice Calculates the total collateral value (MTM discounted with a haircut) of the Account.
   439	     * @return collateralValue The collateral value, returned in the decimal precision of the Numeraire.
   440	     * @dev Returns the value denominated in the Numeraire of the Account.
   441	     * @dev The collateral value of the Account is equal to the spot value of the underlying assets,
   442	     * discounted by a haircut (the collateral factor). Since the value of
   443	     * collateralized assets can fluctuate, the haircut guarantees that the Account
   444	     * remains over-collateralized with a high confidence level.
   445	     * The size of the haircut depends on the underlying risk of the assets in the Account.
   446	     * The bigger the volatility or the smaller the onchain liquidity, the bigger the haircut will be.
   447	     */
   448	    function getCollateralValue() public view returns (uint256 collateralValue) {
   449	        (address[] memory assetAddresses, uint256[] memory assetIds, uint256[] memory assetAmounts) =
   450	            generateAssetData();
   451	        collateralValue =
   452	            IRegistry(registry).getCollateralValue(numeraire, creditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   453	    }
   454	
   455	    /**
   456	     * @notice Calculates the total liquidation value (MTM discounted with a factor to account for slippage) of the Account.
   457	     * @return liquidationValue The liquidation value, returned in the decimal precision of the Numeraire.
   458	     * @dev The liquidation value of the Account is equal to the spot value of the underlying assets,
   459	     * discounted by a haircut (the liquidation factor).
   460	     * The liquidation value takes into account that not the full value of the assets can go towards
   461	     * repaying the liabilities: a fraction of the value is lost due to:
   462	     * slippage while liquidating the assets,
   463	     * fees for the auction initiator,
   464	     * fees for the auction terminator and
   465	     * a penalty to the protocol.
   466	     */
   467	    function getLiquidationValue() public view returns (uint256 liquidationValue) {
   468	        (address[] memory assetAddresses, uint256[] memory assetIds, uint256[] memory assetAmounts) =
   469	            generateAssetData();
   470	        liquidationValue =
   471	            IRegistry(registry).getLiquidationValue(numeraire, creditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   472	    }
   473	
   474	    /**
   475	     * @notice Returns the used margin of the Account.
   476	     * @return usedMargin The total amount of margin that is currently in use to back liabilities.
   477	     * @dev Used Margin is the value of the assets that is currently 'locked' to back:
   478	     *  - All the liabilities issued against the Account.
   479	     *  - An additional fixed buffer to cover gas fees in case of a liquidation.
   480	     * @dev The used margin is denominated in the Numeraire.
   481	     * @dev Currently only one Creditor at a time can open a margin account.
   482	     * The open liability is fetched at the contract of the Creditor -> only allow trusted audited Creditors!!!
   483	     */
   484	    function getUsedMargin() public view returns (uint256 usedMargin) {
   485	        // Cache creditor
   486	        address creditor_ = creditor;
   487	        if (creditor_ == address(0)) return 0;
   488	
   489	        // getOpenPosition() is a view function, cannot modify state.
   490	        usedMargin = ICreditor(creditor_).getOpenPosition(address(this)) + minimumMargin;
   491	    }
   492	
   493	    /**
   494	     * @notice Calculates the remaining margin the owner of the Account can use.
   495	     * @return freeMargin The remaining amount of margin a user can take.
   496	     * @dev Free Margin is the value of the assets that is still free to back additional liabilities.
   497	     * @dev The free margin is denominated in the Numeraire.
   498	     */
   499	    function getFreeMargin() public view returns (uint256 freeMargin) {
   500	        uint256 collateralValue = getCollateralValue();
   501	        uint256 usedMargin = getUsedMargin();
   502	
   503	        unchecked {
   504	            freeMargin = collateralValue > usedMargin ? collateralValue - usedMargin : 0;
   505	        }
   506	    }
   507	
   508	    /**
   509	     * @notice Checks if the Account is unhealthy.
   510	     * @return isUnhealthy Boolean indicating if the Account is unhealthy.
   511	     */
   512	    function isAccountUnhealthy() public view returns (bool isUnhealthy) {
   513	        // If usedMargin is equal to minimumMargin, the open liabilities are 0 and the Account is always healthy.
   514	        // An Account is unhealthy if the collateral value is smaller than the used margin.
   515	        uint256 usedMargin = getUsedMargin();
   516	        isUnhealthy = usedMargin > minimumMargin && getCollateralValue() < usedMargin;
   517	    }
   518	
   519	    /**
   520	     * @notice Checks if the Account can be liquidated.
   521	     * @return success Boolean indicating if the Account can be liquidated.
   522	     */
   523	    function isAccountLiquidatable() external view returns (bool success) {
   524	        // If usedMargin is equal to minimumMargin, the open liabilities are 0 and the Account is never liquidatable.
   525	        // An Account can be liquidated if the liquidation value is smaller than the used margin.
   526	        uint256 usedMargin = getUsedMargin();
   527	        success = usedMargin > minimumMargin && getLiquidationValue() < usedMargin;
   528	    }
   529	
   530	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   531	                          LIQUIDATION LOGIC
   532	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   533	
   534	    /**
   535	     * @notice Checks if an Account is liquidatable and continues the liquidation flow.
   536	     * @param initiator The address of the liquidation initiator.
   537	     * @return assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets in Account.
   538	     * @return assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets in Account.
   539	     * @return assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets in Account.
   540	     * @return creditor_ The contract address of the Creditor.
   541	     * @return minimumMargin_ The minimum margin.
   542	     * @return openPosition The open position (liabilities) issued against the Account.
   543	     * @return assetAndRiskValues Array of asset values and corresponding collateral and liquidation factors.
   544	     */
   545	    function startLiquidation(address initiator)
   546	        external
   547	        onlyLiquidator
   548	        nonReentrant(WITHOUT_PAUSE_CHECK)
   549	        updateActionTimestamp
   550	        returns (
   551	            address[] memory assetAddresses,
   552	            uint256[] memory assetIds,
   553	            uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
   554	            address creditor_,
   555	            uint96 minimumMargin_,
   556	            uint256 openPosition,
   557	            AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory assetAndRiskValues
   558	        )
   559	    {
   560	        inAuction = true;
   561	        creditor_ = creditor;
   562	        minimumMargin_ = minimumMargin;
   563	
   564	        (assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts) = generateAssetData();
   565	        assetAndRiskValues =
   566	            IRegistry(registry).getValuesInNumeraire(numeraire, creditor_, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   567	
   568	        // Since the function is only callable by the Liquidator, we know that a liquidator and a Creditor are set.
   569	        openPosition = ICreditor(creditor_).startLiquidation(initiator, minimumMargin_);
   570	        uint256 usedMargin = openPosition + minimumMargin_;
   571	
   572	        if (openPosition == 0 || assetAndRiskValues._calculateLiquidationValue() >= usedMargin) {
   573	            revert AccountErrors.AccountNotLiquidatable();
   574	        }
   575	    }
   576	
   577	    /**
   578	     * @notice Transfers the asset bought by a bidder during a liquidation event.
   579	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   580	     * @param assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
   581	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   582	     * @param bidder The address of the bidder.
   583	     * @return assetAmounts_ Array with the actual transferred amounts of assets.
   584	     */
   585	    function auctionBid(
   586	        address[] memory assetAddresses,
   587	        uint256[] memory assetIds,
   588	        uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
   589	        address bidder
   590	    ) external onlyLiquidator nonReentrant(WITHOUT_PAUSE_CHECK) returns (uint256[] memory assetAmounts_) {
   591	        uint256[] memory assetTypes = IRegistry(registry).batchGetAssetTypes(assetAddresses);
   592	        uint256 balance;
   593	        for (uint256 i; i < assetAddresses.length; ++i) {
   594	            // Skip if amount is 0.
   595	            if (assetAmounts[i] == 0) continue;
   596	
   597	            if (assetTypes[i] == 1) {
   598	                balance = erc20Balances[assetAddresses[i]];
   599	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 2) {
   600	                balance = (address(this) == IERC721(assetAddresses[i]).ownerOf(assetIds[i])) ? 1 : 0;
   601	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 3) {
   602	                balance = erc1155Balances[assetAddresses[i]][assetIds[i]];
   603	            } else {
   604	                revert AccountErrors.UnknownAssetType();
   605	            }
   606	            if (assetAmounts[i] > balance) assetAmounts[i] = balance;
   607	        }
   608	
   609	        _withdraw(assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts, bidder);
   610	
   611	        // Return the actual withdrawn amounts.
   612	        assetAmounts_ = assetAmounts;
   613	    }
   614	
   615	    /**
   616	     * @notice Transfers all assets of the Account in case the auction did not end successful (= Bought In).
   617	     * @param recipient The recipient address to receive the assets, set by the Creditor.
   618	     * @dev When an auction is not successful, the Account is considered "Bought In":
   619	     * The whole Account including any remaining assets are transferred to a certain recipient address, set by the Creditor.
   620	     */
   621	    function auctionBoughtIn(address recipient) external onlyLiquidator nonReentrant(WITHOUT_PAUSE_CHECK) {
   622	        _transferOwnership(recipient);
   623	    }
   624	
   625	    /**
   626	     * @notice Sets the "inAuction" flag to false when an auction ends.
   627	     */
   628	    function endAuction() external onlyLiquidator nonReentrant(WITHOUT_PAUSE_CHECK) {
   629	        inAuction = false;
   630	    }
   631	
   632	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   633	                       ASSET MANAGER ACTIONS
   634	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   635	
   636	    /**
   637	     * @notice Removes an Asset Manager.
   638	     * @param assetManager The address of the Asset Manager.
   639	     * @dev Anyone can remove an Asset Manager for themselves, this will not impact the current owner of the Account
   640	     * since the combination of "stored owner -> asset manager" is used in authentication checks.
   641	     * This guarantees that when the ownership of the Account is transferred, the asset managers of the old owner have no
   642	     * impact on the new owner. But the new owner can still remove any existing asset managers before the transfer.
   643	     */
   644	    function removeAssetManager(address assetManager) external nonReentrant(WITHOUT_PAUSE_CHECK) {
   645	        emit AssetManagerSet(msg.sender, assetManager, isAssetManager[msg.sender][assetManager] = false);
   646	    }
   647	
   648	    /**
   649	     * @notice Adds, removes or modifies Asset Managers.
   650	     * @param assetManagers Array of Asset Managers.
   651	     * @param statuses Array of Bools indicating if the corresponding Asset Manager should be enabled or disabled.
   652	     * @param datas Array of calldata optionally passed to the corresponding Asset Manager via hook.
   653	     * @dev Only set trusted addresses as Asset Manager. Asset Managers have full control over assets in the Account.
   654	     * @dev No need to set the Owner as Asset Manager as they will automatically have all permissions of an Asset Manager.
   655	     * @dev Potential use-cases of the Asset Manager might be to:
   656	     * - Liquidity Management.
   657	     * - Do flash actions (optimistic actions).
   658	     * - Compounding.
   659	     * - Chain multiple interactions together.
   660	     */
   661	    function setAssetManagers(address[] calldata assetManagers, bool[] calldata statuses, bytes[] calldata datas)
   662	        external
   663	        onlyOwner
   664	        nonReentrant(WITH_PAUSE_CHECK)
   665	        updateActionTimestamp
   666	    {
   667	        if (assetManagers.length != statuses.length || assetManagers.length != datas.length) {
   668	            revert AccountErrors.LengthMismatch();
   669	        }
   670	
   671	        address assetManager;
   672	        for (uint256 i; i < assetManagers.length; ++i) {
   673	            assetManager = assetManagers[i];
   674	            emit AssetManagerSet(msg.sender, assetManager, isAssetManager[msg.sender][assetManager] = statuses[i]);
   675	
   676	            // Optionally call Hook on the Asset Manager to initialize/update it.
   677	            if (datas[i].length > 0) {
   678	                IAssetManager(assetManager).onSetAssetManager(msg.sender, statuses[i], datas[i]);
   679	            }
   680	        }
   681	    }
   682	
   683	    /**
   684	     * @notice Executes a flash action.
   685	     * @param actionTarget The contract address of the actionTarget to execute external logic.
   686	     * @param actionData A bytes object containing three structs and two bytes objects.
   687	     * The first struct contains the info about the assets to withdraw from this Account to the actionTarget.
   688	     * The second struct contains the info about the owner's assets that need to be transferred from the owner to the actionTarget.
   689	     * The third struct contains the permit for the Permit2 transfer.
   690	     * The first bytes object contains the signature for the Permit2 transfer.
   691	     * The second bytes object contains the encoded input for the actionTarget.
   692	     * @dev This function optimistically chains multiple actions together (= do a flash action):
   693	     * - It can optimistically withdraw assets from the Account to the actionTarget.
   694	     * - It can transfer assets directly from the owner to the actionTarget.
   695	     * - It can execute external logic on the actionTarget, and interact with any DeFi protocol to swap, stake, claim...
   696	     * - It can deposit all recipient tokens from the actionTarget back into the Account.
   697	     * At the very end of the flash action, the following check is performed:
   698	     * - The Account is in a healthy state (collateral value is greater than open liabilities).
   699	     * If a check fails, the whole transaction reverts.
   700	     */
   701	    function flashAction(address actionTarget, bytes calldata actionData)
   702	        external
   703	        onlyAssetManager
   704	        nonReentrant(WITH_PAUSE_CHECK)
   705	        notDuringAuction
   706	        updateActionTimestamp
   707	    {
   708	        // Decode flash action data.
   709	        (
   710	            ActionData memory withdrawData,
   711	            ActionData memory transferFromOwnerData,
   712	            IPermit2.PermitBatchTransferFrom memory permit,
   713	            bytes memory signature,
   714	            bytes memory actionTargetData
   715	        ) = abi.decode(actionData, (ActionData, ActionData, IPermit2.PermitBatchTransferFrom, bytes, bytes));
   716	
   717	        // Withdraw assets to the actionTarget.
   718	        _withdraw(withdrawData.assets, withdrawData.assetIds, withdrawData.assetAmounts, actionTarget);
   719	
   720	        // Transfer assets from owner (that are not assets in this account) to the actionTarget.
   721	        _transferFromOwner(transferFromOwnerData, actionTarget);
   722	
   723	        // If the function input includes non-empty token permissions,
   724	        // initiate a transfer from the owner to the actionTarget via Permit2.
   725	        _transferFromOwnerWithPermit(permit, signature, actionTarget);
   726	
   727	        // Execute external logic on the actionTarget.
   728	        ActionData memory depositData = IActionBase(actionTarget).executeAction(actionTargetData);
   729	
   730	        // Deposit assets from actionTarget into Account.
   731	        _deposit(depositData.assets, depositData.assetIds, depositData.assetAmounts, actionTarget);
   732	
   733	        // Account must be healthy after actions are executed.
   734	        if (isAccountUnhealthy()) revert AccountErrors.AccountUnhealthy();
   735	    }
   736	
   737	    /**
   738	     * @notice Removes a Merkl Operator.
   739	     * @param operator The merkl operator.
   740	     */
   741	    function removeMerklOperator(address operator) external onlyOwner nonReentrant(WITHOUT_PAUSE_CHECK) {
   742	        bool enabled = MERKL_DISTRIBUTOR.operators(address(this), operator) > 0;
   743	        if (enabled) MERKL_DISTRIBUTOR.toggleOperator(address(this), operator);
   744	
   745	        emit MerklOperatorSet(operator, false);
   746	    }
   747	
   748	    /**
   749	     * @notice Manages Merkl Operators.
   750	     * @param operators Array of merkl operators.
   751	     * @param operatorStatuses Array of Bools indicating if the corresponding operator should be enabled or disabled.
   752	     * @param operatorDatas Array of calldata optionally passed to the corresponding merkl operator via hook.
   753	     * @param recipient The address of the recipient of the merkl rewards for each of the tokens.
   754	     * @param tokens Array of tokens for which the recipient will be set.
   755	     * @dev A Merkl Operator can claim any pending merkl rewards on behalf of the Account.
   756	     * @dev The recipient will receive the Merkl rewards and only one recipient can be set per token.
   757	     * The Recipient can be the operator itself, the Account itself, the Account owner or any other address.
   758	     * It is up to the Account owner to add/remove/change recipient for some/all tokens when adding/removing/changing operators.
   759	     * @dev The Operator and recipients are NOT reset when transferring ownership of the Account.
   760	     * Since the Account is not involved in the claiming flow, a check on owner must be implemented in the Operator.
   761	     */
   762	    function setMerklOperators(
   763	        address[] calldata operators,
   764	        bool[] calldata operatorStatuses,
   765	        bytes[] calldata operatorDatas,
   766	        address recipient,
   767	        address[] calldata tokens
   768	    ) external onlyOwner nonReentrant(WITH_PAUSE_CHECK) updateActionTimestamp {
   769	        if (operators.length != operatorStatuses.length || operators.length != operatorDatas.length) {
   770	            revert AccountErrors.LengthMismatch();
   771	        }
   772	
   773	        address operator;
   774	        bool currentStatus;
   775	        for (uint256 i; i < operators.length; ++i) {
   776	            operator = operators[i];
   777	            // If the current status is different from the desired status, toggle the status of the operator.
   778	            currentStatus = MERKL_DISTRIBUTOR.operators(address(this), operator) > 0;
   779	            if (operatorStatuses[i] != currentStatus) MERKL_DISTRIBUTOR.toggleOperator(address(this), operator);
   780	
   781	            // Optionally call Hook on the Operator to initialize/update it.
   782	            if (operatorDatas[i].length > 0) {
   783	                IMerklOperator(operator).onSetMerklOperator(msg.sender, operatorStatuses[i], operatorDatas[i]);
   784	            }
   785	
   786	            emit MerklOperatorSet(operator, operatorStatuses[i]);
   787	        }
   788	
   789	        // If provided, set recipient for tokens.
   790	        for (uint256 j; j < tokens.length; ++j) {
   791	            MERKL_DISTRIBUTOR.setClaimRecipient(recipient, tokens[j]);
   792	        }
   793	    }
   794	
   795	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   796	                        CREDITOR ACTIONS
   797	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   798	
   799	    /**
   800	     * @notice Checks that the increase of the open position is allowed.
   801	     * @param openPosition The new open position.
   802	     * @return accountVersion The current Account version.
   803	     * @dev The Account performs the following checks when an open position (liabilities) are increased:
   804	     *  - The caller is indeed a Creditor for which a margin account is opened.
   805	     *  - The Account is still healthy after given the new open position.
   806	     */
   807	    function increaseOpenPosition(uint256 openPosition)
   808	        external
   809	        onlyCreditor
   810	        nonReentrant(WITH_PAUSE_CHECK)
   811	        notDuringAuction
   812	        updateActionTimestamp
   813	        returns (uint256 accountVersion)
   814	    {
   815	        // If the open position is 0, the Account is always healthy.
   816	        // An Account is unhealthy if the collateral value is smaller than the used margin.
   817	        // The used margin equals the sum of the given open position and the minimum margin.
   818	        if (openPosition > 0 && getCollateralValue() < openPosition + minimumMargin) {
   819	            revert AccountErrors.AccountUnhealthy();
   820	        }
   821	
   822	        accountVersion = ACCOUNT_VERSION;
   823	    }
   824	
   825	    /**
   826	     * @notice Executes a flash action initiated by a Creditor.
   827	     * @param callbackData A bytes object containing the data to execute arbitrary logic on the Creditor.
   828	     * @param actionTarget The contract address of the actionTarget to execute external logic.
   829	     * @param actionData A bytes object containing three structs and two bytes objects.
   830	     * The first struct contains the info about the assets to withdraw from this Account to the actionTarget.
   831	     * The second struct contains the info about the owner's assets that need to be transferred from the owner to the actionTarget.
   832	     * The third struct contains the permit for the Permit2 transfer.
   833	     * The first bytes object contains the signature for the Permit2 transfer.
   834	     * The second bytes object contains the encoded input for the actionTarget.
   835	     * @return accountVersion The current Account version.
   836	     * @dev This function optimistically chains multiple actions together (= do a flash action):
   837	     * - A margin Account can be opened for a new Creditor, if the new Creditor is approved by the Account Owner.
   838	     * - It can execute arbitrary logic on the Creditor (e.g. give a flashloan to the actionTarget).
   839	     * - It can optimistically withdraw assets from the Account to the actionTarget.
   840	     * - It can transfer assets directly from the owner to the actionTarget.
   841	     * - It can execute external logic on the actionTarget, and interact with any DeFi protocol to swap, stake, claim...
   842	     * - It can deposit all recipient tokens from the actionTarget back into the Account.
   843	     * At the very end of the flash action, the following checks are performed:
   844	     * - The Account is in a healthy state (collateral value is greater than open liabilities).
   845	     * - If a new margin Account is opened for a new Creditor, then the Account has no open positions anymore with the old Creditor.
   846	     * If a check fails, the whole transaction reverts.
   847	     * @dev This function can be used to refinance liabilities between different Creditors,
   848	     * without the need to first sell collateral to close the open position of the old Creditor.
   849	     */
   850	    function flashActionByCreditor(bytes calldata callbackData, address actionTarget, bytes calldata actionData)
   851	        external
   852	        nonReentrant(WITH_PAUSE_CHECK)
   853	        notDuringAuction
   854	        updateActionTimestamp
   855	        returns (uint256 accountVersion)
   856	    {
   857	        // Cache the current Creditor.
   858	        address currentCreditor = creditor;
   859	
   860	        // The caller has to be or the Creditor of the Account, or an approved Creditor.
   861	        if (msg.sender != currentCreditor && msg.sender != approvedCreditor[owner]) {
   862	            revert AccountErrors.OnlyCreditor();
   863	        }
   864	
   865	        // Decode flash action data.
   866	        ActionData memory transferFromOwnerData;
   867	        IPermit2.PermitBatchTransferFrom memory permit;
   868	        bytes memory signature;
   869	        bytes memory actionTargetData;
   870	        {
   871	            ActionData memory withdrawData;
   872	            (withdrawData, transferFromOwnerData, permit, signature, actionTargetData) =
   873	                abi.decode(actionData, (ActionData, ActionData, IPermit2.PermitBatchTransferFrom, bytes, bytes));
   874	
   875	            // Callback to execute external logic on the Creditor.
   876	            ICreditor(msg.sender).flashActionCallback(callbackData);
   877	
   878	            // Withdraw assets to the actionTarget.
   879	            _withdraw(withdrawData.assets, withdrawData.assetIds, withdrawData.assetAmounts, actionTarget);
   880	        }
   881	
   882	        if (msg.sender != currentCreditor) {
   883	            // If the caller is the approved Creditor, a margin Account must be opened for the approved Creditor.
   884	            // And the exposures for the current and approved Creditors need to be updated.
   885	            approvedCreditor[owner] = address(0);
   886	
   887	            (address[] memory assetAddresses, uint256[] memory assetIds, uint256[] memory assetAmounts) =
   888	                generateAssetData();
   889	
   890	            // Remove the exposures of the Account for the current Creditor.
   891	            if (currentCreditor != address(0)) {
   892	                IRegistry(registry).batchProcessWithdrawal(currentCreditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   893	            }
   894	
   895	            // Check if all assets in the Account are allowed by the approved Creditor
   896	            // and add the exposure of the account for the approved Creditor.
   897	            IRegistry(registry).batchProcessDeposit(msg.sender, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   898	
   899	            // Open margin account for the approved Creditor.
   900	            _openMarginAccount(msg.sender);
   901	        }
   902	
   903	        // Transfer assets from owner (that are not assets in this account) to the actionTarget.
   904	        _transferFromOwner(transferFromOwnerData, actionTarget);
   905	
   906	        // If the function input includes a signature and non-empty token permissions,
   907	        // initiate a transfer from the owner to the actionTarget via Permit2.
   908	        _transferFromOwnerWithPermit(permit, signature, actionTarget);
   909	
   910	        // Execute external logic on the actionTarget.
   911	        ActionData memory depositData = IActionBase(actionTarget).executeAction(actionTargetData);
   912	
   913	        // Deposit assets from actionTarget into Account.
   914	        _deposit(depositData.assets, depositData.assetIds, depositData.assetAmounts, actionTarget);
   915	
   916	        if (currentCreditor != address(0) && msg.sender != currentCreditor) {
   917	            // If the caller is the approved Creditor, the margin Account for the current Creditor (if set) must be closed.
   918	            // closeMarginAccount() checks if there is still an open position (open liabilities) of the Account for the old Creditor.
   919	            // If so, the function reverts.
   920	            ICreditor(currentCreditor).closeMarginAccount(address(this));
   921	        }
   922	
   923	        // Account must be healthy after actions are executed.
   924	        if (isAccountUnhealthy()) revert AccountErrors.AccountUnhealthy();
   925	
   926	        accountVersion = ACCOUNT_VERSION;
   927	    }
   928	
   929	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   930	                          ASSET MANAGEMENT
   931	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   932	
   933	    /**
   934	     * @notice Deposits assets into the Account.
   935	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   936	     * One address for each asset to be deposited, even if multiple assets of the same contract address are deposited.
   937	     * @param assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
   938	     * When depositing an ERC20 token, this will be disregarded, HOWEVER a value (eg. 0) must be set in the array!
   939	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   940	     * When depositing an ERC721 token, this will be disregarded, HOWEVER a value (eg. 1) must be set in the array!
   941	     * @dev All arrays should be of same length, each index in each array corresponding
   942	     * to the same asset that will get deposited. If multiple asset IDs of the same contract address
   943	     * are deposited, the assetAddress must be repeated in assetAddresses.
   944	     * Example inputs:
   945	     * [wETH, DAI, BAYC, SandboxASSET], [0, 0, 15, 2], [10**18, 10**18, 1, 100]
   946	     * [SandboxASSET, SandboxASSET, BAYC, BAYC, wETH], [3, 5, 16, 17, 0], [123, 456, 1, 1, 10**18]
   947	     */
   948	    function deposit(address[] calldata assetAddresses, uint256[] calldata assetIds, uint256[] calldata assetAmounts)
   949	        external
   950	        onlyOwner
   951	        nonReentrant(WITH_PAUSE_CHECK)
   952	        notDuringAuction
   953	    {
   954	        // No need to check that all arrays have equal length, this check will be done in the Registry.
   955	        _deposit(assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts, msg.sender);
   956	    }
   957	
   958	    /**
   959	     * @notice Deposits assets into the Account.
   960	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   961	     * @param assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
   962	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   963	     * @param from The assets deposited into the Account will come from this address.
   964	     */
   965	    function _deposit(
   966	        address[] memory assetAddresses,
   967	        uint256[] memory assetIds,
   968	        uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
   969	        address from
   970	    ) internal {
   971	        // Transfer assets to Account before processing them.
   972	        uint256[] memory assetTypes = IRegistry(registry).batchGetAssetTypes(assetAddresses);
   973	        for (uint256 i; i < assetAddresses.length; ++i) {
   974	            // Skip if amount is 0 to prevent storing addresses that have 0 balance.
   975	            if (assetAmounts[i] == 0) continue;
   976	
   977	            if (assetTypes[i] == 1) {
   978	                if (assetIds[i] != 0) revert AccountErrors.InvalidERC20Id();
   979	                _depositERC20(from, assetAddresses[i], assetAmounts[i]);
   980	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 2) {
   981	                if (assetAmounts[i] != 1) revert AccountErrors.InvalidERC721Amount();
   982	                _depositERC721(from, assetAddresses[i], assetIds[i]);
   983	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 3) {
   984	                _depositERC1155(from, assetAddresses[i], assetIds[i], assetAmounts[i]);
   985	            } else {
   986	                revert AccountErrors.UnknownAssetType();
   987	            }
   988	        }
   989	
   990	        if (erc20Stored.length + erc721Stored.length + erc1155Stored.length > ASSET_LIMIT) {
   991	            revert AccountErrors.TooManyAssets();
   992	        }
   993	
   994	        // If no Creditor is set, batchProcessDeposit only checks if the assets can be priced.
   995	        // If a Creditor is set, batchProcessDeposit will also update the exposures of assets and underlying assets for the Creditor.
   996	        IRegistry(registry).batchProcessDeposit(creditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   997	
   998	        if (assetAddresses.length > 0) {
   999	            emit Transfers(from, address(this), assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts, assetTypes);
  1000	        }
  1001	    }
  1002	
  1003	    /**
  1004	     * @notice Withdraws assets from the Account to the owner.
  1005	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
  1006	     * One address for each asset to be withdrawn, even if multiple assets of the same contract address are withdrawn.
  1007	     * @param assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
  1008	     * For ERC20 assets, the id must be 0.
  1009	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
  1010	     * For ERC721 assets, the amount must be 1.
  1011	     * @dev All arrays should be of same length, each index in each array corresponding
  1012	     * to the same asset that will get withdrawn. If multiple asset IDs of the same contract address
  1013	     * are to be withdrawn, the assetAddress must be repeated in assetAddresses.
  1014	     * Example inputs:
  1015	     * [wETH, DAI, BAYC, SandboxASSET], [0, 0, 15, 2], [10**18, 10**18, 1, 100]
  1016	     * [SandboxASSET, SandboxASSET, BAYC, BAYC, wETH], [3, 5, 16, 17, 0], [123, 456, 1, 1, 10**18]
  1017	     * @dev Will fail if the Account is in an unhealthy state after withdrawal (collateral value is smaller than the used margin).
  1018	     * If the Account has no open position (liabilities), users are free to withdraw any asset at any time.
  1019	     */
  1020	    function withdraw(address[] calldata assetAddresses, uint256[] calldata assetIds, uint256[] calldata assetAmounts)
  1021	        external
  1022	        onlyOwner
  1023	        nonReentrant(WITHOUT_PAUSE_CHECK)
  1024	        notDuringAuction
  1025	        updateActionTimestamp
  1026	    {
  1027	        // No need to check that all arrays have equal length, this check is will be done in the Registry.
  1028	        _withdraw(assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts, msg.sender);
  1029	
  1030	        // Account must be healthy after assets are withdrawn.
  1031	        if (isAccountUnhealthy()) revert AccountErrors.AccountUnhealthy();
  1032	    }
  1033	
  1034	    /**
  1035	     * @notice Withdraws assets from the Account to the owner.
  1036	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
  1037	     * @param assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
  1038	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
  1039	     * @param to The address to withdraw to.
  1040	     * @dev (batch)ProcessWithdrawal handles the accounting of assets in the Registry.
  1041	     */
  1042	    function _withdraw(
  1043	        address[] memory assetAddresses,
  1044	        uint256[] memory assetIds,
  1045	        uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
  1046	        address to
  1047	    ) internal {
  1048	        // Process assets before transferring them out of the Account.
  1049	        // If a Creditor is set, batchProcessWithdrawal will also update the exposures of assets and underlying assets for the Creditor.
  1050	        uint256[] memory assetTypes =
  1051	            IRegistry(registry).batchProcessWithdrawal(creditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
  1052	
  1053	        // If no assets are being withdrawn, return early.
  1054	        if (assetAddresses.length == 0) return;
  1055	
  1056	        for (uint256 i; i < assetAddresses.length; ++i) {
  1057	            // Skip if amount is 0 to prevent transferring 0 balances.
  1058	            if (assetAmounts[i] == 0) continue;
  1059	
  1060	            if (assetTypes[i] == 1) {
  1061	                if (assetIds[i] != 0) revert AccountErrors.InvalidERC20Id();
  1062	                _withdrawERC20(to, assetAddresses[i], assetAmounts[i]);
  1063	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 2) {
  1064	                if (assetAmounts[i] != 1) revert AccountErrors.InvalidERC721Amount();
  1065	                _withdrawERC721(to, assetAddresses[i], assetIds[i]);
  1066	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 3) {
  1067	                _withdrawERC1155(to, assetAddresses[i], assetIds[i], assetAmounts[i]);
  1068	            } else {
  1069	                revert AccountErrors.UnknownAssetType();
  1070	            }
  1071	        }
  1072	
  1073	        emit Transfers(address(this), to, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts, assetTypes);
  1074	    }
  1075	
  1076	    /**
  1077	     * @notice Internal function to deposit ERC20 assets.
  1078	     * @param from Address the tokens should be transferred from. This address must have approved the Account.
  1079	     * @param ERC20Address The contract address of the asset.
  1080	     * @param amount The amount of ERC20 assets.
  1081	     * @dev Used for all asset type == 1.
  1082	     * @dev If the token has not yet been deposited, the ERC20 token address is stored.
  1083	     */
  1084	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function,mixed-case-variable)
  1085	    function _depositERC20(address from, address ERC20Address, uint256 amount) internal {
  1086	        ERC20(ERC20Address).safeTransferFrom(from, address(this), amount);
  1087	
  1088	        uint256 currentBalance = erc20Balances[ERC20Address];
  1089	
  1090	        if (currentBalance == 0) {
  1091	            erc20Stored.push(ERC20Address);
  1092	        }
  1093	
  1094	        unchecked {
  1095	            erc20Balances[ERC20Address] = currentBalance + amount;
  1096	        }
  1097	    }
  1098	
  1099	    /**
  1100	     * @notice Internal function to deposit ERC721 tokens.
  1101	     * @param from Address the tokens should be transferred from. This address must have approved the Account.
  1102	     * @param ERC721Address The contract address of the asset.
  1103	     * @param id The ID of the ERC721 token.
  1104	     * @dev Used for all asset type == 2.
  1105	     * @dev After successful transfer, the function pushes the ERC721 address to the stored token and stored ID array.
  1106	     * This may cause duplicates in the ERC721 stored addresses array, but this is intended.
  1107	     */
  1108	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function,mixed-case-variable)
  1109	    function _depositERC721(address from, address ERC721Address, uint256 id) internal {
  1110	        IERC721(ERC721Address).safeTransferFrom(from, address(this), id);
  1111	
  1112	        erc721Stored.push(ERC721Address);
  1113	        erc721TokenIds.push(id);
  1114	    }
  1115	
  1116	    /**
  1117	     * @notice Internal function to deposit ERC1155 tokens.
  1118	     * @param from The Address the tokens should be transferred from. This address must have approved the Account.
  1119	     * @param ERC1155Address The contract address of the asset.
  1120	     * @param id The ID of the ERC1155 tokens.
  1121	     * @param amount The amount of ERC1155 tokens.
  1122	     * @dev Used for all asset type == 3.
  1123	     * @dev After successful transfer, the function checks whether the combination of address & ID has already been stored.
  1124	     * If not, the function pushes the new address and ID to the stored arrays.
  1125	     * This may cause duplicates in the ERC1155 stored addresses array, this is intended.
  1126	     */
  1127	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function,mixed-case-variable)
  1128	    function _depositERC1155(address from, address ERC1155Address, uint256 id, uint256 amount) internal {
  1129	        IERC1155(ERC1155Address).safeTransferFrom(from, address(this), id, amount, "");
  1130	
  1131	        uint256 currentBalance = erc1155Balances[ERC1155Address][id];
  1132	
  1133	        if (currentBalance == 0) {
  1134	            erc1155Stored.push(ERC1155Address);
  1135	            erc1155TokenIds.push(id);
  1136	        }
  1137	
  1138	        unchecked {
  1139	            erc1155Balances[ERC1155Address][id] = currentBalance + amount;
  1140	        }
  1141	    }
  1142	
  1143	    /**
  1144	     * @notice Internal function to withdraw ERC20 assets.
  1145	     * @param to Address the tokens should be sent to.
  1146	     * @param ERC20Address The contract address of the asset.
  1147	     * @param amount The amount of ERC20 assets.
  1148	     * @dev Used for all asset type == 1.
  1149	     * @dev The function checks whether the Account has any leftover balance of said asset.
  1150	     * If not, it will pop() the ERC20 asset address from the stored addresses array.
  1151	     * Note: this shifts the order of erc20Stored!
  1152	     * @dev This check is done using a loop:
  1153	     * gas usage of writing it in a mapping vs extra loops is in favor of extra loops in this case.
  1154	     */
  1155	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function,mixed-case-variable)
  1156	    function _withdrawERC20(address to, address ERC20Address, uint256 amount) internal {
  1157	        erc20Balances[ERC20Address] -= amount;
  1158	
  1159	        if (erc20Balances[ERC20Address] == 0) {
  1160	            uint256 erc20StoredLength = erc20Stored.length;
  1161	
  1162	            if (erc20StoredLength == 1) {
  1163	                // There was only one ERC20 stored on the contract, safe to remove from array.
  1164	                erc20Stored.pop();
  1165	            } else {
  1166	                for (uint256 i; i < erc20StoredLength; ++i) {
  1167	                    if (erc20Stored[i] == ERC20Address) {
  1168	                        erc20Stored[i] = erc20Stored[erc20StoredLength - 1];
  1169	                        erc20Stored.pop();
  1170	                        break;
  1171	                    }
  1172	                }
  1173	            }
  1174	        }
  1175	
  1176	        ERC20(ERC20Address).safeTransfer(to, amount);
  1177	    }
  1178	
  1179	    /**
  1180	     * @notice Internal function to withdraw ERC721 tokens.
  1181	     * @param to Address the tokens should be sent to.
  1182	     * @param ERC721Address The contract address of the asset.
  1183	     * @param id The ID of the ERC721 token.
  1184	     * @dev Used for all asset type == 2.
  1185	     * @dev The function checks whether any other ERC721 is deposited in the Account.
  1186	     * If not, it pops the stored addresses and stored IDs (pop() of two arrays is 180 gas cheaper than deleting).
  1187	     * If there are, it loops through the stored arrays and searches the ID that's withdrawn,
  1188	     * then replaces it with the last index, followed by a pop().
  1189	     * @dev Sensitive to ReEntrance attacks! SafeTransferFrom therefore done at the end of the function.
  1190	     */
  1191	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function,mixed-case-variable)
  1192	    function _withdrawERC721(address to, address ERC721Address, uint256 id) internal {
  1193	        uint256 tokenIdLength = erc721TokenIds.length;
  1194	
  1195	        uint256 i;
  1196	        if (tokenIdLength == 1) {
  1197	            // There was only one ERC721 stored on the contract, safe to remove both lists.
  1198	            if (erc721TokenIds[0] != id || erc721Stored[0] != ERC721Address) revert AccountErrors.UnknownAsset();
  1199	            erc721TokenIds.pop();
  1200	            erc721Stored.pop();
  1201	        } else {
  1202	            for (; i < tokenIdLength; ++i) {
  1203	                if (erc721TokenIds[i] == id && erc721Stored[i] == ERC721Address) {
  1204	                    erc721TokenIds[i] = erc721TokenIds[tokenIdLength - 1];
  1205	                    erc721TokenIds.pop();
  1206	                    erc721Stored[i] = erc721Stored[tokenIdLength - 1];
  1207	                    erc721Stored.pop();
  1208	                    break;
  1209	                }
  1210	            }
  1211	            // For loop should break, otherwise we never went into the if-branch, meaning the token being withdrawn
  1212	            // is unknown and not properly deposited.
  1213	            // i + 1 is done after loop, so i reaches tokenIdLength.
  1214	            if (i == tokenIdLength) revert AccountErrors.UnknownAsset();
  1215	        }
  1216	
  1217	        IERC721(ERC721Address).safeTransferFrom(address(this), to, id);
  1218	    }
  1219	
  1220	    /**
  1221	     * @notice Internal function to withdraw ERC1155 tokens.
  1222	     * @param to Address the tokens should be sent to.
  1223	     * @param ERC1155Address The contract address of the asset.
  1224	     * @param id The ID of the ERC1155 tokens.
  1225	     * @param amount The amount of ERC1155 tokens.
  1226	     * @dev Used for all asset types = 3.
  1227	     * @dev After successful transfer, the function checks whether there is any balance left for that ERC1155.
  1228	     * If there is, it simply transfers the tokens.
  1229	     * If not, it checks whether it can pop() (used for gas savings vs delete) the stored arrays.
  1230	     * If there are still other ERC1155's on the contract, it looks for the ID and token address to be withdrawn
  1231	     * and then replaces it with the last index, followed by a pop().
  1232	     * @dev Sensitive to ReEntrance attacks! SafeTransferFrom therefore done at the end of the function.
  1233	     */
  1234	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function,mixed-case-variable)
  1235	    function _withdrawERC1155(address to, address ERC1155Address, uint256 id, uint256 amount) internal {
  1236	        uint256 tokenIdLength = erc1155TokenIds.length;
  1237	
  1238	        erc1155Balances[ERC1155Address][id] -= amount;
  1239	
  1240	        if (erc1155Balances[ERC1155Address][id] == 0) {
  1241	            if (tokenIdLength == 1) {
  1242	                erc1155TokenIds.pop();
  1243	                erc1155Stored.pop();
  1244	            } else {
  1245	                for (uint256 i; i < tokenIdLength; ++i) {
  1246	                    if (erc1155TokenIds[i] == id) {
  1247	                        if (erc1155Stored[i] == ERC1155Address) {
  1248	                            erc1155TokenIds[i] = erc1155TokenIds[tokenIdLength - 1];
  1249	                            erc1155TokenIds.pop();
  1250	                            erc1155Stored[i] = erc1155Stored[tokenIdLength - 1];
  1251	                            erc1155Stored.pop();
  1252	                            break;
  1253	                        }
  1254	                    }
  1255	                }
  1256	            }
  1257	        }
  1258	
  1259	        IERC1155(ERC1155Address).safeTransferFrom(address(this), to, id, amount, "");
  1260	    }
  1261	
  1262	    /**
  1263	     * @notice Transfers assets directly from the owner to the actionTarget contract.
  1264	     * @param transferFromOwnerData A struct containing the info of all assets transferred from the owner that are not in this account.
  1265	     * @param to The address to withdraw to.
  1266	     */
  1267	    function _transferFromOwner(ActionData memory transferFromOwnerData, address to) internal {
  1268	        uint256 assetAddressesLength = transferFromOwnerData.assets.length;
  1269	        // If no assets are being transferred, return early.
  1270	        if (assetAddressesLength == 0) return;
  1271	
  1272	        address owner_ = owner;
  1273	        for (uint256 i; i < assetAddressesLength; ++i) {
  1274	            if (transferFromOwnerData.assetAmounts[i] == 0) {
  1275	                // Skip if amount is 0 to prevent transferring 0 balances.
  1276	                continue;
  1277	            }
  1278	
  1279	            if (transferFromOwnerData.assetTypes[i] == 1) {
  1280	                ERC20(transferFromOwnerData.assets[i])
  1281	                    .safeTransferFrom(owner_, to, transferFromOwnerData.assetAmounts[i]);
  1282	            } else if (transferFromOwnerData.assetTypes[i] == 2) {
  1283	                IERC721(transferFromOwnerData.assets[i]).safeTransferFrom(owner_, to, transferFromOwnerData.assetIds[i]);
  1284	            } else if (transferFromOwnerData.assetTypes[i] == 3) {
  1285	                IERC1155(transferFromOwnerData.assets[i])
  1286	                    .safeTransferFrom(
  1287	                        owner_, to, transferFromOwnerData.assetIds[i], transferFromOwnerData.assetAmounts[i], ""
  1288	                    );
  1289	            } else {
  1290	                revert AccountErrors.UnknownAssetType();
  1291	            }
  1292	        }
  1293	
  1294	        emit Transfers(
  1295	            owner_,
  1296	            to,
  1297	            transferFromOwnerData.assets,
  1298	            transferFromOwnerData.assetIds,
  1299	            transferFromOwnerData.assetAmounts,
  1300	            transferFromOwnerData.assetTypes
  1301	        );
  1302	    }
  1303	
  1304	    /**
  1305	     * @notice Transfers assets from the owner to the actionTarget contract via Permit2.
  1306	     * @param permit Data specifying the terms of the transfer.
  1307	     * @param signature The signature to verify.
  1308	     * @param to The address to withdraw to.
  1309	     */
  1310	    function _transferFromOwnerWithPermit(
  1311	        IPermit2.PermitBatchTransferFrom memory permit,
  1312	        bytes memory signature,
  1313	        address to
  1314	    ) internal {
  1315	        uint256 tokenPermissionsLength = permit.permitted.length;
  1316	        // If no assets are being transferred, return early.
  1317	        if (tokenPermissionsLength == 0) return;
  1318	
  1319	        IPermit2.SignatureTransferDetails[] memory transferDetails =
  1320	            new IPermit2.SignatureTransferDetails[](tokenPermissionsLength);
  1321	
  1322	        address[] memory addresses = new address[](tokenPermissionsLength);
  1323	        uint256[] memory amounts = new uint256[](tokenPermissionsLength);
  1324	        uint256[] memory types = new uint256[](tokenPermissionsLength);
  1325	
  1326	        for (uint256 i; i < tokenPermissionsLength; ++i) {
  1327	            transferDetails[i].to = to;
  1328	            transferDetails[i].requestedAmount = permit.permitted[i].amount;
  1329	
  1330	            addresses[i] = permit.permitted[i].token;
  1331	            amounts[i] = permit.permitted[i].amount;
  1332	            types[i] = 1;
  1333	        }
  1334	
  1335	        address owner_ = owner;
  1336	        PERMIT2.permitTransferFrom(permit, transferDetails, owner_, signature);
  1337	
  1338	        emit Transfers(owner_, to, addresses, new uint256[](tokenPermissionsLength), amounts, types);
  1339	    }
  1340	
  1341	    /**
  1342	     * @notice Skims non-deposited assets from the Account.
  1343	     * @param token The contract address of the asset, address(0) for native token.
  1344	     * @param id The ID of the asset.
  1345	     * @param type_ The asset type of the asset.
  1346	     * @dev Function can retrieve assets that were transferred to the Account but not deposited
  1347	     * or can be used to claim yield for strictly upwards rebasing tokens.
  1348	     * @dev Unused input parameters (e.g. id's for ERC20, or type for native token) are not validated,
  1349	     * hence arbitrary value can be emitted in events.
  1350	     */
  1351	    function skim(address token, uint256 id, uint256 type_)
  1352	        external
  1353	        onlyOwner
  1354	        nonReentrant(WITHOUT_PAUSE_CHECK)
  1355	        updateActionTimestamp
  1356	    {
  1357	        uint256 amount;
  1358	        if (token == address(0)) {
  1359	            amount = address(this).balance;
  1360	            (bool success, bytes memory result) = payable(msg.sender).call{ value: amount }("");
  1361	            require(success, string(result));
  1362	        } else if (type_ == 1) {
  1363	            uint256 balance = ERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));
  1364	            uint256 balanceStored = erc20Balances[token];
  1365	            if (balance > balanceStored) {
  1366	                amount = balance - balanceStored;
  1367	                ERC20(token).safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount);
  1368	            }
  1369	        } else if (type_ == 2) {
  1370	            bool isStored;
  1371	            uint256 erc721StoredLength = erc721Stored.length;
  1372	            for (uint256 i; i < erc721StoredLength; ++i) {
  1373	                if (erc721Stored[i] == token && erc721TokenIds[i] == id) {
  1374	                    isStored = true;
  1375	                    break;
  1376	                }
  1377	            }
  1378	
  1379	            if (!isStored) {
  1380	                amount = 1;
  1381	                IERC721(token).safeTransferFrom(address(this), msg.sender, id);
  1382	            }
  1383	        } else if (type_ == 3) {
  1384	            uint256 balance = IERC1155(token).balanceOf(address(this), id);
  1385	            uint256 balanceStored = erc1155Balances[token][id];
  1386	            if (balance > balanceStored) {
  1387	                amount = balance - balanceStored;
  1388	                IERC1155(token).safeTransferFrom(address(this), msg.sender, id, amount, "");
  1389	            }
  1390	        } else {
  1391	            revert AccountErrors.UnknownAssetType();
  1392	        }
  1393	
  1394	        if (amount > 0) emit Skim(address(this), msg.sender, token, id, amount, type_);
  1395	    }
  1396	
  1397	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
  1398	                        HELPER FUNCTIONS
  1399	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
  1400	
  1401	    /**
  1402	     * @notice Returns the total value (mark to market) of the Account in a specific Numeraire
  1403	     * @param numeraire_ The Numeraire to return the value in.
  1404	     * @return accountValue Total value stored in the account, denominated in Numeraire.
  1405	     * @dev Fetches all stored assets with their amounts.
  1406	     * Using a specified Numeraire, fetches the value of all assets in said Numeraire.
  1407	     */
  1408	    function getAccountValue(address numeraire_) external view returns (uint256 accountValue) {
  1409	        (address[] memory assetAddresses, uint256[] memory assetIds, uint256[] memory assetAmounts) =
  1410	            generateAssetData();
  1411	        accountValue = IRegistry(registry).getTotalValue(numeraire_, creditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
  1412	    }
  1413	
  1414	    /**
  1415	     * @notice Generates three arrays of all the stored assets in the Account.
  1416	     * @return assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
  1417	     * @return assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
  1418	     * @return assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
  1419	     * @dev Balances are stored on the contract to prevent working around the deposit limits.
  1420	     * @dev Loops through the stored asset addresses and fills the arrays.
  1421	     * @dev There is no importance of the order in the arrays, but all indexes of the arrays correspond to the same asset.
  1422	     */
  1423	    function generateAssetData()
  1424	        public
  1425	        view
  1426	        returns (address[] memory assetAddresses, uint256[] memory assetIds, uint256[] memory assetAmounts)
  1427	    {
  1428	        uint256 totalLength;
  1429	        unchecked {
  1430	            totalLength = erc20Stored.length + erc721Stored.length + erc1155Stored.length;
  1431	        } // Cannot realistically overflow.
  1432	        assetAddresses = new address[](totalLength);
  1433	        assetIds = new uint256[](totalLength);
  1434	        assetAmounts = new uint256[](totalLength);
  1435	
  1436	        uint256 i;
  1437	        uint256 erc20StoredLength = erc20Stored.length;
  1438	        address cacheAddr;
  1439	        for (; i < erc20StoredLength; ++i) {
  1440	            cacheAddr = erc20Stored[i];
  1441	            assetAddresses[i] = cacheAddr;
  1442	            // Gas: no need to store 0, index will continue anyway.
  1443	            // assetIds[i] = 0;
  1444	            assetAmounts[i] = erc20Balances[cacheAddr];
  1445	        }
  1446	
  1447	        uint256 j;
  1448	        uint256 erc721StoredLength = erc721Stored.length;
  1449	        for (; j < erc721StoredLength; ++j) {
  1450	            cacheAddr = erc721Stored[j];
  1451	            assetAddresses[i] = cacheAddr;
  1452	            assetIds[i] = erc721TokenIds[j];
  1453	            assetAmounts[i] = 1;
  1454	            unchecked {
  1455	                ++i;
  1456	            }
  1457	        }
  1458	
  1459	        uint256 k;
  1460	        uint256 erc1155StoredLength = erc1155Stored.length;
  1461	        uint256 cacheId;
  1462	        for (; k < erc1155StoredLength; ++k) {
  1463	            cacheAddr = erc1155Stored[k];
  1464	            cacheId = erc1155TokenIds[k];
  1465	            assetAddresses[i] = cacheAddr;
  1466	            assetIds[i] = cacheId;
  1467	            assetAmounts[i] = erc1155Balances[cacheAddr][cacheId];
  1468	            unchecked {
  1469	                ++i;
  1470	            }
  1471	        }
  1472	    }
  1473	
  1474	    /*
  1475	    @notice Returns the onERC721Received selector.
  1476	    @dev Needed to receive ERC721 tokens.
  1477	    */
  1478	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function)
  1479	    function onERC721Received(address, address, uint256, bytes calldata) public pure returns (bytes4) {
  1480	        return this.onERC721Received.selector;
  1481	    }
  1482	
  1483	    /*
  1484	    @notice Returns the onERC1155Received selector.
  1485	    @dev Needed to receive ERC1155 tokens.
  1486	    */
  1487	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function)
  1488	    function onERC1155Received(address, address, uint256, uint256, bytes calldata) public pure returns (bytes4) {
  1489	        return this.onERC1155Received.selector;
  1490	    }
  1491	
  1492	    /*
  1493	    @notice Called when function selector doesn't match any other.
  1494	    @dev No fallback allowed.
  1495	    */
  1496	    fallback() external {
  1497	        revert AccountErrors.NoFallback();
  1498	    }
  1499	}

   119	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

   122	
   123	    /**

   128	    constructor(address factory, address accountsGuard, address merklDistributor) {

   141	
   142	    /**
   143	     * @notice Initiates the variables of the Account.

   150	    function initialize(address owner_, address registry_, address)

   160	    /**
   161	     * @notice Upgrades the Account version and stores a new address in the EIP1967 implementation slot.
   162	     * @param newImplementation The new contract address of the Account implementation.

   164	     * @param data Arbitrary data, can contain instructions to execute when updating Account to new implementation.

   167	    function upgradeAccount(address newImplementation, address newRegistry, uint256, bytes calldata data)
   168	        external
   169	        onlyFactory
   170	        nonReentrant(WITHOUT_PAUSE_CHECK)
   171	        updateActionTimestamp
   172	    {
   173	        // Cache old parameters.
   174	        address oldImplementation = _getAddressSlot(IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT).value;

   177	        // Store new parameters.

   189	    /**
   190	     * @notice Returns the "AddressSlot" with member "value" located at "slot".
   191	     * @param slot The slot where the address of the Logic contract is stored.
   192	     * @return r The address stored in slot.

   194	    function _getAddressSlot(bytes32 slot) internal pure returns (AddressSlot storage r) {
   195	        assembly {
   196	            r.slot := slot
   197	        }

   200	    /**
   201	     * @notice Finalizes the Upgrade from a different Account version to this version.
   202	     * param oldImplementation The old contract address of the Account implementation.
   203	     * param oldRegistry The Registry of the old version (might be identical to the new registry)
   204	     * param oldVersion The old version of the Account implementation.
   205	     * param data Arbitrary data, can contain instructions to execute in this function.
   206	     * @dev If upgradeHook() is implemented, it MUST verify that msg.sender == address(this).
   207	     * @dev We delete the deprecated AccountStorageV1 variables.
   208	     */
   209	    function upgradeHook(address, address, uint256, bytes calldata) external {
   210	        if (msg.sender != address(this)) revert AccountErrors.OnlySelf();
   211	        if (registry == address(0)) revert AccountErrors.InvalidRegistry();
   212	
   213	        // Require that no creditor is set and no auctions are ongoing.
   214	        // (This should always be enforced in the old Version we upgrade from, but we do a redundant safety check).
   215	        if (creditor != address(0) || inAuction) revert AccountErrors.InvalidUpgrade();
   216	
   217	        // Delete margin account related storage data (should normally already be empty).
   218	        delete liquidator;
   219	        delete minimumMargin;
   220	        delete numeraire;
   221	
   222	        // Delete asset related storage data.

   229	        delete erc721Stored;

   232	        uint256 erc1155StoredLength = erc1155Stored.length;

   240	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

   244	    /**

   263	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   264	                       ASSET MANAGER ACTIONS

   266	
   267	    /**
   268	     * @notice Removes an Asset Manager.
   269	     * @param assetManager The address of the Asset Manager.

   271	     * since the combination of "stored owner -> asset manager" is used in authentication checks.
   272	     * This guarantees that when the ownership of the Account is transferred, the asset managers of the old owner have no
   273	     * impact on the new owner. But the new owner can still remove any existing asset managers before the transfer.
   274	     */
   275	    function removeAssetManager(address assetManager) external nonReentrant(WITHOUT_PAUSE_CHECK) {
   276	        emit AssetManagerSet(msg.sender, assetManager, isAssetManager[msg.sender][assetManager] = false);
   277	    }
   278	
   279	    /**
   280	     * @notice Adds, removes or modifies Asset Managers.
   281	     * @param assetManagers Array of Asset Managers.
   282	     * @param statuses Array of Bools indicating if the corresponding Asset Manager should be enabled or disabled.
   283	     * @param datas Array of calldata optionally passed to the corresponding Asset Manager via hook.
   284	     * @dev Only set trusted addresses as Asset Manager. Asset Managers have full control over assets in the Account.
   285	     * @dev No need to set the Owner as Asset Manager as they will automatically have all permissions of an Asset Manager.
   286	     * @dev Potential use-cases of the Asset Manager might be to:
   287	     * - Liquidity Management.
   288	     * - Do flash actions (optimistic actions).
   289	     * - Compounding.
   290	     * - Chain multiple interactions together.
   291	     */
   292	    function setAssetManagers(address[] calldata assetManagers, bool[] calldata statuses, bytes[] calldata datas)
   293	        external
   294	        onlyOwner
   295	        nonReentrant(WITH_PAUSE_CHECK)
   296	        updateActionTimestamp
   297	    {
   298	        if (assetManagers.length != statuses.length || assetManagers.length != datas.length) {
   299	            revert AccountErrors.LengthMismatch();
   300	        }

   302	        address assetManager;
   303	        for (uint256 i; i < assetManagers.length; ++i) {

   305	            emit AssetManagerSet(msg.sender, assetManager, isAssetManager[msg.sender][assetManager] = statuses[i]);
   306	
   307	            // Optionally call Hook on the Asset Manager to initialize/update it.
   308	            if (datas[i].length > 0) {
