```solidity
   314	    /**
   315	     * @notice Executes a flash action.
   316	     * @param actionTarget The contract address of the actionTarget to execute external logic.
   317	     * @param actionData A bytes object containing three structs and two bytes objects.
   318	     * The first struct contains the info about the assets to withdraw from this Account to the actionTarget.
   319	     * The second struct contains the info about the owner's assets that need to be transferred from the owner to the actionTarget.
   320	     * The third struct contains the permit for the Permit2 transfer.
   321	     * The first bytes object contains the signature for the Permit2 transfer.
   322	     * The second bytes object contains the encoded input for the actionTarget.
   323	     * @dev This function optimistically chains multiple actions together (= do a flash action):
   324	     * - It can optimistically withdraw assets from the Account to the actionTarget.
   325	     * - It can transfer assets directly from the owner to the actionTarget.
   326	     * - It can execute external logic on the actionTarget, and interact with any DeFi protocol to swap, stake, claim...
   327	     * - It can deposit all recipient tokens from the actionTarget back into the Account.
   328	     */
   329	    function flashAction(address actionTarget, bytes calldata actionData)
   330	        external
   331	        payable
   332	        onlyAssetManager
   333	        nonReentrant(WITH_PAUSE_CHECK)
   334	        updateActionTimestamp
   335	    {
   336	        // Decode flash action data.
   337	        (
   338	            ActionData memory withdrawData,
   339	            ActionData memory transferFromOwnerData,
   340	            IPermit2.PermitBatchTransferFrom memory permit,
   341	            bytes memory signature,
   342	            bytes memory actionTargetData
   343	        ) = abi.decode(actionData, (ActionData, ActionData, IPermit2.PermitBatchTransferFrom, bytes, bytes));
   344	
   345	        // Withdraw assets to the actionTarget.
   346	        _withdraw(
   347	            withdrawData.assets, withdrawData.assetIds, withdrawData.assetAmounts, withdrawData.assetTypes, actionTarget
   348	        );
   349	
   350	        // Transfer assets from owner (that are not assets in this account) to the actionTarget.
   351	        _transferFromOwner(transferFromOwnerData, actionTarget);
   352	
   353	        // If the function input includes non-empty token permissions,
   354	        // initiate a transfer from the owner to the actionTarget via Permit2.
   355	        _transferFromOwnerWithPermit(permit, signature, actionTarget);
   356	
   357	        // Execute external logic on the actionTarget.
   358	        ActionData memory depositData = IActionBase(actionTarget).executeAction(actionTargetData);
   359	
   360	        // Deposit assets from actionTarget into Account.
   361	        _deposit(
   362	            depositData.assets, depositData.assetIds, depositData.assetAmounts, depositData.assetTypes, actionTarget
   363	        );
   364	    }
   365	
   366	    /**
   367	     * @notice Removes a Merkl Operator.
   368	     * @param operator The merkl operator.
   369	     */
   370	    function removeMerklOperator(address operator) external onlyOwner nonReentrant(WITHOUT_PAUSE_CHECK) {
   371	        bool enabled = MERKL_DISTRIBUTOR.operators(address(this), operator) > 0;
   372	        if (enabled) MERKL_DISTRIBUTOR.toggleOperator(address(this), operator);
   373

   376	
   377	    /**
   378	     * @notice Manages Merkl Operators.
   379	     * @param operators Array of merkl operators.
   380	     * @param operatorStatuses Array of Bools indicating if the corresponding operator should be enabled or disabled.
   381	     * @param operatorDatas Array of calldata optionally passed to the corresponding merkl operator via hook.
   382	     * @param recipient The address of the recipient of the merkl rewards for each of the tokens.
   383	     * @param tokens Array of tokens for which the recipient will be set.
   384	     * @dev A Merkl Operator can claim any pending merkl rewards on behalf of the Account.
   385	     * @dev The recipient will receive the Merkl rewards and only one recipient can be set per token.
   386	     * The Recipient can be the operator itself, the Account itself, the Account owner or any other address.
   387	     * It is up to the Account owner to add/remove/change recipient for some/all tokens when adding/removing/changing operators.
   388	     * @dev The Operator and recipients are NOT reset when transferring ownership of the Account.
   389	     * Since the Account is not involved in the claiming flow, a check on owner must be implemented in the Operator.
   390	     */
   391	    function setMerklOperators(
   392	        address[] calldata operators,
   393	        bool[] calldata operatorStatuses,
   394	        bytes[] calldata operatorDatas,
   395	        address recipient,
   396	        address[] calldata tokens
   397	    ) external onlyOwner nonReentrant(WITH_PAUSE_CHECK) updateActionTimestamp {
   398	        if (operators.length != operatorStatuses.length || operators.length != operatorDatas.length) {
   399	            revert AccountErrors.LengthMismatch();
   400	        }
   401	
   402	        address operator;
   403	        bool currentStatus;
   404	        for (uint256 i; i < operators.length; ++i) {
   405	            operator = operators[i];
   406	            // If the current status is different from the desired status, toggle the status of the operator.
   407	            currentStatus = MERKL_DISTRIBUTOR.operators(address(this), operator) > 0;
   408	            if (operatorStatuses[i] != currentStatus) MERKL_DISTRIBUTOR.toggleOperator(address(this), operator);
   409	
   410	            // Optionally call Hook on the Operator to initialize/update it.
   411	            if (operatorDatas[i].length > 0) {
   412	                IMerklOperator(operator).onSetMerklOperator(msg.sender, operatorStatuses[i], operatorDatas[i]);
   413	            }
   414	
   415	            emit MerklOperatorSet(operator, operatorStatuses[i]);
   416	        }
   417	
   418	        // If provided, set recipient for tokens.
   419	        for (uint256 j; j < tokens.length; ++j) {
   420	            MERKL_DISTRIBUTOR.setClaimRecipient(recipient, tokens[j]);
   421	        }
   422	    }
   423	
   424	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   425	                          ASSET MANAGEMENT
   426	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   427	
   428	    /**
   429	     * @notice Deposits assets into the Account.
   430	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   431	     * @param assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
   432	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   433	     * @param assetTypes Array of the asset types.
   434	     */
   435	    function deposit(
   436	        address[] memory assetAddresses,
   437	        uint256[] memory assetIds,
   438	        uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
   439	        uint256[] memory assetTypes
   440	    ) external payable onlyOwner nonReentrant(WITH_PAUSE_CHECK) {
   441	        _deposit(assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts, assetTypes, msg.sender);
   442	    }
   443	
   444	    /**
   445	     * @notice Deposits assets into the Account.
   446	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   447	     * @param assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
   448	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   449	     * @param assetTypes Array of the asset types.
   450	     * @param from The assets deposited into the Account will come from this address.
   451	     */
   452	    function _deposit(
   453	        address[] memory assetAddresses,
   454	        uint256[] memory assetIds,
   455	        uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
   456	        uint256[] memory assetTypes,
   457	        address from
   458	    ) internal {
   459	        // If no assets are being deposited, return early.
   460	        if (assetAddresses.length == 0) return;
   461	
   462	        for (uint256 i; i < assetAddresses.length; ++i) {
   463	            // Skip if amount is 0 to prevent transferring addresses that have 0 balance.
   464	            if (assetAmounts[i] == 0) continue;
   465	
   466	            if (assetTypes[i] == 1) {
   467	                ERC20(assetAddresses[i]).safeTransferFrom(from, address(this), assetAmounts[i]);
   468	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 2) {
   469	                IERC721(assetAddresses[i]).safeTransferFrom(from, address(this), assetIds[i]);
   470	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 3) {
   471	                IERC1155(assetAddresses[i]).safeTransferFrom(from, address(this), assetIds[i], assetAmounts[i], "");
   472	            } else {
   473	                revert AccountErrors.UnknownAssetType();
   474	            }
   475	        }
   476	
   477	        emit Transfers(from, address(this), assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts, assetTypes);
   478	    }
   479	
   480	    /**
   481	     * @notice Withdraws assets from the Account to the owner.
   482	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   483	     * @param assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
   484	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   485	     * @param assetTypes Array of the asset types.
   486	     */
   487	    function withdraw(
   488	        address[] memory assetAddresses,
   489	        uint256[] memory assetIds,
   490	        uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
   491	        uint256[] memory assetTypes
   492	    ) public onlyOwner nonReentrant(WITHOUT_PAUSE_CHECK) updateActionTimestamp {
   493	        _withdraw(assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts, assetTypes, msg.sender);
   494	    }
   495	
   496	    /**
   497	     * @notice Withdraws assets from the Account.
   498	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   499	     * @param assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
   500	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   501	     * @param assetTypes Array of the asset types.
   502	     * @param to The address to withdraw to.
   503	     */
   504	    function _withdraw(
   505	        address[] memory assetAddresses,
   506	        uint256[] memory assetIds,
   507	        uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
   508	        uint256[] memory assetTypes,
   509	        address to
   510	    ) internal {
   511	        // If no assets are being withdrawn, return early.
   512	        if (assetAddresses.length == 0) return;
   513	
   514	        for (uint256 i; i < assetAddresses.length; ++i) {
   515	            // Skip if amount is 0 to prevent transferring addresses that have 0 balance.
   516	            if (assetAmounts[i] == 0) continue;
   517	
   518	            if (assetAddresses[i] == address(0)) {
   519	                (bool success, bytes memory result) = payable(to).call{ value: assetAmounts[i] }("");
   520	                require(success, string(result));
   521	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 1) {
   522	                ERC20(assetAddresses[i]).safeTransfer(to, assetAmounts[i]);
   523	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 2) {
   524	                IERC721(assetAddresses[i]).safeTransferFrom(address(this), to, assetIds[i]);
   525	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 3) {
   526	                IERC1155(assetAddresses[i]).safeTransferFrom(address(this), to, assetIds[i], assetAmounts[i], "");
   527	            } else {
   528	                revert AccountErrors.UnknownAssetType();
   529	            }
   530	        }
   531	
   532	        emit Transfers(address(this), to, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts, assetTypes);
   533	    }
   534	
   535	    /**
   536	     * @notice Transfers assets directly from the owner to the actionTarget contract.
   537	     * @param transferFromOwnerData A struct containing the info of all assets transferred from the owner that are not in this account.
   538	     * @param to The address to withdraw to.
   539	     */
   540	    function _transferFromOwner(ActionData memory transferFromOwnerData, address to) internal {
   541	        uint256 assetAddressesLength = transferFromOwnerData.assets.length;
   542	        // If no assets are being transferred, return early.
   543	        if (assetAddressesLength == 0) return;
   544	
   545	        address owner_ = owner;
   546	        for (uint256 i; i < assetAddressesLength; ++i) {
   547	            // Skip if amount is 0 to prevent transferring 0 balances.
   548	            if (transferFromOwnerData.assetAmounts[i] == 0) continue;
   549	
   550	            if (transferFromOwnerData.assetTypes[i] == 1) {
   551	                ERC20(transferFromOwnerData.assets[i])
   552	                    .safeTransferFrom(owner_, to, transferFromOwnerData.assetAmounts[i]);
   553	            } else if (transferFromOwnerData.assetTypes[i] == 2) {
   554	                IERC721(transferFromOwnerData.assets[i]).safeTransferFrom(owner_, to, transferFromOwnerData.assetIds[i]);
   555	            } else if (transferFromOwnerData.assetTypes[i] == 3) {
   556	                IERC1155(transferFromOwnerData.assets[i])
   557	                    .safeTransferFrom(
   558	                        owner_, to, transferFromOwnerData.assetIds[i], transferFromOwnerData.assetAmounts[i], ""
   559	                    );
   560	            } else {
   561	                revert AccountErrors.UnknownAssetType();
   562	            }
   563	        }
   564	
   565	        emit Transfers(
   566	            owner_,
   567	            to,
   568	            transferFromOwnerData.assets,
   569	            transferFromOwnerData.assetIds,
   570	            transferFromOwnerData.assetAmounts,
   571	            transferFromOwnerData.assetTypes
   572	        );
   573	    }
   574	
   575	    /**
   576	     * @notice Transfers assets from the owner to the actionTarget contract via Permit2.
   577	     * @param permit Data specifying the terms of the transfer.
   578	     * @param signature The signature to verify.
   579	     * @param to The address to withdraw to.
   580	     */
   581	    function _transferFromOwnerWithPermit(
   582	        IPermit2.PermitBatchTransferFrom memory permit,
   583	        bytes memory signature,
   584	        address to
   585	    ) internal {
   586	        uint256 tokenPermissionsLength = permit.permitted.length;
   587	        // If no assets are being transferred, return early.
   588	        if (tokenPermissionsLength == 0) return;
   589	
   590	        IPermit2.SignatureTransferDetails[] memory transferDetails =
   591	            new IPermit2.SignatureTransferDetails[](tokenPermissionsLength);
   592	
   593	        address[] memory addresses = new address[](tokenPermissionsLength);
   594	        uint256[] memory amounts = new uint256[](tokenPermissionsLength);
   595	        uint256[] memory types = new uint256[](tokenPermissionsLength);
   596	
   597	        for (uint256 i; i < tokenPermissionsLength; ++i) {
   598	            transferDetails[i].to = to;
   599	            transferDetails[i].requestedAmount = permit.permitted[i].amount;
   600	
   601	            addresses[i] = permit.permitted[i].token;
   602	            amounts[i] = permit.permitted[i].amount;
   603	            types[i] = 1;
   604	        }
   605	
   606	        address owner_ = owner;
   607	        PERMIT2.permitTransferFrom(permit, transferDetails, owner_, signature);
   608	
   609	        emit Transfers(owner_, to, addresses, new uint256[](tokenPermissionsLength), amounts, types);
   610	    }
   611	
   612	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   613	                        HELPER FUNCTIONS
   614	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   615	
   616	    /*
   617	    @notice Returns the onERC721Received selector.
   618	    @dev Needed to receive ERC721 tokens.
   619	    */
   620	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function)
   621	    function onERC721Received(address, address, uint256, bytes calldata) public pure returns (bytes4) {
   622	        return this.onERC721Received.selector;
   623	    }
   624	
   625	    /*
   626	    @notice Returns the onERC1155Received selector.
   627	    @dev Needed to receive ERC1155 tokens.
   628	    */
   629	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function)
   630	    function onERC1155Received(address, address, uint256, uint256, bytes calldata) public pure returns (bytes4) {
   631	        return this.onERC1155Received.selector;
   632	    }
   633	
   634	    /*
   635	    @notice Called when function selector doesn't match any other.
   636	    @dev No fallback allowed.
   637	    */
   638	    fallback() external {
   639	        revert AccountErrors.NoFallback();
   640	    }
   641	
   642	    /*
   643	    @notice Called on a plain ETH transfer.
   644	    */
   645	    receive() external payable { }
   646	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/accounts/helpers/AccountsGuard.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { IFactory } from "../../interfaces/IFactory.sol";
     8	import { Owned } from "../../../lib/solmate/src/auth/Owned.sol";
     9	
    10	/**
    11	 * @title Guard for preventing multi Account reentrancy and cross account pausing.
    12	 * @author Pragma Labs
    13	 */
    14	contract AccountsGuard is Owned {
    15	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    16	                                CONSTANTS
    17	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    18	
    19	    // The contract address of the Arcadia Factory.
    20	    IFactory public immutable ARCADIA_FACTORY;
    21	
    22	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    23	                                STORAGE
    24	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    25	
    26	    // Flag indicating if the functionalities are paused.
    27	    bool public paused;
    28	
    29	    // Address of the Guardian.
    30	    address public guardian;
    31	
    32	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    33	                          TRANSIENT STORAGE
    34	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    35	
    36	    // The address of the Arcadia Account that initiated the lock.
    37	    address internal transient account;
    38	
    39	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    40	                                ERRORS
    41	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    42	
    43	    error Locked();
    44	    error OnlyAccount();
    45	    error OnlyGuardian();
    46	    error Paused();
    47	    error Reentered();
    48	
    49	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    50	                                EVENTS
    51	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    52	
    53	    event GuardianChanged(address indexed user, address indexed newGuardian);
    54	    event PauseFlagsUpdated(bool pauseUpdate);
    55	
    56	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    57	                                MODIFIERS
    58	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    59	
    60	    /**
    61	     * @dev Throws when caller is not the guardian.
    62	     */
    63	    modifier onlyGuardian() {
    64	        if (msg.sender != guardian) revert OnlyGuardian();
    65	        _;
    66	    }
    67	
    68	    /**
    69	     * @dev Throws if the functionalities are paused.
    70	     */
    71	    modifier whenNotPaused() {
    72	        if (paused) revert Paused();
    73	        _;
    74	    }
    75	
    76	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    77	                            CONSTRUCTOR
    78	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    79	
    80	    /**
    81	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    82	     * @param arcadiaFactory The contract address of the Arcadia Factory.
    83	     */
    84	    constructor(address owner_, address arcadiaFactory) Owned(owner_) {
    85	        ARCADIA_FACTORY = IFactory(arcadiaFactory);
    86	    }
    87	
    88	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    89	                        REENTRANCY GUARD LOGIC
    90	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    91	
    92	    /**
    93	     * @notice Locks the cross accounts guard.
    94	     * @param pauseCheck Bool indicating if a pause check should be done.
    95	     * @dev Serves as a cross account reentrancy and pause guard.
    96	     * @dev lock() and unlock() should always be called atomically at the beginning and end of any Account-function
    97	     * that should be protected by the cross accounts guard.
    98	     * The guard gives NO reentrancy protection for non atomic flows.
    99	     * @dev If the AccountsGuard gets in an invalid state due to a faulty implementation in an Account
   100	     * where the Guard was locked but not unlocked (should never happen in practice),
   101	     * then only calls within the same transaction as the faulty call will revert.
   102	     */
   103	    function lock(bool pauseCheck) external {
   104	        if (pauseCheck && paused) revert Paused();
   105	        if (account != address(0)) revert Reentered();
   106	        if (!ARCADIA_FACTORY.isAccount(msg.sender)) revert OnlyAccount();
   107	
   108	        account = msg.sender;
   109	    }
   110	
   111	    /**
   112	     * @notice Unlocks the cross accounts guard.
   113	     * @dev lock() and unlock() should always be called atomically at the beginning and end of any Account-function
   114	     * that should be protected by the cross accounts guard.
   115	     * The guard gives NO reentrancy protection for non atomic flows.
   116	     */
   117	    function unLock() external {
   118	        if (account != msg.sender) revert OnlyAccount();
   119	
   120	        account = address(0);
   121	    }
   122	
   123	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   124	                        PAUSE GUARD LOGIC
   125	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   126	
   127	    /**
   128	     * @notice Sets a new guardian.
   129	     * @param guardian_ The address of the new guardian.
   130	     */
   131	    function changeGuardian(address guardian_) external onlyOwner {
   132	        emit GuardianChanged(msg.sender, guardian = guardian_);
   133	    }
   134	
   135	    /**
   136	     * @notice Pauses all functionalities.
   137	     */
   138	    function pause() external onlyGuardian whenNotPaused {
   139	        emit PauseFlagsUpdated(paused = true);
   140	    }
   141	
   142	    /**
   143	     * @notice Sets the pause flag.
   144	     * @param paused_ Flag indicating if the functionalities are paused.
   145	     */
   146	    function setPauseFlag(bool paused_) external onlyOwner {
   147	        emit PauseFlagsUpdated(paused = paused_);
   148	    }
   149	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/accounts/helpers/SpotToMarginMigrator.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { ERC20 } from "../../../lib/solmate/src/tokens/ERC20.sol";
     8	import { IAccountSpot } from "../../interfaces/IAccountSpot.sol";
     9	import { IAccountV1 } from "../../interfaces/IAccountV1.sol";
    10	import { IERC1155 } from "../../interfaces/IERC1155.sol";
    11	import { IERC721 } from "../../interfaces/IERC721.sol";
    12	import { IFactory } from "../../interfaces/IFactory.sol";
    13	import { SafeTransferLib } from "../../../lib/solmate/src/utils/SafeTransferLib.sol";
    14	
    15	/**
    16	 * @title SpotToMarginMigrator.
    17	 * @author Pragma Labs
    18	 * @notice This contracts acts as a facilitator to upgrade an Arcadia Spot Account to a Margin Account.
    19	 * @notice The upgrade process consists of two steps. First, the Account owner must call upgradeAccount().
    20	 * Second, after any cool-down period in the Spot Account, the owner must call endUpgrade() to receive their Margin Account back.
    21	 */
    22	// forge-lint: disable-next-item(all)
    23	contract SpotToMarginMigrator {
    24	    using SafeTransferLib for ERC20;
    25	
    26	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    27	                                CONSTANTS
    28	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    29	
    30	    // The contract address of the Arcadia Accounts Factory.
    31	    IFactory public immutable FACTORY;
    32	
    33	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    34	                                STORAGE
    35	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    36	
    37	    // Map an Account to its owner, used to keep track of account owner during upgrade.
    38	    mapping(address account => address owner) internal accountToOwner;
    39	
    40	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    41	                                ERRORS
    42	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    43	
    44	    error CreditorNotValid();
    45	    error NotOwner();
    46	    error NoUpgradeOngoing();
    47	
    48	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    49	                              CONSTRUCTOR
    50	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    51	
    52	    /**
    53	     * @param factory The contract address of the Arcadia Accounts Factory.
    54	     */
    55	    constructor(address factory) {
    56	        FACTORY = IFactory(factory);
    57	    }
    58	
    59	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    60	                               MIGRATION
    61	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    62	
    63	    /**
    64	     * @notice This function will upgrade a Spot Account to a Margin Account.
    65	     * @param account The Account to upgrade.
    66	     * @param creditor The creditor that will be set on the Margin Account.
    67	     * @param newVersion The Account Version of the Margin Account.
    68	     * @param proofs The Merkle proofs that prove the compatibility of the upgrade from current to new account version.
    69	     * @param assets The assets that needs to be withdrawn from the Spot Account and deposited in the Margin Account.
    70	     * Only assets deposited via the deposit function in the Margin Account will be accounted as collateral.
    71	     * @param assetIds The assetIds of respective assets to withdraw from Spot Account and Deposit in Margin Account.
    72	     * @param assetAmounts The amount of respective assets to withdraw from Spot Account and Deposit in Margin Account.
    73	     * @param assetTypes The asset types of respective assets to withdraw from Spot Account and Deposit in Margin Account.
    74	     * @dev The upgrade is a two-step process. As withdraw function uses a cool-down period during which ownership cannot be transferred.
    75	     * This prevents the old Owner from frontrunning a transferFrom().
    76	     * User needs to call endUpgrade() after cool-down period to transfer the upgraded Margin Account to the user.
    77	     */
    78	    function upgradeAccount(
    79	        address account,
    80	        address creditor,
    81	        uint256 newVersion,
    82	        bytes32[] memory proofs,
    83	        address[] memory assets,
    84	        uint256[] memory assetIds,
    85	        uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
    86	        uint256[] memory assetTypes
    87	    ) external {
    88	        if (msg.sender != IAccountSpot(account).owner()) revert NotOwner();
    89	        if (creditor == address(0)) revert CreditorNotValid();
    90	        // Transfer the Account
    91	        FACTORY.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), account);
    92	        // Withdraw assets from the account
    93	        IAccountSpot(account).withdraw(assets, assetIds, assetAmounts, assetTypes);
    94	        // Upgrade account
    95	        FACTORY.upgradeAccountVersion(account, newVersion, proofs);
    96	        // Approve all assets to deposit in Account
    97	        _approveAllAssets(account, assets, assetIds, assetAmounts, assetTypes);
    98	        // Deposit assets in new Account version
    99	        IAccountV1(account).deposit(assets, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   100	        // Open margin account
   101	        IAccountV1(account).openMarginAccount(creditor);
   102	        // Keep track of the owner of the Account, mapping will be set to the zero address when upgrade is complete.
   103	        accountToOwner[account] = msg.sender;
   104	    }
   105	
   106	    /**
   107	     * @notice Call this function after the cool-down period of the initial Spot Account has passed (following upgradeAccount()).
   108	     * This will finalize the upgrade and transfer the Margin Account to its owner.
   109	     * @param account The Account to transfer back to its owner after the cool-down period.
   110	     */
   111	    function endUpgrade(address account) external {
   112	        // Cache owner of account.
   113	        address accountOwner = accountToOwner[account];
   114	        // Check if account is being upgraded.
   115	        if (accountOwner == address(0)) revert NoUpgradeOngoing();
   116	        // Remove owner from Account in storage
   117	        accountToOwner[account] = address(0);
   118	        // Transfer Account back to owner
   119	        FACTORY.safeTransferFrom(address(this), accountOwner, account);
   120	    }
   121	
   122	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   123	                        HELPER FUNCTIONS
   124	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   125	
   126	    /**
   127	     * @notice This internal function approves all assets that needs to be deposited in the Account on an upgrade.
   128	     * @param account The Account to upgrade.
   129	     * @param assets The assets to approve for deposit in the Account.
   130	     * @param assetIds The assetIds of respective assets to approve.
   131	     * @param assetAmounts The amount of respective assets to approve.
   132	     * @param assetTypes The asset types of respective assets to approve.
   133	     * @dev The same data is used for withdrawal from the Spot Account and deposit into the Margin Account.
   134	     * This approach eliminates the risk of leftover assets that could potentially be taken advantage of during subsequent Account upgrades.
   135	     */
   136	    function _approveAllAssets(
   137	        address account,
   138	        address[] memory assets,
   139	        uint256[] memory assetIds,
   140	        uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
   141	        uint256[] memory assetTypes
   142	    ) internal {
   143	        for (uint256 i; i < assets.length; ++i) {
   144	            // Skip if amount is 0, no approval needed.
   145	            if (assetAmounts[i] == 0) continue;
   146	            if (assetTypes[i] == 1) {
   147	                ERC20(assets[i]).safeApprove(account, assetAmounts[i]);
   148	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 2) {
   149	                IERC721(assets[i]).approve(account, assetIds[i]);
   150	            } else if (assetTypes[i] == 3) {
   151	                IERC1155(assets[i]).setApprovalForAll(account, true);
   152	            }
   153	        }
   154	    }
   155	
   156	    /*
   157	    @notice Returns the onERC721Received selector.
   158	    @dev Needed to receive ERC721 tokens.
   159	    */
   160	    function onERC721Received(address, address, uint256, bytes calldata) public pure returns (bytes4) {
   161	        return this.onERC721Received.selector;
   162	    }
   163	
   164	    /*
   165	    @notice Returns the onERC1155Received selector.
   166	    @dev Needed to receive ERC1155 tokens.
   167	    */
   168	    function onERC1155Received(address, address, uint256, uint256, bytes calldata) public pure returns (bytes4) {
   169	        return this.onERC1155Received.selector;
   170	    }
   171	}
```

```solidity
     1	/**

     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;

     7	import { AssetValuationLib, AssetValueAndRiskFactors } from "../../libraries/AssetValuationLib.sol";
     8	import { DerivedAM, FixedPointMathLib, IRegistry } from "../abstracts/AbstractDerivedAM.sol";
     9	import { ERC20 } from "../../../lib/solmate/src/tokens/ERC20.sol";

    14	/**
    15	 * @title Asset-Module for Aerodrome Finance Pools
    16	 * @author Pragma Labs
    17	 * @notice The AerodromePoolAM stores pricing logic and basic information for Aerodrome Finance Pools
    18	 * @dev No end-user should directly interact with the AerodromePoolAM, only the Registry, the contract owner or via the actionHandler
    19	 */
    20	contract AerodromePoolAM is DerivedAM {
    21	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    22	
    23	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    24	                                CONSTANTS
    25	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    26	
    27	    // The Aerodrome Finance Factory
    28	    IAeroFactory public immutable AERO_FACTORY;
    29	
    30	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    31	                                STORAGE
    32	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    33	
    34	    // Maps an Aerodrome Finance pool to its underlying assets.
    35	    mapping(bytes32 asset => bytes32[] underlyingAssets) public assetToUnderlyingAssets;
    36	
    37	    // Maps an asset to its struct with information.
    38	    mapping(address asset => AssetInformation) public assetToInformation;
    39	
    40	    // Struct with additional information for a specific pool.
    41	    struct AssetInformation {
    42	        bool stable;
    43	        uint64 unitCorrection0;
    44	        uint64 unitCorrection1;
    45	    }
    46	
    47	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    48	                                ERRORS
    49	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    50	
    51	    error AssetNotAllowed();
    52	    error InvalidPool();
    53	
    54	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    55	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    56	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    57	
    58	    /**
    59	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    60	     * @param registry_ The address of the Registry.
    61	     * @param aerodromeFactory The contract address of the pool factory of Aerodrome Finance.
    62	     * @dev The ASSET_TYPE, necessary for the deposit and withdraw logic in the Accounts, is "1" for ERC20 tokens.
    63	     */
    64	    constructor(address owner_, address registry_, address aerodromeFactory) DerivedAM(owner_, registry_, 1) {
    65	        AERO_FACTORY = IAeroFactory(aerodromeFactory);
    66	    }
    67	
    68	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    69	                        ASSET MANAGEMENT
    70	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    71	
    72	    /**
    73	     * @notice Adds a new Aerodrome pool to the AerodromePoolAM.
    74	     * @param pool The contract address of the Aerodrome Finance pool.
    75	     * @dev Owner should not add stable pools where one of the tokens has or can have a very high supply (>15511800964 * 10 ** decimals)
    76	     * Since tokens with very high supply might cause an overflow in _getTrustedReservesStable().
    77	     */
    78	    function addAsset(address pool) external onlyOwner {
    79	        if (!AERO_FACTORY.isPool(pool)) revert InvalidPool();
    80	
    81	        (address token0, address token1) = IAeroPool(pool).tokens();
    82	        if (!IRegistry(REGISTRY).isAllowed(token0, 0)) revert AssetNotAllowed();
    83	        if (!IRegistry(REGISTRY).isAllowed(token1, 0)) revert AssetNotAllowed();
    84	
    85	        if (IAeroPool(pool).stable()) {
    86	            assetToInformation[pool] = AssetInformation({
    87	                stable: true,
    88	                unitCorrection0: uint64(10 ** (18 - ERC20(token0).decimals())),
    89	                unitCorrection1: uint64(10 ** (18 - ERC20(token1).decimals()))
    90	            });
    91	        }
    92	
    93	        inAssetModule[pool] = true;
    94	
    95	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetsKey = new bytes32[](2);
    96	        underlyingAssetsKey[0] = _getKeyFromAsset(token0, 0);
    97	        underlyingAssetsKey[1] = _getKeyFromAsset(token1, 0);
    98	
    99	        assetToUnderlyingAssets[_getKeyFromAsset(pool, 0)] = underlyingAssetsKey;
   100	
   101	        // Will revert in Registry if Aerodrome Finance pool was already added.
   102	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   103	        IRegistry(REGISTRY).addAsset(uint96(ASSET_TYPE), pool);
   104	    }
   105	
   106	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   107	                        ASSET INFORMATION
   108	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   109	
   110	    /**
   111	     * @notice Checks for a token address and the corresponding id if it is allowed.
   112	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   113	     * @return allowed A boolean, indicating if the asset is allowed.
   114	     */
   115	    function isAllowed(address asset, uint256) public view override returns (bool allowed) {
   116	        if (inAssetModule[asset]) allowed = true;
   117	    }
   118	
   119	    /**
   120	     * @notice Returns the unique identifier of an asset based on the contract address and id.
   121	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   122	     * param assetId The Id of the asset.
   123	     * @return key The unique identifier.
   124	     * @dev The assetId is hard-coded to 0, since both the assets as underlying assets for this Asset Module are ERC20's.
   125	     */
   126	    function _getKeyFromAsset(address asset, uint256) internal pure override returns (bytes32 key) {
   127	        assembly {
   128	            key := asset
   129	        }
   130	    }
   131	
   132	    /**
   133	     * @notice Returns the contract address and id of an asset based on the unique identifier.
   134	     * @param key The unique identifier.
   135	     * @return asset The contract address of the asset.
   136	     * @return assetId The Id of the asset.
   137	     * @dev The assetId is hard-coded to 0, since both the assets as underlying assets for this Asset Module are ERC20's.
   138	     */
   139	    function _getAssetFromKey(bytes32 key) internal pure override returns (address asset, uint256) {
   140	        assembly {
   141	            asset := key
   142	        }
   143	
   144	        return (asset, 0);
   145	    }
   146	
   147	    /**
   148	     * @notice Returns the unique identifiers of the underlying assets.
   149	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   150	     * @return underlyingAssetKeys The unique identifiers of the underlying assets.
   151	     */
   152	    function _getUnderlyingAssets(bytes32 assetKey)
   153	        internal
   154	        view
   155	        override
   156	        returns (bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys)
   157	    {
   158	        underlyingAssetKeys = assetToUnderlyingAssets[assetKey];
   159	    }
   160	
   161	    /**
   162	     * @notice Calculates for a given amount of Asset the corresponding amount(s) of underlying asset(s).
   163	     * @param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
   164	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   165	     * @param amount The amount of the Asset, in the decimal precision of the Asset.
   166	     * @param underlyingAssetKeys The unique identifiers of the underlying assets.
   167	     * @return underlyingAssetsAmounts The corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s), in the decimal precision of the Underlying Asset.
   168	     * @return rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The usd rates of 10**18 tokens of underlying asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   169	     */
   170	    function _getUnderlyingAssetsAmounts(
   171	        address creditor,
   172	        bytes32 assetKey,
   173	        uint256 amount,
   174	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys
   175	    )
   176	        internal
   177	        view
   178	        override
   179	        returns (uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts, AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd)
   180	    {
   181	        underlyingAssetsAmounts = new uint256[](2);
   182	        rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd = _getRateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd(creditor, underlyingAssetKeys);
   183	
   184	        // If one of the assets has a rate of 0, the whole LP positions will have a value of zero.
   185	        if (rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue == 0 || rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue == 0) {
   186	            return (underlyingAssetsAmounts, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd);
   187	        }
   188	
   189	        (address pool,) = _getAssetFromKey(assetKey);
   190	
   191	        // Calculate the trusted reserves of the pool.
   192	        (uint256 trustedReserve0, uint256 trustedReserve1) = assetToInformation[pool].stable
   193	            ? _getTrustedReservesStable(pool, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd)
   194	            : _getTrustedReservesVolatile(pool, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd);
   195	
   196	        // Cache totalSupply
   197	        uint256 totalSupply = IAeroPool(pool).totalSupply();
   198	
   199	        underlyingAssetsAmounts[0] = trustedReserve0.mulDivDown(amount, totalSupply);
   200	        underlyingAssetsAmounts[1] = trustedReserve1.mulDivDown(amount, totalSupply);
   201	
   202	        return (underlyingAssetsAmounts, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd);
   203	    }
   204	
   205	    /**
   206	     * @notice Calculates the trusted reserves of a volatile Aerodrome pool.
   207	     * @param pool The contract address of the pool.
   208	     * @param rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The usd rates of 10**18 tokens of underlying asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   209	     * @return trustedReserve0 The trusted reserve of token0.
   210	     * @return trustedReserve1 The trusted reserve of token1.
   211	     * @dev The trusted reserves (r0' and r1') must satisfy two conditions:
   212	     *  1) The pool is in equilibrium with external markets.
   213	     *     r0' * P0usd = r1' * P1usd
   214	     *     With P0usd and P1usd the trusted usd prices of both Underlying Assets.
   215	     *  2) The invariant, k, of the pool is equal for both the trusted and untrusted reserves.
   216	     *     k(r0', r1') = k(r0, r1)
   217	     *     The invariant is defined as: k(r0, r1) = r0 * r1
   218	     * From these two conditions, the trusted reserves can be calculated as follows:
   219	     *  3) Condition 1) can be rewritten as:
   220	     *     r1' = r0' * P0usd / P1usd
   221	     *  4) We plug 3) into 2) and solve for r0':
   222	     *     r0' = √[P1usd * k / P0usd]
   223	     *  5) Calculate r1' from r1':
   224	     *     r1' = r0' * P0usd / P1usd
   225	     */
   226	    function _getTrustedReservesVolatile(address pool, AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd)
   227	        internal
   228	        view
   229	        returns (uint256 trustedReserve0, uint256 trustedReserve1)
   230	    {
   231	        // Calculate k from the untrusted reserves:
   232	        // k = r0 * r1
   233	        (uint256 reserve0, uint256 reserve1,) = IAeroPool(pool).getReserves();
   234	        uint256 k = reserve0 * reserve1;
   235	
   236	        // Calculate trusted reserves:
   237	        // r0' = √[P1usd * k / P0usd]
   238	        trustedReserve0 = FixedPointMathLib.sqrt(
   239	            FullMath.mulDiv(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue, k, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue)
   240	        );
   241	
   242	        // r1' = r0' * P0usd / P1usd
   243	        trustedReserve1 = FullMath.mulDiv(
   244	            trustedReserve0, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue
   245	        );
   246	    }
   247	
   248	    /**
   249	     * @notice Calculates the trusted reserves of a stable Aerodrome pool.
   250	     * @param pool The contract address of the pool.
   251	     * @param rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The usd rates of 10**18 tokens of underlying asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   252	     * @return trustedReserve0 The trusted reserve of token0.
   253	     * @return trustedReserve1 The trusted reserve of token1.
   254	     * @dev The trusted reserves (r0' and r1') must satisfy two conditions:
   255	     *  1) The pool is in equilibrium with external markets.
   256	     *     r0' * P0usd = r1' * P1usd
   257	     *     With P0usd and P1usd the trusted usd prices of both Underlying Assets.
   258	     *  2) The invariant, k, of the pool is equal for both the trusted and untrusted reserves.
   259	     *     k(r0', r1') = k(r0, r1)
   260	     *     Stable aerodrome pools use a correction for the underlying token amounts to bring them to 18 decimals:
   261	     *     x = r0 * 10^(18 - D0).
   262	     *     y = r1 * 10^(18 - D1).
   263	     *     The invariant is defined as: k = x³y + y³x
   264	     * From these two conditions, the trusted reserves can be calculated as follows:
   265	     *  3) We plug the definition of x and y into 1) and rewrite it as:
   266	     *     y = x * [P0usd / 10^(18 - D0)] / [P1usd / 10^(18 - D1)]
   267	     *     => y = x * p0 / p1
   268	     *     With p0 = P0usd / 10^(18 - D0) and p1 = P1usd / 10^(18 - D1)
   269	     *  4) We plug 3) into 2) and solve for x:
   270	     *     x = ∜[k(r0, r1) * p1³ / (p0 * p1² + p0³)]
   271	     *  5) Calculate r0' and r1' from x:
   272	     *     r0' = x / 10^(18 - D0)
   273	     *     r1' = r0' * P0usd / P1usd
   274	     */
   275	    function _getTrustedReservesStable(address pool, AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd)
   276	        internal
   277	        view
   278	        returns (uint256 trustedReserve0, uint256 trustedReserve1)
   279	    {
   280	        // Calculate k from the untrusted reserves:
   281	        // k = x³y + y³x
   282	        // => k = xy * (x² + y²)
   283	        // => k = a * b
   284	        // Note: we use 36 decimals precision for k, instead of the 18 decimals used in Aerodromes Pool.sol.
   285	        uint256 k;
   286	        uint256 unitCorrection0 = assetToInformation[pool].unitCorrection0;
   287	        uint256 unitCorrection1 = assetToInformation[pool].unitCorrection1;
   288	        {
   289	            (uint256 reserve0, uint256 reserve1,) = IAeroPool(pool).getReserves();
   290	            // Stable aerodrome pools use a correction for the underlying token amounts to bring them to 18 decimals:
   291	            // x = r0 * 10^(18 - D0).
   292	            // y = r1 * 10^(18 - D1).
   293	            uint256 x = reserve0 * unitCorrection0; // 18 decimals.
   294	            uint256 y = reserve1 * unitCorrection1; // 18 decimals.
   295	            uint256 a = x.mulDivDown(y, 1e18); // 18 decimals.
   296	            uint256 b = (x * x + y * y) / 1e18; // 18 decimals.
   297	            k = a * b; // 36 decimals.
   298	        }
   299	
   300	        // Calculate x:
   301	        // x = ∜[k(r0, r1) * p1³ / (p0 * p1² + p0³)]
   302	        // => x = √{p1 * √[(k * p1 / p0) / (p0² + p1²)]}
   303	        // => x = √{p1 * √[c / d]}
   304	        {
   305	            // USD rates also have to be corrected as shown in 3).
   306	            uint256 p0 = rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue / unitCorrection0; // 18 decimals.
   307	            uint256 p1 = rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue / unitCorrection1; // 18 decimals.
   308	            uint256 c = FullMath.mulDiv(k, p1, p0); // 36 decimals.
   309	            uint256 d = p0 * p0 + p1 * p1; // 36 decimals.
   310	            // Sqrt halves the number of decimals.
   311	            uint256 x = FixedPointMathLib.sqrt(p1 * FixedPointMathLib.sqrt(FullMath.mulDiv(1e36, c, d))); // 18 decimals.
   312	
   313	            // Bring reserve0 from 18 decimals precision to the actual token decimals.
   314	            // r0' = x / 10^(18 - D0).
   315	            trustedReserve0 = x / unitCorrection0;
   316	        }
   317	
   318	        // r1' = r0' * P0usd / P1usd
   319	        trustedReserve1 = FullMath.mulDiv(
   320	            trustedReserve0, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue
   321	        );
   322	    }
   323	
   324	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   325	                    RISK VARIABLES MANAGEMENT
   326	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   327	
   328	    /**
   329	     * @notice Returns the risk factors of an asset for a Creditor.
   330	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   331	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   332	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   333	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   334	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   335	     */
   336	    function getRiskFactors(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId)
   337	        external
   338	        view
   339	        override
   340	        returns (uint16 collateralFactor, uint16 liquidationFactor)
   341	    {
   342	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys = _getUnderlyingAssets(_getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId));
   343	
   344	        address[] memory assets = new address[](2);
   345	        (assets[0],) = _getAssetFromKey(underlyingAssetKeys[0]);
   346	        (assets[1],) = _getAssetFromKey(underlyingAssetKeys[1]);
   347	
   348	        (uint16[] memory collateralFactors, uint16[] memory liquidationFactors) =
   349	            IRegistry(REGISTRY).getRiskFactors(creditor, assets, new uint256[](2));
   350	
   351	        // Lower risk factors with the protocol wide risk factor.
   352	        uint256 riskFactor = riskParams[creditor].riskFactor;
   353	
   354	        // Keep the lowest risk factor of all underlying assets.
   355	        // Unsafe cast: collateralFactor and liquidationFactor are smaller than or equal to 1e4.
   356	        collateralFactor = uint16(
   357	            collateralFactors[0] < collateralFactors[1]
   358	                ? riskFactor.mulDivDown(collateralFactors[0], AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   359	                : riskFactor.mulDivDown(collateralFactors[1], AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   360	        );
   361	        liquidationFactor = uint16(
   362	            liquidationFactors[0] < liquidationFactors[1]
   363	                ? riskFactor.mulDivDown(liquidationFactors[0], AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   364	                : riskFactor.mulDivDown(liquidationFactors[1], AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   365	        );
   366	    }
   367	
   368	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   369	                          PRICING LOGIC
   370	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   371	
   372	    /**
   373	     * @notice Returns the USD value of an asset.
   374	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   375	     * @param underlyingAssetsAmounts The corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s), in the decimal precision of the Underlying Asset.
   376	     * @param rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The USD rates of 10**18 tokens of underlying asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   377	     * @return valueInUsd The value of the asset denominated in USD, with 18 Decimals precision.
   378	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   379	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   380	     * @dev We take the most conservative (lowest) risk factor of all underlying assets.
   381	     */
   382	    function _calculateValueAndRiskFactors(
   383	        address creditor,
   384	        uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts,
   385	        AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd
   386	    ) internal view override returns (uint256 valueInUsd, uint256 collateralFactor, uint256 liquidationFactor) {
   387	        // "rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd" is the USD value with 18 decimals precision for 10**18 tokens of Underlying Asset.
   388	        // To get the USD value (also with 18 decimals) of the actual amount of underlying assets, we have to multiply
   389	        // the actual amount with the rate for 10**18 tokens, and divide by 10**18.
   390	        valueInUsd = underlyingAssetsAmounts[0].mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue, 1e18)
   391	            + underlyingAssetsAmounts[1].mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue, 1e18);
   392	
   393	        // Lower risk factors with the protocol wide risk factor.
   394	        uint256 riskFactor = riskParams[creditor].riskFactor;
   395	
   396	        // Keep the lowest risk factor of all underlying assets.
   397	        collateralFactor = rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].collateralFactor < rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].collateralFactor
   398	            ? riskFactor.mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].collateralFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   399	            : riskFactor.mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].collateralFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4);
   400	        liquidationFactor = rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].liquidationFactor
   401	            < rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].liquidationFactor
   402	            ? riskFactor.mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].liquidationFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   403	            : riskFactor.mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].liquidationFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4);
   404	    }
   405	}
```

```solidity
    11	/**
    12	 * @title Asset Module for Staked Aerodrome Finance pools
    13	 * @author Pragma Labs
    14	 * @notice The Staked Aerodrome Finance Asset Module stores pricing logic
    15	 * and basic information for Staked Aerodrome Finance LP pools.
    16	 */
    17	contract StakedAerodromeAM is StakingAM {
    18	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    19	                                CONSTANTS
    20	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    21	
    22	    IAeroVoter public immutable AERO_VOTER;
    23	
    24	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    25	                                STORAGE
    26	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    27	
    28	    // Bool indicating if the AssetModule has been initialized and rewardToken is allowed.
    29	    bool internal initialized;
    30	
    31	    // Maps an Aerodrome Finance Pool to its gauge.
    32	    mapping(address asset => address gauge) public assetToGauge;
    33	
    34	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    35	                                ERRORS
    36	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    37	
    38	    error AssetAlreadySet();
    39	    error GaugeNotValid();
    40	    error PoolNotAllowed();
    41	    error RewardTokenNotAllowed();
    42	    error RewardTokenNotValid();
    43	
    44	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    45	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    46	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    47	
    48	    /**
    49	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    50	     * @param registry The address of the Registry.
    51	     * @param aerodromeVoter The address of the Aerodrome Finance Voter contract.
    52	     * @param rewardToken The contract address of the Reward Token.
    53	     * @dev The ASSET_TYPE, necessary for the deposit and withdraw logic in the Accounts, is "2" for ERC721 tokens.
    54	     */
    55	    constructor(address owner_, address registry, address aerodromeVoter, address rewardToken)
    56	        StakingAM(owner_, registry, "Arcadia Staked Aerodrome Positions", "aSAEROP")
    57	    {
    58	        REWARD_TOKEN = ERC20(rewardToken);
    59	        AERO_VOTER = IAeroVoter(aerodromeVoter);
    60	    }
    61	
    62	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    63	                            ASSET MANAGEMENT
    64	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    65	
    66	    /**
    67	     * @notice Adds a new Staked Aerodrome Finance pool to the StakedAerodromeAM.
    68	     * @param gauge The contract address of the gauge to stake the Aerodrome Finance LP.
    69	     */
    70	    function addAsset(address gauge) external {
    71	        if (!AERO_VOTER.isGauge(gauge)) revert GaugeNotValid();
    72	
    73	        address pool = IAeroGauge(gauge).stakingToken();
    74	        if (!IRegistry(REGISTRY).isAllowed(pool, 0)) revert PoolNotAllowed();
    75	        if (assetState[pool].allowed) revert AssetAlreadySet();
    76	
    77	        if (IAeroGauge(gauge).rewardToken() != address(REWARD_TOKEN)) revert RewardTokenNotValid();
    78	        if (!initialized) {
    79	            if (!IRegistry(REGISTRY).isAllowed(address(REWARD_TOKEN), 0)) revert RewardTokenNotAllowed();
    80	            initialized = true;
    81	        }
    82	
    83	        assetToGauge[pool] = gauge;
    84	        _addAsset(pool);
    85	    }
    86	
    87	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    88	                     INTERACTIONS STAKING CONTRACT
    89	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    90	
    91	    /**
    92	     * @notice Stakes an amount of tokens in the external staking contract.
    93	     * @param asset The contract address of the Asset to stake.
    94	     * @param amount The amount of Asset to stake.
    95	     */
    96	    function _stakeAndClaim(address asset, uint256 amount) internal override {
    97	        address gauge = assetToGauge[asset];
    98	
    99	        // Claim rewards
   100	        IAeroGauge(gauge).getReward(address(this));
   101	
   102	        // Stake asset
   103	        ERC20(asset).approve(gauge, amount);
   104	        IAeroGauge(gauge).deposit(amount);
   105	    }
   106	
   107	    /**
   108	     * @notice Unstakes and withdraws the Asset from the external contract.
   109	     * @param asset The contract address of the Asset to unstake and withdraw.
   110	     * @param amount The amount of underlying tokens to unstake and withdraw.
   111	     */
   112	    function _withdrawAndClaim(address asset, uint256 amount) internal override {
   113	        address gauge = assetToGauge[asset];
   114	
   115	        // Claim rewards
   116	        IAeroGauge(gauge).getReward(address(this));
   117	
   118	        // Withdraw asset
   119	        IAeroGauge(gauge).withdraw(amount);
   120	    }
   121	
   122	    /**
   123	     * @notice Claims the rewards available for this contract.
   124	     * @param asset The contract address of the Asset to claim the rewards for.
   125	     * @dev Withdrawing a zero amount will trigger the claim for rewards.
   126	     */
   127	    function _claimReward(address asset) internal override {
   128	        IAeroGauge(assetToGauge[asset]).getReward(address(this));
   129	    }
   130	
   131	    /**
   132	     * @notice Returns the amount of reward tokens that can be claimed by this contract for a specific asset.
   133	     * @param asset The Asset to get the current rewards for.
   134	     * @return currentReward The amount of reward tokens that can be claimed.
   135	     */
   136	    function _getCurrentReward(address asset) internal view override returns (uint256 currentReward) {
   137	        currentReward = IAeroGauge(assetToGauge[asset]).earned(address(this));
   138	    }
   139	}
```

```solidity
    92	
    93	    /**

   103	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   104	                               INITIALIZE
   105	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   106	
   107	    /**
   108	     * @notice This function will add this contract as an asset in the Registry.
   109	     * @dev Will revert if called more than once.
   110	     */
   111	    function initialize() external onlyOwner {
   112	        inAssetModule[address(this)] = true;

   114	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)

   118	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   119	                            ASSET MANAGEMENT
   120	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   121	
   122	    /**
   123	     * @notice Adds a new Aerodrome Finance pool to the WrappedAerodromeAM.
   124	     * @param pool The contract address of the Aerodrome Finance pool.
   125	     */
   126	    function addAsset(address pool) external {
   127	        if (!IRegistry(REGISTRY).isAllowed(pool, 0)) revert PoolNotAllowed();
   128	
   129	        // No need to check if token0 and token1 are allowed, since that was already checked when the pool was added.
   130	        (address token0_, address token1_) = IAeroPool(pool).tokens();
   131	        token0[pool] = token0_;
   132	        token1[pool] = token1_;
```
