```solidity
   135	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   136	                        ASSET INFORMATION
   137	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   138	
   139	    /**
   140	     * @notice Checks for a token address and the corresponding id if it is allowed.
   141	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   142	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   143	     * @return allowed A boolean, indicating if the asset is allowed.
   144	     */
   145	    function isAllowed(address asset, uint256 assetId) public view override returns (bool allowed) {
   146	        if (asset == address(this) && assetId <= lastPositionId) allowed = true;
   147	    }
   148	
   149	    /**
   150	     * @notice Returns the unique identifiers of the underlying assets.
   151	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   152	     * @return underlyingAssetKeys The unique identifiers of the underlying assets.
   153	     */
   154	    function _getUnderlyingAssets(bytes32 assetKey)
   155	        internal
   156	        view
   157	        override
   158	        returns (bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys)
   159	    {
   160	        (, uint256 positionId) = _getAssetFromKey(assetKey);
   161	
   162	        address pool = positionState[positionId].pool;
   163	        underlyingAssetKeys = new bytes32[](3);
   164	        underlyingAssetKeys[0] = _getKeyFromAsset(pool, 0);
   165	        underlyingAssetKeys[1] = _getKeyFromAsset(token0[pool], 0);
   166	        underlyingAssetKeys[2] = _getKeyFromAsset(token1[pool], 0);
   167	    }
   168	
   169	    /**
   170	     * @notice Calculates for a given amount of Asset the corresponding amount(s) of underlying asset(s).
   171	     * param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
   172	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   173	     * @param amount The amount of the Asset, in the decimal precision of the Asset.
   174	     * param underlyingAssetKeys The unique identifiers of the underlying assets.
   175	     * @return underlyingAssetsAmounts The corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s), in the decimal precision of the Underlying Asset.
   176	     * @return rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The usd rates of 10**18 tokens of underlying asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   177	     */
   178	    function _getUnderlyingAssetsAmounts(address, bytes32 assetKey, uint256 amount, bytes32[] memory)
   179	        internal
   180	        view
   181	        override
   182	        returns (uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts, AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd)
   183	    {
   184	        // Amount of a Wrapped position in the Asset Module can only be either 0 or 1.
   185	        if (amount == 0) return (new uint256[](3), rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd);
   186	
   187	        (, uint256 positionId) = _getAssetFromKey(assetKey);
   188	        (uint256 fee0Position, uint256 fee1Position) = feesOf(positionId);
   189	
   190	        underlyingAssetsAmounts = new uint256[](3);
   191	        underlyingAssetsAmounts[0] = positionState[positionId].amountWrapped;
   192	        underlyingAssetsAmounts[1] = fee0Position;
   193	        underlyingAssetsAmounts[2] = fee1Position;
   194	
   195	        return (underlyingAssetsAmounts, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd);
   196	    }
   197	
   198	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   199	                          PRICING LOGIC
   200	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   201	
   202	    /**
   203	     * @notice Returns the risk factors of an asset for a Creditor.
   204	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   205	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   206	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   207	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   208	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   209	     */
   210	    function getRiskFactors(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId)
   211	        external
   212	        view
   213	        override
   214	        returns (uint16 collateralFactor, uint16 liquidationFactor)
   215	    {
   216	        bytes32 assetKey = _getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId);
   217	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys = _getUnderlyingAssets(assetKey);
   218	
   219	        uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts;
   220	        (underlyingAssetsAmounts,) = _getUnderlyingAssetsAmounts(creditor, assetKey, 1, underlyingAssetKeys);
   221	        AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd =
   222	            _getRateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd(creditor, underlyingAssetKeys);
   223	
   224	        (, uint256 collateralFactor_, uint256 liquidationFactor_) =
   225	            _calculateValueAndRiskFactors(creditor, underlyingAssetsAmounts, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd);
   226	
   227	        // Unsafe cast: collateralFactor_ and liquidationFactor_ are smaller than or equal to 1e4.
   228	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   229	        return (uint16(collateralFactor_), uint16(liquidationFactor_));
   230	    }
   231	
   232	    /**
   233	     * @notice Returns the USD value of an asset.
   234	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   235	     * @param underlyingAssetsAmounts The corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s), in the decimal precision of the Underlying Asset.
   236	     * @param rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The USD rates of 10**18 tokens of underlying asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   237	     * @return valueInUsd The value of the asset denominated in USD, with 18 Decimals precision.
   238	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   239	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   240	     * @dev We take a weighted risk factor of both underlying assets.
   241	     */
   242	    function _calculateValueAndRiskFactors(
   243	        address creditor,
   244	        uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts,
   245	        AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd
   246	    ) internal view override returns (uint256 valueInUsd, uint256 collateralFactor, uint256 liquidationFactor) {
   247	        // "rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd" is the USD value with 18 decimals precision for 10**18 tokens of Underlying Asset.
   248	        // To get the USD value (also with 18 decimals) of the actual amount of underlying assets, we have to multiply
   249	        // the actual amount with the rate for 10**18 tokens, and divide by 10**18.
   250	        uint256 valuePool = underlyingAssetsAmounts[0].mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue, 1e18);
   251	        uint256 valueToken0 = underlyingAssetsAmounts[1].mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue, 1e18);
   252	        uint256 valueToken1 = underlyingAssetsAmounts[2].mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[2].assetValue, 1e18);
   253	
   254	        valueInUsd = valuePool + valueToken0 + valueToken1;
   255	
   256	        // Calculate weighted risk factors.
   257	        if (valueInUsd > 0) {
   258	            unchecked {
   259	                collateralFactor =
   260	                    (valuePool
   261	                            * rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].collateralFactor
   262	                            + valueToken0
   263	                            * rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].collateralFactor
   264	                            + valueToken1
   265	                            * rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[2].collateralFactor) / valueInUsd;
   266	                liquidationFactor =
   267	                    (valuePool
   268	                            * rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].liquidationFactor
   269	                            + valueToken0
   270	                            * rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].liquidationFactor
   271	                            + valueToken1
   272	                            * rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[2].liquidationFactor) / valueInUsd;
   273	            }
   274	        }
   275	
   276	        // Lower risk factors with the protocol wide risk factor.
   277	        uint256 riskFactor = riskParams[creditor].riskFactor;
   278	        collateralFactor = riskFactor.mulDivDown(collateralFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4);
   279	        liquidationFactor = riskFactor.mulDivDown(liquidationFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4);
   280	    }
   281	
   282	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   283	                         WRAPPING MODULE LOGIC
   284	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   285	
   286	    /**
   287	     * @notice Wraps an amount of liquidity and mints a new position.
   288	     * @param pool The contract address of the Aerodrome pool.
   289	     * @param amount The amount of liquidity to wrap.
   290	     * @return positionId The id of the minted position.
   291	     */
   292	    function mint(address pool, uint128 amount) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 positionId) {
   293	        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();
   294	        if (token0[pool] == address(0)) revert PoolNotAllowed();
   295	
   296	        // Need to transfer before minting or ERC777s could reenter.
   297	        ERC20(pool).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);
   298	
   299	        // Cache the old poolState.
   300	        PoolState memory poolState_ = poolState[pool];
   301	
   302	        // Create a new positionState.
   303	        PositionState memory positionState_;
   304	        positionState_.pool = pool;
   305	
   306	        // Claim any pending fees from the Aerodrome Pool.
   307	        (uint256 fee0Pool, uint256 fee1Pool) = _claimFees(pool);
   308	
   309	        // Calculate the new fee balances.
   310	        (poolState_, positionState_) = _getFeeBalances(poolState_, positionState_, fee0Pool, fee1Pool);
   311	
   312	        // Calculate the new wrapped amounts.
   313	        poolState_.totalWrapped = poolState_.totalWrapped + amount;
   314	        positionState_.amountWrapped = amount;
   315	
   316	        // Store the new positionState and poolState.
   317	        unchecked {
   318	            positionId = ++lastPositionId;
   319	        }
   320	        positionState[positionId] = positionState_;
   321	        poolState[pool] = poolState_;
   322	
   323	        // Mint the new position.
   324	        _safeMint(msg.sender, positionId);
   325	
   326	        emit LiquidityIncreased(positionId, pool, amount);
   327	    }
   328	
   329	    /**
   330	     * @notice Wraps additional liquidity for an existing position.
   331	     * @param positionId The id of the position.
   332	     * @param amount The amount of liquidity to wrap.
   333	     */
   334	    function increaseLiquidity(uint256 positionId, uint128 amount) external nonReentrant {
   335	        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();
   336	        if (_ownerOf[positionId] != msg.sender) revert NotOwner();
   337	
   338	        // Cache the old positionState and poolState.
   339	        PositionState memory positionState_ = positionState[positionId];
   340	        address pool = positionState_.pool;
   341	        PoolState memory poolState_ = poolState[pool];
   342	
   343	        // Need to transfer before increasing liquidity or ERC777s could reenter.
   344	        ERC20(pool).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);
   345	
   346	        // Claim any pending fees from the Aerodrome Pool.
   347	        (uint256 fee0Pool, uint256 fee1Pool) = _claimFees(pool);
   348	
   349	        // Calculate the new fee balances.
   350	        (poolState_, positionState_) = _getFeeBalances(poolState_, positionState_, fee0Pool, fee1Pool);
   351	
   352	        // Calculate the new wrapped amounts.
   353	        poolState_.totalWrapped = poolState_.totalWrapped + amount;
   354	        positionState_.amountWrapped = positionState_.amountWrapped + amount;
   355	
   356	        // Store the new positionState and poolState.
   357	        positionState[positionId] = positionState_;
   358	        poolState[pool] = poolState_;
   359	
   360	        emit LiquidityIncreased(positionId, pool, amount);
   361	    }
   362	
   363	    /**
   364	     * @notice Unwraps, withdraws and claims fees for total amount of liquidity in position.
   365	     * @param positionId The id of the position to burn.
   366	     * @return fee0Position The amount of fees of token0 that can be claimed for a certain position.
   367	     * @return fee1Position The amount of fees of token1 that can be claimed for a certain position.
   368	     * @dev Also claims and transfers the fees of the position.
   369	     */
   370	    function burn(uint256 positionId) external returns (uint256 fee0Position, uint256 fee1Position) {
   371	        return decreaseLiquidity(positionId, positionState[positionId].amountWrapped);
   372	    }
   373	
   374	    /**
   375	     * @notice Unwraps and withdraws liquidity.
   376	     * @param positionId The id of the position to withdraw from.
   377	     * @param amount The amount of liquidity to unwrap and withdraw.
   378	     * @return fee0Position The amount of fees of token0 that can be claimed for a certain position.
   379	     * @return fee1Position The amount of fees of token1 that can be claimed for a certain position.
   380	     * @dev Also claims and transfers the fees of the position.
   381	     */
   382	    function decreaseLiquidity(uint256 positionId, uint128 amount)
   383	        public
   384	        nonReentrant
   385	        returns (uint256 fee0Position, uint256 fee1Position)
   386	    {
   387	        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();
   388	        if (_ownerOf[positionId] != msg.sender) revert NotOwner();
   389	
   390	        // Cache the old positionState and poolState.
   391	        PositionState memory positionState_ = positionState[positionId];
   392	        address pool = positionState_.pool;
   393	        PoolState memory poolState_ = poolState[pool];
   394	
   395	        // Claim any pending fees from the Aerodrome Pool.
   396	        (uint256 fee0Pool, uint256 fee1Pool) = _claimFees(pool);
   397	
   398	        // Calculate the new fee balances.
   399	        (poolState_, positionState_) = _getFeeBalances(poolState_, positionState_, fee0Pool, fee1Pool);
   400	
   401	        // Calculate the new wrapped amounts, reverts if balance is too low.
   402	        poolState_.totalWrapped = poolState_.totalWrapped - amount;
   403	        positionState_.amountWrapped = positionState_.amountWrapped - amount;
   404	
   405	        // Fees are paid out to the owner on a decreaseLiquidity.
   406	        // -> Reset the balances of the pending fees.
   407	        fee0Position = positionState_.fee0;
   408	        fee1Position = positionState_.fee1;
   409	        positionState_.fee0 = 0;
   410	        positionState_.fee1 = 0;
   411	
   412	        // Store the new positionState and poolState.
   413	        if (positionState_.amountWrapped > 0) {
   414	            positionState[positionId] = positionState_;
   415	        } else {
   416	            delete positionState[positionId];
   417	            _burn(positionId);
   418	        }
   419	        poolState[pool] = poolState_;
   420	
   421	        // Pay out the fees to the position owner.
   422	        if (fee0Position > 0) ERC20(token0[pool]).safeTransfer(msg.sender, fee0Position);
   423	        if (fee1Position > 0) ERC20(token1[pool]).safeTransfer(msg.sender, fee1Position);
   424	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   425	        emit FeesPaid(positionId, uint128(fee0Position), uint128(fee1Position));
   426	
   427	        // Transfer the liquidity back to the position owner.
   428	        ERC20(pool).safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount);
   429	        emit LiquidityDecreased(positionId, pool, amount);
   430	    }
   431	
   432	    /**
   433	     * @notice Claims and transfers the fees of the position.
   434	     * @param positionId The id of the position.
   435	     * @return fee0Position The amount of fees of token0 that can be claimed for a certain position.
   436	     * @return fee1Position The amount of fees of token1 that can be claimed for a certain position.
   437	     */
   438	    function claimFees(uint256 positionId) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 fee0Position, uint256 fee1Position) {
   439	        if (_ownerOf[positionId] != msg.sender) revert NotOwner();
   440	
   441	        // Cache the old positionState and poolState.
   442	        PositionState memory positionState_ = positionState[positionId];
   443	        address pool = positionState_.pool;
   444	        PoolState memory poolState_ = poolState[pool];
   445	
   446	        // Claim any pending fees from the Aerodrome Pool.
   447	        (uint256 fee0Pool, uint256 fee1Pool) = _claimFees(pool);
   448	
   449	        // Calculate the new fee balances.
   450	        (poolState_, positionState_) = _getFeeBalances(poolState_, positionState_, fee0Pool, fee1Pool);
   451	
   452	        // Fees are paid out to the owner on a claimFees.
   453	        // -> Reset the balances of the pending fees.
   454	        fee0Position = positionState_.fee0;
   455	        fee1Position = positionState_.fee1;
   456	        positionState_.fee0 = 0;
   457	        positionState_.fee1 = 0;
   458	
   459	        // Store the new positionState and poolState.
   460	        positionState[positionId] = positionState_;
   461	        poolState[pool] = poolState_;
   462	
   463	        // Pay out the fees to the position owner.
   464	        if (fee0Position > 0) ERC20(token0[pool]).safeTransfer(msg.sender, fee0Position);
   465	        if (fee1Position > 0) ERC20(token1[pool]).safeTransfer(msg.sender, fee1Position);
   466	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   467	        emit FeesPaid(positionId, uint128(fee0Position), uint128(fee1Position));
   468	    }
   469	
   470	    /**
   471	     * @notice Skims any surplus pool-tokens to the owner.
   472	     * @param pool The contract address of the Aerodrome pool.
   473	     * @dev If pool tokens are transferred without depositing before any position is minted,
   474	     * the pool can have non zero fees balances while totalWrapped_ is 0.
   475	     * In this case the fees are not accounted for and will be lost.
   476	     */
   477	    function skim(address pool) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
   478	        if (token0[pool] == address(0)) revert PoolNotAllowed();
   479	
   480	        // Claim any pending fees from the Aerodrome Pool.
   481	        (uint256 fee0Pool, uint256 fee1Pool) = _claimFees(pool);
   482	
   483	        // Cache the poolState.
   484	        PoolState memory poolState_ = poolState[pool];
   485	
   486	        // Calculate the new fee balances.
   487	        PositionState memory positionState_;
   488	        (poolState_,) = _getFeeBalances(poolState_, positionState_, fee0Pool, fee1Pool);
   489	
   490	        // Store the new poolState.
   491	        poolState[pool] = poolState_;
   492	
   493	        // Transfer excess funds to the owner.
   494	        uint256 deltaWrapped = ERC20(pool).balanceOf(address(this)) - poolState_.totalWrapped;
   495	        ERC20(pool).safeTransfer(msg.sender, deltaWrapped);
   496	    }
   497	
   498	    /**
   499	     * @notice Returns the total amount of liquidity wrapped via this contract.
   500	     * @param pool The contract address of the Aerodrome pool.
   501	     * @return totalWrapped_ The total amount of liquidity wrapped via this contract.
   502	     */
   503	    function totalWrapped(address pool) external view returns (uint256 totalWrapped_) {
   504	        totalWrapped_ = poolState[pool].totalWrapped;
   505	    }
   506	
   507	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   508	                     INTERACTIONS AERODROME POOL
   509	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   510	
   511	    /**
   512	     * @notice Claims the fees available for this contract.
   513	     * @param pool The contract address of the Aerodrome pool to claim the fees for.
   514	     * @return fee0 The amount of fees of token0 claimed.
   515	     * @return fee1 The amount of fees of token1 claimed.
   516	     */
   517	    function _claimFees(address pool) internal returns (uint256 fee0, uint256 fee1) {
   518	        (fee0, fee1) = IAeroPool(pool).claimFees();
   519	    }
   520	
   521	    /**
   522	     * @notice Returns the amount of fees that can be claimed by this contract for a specific asset.
   523	     * @param pool The contract address of the Aerodrome pool to get the current fees for.
   524	     * @return fee0 The amount of fees of token0 that can be claimed by this contract.
   525	     * @return fee1 The amount of fees of token1 that can be claimed by this contract.
   526	     * @dev If pool tokens are transferred without depositing before any position is minted,
   527	     * the pool can have non zero fees balances while totalWrapped_ is 0.
   528	     * In this case the fees are not accounted for and will be lost.
   529	     */
   530	    function _getCurrentFees(address pool) internal view returns (uint256 fee0, uint256 fee1) {
   531	        // Cache totalWrapped.
   532	        uint256 totalWrapped_ = poolState[pool].totalWrapped;
   533	
   534	        if (totalWrapped_ > 0) {
   535	            // Unfortunately Aerodrome does not have a view function to get pending fees.
   536	            fee0 = IAeroPool(pool).claimable0(address(this))
   537	                + totalWrapped_.mulDivDown(IAeroPool(pool).index0() - IAeroPool(pool).supplyIndex0(address(this)), 1e18);
   538	            fee1 = IAeroPool(pool).claimable1(address(this))
   539	                + totalWrapped_.mulDivDown(IAeroPool(pool).index1() - IAeroPool(pool).supplyIndex1(address(this)), 1e18);
   540	        }
   541	    }
   542	
   543	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   544	                         REWARDS VIEW FUNCTIONS
   545	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   546	
   547	    /**
   548	     * @notice Returns the amount of fees claimable by a position.
   549	     * @param positionId The id of the position to check the fees for.
   550	     * @return fee0Position The amount of fees of token0 that can be claimed for a certain position.
   551	     * @return fee1Position The amount of fees of token1 that can be claimed for a certain position.
   552	     */
   553	    function feesOf(uint256 positionId) public view returns (uint256 fee0Position, uint256 fee1Position) {
   554	        // Cache the old positionState and poolState.
   555	        PositionState memory positionState_ = positionState[positionId];
   556	        PoolState memory poolState_ = poolState[positionState_.pool];
   557	
   558	        // Calculate the new fee balances.
   559	        (uint256 fee0Pool, uint256 fee1Pool) = _getCurrentFees(positionState_.pool);
   560	        (, positionState_) = _getFeeBalances(poolState_, positionState_, fee0Pool, fee1Pool);
   561	
   562	        fee0Position = positionState_.fee0;
   563	        fee1Position = positionState_.fee1;
   564	    }
   565	
   566	    /**
   567	     * @notice Calculates the current global and position specific fee balances.
   568	     * @param poolState_ Struct with the old fees state of the Asset.
   569	     * @param positionState_ Struct with the old fees state of the position.
   570	     * @return currentPoolState Struct with the current fees state of the Asset.
   571	     * @return currentPositionState Struct with the current fees state of the position.
   572	     */
   573	    function _getFeeBalances(
   574	        PoolState memory poolState_,
   575	        PositionState memory positionState_,
   576	        uint256 fee0,
   577	        uint256 fee1
   578	    ) internal pure returns (PoolState memory, PositionState memory) {
   579	        if (poolState_.totalWrapped > 0) {
   580	            // Calculate the new poolState.
   581	            // Calculate the change in FeePerLiquidity.
   582	            uint256 deltaFee0PerLiquidity = fee0.mulDivDown(1e18, poolState_.totalWrapped);
   583	            uint256 deltaFee1PerLiquidity = fee1.mulDivDown(1e18, poolState_.totalWrapped);
   584	            // Calculate and update the new FeePerLiquidity of the Pool.
   585	            // unchecked: FeePerLiquidity can overflow, what matters is the delta in FeePerLiquidity between two interactions.
   586	            unchecked {
   587	                poolState_.fee0PerLiquidity = poolState_.fee0PerLiquidity + deltaFee0PerLiquidity.safeCastTo128();
   588	                poolState_.fee1PerLiquidity = poolState_.fee1PerLiquidity + deltaFee1PerLiquidity.safeCastTo128();
   589	            }
   590	
   591	            if (positionState_.amountWrapped > 0) {
   592	                // Calculate the new positionState.
   593	                // Calculate the difference in feePerLiquidity since the last position interaction.
   594	                // unchecked: FeePerLiquidity can underflow, what matters is the delta in FeePerLiquidity between two interactions.
   595	                unchecked {
   596	                    deltaFee0PerLiquidity = poolState_.fee0PerLiquidity - positionState_.fee0PerLiquidity;
   597	                    deltaFee1PerLiquidity = poolState_.fee1PerLiquidity - positionState_.fee1PerLiquidity;
   598	                }
   599	                // Calculate the fees earned by the position since its last interaction.
   600	                // unchecked: deltaFeePerLiquidity and positionState_.amountWrapped are smaller than type(uint128).max.
   601	                uint256 deltaFee0;
   602	                uint256 deltaFee1;
   603	                unchecked {
   604	                    deltaFee0 = deltaFee0PerLiquidity * positionState_.amountWrapped / 1e18;
   605	                    deltaFee1 = deltaFee1PerLiquidity * positionState_.amountWrapped / 1e18;
   606	                }
   607	                // Update the fee balance of the position.
   608	                positionState_.fee0 = (positionState_.fee0 + deltaFee0).safeCastTo128();
   609	                positionState_.fee1 = (positionState_.fee1 + deltaFee1).safeCastTo128();
   610	            }
   611	        }
   612	        // Update the FeePerLiquidity of the position.
   613	        positionState_.fee0PerLiquidity = poolState_.fee0PerLiquidity;
   614	        positionState_.fee1PerLiquidity = poolState_.fee1PerLiquidity;
   615	
   616	        return (poolState_, positionState_);
   617	    }
   618	
   619	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   620	                        ERC-721 LOGIC
   621	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   622	
   623	    /**
   624	     * @notice Function that stores a new base URI.
   625	     * @param newBaseURI The new base URI to store.
   626	     */
   627	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function,mixed-case-variable)
   628	    function setBaseURI(string calldata newBaseURI) external onlyOwner {
   629	        baseURI = newBaseURI;
   630	    }
   631	
   632	    /**
   633	     * @notice Function that returns the token URI as defined in the ERC721 standard.
   634	     * @param tokenId The id of the Account.
   635	     * @return uri The token URI.
   636	     */
   637	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function,mixed-case-variable)
   638	    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) public view override returns (string memory uri) {
   639	        return bytes(baseURI).length > 0 ? string(abi.encodePacked(baseURI, tokenId.toString())) : "";
   640	    }
   641	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/asset-modules/ERC20-Primaries/ERC20PrimaryAM.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { IERC20 } from "../../interfaces/IERC20.sol";
     8	import { IRegistry } from "../interfaces/IRegistry.sol";
     9	import { PrimaryAM } from "../abstracts/AbstractPrimaryAM.sol";
    10	
    11	/**
    12	 * @title Asset Module for Standard ERC20 tokens
    13	 * @author Pragma Labs
    14	 * @notice The pricing logic and basic information for ERC20 tokens for which a direct price feed exists.
    15	 * @dev No end-user should directly interact with the ERC20PrimaryAM, only the Registry
    16	 * or the contract owner.
    17	 */
    18	contract ERC20PrimaryAM is PrimaryAM {
    19	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    20	                                ERRORS
    21	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    22	
    23	    error Max18Decimals();
    24	
    25	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    26	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    27	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    28	
    29	    /**
    30	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    31	     * @param registry_ The contract address of the Registry.
    32	     * @dev The ASSET_TYPE, necessary for the deposit and withdraw logic in the Accounts, is "1" for ERC20 tokens.
    33	     */
    34	    constructor(address owner_, address registry_) PrimaryAM(owner_, registry_, 1) { }
    35	
    36	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    37	                        ASSET MANAGEMENT
    38	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    39	
    40	    /**
    41	     * @notice Adds a new asset to the ERC20PrimaryAM.
    42	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
    43	     * @param oracleSequence The sequence of the oracles to price the asset in USD,
    44	     * packed in a single bytes32 object.
    45	     * @dev Assets can't have more than 18 decimals.
    46	     */
    47	    function addAsset(address asset, bytes32 oracleSequence) external onlyOwner {
    48	        // View function, reverts in Registry if sequence is not correct.
    49	        if (!IRegistry(REGISTRY).checkOracleSequence(oracleSequence)) revert BadOracleSequence();
    50	        // Will revert in Registry if asset was already added.
    51	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
    52	        IRegistry(REGISTRY).addAsset(uint96(ASSET_TYPE), asset);
    53	
    54	        inAssetModule[asset] = true;
    55	
    56	        uint256 assetUnit = 10 ** IERC20(asset).decimals();
    57	        if (assetUnit > 1e18) revert Max18Decimals();
    58	
    59	        // Can safely cast to uint64, we previously checked it is smaller than 1e18.
    60	        // forge-lint: disable-next-item(unsafe-typecast)
    61	        assetToInformation[_getKeyFromAsset(asset, 0)] =
    62	            AssetInformation({ assetUnit: uint64(assetUnit), oracleSequence: oracleSequence });
    63	    }
    64	
    65	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    66	                        ASSET INFORMATION
    67	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    68	
    69	    /**
    70	     * @notice Checks for a token address and the corresponding id if it is allowed.
    71	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
    72	     * param assetId The id of the asset.
    73	     * @return A boolean, indicating if the asset is allowed.
    74	     * @dev Since ERC20s don't have an id, the id should be set to 0.
    75	     */
    76	    function isAllowed(address asset, uint256) public view override returns (bool) {
    77	        return inAssetModule[asset];
    78	    }
    79	
    80	    /**
    81	     * @notice Returns the unique identifier of an asset based on the contract address and id.
    82	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
    83	     * param assetId The id of the asset.
    84	     * @return key The unique identifier.
    85	     * @dev The assetId is hard-coded to 0, since the assets for this Asset Module are ERC20s.
    86	     */
    87	    function _getKeyFromAsset(address asset, uint256) internal pure override returns (bytes32 key) {
    88	        assembly {
    89	            key := asset
    90	        }
    91	    }
    92	
    93	    /**
    94	     * @notice Returns the contract address and id of an asset based on the unique identifier.
    95	     * @param key The unique identifier.
    96	     * @return asset The contract address of the asset.
    97	     * @return assetId The id of the asset.
    98	     * @dev The assetId is hard-coded to 0, since the assets for this Asset Module are ERC20s.
    99	     */
   100	    function _getAssetFromKey(bytes32 key) internal pure override returns (address asset, uint256) {
   101	        assembly {
   102	            asset := key
   103	        }
   104	
   105	        return (asset, 0);
   106	    }
   107	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/asset-modules/Slipstream/SlipstreamAM.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { AssetValuationLib, AssetValueAndRiskFactors } from "../../libraries/AssetValuationLib.sol";
     8	import { DerivedAM, FixedPointMathLib, IRegistry } from "../abstracts/AbstractDerivedAM.sol";
     9	import { FixedPoint96 } from "../UniswapV3/libraries/FixedPoint96.sol";
    10	import { FixedPoint128 } from "../UniswapV3/libraries/FixedPoint128.sol";
    11	import { FullMath } from "../UniswapV3/libraries/FullMath.sol";
    12	import { INonfungiblePositionManager } from "./interfaces/INonfungiblePositionManager.sol";
    13	import { ICLPool } from "./interfaces/ICLPool.sol";
    14	import { LiquidityAmounts } from "../UniswapV3/libraries/LiquidityAmounts.sol";
    15	import { PoolAddress } from "./libraries/PoolAddress.sol";
    16	import { TickMath } from "../UniswapV3/libraries/TickMath.sol";
    17	
    18	/**
    19	 * @title Asset Module for Slipstream Liquidity Positions
    20	 * @author Pragma Labs
    21	 * @notice The pricing logic and basic information for Slipstream Liquidity Positions.
    22	 * @dev The SlipstreamAM will not price the LP tokens via direct price oracles,
    23	 * it will break down liquidity positions in the underlying tokens (ERC20s).
    24	 * Only LP tokens for which the underlying tokens are allowed as collateral can be priced.
    25	 * @dev No end-user should directly interact with the SlipstreamAM, only the Registry,
    26	 * or the contract owner.
    27	 */
    28	contract SlipstreamAM is DerivedAM {
    29	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    30	
    31	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    32	                                CONSTANTS
    33	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    34	
    35	    // The contract address of the NonfungiblePositionManager.
    36	    INonfungiblePositionManager internal immutable NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER;
    37	
    38	    // The contract address of the Slipstream (or exact clone) Factory.
    39	    address internal immutable CL_FACTORY;
    40	
    41	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    42	                                STORAGE
    43	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    44	
    45	    // The liquidity of the Liquidity Position when it was deposited.
    46	    mapping(uint256 assetId => uint256 liquidity) internal assetToLiquidity;
    47	
    48	    // The unique identifiers of the Underlying Assets of a Liquidity Position.
    49	    mapping(bytes32 assetKey => bytes32[] underlyingAssetKeys) public assetToUnderlyingAssets;
    50	
    51	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    52	                                ERRORS
    53	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    54	
    55	    error InvalidId();
    56	    error ZeroLiquidity();
    57	    error InvalidAmount();
    58	
    59	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    60	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    61	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    62	
    63	    /**
    64	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    65	     * @param registry_ The contract address of the Registry.
    66	     * @param nonFungiblePositionManager The contract address of the protocols NonFungiblePositionManager.
    67	     * @dev The ASSET_TYPE, necessary for the deposit and withdraw logic in the Accounts, is "2" for Slipstream Liquidity Positions (ERC721).
    68	     */
    69	    constructor(address owner_, address registry_, address nonFungiblePositionManager) DerivedAM(owner_, registry_, 2) {
    70	        NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER = INonfungiblePositionManager(nonFungiblePositionManager);
    71	        CL_FACTORY = INonfungiblePositionManager(nonFungiblePositionManager).factory();
    72	    }
    73	
    74	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    75	                        ASSET MANAGEMENT
    76	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    77	
    78	    /**
    79	     * @notice Adds the mapping from the NonfungiblePositionManager to this Asset Module in this Registry.
    80	     * @dev Since all assets will have the same contract address, only the NonfungiblePositionManager has to be added to the Registry.
    81	     */
    82	    function setProtocol() external onlyOwner {
    83	        inAssetModule[address(NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER)] = true;
    84	
    85	        // Will revert in Registry if asset was already added.
    86	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
    87	        IRegistry(REGISTRY).addAsset(uint96(ASSET_TYPE), address(NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER));
    88	    }
    89	
    90	    /**
    91	     * @notice Adds a new asset (Liquidity Position) to the SlipstreamAM.
    92	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
    93	     * @dev All assets (Liquidity Positions) will have the same contract address (the NonfungiblePositionManager),
    94	     * but a different id.
    95	     */
    96	    function _addAsset(uint256 assetId) internal {
    97	        if (assetId > type(uint96).max) revert InvalidId();
    98	
    99	        (,, address token0, address token1,,,, uint128 liquidity,,,,) = NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER.positions(assetId);
   100	
   101	        // No need to explicitly check if token0 and token1 are allowed, _addAsset() is only called in the
   102	        // deposit functions and there any deposit of non-allowed Underlying Assets will revert.
   103	        if (liquidity == 0) revert ZeroLiquidity();
   104	
   105	        // The liquidity of the Liquidity Position is stored in the Asset Module,
   106	        // not fetched from the NonfungiblePositionManager.
   107	        // Since liquidity of a position can be increased by a non-owner,
   108	        // the max exposure checks could otherwise be circumvented.
   109	        assetToLiquidity[assetId] = liquidity;
   110	
   111	        bytes32 assetKey = _getKeyFromAsset(address(NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER), assetId);
   112	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys = new bytes32[](2);
   113	        underlyingAssetKeys[0] = _getKeyFromAsset(token0, 0);
   114	        underlyingAssetKeys[1] = _getKeyFromAsset(token1, 0);
   115	        assetToUnderlyingAssets[assetKey] = underlyingAssetKeys;
   116	    }
   117	
   118	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   119	                        ASSET INFORMATION
   120	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   121	
   122	    /**
   123	     * @notice Checks for a token address and the corresponding id if it is allowed.
   124	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   125	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   126	     * @return A boolean, indicating if the asset is allowed.
   127	     */
   128	    function isAllowed(address asset, uint256 assetId) public view override returns (bool) {
   129	        if (asset != address(NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER)) return false;
   130	
   131	        try NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER.positions(assetId) returns (
   132	            uint96,
   133	            address,
   134	            address token0,
   135	            address token1,
   136	            int24,
   137	            int24,
   138	            int24,
   139	            uint128 liquidity,
   140	            uint256,
   141	            uint256,
   142	            uint128,
   143	            uint128
   144	        ) {
   145	            return IRegistry(REGISTRY).isAllowed(token0, 0) && IRegistry(REGISTRY).isAllowed(token1, 0) && liquidity > 0;
   146	        } catch {
   147	            return false;
   148	        }
   149	    }
   150	
   151	    /**
   152	     * @notice Returns the unique identifiers of the Underlying Assets.
   153	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   154	     * @return underlyingAssetKeys The unique identifiers of the Underlying Assets.
   155	     */
   156	    function _getUnderlyingAssets(bytes32 assetKey)
   157	        internal
   158	        view
   159	        override
   160	        returns (bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys)
   161	    {
   162	        underlyingAssetKeys = assetToUnderlyingAssets[assetKey];
   163	
   164	        if (underlyingAssetKeys.length == 0) {
   165	            // Only used as an off-chain view function by getValue() to return the value of a non deposited Liquidity Position.
   166	            (, uint256 assetId) = _getAssetFromKey(assetKey);
   167	            (,, address token0, address token1,,,,,,,,) = NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER.positions(assetId);
   168	
   169	            underlyingAssetKeys = new bytes32[](2);
   170	            underlyingAssetKeys[0] = _getKeyFromAsset(token0, 0);
   171	            underlyingAssetKeys[1] = _getKeyFromAsset(token1, 0);
   172	        }
   173	    }
   174	
   175	    /**
   176	     * @notice Calculates for a given asset the corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s).
   177	     * @param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
   178	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   179	     * param assetAmount The amount of the asset, in the decimal precision of the Asset.
   180	     * param underlyingAssetKeys The unique identifiers of the Underlying Assets.
   181	     * @return underlyingAssetsAmounts The corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s), in the decimal precision of the Underlying Asset.
   182	     * @return rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The usd rates of 1e18 tokens of Underlying Asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   183	     * @dev External price feeds of the Underlying Assets are used to calculate the flashloan resistant amounts.
   184	     * This approach accommodates scenarios where an underlying asset could be
   185	     * a derived asset itself (e.g., USDC/aUSDC pool), ensuring more versatile and accurate price calculations.
   186	     */
   187	    function _getUnderlyingAssetsAmounts(address creditor, bytes32 assetKey, uint256 amount, bytes32[] memory)
   188	        internal
   189	        view
   190	        override
   191	        returns (uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts, AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd)
   192	    {
   193	        // Amount of a Slipstream LP can only be either 0 or 1.
   194	        if (amount == 0) {
   195	            return (new uint256[](2), rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd);
   196	        }
   197	
   198	        (, uint256 assetId) = _getAssetFromKey(assetKey);
   199	
   200	        (address token0, address token1, int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper, uint128 liquidity) = _getPosition(assetId);
   201	
   202	        // Get the trusted rates to USD of the Underlying Assets.
   203	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys = new bytes32[](2);
   204	        underlyingAssetKeys[0] = _getKeyFromAsset(token0, 0);
   205	        underlyingAssetKeys[1] = _getKeyFromAsset(token1, 0);
   206	        rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd = _getRateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd(creditor, underlyingAssetKeys);
   207	
   208	        // Calculate amount0 and amount1 of the principal (the actual liquidity position).
   209	        (uint256 principal0, uint256 principal1) = _getPrincipalAmounts(
   210	            tickLower,
   211	            tickUpper,
   212	            liquidity,
   213	            rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue,
   214	            rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue
   215	        );
   216	
   217	        // Calculate amount0 and amount1 of the accumulated fees.
   218	        (uint256 fee0, uint256 fee1) = _getFeeAmounts(assetId);
   219	
   220	        // As the sole liquidity provider in a new pool,
   221	        // a malicious actor could bypass the max exposure by
   222	        // continuously swapping large amounts and increasing the fee portion
   223	        // of the liquidity position.
   224	        fee0 = fee0 > principal0 ? principal0 : fee0;
   225	        fee1 = fee1 > principal1 ? principal1 : fee1;
   226	
   227	        underlyingAssetsAmounts = new uint256[](2);
   228	        unchecked {
   229	            underlyingAssetsAmounts[0] = principal0 + fee0;
   230	            underlyingAssetsAmounts[1] = principal1 + fee1;
   231	        }
   232	    }
   233	
   234	    /**
   235	     * @notice Returns the position information.
   236	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   237	     * @return token0 Token0 of the Liquidity Pool.
   238	     * @return token1 Token1 of the Liquidity Pool.
   239	     * @return tickLower The lower tick of the liquidity position.
   240	     * @return tickUpper The upper tick of the liquidity position.
   241	     * @return liquidity The liquidity per tick of the liquidity position.
   242	     */
   243	    function _getPosition(uint256 assetId)
   244	        internal
   245	        view
   246	        returns (address token0, address token1, int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper, uint128 liquidity)
   247	    {
   248	        // For deposited assets, the liquidity of the Liquidity Position is stored in the Asset Module,
   249	        // not fetched from the NonfungiblePositionManager.
   250	        // Since liquidity of a position can be increased by a non-owner, the max exposure checks could otherwise be circumvented.
   251	        liquidity = uint128(assetToLiquidity[assetId]);
   252	
   253	        if (liquidity > 0) {
   254	            (,, token0, token1,, tickLower, tickUpper,,,,,) = NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER.positions(assetId);
   255	        } else {
   256	            // Only used as an off-chain view function by getValue() to return the value of a non deposited Liquidity Position.
   257	            (,, token0, token1,, tickLower, tickUpper, liquidity,,,,) = NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER.positions(assetId);
   258	        }
   259	    }
   260	
   261	    /**
   262	     * @notice Calculates the underlying token amounts of a liquidity position, given external trusted prices.
   263	     * @param tickLower The lower tick of the liquidity position.
   264	     * @param tickUpper The upper tick of the liquidity position.
   265	     * @param priceToken0 The price of 1e18 tokens of token0 in USD, with 18 decimals precision.
   266	     * @param priceToken1 The price of 1e18 tokens of token1 in USD, with 18 decimals precision.
   267	     * @return amount0 The amount of underlying token0 tokens.
   268	     * @return amount1 The amount of underlying token1 tokens.
   269	     */
   270	    function _getPrincipalAmounts(
   271	        int24 tickLower,
   272	        int24 tickUpper,
   273	        uint128 liquidity,
   274	        uint256 priceToken0,
   275	        uint256 priceToken1
   276	    ) internal pure returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) {
   277	        // Calculate the square root of the relative rate sqrt(token1/token0) from the trusted USD price of both tokens.
   278	        // sqrtPriceX96 is a binary fixed point number with 96 digits precision.
   279	        uint160 sqrtPriceX96 = _getSqrtPriceX96(priceToken0, priceToken1);
   280	
   281	        // Calculate amount0 and amount1 of the principal (the liquidity position without accumulated fees).
   282	        (amount0, amount1) = LiquidityAmounts.getAmountsForLiquidity(
   283	            sqrtPriceX96, TickMath.getSqrtRatioAtTick(tickLower), TickMath.getSqrtRatioAtTick(tickUpper), liquidity
   284	        );
   285	    }
   286	
   287	    /**
   288	     * @notice Calculates the sqrtPriceX96 (token1/token0) from trusted USD prices of both tokens.
   289	     * @param priceToken0 The price of 1e18 tokens of token0 in USD, with 18 decimals precision.
   290	     * @param priceToken1 The price of 1e18 tokens of token1 in USD, with 18 decimals precision.
   291	     * @return sqrtPriceX96 The square root of the price (token1/token0), with 96 binary precision.
   292	     * @dev The price in Slipstream is defined as:
   293	     * price = amountToken1/amountToken0.
   294	     * The usdPriceToken is defined as: usdPriceToken = amountUsd/amountToken.
   295	     * => amountToken = amountUsd/usdPriceToken.
   296	     * Hence we can derive the Slipstream price as:
   297	     * price = (amountUsd/usdPriceToken1)/(amountUsd/usdPriceToken0) = usdPriceToken0/usdPriceToken1.
   298	     */
   299	    function _getSqrtPriceX96(uint256 priceToken0, uint256 priceToken1) internal pure returns (uint160 sqrtPriceX96) {
   300	        if (priceToken1 == 0) return TickMath.MAX_SQRT_RATIO;
   301	
   302	        // Both priceTokens have 18 decimals precision and result of division should have 28 decimals precision.
   303	        // -> multiply by 1e28
   304	        // priceXd28 will overflow if priceToken0 is greater than 1.158e+49.
   305	        // For WBTC (which only has 8 decimals) this would require a bitcoin price greater than 115 792 089 237 316 198 989 824 USD/BTC.
   306	        uint256 priceXd28 = priceToken0.mulDivDown(1e28, priceToken1);
   307	        // Square root of a number with 28 decimals precision has 14 decimals precision.
   308	        uint256 sqrtPriceXd14 = FixedPointMathLib.sqrt(priceXd28);
   309	
   310	        // Change sqrtPrice from a decimal fixed point number with 14 digits to a binary fixed point number with 96 digits.
   311	        // Unsafe cast: Cast will only overflow when priceToken0/priceToken1 >= 2^128.
   312	        sqrtPriceX96 = uint160((sqrtPriceXd14 << FixedPoint96.RESOLUTION) / 1e14);
   313	    }
   314	
   315	    /**
   316	     * @notice Calculates the underlying token amounts of accrued fees, both collected and uncollected.
   317	     * @param id The id of the Liquidity Position.
   318	     * @return amount0 The amount of fees in underlying token0 tokens.
   319	     * @return amount1 The amount of fees in underlying token1 tokens.
   320	     */
   321	    function _getFeeAmounts(uint256 id) internal view returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) {
   322	        (
   323	            ,,
   324	            address token0,
   325	            address token1,
   326	            int24 tickSpacing,
   327	            int24 tickLower,
   328	            int24 tickUpper,
   329	            uint256 liquidity, // gas: cheaper to use uint256 instead of uint128.
   330	            uint256 feeGrowthInside0LastX128,
   331	            uint256 feeGrowthInside1LastX128,
   332	            uint256 tokensOwed0, // gas: cheaper to use uint256 instead of uint128.
   333	            uint256 tokensOwed1 // gas: cheaper to use uint256 instead of uint128.
   334	        ) = NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER.positions(id);
   335	
   336	        (uint256 feeGrowthInside0CurrentX128, uint256 feeGrowthInside1CurrentX128) =
   337	            _getFeeGrowthInside(token0, token1, tickSpacing, tickLower, tickUpper);
   338	
   339	        // Calculate the total amount of fees by adding the already realized fees (tokensOwed),
   340	        // to the accumulated fees since the last time the position was updated:
   341	        // (feeGrowthInsideCurrentX128 - feeGrowthInsideLastX128) * liquidity.
   342	        // Fee calculations in NonfungiblePositionManager.sol overflow (without reverting) when
   343	        // one or both terms, or their sum, is bigger than a uint128.
   344	        // This is however much bigger than any realistic situation.
   345	        unchecked {
   346	            amount0 = FullMath.mulDiv(
   347	                feeGrowthInside0CurrentX128 - feeGrowthInside0LastX128, liquidity, FixedPoint128.Q128
   348	            ) + tokensOwed0;
   349	            amount1 = FullMath.mulDiv(
   350	                feeGrowthInside1CurrentX128 - feeGrowthInside1LastX128, liquidity, FixedPoint128.Q128
   351	            ) + tokensOwed1;
   352	        }
   353	    }
   354	
   355	    /**
   356	     * @notice Calculates the current fee growth inside the Liquidity Range.
   357	     * @param token0 Token0 of the Liquidity Pool.
   358	     * @param token1 Token1 of the Liquidity Pool.
   359	     * @param tickSpacing The tickSpacing of the Liquidity Pool.
   360	     * @param tickLower The lower tick of the liquidity position.
   361	     * @param tickUpper The upper tick of the liquidity position.
   362	     * @return feeGrowthInside0X128 The amount of fees in underlying token0 tokens.
   363	     * @return feeGrowthInside1X128 The amount of fees in underlying token1 tokens.
   364	     */
   365	    function _getFeeGrowthInside(address token0, address token1, int24 tickSpacing, int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper)
   366	        internal
   367	        view
   368	        returns (uint256 feeGrowthInside0X128, uint256 feeGrowthInside1X128)
   369	    {
   370	        ICLPool pool = ICLPool(PoolAddress.computeAddress(CL_FACTORY, token0, token1, tickSpacing));
   371	
   372	        // To calculate the pending fees, the current tick has to be used, even if the pool would be unbalanced.
   373	        (, int24 tickCurrent,,,,) = pool.slot0();
   374	        (,,, uint256 lowerFeeGrowthOutside0X128, uint256 lowerFeeGrowthOutside1X128,,,,,) = pool.ticks(tickLower);
   375	        (,,, uint256 upperFeeGrowthOutside0X128, uint256 upperFeeGrowthOutside1X128,,,,,) = pool.ticks(tickUpper);
   376	
   377	        // Calculate the fee growth inside of the Liquidity Range since the last time the position was updated.
   378	        // feeGrowthInside can overflow (without reverting), as is the case in the Slipstream fee calculations.
   379	        unchecked {
   380	            if (tickCurrent < tickLower) {
   381	                feeGrowthInside0X128 = lowerFeeGrowthOutside0X128 - upperFeeGrowthOutside0X128;
   382	                feeGrowthInside1X128 = lowerFeeGrowthOutside1X128 - upperFeeGrowthOutside1X128;
   383	            } else if (tickCurrent < tickUpper) {
   384	                feeGrowthInside0X128 =
   385	                    pool.feeGrowthGlobal0X128() - lowerFeeGrowthOutside0X128 - upperFeeGrowthOutside0X128;
   386	                feeGrowthInside1X128 =
   387	                    pool.feeGrowthGlobal1X128() - lowerFeeGrowthOutside1X128 - upperFeeGrowthOutside1X128;
   388	            } else {
   389	                feeGrowthInside0X128 = upperFeeGrowthOutside0X128 - lowerFeeGrowthOutside0X128;
   390	                feeGrowthInside1X128 = upperFeeGrowthOutside1X128 - lowerFeeGrowthOutside1X128;
   391	            }
   392	        }
   393	    }
   394	
   395	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   396	                    RISK VARIABLES MANAGEMENT
   397	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   398	
   399	    /**
   400	     * @notice Returns the risk factors of an asset for a Creditor.
   401	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   402	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   403	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   404	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   405	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   406	     */
   407	    function getRiskFactors(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId)
   408	        external
   409	        view
   410	        override
   411	        returns (uint16 collateralFactor, uint16 liquidationFactor)
   412	    {
   413	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys = _getUnderlyingAssets(_getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId));
   414	
   415	        address[] memory assets = new address[](2);
   416	        uint256[] memory assetIds = new uint256[](2);
   417	
   418	        (assets[0], assetIds[0]) = _getAssetFromKey(underlyingAssetKeys[0]);
   419	        (assets[1], assetIds[1]) = _getAssetFromKey(underlyingAssetKeys[1]);
   420	
   421	        (uint16[] memory collateralFactors, uint16[] memory liquidationFactors) =
   422	            IRegistry(REGISTRY).getRiskFactors(creditor, assets, assetIds);
   423	
   424	        // Lower risk factors with the protocol wide risk factor.
   425	        uint256 riskFactor = riskParams[creditor].riskFactor;
   426	
   427	        // Keep the lowest risk factor of all underlying assets.
   428	        // Unsafe cast: collateralFactor and liquidationFactor are smaller than or equal to 1e4.
   429	        collateralFactor = uint16(
   430	            collateralFactors[0] < collateralFactors[1]
   431	                ? riskFactor.mulDivDown(collateralFactors[0], AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   432	                : riskFactor.mulDivDown(collateralFactors[1], AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   433	        );
   434	        liquidationFactor = uint16(
   435	            liquidationFactors[0] < liquidationFactors[1]
   436	                ? riskFactor.mulDivDown(liquidationFactors[0], AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   437	                : riskFactor.mulDivDown(liquidationFactors[1], AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   438	        );
   439	    }
   440	
   441	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   442	                          PRICING LOGIC
   443	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   444	
   445	    /**
   446	     * @notice Returns the USD value of an asset.
   447	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   448	     * @param underlyingAssetsAmounts The corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s), in the decimal precision of the Underlying Asset.
   449	     * @param rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The USD rates of 10**18 tokens of underlying asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   450	     * @return valueInUsd The value of the asset denominated in USD, with 18 Decimals precision.
   451	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   452	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   453	     * @dev We take the most conservative (lowest) risk factor of all underlying assets.
   454	     */
   455	    function _calculateValueAndRiskFactors(
   456	        address creditor,
   457	        uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts,
   458	        AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd
   459	    ) internal view override returns (uint256 valueInUsd, uint256 collateralFactor, uint256 liquidationFactor) {
   460	        // "rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd" is the USD value with 18 decimals precision for 10**18 tokens of Underlying Asset.
   461	        // To get the USD value (also with 18 decimals) of the actual amount of underlying assets, we have to multiply
   462	        // the actual amount with the rate for 10**18 tokens, and divide by 10**18.
   463	        valueInUsd = underlyingAssetsAmounts[0].mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue, 1e18)
   464	            + underlyingAssetsAmounts[1].mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue, 1e18);
   465	
   466	        // Lower risk factors with the protocol wide risk factor.
   467	        uint256 riskFactor = riskParams[creditor].riskFactor;
   468	
   469	        // Keep the lowest risk factor of all underlying assets.
   470	        collateralFactor = rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].collateralFactor < rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].collateralFactor
   471	            ? riskFactor.mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].collateralFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   472	            : riskFactor.mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].collateralFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4);
   473	        liquidationFactor = rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].liquidationFactor
   474	            < rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].liquidationFactor
   475	            ? riskFactor.mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].liquidationFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   476	            : riskFactor.mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].liquidationFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4);
   477	    }
   478	
   479	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   480	                    WITHDRAWALS AND DEPOSITS
   481	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   482	
   483	    /**
   484	     * @notice Increases the exposure to an asset on a direct deposit.
   485	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   486	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   487	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   488	     * @param amount The amount of tokens.
   489	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
   490	     * @dev super.processDirectDeposit checks that msg.sender is the Registry.
   491	     */
   492	    function processDirectDeposit(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId, uint256 amount)
   493	        public
   494	        override
   495	        returns (uint256 recursiveCalls)
   496	    {
   497	        // Amount deposited of a Slipstream LP can be either 0 or 1 (checked in the Account).
   498	        // For Slipstream every id is a unique asset -> on every deposit the asset must added to the Asset Module.
   499	        if (amount == 1) _addAsset(assetId);
   500	
   501	        // Also checks that msg.sender == Registry.
   502	        recursiveCalls = super.processDirectDeposit(creditor, asset, assetId, amount);
   503	    }
   504	
   505	    /**
   506	     * @notice Increases the exposure to an asset on an indirect deposit.
   507	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   508	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   509	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   510	     * @param exposureUpperAssetToAsset The amount of exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module.
   511	     * @param deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module since last interaction.
   512	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
   513	     * @return usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset The USD value of the exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module, 18 decimals precision.
   514	     * @dev super.processIndirectDeposit checks that msg.sender is the Registry.
   515	     * @dev deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset of a Slipstream LP must be either 0 or 1 for processIndirectDeposit().
   516	     */
   517	    function processIndirectDeposit(
   518	        address creditor,
   519	        address asset,
   520	        uint256 assetId,
   521	        uint256 exposureUpperAssetToAsset,
   522	        int256 deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
   523	    ) public override returns (uint256 recursiveCalls, uint256 usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset) {
   524	        // deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset of a Slipstream LP can be either 0 or 1.
   525	        // For Slipstream every id is a unique asset -> on a deposit, the asset must added to the Asset Module.
   526	        if (deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset == 1) _addAsset(assetId);
   527	        else if (deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset != 0) revert InvalidAmount();
   528	
   529	        // Also checks that msg.sender == Registry.
   530	        (recursiveCalls, usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset) = super.processIndirectDeposit(
   531	            creditor, asset, assetId, exposureUpperAssetToAsset, deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
   532	        );
   533	    }
   534	
   535	    /**
   536	     * @notice Decreases the exposure to an asset on a direct withdrawal.
   537	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   538	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   539	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   540	     * @param amount The amount of tokens.
   541	     * @dev super.processDirectWithdrawal checks that msg.sender is the Registry.
   542	     * @dev If the asset is withdrawn, remove its liquidity from the mapping.
   543	     * If we would keep the liquidity of the asset in storage,
   544	     * _getUnderlyingAssets() would keep using the liquidity of the asset at the time of deposit.
   545	     * This might result in a wrongly calculated getValue() of the non-deposited asset (for off-chain purposes).
   546	     */
   547	    function processDirectWithdrawal(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId, uint256 amount) public override {
   548	        // Also checks that msg.sender == Registry.
   549	        super.processDirectWithdrawal(creditor, asset, assetId, amount);
   550	
   551	        // Amount withdrawn of a Slipstream LP can be either 0 or 1 (checked in the Account).
   552	        if (amount == 1) delete assetToLiquidity[assetId];
   553	    }
   554	
   555	    /**
   556	     * @notice Decreases the exposure to an asset on an indirect withdrawal.
   557	     * @param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
   558	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   559	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   560	     * @param exposureUpperAssetToAsset The amount of exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module.
   561	     * @param deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module since last interaction.
   562	     * @return usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset The USD value of the exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module, 18 decimals precision.
   563	     * @dev super.processIndirectWithdrawal checks that msg.sender is the Registry.
   564	     * @dev If the asset is withdrawn, remove its liquidity from the mapping.
   565	     * If we would keep the liquidity of the asset in storage,
   566	     * _getUnderlyingAssets() would keep using the liquidity of the asset at the time of deposit.
   567	     * This might result in a wrongly calculated getValue() of the non-deposited asset (for off-chain purposes).
   568	     * @dev deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset of a Slipstream LP must be either 0 or -1 for processIndirectWithdrawal().
   569	     * But we do NOT revert if the value is different from 0 or -1, since this would block withdrawals and hence liquidations,
   570	     * which is worse as having wrongly calculated exposures.
   571	     */
   572	    function processIndirectWithdrawal(
   573	        address creditor,
   574	        address asset,
   575	        uint256 assetId,
   576	        uint256 exposureUpperAssetToAsset,
   577	        int256 deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
   578	    ) public override returns (uint256 usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset) {
   579	        // Also checks that msg.sender == Registry.
   580	        usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset = super.processIndirectWithdrawal(
   581	            creditor, asset, assetId, exposureUpperAssetToAsset, deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
   582	        );
   583	
   584	        // deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset of a Slipstream LP can be either 0 or -1.
   585	        if (deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset == -1) delete assetToLiquidity[assetId];
   586	    }
   587	}
```

```solidity
   128	    /**

   144	
   145	    /**
   146	     * @notice Adds a new Gauge to the StakedSlipstreamAM.

   150	    function addGauge(address gauge) external onlyOwner {
```
