```solidity
   161	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   162	                        ASSET INFORMATION
   163	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   164	
   165	    /**
   166	     * @notice Checks for a token address and the corresponding id if it is allowed.
   167	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   168	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   169	     * @return A boolean, indicating if the asset is allowed.
   170	     */
   171	    function isAllowed(address asset, uint256 assetId) public view override returns (bool) {
   172	        if (asset == address(this) && _ownerOf[assetId] != address(0)) return true;
   173	        else return false;
   174	    }
   175	
   176	    /**
   177	     * @notice Returns the unique identifiers of the Underlying Assets.
   178	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   179	     * @return underlyingAssetKeys The unique identifiers of the Underlying Assets.
   180	     */
   181	    function _getUnderlyingAssets(bytes32 assetKey)
   182	        internal
   183	        view
   184	        override
   185	        returns (bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys)
   186	    {
   187	        underlyingAssetKeys = assetToUnderlyingAssets[assetKey];
   188	    }
   189	
   190	    /**
   191	     * @notice Calculates for a given asset the corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s).
   192	     * @param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
   193	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   194	     * @param amount The amount of the asset, in the decimal precision of the Asset.
   195	     * @param underlyingAssetKeys The unique identifiers of the Underlying Assets.
   196	     * @return underlyingAssetsAmounts The corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s), in the decimal precision of the Underlying Asset.
   197	     * @return rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The usd rates of 1e18 tokens of Underlying Asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   198	     * @dev External price feeds of the Underlying Liquidity Position are used to calculate the flashloan resistant amounts.
   199	     * This approach accommodates scenarios where an underlying asset could be
   200	     * a derived asset itself (e.g., USDC/aUSDC pool), ensuring more versatile and accurate price calculations.
   201	     */
   202	    function _getUnderlyingAssetsAmounts(
   203	        address creditor,
   204	        bytes32 assetKey,
   205	        uint256 amount,
   206	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys
   207	    )
   208	        internal
   209	        view
   210	        override
   211	        returns (uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts, AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd)
   212	    {
   213	        // Amount of a Staked Slipstream LP can only be either 0 or 1.
   214	        if (amount == 0) {
   215	            return (new uint256[](3), rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd);
   216	        }
   217	
   218	        // Get the trusted rates to USD of the Underlying Assets.
   219	        rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd = _getRateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd(creditor, underlyingAssetKeys);
   220	
   221	        // Calculate amount0 and amount1 of the principal (the actual liquidity position).
   222	        // The liquidity of the Liquidity Position is stored in the Asset Module,
   223	        // not fetched from the NonfungiblePositionManager.
   224	        // Since liquidity of a position can be increased by a non-owner,
   225	        // the max exposure checks for the principal of the position could otherwise be circumvented.
   226	        (, uint256 assetId) = _getAssetFromKey(assetKey);
   227	        underlyingAssetsAmounts = new uint256[](3);
   228	        (underlyingAssetsAmounts[0], underlyingAssetsAmounts[1]) = _getPrincipalAmounts(
   229	            positionState[assetId].tickLower,
   230	            positionState[assetId].tickUpper,
   231	            positionState[assetId].liquidity,
   232	            rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue,
   233	            rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue
   234	        );
   235	
   236	        // Get the staking rewards.
   237	        underlyingAssetsAmounts[2] = rewardOf(assetId);
   238	    }
   239	
   240	    /**
   241	     * @notice Calculates the underlying token amounts of a liquidity position, given external trusted prices.
   242	     * @param tickLower The lower tick of the liquidity position.
   243	     * @param tickUpper The upper tick of the liquidity position.
   244	     * @param priceToken0 The price of 1e18 tokens of token0 in USD, with 18 decimals precision.
   245	     * @param priceToken1 The price of 1e18 tokens of token1 in USD, with 18 decimals precision.
   246	     * @return amount0 The amount of underlying token0 tokens.
   247	     * @return amount1 The amount of underlying token1 tokens.
   248	     */
   249	    function _getPrincipalAmounts(
   250	        int24 tickLower,
   251	        int24 tickUpper,
   252	        uint128 liquidity,
   253	        uint256 priceToken0,
   254	        uint256 priceToken1
   255	    ) internal pure returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) {
   256	        // Calculate the square root of the relative rate sqrt(token1/token0) from the trusted USD price of both tokens.
   257	        // sqrtPriceX96 is a binary fixed point number with 96 digits precision.
   258	        uint160 sqrtPriceX96 = _getSqrtPriceX96(priceToken0, priceToken1);
   259	
   260	        // Calculate amount0 and amount1 of the principal (the liquidity position without accumulated fees).
   261	        (amount0, amount1) = LiquidityAmounts.getAmountsForLiquidity(
   262	            sqrtPriceX96, TickMath.getSqrtRatioAtTick(tickLower), TickMath.getSqrtRatioAtTick(tickUpper), liquidity
   263	        );
   264	    }
   265	
   266	    /**
   267	     * @notice Calculates the sqrtPriceX96 (token1/token0) from trusted USD prices of both tokens.
   268	     * @param priceToken0 The price of 1e18 tokens of token0 in USD, with 18 decimals precision.
   269	     * @param priceToken1 The price of 1e18 tokens of token1 in USD, with 18 decimals precision.
   270	     * @return sqrtPriceX96 The square root of the price (token1/token0), with 96 binary precision.
   271	     * @dev The price in Slipstream is defined as:
   272	     * price = amountToken1/amountToken0.
   273	     * The usdPriceToken is defined as: usdPriceToken = amountUsd/amountToken.
   274	     * => amountToken = amountUsd/usdPriceToken.
   275	     * Hence we can derive the Slipstream price as:
   276	     * price = (amountUsd/usdPriceToken1)/(amountUsd/usdPriceToken0) = usdPriceToken0/usdPriceToken1.
   277	     */
   278	    function _getSqrtPriceX96(uint256 priceToken0, uint256 priceToken1) internal pure returns (uint160 sqrtPriceX96) {
   279	        if (priceToken1 == 0) return TickMath.MAX_SQRT_RATIO;
   280	
   281	        // Both priceTokens have 18 decimals precision and result of division should have 28 decimals precision.
   282	        // -> multiply by 1e28
   283	        // priceXd28 will overflow if priceToken0 is greater than 1.158e+49.
   284	        // For WBTC (which only has 8 decimals) this would require a bitcoin price greater than 115 792 089 237 316 198 989 824 USD/BTC.
   285	        uint256 priceXd28 = priceToken0.mulDivDown(1e28, priceToken1);
   286	        // Square root of a number with 28 decimals precision has 14 decimals precision.
   287	        uint256 sqrtPriceXd14 = FixedPointMathLib.sqrt(priceXd28);
   288	
   289	        // Change sqrtPrice from a decimal fixed point number with 14 digits to a binary fixed point number with 96 digits.
   290	        // Unsafe cast: Cast will only overflow when priceToken0/priceToken1 >= 2^128.
   291	        sqrtPriceX96 = uint160((sqrtPriceXd14 << FixedPoint96.RESOLUTION) / 1e14);
   292	    }
   293	
   294	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   295	                    RISK VARIABLES MANAGEMENT
   296	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   297	
   298	    /**
   299	     * @notice Returns the risk factors of an asset for a Creditor.
   300	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   301	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   302	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   303	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   304	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   305	     */
   306	    function getRiskFactors(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId)
   307	        external
   308	        view
   309	        override
   310	        returns (uint16 collateralFactor, uint16 liquidationFactor)
   311	    {
   312	        bytes32 assetKey = _getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId);
   313	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys = _getUnderlyingAssets(assetKey);
   314	
   315	        (uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts,) =
   316	            _getUnderlyingAssetsAmounts(creditor, assetKey, 1, underlyingAssetKeys);
   317	        AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd =
   318	            _getRateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd(creditor, underlyingAssetKeys);
   319	
   320	        (, uint256 collateralFactor_, uint256 liquidationFactor_) =
   321	            _calculateValueAndRiskFactors(creditor, underlyingAssetsAmounts, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd);
   322	
   323	        // Unsafe cast: collateralFactor_ and liquidationFactor_ are smaller than or equal to 1e4.
   324	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   325	        return (uint16(collateralFactor_), uint16(liquidationFactor_));
   326	    }
   327	
   328	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   329	                          PRICING LOGIC
   330	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   331	
   332	    /**
   333	     * @notice Returns the USD value of an asset.
   334	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   335	     * @param underlyingAssetsAmounts The corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s), in the decimal precision of the Underlying Asset.
   336	     * @param rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The USD rates of 10**18 tokens of underlying asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   337	     * @return valueInUsd The value of the asset denominated in USD, with 18 Decimals precision.
   338	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   339	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   340	     * @dev We take the most conservative (lowest) risk factor of the principal assets of the Liquidity Position.
   341	     * Next we take a USD-value weighted average of the risk factors of the principal and staking rewards.
   342	     */
   343	    function _calculateValueAndRiskFactors(
   344	        address creditor,
   345	        uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts,
   346	        AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd
   347	    ) internal view override returns (uint256 valueInUsd, uint256 collateralFactor, uint256 liquidationFactor) {
   348	        // "rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd" is the USD value with 18 decimals precision for 10**18 tokens of Underlying Asset.
   349	        // To get the USD value (also with 18 decimals) of the actual amount of underlying assets, we have to multiply
   350	        // the actual amount with the rate for 10**18 tokens, and divide by 10**18.
   351	        uint256 valuePrincipal = underlyingAssetsAmounts[0].mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue, 1e18)
   352	            + underlyingAssetsAmounts[1].mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue, 1e18);
   353	        uint256 valueReward = underlyingAssetsAmounts[2].mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[2].assetValue, 1e18);
   354	        valueInUsd = valuePrincipal + valueReward;
   355	
   356	        if (valueInUsd == 0) return (0, 0, 0);
   357	
   358	        // Keep the lowest risk factor of the principal assets.
   359	        collateralFactor = rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].collateralFactor < rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].collateralFactor
   360	            ? rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].collateralFactor
   361	            : rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].collateralFactor;
   362	        liquidationFactor = rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].liquidationFactor
   363	            < rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].liquidationFactor
   364	            ? rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].liquidationFactor
   365	            : rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].liquidationFactor;
   366	
   367	        // Calculate weighted risk factors of principal and reward.
   368	        unchecked {
   369	            collateralFactor =
   370	                (valuePrincipal * collateralFactor + valueReward * rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[2].collateralFactor)
   371	                    / valueInUsd;
   372	            liquidationFactor =
   373	                (valuePrincipal * liquidationFactor + valueReward * rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[2].liquidationFactor)
   374	                    / valueInUsd;
   375	        }
   376	
   377	        // Lower risk factors with the protocol wide risk factor.
   378	        uint256 riskFactor = riskParams[creditor].riskFactor;
   379	        collateralFactor = riskFactor.mulDivDown(collateralFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4);
   380	        liquidationFactor = riskFactor.mulDivDown(liquidationFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4);
   381	    }
   382	
   383	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   384	                         STAKING MODULE LOGIC
   385	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   386	
   387	    /**
   388	     * @notice Stakes a Slipstream Liquidity Position in its Gauge and mints a new position.
   389	     * @param assetId The id of the Liquidity Position.
   390	     * @return positionId The id of the Minted Position.
   391	     * @dev the Minted Position has the same id as the Liquidity Position.
   392	     */
   393	    function mint(uint256 assetId) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 positionId) {
   394	        if (assetId > type(uint96).max) revert InvalidId();
   395	        NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), assetId);
   396	
   397	        // Get position.
   398	        (
   399	            ,,
   400	            address token0,
   401	            address token1,
   402	            int24 tickSpacing,
   403	            int24 tickLower,
   404	            int24 tickUpper,
   405	            uint128 liquidity,,,,
   406	        ) = NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER.positions(assetId);
   407	        if (liquidity == 0) revert ZeroLiquidity();
   408	
   409	        // Get the Gauge.
   410	        // If the gauge is not approved, poolToGauge will return the 0 address and deposit will revert.
   411	        address gauge = poolToGauge[PoolAddress.computeAddress(CL_FACTORY, token0, token1, tickSpacing)];
   412	
   413	        // Store the position state.
   414	        positionState[assetId] =
   415	            PositionState({ tickLower: tickLower, tickUpper: tickUpper, liquidity: liquidity, gauge: gauge });
   416	
   417	        // Store underlying assets.
   418	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys = new bytes32[](3);
   419	        underlyingAssetKeys[0] = _getKeyFromAsset(token0, 0);
   420	        underlyingAssetKeys[1] = _getKeyFromAsset(token1, 0);
   421	        underlyingAssetKeys[2] = _getKeyFromAsset(address(REWARD_TOKEN), 0);
   422	        assetToUnderlyingAssets[_getKeyFromAsset(address(this), assetId)] = underlyingAssetKeys;
   423	
   424	        // Stake the Liquidity Position.
   425	        NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER.approve(gauge, assetId);
   426	        ICLGauge(gauge).deposit(assetId);
   427	
   428	        // If the Liquidity Position already collected fees,
   429	        // these were claimed during the deposit and send to this contract.
   430	        uint256 balance0 = ERC20(token0).balanceOf(address(this));
   431	        uint256 balance1 = ERC20(token1).balanceOf(address(this));
   432	        if (balance0 > 0) ERC20(token0).safeTransfer(msg.sender, balance0);
   433	        if (balance1 > 0) ERC20(token1).safeTransfer(msg.sender, balance1);
   434	
   435	        // Mint the new position, with same id as the underlying position.
   436	        positionId = assetId;
   437	        _safeMint(msg.sender, positionId);
   438	    }
   439	
   440	    /**
   441	     * @notice Unstakes a staked Slipstream Liquidity Position and claims rewards.
   442	     * @param positionId The id of the position.
   443	     * @return rewards The amount of reward tokens claimed.
   444	     */
   445	    function burn(uint256 positionId) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 rewards) {
   446	        if (_ownerOf[positionId] != msg.sender) revert NotOwner();
   447	
   448	        // Unstake the Liquidity Position.
   449	        ICLGauge(positionState[positionId].gauge).withdraw(positionId);
   450	        rewards = REWARD_TOKEN.balanceOf(address(this));
   451	
   452	        // Burn the position.
   453	        delete positionState[positionId];
   454	        _burn(positionId);
   455	
   456	        // Pay out the rewards to the position owner.
   457	        if (rewards > 0) {
   458	            // Transfer reward
   459	            REWARD_TOKEN.safeTransfer(msg.sender, rewards);
   460	            // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   461	            emit RewardPaid(positionId, address(REWARD_TOKEN), uint128(rewards));
   462	        }
   463	
   464	        // Transfer the asset back to the position owner.
   465	        NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER.safeTransferFrom(address(this), msg.sender, positionId);
   466	    }
   467	
   468	    /**
   469	     * @notice Claims and transfers the staking rewards of the position.
   470	     * @param positionId The id of the position.
   471	     * @return rewards The amount of reward tokens claimed.
   472	     */
   473	    function claimReward(uint256 positionId) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 rewards) {
   474	        if (_ownerOf[positionId] != msg.sender) revert NotOwner();
   475	
   476	        // Claim the rewards from the external staking contract.
   477	        ICLGauge(positionState[positionId].gauge).getReward(positionId);
   478	        rewards = REWARD_TOKEN.balanceOf(address(this));
   479	
   480	        // Pay out the rewards to the position owner.
   481	        if (rewards > 0) {
   482	            // Transfer reward
   483	            REWARD_TOKEN.safeTransfer(msg.sender, rewards);
   484	            // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   485	            emit RewardPaid(positionId, address(REWARD_TOKEN), uint128(rewards));
   486	        }
   487	    }
   488	
   489	    /**
   490	     * @notice Returns the amount of reward tokens claimable by a position.
   491	     * @param positionId The id of the position to check the rewards for.
   492	     * @return rewards The current amount of reward tokens claimable by the owner of the position.
   493	     */
   494	    function rewardOf(uint256 positionId) public view returns (uint256 rewards) {
   495	        rewards = ICLGauge(positionState[positionId].gauge).earned(address(this), positionId);
   496	    }
   497	
   498	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   499	                        ERC-721 LOGIC
   500	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   501	
   502	    /**
   503	     * @notice Function that stores a new base URI.
   504	     * @param newBaseURI The new base URI to store.
   505	     */
   506	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function,mixed-case-variable)
   507	    function setBaseURI(string calldata newBaseURI) external onlyOwner {
   508	        baseURI = newBaseURI;
   509	    }
   510	
   511	    /**
   512	     * @notice Function that returns the token URI as defined in the ERC721 standard.
   513	     * @param tokenId The id of the Account.
   514	     * @return uri The token URI.
   515	     */
   516	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function,mixed-case-variable)
   517	    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) public view override returns (string memory uri) {
   518	        return bytes(baseURI).length > 0 ? string(abi.encodePacked(baseURI, tokenId.toString())) : "";
   519	    }
   520	
   521	    /**
   522	     * @notice Returns the onERC721Received selector.
   523	     */
   524	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function)
   525	    function onERC721Received(address, address, uint256, bytes calldata) public pure returns (bytes4) {
   526	        return this.onERC721Received.selector;
   527	    }
   528	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/asset-modules/Slipstream/libraries/PoolAddress.sol
```solidity
     1	// https://github.com/velodrome-finance/slipstream/blob/main/contracts/periphery/libraries/PoolAddress.sol
     2	// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
     3	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     4	
     5	import { ICLFactory } from "../interfaces/ICLFactory.sol";
     6	
     7	/// @title Provides functions for deriving a pool address from the factory, tokens, and the tickSpacing
     8	library PoolAddress {
     9	    /// @notice The identifying key of the pool
    10	    struct PoolKey {
    11	        address token0;
    12	        address token1;
    13	        int24 tickSpacing;
    14	    }
    15	
    16	    /// @notice Deterministically computes the pool address given the factory and PoolKey
    17	    /// @param factory The Slipstream factory contract address
    18	    /// @param token0 Contract address of token0.
    19	    /// @param token1 Contract address of token1.
    20	    /// @param tickSpacing The tick spacing of the pool
    21	    /// @return pool The contract address of the pool
    22	    function computeAddress(address factory, address token0, address token1, int24 tickSpacing)
    23	        internal
    24	        view
    25	        returns (address pool)
    26	    {
    27	        require(token0 < token1);
    28	        pool = predictDeterministicAddress({
    29	            master: ICLFactory(factory).poolImplementation(),
    30	            salt: keccak256(abi.encode(token0, token1, tickSpacing)),
    31	            deployer: factory
    32	        });
    33	    }
    34	
    35	    /**
    36	     * @dev Computes the address of a clone deployed using {Clones-cloneDeterministic}.
    37	     */
    38	    function predictDeterministicAddress(address master, bytes32 salt, address deployer)
    39	        internal
    40	        pure
    41	        returns (address predicted)
    42	    {
    43	        // solhint-disable-next-line no-inline-assembly
    44	        assembly {
    45	            let ptr := mload(0x40)
    46	            mstore(ptr, 0x3d602d80600a3d3981f3363d3d373d3d3d363d73000000000000000000000000)
    47	            mstore(add(ptr, 0x14), shl(0x60, master))
    48	            mstore(add(ptr, 0x28), 0x5af43d82803e903d91602b57fd5bf3ff00000000000000000000000000000000)
    49	            mstore(add(ptr, 0x38), shl(0x60, deployer))
    50	            mstore(add(ptr, 0x4c), salt)
    51	            mstore(add(ptr, 0x6c), keccak256(ptr, 0x37))
    52	            predicted := keccak256(add(ptr, 0x37), 0x55)
    53	        }
    54	    }
    55	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/asset-modules/Stargate-Finance/StakedStargateAM.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { ERC20, IRegistry, StakingAM } from "../abstracts/AbstractStakingAM.sol";
     8	import { ILpStakingTime } from "./interfaces/ILpStakingTime.sol";
     9	
    10	/**
    11	 * @title Asset Module for Staked Stargate Finance pools
    12	 * @author Pragma Labs
    13	 * @notice The Staked Stargate Asset Module stores pricing logic and basic information for Staked Stargate Finance LP pools
    14	 * @dev No end-user should directly interact with the Staked Stargate Asset Module, only the Registry, the contract owner or via the actionHandler
    15	 */
    16	contract StakedStargateAM is StakingAM {
    17	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    18	                                CONSTANTS
    19	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    20	
    21	    // The Stargate LP tokens staking contract.
    22	    ILpStakingTime public immutable LP_STAKING_TIME;
    23	
    24	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    25	                                STORAGE
    26	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    27	
    28	    // Bool indicating if the AssetModule has been initialized and rewardToken is allowed.
    29	    bool internal initialized;
    30	
    31	    // Maps a Stargate Pool to its pool specific id.
    32	    mapping(address asset => uint256 pid) public assetToPid;
    33	
    34	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    35	                                ERRORS
    36	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    37	
    38	    error AssetAlreadySet();
    39	    error PoolNotAllowed();
    40	    error RewardTokenNotAllowed();
    41	
    42	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    43	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    44	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    45	
    46	    /**
    47	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    48	     * @param registry The address of the Registry.
    49	     * @param lpStakingTime The address of the Stargate LP staking contract.
    50	     * @dev The ASSET_TYPE, necessary for the deposit and withdraw logic in the Accounts, is "2" for ERC721 tokens.
    51	     */
    52	    constructor(address owner_, address registry, address lpStakingTime)
    53	        StakingAM(owner_, registry, "Arcadia Stargate Positions", "aSGP")
    54	    {
    55	        LP_STAKING_TIME = ILpStakingTime(lpStakingTime);
    56	        REWARD_TOKEN = ERC20(address(LP_STAKING_TIME.eToken()));
    57	    }
    58	
    59	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    60	                        ASSET MANAGEMENT
    61	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    62	
    63	    /**
    64	     * @notice Adds a new Staked Stargate Pool to the StargateAssetModule.
    65	     * @param pid The id of the stargatePool used in the LP_STAKING_TIME contract.
    66	     */
    67	    function addAsset(uint256 pid) external {
    68	        // poolInfo is an array -> will revert on a non-existing pid.
    69	        (address stargatePool,,,) = LP_STAKING_TIME.poolInfo(pid);
    70	
    71	        if (!IRegistry(REGISTRY).isAllowed(stargatePool, 0)) revert PoolNotAllowed();
    72	        if (assetState[stargatePool].allowed) revert AssetAlreadySet();
    73	
    74	        if (!initialized) {
    75	            if (!IRegistry(REGISTRY).isAllowed(address(REWARD_TOKEN), 0)) revert RewardTokenNotAllowed();
    76	            initialized = true;
    77	        }
    78	
    79	        assetToPid[stargatePool] = pid;
    80	        _addAsset(stargatePool);
    81	    }
    82	
    83	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    84	                    INTERACTIONS STAKING CONTRACT
    85	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    86	
    87	    /**
    88	     * @notice Stakes an amount of Asset in the external staking contract and claims pending rewards.
    89	     * @param asset The contract address of the Asset to stake.
    90	     * @param amount The amount of Asset to stake.
    91	     */
    92	    function _stakeAndClaim(address asset, uint256 amount) internal override {
    93	        ERC20(asset).approve(address(LP_STAKING_TIME), amount);
    94	
    95	        // Stake asset.
    96	        // deposit() will also claim all pending rewards from the staking contract.
    97	        LP_STAKING_TIME.deposit(assetToPid[asset], amount);
    98	    }
    99	
   100	    /**
   101	     * @notice Unstakes and withdraws the Asset from the external contract and claims pending rewards.
   102	     * @param asset The contract address of the Asset to unstake and withdraw.
   103	     * @param amount The amount of underlying tokens to unstake and withdraw.
   104	     */
   105	    function _withdrawAndClaim(address asset, uint256 amount) internal override {
   106	        // Withdraw asset.
   107	        // withdraw() will also claim all pending rewards from the staking contract.
   108	        LP_STAKING_TIME.withdraw(assetToPid[asset], amount);
   109	    }
   110	
   111	    /**
   112	     * @notice Claims the rewards available for this contract.
   113	     * @param asset The contract address of the Asset to claim the rewards for.
   114	     * @dev Withdrawing a zero amount will trigger the claim for rewards.
   115	     */
   116	    function _claimReward(address asset) internal override {
   117	        LP_STAKING_TIME.withdraw(assetToPid[asset], 0);
   118	    }
   119	
   120	    /**
   121	     * @notice Returns the amount of reward tokens that can be claimed by this contract for a specific asset.
   122	     * @param asset The Asset to get the current rewards for.
   123	     * @return currentReward The amount of reward tokens that can be claimed.
   124	     */
   125	    function _getCurrentReward(address asset) internal view override returns (uint256 currentReward) {
   126	        currentReward = LP_STAKING_TIME.pendingEmissionToken(assetToPid[asset], address(this));
   127	    }
   128	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/asset-modules/Stargate-Finance/StargateAM.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { AssetValuationLib, AssetValueAndRiskFactors } from "../../libraries/AssetValuationLib.sol";
     8	import { DerivedAM, FixedPointMathLib, IRegistry } from "../abstracts/AbstractDerivedAM.sol";
     9	import { IPool } from "./interfaces/IPool.sol";
    10	import { ISGFactory } from "./interfaces/ISGFactory.sol";
    11	
    12	/**
    13	 * @title Asset Module for non-staked Stargate Finance pools
    14	 * @author Pragma Labs
    15	 * @notice The Stargate Asset Module stores pricing logic and basic information for Stargate Finance LP pools
    16	 * @dev No end-user should directly interact with the Stargate Asset Module, only the Registry, the contract owner or via the actionHandler
    17	 */
    18	contract StargateAM is DerivedAM {
    19	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    20	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    21	                                CONSTANTS
    22	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    23	
    24	    // The Stargate Factory.
    25	    ISGFactory public immutable SG_FACTORY;
    26	
    27	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    28	                                STORAGE
    29	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    30	
    31	    // The unique identifiers of the underlying assets of a Liquidity Position.
    32	    mapping(bytes32 assetKey => bytes32[] underlyingAssetKeys) public assetToUnderlyingAssets;
    33	
    34	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    35	                                ERRORS
    36	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    37	
    38	    error InvalidPool();
    39	    error UnderlyingAssetNotAllowed();
    40	
    41	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    42	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    43	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    44	
    45	    /**
    46	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    47	     * @param registry_ The address of the Registry.
    48	     * @param stargateFactory The factory for Stargate Pools.
    49	     * @dev The ASSET_TYPE, necessary for the deposit and withdraw logic in the Accounts, is "1" for ERC20 tokens.
    50	     */
    51	    constructor(address owner_, address registry_, address stargateFactory) DerivedAM(owner_, registry_, 1) {
    52	        SG_FACTORY = ISGFactory(stargateFactory);
    53	    }
    54	
    55	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    56	                        ASSET MANAGEMENT
    57	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    58	
    59	    /**
    60	     * @notice Adds a new Stargate Pool to the StargateAssetModule.
    61	     * @param poolId The id of the stargatePool used in the LP_STAKING_TIME contract.
    62	     */
    63	    function addAsset(uint256 poolId) external {
    64	        address asset = address(SG_FACTORY.getPool(poolId));
    65	        if (asset == address(0)) revert InvalidPool();
    66	
    67	        address underlyingAsset = IPool(asset).token();
    68	        if (!IRegistry(REGISTRY).isAllowed(underlyingAsset, 0)) revert UnderlyingAssetNotAllowed();
    69	
    70	        inAssetModule[asset] = true;
    71	
    72	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssets_ = new bytes32[](1);
    73	        underlyingAssets_[0] = _getKeyFromAsset(underlyingAsset, 0);
    74	        assetToUnderlyingAssets[_getKeyFromAsset(asset, 0)] = underlyingAssets_;
    75	
    76	        // Will revert in Registry if asset was already added.
    77	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
    78	        IRegistry(REGISTRY).addAsset(uint96(ASSET_TYPE), asset);
    79	    }
    80	
    81	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    82	                        ASSET INFORMATION
    83	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    84	
    85	    /**
    86	     * @notice Checks for a token address and the corresponding Id if it is allowed.
    87	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
    88	     * param assetId The Id of the asset.
    89	     * @return allowed A boolean, indicating if the asset is allowed.
    90	     */
    91	    function isAllowed(address asset, uint256) public view override returns (bool allowed) {
    92	        if (inAssetModule[asset]) allowed = true;
    93	    }
    94	
    95	    /**
    96	     * @notice Returns the unique identifier of an asset based on the contract address and id.
    97	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
    98	     * param assetId The Id of the asset.
    99	     * @return key The unique identifier.
   100	     * @dev The assetId is hard-coded to 0, since both the assets as underlying assets for this Asset Modules are ERC20's.
   101	     */
   102	    function _getKeyFromAsset(address asset, uint256) internal pure override returns (bytes32 key) {
   103	        assembly {
   104	            key := asset
   105	        }
   106	    }
   107	
   108	    /**
   109	     * @notice Returns the contract address and id of an asset based on the unique identifier.
   110	     * @param key The unique identifier.
   111	     * @return asset The contract address of the asset.
   112	     * @return assetId The Id of the asset.
   113	     * @dev The assetId is hard-coded to 0, since both the assets as underlying assets for this Asset Modules are ERC20's.
   114	     */
   115	    function _getAssetFromKey(bytes32 key) internal pure override returns (address asset, uint256) {
   116	        assembly {
   117	            asset := key
   118	        }
   119	
   120	        return (asset, 0);
   121	    }
   122	
   123	    /**
   124	     * @notice Returns the unique identifiers of the underlying assets.
   125	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   126	     * @return underlyingAssetKeys The unique identifiers of the underlying assets.
   127	     */
   128	    function _getUnderlyingAssets(bytes32 assetKey)
   129	        internal
   130	        view
   131	        override
   132	        returns (bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys)
   133	    {
   134	        underlyingAssetKeys = assetToUnderlyingAssets[assetKey];
   135	    }
   136	
   137	    /**
   138	     * @notice Calculates for a given amount of Asset the corresponding amount(s) of underlying asset(s).
   139	     * param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
   140	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   141	     * @param amount The amount of the Asset, in the decimal precision of the Asset.
   142	     * param underlyingAssetKeys The unique identifiers of the underlying assets.
   143	     * @return underlyingAssetsAmounts The corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s), in the decimal precision of the Underlying Asset.
   144	     * @return rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The usd rates of 10**18 tokens of underlying asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   145	     */
   146	    function _getUnderlyingAssetsAmounts(address, bytes32 assetKey, uint256 amount, bytes32[] memory)
   147	        internal
   148	        view
   149	        override
   150	        returns (uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts, AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd)
   151	    {
   152	        (address asset,) = _getAssetFromKey(assetKey);
   153	
   154	        // "amountLPtoLD()" converts an amount of LP tokens into the corresponding amount of underlying tokens (LD stands for Local Decimals).
   155	        underlyingAssetsAmounts = new uint256[](1);
   156	        underlyingAssetsAmounts[0] = IPool(asset).amountLPtoLD(amount);
   157	
   158	        return (underlyingAssetsAmounts, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd);
   159	    }
   160	
   161	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   162	                    RISK VARIABLES MANAGEMENT
   163	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   164	
   165	    /**
   166	     * @notice Returns the risk factors of an asset for a Creditor.
   167	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   168	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   169	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   170	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   171	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   172	     */
   173	    function getRiskFactors(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId)
   174	        external
   175	        view
   176	        override
   177	        returns (uint16 collateralFactor, uint16 liquidationFactor)
   178	    {
   179	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys = _getUnderlyingAssets(_getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId));
   180	
   181	        address[] memory assets = new address[](1);
   182	        uint256[] memory assetIds = new uint256[](1);
   183	        (assets[0], assetIds[0]) = _getAssetFromKey(underlyingAssetKeys[0]);
   184	
   185	        (uint16[] memory collateralFactors, uint16[] memory liquidationFactors) =
   186	            IRegistry(REGISTRY).getRiskFactors(creditor, assets, assetIds);
   187	
   188	        // Cache riskFactor
   189	        uint256 riskFactor = riskParams[creditor].riskFactor;
   190	
   191	        // Lower risk factors with the protocol wide risk factor.
   192	        collateralFactor = uint16(riskFactor.mulDivDown(collateralFactors[0], AssetValuationLib.ONE_4));
   193	        liquidationFactor = uint16(riskFactor.mulDivDown(liquidationFactors[0], AssetValuationLib.ONE_4));
   194	    }
   195	
   196	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   197	                          PRICING LOGIC
   198	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   199	
   200	    /**
   201	     * @notice Returns the USD value of an asset.
   202	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   203	     * @param underlyingAssetsAmounts The corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s), in the decimal precision of the Underlying Asset.
   204	     * @param rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The USD rates of 10**18 tokens of underlying asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   205	     * @return valueInUsd The value of the asset denominated in USD, with 18 Decimals precision.
   206	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   207	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   208	     */
   209	    function _calculateValueAndRiskFactors(
   210	        address creditor,
   211	        uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts,
   212	        AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd
   213	    ) internal view override returns (uint256 valueInUsd, uint256 collateralFactor, uint256 liquidationFactor) {
   214	        // Initialize variables with first elements of array.
   215	        // "rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd" is the USD value with 18 decimals precision for 10**18 tokens of Underlying Asset.
   216	        // To get the USD value (also with 18 decimals) of the actual amount of underlying assets, we have to multiply
   217	        // the actual amount with the rate for 10**18 tokens, and divide by 10**18.
   218	        valueInUsd = underlyingAssetsAmounts[0].mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue, 1e18);
   219	
   220	        // Lower risk factors with the protocol wide risk factor.
   221	        uint256 riskFactor = riskParams[creditor].riskFactor;
   222	        collateralFactor = riskFactor.mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].collateralFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4);
   223	        liquidationFactor =
   224	            riskFactor.mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].liquidationFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4);
   225	    }
   226	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/asset-modules/UniswapV3/UniswapV3AM.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { DerivedAM, FixedPointMathLib, IRegistry } from "../abstracts/AbstractDerivedAM.sol";
     8	import { FixedPoint96 } from "./libraries/FixedPoint96.sol";
     9	import { FixedPoint128 } from "./libraries/FixedPoint128.sol";
    10	import { FullMath } from "./libraries/FullMath.sol";
    11	import { INonfungiblePositionManager } from "./interfaces/INonfungiblePositionManager.sol";
    12	import { IUniswapV3Pool } from "./interfaces/IUniswapV3Pool.sol";
    13	import { LiquidityAmounts } from "./libraries/LiquidityAmounts.sol";
    14	import { PoolAddress } from "./libraries/PoolAddress.sol";
    15	import { AssetValuationLib, AssetValueAndRiskFactors } from "../../libraries/AssetValuationLib.sol";
    16	import { TickMath } from "./libraries/TickMath.sol";
    17	
    18	/**
    19	 * @title Asset Module for Uniswap V3 Liquidity Positions
    20	 * @author Pragma Labs
    21	 * @notice The pricing logic and basic information for Uniswap V3 Liquidity Positions.
    22	 * @dev The UniswapV3AM will not price the LP tokens via direct price oracles,
    23	 * it will break down liquidity positions in the underlying tokens (ERC20s).
    24	 * Only LP tokens for which the underlying tokens are allowed as collateral can be priced.
    25	 * @dev No end-user should directly interact with the UniswapV3AM, only the Registry,
    26	 * or the contract owner.
    27	 */
    28	contract UniswapV3AM is DerivedAM {
    29	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    30	
    31	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    32	                                CONSTANTS
    33	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    34	
    35	    // The contract address of the NonfungiblePositionManager.
    36	    INonfungiblePositionManager internal immutable NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER;
    37	
    38	    // The contract address of the Uniswap V3 (or exact clone) Factory.
    39	    address internal immutable UNISWAP_V3_FACTORY;
    40	
    41	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    42	                                STORAGE
    43	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    44	
    45	    // The liquidity of the Liquidity Position when it was deposited.
    46	    mapping(uint256 assetId => uint256 liquidity) internal assetToLiquidity;
    47	
    48	    // The unique identifiers of the Underlying Assets of a Liquidity Position.
    49	    mapping(bytes32 assetKey => bytes32[] underlyingAssetKeys) public assetToUnderlyingAssets;
    50	
    51	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    52	                                ERRORS
    53	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    54	
    55	    error InvalidId();
    56	    error ZeroLiquidity();
    57	    error InvalidAmount();
    58	
    59	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    60	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    61	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    62	
    63	    /**
    64	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    65	     * @param registry_ The contract address of the Registry.
    66	     * @param nonFungiblePositionManager The contract address of the protocols NonFungiblePositionManager.
    67	     * @dev The ASSET_TYPE, necessary for the deposit and withdraw logic in the Accounts, is "2" for Uniswap V3 Liquidity Positions (ERC721).
    68	     */
    69	    constructor(address owner_, address registry_, address nonFungiblePositionManager) DerivedAM(owner_, registry_, 2) {
    70	        NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER = INonfungiblePositionManager(nonFungiblePositionManager);
    71	        UNISWAP_V3_FACTORY = INonfungiblePositionManager(nonFungiblePositionManager).factory();
    72	    }
    73	
    74	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    75	                        ASSET MANAGEMENT
    76	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    77	
    78	    /**
    79	     * @notice Adds the mapping from the NonfungiblePositionManager to this Asset Module in this Registry.
    80	     * @dev Since all assets will have the same contract address, only the NonfungiblePositionManager has to be added to the Registry.
    81	     */
    82	    function setProtocol() external onlyOwner {
    83	        inAssetModule[address(NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER)] = true;
    84	
    85	        // Will revert in Registry if asset was already added.
    86	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
    87	        IRegistry(REGISTRY).addAsset(uint96(ASSET_TYPE), address(NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER));
    88	    }
    89	
    90	    /**
    91	     * @notice Adds a new asset (Liquidity Position) to the UniswapV3AM.
    92	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
    93	     * @dev All assets (Liquidity Positions) will have the same contract address (the NonfungiblePositionManager),
    94	     * but a different id.
    95	     */
    96	    function _addAsset(uint256 assetId) internal {
    97	        if (assetId > type(uint96).max) revert InvalidId();
    98	
    99	        (,, address token0, address token1,,,, uint128 liquidity,,,,) = NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER.positions(assetId);
   100	
   101	        // No need to explicitly check if token0 and token1 are allowed, _addAsset() is only called in the
   102	        // deposit functions and there any deposit of non-allowed Underlying Assets will revert.
   103	        if (liquidity == 0) revert ZeroLiquidity();
   104	
   105	        // The liquidity of the Liquidity Position is stored in the Asset Module,
   106	        // not fetched from the NonfungiblePositionManager.
   107	        // Since liquidity of a position can be increased by a non-owner,
   108	        // the max exposure checks could otherwise be circumvented.
   109	        assetToLiquidity[assetId] = liquidity;
   110	
   111	        bytes32 assetKey = _getKeyFromAsset(address(NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER), assetId);
   112	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys = new bytes32[](2);
   113	        underlyingAssetKeys[0] = _getKeyFromAsset(token0, 0);
   114	        underlyingAssetKeys[1] = _getKeyFromAsset(token1, 0);
   115	        assetToUnderlyingAssets[assetKey] = underlyingAssetKeys;
   116	    }
   117	
   118	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   119	                        ASSET INFORMATION
   120	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   121	
   122	    /**
   123	     * @notice Checks for a token address and the corresponding id if it is allowed.
   124	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   125	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   126	     * @return A boolean, indicating if the asset is allowed.
   127	     */
   128	    function isAllowed(address asset, uint256 assetId) public view override returns (bool) {
   129	        if (asset != address(NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER)) return false;
   130	
   131	        try NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER.positions(assetId) returns (
   132	            uint96,
   133	            address,
   134	            address token0,
   135	            address token1,
   136	            uint24,
   137	            int24,
   138	            int24,
   139	            uint128 liquidity,
   140	            uint256,
   141	            uint256,
   142	            uint128,
   143	            uint128
   144	        ) {
   145	            return IRegistry(REGISTRY).isAllowed(token0, 0) && IRegistry(REGISTRY).isAllowed(token1, 0) && liquidity > 0;
   146	        } catch {
   147	            return false;
   148	        }
   149	    }
   150	
   151	    /**
   152	     * @notice Returns the unique identifiers of the Underlying Assets.
   153	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   154	     * @return underlyingAssetKeys The unique identifiers of the Underlying Assets.
   155	     */
   156	    function _getUnderlyingAssets(bytes32 assetKey)
   157	        internal
   158	        view
   159	        override
   160	        returns (bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys)
   161	    {
   162	        underlyingAssetKeys = assetToUnderlyingAssets[assetKey];
   163	
   164	        if (underlyingAssetKeys.length == 0) {
   165	            // Only used as an off-chain view function by getValue() to return the value of a non deposited Liquidity Position.
   166	            (, uint256 assetId) = _getAssetFromKey(assetKey);
   167	            (,, address token0, address token1,,,,,,,,) = NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER.positions(assetId);
   168	
   169	            underlyingAssetKeys = new bytes32[](2);
   170	            underlyingAssetKeys[0] = _getKeyFromAsset(token0, 0);
   171	            underlyingAssetKeys[1] = _getKeyFromAsset(token1, 0);
   172	        }
   173	    }
   174	
   175	    /**
   176	     * @notice Calculates for a given asset the corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s).
   177	     * @param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
   178	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   179	     * param assetAmount The amount of the asset, in the decimal precision of the Asset.
   180	     * param underlyingAssetKeys The unique identifiers of the Underlying Assets.
   181	     * @return underlyingAssetsAmounts The corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s), in the decimal precision of the Underlying Asset.
   182	     * @return rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The usd rates of 1e18 tokens of Underlying Asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   183	     * @dev External price feeds of the Underlying Assets are used to calculate the flashloan resistant amounts.
   184	     * This approach accommodates scenarios where an underlying asset could be
   185	     * a derived asset itself (e.g., USDC/aUSDC pool), ensuring more versatile and accurate price calculations.
   186	     */
   187	    function _getUnderlyingAssetsAmounts(address creditor, bytes32 assetKey, uint256 amount, bytes32[] memory)
   188	        internal
   189	        view
   190	        override
   191	        returns (uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts, AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd)
   192	    {
   193	        // Amount of a Uniswap V3 LP can only be either 0 or 1.
   194	        if (amount == 0) {
   195	            return (new uint256[](2), rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd);
   196	        }
   197	
   198	        (, uint256 assetId) = _getAssetFromKey(assetKey);
   199	
   200	        (address token0, address token1, int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper, uint128 liquidity) = _getPosition(assetId);
   201	
   202	        // Get the trusted rates to USD of the Underlying Assets.
   203	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys = new bytes32[](2);
   204	        underlyingAssetKeys[0] = _getKeyFromAsset(token0, 0);
   205	        underlyingAssetKeys[1] = _getKeyFromAsset(token1, 0);
   206	        rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd = _getRateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd(creditor, underlyingAssetKeys);
   207	
   208	        // Calculate amount0 and amount1 of the principal (the actual liquidity position).
   209	        (uint256 principal0, uint256 principal1) = _getPrincipalAmounts(
   210	            tickLower,
   211	            tickUpper,
   212	            liquidity,
   213	            rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue,
   214	            rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue
   215	        );
   216	
   217	        // Calculate amount0 and amount1 of the accumulated fees.
   218	        (uint256 fee0, uint256 fee1) = _getFeeAmounts(assetId);
   219	
   220	        // As the sole liquidity provider in a new pool,
   221	        // a malicious actor could bypass the max exposure by
   222	        // continuously swapping large amounts and increasing the fee portion
   223	        // of the liquidity position.
   224	        fee0 = fee0 > principal0 ? principal0 : fee0;
   225	        fee1 = fee1 > principal1 ? principal1 : fee1;
   226	
   227	        underlyingAssetsAmounts = new uint256[](2);
   228	        unchecked {
   229	            underlyingAssetsAmounts[0] = principal0 + fee0;
   230	            underlyingAssetsAmounts[1] = principal1 + fee1;
   231	        }
   232	    }
   233	
   234	    /**
   235	     * @notice Returns the position information.
   236	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   237	     * @return token0 Token0 of the Liquidity Pool.
   238	     * @return token1 Token1 of the Liquidity Pool.
   239	     * @return tickLower The lower tick of the liquidity position.
   240	     * @return tickUpper The upper tick of the liquidity position.
   241	     * @return liquidity The liquidity per tick of the liquidity position.
   242	     */
   243	    function _getPosition(uint256 assetId)
   244	        internal
   245	        view
   246	        returns (address token0, address token1, int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper, uint128 liquidity)
   247	    {
   248	        // For deposited assets, the liquidity of the Liquidity Position is stored in the Asset Module,
   249	        // not fetched from the NonfungiblePositionManager.
   250	        // Since liquidity of a position can be increased by a non-owner, the max exposure checks could otherwise be circumvented.
   251	        liquidity = uint128(assetToLiquidity[assetId]);
   252	
   253	        if (liquidity > 0) {
   254	            (,, token0, token1,, tickLower, tickUpper,,,,,) = NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER.positions(assetId);
   255	        } else {
   256	            // Only used as an off-chain view function by getValue() to return the value of a non deposited Liquidity Position.
   257	            (,, token0, token1,, tickLower, tickUpper, liquidity,,,,) = NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER.positions(assetId);
   258	        }
   259	    }
   260	
   261	    /**
   262	     * @notice Calculates the underlying token amounts of a liquidity position, given external trusted prices.
   263	     * @param tickLower The lower tick of the liquidity position.
   264	     * @param tickUpper The upper tick of the liquidity position.
   265	     * @param priceToken0 The price of 1e18 tokens of token0 in USD, with 18 decimals precision.
   266	     * @param priceToken1 The price of 1e18 tokens of token1 in USD, with 18 decimals precision.
   267	     * @return amount0 The amount of underlying token0 tokens.
   268	     * @return amount1 The amount of underlying token1 tokens.
   269	     */
   270	    function _getPrincipalAmounts(
   271	        int24 tickLower,
   272	        int24 tickUpper,
   273	        uint128 liquidity,
   274	        uint256 priceToken0,
   275	        uint256 priceToken1
   276	    ) internal pure returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) {
   277	        // Calculate the square root of the relative rate sqrt(token1/token0) from the trusted USD price of both tokens.
   278	        // sqrtPriceX96 is a binary fixed point number with 96 digits precision.
   279	        uint160 sqrtPriceX96 = _getSqrtPriceX96(priceToken0, priceToken1);
   280	
   281	        // Calculate amount0 and amount1 of the principal (the liquidity position without accumulated fees).
   282	        (amount0, amount1) = LiquidityAmounts.getAmountsForLiquidity(
   283	            sqrtPriceX96, TickMath.getSqrtRatioAtTick(tickLower), TickMath.getSqrtRatioAtTick(tickUpper), liquidity
   284	        );
   285	    }
   286	
   287	    /**
   288	     * @notice Calculates the sqrtPriceX96 (token1/token0) from trusted USD prices of both tokens.
   289	     * @param priceToken0 The price of 1e18 tokens of token0 in USD, with 18 decimals precision.
   290	     * @param priceToken1 The price of 1e18 tokens of token1 in USD, with 18 decimals precision.
   291	     * @return sqrtPriceX96 The square root of the price (token1/token0), with 96 binary precision.
   292	     * @dev The price in Uniswap V3 is defined as:
   293	     * price = amountToken1/amountToken0.
   294	     * The usdPriceToken is defined as: usdPriceToken = amountUsd/amountToken.
   295	     * => amountToken = amountUsd/usdPriceToken.
   296	     * Hence we can derive the Uniswap V3 price as:
   297	     * price = (amountUsd/usdPriceToken1)/(amountUsd/usdPriceToken0) = usdPriceToken0/usdPriceToken1.
   298	     */
   299	    function _getSqrtPriceX96(uint256 priceToken0, uint256 priceToken1) internal pure returns (uint160 sqrtPriceX96) {
   300	        if (priceToken1 == 0) return TickMath.MAX_SQRT_RATIO;
   301	
   302	        // Both priceTokens have 18 decimals precision and result of division should have 28 decimals precision.
   303	        // -> multiply by 1e28
   304	        // priceXd28 will overflow if priceToken0 is greater than 1.158e+49.
   305	        // For WBTC (which only has 8 decimals) this would require a bitcoin price greater than 115 792 089 237 316 198 989 824 USD/BTC.
   306	        uint256 priceXd28 = priceToken0.mulDivDown(1e28, priceToken1);
   307	        // Square root of a number with 28 decimals precision has 14 decimals precision.
   308	        uint256 sqrtPriceXd14 = FixedPointMathLib.sqrt(priceXd28);
   309	
   310	        // Change sqrtPrice from a decimal fixed point number with 14 digits to a binary fixed point number with 96 digits.
   311	        // Unsafe cast: Cast will only overflow when priceToken0/priceToken1 >= 2^128.
   312	        sqrtPriceX96 = uint160((sqrtPriceXd14 << FixedPoint96.RESOLUTION) / 1e14);
   313	    }
   314	
   315	    /**
   316	     * @notice Calculates the underlying token amounts of accrued fees, both collected and uncollected.
   317	     * @param id The id of the Liquidity Position.
   318	     * @return amount0 The amount of fees in underlying token0 tokens.
   319	     * @return amount1 The amount of fees in underlying token1 tokens.
   320	     */
   321	    function _getFeeAmounts(uint256 id) internal view returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) {
   322	        (
   323	            ,,
   324	            address token0,
   325	            address token1,
   326	            uint24 fee,
   327	            int24 tickLower,
   328	            int24 tickUpper,
   329	            uint256 liquidity, // gas: cheaper to use uint256 instead of uint128.
   330	            uint256 feeGrowthInside0LastX128,
   331	            uint256 feeGrowthInside1LastX128,
   332	            uint256 tokensOwed0, // gas: cheaper to use uint256 instead of uint128.
   333	            uint256 tokensOwed1 // gas: cheaper to use uint256 instead of uint128.
   334	        ) = NON_FUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER.positions(id);
   335	
   336	        (uint256 feeGrowthInside0CurrentX128, uint256 feeGrowthInside1CurrentX128) =
   337	            _getFeeGrowthInside(token0, token1, fee, tickLower, tickUpper);
   338	
   339	        // Calculate the total amount of fees by adding the already realized fees (tokensOwed),
   340	        // to the accumulated fees since the last time the position was updated:
   341	        // (feeGrowthInsideCurrentX128 - feeGrowthInsideLastX128) * liquidity.
   342	        // Fee calculations in NonfungiblePositionManager.sol overflow (without reverting) when
   343	        // one or both terms, or their sum, is bigger than a uint128.
   344	        // This is however much bigger than any realistic situation.
   345	        unchecked {
   346	            amount0 = FullMath.mulDiv(
   347	                feeGrowthInside0CurrentX128 - feeGrowthInside0LastX128, liquidity, FixedPoint128.Q128
   348	            ) + tokensOwed0;
   349	            amount1 = FullMath.mulDiv(
   350	                feeGrowthInside1CurrentX128 - feeGrowthInside1LastX128, liquidity, FixedPoint128.Q128
   351	            ) + tokensOwed1;
   352	        }
   353	    }
   354	
   355	    /**
   356	     * @notice Calculates the current fee growth inside the Liquidity Range.
   357	     * @param token0 Token0 of the Liquidity Pool.
   358	     * @param token1 Token1 of the Liquidity Pool.
   359	     * @param fee The fee of the Liquidity Pool.
   360	     * @param tickLower The lower tick of the liquidity position.
   361	     * @param tickUpper The upper tick of the liquidity position.
   362	     * @return feeGrowthInside0X128 The amount of fees in underlying token0 tokens.
   363	     * @return feeGrowthInside1X128 The amount of fees in underlying token1 tokens.
   364	     */
   365	    function _getFeeGrowthInside(address token0, address token1, uint24 fee, int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper)
   366	        internal
   367	        view
   368	        returns (uint256 feeGrowthInside0X128, uint256 feeGrowthInside1X128)
   369	    {
   370	        IUniswapV3Pool pool = IUniswapV3Pool(PoolAddress.computeAddress(UNISWAP_V3_FACTORY, token0, token1, fee));
   371	
   372	        // To calculate the pending fees, the current tick has to be used, even if the pool would be unbalanced.
   373	        (, int24 tickCurrent,,,,,) = pool.slot0();
   374	        (,, uint256 lowerFeeGrowthOutside0X128, uint256 lowerFeeGrowthOutside1X128,,,,) = pool.ticks(tickLower);
   375	        (,, uint256 upperFeeGrowthOutside0X128, uint256 upperFeeGrowthOutside1X128,,,,) = pool.ticks(tickUpper);
   376	
   377	        // Calculate the fee growth inside of the Liquidity Range since the last time the position was updated.
   378	        // feeGrowthInside can overflow (without reverting), as is the case in the Uniswap fee calculations.
   379	        unchecked {
   380	            if (tickCurrent < tickLower) {
   381	                feeGrowthInside0X128 = lowerFeeGrowthOutside0X128 - upperFeeGrowthOutside0X128;
   382	                feeGrowthInside1X128 = lowerFeeGrowthOutside1X128 - upperFeeGrowthOutside1X128;
   383	            } else if (tickCurrent < tickUpper) {
   384	                feeGrowthInside0X128 =
   385	                    pool.feeGrowthGlobal0X128() - lowerFeeGrowthOutside0X128 - upperFeeGrowthOutside0X128;
   386	                feeGrowthInside1X128 =
   387	                    pool.feeGrowthGlobal1X128() - lowerFeeGrowthOutside1X128 - upperFeeGrowthOutside1X128;
   388	            } else {
   389	                feeGrowthInside0X128 = upperFeeGrowthOutside0X128 - lowerFeeGrowthOutside0X128;
   390	                feeGrowthInside1X128 = upperFeeGrowthOutside1X128 - lowerFeeGrowthOutside1X128;
   391	            }
   392	        }
   393	    }
   394	
   395	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   396	                    RISK VARIABLES MANAGEMENT
   397	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   398	
   399	    /**
   400	     * @notice Returns the risk factors of an asset for a Creditor.
   401	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   402	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   403	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   404	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   405	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   406	     */
   407	    function getRiskFactors(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId)
   408	        external
   409	        view
   410	        override
   411	        returns (uint16 collateralFactor, uint16 liquidationFactor)
   412	    {
   413	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys = _getUnderlyingAssets(_getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId));
   414	
   415	        address[] memory assets = new address[](2);
   416	        uint256[] memory assetIds = new uint256[](2);
   417	
   418	        (assets[0], assetIds[0]) = _getAssetFromKey(underlyingAssetKeys[0]);
   419	        (assets[1], assetIds[1]) = _getAssetFromKey(underlyingAssetKeys[1]);
   420	
   421	        (uint16[] memory collateralFactors, uint16[] memory liquidationFactors) =
   422	            IRegistry(REGISTRY).getRiskFactors(creditor, assets, assetIds);
   423	
   424	        // Lower risk factors with the protocol wide risk factor.
   425	        uint256 riskFactor = riskParams[creditor].riskFactor;
   426	
   427	        // Keep the lowest risk factor of all underlying assets.
   428	        // Unsafe cast: collateralFactor and liquidationFactor are smaller than or equal to 1e4.
   429	        collateralFactor = uint16(
   430	            collateralFactors[0] < collateralFactors[1]
   431	                ? riskFactor.mulDivDown(collateralFactors[0], AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   432	                : riskFactor.mulDivDown(collateralFactors[1], AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   433	        );
   434	        liquidationFactor = uint16(
   435	            liquidationFactors[0] < liquidationFactors[1]
   436	                ? riskFactor.mulDivDown(liquidationFactors[0], AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   437	                : riskFactor.mulDivDown(liquidationFactors[1], AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   438	        );
   439	    }
   440	
   441	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   442	                          PRICING LOGIC
   443	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   444	
   445	    /**
   446	     * @notice Returns the USD value of an asset.
   447	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   448	     * @param underlyingAssetsAmounts The corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s), in the decimal precision of the Underlying Asset.
   449	     * @param rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The USD rates of 10**18 tokens of underlying asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   450	     * @return valueInUsd The value of the asset denominated in USD, with 18 Decimals precision.
   451	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   452	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   453	     * @dev We take the most conservative (lowest) risk factor of all underlying assets.
   454	     */
   455	    function _calculateValueAndRiskFactors(
   456	        address creditor,
   457	        uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts,
   458	        AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd
   459	    ) internal view override returns (uint256 valueInUsd, uint256 collateralFactor, uint256 liquidationFactor) {
   460	        // "rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd" is the USD value with 18 decimals precision for 10**18 tokens of Underlying Asset.
   461	        // To get the USD value (also with 18 decimals) of the actual amount of underlying assets, we have to multiply
   462	        // the actual amount with the rate for 10**18 tokens, and divide by 10**18.
   463	        valueInUsd = underlyingAssetsAmounts[0].mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue, 1e18)
   464	            + underlyingAssetsAmounts[1].mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue, 1e18);
   465	
   466	        // Lower risk factors with the protocol wide risk factor.
   467	        uint256 riskFactor = riskParams[creditor].riskFactor;
   468	
   469	        // Keep the lowest risk factor of all underlying assets.
   470	        collateralFactor = rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].collateralFactor < rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].collateralFactor
   471	            ? riskFactor.mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].collateralFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   472	            : riskFactor.mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].collateralFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4);
   473	        liquidationFactor = rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].liquidationFactor
   474	            < rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].liquidationFactor
   475	            ? riskFactor.mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].liquidationFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   476	            : riskFactor.mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].liquidationFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4);
   477	    }
   478	
   479	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   480	                    WITHDRAWALS AND DEPOSITS
   481	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   482	
   483	    /**
   484	     * @notice Increases the exposure to an asset on a direct deposit.
   485	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   486	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   487	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   488	     * @param amount The amount of tokens.
   489	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
   490	     * @dev super.processDirectDeposit checks that msg.sender is the Registry.
   491	     */
   492	    function processDirectDeposit(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId, uint256 amount)
   493	        public
   494	        override
   495	        returns (uint256 recursiveCalls)
   496	    {
   497	        // Amount deposited of a Uniswap V3 LP can be either 0 or 1 (checked in the Account).
   498	        // For uniswap V3 every id is a unique asset -> on every deposit the asset must added to the Asset Module.
   499	        if (amount == 1) _addAsset(assetId);
   500	
   501	        // Also checks that msg.sender == Registry.
   502	        recursiveCalls = super.processDirectDeposit(creditor, asset, assetId, amount);
   503	    }
   504	
   505	    /**
   506	     * @notice Increases the exposure to an asset on an indirect deposit.
   507	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   508	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   509	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   510	     * @param exposureUpperAssetToAsset The amount of exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module.
   511	     * @param deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module since last interaction.
   512	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
   513	     * @return usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset The USD value of the exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module, 18 decimals precision.
   514	     * @dev super.processIndirectDeposit checks that msg.sender is the Registry.
   515	     * @dev deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset of a Uniswap V3 LP must be either 0 or 1 for processIndirectDeposit().
   516	     */
   517	    function processIndirectDeposit(
   518	        address creditor,
   519	        address asset,
   520	        uint256 assetId,
   521	        uint256 exposureUpperAssetToAsset,
   522	        int256 deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
   523	    ) public override returns (uint256 recursiveCalls, uint256 usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset) {
   524	        // deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset of a Uniswap V3 LP can be either 0 or 1.
   525	        // For uniswap V3 every id is a unique asset -> on a deposit, the asset must added to the Asset Module.
   526	        if (deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset == 1) _addAsset(assetId);
   527	        else if (deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset != 0) revert InvalidAmount();
   528	
   529	        // Also checks that msg.sender == Registry.
   530	        (recursiveCalls, usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset) = super.processIndirectDeposit(
   531	            creditor, asset, assetId, exposureUpperAssetToAsset, deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
   532	        );
   533	    }
   534	
   535	    /**
   536	     * @notice Decreases the exposure to an asset on a direct withdrawal.
   537	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   538	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   539	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   540	     * @param amount The amount of tokens.
   541	     * @dev super.processDirectWithdrawal checks that msg.sender is the Registry.
   542	     * @dev If the asset is withdrawn, remove its liquidity from the mapping.
   543	     * If we would keep the liquidity of the asset in storage,
   544	     * _getUnderlyingAssets() would keep using the liquidity of the asset at the time of deposit.
   545	     * This might result in a wrongly calculated getValue() of the non-deposited asset (for off-chain purposes).
   546	     */
   547	    function processDirectWithdrawal(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId, uint256 amount) public override {
   548	        // Also checks that msg.sender == Registry.
   549	        super.processDirectWithdrawal(creditor, asset, assetId, amount);
   550	
   551	        // Amount withdrawn of a Uniswap V3 LP can be either 0 or 1 (checked in the Account).
   552	        if (amount == 1) delete assetToLiquidity[assetId];
   553	    }
   554	
   555	    /**
   556	     * @notice Decreases the exposure to an asset on an indirect withdrawal.
   557	     * @param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
   558	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   559	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   560	     * @param exposureUpperAssetToAsset The amount of exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module.
   561	     * @param deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module since last interaction.
   562	     * @return usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset The USD value of the exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module, 18 decimals precision.
   563	     * @dev super.processIndirectWithdrawal checks that msg.sender is the Registry.
   564	     * @dev If the asset is withdrawn, remove its liquidity from the mapping.
   565	     * If we would keep the liquidity of the asset in storage,
   566	     * _getUnderlyingAssets() would keep using the liquidity of the asset at the time of deposit.
   567	     * This might result in a wrongly calculated getValue() of the non-deposited asset (for off-chain purposes).
   568	     * @dev deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset of a Uniswap V3 LP must be either 0 or -1 for processIndirectWithdrawal().
   569	     * But we do NOT revert if the value is different from 0 or -1, since this would block withdrawals and hence liquidations,
   570	     * which is worse as having wrongly calculated exposures.
   571	     */
   572	    function processIndirectWithdrawal(
   573	        address creditor,
   574	        address asset,
   575	        uint256 assetId,
   576	        uint256 exposureUpperAssetToAsset,
   577	        int256 deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
   578	    ) public override returns (uint256 usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset) {
   579	        // Also checks that msg.sender == Registry.
   580	        usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset = super.processIndirectWithdrawal(
   581	            creditor, asset, assetId, exposureUpperAssetToAsset, deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
   582	        );
   583	
   584	        // deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset of a Uniswap V3 LP can be either 0 or -1.
   585	        if (deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset == -1) delete assetToLiquidity[assetId];
   586	    }
   587	}
```
