### accounts-v2/src/asset-modules/UniswapV3/libraries/FullMath.sol
```solidity
     1	// https://github.com/Uniswap/v3-core/blob/main/contracts/libraries/FullMath.sol
     2	// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
     3	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     4	
     5	/// @title Contains 512-bit math functions
     6	/// @notice Facilitates multiplication and division that can have overflow of an intermediate value without any loss of precision
     7	/// @dev Handles "phantom overflow" i.e., allows multiplication and division where an intermediate value overflows 256 bits
     8	library FullMath {
     9	    /// @notice Calculates floor(a×b÷denominator) with full precision. Throws if result overflows a uint256 or denominator == 0
    10	    /// @param a The multiplicand
    11	    /// @param b The multiplier
    12	    /// @param denominator The divisor
    13	    /// @return result The 256-bit result
    14	    /// @dev Credit to Remco Bloemen under MIT license https://xn--2-umb.com/21/muldiv
    15	    function mulDiv(uint256 a, uint256 b, uint256 denominator) internal pure returns (uint256 result) {
    16	        unchecked {
    17	            // 512-bit multiply [prod1 prod0] = a * b
    18	            // Compute the product mod 2**256 and mod 2**256 - 1
    19	            // then use the Chinese Remainder Theorem to reconstruct
    20	            // the 512 bit result. The result is stored in two 256
    21	            // variables such that product = prod1 * 2**256 + prod0
    22	            uint256 prod0; // Least significant 256 bits of the product
    23	            uint256 prod1; // Most significant 256 bits of the product
    24	            assembly {
    25	                let mm := mulmod(a, b, not(0))
    26	                prod0 := mul(a, b)
    27	                prod1 := sub(sub(mm, prod0), lt(mm, prod0))
    28	            }
    29	
    30	            // Handle non-overflow cases, 256 by 256 division
    31	            if (prod1 == 0) {
    32	                require(denominator > 0);
    33	                assembly {
    34	                    result := div(prod0, denominator)
    35	                }
    36	                return result;
    37	            }
    38	
    39	            // Make sure the result is less than 2**256.
    40	            // Also prevents denominator == 0
    41	            require(denominator > prod1);
    42	
    43	            ///////////////////////////////////////////////
    44	            // 512 by 256 division.
    45	            ///////////////////////////////////////////////
    46	
    47	            // Make division exact by subtracting the remainder from [prod1 prod0]
    48	            // Compute remainder using mulmod
    49	            uint256 remainder;
    50	            assembly {
    51	                remainder := mulmod(a, b, denominator)
    52	            }
    53	            // Subtract 256 bit number from 512 bit number
    54	            assembly {
    55	                prod1 := sub(prod1, gt(remainder, prod0))
    56	                prod0 := sub(prod0, remainder)
    57	            }
    58	
    59	            // Factor powers of two out of denominator
    60	            // Compute largest power of two divisor of denominator.
    61	            // Always >= 1.
    62	            uint256 twos = (type(uint256).max - denominator + 1) & denominator;
    63	            // Divide denominator by power of two
    64	            assembly {
    65	                denominator := div(denominator, twos)
    66	            }
    67	
    68	            // Divide [prod1 prod0] by the factors of two
    69	            assembly {
    70	                prod0 := div(prod0, twos)
    71	            }
    72	            // Shift in bits from prod1 into prod0. For this we need
    73	            // to flip `twos` such that it is 2**256 / twos.
    74	            // If twos is zero, then it becomes one
    75	            assembly {
    76	                twos := add(div(sub(0, twos), twos), 1)
    77	            }
    78	            prod0 |= prod1 * twos;
    79	
    80	            // Invert denominator mod 2**256
    81	            // Now that denominator is an odd number, it has an inverse
    82	            // modulo 2**256 such that denominator * inv = 1 mod 2**256.
    83	            // Compute the inverse by starting with a seed that is correct
    84	            // correct for four bits. That is, denominator * inv = 1 mod 2**4
    85	            uint256 inv = (3 * denominator) ^ 2;
    86	            // Now use Newton-Raphson iteration to improve the precision.
    87	            // Thanks to Hensel's lifting lemma, this also works in modular
    88	            // arithmetic, doubling the correct bits in each step.
    89	            inv *= 2 - denominator * inv; // inverse mod 2**8
    90	            inv *= 2 - denominator * inv; // inverse mod 2**16
    91	            inv *= 2 - denominator * inv; // inverse mod 2**32
    92	            inv *= 2 - denominator * inv; // inverse mod 2**64
    93	            inv *= 2 - denominator * inv; // inverse mod 2**128
    94	            inv *= 2 - denominator * inv; // inverse mod 2**256
    95	
    96	            // Because the division is now exact we can divide by multiplying
    97	            // with the modular inverse of denominator. This will give us the
    98	            // correct result modulo 2**256. Since the preconditions guarantee
    99	            // that the outcome is less than 2**256, this is the final result.
   100	            // We don't need to compute the high bits of the result and prod1
   101	            // is no longer required.
   102	            result = prod0 * inv;
   103	        }
   104	        return result;
   105	    }
   106	
   107	    /// @notice Calculates ceil(a×b÷denominator) with full precision. Throws if result overflows a uint256 or denominator == 0
   108	    /// @param a The multiplicand
   109	    /// @param b The multiplier
   110	    /// @param denominator The divisor
   111	    /// @return result The 256-bit result
   112	    function mulDivRoundingUp(uint256 a, uint256 b, uint256 denominator) internal pure returns (uint256 result) {
   113	        result = mulDiv(a, b, denominator);
   114	        if (mulmod(a, b, denominator) > 0) {
   115	            require(result < type(uint256).max);
   116	            result++;
   117	        }
   118	    }
   119	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/asset-modules/UniswapV3/libraries/LiquidityAmounts.sol
```solidity
     1	// https://github.com/Uniswap/v3-periphery/blob/main/contracts/libraries/LiquidityAmounts.sol
     2	// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
     3	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     4	
     5	import { FullMath } from "./FullMath.sol";
     6	import { FixedPoint96 } from "./FixedPoint96.sol";
     7	
     8	/// @title Liquidity amount functions
     9	/// @notice Provides functions for computing liquidity amounts from token amounts and prices
    10	// forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-variable)
    11	library LiquidityAmounts {
    12	    /// @notice Computes the amount of token0 for a given amount of liquidity and a price range
    13	    /// @param sqrtRatioAX96 A sqrt price representing the first tick boundary
    14	    /// @param sqrtRatioBX96 A sqrt price representing the second tick boundary
    15	    /// @param liquidity The liquidity being valued
    16	    /// @return amount0 The amount of token0
    17	    function getAmount0ForLiquidity(uint160 sqrtRatioAX96, uint160 sqrtRatioBX96, uint128 liquidity)
    18	        internal
    19	        pure
    20	        returns (uint256 amount0)
    21	    {
    22	        unchecked {
    23	            if (sqrtRatioAX96 > sqrtRatioBX96) (sqrtRatioAX96, sqrtRatioBX96) = (sqrtRatioBX96, sqrtRatioAX96);
    24	
    25	            return FullMath.mulDiv(
    26	                uint256(liquidity) << FixedPoint96.RESOLUTION, sqrtRatioBX96 - sqrtRatioAX96, sqrtRatioBX96
    27	            ) / sqrtRatioAX96;
    28	        }
    29	    }
    30	
    31	    /// @notice Computes the amount of token1 for a given amount of liquidity and a price range
    32	    /// @param sqrtRatioAX96 A sqrt price representing the first tick boundary
    33	    /// @param sqrtRatioBX96 A sqrt price representing the second tick boundary
    34	    /// @param liquidity The liquidity being valued
    35	    /// @return amount1 The amount of token1
    36	    function getAmount1ForLiquidity(uint160 sqrtRatioAX96, uint160 sqrtRatioBX96, uint128 liquidity)
    37	        internal
    38	        pure
    39	        returns (uint256 amount1)
    40	    {
    41	        unchecked {
    42	            if (sqrtRatioAX96 > sqrtRatioBX96) (sqrtRatioAX96, sqrtRatioBX96) = (sqrtRatioBX96, sqrtRatioAX96);
    43	
    44	            return FullMath.mulDiv(liquidity, sqrtRatioBX96 - sqrtRatioAX96, FixedPoint96.Q96);
    45	        }
    46	    }
    47	
    48	    /// @notice Computes the token0 and token1 value for a given amount of liquidity, the current
    49	    /// pool prices and the prices at the tick boundaries
    50	    /// @param sqrtRatioX96 A sqrt price representing the current pool prices
    51	    /// @param sqrtRatioAX96 A sqrt price representing the first tick boundary
    52	    /// @param sqrtRatioBX96 A sqrt price representing the second tick boundary
    53	    /// @param liquidity The liquidity being valued
    54	    /// @return amount0 The amount of token0
    55	    /// @return amount1 The amount of token1
    56	    function getAmountsForLiquidity(
    57	        uint160 sqrtRatioX96,
    58	        uint160 sqrtRatioAX96,
    59	        uint160 sqrtRatioBX96,
    60	        uint128 liquidity
    61	    ) internal pure returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) {
    62	        if (sqrtRatioAX96 > sqrtRatioBX96) {
    63	            (sqrtRatioAX96, sqrtRatioBX96) = (sqrtRatioBX96, sqrtRatioAX96);
    64	        }
    65	
    66	        if (sqrtRatioX96 <= sqrtRatioAX96) {
    67	            amount0 = getAmount0ForLiquidity(sqrtRatioAX96, sqrtRatioBX96, liquidity);
    68	        } else if (sqrtRatioX96 < sqrtRatioBX96) {
    69	            amount0 = getAmount0ForLiquidity(sqrtRatioX96, sqrtRatioBX96, liquidity);
    70	            amount1 = getAmount1ForLiquidity(sqrtRatioAX96, sqrtRatioX96, liquidity);
    71	        } else {
    72	            amount1 = getAmount1ForLiquidity(sqrtRatioAX96, sqrtRatioBX96, liquidity);
    73	        }
    74	    }
    75	}
```

```solidity
     1	// https://github.com/Uniswap/v3-periphery/blob/main/contracts/libraries/PoolAddress.sol

     3	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     4	
     5	/// @title Provides functions for deriving a pool address from the factory, tokens, and the fee
     6	library PoolAddress {
     7	    bytes32 internal constant POOL_INIT_CODE_HASH = 0xe34f199b19b2b4f47f68442619d555527d244f78a3297ea89325f843f87b8b54;
     8	
     9	    /// @notice The identifying key of the pool
    10	    struct PoolKey {
    11	        address token0;
    12	        address token1;
    13	        uint24 fee;
    14	    }
    15	
    16	    /// @notice Deterministically computes the pool address given the factory and PoolKey
    17	    /// @param factory The Uniswap V3 factory contract address
    18	    /// @param token0 Contract address of token0.
    19	    /// @param token1 Contract address of token1.
    20	    /// @param fee The fee of the pool.
    21	    /// @return pool The contract address of the V3 pool
    22	    function computeAddress(address factory, address token0, address token1, uint24 fee)
    23	        internal
    24	        pure
    25	        returns (address pool)
    26	    {
    27	        require(token0 < token1);
    28	        pool = address(
    29	            uint160(
    30	                uint256(
    31	                    keccak256(
    32	                        abi.encodePacked(
    33	                            hex"ff", factory, keccak256(abi.encode(token0, token1, fee)), POOL_INIT_CODE_HASH
    34	                        )
    35	                    )
    36	                )
    37	            )
    38	        );
    39	    }
    40	}
```

```solidity
    24	            uint256 absTick = tick < 0 ? uint256(-int256(tick)) : uint256(int256(tick));

    30	            if (absTick & 0x4 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xfff2e50f5f656932ef12357cf3c7fdcc) >> 128;
    31	            if (absTick & 0x8 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xffe5caca7e10e4e61c3624eaa0941cd0) >> 128;
    32	            if (absTick & 0x10 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xffcb9843d60f6159c9db58835c926644) >> 128;

    35	            if (absTick & 0x80 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xfe5dee046a99a2a811c461f1969c3053) >> 128;
    36	            if (absTick & 0x100 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xfcbe86c7900a88aedcffc83b479aa3a4) >> 128;
    37	            if (absTick & 0x200 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xf987a7253ac413176f2b074cf7815e54) >> 128;
    38	            if (absTick & 0x400 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xf3392b0822b70005940c7a398e4b70f3) >> 128;
    39	            if (absTick & 0x800 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xe7159475a2c29b7443b29c7fa6e889d9) >> 128;
    40	            if (absTick & 0x1000 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xd097f3bdfd2022b8845ad8f792aa5825) >> 128;
    41	            if (absTick & 0x2000 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xa9f746462d870fdf8a65dc1f90e061e5) >> 128;

    43	            if (absTick & 0x8000 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0x31be135f97d08fd981231505542fcfa6) >> 128;

    47	            if (absTick & 0x80000 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0x48a170391f7dc42444e8fa2) >> 128;

    58	    /// @notice Calculates the greatest tick value such that getRatioAtTick(tick) <= ratio

    99	                msb := or(msb, f)
```

### accounts-v2/src/asset-modules/UniswapV4/DefaultUniswapV4AM.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { AssetValuationLib, AssetValueAndRiskFactors } from "../../libraries/AssetValuationLib.sol";
     8	import { Currency } from "../../../lib/v4-periphery/lib/v4-core/src/types/Currency.sol";
     9	import { DerivedAM, FixedPointMathLib, IRegistry } from "../abstracts/AbstractDerivedAM.sol";
    10	import { FixedPoint96 } from "../../../lib/v4-periphery/lib/v4-core/src/libraries/FixedPoint96.sol";
    11	import { FixedPoint128 } from "../../../lib/v4-periphery/lib/v4-core/src/libraries/FixedPoint128.sol";
    12	import { FullMath } from "../../../lib/v4-periphery/lib/v4-core/src/libraries/FullMath.sol";
    13	import { Hooks } from "./libraries/Hooks.sol";
    14	import { IPoolManager } from "../../../lib/v4-periphery/lib/v4-core/src/interfaces/IPoolManager.sol";
    15	import { IPositionManager } from "./interfaces/IPositionManager.sol";
    16	import { LiquidityAmounts } from "../UniswapV3/libraries/LiquidityAmounts.sol";
    17	import { PoolId, PoolIdLibrary } from "../../../lib/v4-periphery/lib/v4-core/src/types/PoolId.sol";
    18	import { PoolKey } from "../../../lib/v4-periphery/lib/v4-core/src/types/PoolKey.sol";
    19	import { PositionInfoLibrary, PositionInfo } from "../../../lib/v4-periphery/src/libraries/PositionInfoLibrary.sol";
    20	import { StateLibrary } from "../../../lib/v4-periphery/lib/v4-core/src/libraries/StateLibrary.sol";
    21	import { TickMath } from "../../../lib/v4-periphery/lib/v4-core/src/libraries/TickMath.sol";
    22	
    23	/**
    24	 * @title Asset Module for Uniswap V4 Liquidity Positions
    25	 * @author Pragma Labs
    26	 * @notice The pricing logic and basic information for Uniswap V4 Liquidity Positions,
    27	 * that have no permissions for the BEFORE_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG and AFTER_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG hooks.
    28	 * @dev The DefaultUniswapV4AM will not price the LP tokens via direct price oracles,
    29	 * it will break down liquidity positions in the underlying tokens (ERC20s).
    30	 * Only LP tokens for which the underlying tokens are allowed as collateral can be priced.
    31	 * @dev No end-user should directly interact with the DefaultUniswapV4AM, only the Registry,
    32	 * or the contract owner.
    33	 */
    34	contract DefaultUniswapV4AM is DerivedAM {
    35	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    36	    using PoolIdLibrary for PoolKey;
    37	    using PositionInfoLibrary for PositionInfo;
    38	    using StateLibrary for IPoolManager;
    39	
    40	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    41	                                CONSTANTS
    42	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    43	
    44	    // The contract address of the PoolManager.
    45	    IPoolManager internal immutable POOL_MANAGER;
    46	
    47	    // The contract address of the PositionManager.
    48	    IPositionManager internal immutable POSITION_MANAGER;
    49	
    50	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    51	                                STORAGE
    52	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    53	
    54	    // The unique identifiers of the Underlying Assets of a Liquidity Position.
    55	    mapping(bytes32 assetKey => bytes32[] underlyingAssetKeys) public assetToUnderlyingAssets;
    56	
    57	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    58	                                ERRORS
    59	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    60	
    61	    error HooksNotAllowed();
    62	    error InvalidAmount();
    63	    error InvalidId();
    64	    error ZeroLiquidity();
    65	
    66	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    67	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    68	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    69	
    70	    /**
    71	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    72	     * @param registry_ The contract address of the Registry.
    73	     * @param positionManager The contract address of the uniswapV4 PositionManager.
    74	     * @dev The ASSET_TYPE, necessary for the deposit and withdraw logic in the Accounts, is "2" for Uniswap V4 Liquidity Positions (ERC721).
    75	     */
    76	    constructor(address owner_, address registry_, address positionManager) DerivedAM(owner_, registry_, 2) {
    77	        POSITION_MANAGER = IPositionManager(positionManager);
    78	        POOL_MANAGER = IPoolManager(POSITION_MANAGER.poolManager());
    79	    }
    80	
    81	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    82	                        ASSET MANAGEMENT
    83	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    84	
    85	    /**
    86	     * @notice Adds a new asset (Liquidity Position) to the DefaultUniswapV4AM.
    87	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
    88	     * @dev All assets (Liquidity Positions) will have the same contract address (the PositionManager),
    89	     * but a different id.
    90	     * @dev No need to check if hooks are allowed, since for deposits this implicitly imposed
    91	     * by the UniswapV4HooksRegistry, in getAssetModule().
    92	     */
    93	    function _addAsset(uint256 assetId) internal {
    94	        if (assetId > type(uint96).max) revert InvalidId();
    95	
    96	        (PoolKey memory poolKey, PositionInfo info) = POSITION_MANAGER.getPoolAndPositionInfo(assetId);
    97	        bytes32 positionId = keccak256(
    98	            abi.encodePacked(address(POSITION_MANAGER), info.tickLower(), info.tickUpper(), bytes32(assetId))
    99	        );
   100	
   101	        // Liquidity should be greater than zero.
   102	        if (POOL_MANAGER.getPositionLiquidity(poolKey.toId(), positionId) == 0) revert ZeroLiquidity();
   103	
   104	        // No need to explicitly check if token0 and token1 are allowed, _addAsset() is only called in the
   105	        // deposit functions, and deposits of non-allowed Underlying Assets will revert.
   106	        bytes32 assetKey = _getKeyFromAsset(address(POSITION_MANAGER), assetId);
   107	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys = new bytes32[](2);
   108	        underlyingAssetKeys[0] = _getKeyFromAsset(Currency.unwrap(poolKey.currency0), 0);
   109	        underlyingAssetKeys[1] = _getKeyFromAsset(Currency.unwrap(poolKey.currency1), 0);
   110	        assetToUnderlyingAssets[assetKey] = underlyingAssetKeys;
   111	    }
   112	
   113	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   114	                        ASSET INFORMATION
   115	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   116	
   117	    /**
   118	     * @notice Checks for a token address and the corresponding id if it is allowed.
   119	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   120	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   121	     * @return A boolean, indicating if the asset is allowed.
   122	     */
   123	    function isAllowed(address asset, uint256 assetId) public view override returns (bool) {
   124	        if (asset != address(POSITION_MANAGER)) return false;
   125	
   126	        try POSITION_MANAGER.getPoolAndPositionInfo(assetId) returns (PoolKey memory poolKey, PositionInfo info) {
   127	            bytes32 positionId = keccak256(
   128	                abi.encodePacked(address(POSITION_MANAGER), info.tickLower(), info.tickUpper(), bytes32(assetId))
   129	            );
   130	
   131	            // Hook flags should be valid for this specific AM.
   132	            // The NoOP hook "AFTER_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG" is by default not allowed,
   133	            // as it can only be accessed if "AFTER_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG" is implemented.
   134	            if (
   135	                Hooks.hasPermission(uint160(address(poolKey.hooks)), Hooks.BEFORE_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG)
   136	                    || Hooks.hasPermission(uint160(address(poolKey.hooks)), Hooks.AFTER_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG)
   137	            ) return false;
   138	
   139	            // Underlying assets should be allowed and liquidity should be greater than zero.
   140	            return IRegistry(REGISTRY).isAllowed(Currency.unwrap(poolKey.currency0), 0)
   141	                && IRegistry(REGISTRY).isAllowed(Currency.unwrap(poolKey.currency1), 0)
   142	                && POOL_MANAGER.getPositionLiquidity(poolKey.toId(), positionId) > 0;
   143	        } catch {
   144	            return false;
   145	        }
   146	    }
   147	
   148	    /**
   149	     * @notice Returns the unique identifiers of the Underlying Assets.
   150	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   151	     * @return underlyingAssetKeys The unique identifiers of the Underlying Assets.
   152	     */
   153	    function _getUnderlyingAssets(bytes32 assetKey)
   154	        internal
   155	        view
   156	        override
   157	        returns (bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys)
   158	    {
   159	        underlyingAssetKeys = assetToUnderlyingAssets[assetKey];
   160	
   161	        if (underlyingAssetKeys.length == 0) {
   162	            // Only used as an off-chain view function by getValue() to return the value of a non deposited Liquidity Position.
   163	            (, uint256 assetId) = _getAssetFromKey(assetKey);
   164	
   165	            (PoolKey memory poolKey,) = POSITION_MANAGER.getPoolAndPositionInfo(assetId);
   166	
   167	            underlyingAssetKeys = new bytes32[](2);
   168	            underlyingAssetKeys[0] = _getKeyFromAsset(Currency.unwrap(poolKey.currency0), 0);
   169	            underlyingAssetKeys[1] = _getKeyFromAsset(Currency.unwrap(poolKey.currency1), 0);
   170	        }
   171	    }
   172	
   173	    /**
   174	     * @notice Calculates for a given asset the corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s).
   175	     * @param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
   176	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   177	     * @param amount The amount of the asset, in the decimal precision of the Asset.
   178	     * param underlyingAssetKeys The unique identifiers of the Underlying Assets.
   179	     * @return underlyingAssetsAmounts The corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s), in the decimal precision of the Underlying Asset.
   180	     * @return rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The usd rates of 1e18 tokens of Underlying Asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   181	     * @dev External price feeds of the Underlying Assets are used to calculate the flashloan resistant amounts.
   182	     * This approach accommodates scenarios where an underlying asset could be
   183	     * a derived asset itself (e.g., USDC/aUSDC pool), ensuring more versatile and accurate price calculations.
   184	     */
   185	    function _getUnderlyingAssetsAmounts(address creditor, bytes32 assetKey, uint256 amount, bytes32[] memory)
   186	        internal
   187	        view
   188	        override
   189	        returns (uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts, AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd)
   190	    {
   191	        // Amount of a Uniswap V4 LP can only be either 0 or 1.
   192	        if (amount == 0) {
   193	            return (new uint256[](2), rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd);
   194	        }
   195	
   196	        (, uint256 assetId) = _getAssetFromKey(assetKey);
   197	
   198	        (PoolKey memory poolKey, PositionInfo info) = POSITION_MANAGER.getPoolAndPositionInfo(assetId);
   199	
   200	        // Get the trusted rates to USD of the Underlying Assets.
   201	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys = new bytes32[](2);
   202	        underlyingAssetKeys[0] = _getKeyFromAsset(Currency.unwrap(poolKey.currency0), 0);
   203	        underlyingAssetKeys[1] = _getKeyFromAsset(Currency.unwrap(poolKey.currency1), 0);
   204	        rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd = _getRateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd(creditor, underlyingAssetKeys);
   205	
   206	        // Calculate amount0 and amount1 of the principal (the actual liquidity position).
   207	        bytes32 positionId = keccak256(
   208	            abi.encodePacked(address(POSITION_MANAGER), info.tickLower(), info.tickUpper(), bytes32(assetId))
   209	        );
   210	        uint128 liquidity = POOL_MANAGER.getPositionLiquidity(poolKey.toId(), positionId);
   211	        (uint256 principal0, uint256 principal1) = _getPrincipalAmounts(
   212	            info, liquidity, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue
   213	        );
   214	
   215	        // Calculate amount0 and amount1 of the accumulated fees.
   216	        (uint256 fee0, uint256 fee1) = _getFeeAmounts(assetId, poolKey.toId(), info, liquidity);
   217	
   218	        // As the sole liquidity provider in a new pool,
   219	        // a malicious actor could bypass the max exposure by
   220	        // continuously swapping large amounts and increasing the fee portion
   221	        // of the liquidity position.
   222	        // Therefore we cap the fee amounts so that this cannot be abused to far exceed the max exposures.
   223	        unchecked {
   224	            fee0 = fee0
   225	                < principal0
   226	                    + principal1.mulDivDown(
   227	                        rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue
   228	                    )
   229	                ? fee0
   230	                : principal0
   231	                    + principal1.mulDivDown(
   232	                        rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue
   233	                    );
   234	            fee1 = fee1
   235	                < principal0.mulDivDown(
   236	                        rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue
   237	                    ) + principal1
   238	                ? fee1
   239	                : principal0.mulDivDown(
   240	                        rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue
   241	                    ) + principal1;
   242	
   243	            underlyingAssetsAmounts = new uint256[](2);
   244	            underlyingAssetsAmounts[0] = principal0 + fee0;
   245	            underlyingAssetsAmounts[1] = principal1 + fee1;
   246	        }
   247	    }
   248	
   249	    /**
   250	     * @notice Calculates the underlying token amounts of a liquidity position, given external trusted prices.
   251	     * @param info A packed struct including the poolId and the ticks of the position.
   252	     * @param liquidity The liquidity of the specific position.
   253	     * @param priceToken0 The price of 1e18 tokens of token0 in USD, with 18 decimals precision.
   254	     * @param priceToken1 The price of 1e18 tokens of token1 in USD, with 18 decimals precision.
   255	     * @return amount0 The amount of underlying token0 tokens.
   256	     * @return amount1 The amount of underlying token1 tokens.
   257	     */
   258	    function _getPrincipalAmounts(PositionInfo info, uint128 liquidity, uint256 priceToken0, uint256 priceToken1)
   259	        internal
   260	        pure
   261	        returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1)
   262	    {
   263	        // Calculate the square root of the relative rate sqrt(token1/token0) from the trusted USD price of both tokens.
   264	        // sqrtPriceX96 is a binary fixed point number with 96 digits precision.
   265	        uint160 sqrtPriceX96 = _getSqrtPriceX96(priceToken0, priceToken1);
   266	
   267	        // Calculate amount0 and amount1 of the principal (the liquidity position without accumulated fees).
   268	        (amount0, amount1) = LiquidityAmounts.getAmountsForLiquidity(
   269	            sqrtPriceX96,
   270	            TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(info.tickLower()),
   271	            TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(info.tickUpper()),
   272	            liquidity
   273	        );
   274	    }
   275	
   276	    /**
   277	     * @notice Calculates the sqrtPriceX96 (token1/token0) from trusted USD prices of both tokens.
   278	     * @param priceToken0 The price of 1e18 tokens of token0 in USD, with 18 decimals precision.
   279	     * @param priceToken1 The price of 1e18 tokens of token1 in USD, with 18 decimals precision.
   280	     * @return sqrtPriceX96 The square root of the price (token1/token0), with 96 binary precision.
   281	     * @dev The price in Uniswap V4 is defined as:
   282	     * price = amountToken1/amountToken0.
   283	     * The usdPriceToken is defined as: usdPriceToken = amountUsd/amountToken.
   284	     * => amountToken = amountUsd/usdPriceToken.
   285	     * Hence we can derive the Uniswap V4 price as:
   286	     * price = (amountUsd/usdPriceToken1)/(amountUsd/usdPriceToken0) = usdPriceToken0/usdPriceToken1.
   287	     */
   288	    function _getSqrtPriceX96(uint256 priceToken0, uint256 priceToken1) internal pure returns (uint160 sqrtPriceX96) {
   289	        if (priceToken1 == 0) return TickMath.MAX_SQRT_PRICE;
   290	
   291	        // Both priceTokens have 18 decimals precision and result of division should have 28 decimals precision.
   292	        // -> multiply by 1e28
   293	        // priceXd28 will overflow if priceToken0 is greater than 1.158e+49.
   294	        // For WBTC (which only has 8 decimals) this would require a bitcoin price greater than 115 792 089 237 316 198 989 824 USD/BTC.
   295	        uint256 priceXd28 = priceToken0.mulDivDown(1e28, priceToken1);
   296	        // Square root of a number with 28 decimals precision has 14 decimals precision.
   297	        uint256 sqrtPriceXd14 = FixedPointMathLib.sqrt(priceXd28);
   298	
   299	        // Change sqrtPrice from a decimal fixed point number with 14 digits to a binary fixed point number with 96 digits.
   300	        // Unsafe cast: Cast will only overflow when priceToken0/priceToken1 >= 2^128.
   301	        sqrtPriceX96 = uint160((sqrtPriceXd14 << FixedPoint96.RESOLUTION) / 1e14);
   302	    }
   303	
   304	    /**
   305	     * @notice Calculates the underlying token amounts of accrued fees.
   306	     * @param id The id of the Liquidity Position.
   307	     * @param poolId The id of a UniswapV4 pool computed from the PoolKey.
   308	     * @param info A packed struct including the poolId and the ticks of the position.
   309	     * @param liquidity The liquidity of the specific position.
   310	     * @return amount0 The amount of fees in underlying token0 tokens.
   311	     * @return amount1 The amount of fees in underlying token1 tokens.
   312	     */
   313	    function _getFeeAmounts(uint256 id, PoolId poolId, PositionInfo info, uint128 liquidity)
   314	        internal
   315	        view
   316	        returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1)
   317	    {
   318	        (uint256 feeGrowthInside0CurrentX128, uint256 feeGrowthInside1CurrentX128) =
   319	            POOL_MANAGER.getFeeGrowthInside(poolId, info.tickLower(), info.tickUpper());
   320	
   321	        bytes32 positionId =
   322	            keccak256(abi.encodePacked(address(POSITION_MANAGER), info.tickLower(), info.tickUpper(), bytes32(id)));
   323	
   324	        (, uint256 feeGrowthInside0LastX128, uint256 feeGrowthInside1LastX128) =
   325	            POOL_MANAGER.getPositionInfo(poolId, positionId);
   326	
   327	        // Calculate accumulated fees since the last time the position was updated:
   328	        // (feeGrowthInsideCurrentX128 - feeGrowthInsideLastX128) * liquidity.
   329	        // Fee calculations in PositionManager.sol overflow (without reverting) when
   330	        // one or both terms, or their sum, is bigger than a uint128.
   331	        // This is however much bigger than any realistic situation.
   332	        unchecked {
   333	            amount0 =
   334	                FullMath.mulDiv(feeGrowthInside0CurrentX128 - feeGrowthInside0LastX128, liquidity, FixedPoint128.Q128);
   335	            amount1 =
   336	                FullMath.mulDiv(feeGrowthInside1CurrentX128 - feeGrowthInside1LastX128, liquidity, FixedPoint128.Q128);
   337	        }
   338	    }
   339	
   340	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   341	                    RISK VARIABLES MANAGEMENT
   342	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   343	
   344	    /**
   345	     * @notice Returns the risk factors of an asset for a Creditor.
   346	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   347	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   348	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   349	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   350	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   351	     */
   352	    function getRiskFactors(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId)
   353	        external
   354	        view
   355	        override
   356	        returns (uint16 collateralFactor, uint16 liquidationFactor)
   357	    {
   358	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys = _getUnderlyingAssets(_getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId));
   359	
   360	        address[] memory assets = new address[](2);
   361	        uint256[] memory assetIds = new uint256[](2);
   362	
   363	        (assets[0], assetIds[0]) = _getAssetFromKey(underlyingAssetKeys[0]);
   364	        (assets[1], assetIds[1]) = _getAssetFromKey(underlyingAssetKeys[1]);
   365	
   366	        (uint16[] memory collateralFactors, uint16[] memory liquidationFactors) =
   367	            IRegistry(REGISTRY).getRiskFactors(creditor, assets, assetIds);
   368	
   369	        // Lower risk factors with the protocol wide risk factor.
   370	        uint256 riskFactor = riskParams[creditor].riskFactor;
   371	
   372	        // Keep the lowest risk factor of all underlying assets.
   373	        // Unsafe cast: collateralFactor and liquidationFactor are smaller than or equal to 1e4.
   374	        collateralFactor = uint16(
   375	            collateralFactors[0] < collateralFactors[1]
   376	                ? riskFactor.mulDivDown(collateralFactors[0], AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   377	                : riskFactor.mulDivDown(collateralFactors[1], AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   378	        );
   379	        liquidationFactor = uint16(
   380	            liquidationFactors[0] < liquidationFactors[1]
   381	                ? riskFactor.mulDivDown(liquidationFactors[0], AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   382	                : riskFactor.mulDivDown(liquidationFactors[1], AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   383	        );
   384	    }
   385	
   386	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   387	                          PRICING LOGIC
   388	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   389	
   390	    /**
   391	     * @notice Returns the USD value of an asset.
   392	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   393	     * @param underlyingAssetsAmounts The corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s), in the decimal precision of the Underlying Asset.
   394	     * @param rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The USD rates of 10**18 tokens of underlying asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   395	     * @return valueInUsd The value of the asset denominated in USD, with 18 Decimals precision.
   396	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   397	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   398	     * @dev We take the most conservative (lowest) risk factor of all underlying assets.
   399	     */
   400	    function _calculateValueAndRiskFactors(
   401	        address creditor,
   402	        uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts,
   403	        AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd
   404	    ) internal view override returns (uint256 valueInUsd, uint256 collateralFactor, uint256 liquidationFactor) {
   405	        // "rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd" is the USD value with 18 decimals precision for 10**18 tokens of Underlying Asset.
   406	        // To get the USD value (also with 18 decimals) of the actual amount of underlying assets, we have to multiply
   407	        // the actual amount with the rate for 10**18 tokens, and divide by 10**18.
   408	        valueInUsd = underlyingAssetsAmounts[0].mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue, 1e18)
   409	            + underlyingAssetsAmounts[1].mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue, 1e18);
   410	
   411	        // Lower risk factors with the protocol wide risk factor.
   412	        uint256 riskFactor = riskParams[creditor].riskFactor;
   413	
   414	        // Keep the lowest risk factor of all underlying assets.
   415	        collateralFactor = rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].collateralFactor < rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].collateralFactor
   416	            ? riskFactor.mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].collateralFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   417	            : riskFactor.mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].collateralFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4);
   418	        liquidationFactor = rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].liquidationFactor
   419	            < rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].liquidationFactor
   420	            ? riskFactor.mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].liquidationFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4)
   421	            : riskFactor.mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].liquidationFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4);
   422	    }
   423	
   424	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   425	                    WITHDRAWALS AND DEPOSITS
   426	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   427	
   428	    /**
   429	     * @notice Increases the exposure to an asset on a direct deposit.
   430	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   431	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   432	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   433	     * @param amount The amount of tokens.
   434	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
   435	     * @dev super.processDirectDeposit checks that msg.sender is the Registry.
   436	     */
   437	    function processDirectDeposit(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId, uint256 amount)
   438	        public
   439	        override
   440	        returns (uint256 recursiveCalls)
   441	    {
   442	        // Amount deposited of a Uniswap V4 LP can be either 0 or 1 (checked in the Account).
   443	        // For uniswap V4 every id is a unique asset -> on every deposit the asset must added to the Asset Module.
   444	        if (amount == 1) _addAsset(assetId);
   445	
   446	        // Also checks that msg.sender == Registry.
   447	        recursiveCalls = super.processDirectDeposit(creditor, asset, assetId, amount);
   448	    }
   449	
   450	    /**
   451	     * @notice Increases the exposure to an asset on an indirect deposit.
   452	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   453	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   454	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   455	     * @param exposureUpperAssetToAsset The amount of exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module.
   456	     * @param deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module since last interaction.
   457	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
   458	     * @return usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset The USD value of the exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module, 18 decimals precision.
   459	     * @dev super.processIndirectDeposit checks that msg.sender is the Registry.
   460	     * @dev deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset of a Uniswap V4 LP must be either 0 or 1 for processIndirectDeposit().
   461	     */
   462	    function processIndirectDeposit(
   463	        address creditor,
   464	        address asset,
   465	        uint256 assetId,
   466	        uint256 exposureUpperAssetToAsset,
   467	        int256 deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
   468	    ) public override returns (uint256 recursiveCalls, uint256 usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset) {
   469	        // deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset of a Uniswap V4 LP can be either 0 or 1.
   470	        // For uniswap V4 every id is a unique asset -> on a deposit, the asset must added to the Asset Module.
   471	        if (deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset == 1) _addAsset(assetId);
   472	        else if (deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset != 0) revert InvalidAmount();
   473	
   474	        // Also checks that msg.sender == Registry.
   475	        (recursiveCalls, usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset) = super.processIndirectDeposit(
   476	            creditor, asset, assetId, exposureUpperAssetToAsset, deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
   477	        );
   478	    }
   479	}
```

```solidity
    27	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    28	                                CONSTANTS
    29	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */

    33

    36	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */

    76	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

    79	
    80	    /**
    81	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.

    96	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

    98	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    99	
   100	    /**
   101	     * @notice Adds a new Asset Module to the Hooks Registry.
   102	     * @param assetModule The contract address of the Asset Module.
   103	     */
   104	    function addAssetModule(address assetModule) external onlyOwner {

   110	
   111	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

   113	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   114	
   115	    /**

   117	     */
   118	    function setProtocol() external onlyOwner {
   119	        inAssetModule[address(POSITION_MANAGER)] = true;
   120	
   121	        // Will revert in Registry if asset was already added.

   125	
   126	    /**
   127	     * @notice Adds a new hooks contract to the Hooks Registry.
   128	     * @param assetType Identifier for the type of the asset.
   129	     * @param hooks The contract address of the hooks.
   130	     * @dev Hooks that are already in the registry cannot be overwritten,
   131	     * as that would make it possible for devs to change the asset pricing.

   133	     * (no hook implemented on before or after removing liquidity) are automatically added to the Hooks Registry.
   134	     * Hence they cannot be added by specific Uniswap V4 AMs.

   136	    function addHooks(uint96 assetType, address hooks) external onlyAssetModule {
   137	        if (assetType != 2) revert RegistryErrors.InvalidAssetType();

   146	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

   148	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   149	
   150	    /**
   151	     * @notice Checks for a token address and the corresponding id if it is allowed.
   152	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   153	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   154	     * @return A boolean, indicating if the asset is allowed.
   155	     */
   156	    function isAllowed(address asset, uint256 assetId) public view override returns (bool) {
   157	        // If the caller is an Asset Module, check if the asset is allowed in the Registry.
   158	        if (isAssetModule[msg.sender]) return IRegistry(REGISTRY).isAllowed(asset, assetId);
   159	
   160	        // Else pass the call to its Asset Module.

   165	
   166	    /**
   167	     * @notice Checks if a hooks contract is in the Hooks Registry.
   168	     * @param hooks The contract address of the hooks.
   169	     * @return bool indicating if the hook is in the Hooks Registry.
   170	     */
   171	    function inRegistry(address hooks) public view returns (bool) {
   172	        // Specific Uniswap V4 AM can only be set if the default Uniswap V4 AM cannot be used.
   173	        if (
   174	            Hooks.hasPermission(uint160(hooks), Hooks.BEFORE_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG)
   175	                || Hooks.hasPermission(uint160(hooks), Hooks.AFTER_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG)
   176	        ) {
   177	            // Check if hook is added by a specific Uniswap V4 AM.
   178	            return _inRegistry[hooks];
   179	        } else {
   180	            // Hooks that can be priced by the Default Uniswap V4 AM are automatically added to the Hooks Registry.
   181	            return true;
   182	        }
   183	    }
   184	
   185	    /**
   186	     * @notice Returns the Asset Manager for a given position Id.
   187	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   188	     * @return assetModule The contract address of the Asset Module.
   189	     */
   190	    function getAssetModule(uint256 assetId) public view returns (address assetModule) {
   191	        (PoolKey memory poolKey,) = POSITION_MANAGER.getPoolAndPositionInfo(assetId);
   192	
   193	        // If the assetId does not exist, the poolKey will have zero-values,
   194	        // and for an existing pool tickSpacing can't be zero.
   195	        if (poolKey.tickSpacing == 0) return address(0);
   196	
   197	        // Check if we can use the default Uniswap V4 AM.
   198	        if (
   199	            Hooks.hasPermission(uint160(address(poolKey.hooks)), Hooks.BEFORE_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG)
   200	                || Hooks.hasPermission(uint160(address(poolKey.hooks)), Hooks.AFTER_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG)
   201	        ) {
   202	            // If not a specific Uniswap V4 AM must have been set.
   203	            // Returns the zero address if no Asset Module is set.
   204	            assetModule = hooksToAssetModule[address(poolKey.hooks)];
   205	        } else {
   206	            // If BEFORE_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG and AFTER_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG are not set,
   207	            // then we use the default Uniswap V4 AM.
   208	            // The NoOP hook "AFTER_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG" is by default not allowed,
   209	            // as it can only be accessed if "AFTER_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG" is implemented.
   210	            assetModule = DEFAULT_UNISWAP_V4_AM;
   211	        }
   212	    }
   213	
   214	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   215	                          PRICING LOGIC
   216	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   217	
   218	    /**
   219	     * @notice Returns the usd value of an asset.
   220	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   221	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   222	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   223	     * @param assetAmount The amount of assets.
   224	     * @return valueInUsd The value of the asset denominated in USD, with 18 Decimals precision.
   225	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   226	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   227	     */
   228	    function getValue(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId, uint256 assetAmount)
   229	        public
   230	        view
   231	        override
   232	        returns (uint256, uint256, uint256)
   233	    {
   234	        return IAssetModule(getAssetModule(assetId)).getValue(creditor, asset, assetId, assetAmount);
   235	    }
   236	
   237	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   238	                    RISK VARIABLES MANAGEMENT
   239	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   240	
   241	    /**
   242	     * @notice Sets the risk parameters for the protocol of the Derived Asset Module for a given Creditor.
   243	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   244	     * @param assetModule The contract address of the Derived Asset Module.
   245	     * @param maxUsdExposureProtocol The maximum USD exposure of the protocol for each Creditor,
   246	     * denominated in USD with 18 decimals precision.
   247	     * @param riskFactor The risk factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   248	     */
   249	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function)
   250	    function setRiskParametersOfDerivedAM(
   251	        address creditor,
   252	        address assetModule,
   253	        uint112 maxUsdExposureProtocol,
   254	        uint16 riskFactor
   255	    ) external onlyRiskManager(creditor) {
   256	        IDerivedAM(assetModule).setRiskParameters(creditor, maxUsdExposureProtocol, riskFactor);
   257	    }
   258	
   259	    /**
   260	     * @notice Returns the risk factors of an asset for a Creditor.
   261	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   262	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   263	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   264	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   265	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   266	     */
   267	    function getRiskFactors(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId)
   268	        external
   269	        view
   270	        override
   271	        returns (uint16 collateralFactor, uint16 liquidationFactor)
   272	    {
   273	        return IAssetModule(getAssetModule(assetId)).getRiskFactors(creditor, asset, assetId);
   274	    }
   275	
   276	    /**
   277	     * @notice Returns the risk factors per asset for a given Creditor.
   278	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   279	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   280	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   281	     * @return collateralFactors Array of the collateral factors of the assets for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   282	     * @return liquidationFactors Array of the liquidation factors of the assets for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   283	     */
   284	    function getRiskFactors(address creditor, address[] calldata assetAddresses, uint256[] calldata assetIds)
   285	        external
   286	        view
   287	        returns (uint16[] memory collateralFactors, uint16[] memory liquidationFactors)
   288	    {
   289	        (collateralFactors, liquidationFactors) = IRegistry(REGISTRY).getRiskFactors(creditor, assetAddresses, assetIds);
   290	    }
   291	
   292	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   293	                    WITHDRAWALS AND DEPOSITS
   294	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   295	
   296	    /**
   297	     * @notice Increases the exposure to an asset on a direct deposit.
   298	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   299	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   300	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   301	     * @param amount The amount of tokens.
   302	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
   303	     */
   304	    function processDirectDeposit(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId, uint256 amount)
   305	        public
   306	        override
   307	        onlyRegistry
   308	        returns (uint256 recursiveCalls)
   309	    {
   310	        return IAssetModule(getAssetModule(assetId)).processDirectDeposit(creditor, asset, assetId, amount);
   311	    }
   312	
   313	    /**
   314	     * @notice Increases the exposure to an asset on an indirect deposit.
   315	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   316	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   317	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   318	     * @param exposureUpperAssetToAsset The amount of exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module.
   319	     * @param deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module since last interaction.
   320	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
   321	     * @return usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset The USD value of the exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module, 18 decimals precision.
   322	     */
   323	    function processIndirectDeposit(
   324	        address creditor,
   325	        address asset,
   326	        uint256 assetId,
   327	        uint256 exposureUpperAssetToAsset,
   328	        int256 deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
   329	    ) public override onlyRegistry returns (uint256 recursiveCalls, uint256 usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset) {
   330	        return IAssetModule(getAssetModule(assetId))
   331	            .processIndirectDeposit(creditor, asset, assetId, exposureUpperAssetToAsset, deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset);
   332	    }
   333	
   334	    /**
   335	     * @notice Decreases the exposure to an asset on a direct withdrawal.
   336	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   337	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   338	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   339	     * @param amount The amount of tokens.
   340	     */
   341	    function processDirectWithdrawal(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId, uint256 amount)
   342	        public
   343	        override
   344	        onlyRegistry
   345	    {
   346	        return IAssetModule(getAssetModule(assetId)).processDirectWithdrawal(creditor, asset, assetId, amount);
   347	    }
   348	
   349	    /**
   350	     * @notice Decreases the exposure to an asset on an indirect withdrawal.
   351	     * @param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
   352	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   353	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   354	     * @param exposureUpperAssetToAsset The amount of exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module.
   355	     * @param deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module since last interaction.
   356	     * @return usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset The USD value of the exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module, 18 decimals precision.
   357	     */
   358	    function processIndirectWithdrawal(
   359	        address creditor,
   360	        address asset,
   361	        uint256 assetId,
   362	        uint256 exposureUpperAssetToAsset,
   363	        int256 deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
   364	    ) public override onlyRegistry returns (uint256 usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset) {
   365	        return IAssetModule(getAssetModule(assetId))
   366	            .processIndirectWithdrawal(
   367	                creditor, asset, assetId, exposureUpperAssetToAsset, deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
   368	            );
   369	    }
   370	
   371	    /**
   372	     * @notice This function is called by Asset Modules of non-primary assets
   373	     * in order to update the exposure of an underlying asset after a deposit.
   374	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   375	     * @param underlyingAsset The underlying asset.
   376	     * @param underlyingAssetId The underlying asset id.
   377	     * @param exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The amount of exposure of the asset to the underlying asset.
   378	     * @param deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the asset to the underlying asset
   379	     * since the last interaction.
   380	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
   381	     * @return usdExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The USD-value of the exposure of the asset to its underlying asset,
   382	     * 18 decimals precision.
   383	     */
   384	    function getUsdValueExposureToUnderlyingAssetAfterDeposit(
   385	        address creditor,
   386	        address underlyingAsset,
   387	        uint256 underlyingAssetId,
   388	        uint256 exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset,
   389	        int256 deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset
   390	    ) external onlyAssetModule returns (uint256 recursiveCalls, uint256 usdExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset) {
   391	        return IRegistry(REGISTRY)
   392	            .getUsdValueExposureToUnderlyingAssetAfterDeposit(
   393	                creditor,
   394	                underlyingAsset,
   395	                underlyingAssetId,
   396	                exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset,
   397	                deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset
   398	            );
   399	    }
   400	
   401	    /**
   402	     * @notice This function is called by Asset Modules of non-primary assets
   403	     * in order to update the exposure of an underlying asset after a withdrawal.
   404	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   405	     * @param underlyingAsset The underlying asset.
   406	     * @param underlyingAssetId The underlying asset id.
   407	     * @param exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The amount of exposure of the asset to the underlying asset.
   408	     * @param deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the asset to the underlying asset
   409	     * since the last interaction.
   410	     * @return usdExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The Usd value of the exposure of the asset to its underlying asset,
   411	     * 18 decimals precision.
   412	     */
   413	    function getUsdValueExposureToUnderlyingAssetAfterWithdrawal(
   414	        address creditor,
   415	        address underlyingAsset,
   416	        uint256 underlyingAssetId,
   417	        uint256 exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset,
   418	        int256 deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset
   419	    ) external onlyAssetModule returns (uint256 usdExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset) {
   420	        return IRegistry(REGISTRY)
   421	            .getUsdValueExposureToUnderlyingAssetAfterWithdrawal(
   422	                creditor,
   423	                underlyingAsset,
   424	                underlyingAssetId,
   425	                exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset,
   426	                deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset
   427	            );
   428	    }
   429	
   430	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   431	                          PRICING LOGIC
   432	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   433	
   434	    /**
   435	     * @notice Calculates the USD values of underlying assets.
   436	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   437	     * @param assets Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   438	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   439	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   440	     * @return valuesAndRiskFactors The values of the assets, denominated in USD with 18 Decimals precision
   441	     */
   442	    function getValuesInUsdRecursive(
   443	        address creditor,
   444	        address[] calldata assets,
   445	        uint256[] calldata assetIds,
   446	        uint256[] calldata assetAmounts
   447	    ) external view returns (AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory valuesAndRiskFactors) {
   448	        return IRegistry(REGISTRY).getValuesInUsdRecursive(creditor, assets, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   449	    }
   450	}
```

```solidity
     1	// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
     2	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     3	
     4	library Hooks {
     5	    uint160 internal constant BEFORE_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG = 1 << 9;
     6	    uint160 internal constant AFTER_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG = 1 << 8;
     7	
     8	    function hasPermission(uint160 hook, uint160 flag) internal pure returns (bool) {
     9	        return hook & flag != 0;
    10	    }
    11	}
```

```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { IAssetModule } from "../../interfaces/IAssetModule.sol";
     8	import { Owned } from "../../../lib/solmate/src/auth/Owned.sol";
     9	
    10	/**
    11	 * @title Abstract Asset Module
    12	 * @author Pragma Labs
    13	 * @notice Abstract contract with the minimal implementation of an Asset Module.
    14	 * @dev Each different asset class should have its own Oracle Module.
    15	 * The Asset Modules will:
    16	 *  - Implement the pricing logic to calculate the USD value (with 18 decimals precision).
    17	 *  - Process Deposits and Withdrawals.
    18	 *  - Manage the risk parameters.
    19	 */
    20	abstract contract AssetModule is Owned, IAssetModule {
    21	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    22	                                CONSTANTS
    23	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    24	
    25	    // Identifier for the type of the asset.
    26	    uint256 public immutable ASSET_TYPE;
    27	    // The contract address of the Registry.
    28	    address public immutable REGISTRY;
    29	
    30	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    31	                                STORAGE
    32	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    33	
    34	    // Map asset => flag.
    35	    mapping(address => bool) public inAssetModule;
    36	
    37	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    38	                                ERRORS
    39	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    40	
    41	    error ExposureNotInLimits();
    42	    error OnlyRegistry();
    43	    error Overflow();
    44	
    45	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    46	                                MODIFIERS
    47	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    48	
    49	    /**
    50	     * @dev Only the Registry can call functions with this modifier.
    51	     */
    52	    modifier onlyRegistry() {
    53	        if (msg.sender != REGISTRY) revert OnlyRegistry();
    54	        _;
    55	    }
    56	
    57	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    58	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    59	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    60	
    61	    /**
    62	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    63	     * @param registry_ The contract address of the Registry.
    64	     * @param assetType_ Identifier for the token standard of the asset.
    65	     * 0 = Unknown asset.
    66	     * 1 = ERC20.
    67	     * 2 = ERC721.
    68	     * 3 = ERC1155.
    69	     */
    70	    constructor(address owner_, address registry_, uint256 assetType_) Owned(owner_) {
    71	        REGISTRY = registry_;
    72	        ASSET_TYPE = assetType_;
    73	    }
    74	
    75	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    76	                        ASSET INFORMATION
    77	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    78	
    79	    /**
    80	     * @notice Checks for a token address and the corresponding id if it is allowed.
    81	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
    82	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
    83	     * @return A boolean, indicating if the asset is allowed.
    84	     * @dev For assets without id (ERC20, ERC4626...), the id should be set to 0.
    85	     */
    86	    function isAllowed(address asset, uint256 assetId) public view virtual returns (bool);
    87	
    88	    /**
    89	     * @notice Returns the unique identifier of an asset based on the contract address and id.
    90	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
    91	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
    92	     * @return key The unique identifier.
    93	     * @dev Unsafe bitshift from uint256 to uint96, use only when the ids of the assets cannot exceed type(uint96).max.
    94	     * For asset where the id can be bigger than a uint96, use a mapping of asset and assetId to storage.
    95	     * These assets can however NOT be used as underlying assets (processIndirectDeposit() must revert).
    96	     */
    97	    function _getKeyFromAsset(address asset, uint256 assetId) internal view virtual returns (bytes32 key) {
    98	        assembly {
    99	            // Shift the assetId to the left by 20 bytes (160 bits).
   100	            // Then OR the result with the address.
   101	            key := or(shl(160, assetId), asset)
   102	        }
   103	    }
   104	
   105	    /**
   106	     * @notice Returns the contract address and id of an asset based on the unique identifier.
   107	     * @param key The unique identifier.
   108	     * @return asset The contract address of the asset.
   109	     * @return assetId The id of the asset.
   110	     */
   111	    function _getAssetFromKey(bytes32 key) internal view virtual returns (address asset, uint256 assetId) {
   112	        assembly {
   113	            // Shift to the right by 20 bytes (160 bits) to extract the uint96 assetId.
   114	            assetId := shr(160, key)
   115	
   116	            // Use bitmask to extract the address from the rightmost 160 bits.
   117	            asset := and(key, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF)
   118	        }
   119	    }
   120	
   121	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   122	                          PRICING LOGIC
   123	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   124	
   125	    /**
   126	     * @notice Returns the usd value of an asset.
   127	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   128	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   129	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   130	     * @param assetAmount The amount of assets.
   131	     * @return valueInUsd The value of the asset denominated in USD, with 18 Decimals precision.
   132	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   133	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   134	     */
   135	    function getValue(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId, uint256 assetAmount)
   136	        public
   137	        view
   138	        virtual
   139	        returns (uint256, uint256, uint256);
   140	
   141	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   142	                    RISK VARIABLES MANAGEMENT
   143	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   144	
   145	    /**
   146	     * @notice Returns the risk factors of an asset for a Creditor.
   147	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   148	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   149	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   150	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   151	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   152	     */
   153	    function getRiskFactors(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId)
   154	        external
   155	        view
   156	        virtual
   157	        returns (uint16 collateralFactor, uint16 liquidationFactor);
   158	
   159	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   160	                    WITHDRAWALS AND DEPOSITS
   161	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   162	
   163	    /**
   164	     * @notice Increases the exposure to an asset on a direct deposit.
   165	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   166	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   167	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   168	     * @param amount The amount of tokens.
   169	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
   170	     */
   171	    function processDirectDeposit(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId, uint256 amount)
   172	        public
   173	        virtual
   174	        returns (uint256 recursiveCalls);
   175	
   176	    /**
   177	     * @notice Increases the exposure to an asset on an indirect deposit.
   178	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   179	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   180	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   181	     * @param exposureUpperAssetToAsset The amount of exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module.
   182	     * @param deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module since last interaction.
   183	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
   184	     * @return usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset The USD value of the exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module, 18 decimals precision.
   185	     */
   186	    function processIndirectDeposit(
   187	        address creditor,
   188	        address asset,
   189	        uint256 assetId,
   190	        uint256 exposureUpperAssetToAsset,
   191	        int256 deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
   192	    ) public virtual returns (uint256 recursiveCalls, uint256 usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset);
   193	
   194	    /**
   195	     * @notice Decreases the exposure to an asset on a direct withdrawal.
   196	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   197	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   198	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   199	     * @param amount The amount of tokens.
   200	     */
   201	    function processDirectWithdrawal(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId, uint256 amount) public virtual;
   202	
   203	    /**
   204	     * @notice Decreases the exposure to an asset on an indirect withdrawal.
   205	     * @param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
   206	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   207	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   208	     * @param exposureUpperAssetToAsset The amount of exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module.
   209	     * @param deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module since last interaction.
   210	     * @return usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset The USD value of the exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module, 18 decimals precision.
   211	     */
   212	    function processIndirectWithdrawal(
   213	        address creditor,
   214	        address asset,
   215	        uint256 assetId,
   216	        uint256 exposureUpperAssetToAsset,
   217	        int256 deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
   218	    ) public virtual returns (uint256 usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset);
   219	}
```

```solidity
    13	/**
    14	 * @title Derived Asset Module
    15	 * @author Pragma Labs
    16	 * @notice Abstract contract with the minimal implementation of a Derived Asset Module.
    17	 * @dev Derived Assets are assets with underlying assets, the underlying assets can be Primary Assets or also Derived Assets.
    18	 * For Derived Assets there are no direct external oracles.
    19	 * USD values of assets must be calculated in a recursive manner via the pricing logic of the Underlying Assets.
    20	 */
    21	abstract contract DerivedAM is AssetModule {
    22	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    23	
    24	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    25	                                STORAGE
    26	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    27	
    28	    // Map with the risk parameters of the protocol for each Creditor.
    29	    mapping(address creditor => RiskParameters riskParameters) public riskParams;
    30	    // Map with the last exposures of each asset for each Creditor.
    31	    mapping(address creditor => mapping(bytes32 assetKey => ExposuresPerAsset)) public lastExposuresAsset;
    32	    // Map with the last amount of exposure of each underlying asset for each asset for each Creditor.
    33	    mapping(
    34	        address creditor => mapping(bytes32 assetKey => mapping(bytes32 underlyingAssetKey => uint256 exposure))
    35	    ) public lastExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset;
    36	
    37	    // Struct with the risk parameters of the protocol for a specific Creditor.
    38	    struct RiskParameters {
    39	        // The exposure in USD of the Creditor to the protocol at the last interaction, 18 decimals precision.
    40	        uint112 lastUsdExposureProtocol;
    41	        // The maximum exposure in USD of the Creditor to the protocol, 18 decimals precision.
    42	        uint112 maxUsdExposureProtocol;
    43	        // The risk factor of the protocol for a Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
    44	        uint16 riskFactor;
    45	    }
    46	
    47	    // Struct with the exposures of a specific asset for a specific Creditor.
    48	    struct ExposuresPerAsset {
    49	        // The amount of exposure of the Creditor to the asset at the last interaction.
    50	        uint112 lastExposureAsset;
    51	        // The exposure in USD of the Creditor to the asset at the last interaction, 18 decimals precision.
    52	        uint112 lastUsdExposureAsset;
    53	    }
    54	
    55	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    56	                                ERRORS
    57	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
```
