```solidity
    59	    error RiskFactorNotInLimits();
    60	
    61	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    62	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    63	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    64	
    65	    /**
    66	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    67	     * @param registry_ The contract address of the Registry.
    68	     * @param assetType_ Identifier for the token standard of the asset.
    69	     * 0 = Unknown asset.
    70	     * 1 = ERC20.
    71	     * 2 = ERC721.
    72	     * 3 = ERC1155.
    73	     * ...
    74	     */
    75	    constructor(address owner_, address registry_, uint256 assetType_) AssetModule(owner_, registry_, assetType_) { }
    76	
    77	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    78	                        ASSET INFORMATION
    79	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    80	
    81	    /**
    82	     * @notice Returns the unique identifiers of the underlying assets.
    83	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
    84	     * @return underlyingAssetKeys The unique identifiers of the underlying assets.
    85	     */
    86	    function _getUnderlyingAssets(bytes32 assetKey) internal view virtual returns (bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys);
    87	
    88	    /**
    89	     * @notice Calculates the USD rate of 10**18 underlying assets.
    90	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
    91	     * @param underlyingAssetKeys The unique identifiers of the underlying assets.
    92	     * @return rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The USD rates of 10**18 tokens of underlying asset, with 18 decimals precision.
    93	     * @dev The USD price per 10**18 tokens is used (instead of the USD price per token) to guarantee sufficient precision.
    94	     */
    95	    function _getRateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd(address creditor, bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys)
    96	        internal
    97	        view
    98	        virtual
    99	        returns (AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd)
   100	    {
   101	        uint256 length = underlyingAssetKeys.length;
   102	
   103	        address[] memory underlyingAssets = new address[](length);
   104	        uint256[] memory underlyingAssetIds = new uint256[](length);
   105	        uint256[] memory amounts = new uint256[](length);
   106	        for (uint256 i; i < length; ++i) {
   107	            (underlyingAssets[i], underlyingAssetIds[i]) = _getAssetFromKey(underlyingAssetKeys[i]);
   108	            // We use the USD price per 10**18 tokens instead of the USD price per token to guarantee
   109	            // sufficient precision.
   110	            amounts[i] = 1e18;
   111	        }
   112	
   113	        rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd =
   114	            IRegistry(REGISTRY).getValuesInUsdRecursive(creditor, underlyingAssets, underlyingAssetIds, amounts);
   115	    }
   116	
   117	    /**
   118	     * @notice Calculates for a given amount of an Asset the corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s).
   119	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   120	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   121	     * @param assetAmount The amount of the asset, in the decimal precision of the Asset.
   122	     * @param underlyingAssetKeys The unique identifiers of the underlying assets.
   123	     * @return underlyingAssetsAmounts The corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s), in the decimal precision of the Underlying Asset.
   124	     * @return rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The USD rates of 10**18 tokens of underlying asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   125	     * @dev The USD price per 10**18 tokens is used (instead of the USD price per token) to guarantee sufficient precision.
   126	     */
   127	    function _getUnderlyingAssetsAmounts(
   128	        address creditor,
   129	        bytes32 assetKey,
   130	        uint256 assetAmount,
   131	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys
   132	    )
   133	        internal
   134	        view
   135	        virtual
   136	        returns (uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts, AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd);
   137	
   138	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   139	                    RISK VARIABLES MANAGEMENT
   140	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   141	
   142	    /**
   143	     * @notice Returns the risk factors of an asset for a Creditor.
   144	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   145	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   146	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   147	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   148	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   149	     */
   150	    function getRiskFactors(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId)
   151	        external
   152	        view
   153	        virtual
   154	        override
   155	        returns (uint16 collateralFactor, uint16 liquidationFactor);
   156	
   157	    /**
   158	     * @notice Sets the risk parameters of the Protocol for a given Creditor.
   159	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   160	     * @param maxUsdExposureProtocol_ The maximum USD exposure of the protocol for each Creditor, denominated in USD with 18 decimals precision.
   161	     * @param riskFactor The risk factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   162	     */
   163	    function setRiskParameters(address creditor, uint112 maxUsdExposureProtocol_, uint16 riskFactor)
   164	        external
   165	        onlyRegistry
   166	    {
   167	        if (riskFactor > AssetValuationLib.ONE_4) revert RiskFactorNotInLimits();
   168	
   169	        riskParams[creditor].maxUsdExposureProtocol = maxUsdExposureProtocol_;
   170	        riskParams[creditor].riskFactor = riskFactor;
   171	    }
   172	
   173	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   174	                          PRICING LOGIC
   175	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   176	
   177	    /**
   178	     * @notice Returns the USD value of an asset.
   179	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   180	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   181	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   182	     * @param assetAmount The amount of assets.
   183	     * @return valueInUsd The value of the asset denominated in USD, with 18 Decimals precision.
   184	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   185	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   186	     */
   187	    function getValue(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId, uint256 assetAmount)
   188	        public
   189	        view
   190	        virtual
   191	        override
   192	        returns (uint256 valueInUsd, uint256 collateralFactor, uint256 liquidationFactor)
   193	    {
   194	        bytes32 assetKey = _getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId);
   195	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys = _getUnderlyingAssets(assetKey);
   196	
   197	        (uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts, AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd) =
   198	            _getUnderlyingAssetsAmounts(creditor, assetKey, assetAmount, underlyingAssetKeys);
   199	
   200	        // Check if rateToUsd for the underlying assets was already calculated in _getUnderlyingAssetsAmounts().
   201	        if (rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd.length == 0) {
   202	            // If not, get the USD value of the underlying assets recursively.
   203	            rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd = _getRateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd(creditor, underlyingAssetKeys);
   204	        }
   205	
   206	        (valueInUsd, collateralFactor, liquidationFactor) =
   207	            _calculateValueAndRiskFactors(creditor, underlyingAssetsAmounts, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd);
   208	    }
   209	
   210	    /**
   211	     * @notice Returns the USD value of an asset.
   212	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   213	     * @param underlyingAssetsAmounts The corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s), in the decimal precision of the Underlying Asset.
   214	     * @param rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The USD rates of 10**18 tokens of underlying asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   215	     * @return valueInUsd The value of the asset denominated in USD, with 18 Decimals precision.
   216	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   217	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   218	     * @dev We take the most conservative (lowest) risk factor of all underlying assets.
   219	     */
   220	    function _calculateValueAndRiskFactors(
   221	        address creditor,
   222	        uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts,
   223	        AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd
   224	    ) internal view virtual returns (uint256 valueInUsd, uint256 collateralFactor, uint256 liquidationFactor);
   225	
   226	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   227	                    WITHDRAWALS AND DEPOSITS
   228	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   229	
   230	    /**
   231	     * @notice Increases the exposure to an asset on a direct deposit.
   232	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   233	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   234	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   235	     * @param amount The amount of tokens.
   236	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
   237	     */
   238	    function processDirectDeposit(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId, uint256 amount)
   239	        public
   240	        virtual
   241	        override
   242	        onlyRegistry
   243	        returns (uint256 recursiveCalls)
   244	    {
   245	        bytes32 assetKey = _getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId);
   246	
   247	        // Calculate and update the new exposure to Asset.
   248	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   249	        uint256 exposureAsset = _getAndUpdateExposureAsset(creditor, assetKey, int256(amount));
   250	
   251	        (uint256 underlyingCalls,) = _processDeposit(exposureAsset, creditor, assetKey);
   252	
   253	        unchecked {
   254	            recursiveCalls = underlyingCalls + 1;
   255	        }
   256	    }
   257	
   258	    /**
   259	     * @notice Increases the exposure to an asset on an indirect deposit.
   260	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   261	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   262	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   263	     * @param exposureUpperAssetToAsset The amount of exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module.
   264	     * @param deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module since last interaction.
   265	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
   266	     * @return usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset The USD value of the exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module, 18 decimals precision.
   267	     * @dev An indirect deposit, is initiated by a deposit of another derived asset (the upper asset),
   268	     * from which the asset of this Asset Module is an underlying asset.
   269	     */
   270	    function processIndirectDeposit(
   271	        address creditor,
   272	        address asset,
   273	        uint256 assetId,
   274	        uint256 exposureUpperAssetToAsset,
   275	        int256 deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
   276	    ) public virtual override onlyRegistry returns (uint256 recursiveCalls, uint256 usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset) {
   277	        bytes32 assetKey = _getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId);
   278	
   279	        // Calculate and update the new exposure to "Asset".
   280	        uint256 exposureAsset = _getAndUpdateExposureAsset(creditor, assetKey, deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset);
   281	
   282	        (uint256 underlyingCalls, uint256 usdExposureAsset) = _processDeposit(exposureAsset, creditor, assetKey);
   283	
   284	        if (exposureAsset == 0 || usdExposureAsset == 0) {
   285	            usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset = 0;
   286	        } else {
   287	            // Calculate the USD value of the exposure of the upper asset to the underlying asset.
   288	            usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset = usdExposureAsset.mulDivDown(exposureUpperAssetToAsset, exposureAsset);
   289	        }
   290	
   291	        unchecked {
   292	            recursiveCalls = underlyingCalls + 1;
   293	        }
   294	    }
   295	
   296	    /**
   297	     * @notice Decreases the exposure to an asset on a direct withdrawal.
   298	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   299	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   300	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   301	     * @param amount The amount of tokens.
   302	     */
   303	    function processDirectWithdrawal(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId, uint256 amount)
   304	        public
   305	        virtual
   306	        override
   307	        onlyRegistry
   308	    {
   309	        bytes32 assetKey = _getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId);
   310	
   311	        // Calculate and update the new exposure to "Asset".
   312	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   313	        uint256 exposureAsset = _getAndUpdateExposureAsset(creditor, assetKey, -int256(amount));
   314	
   315	        _processWithdrawal(creditor, assetKey, exposureAsset);
   316	    }
   317	
   318	    /**
   319	     * @notice Decreases the exposure to an asset on an indirect withdrawal.
   320	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   321	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   322	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   323	     * @param exposureUpperAssetToAsset The amount of exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module.
   324	     * @param deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module since last interaction.
   325	     * @return usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset The USD value of the exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module, 18 decimals precision.
   326	     * @dev An indirect withdrawal is initiated by a withdrawal of another Derived Asset (the upper asset),
   327	     * from which the asset of this Asset Module is an Underlying Asset.
   328	     */
   329	    function processIndirectWithdrawal(
   330	        address creditor,
   331	        address asset,
   332	        uint256 assetId,
   333	        uint256 exposureUpperAssetToAsset,
   334	        int256 deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
   335	    ) public virtual override onlyRegistry returns (uint256 usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset) {
   336	        bytes32 assetKey = _getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId);
   337	
   338	        // Calculate and update the new exposure to "Asset".
   339	        uint256 exposureAsset = _getAndUpdateExposureAsset(creditor, assetKey, deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset);
   340	
   341	        uint256 usdExposureAsset = _processWithdrawal(creditor, assetKey, exposureAsset);
   342	
   343	        if (exposureAsset == 0 || usdExposureAsset == 0) {
   344	            usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset = 0;
   345	        } else {
   346	            // Calculate the USD value of the exposure of the Upper Asset to the Underlying asset.
   347	            usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset = usdExposureAsset.mulDivDown(exposureUpperAssetToAsset, exposureAsset);
   348	        }
   349	    }
   350	
   351	    /**
   352	     * @notice Update the exposure to an asset and its underlying asset(s) on deposit.
   353	     * @param exposureAsset The updated exposure to the asset.
   354	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   355	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   356	     * @return underlyingCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the underlying assets.
   357	     * @return usdExposureAsset The USD value of the exposure of the asset, 18 decimals precision.
   358	     * @dev The checks on exposures are only done to block deposits that would over-expose a Creditor to a certain asset or protocol.
   359	     * Underflows will not revert, but the exposure is instead set to 0.
   360	     */
   361	    function _processDeposit(uint256 exposureAsset, address creditor, bytes32 assetKey)
   362	        internal
   363	        virtual
   364	        returns (uint256 underlyingCalls, uint256 usdExposureAsset)
   365	    {
   366	        uint256 usdExposureProtocol;
   367	        {
   368	            // Get the unique identifier(s) of the underlying asset(s).
   369	            bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys = _getUnderlyingAssets(assetKey);
   370	
   371	            // Get the exposure to the asset's underlying asset(s) (in the decimal precision of the underlying assets).
   372	            (uint256[] memory exposureAssetToUnderlyingAssets,) =
   373	                _getUnderlyingAssetsAmounts(creditor, assetKey, exposureAsset, underlyingAssetKeys);
   374	
   375	            int256 deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset;
   376	            address underlyingAsset;
   377	            uint256 underlyingId;
   378	            uint256 underlyingCalls_;
   379	            uint256 usdExposureToUnderlyingAsset;
   380	
   381	            for (uint256 i; i < underlyingAssetKeys.length; ++i) {
   382	                // Calculate the change in exposure to the underlying assets since last interaction.
   383	                deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset = int256(exposureAssetToUnderlyingAssets[i])
   384	                    - int256(uint256(lastExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset[creditor][assetKey][underlyingAssetKeys[i]]));
   385	
   386	                // Update "lastExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset".
   387	                lastExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset[creditor][assetKey][underlyingAssetKeys[i]] =
   388	                    exposureAssetToUnderlyingAssets[i];
   389	
   390	                // Get the USD Value of the total exposure of "Asset" for its "Underlying Assets" at index "i".
   391	                // If the "underlyingAsset" has one or more underlying assets itself, the lower level
   392	                // Asset Module(s) will recursively update their respective exposures and return
   393	                // the requested USD value to this Asset Module.
   394	                (underlyingAsset, underlyingId) = _getAssetFromKey(underlyingAssetKeys[i]);
   395	                (underlyingCalls_, usdExposureToUnderlyingAsset) = IRegistry(REGISTRY)
   396	                    .getUsdValueExposureToUnderlyingAssetAfterDeposit(
   397	                        creditor,
   398	                        underlyingAsset,
   399	                        underlyingId,
   400	                        exposureAssetToUnderlyingAssets[i],
   401	                        deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset
   402	                    );
   403	                usdExposureAsset += usdExposureToUnderlyingAsset;
   404	                unchecked {
   405	                    underlyingCalls += underlyingCalls_;
   406	                }
   407	            }
   408	
   409	            // Cache and update lastUsdExposureAsset.
   410	            uint256 lastUsdExposureAsset = lastExposuresAsset[creditor][assetKey].lastUsdExposureAsset;
   411	            // If usdExposureAsset is bigger than uint112, then check on usdExposureProtocol below will revert.
   412	            // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   413	            lastExposuresAsset[creditor][assetKey].lastUsdExposureAsset = uint112(usdExposureAsset);
   414	
   415	            // Cache lastUsdExposureProtocol.
   416	            uint256 lastUsdExposureProtocol = riskParams[creditor].lastUsdExposureProtocol;
   417	
   418	            // Update lastUsdExposureProtocol.
   419	            unchecked {
   420	                if (usdExposureAsset >= lastUsdExposureAsset) {
   421	                    usdExposureProtocol = lastUsdExposureProtocol + (usdExposureAsset - lastUsdExposureAsset);
   422	                } else if (lastUsdExposureProtocol > lastUsdExposureAsset - usdExposureAsset) {
   423	                    usdExposureProtocol = lastUsdExposureProtocol - (lastUsdExposureAsset - usdExposureAsset);
   424	                }
   425	                // For the else case: (lastUsdExposureProtocol < lastUsdExposureAsset - usdExposureAsset),
   426	                // usdExposureProtocol is set to 0, but usdExposureProtocol is already 0.
   427	            }
   428	            // The exposure must be strictly smaller than the maxExposure, not equal to or smaller than.
   429	            // This is to ensure that all deposits revert when maxExposure is set to 0, also deposits with 0 amounts.
   430	            if (usdExposureProtocol >= riskParams[creditor].maxUsdExposureProtocol) {
   431	                revert AssetModule.ExposureNotInLimits();
   432	            }
   433	        }
   434	        // unsafe cast: usdExposureProtocol is smaller than maxUsdExposureProtocol, which is a uint112.
   435	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   436	        riskParams[creditor].lastUsdExposureProtocol = uint112(usdExposureProtocol);
   437	    }
   438	
   439	    /**
   440	     * @notice Update the exposure to an asset and its underlying asset(s) on withdrawal.
   441	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   442	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   443	     * @param exposureAsset The updated exposure to the asset.
   444	     * @return usdExposureAsset The USD value of the exposure of the asset, 18 decimals precision.
   445	     * @dev The checks on exposures are only done to block deposits that would over-expose a Creditor to a certain asset or protocol.
   446	     * Underflows will not revert, but the exposure is instead set to 0.
   447	     * @dev Due to changing usd-prices of underlying assets, or due to changing compositions of upper assets,
   448	     * the exposure to a derived asset can increase or decrease over time independent of deposits/withdrawals.
   449	     * When derived assets are deposited/withdrawn, these changes in exposure since last interaction are also synced.
   450	     * As such the actual exposure on a withdrawal of a derived asset can exceed the maxExposure, but this should never be blocked,
   451	     * (the withdrawal actually improves the situation by making the asset less over-exposed).
   452	     */
   453	    function _processWithdrawal(address creditor, bytes32 assetKey, uint256 exposureAsset)
   454	        internal
   455	        virtual
   456	        returns (uint256 usdExposureAsset)
   457	    {
   458	        // Get the unique identifier(s) of the underlying asset(s).
   459	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys = _getUnderlyingAssets(assetKey);
   460	
   461	        // Get the exposure to the asset's underlying asset(s) (in the decimal precision of the underlying assets).
   462	        (uint256[] memory exposureAssetToUnderlyingAssets,) =
   463	            _getUnderlyingAssetsAmounts(creditor, assetKey, exposureAsset, underlyingAssetKeys);
   464	
   465	        int256 deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset;
   466	        address underlyingAsset;
   467	        uint256 underlyingId;
   468	
   469	        for (uint256 i; i < underlyingAssetKeys.length; ++i) {
   470	            // Calculate the change in exposure to the underlying assets since last interaction.
   471	            deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset = int256(exposureAssetToUnderlyingAssets[i])
   472	                - int256(uint256(lastExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset[creditor][assetKey][underlyingAssetKeys[i]]));
   473	
   474	            // Update "lastExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset".
   475	            lastExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset[creditor][assetKey][underlyingAssetKeys[i]] =
   476	                exposureAssetToUnderlyingAssets[i];
   477	
   478	            // Get the USD Value of the total exposure of "Asset" for for all of its "Underlying Assets".
   479	            // If an "underlyingAsset" has one or more underlying assets itself, the lower level
   480	            // Asset Modules will recursively update their respective exposures and return
   481	            // the requested USD value to this Asset Module.
   482	            (underlyingAsset, underlyingId) = _getAssetFromKey(underlyingAssetKeys[i]);
   483	            usdExposureAsset += IRegistry(REGISTRY)
   484	                .getUsdValueExposureToUnderlyingAssetAfterWithdrawal(
   485	                    creditor,
   486	                    underlyingAsset,
   487	                    underlyingId,
   488	                    exposureAssetToUnderlyingAssets[i],
   489	                    deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset
   490	                );
   491	        }
   492	
   493	        // Cache and update lastUsdExposureAsset.
   494	        uint256 lastUsdExposureAsset = lastExposuresAsset[creditor][assetKey].lastUsdExposureAsset;
   495	        // If usdExposureAsset is bigger than uint112, then safecast on usdExposureProtocol below will revert.
   496	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   497	        lastExposuresAsset[creditor][assetKey].lastUsdExposureAsset = uint112(usdExposureAsset);
   498	
   499	        // Cache lastUsdExposureProtocol.
   500	        uint256 lastUsdExposureProtocol = riskParams[creditor].lastUsdExposureProtocol;
   501	
   502	        // Update lastUsdExposureProtocol.
   503	        uint256 usdExposureProtocol;
   504	        unchecked {
   505	            if (usdExposureAsset >= lastUsdExposureAsset) {
   506	                usdExposureProtocol = lastUsdExposureProtocol + (usdExposureAsset - lastUsdExposureAsset);
   507	            } else if (lastUsdExposureProtocol > lastUsdExposureAsset - usdExposureAsset) {
   508	                usdExposureProtocol = lastUsdExposureProtocol - (lastUsdExposureAsset - usdExposureAsset);
   509	            }
   510	            // For the else case: (lastUsdExposureProtocol < lastUsdExposureAsset - usdExposureAsset),
   511	            // usdExposureProtocol is set to 0, but usdExposureProtocol is already 0.
   512	        }
   513	        riskParams[creditor].lastUsdExposureProtocol = SafeCastLib.safeCastTo112(usdExposureProtocol);
   514	    }
   515	
   516	    /**
   517	     * @notice Updates the exposure to the asset.
   518	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   519	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   520	     * @param deltaAsset The increase or decrease in asset amount since the last interaction.
   521	     * @return exposureAsset The updated exposure to the asset.
   522	     * @dev The checks on exposures are only done to block deposits that would over-expose a Creditor to a certain asset or protocol.
   523	     * Underflows will not revert, but the exposure is instead set to 0.
   524	     */
   525	    function _getAndUpdateExposureAsset(address creditor, bytes32 assetKey, int256 deltaAsset)
   526	        internal
   527	        returns (uint256 exposureAsset)
   528	    {
   529	        // Update exposureAssetLast.
   530	        // forge-lint: disable-next-item(unsafe-typecast)
   531	        if (deltaAsset > 0) {
   532	            exposureAsset = lastExposuresAsset[creditor][assetKey].lastExposureAsset + uint256(deltaAsset);
   533	        } else {
   534	            uint256 exposureAssetLast = lastExposuresAsset[creditor][assetKey].lastExposureAsset;
   535	            exposureAsset = exposureAssetLast > uint256(-deltaAsset) ? exposureAssetLast - uint256(-deltaAsset) : 0;
   536	        }
   537	        lastExposuresAsset[creditor][assetKey].lastExposureAsset = SafeCastLib.safeCastTo112(exposureAsset);
   538	    }
   539	}
```

```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs

     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { FixedPointMathLib } from "../../../lib/solmate/src/utils/FixedPointMathLib.sol";
     8	import { IRegistry } from "./../interfaces/IRegistry.sol";
     9	import { AssetModule } from "./AbstractAM.sol";
    10	
    11	/**
    12	 * @title Primary Asset Module
    13	 * @author Pragma Labs
    14	 * @notice Abstract contract with the minimal implementation of a Primary Asset Module.
    15	 * @dev Primary assets are assets with no underlying assets, that can be priced using external oracles.
    16	 */
    17	abstract contract PrimaryAM is AssetModule {
    18	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    19	
    20	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    21	                                CONSTANTS
    22	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    23	
    24	    // The unit of the liquidation and collateral factors, 4 decimals precision.
    25	    uint256 internal constant ONE_4 = 10_000;
    26	
    27	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    28	                                STORAGE
    29	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    30	
    31	    // Map with the risk parameters of each asset for each Credit.
    32	    mapping(address creditor => mapping(bytes32 assetKey => RiskParameters riskParameters)) public riskParams;
    33	
    34	    // Map asset => assetInformation.
    35	    mapping(bytes32 assetKey => AssetInformation) public assetToInformation;
    36	
    37	    // Struct with the risk parameters of a specific asset for a specific Creditor.
    38	    struct RiskParameters {
    39	        // The exposure of a Creditor to an asset at its last interaction.
    40	        uint112 lastExposureAsset;
    41	        // The maximum exposure of a Creditor to an asset.
    42	        uint112 maxExposure;
    43	        // The collateral factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
    44	        uint16 collateralFactor;
    45	        // The liquidation factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
    46	        uint16 liquidationFactor;
    47	    }
    48	
    49	    // Struct with additional information for a specific asset.
    50	    struct AssetInformation {
    51	        // The unit of the asset, equal to 10^decimals.
    52	        uint64 assetUnit;
    53	        // The sequence of the oracles to price the asset in USD, packed in a single bytes32 object.
    54	        bytes32 oracleSequence;
    55	    }
    56	
    57	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    58	                                ERRORS
    59	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    60	
    61	    error BadOracleSequence();
    62	    error CollFactorExceedsLiqFactor();
    63	    error CollFactorNotInLimits();
    64	    error LiqFactorNotInLimits();
    65	    error OracleStillActive();
    66	
    67	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    68	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    69	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    70	
    71	    /**
    72	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    73	     * @param registry_ The address of the Registry.
    74	     * @param assetType_ Identifier for the type of asset, necessary for the deposit and withdraw logic in the Accounts.
    75	     * 0 = ERC20
    76	     * 1 = ERC721
    77	     * 2 = ERC1155
    78	     * ...
    79	     */
    80	    constructor(address owner_, address registry_, uint256 assetType_) AssetModule(owner_, registry_, assetType_) { }
    81	
    82	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    83	                        ASSET INFORMATION
    84	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    85	
    86	    /**
    87	     * @notice Sets a new oracle sequence in the case one of the current oracles is not active.
    88	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
    89	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
    90	     * @param newOracles The new sequence of the oracles, to price the asset in USD,
    91	     * packed in a single bytes32 object.
    92	     */
    93	    function setOracles(address asset, uint256 assetId, bytes32 newOracles) external onlyOwner {
    94	        bytes32 assetKey = _getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId);
    95	
    96	        // At least one of the old oracles must be inactive before a new sequence can be set.
    97	        bytes32 oldOracles = assetToInformation[assetKey].oracleSequence;
    98	        if (IRegistry(REGISTRY).checkOracleSequence(oldOracles)) revert OracleStillActive();
    99	
   100	        // The new oracle sequence must be correct.
   101	        if (!IRegistry(REGISTRY).checkOracleSequence(newOracles)) revert BadOracleSequence();
   102	
   103	        assetToInformation[assetKey].oracleSequence = newOracles;
   104	    }
   105	
   106	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   107	                          PRICING LOGIC
   108	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   109	
   110	    /**
   111	     * @notice Returns the USD value of an asset.
   112	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   113	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   114	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   115	     * @param assetAmount The amount of assets.
   116	     * @return valueInUsd The value of the asset denominated in USD, with 18 decimals precision.
   117	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   118	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   119	     * @dev If the asset is not added to AssetModule, this function will return value 0 without throwing an error.
   120	     * However check in here is not necessary,
   121	     * since the check if the asset is added to the AssetModule is already done in the Registry.
   122	     */
   123	    function getValue(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId, uint256 assetAmount)
   124	        public
   125	        view
   126	        virtual
   127	        override
   128	        returns (uint256 valueInUsd, uint256 collateralFactor, uint256 liquidationFactor)
   129	    {
   130	        bytes32 assetKey = _getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId);
   131	
   132	        uint256 rateInUsd = IRegistry(REGISTRY).getRateInUsd(assetToInformation[assetKey].oracleSequence);
   133	        valueInUsd = assetAmount.mulDivDown(rateInUsd, assetToInformation[assetKey].assetUnit);
   134	
   135	        collateralFactor = riskParams[creditor][assetKey].collateralFactor;
   136	        liquidationFactor = riskParams[creditor][assetKey].liquidationFactor;
   137	    }
   138	
   139	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   140	                    RISK PARAMETER MANAGEMENT
   141	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   142	
   143	    /**
   144	     * @notice Returns the risk factors of an asset for a Creditor.
   145	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   146	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   147	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   148	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   149	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   150	     */
   151	    function getRiskFactors(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId)
   152	        external
   153	        view
   154	        override
   155	        returns (uint16 collateralFactor, uint16 liquidationFactor)
   156	    {
   157	        bytes32 assetKey = _getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId);
   158	        collateralFactor = riskParams[creditor][assetKey].collateralFactor;
   159	        liquidationFactor = riskParams[creditor][assetKey].liquidationFactor;
   160	    }
   161	
   162	    /**
   163	     * @notice Sets the risk parameters for an asset for a given Creditor.
   164	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   165	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   166	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   167	     * @param maxExposure The maximum exposure of a Creditor to the asset.
   168	     * @param collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   169	     * @param liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   170	     */
   171	    function setRiskParameters(
   172	        address creditor,
   173	        address asset,
   174	        uint256 assetId,
   175	        uint112 maxExposure,
   176	        uint16 collateralFactor,
   177	        uint16 liquidationFactor
   178	    ) external onlyRegistry {
   179	        if (collateralFactor > ONE_4) revert CollFactorNotInLimits();
   180	        if (liquidationFactor > ONE_4) revert LiqFactorNotInLimits();
   181	        if (collateralFactor > liquidationFactor) revert CollFactorExceedsLiqFactor();
   182	
   183	        bytes32 assetKey = _getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId);
   184	
   185	        riskParams[creditor][assetKey].maxExposure = maxExposure;
   186	        riskParams[creditor][assetKey].collateralFactor = collateralFactor;
   187	        riskParams[creditor][assetKey].liquidationFactor = liquidationFactor;
   188	    }
   189	
   190	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   191	                    WITHDRAWALS AND DEPOSITS
   192	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   193	
   194	    /**
   195	     * @notice Increases the exposure to an asset on a direct deposit.
   196	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   197	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   198	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   199	     * @param amount The amount of tokens.
   200	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
   201	     */
   202	    function processDirectDeposit(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId, uint256 amount)
   203	        public
   204	        virtual
   205	        override
   206	        onlyRegistry
   207	        returns (uint256)
   208	    {
   209	        bytes32 assetKey = _getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId);
   210	
   211	        // Cache lastExposureAsset.
   212	        uint256 lastExposureAsset = riskParams[creditor][assetKey].lastExposureAsset;
   213	
   214	        // The exposure must be strictly smaller than the maxExposure, not equal to or smaller than.
   215	        // This is to ensure that all deposits revert when maxExposure is set to 0, also deposits with 0 amounts.
   216	        if (lastExposureAsset + amount >= riskParams[creditor][assetKey].maxExposure) revert ExposureNotInLimits();
   217	
   218	        unchecked {
   219	            // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   220	            riskParams[creditor][assetKey].lastExposureAsset = uint112(lastExposureAsset + amount);
   221	        }
   222	
   223	        return 1;
   224	    }
   225	
   226	    /**
   227	     * @notice Increases the exposure to an asset on an indirect deposit.
   228	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   229	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   230	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   231	     * @param exposureUpperAssetToAsset The amount of exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module.
   232	     * @param deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module since last interaction.
   233	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
   234	     * @return usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset The USD value of the exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module, 18 decimals precision.
   235	     * @dev An indirect deposit is initiated by a deposit of a Derived Asset (the upper asset),
   236	     * from which the asset of this Asset Module is an Underlying Asset.
   237	     */
   238	    function processIndirectDeposit(
   239	        address creditor,
   240	        address asset,
   241	        uint256 assetId,
   242	        uint256 exposureUpperAssetToAsset,
   243	        int256 deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
   244	    ) public virtual override onlyRegistry returns (uint256 recursiveCalls, uint256 usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset) {
   245	        bytes32 assetKey = _getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId);
   246	
   247	        // Cache lastExposureAsset.
   248	        uint256 lastExposureAsset = riskParams[creditor][assetKey].lastExposureAsset;
   249	
   250	        // Update lastExposureAsset.
   251	        uint256 exposureAsset;
   252	        // forge-lint: disable-next-item(unsafe-typecast)
   253	        unchecked {
   254	            if (deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset > 0) {
   255	                exposureAsset = lastExposureAsset + uint256(deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset);
   256	            } else {
   257	                exposureAsset = lastExposureAsset > uint256(-deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset)
   258	                    ? lastExposureAsset - uint256(-deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset)
   259	                    : 0;
   260	            }
   261	        }
   262	        // The exposure must be strictly smaller than the maxExposure, not equal to or smaller than.
   263	        // This is to ensure that all deposits revert when maxExposure is set to 0, also deposits with 0 amounts.
   264	        if (exposureAsset >= riskParams[creditor][assetKey].maxExposure) revert ExposureNotInLimits();
   265	        // unchecked cast: "RiskParameters.maxExposure" is a uint112.
   266	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   267	        riskParams[creditor][assetKey].lastExposureAsset = uint112(exposureAsset);
   268	
   269	        // Get Value in USD.
   270	        (usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset,,) = getValue(creditor, asset, assetId, exposureUpperAssetToAsset);
   271	
   272	        return (1, usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset);
   273	    }
   274	
   275	    /**
   276	     * @notice Decreases the exposure to an asset on a direct withdrawal.
   277	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   278	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   279	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   280	     * @param amount The amount of tokens.
   281	     * @dev The checks on exposures are only done to block deposits that would over-expose a Creditor to a certain asset or protocol.
   282	     * Underflows will not revert, but the exposure is instead set to 0.
   283	     */
   284	    function processDirectWithdrawal(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId, uint256 amount)
   285	        public
   286	        virtual
   287	        override
   288	        onlyRegistry
   289	    {
   290	        bytes32 assetKey = _getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId);
   291	
   292	        // Cache lastExposureAsset.
   293	        uint256 lastExposureAsset = riskParams[creditor][assetKey].lastExposureAsset;
   294	
   295	        unchecked {
   296	            lastExposureAsset >= amount
   297	                // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   298	                ? riskParams[creditor][assetKey].lastExposureAsset = uint112(lastExposureAsset - amount)
   299	                : riskParams[creditor][assetKey].lastExposureAsset = 0;
   300	        }
   301	    }
   302	
   303	    /**
   304	     * @notice Decreases the exposure to an asset on an indirect withdrawal.
   305	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   306	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   307	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   308	     * @param exposureUpperAssetToAsset The amount of exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module.
   309	     * @param deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module since last interaction.
   310	     * @return usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset The USD value of the exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module, 18 decimals precision.
   311	     * @dev An indirect withdrawal is initiated by a withdrawal of a Derived Asset (the upper asset),
   312	     * from which the asset of this Asset Module is an Underlying Asset.
   313	     * @dev The checks on exposures are only done to block deposits that would over-expose a Creditor to a certain asset or protocol.
   314	     * Underflows will not revert, but the exposure is instead set to 0.
   315	     * @dev Due to changing compositions of derived assets, exposure to a primary asset can increase or decrease over time,
   316	     * independent of deposits/withdrawals.
   317	     * When derived assets are deposited/withdrawn, these changes in composition since last interaction are also synced.
   318	     * As such the actual exposure on an indirect withdrawal of a primary asset can exceed the maxExposure, but this should never be blocked,
   319	     * (the withdrawal actually improves the situation by making the asset less over-exposed).
   320	     */
   321	    function processIndirectWithdrawal(
   322	        address creditor,
   323	        address asset,
   324	        uint256 assetId,
   325	        uint256 exposureUpperAssetToAsset,
   326	        int256 deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
   327	    ) public virtual override onlyRegistry returns (uint256 usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset) {
   328	        bytes32 assetKey = _getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId);
   329	
   330	        // Cache lastExposureAsset.
   331	        uint256 lastExposureAsset = riskParams[creditor][assetKey].lastExposureAsset;
   332	
   333	        uint256 exposureAsset;
   334	        // forge-lint: disable-next-item(unsafe-typecast)
   335	        unchecked {
   336	            if (deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset > 0) {
   337	                exposureAsset = lastExposureAsset + uint256(deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset);
   338	                if (exposureAsset > type(uint112).max) revert Overflow();
   339	            } else {
   340	                exposureAsset = lastExposureAsset > uint256(-deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset)
   341	                    ? lastExposureAsset - uint256(-deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset)
   342	                    : 0;
   343	            }
   344	        }
   345	        // unsafe cast: Already checked that lastExposureAsset is smaller than type(uint112).max.
   346	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   347	        riskParams[creditor][assetKey].lastExposureAsset = uint112(exposureAsset);
   348	
   349	        // Get Value in USD.
   350	        (usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset,,) = getValue(creditor, asset, assetId, exposureUpperAssetToAsset);
   351	    }
   352	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/asset-modules/abstracts/AbstractStakingAM.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs

     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { AssetValuationLib, AssetValueAndRiskFactors } from "../../libraries/AssetValuationLib.sol";
     8	import { ERC20 } from "../../../lib/solmate/src/tokens/ERC20.sol";

    15	
    16	/**
    17	 * @title Staking Module
    18	 * @author Pragma Labs
    19	 * @notice Abstract contract with the minimal implementation of a wrapper contract for Assets staked in an external staking contract.
    20	 * @dev The staking Module is an ERC721 contract that does the accounting per Asset (staking token) and per position owner for:
    21	 *  - The balances of Assets staked through this contract.
    22	 *  - The balances of reward tokens earned for staking the Assets.
    23	 * Next to keeping the accounting of balances, this contract manages the interactions with the external staking contract:
    24	 *  - Staking Assets.
    25	 *  - Withdrawing the Assets from staked positions.
    26	 *  - Claiming reward tokens.
    27	 */
    28	abstract contract StakingAM is DerivedAM, ERC721, ReentrancyGuard {
    29	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    30	    using Strings for uint256;
    31	    using SafeTransferLib for ERC20;
    32	
    33	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    34	                                CONSTANTS
    35	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    36	
    37	    // The reward token.
    38	    ERC20 public immutable REWARD_TOKEN;
    39	
    40	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    41	                                STORAGE
    42	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    43	
    44	    // The id of last minted position.
    45	    uint256 internal lastPositionId;
    46	
    47	    // The baseURI of the ERC721 tokens.
    48	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-variable)
    49	    string public baseURI;
    50	
    51	    // Map Asset to its corresponding struct with global state.
    52	    mapping(address asset => AssetState) public assetState;
    53	    // Map a position id to its corresponding struct with the position state.
    54	    mapping(uint256 position => PositionState) public positionState;
    55	
    56	    // Struct with the global state per Asset.
    57	    struct AssetState {
    58	        // The growth of reward tokens per Asset staked, at the last interaction with this contract,
    59	        // with 18 decimals precision.
    60	        uint128 lastRewardPerTokenGlobal;
    61	        // The total amount of Assets staked.
    62	        uint128 totalStaked;
    63	        // Flag indicating if the asset is allowed.
    64	        bool allowed;
    65	    }
    66	
    67	    // Struct with the Position specific state.
    68	    struct PositionState {
    69	        // The staked Asset.
    70	        address asset;
    71	        // Total amount of Asset staked for this position.
    72	        uint128 amountStaked;
    73	        // The growth of reward tokens per Asset staked, at the last interaction of the position owner with this contract,
    74	        // with 18 decimals precision.
    75	        uint128 lastRewardPerTokenPosition;
    76	        // The unclaimed amount of reward tokens of the position owner, at the last interaction of the owner with this contract.
    77	        uint128 lastRewardPosition;
    78	    }
    79	
    80	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    81	                                EVENTS
    82	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    83	
    84	    event LiquidityDecreased(uint256 indexed positionId, address indexed asset, uint128 amount);
    85	    event LiquidityIncreased(uint256 indexed positionId, address indexed asset, uint128 amount);

    87	
    88	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    89	                                ERRORS
    90	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    91	
    92	    error AssetNotAllowed();
    93	    error NotOwner();
    94	    error ZeroAmount();
    95	
    96	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    97	                              CONSTRUCTOR
    98	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    99	
   100	    /**
   101	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
   102	     * @param registry The contract address of the Registry.
   103	     * @param name_ Name of the Staking Module.
   104	     * @param symbol_ Symbol of the Staking Module.
   105	     * @dev The ASSET_TYPE, necessary for the deposit and withdraw logic in the Accounts, is "2" for ERC721 tokens.
   106	     */
   107	    constructor(address owner_, address registry, string memory name_, string memory symbol_)
   108	        DerivedAM(owner_, registry, 2)
   109	        ERC721(name_, symbol_)
   110	    { }
   111	
   112	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   113	                               INITIALIZE
   114	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   115	
   116	    /**
   117	     * @notice This function will add this contract as an asset in the Registry.
   118	     * @dev Will revert if called more than once.
   119	     */
   120	    function initialize() external onlyOwner {
   121	        inAssetModule[address(this)] = true;
   122	
   123	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   124	        IRegistry(REGISTRY).addAsset(uint96(ASSET_TYPE), address(this));
   125	    }
   126	
   127	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   128	                        ASSET MANAGEMENT
   129	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   130	
   131	    /**
   132	     * @notice Adds an asset that can be staked to this contract.
   133	     * @param asset The contract address of the Asset.
   134	     */
   135	    function _addAsset(address asset) internal {
   136	        assetState[asset].allowed = true;
   137	    }

   139	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   140	                        ASSET INFORMATION
   141	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   142	
   143	    /**
   144	     * @notice Checks for a token address and the corresponding id if it is allowed.
   145	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   146	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   147	     * @return allowed A boolean, indicating if the asset is allowed.
   148	     */
   149	    function isAllowed(address asset, uint256 assetId) public view override returns (bool allowed) {
   150	        if (asset == address(this) && assetId <= lastPositionId) allowed = true;
   151	    }
   152	
   153	    /**
   154	     * @notice Returns the unique identifiers of the underlying assets.
   155	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   156	     * @return underlyingAssetKeys The unique identifiers of the underlying assets.
   157	     */
   158	    function _getUnderlyingAssets(bytes32 assetKey)
   159	        internal
   160	        view
   161	        virtual
   162	        override
   163	        returns (bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys)
   164	    {
   165	        (, uint256 positionId) = _getAssetFromKey(assetKey);
   166	
   167	        underlyingAssetKeys = new bytes32[](2);
   168	        underlyingAssetKeys[0] = _getKeyFromAsset(positionState[positionId].asset, 0);
   169	        underlyingAssetKeys[1] = _getKeyFromAsset(address(REWARD_TOKEN), 0);
   170	    }
   171	
   172	    /**
   173	     * @notice Calculates for a given amount of Asset the corresponding amount(s) of underlying asset(s).
   174	     * param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
   175	     * @param assetKey The unique identifier of the asset.
   176	     * @param amount The amount of the Asset, in the decimal precision of the Asset.
   177	     * param underlyingAssetKeys The unique identifiers of the underlying assets.
   178	     * @return underlyingAssetsAmounts The corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s), in the decimal precision of the Underlying Asset.
   179	     * @return rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The usd rates of 10**18 tokens of underlying asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   180	     */
   181	    function _getUnderlyingAssetsAmounts(address, bytes32 assetKey, uint256 amount, bytes32[] memory)
   182	        internal
   183	        view
   184	        virtual
   185	        override
   186	        returns (uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts, AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd)
   187	    {
   188	        // Amount of a Staked position in the Asset Module can only be either 0 or 1.
   189	        if (amount == 0) return (new uint256[](2), rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd);
   190	
   191	        (, uint256 positionId) = _getAssetFromKey(assetKey);
   192	
   193	        underlyingAssetsAmounts = new uint256[](2);
   194	        underlyingAssetsAmounts[0] = positionState[positionId].amountStaked;
   195	        underlyingAssetsAmounts[1] = rewardOf(positionId);
   196	
   197	        return (underlyingAssetsAmounts, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd);
   198	    }
   199	
   200	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   201	                          PRICING LOGIC
   202	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   203	
   204	    /**
   205	     * @notice Returns the risk factors of an asset for a Creditor.
   206	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   207	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   208	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   209	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   210	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   211	     */
   212	    function getRiskFactors(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId)
   213	        external
   214	        view
   215	        virtual
   216	        override
   217	        returns (uint16 collateralFactor, uint16 liquidationFactor)
   218	    {
   219	        bytes32 assetKey = _getKeyFromAsset(asset, assetId);
   220	        bytes32[] memory underlyingAssetKeys = _getUnderlyingAssets(assetKey);
   221	
   222	        uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts;
   223	        (underlyingAssetsAmounts,) = _getUnderlyingAssetsAmounts(creditor, assetKey, 1, underlyingAssetKeys);
   224	        AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd =
   225	            _getRateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd(creditor, underlyingAssetKeys);
   226	
   227	        (, uint256 collateralFactor_, uint256 liquidationFactor_) =
   228	            _calculateValueAndRiskFactors(creditor, underlyingAssetsAmounts, rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd);
   229	
   230	        // Unsafe cast: collateralFactor_ and liquidationFactor_ are smaller than or equal to 1e4.
   231	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   232	        return (uint16(collateralFactor_), uint16(liquidationFactor_));
   233	    }
   234	
   235	    /**
   236	     * @notice Returns the USD value of an asset.
   237	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   238	     * @param underlyingAssetsAmounts The corresponding amount(s) of Underlying Asset(s), in the decimal precision of the Underlying Asset.
   239	     * @param rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd The USD rates of 10**18 tokens of underlying asset, with 18 decimals precision.
   240	     * @return valueInUsd The value of the asset denominated in USD, with 18 Decimals precision.
   241	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   242	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for a given Creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
   243	     * @dev We take a weighted risk factor of both underlying assets.
   244	     */
   245	    function _calculateValueAndRiskFactors(
   246	        address creditor,
   247	        uint256[] memory underlyingAssetsAmounts,
   248	        AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd
   249	    ) internal view virtual override returns (uint256 valueInUsd, uint256 collateralFactor, uint256 liquidationFactor) {
   250	        // "rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd" is the USD value with 18 decimals precision for 10**18 tokens of Underlying Asset.
   251	        // To get the USD value (also with 18 decimals) of the actual amount of underlying assets, we have to multiply
   252	        // the actual amount with the rate for 10**18 tokens, and divide by 10**18.
   253	        uint256 valueStakedAsset = underlyingAssetsAmounts[0].mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].assetValue, 1e18);
   254	        uint256 valueRewardAsset = underlyingAssetsAmounts[1].mulDivDown(rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].assetValue, 1e18);
   255	        valueInUsd = valueStakedAsset + valueRewardAsset;
   256	
   257	        // Calculate weighted risk factors.
   258	        if (valueInUsd > 0) {
   259	            unchecked {
   260	                collateralFactor =
   261	                    (valueStakedAsset
   262	                            * rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].collateralFactor
   263	                            + valueRewardAsset
   264	                            * rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].collateralFactor) / valueInUsd;
   265	                liquidationFactor =
   266	                    (valueStakedAsset
   267	                            * rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[0].liquidationFactor
   268	                            + valueRewardAsset
   269	                            * rateUnderlyingAssetsToUsd[1].liquidationFactor) / valueInUsd;
   270	            }
   271	        }
   272	
   273	        // Lower risk factors with the protocol wide risk factor.
   274	        uint256 riskFactor = riskParams[creditor].riskFactor;
   275	        collateralFactor = riskFactor.mulDivDown(collateralFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4);
   276	        liquidationFactor = riskFactor.mulDivDown(liquidationFactor, AssetValuationLib.ONE_4);
   277	    }
   278	
   279	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   280	                         STAKING MODULE LOGIC
   281	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   282	
   283	    /**
   284	     * @notice Stakes an amount of Assets in the external staking contract and mints a new position.
   285	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset to stake.
   286	     * @param amount The amount of Assets to stake.
   287	     * @return positionId The id of the minted position.
   288	     */
   289	    function mint(address asset, uint128 amount) external virtual nonReentrant returns (uint256 positionId) {
   290	        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();
   291	
   292	        // Need to transfer before minting or ERC777s could reenter.
   293	        ERC20(asset).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);
   294	
   295	        // Cache the old assetState.
   296	        AssetState memory assetState_ = assetState[asset];
   297	        if (!assetState_.allowed) revert AssetNotAllowed();
   298	
   299	        // Create a new positionState.
   300	        PositionState memory positionState_;
   301	        positionState_.asset = asset;
   302	
   303	        // Calculate the new reward balances.
   304	        (assetState_, positionState_) = _getRewardBalances(assetState_, positionState_);
   305	
   306	        // Calculate the new staked amounts.
   307	        assetState_.totalStaked = assetState_.totalStaked + amount;
   308	        positionState_.amountStaked = amount;
   309	
   310	        // Store the new positionState and assetState.
   311	        unchecked {
   312	            positionId = ++lastPositionId;
   313	        }
   314	        positionState[positionId] = positionState_;
   315	        assetState[asset] = assetState_;
   316	
   317	        // Stake Asset in external staking contract and claim any pending rewards.
   318	        _stakeAndClaim(asset, amount);
   319	
   320	        // Mint the new position.
   321	        _safeMint(msg.sender, positionId);
   322	
   323	        emit LiquidityIncreased(positionId, asset, amount);
   324	    }
   325	
   326	    /**
   327	     * @notice Stakes additional Assets in the external staking contract for an existing position.
   328	     * @param positionId The id of the position.
   329	     * @param amount The amount of Assets to stake.
   330	     */
   331	    function increaseLiquidity(uint256 positionId, uint128 amount) external virtual nonReentrant {
   332	        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();
   333	        if (_ownerOf[positionId] != msg.sender) revert NotOwner();
   334	
   335	        // Cache the old positionState and assetState.
   336	        PositionState memory positionState_ = positionState[positionId];
   337	        address asset = positionState_.asset;
   338	        AssetState memory assetState_ = assetState[asset];
   339	
   340	        // Need to transfer before increasing liquidity or ERC777s could reenter.
   341	        ERC20(asset).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);
   342	
   343	        // Calculate the new reward balances.
   344	        (assetState_, positionState_) = _getRewardBalances(assetState_, positionState_);
   345	
   346	        // Calculate the new staked amounts.
   347	        assetState_.totalStaked = assetState_.totalStaked + amount;
   348	        positionState_.amountStaked = positionState_.amountStaked + amount;
   349	
   350	        // Store the new positionState and assetState.
   351	        positionState[positionId] = positionState_;
   352	        assetState[asset] = assetState_;
   353	
   354	        // Stake Asset in external staking contract and claim any pending rewards.
   355	        _stakeAndClaim(asset, amount);
   356	
   357	        emit LiquidityIncreased(positionId, asset, amount);
   358	    }
   359	
   360	    /**
   361	     * @notice Unstakes, withdraws and claims rewards for total amount staked of Asset in position.
   362	     * @param positionId The id of the position to burn.
   363	     */
   364	    function burn(uint256 positionId) external virtual {
   365	        decreaseLiquidity(positionId, positionState[positionId].amountStaked);
   366	    }
   367	
   368	    /**
   369	     * @notice Unstakes and withdraws the asset from the external staking contract.
   370	     * @param positionId The id of the position to withdraw from.
   371	     * @param amount The amount of Asset to unstake and withdraw.
   372	     * @return rewards The amount of reward tokens claimed.
   373	     * @dev Also claims and transfers the staking rewards of the position.
   374	     */
   375	    function decreaseLiquidity(uint256 positionId, uint128 amount)
   376	        public
   377	        virtual
   378	        nonReentrant
   379	        returns (uint256 rewards)
   380	    {
   381	        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();
   382	        if (_ownerOf[positionId] != msg.sender) revert NotOwner();
   383	
   384	        // Cache the old positionState and assetState.
   385	        PositionState memory positionState_ = positionState[positionId];
   386	        address asset = positionState_.asset;
   387	        AssetState memory assetState_ = assetState[asset];
   388	
   389	        // Calculate the new reward balances.
   390	        (assetState_, positionState_) = _getRewardBalances(assetState_, positionState_);
   391	
   392	        // Calculate the new staked amounts.
   393	        assetState_.totalStaked = assetState_.totalStaked - amount;
   394	        positionState_.amountStaked = positionState_.amountStaked - amount;
   395	
   396	        // Rewards are paid out to the owner on a decreaseLiquidity.
   397	        // -> Reset the balances of the pending rewards.
   398	        rewards = positionState_.lastRewardPosition;
   399	        positionState_.lastRewardPosition = 0;
   400	
   401	        // Store the new positionState and assetState.
   402	        if (positionState_.amountStaked > 0) {
   403	            positionState[positionId] = positionState_;
   404	        } else {
   405	            delete positionState[positionId];
   406	            _burn(positionId);
   407	        }
   408	        assetState[asset] = assetState_;
   409	
   410	        // Withdraw the Assets from external staking contract and claim any pending rewards.
   411	        _withdrawAndClaim(asset, amount);
   412	
   413	        // Pay out the rewards to the position owner.
   414	        if (rewards > 0) {
   415	            // Transfer reward
   416	            REWARD_TOKEN.safeTransfer(msg.sender, rewards);
   417	            // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   418	            emit RewardPaid(positionId, address(REWARD_TOKEN), uint128(rewards));
   419	        }
   420	
   421	        // Transfer the asset back to the position owner.
   422	        ERC20(asset).safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount);
   423	        emit LiquidityDecreased(positionId, asset, amount);
   424	    }
   425	
   426	    /**
   427	     * @notice Claims and transfers the staking rewards of the position.
   428	     * @param positionId The id of the position.
   429	     * @return rewards The amount of reward tokens claimed.
   430	     */
   431	    function claimReward(uint256 positionId) external virtual nonReentrant returns (uint256 rewards) {
   432	        if (_ownerOf[positionId] != msg.sender) revert NotOwner();
   433	
   434	        // Cache the old positionState and assetState.
   435	        PositionState memory positionState_ = positionState[positionId];
   436	        address asset = positionState_.asset;
   437	        AssetState memory assetState_ = assetState[asset];
   438	
   439	        // Calculate the new reward balances.
   440	        (assetState_, positionState_) = _getRewardBalances(assetState_, positionState_);
   441	
   442	        // Rewards are paid out to the owner on a claimReward.
   443	        // -> Reset the balances of the pending rewards.
   444	        rewards = positionState_.lastRewardPosition;
   445	        positionState_.lastRewardPosition = 0;
   446	
   447	        // Store the new positionState and assetState.
   448	        positionState[positionId] = positionState_;
   449	        assetState[asset] = assetState_;
   450	
   451	        // Claim the pending rewards from the external staking contract.
   452	        _claimReward(asset);
   453	
   454	        // Pay out the share of the reward owed to the position owner.
   455	        if (rewards > 0) {
   456	            // Transfer reward
   457	            REWARD_TOKEN.safeTransfer(msg.sender, rewards);
   458	            // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   459	            emit RewardPaid(positionId, address(REWARD_TOKEN), uint128(rewards));
   460	        }
   461	    }
   462	
   463	    /**
   464	     * @notice Returns the total amount of Asset staked via this contract.
   465	     * @param asset The Asset staked via this contract.
   466	     * @return totalStaked_ The total amount of Asset staked via this contract.
   467	     */
   468	    function totalStaked(address asset) external view returns (uint256 totalStaked_) {
   469	        return assetState[asset].totalStaked;
   470	    }
   471	
   472	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   473	                    INTERACTIONS STAKING CONTRACT
   474	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   475	
   476	    /**
   477	     * @notice Stakes an amount of Asset in the external staking contract and claims pending rewards.
   478	     * @param asset The Asset to stake.
   479	     * @param amount The amount of Asset to stake.
   480	     */
   481	    function _stakeAndClaim(address asset, uint256 amount) internal virtual;
   482	
   483	    /**
   484	     * @notice Unstakes and withdraws the Asset from the external contract and claims pending rewards.
   485	     * @param asset The Asset to withdraw.
   486	     * @param amount The amount of Asset to unstake and withdraw.
   487	     */
   488	    function _withdrawAndClaim(address asset, uint256 amount) internal virtual;
   489	
   490	    /**
   491	     * @notice Claims the rewards available for this contract.
   492	     * @param asset The Asset for which rewards will be claimed.
   493	     */
   494	    function _claimReward(address asset) internal virtual;
   495	
   496	    /**
   497	     * @notice Returns the amount of reward tokens that can be claimed by this contract for a specific Asset.
   498	     * @param asset The Asset that is earning rewards from staking.
   499	     * @return currentReward The amount of rewards tokens that can be claimed.
   500	     */
   501	    function _getCurrentReward(address asset) internal view virtual returns (uint256 currentReward);
   502	
   503	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   504	                         REWARDS VIEW FUNCTIONS
   505	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   506	
   507	    /**
   508	     * @notice Returns the amount of reward tokens claimable by a position.
   509	     * @param positionId The id of the position to check the rewards for.
   510	     * @return currentRewardClaimable The current amount of reward tokens claimable by the owner of the position.
   511	     */
   512	    function rewardOf(uint256 positionId) public view virtual returns (uint256 currentRewardClaimable) {
   513	        // Cache the old positionState and assetState.
   514	        PositionState memory positionState_ = positionState[positionId];
   515	        AssetState memory assetState_ = assetState[positionState_.asset];
   516	
   517	        // Calculate the new reward balances.
   518	        (, positionState_) = _getRewardBalances(assetState_, positionState_);
   519	
   520	        currentRewardClaimable = positionState_.lastRewardPosition;
   521	    }
   522	
   523	    /**
   524	     * @notice Calculates the current global and position specific reward balances.
   525	     * @param assetState_ Struct with the old rewards state of the Asset.
   526	     * @param positionState_ Struct with the old rewards state of the position.
   527	     * @return currentAssetState Struct with the current rewards state of the Asset.
   528	     * @return currentPositionState Struct with the current rewards state of the position.
   529	     */
   530	    function _getRewardBalances(AssetState memory assetState_, PositionState memory positionState_)
   531	        internal
   532	        view
   533	        returns (AssetState memory, PositionState memory)
   534	    {
   535	        if (assetState_.totalStaked > 0) {
   536	            // Calculate the new assetState
   537	            // Fetch the current reward balance from the staking contract and calculate the change in RewardPerToken.
   538	            uint256 deltaRewardPerToken =
   539	                _getCurrentReward(positionState_.asset).mulDivDown(1e18, assetState_.totalStaked);
   540	            // Calculate and update the new RewardPerToken of the asset.
   541	            // unchecked: RewardPerToken can overflow, what matters is the delta in RewardPerToken between two interactions.
   542	            unchecked {
   543	                assetState_.lastRewardPerTokenGlobal =
   544	                    assetState_.lastRewardPerTokenGlobal + SafeCastLib.safeCastTo128(deltaRewardPerToken);
   545	            }
   546	
   547	            // Calculate the new positionState.
   548	            // Calculate the difference in rewardPerToken since the last position interaction.
   549	            // unchecked: RewardPerToken can underflow, what matters is the delta in RewardPerToken between two interactions.
   550	            unchecked {
   551	                deltaRewardPerToken = assetState_.lastRewardPerTokenGlobal - positionState_.lastRewardPerTokenPosition;
   552	            }
   553	            // Calculate the rewards earned by the position since its last interaction.
   554	            // unchecked: deltaRewardPerToken and positionState_.amountStaked are smaller than type(uint128).max.
   555	            uint256 deltaReward;
   556	            unchecked {
   557	                deltaReward = deltaRewardPerToken * positionState_.amountStaked / 1e18;
   558	            }
   559	            // Update the reward balance of the position.
   560	            positionState_.lastRewardPosition =
   561	                SafeCastLib.safeCastTo128(positionState_.lastRewardPosition + deltaReward);
   562	        }
   563	        // Update the RewardPerToken of the position.
   564	        positionState_.lastRewardPerTokenPosition = assetState_.lastRewardPerTokenGlobal;
   565	
   566	        return (assetState_, positionState_);
   567	    }
   568	
   569	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   570	                        ERC-721 LOGIC
   571	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   572	
   573	    /**
   574	     * @notice Function that stores a new base URI.
   575	     * @param newBaseURI The new base URI to store.
   576	     */
   577	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function,mixed-case-variable)
   578	    function setBaseURI(string calldata newBaseURI) external virtual onlyOwner {
   579	        baseURI = newBaseURI;
   580	    }
   581	
   582	    /**
   583	     * @notice Function that returns the token URI as defined in the ERC721 standard.
   584	     * @param tokenId The id of the Account.
   585	     * @return uri The token URI.
   586	     */
   587	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function,mixed-case-variable)
   588	    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) public view virtual override returns (string memory uri) {
   589	        return bytes(baseURI).length > 0 ? string(abi.encodePacked(baseURI, tokenId.toString())) : "";
   590	    }
   591	}
```
