```solidity
    46	    /**
    47	     * @notice This function is called by pricing modules of non-primary assets in order to update the exposure of an underlying asset after a deposit.
    48	     * @param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
    49	     * @param underlyingAsset The underlying asset.
    50	     * @param underlyingAssetId The underlying asset ID.
    51	     * @param exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The amount of exposure of the asset to the underlying asset.
    52	     * @param deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the asset to the underlying asset since the last interaction.
    53	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
    54	     * @return usdExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The Usd value of the exposure of the asset to the underlying asset, 18 decimals precision.
    55	     */
    56	    function getUsdValueExposureToUnderlyingAssetAfterDeposit(
    57	        address creditor,
    58	        address underlyingAsset,
    59	        uint256 underlyingAssetId,
    60	        uint256 exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset,
    61	        int256 deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset
    62	    ) external returns (uint256, uint256);
    63	
    64	    /**
    65	     * @notice This function is called by pricing modules of non-primary assets in order to update the exposure of an underlying asset after a withdrawal.
    66	     * @param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
    67	     * @param underlyingAsset The underlying asset.
    68	     * @param underlyingAssetId The underlying asset ID.
    69	     * @param exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The amount of exposure of the asset to the underlying asset.
    70	     * @param deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the asset to the underlying asset since the last interaction.
    71	     * @return usdExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The Usd value of the exposure of the asset to the underlying asset, 18 decimals precision.
    72	     */
    73	    function getUsdValueExposureToUnderlyingAssetAfterWithdrawal(
    74	        address creditor,
    75	        address underlyingAsset,
    76	        uint256 underlyingAssetId,
    77	        uint256 exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset,
    78	        int256 deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset
    79	    ) external returns (uint256 usdExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset);
    80	
    81	    /**
    82	     * @notice Returns the rate of a certain asset in USD.
    83	     * @param oracleSequence The sequence of the oracles to price a certain asset in USD,
    84	     * packed in a single bytes32 object.
    85	     * @return rate The USD rate of an asset with 18 decimals precision.
    86	     */
    87	    function getRateInUsd(bytes32 oracleSequence) external view returns (uint256);
    88	
    89	    /**
    90	     * @notice Calculates the USD values of underlying assets.
    91	     * @param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
    92	     * @param assets Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
    93	     * @param assetIds Array of the IDs of the assets.
    94	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
    95	     * @return valuesAndRiskFactors The value of the asset denominated in USD, with 18 Decimals precision.
    96	     */
    97	    function getValuesInUsdRecursive(
    98	        address creditor,
    99	        address[] calldata assets,
   100	        uint256[] calldata assetIds,
   101	        uint256[] calldata assetAmounts
   102	    ) external view returns (AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory valuesAndRiskFactors);
   103	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/asset-modules/native-token/NativeTokenAM.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { IRegistry } from "../interfaces/IRegistry.sol";
     8	import { PrimaryAM } from "../abstracts/AbstractPrimaryAM.sol";
     9	
    10	/**
    11	 * @title Asset Module for the native token of the chain
    12	 * @author Pragma Labs
    13	 * @notice The pricing logic and basic information for The native token of the chain.
    14	 * @dev No end-user should directly interact with the NativeTokenAM, only the Registry
    15	 * or the contract owner.
    16	 */
    17	contract NativeTokenAM is PrimaryAM {
    18	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    19	                               CONSTANTS
    20	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    21	
    22	    // The unit of the native asset, equal to 10^decimals.
    23	    uint64 public immutable ASSET_UNIT;
    24	
    25	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    26	                                ERRORS
    27	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    28	
    29	    error Max18Decimals();
    30	
    31	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    32	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    33	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    34	
    35	    /**
    36	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    37	     * @param registry_ The contract address of the Registry.
    38	     * @param decimals The number of decimals of the native asset.
    39	     * @dev The ASSET_TYPE, necessary for the deposit and withdraw logic in the Accounts, is "4" for the native token.
    40	     */
    41	    constructor(address owner_, address registry_, uint256 decimals) PrimaryAM(owner_, registry_, 4) {
    42	        if (decimals > 18) revert Max18Decimals();
    43	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
    44	        ASSET_UNIT = uint64(10 ** decimals);
    45	    }
    46	
    47	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    48	                        ASSET MANAGEMENT
    49	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    50	
    51	    /**
    52	     * @notice Adds a new alias that represents the native asset to the NativeTokenAM.
    53	     * @param asset An alias that represents the native asset.
    54	     * @param oracleSequence The sequence of the oracles to price the asset in USD,
    55	     * packed in a single bytes32 object.
    56	     * @dev Different protocols can use different "aliases" for the native asset, Uniswap v4 uses for instance the 0-address.
    57	     */
    58	    function addAsset(address asset, bytes32 oracleSequence) external onlyOwner {
    59	        // View function, reverts in Registry if sequence is not correct.
    60	        if (!IRegistry(REGISTRY).checkOracleSequence(oracleSequence)) revert BadOracleSequence();
    61	        // Will revert in Registry if asset was already added.
    62	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
    63	        IRegistry(REGISTRY).addAsset(uint96(ASSET_TYPE), asset);
    64	
    65	        inAssetModule[asset] = true;
    66	
    67	        assetToInformation[_getKeyFromAsset(asset, 0)] =
    68	            AssetInformation({ assetUnit: ASSET_UNIT, oracleSequence: oracleSequence });
    69	    }
    70	
    71	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    72	                        ASSET INFORMATION
    73	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    74	
    75	    /**
    76	     * @notice Checks for a token address and the corresponding id if it is allowed.
    77	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
    78	     * param assetId The id of the asset.
    79	     * @return A boolean, indicating if the asset is allowed.
    80	     * @dev Since the Native Token doesn't have an id, the id should be set to 0.
    81	     */
    82	    function isAllowed(address asset, uint256) public view override returns (bool) {
    83	        return inAssetModule[asset];
    84	    }
    85	
    86	    /**
    87	     * @notice Returns the unique identifier of an asset based on the contract address and id.
    88	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
    89	     * param assetId The id of the asset.
    90	     * @return key The unique identifier.
    91	     * @dev The assetId is hard-coded to 0, since the assets for this Asset Module are the Native Token.
    92	     */
    93	    function _getKeyFromAsset(address asset, uint256) internal pure override returns (bytes32 key) {
    94	        assembly {
    95	            key := asset
    96	        }
    97	    }
    98	
    99	    /**
   100	     * @notice Returns the contract address and id of an asset based on the unique identifier.
   101	     * @param key The unique identifier.
   102	     * @return asset The contract address of the asset.
   103	     * @return assetId The id of the asset.
   104	     * @dev The assetId is hard-coded to 0, since the assets for this Asset Module are the Native Token.
   105	     */
   106	    function _getAssetFromKey(bytes32 key) internal pure override returns (address asset, uint256) {
   107	        assembly {
   108	            asset := key
   109	        }
   110	
   111	        return (asset, 0);
   112	    }
   113	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/guardians/BaseGuardian.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { GuardianErrors } from "../libraries/Errors.sol";
     8	import { Owned } from "../../lib/solmate/src/auth/Owned.sol";
     9	
    10	/**
    11	 * @title Guardian
    12	 * @author Pragma Labs
    13	 * @notice Abstract contract with the minimal implementation of a Guardian contract.
    14	 * It implements the following logic:
    15	 * - An authorized guardian can trigger an emergency stop.
    16	 * - The protocol owner can unpause functionalities one-by-one.
    17	 * - Anyone can unpause all functionalities after a fixed cool-down period.
    18	 */
    19	abstract contract BaseGuardian is Owned {
    20	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    21	                                STORAGE
    22	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    23	
    24	    // Last timestamp an emergency stop was triggered.
    25	    uint96 public pauseTimestamp;
    26	    // Address of the Guardian.
    27	    address public guardian;
    28	
    29	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    30	                                EVENTS
    31	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    32	
    33	    event GuardianChanged(address indexed user, address indexed newGuardian);
    34	
    35	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    36	                                MODIFIERS
    37	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    38	
    39	    /**
    40	     * @dev Only guardians can call functions with this modifier.
    41	     */
    42	    modifier onlyGuardian() {
    43	        if (msg.sender != guardian) revert GuardianErrors.OnlyGuardian();
    44	        _;
    45	    }
    46	
    47	    /**
    48	     * @dev The public unpause() function, or a second pause() function, can only called a fixed coolDownPeriod after an initial pause().
    49	     * This gives the protocol owner time to investigate and solve potential issues,
    50	     * but ensures that no rogue owner or guardian can lock user funds for an indefinite amount of time.
    51	     */
    52	    modifier afterCoolDownOf(uint256 coolDownPeriod) {
    53	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(block-timestamp)
    54	        if (block.timestamp <= pauseTimestamp + coolDownPeriod) revert GuardianErrors.CoolDownPeriodNotPassed();
    55	        _;
    56	    }
    57	
    58	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    59	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    60	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    61	
    62	    /**
    63	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    64	     */
    65	    constructor(address owner_) Owned(owner_) { }
    66	
    67	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    68	                            GUARDIAN LOGIC
    69	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    70	
    71	    /**
    72	     * @notice This function is used to set the guardian address
    73	     * @param guardian_ The address of the new guardian.
    74	     */
    75	    function changeGuardian(address guardian_) external onlyOwner {
    76	        emit GuardianChanged(msg.sender, guardian = guardian_);
    77	    }
    78	
    79	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    80	                            PAUSING LOGIC
    81	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    82	
    83	    /**
    84	     * @notice This function is used to pause all the flags of the contract.
    85	     * @dev The Guardian can only pause the protocol again after the cool-down period has passed since the last pause.
    86	     * This prevents a malicious owner or guardian from taking user funds hostage for an indefinite time.
    87	     * After the guardian has paused the protocol, the owner can investigate and unpause functionalities one-by-one.
    88	     * If the protocol is not unpaused before the cool-down period elapses, any user can unpause it via unpause().
    89	     * The length of the cool-down period is set by the implementation.
    90	     */
    91	    function pause() external virtual;
    92	
    93	    /**
    94	     * @notice This function is used to unpause flags that could be abused to lock user assets.
    95	     * @dev Once the cool-down period has passed since the last pause, any user can unpause the protocol.
    96	     * This ensures that no rogue owner or guardian can lock user funds for an indefinite amount of time.
    97	     * The length of the cool-down period is set by the implementation.
    98	     */
    99	    function unpause() external virtual;
   100	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/guardians/FactoryGuardian.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { BaseGuardian, GuardianErrors } from "./BaseGuardian.sol";
     8	
     9	/**
    10	 * @title Factory Guardian
    11	 * @author Pragma Labs
    12	 * @notice Logic inherited by the Factory that allows:
    13	 * - An authorized guardian to trigger an emergency stop.
    14	 * - The protocol owner to unpause functionalities.
    15	 */
    16	abstract contract FactoryGuardian is BaseGuardian {
    17	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    18	                                STORAGE
    19	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    20	
    21	    // Flag indicating if the create() function is paused.
    22	    bool public createPaused;
    23	
    24	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    25	                                ERRORS
    26	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    27	
    28	    error FunctionNotImplemented();
    29	
    30	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    31	                                EVENTS
    32	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    33	
    34	    event PauseFlagsUpdated(bool createPauseUpdate);
    35	
    36	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    37	                                MODIFIERS
    38	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    39	
    40	    /**
    41	     * @dev Throws if the createAccount functionality is paused.
    42	     */
    43	    modifier whenCreateNotPaused() {
    44	        if (createPaused) revert GuardianErrors.FunctionIsPaused();
    45	        _;
    46	    }
    47	
    48	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    49	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    50	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    51	
    52	    /**
    53	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    54	     */
    55	    constructor(address owner_) BaseGuardian(owner_) { }
    56	
    57	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    58	                            PAUSING LOGIC
    59	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    60	
    61	    /**
    62	     * @notice This function is used to pause the creation of Accounts.
    63	     * @dev The pause guardian of the Factory has no cool-down period.
    64	     */
    65	    function pause() external override onlyGuardian {
    66	        emit PauseFlagsUpdated(createPaused = true);
    67	    }
    68	
    69	    /**
    70	     * @notice This function is used to unpause the creation of Accounts.
    71	     * @param createPaused_ "False" when create functionality should be unpaused.
    72	     * @dev This function can unpause the creation of new Accounts.
    73	     * @dev Can only update flags from paused (true) to unpaused (false), cannot be used the other way around
    74	     * (to set unpaused flags to paused).
    75	     */
    76	    function unpause(bool createPaused_) external onlyOwner {
    77	        emit PauseFlagsUpdated(createPaused = createPaused && createPaused_);
    78	    }
    79	
    80	    /**
    81	     * @notice This function is not implemented.
    82	     * @dev No reason to be able to create an Account if the owner of the Factory did not unpause createAccount().
    83	     */
    84	    function unpause() external pure override {
    85	        revert FunctionNotImplemented();
    86	    }
    87	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/guardians/RegistryGuardian.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { BaseGuardian, GuardianErrors } from "./BaseGuardian.sol";
     8	
     9	/**
    10	 * @title Registry Guardian
    11	 * @author Pragma Labs
    12	 * @notice Logic inherited by the Registry that allows:
    13	 * - An authorized guardian to trigger an emergency stop.
    14	 * - The protocol owner to unpause functionalities one-by-one.
    15	 * - Anyone to unpause all functionalities after a fixed cool-down period.
    16	 */
    17	abstract contract RegistryGuardian is BaseGuardian {
    18	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    19	                                STORAGE
    20	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    21	
    22	    // Flag indicating if the withdraw() function is paused.
    23	    bool public withdrawPaused;
    24	    // Flag indicating if the deposit() function is paused.
    25	    bool public depositPaused;
    26	
    27	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    28	                                EVENTS
    29	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    30	
    31	    event PauseFlagsUpdated(bool withdrawPauseUpdate, bool depositPauseUpdate);
    32	
    33	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    34	                                MODIFIERS
    35	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    36	
    37	    /**
    38	     * @dev Throws if the withdraw functionality is paused.
    39	     */
    40	    modifier whenWithdrawNotPaused() {
    41	        if (withdrawPaused) revert GuardianErrors.FunctionIsPaused();
    42	        _;
    43	    }
    44	
    45	    /**
    46	     * @dev Throws if the deposit functionality is paused.
    47	     */
    48	    modifier whenDepositNotPaused() {
    49	        if (depositPaused) revert GuardianErrors.FunctionIsPaused();
    50	        _;
    51	    }
    52	
    53	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    54	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    55	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    56	
    57	    /**
    58	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    59	     */
    60	    constructor(address owner_) BaseGuardian(owner_) { }
    61	
    62	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    63	                            PAUSING LOGIC
    64	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    65	
    66	    /**
    67	     * @inheritdoc BaseGuardian
    68	     * @dev This function will pause the functionality to:
    69	     * - Withdraw assets.
    70	     * - Deposit assets.
    71	     */
    72	    function pause() external override onlyGuardian afterCoolDownOf(1441 minutes) {
    73	        pauseTimestamp = uint96(block.timestamp);
    74	        emit PauseFlagsUpdated(withdrawPaused = true, depositPaused = true);
    75	    }
    76	
    77	    /**
    78	     * @notice This function is used to unpause one or more flags.
    79	     * @param withdrawPaused_ It is false when withdraw functionality should be unPaused.
    80	     * @param depositPaused_ It is false when deposit functionality should be unPaused.
    81	     * @dev This function can unPause withdraw and deposit individually.
    82	     * @dev Can only update flags from paused (true) to unpaused (false), cannot be used the other way around
    83	     * (to set unpaused flags to paused).
    84	     */
    85	    function unpause(bool withdrawPaused_, bool depositPaused_) external onlyOwner {
    86	        emit PauseFlagsUpdated(
    87	            withdrawPaused = withdrawPaused && withdrawPaused_, depositPaused = depositPaused && depositPaused_
    88	        );
    89	    }
    90	
    91	    /**
    92	     * @inheritdoc BaseGuardian
    93	     * @dev This function will unpause the functionality to:
    94	     * - Withdraw assets.
    95	     */
    96	    function unpause() external override afterCoolDownOf(1440 minutes) {
    97	        emit PauseFlagsUpdated(withdrawPaused = false, depositPaused);
    98	    }
    99	}
```

```solidity
    33	     * @param data Arbitrary data, can contain instructions to execute when updating Account to new logic.

    37	        external;

    46	    function upgradeHook(address oldImplementation, address oldRegistry, uint256 oldVersion, bytes calldata data)
    47	        external;
    48
```

```solidity
     8	    /**
     9	     * @notice Checks for a token address and the corresponding Id if it is allowed.
    10	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
    11	     * @param assetId The Id of the asset.
    12	     * @return A boolean, indicating if the asset is allowed.
    13	     * @dev For assets without Id (ERC20, ERC4626...), the Id should be set to 0.
    14	     */
    15	    function isAllowed(address asset, uint256 assetId) external view returns (bool);
    16	
    17	    /**
    18	     * @notice Returns the usd value of an asset.
    19	     * @param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
    20	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
    21	     * @param assetId The Id of the asset.
    22	     * @param assetAmount The amount of assets.
    23	     * @return valueInUsd The value of the asset denominated in USD, with 18 Decimals precision.
    24	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for a given creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
    25	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for a given creditor, with 4 decimals precision.
    26	     */
    27	    function getValue(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId, uint256 assetAmount)
    28	        external
    29	        view
    30	        returns (uint256, uint256, uint256);
    31	
    32	    /**
    33	     * @notice Returns the risk factors of an asset for a creditor.
    34	     * @param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
    35	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
    36	     * @param assetId The Id of the asset.
    37	     * @return collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for the creditor, 4 decimals precision.
    38	     * @return liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for the creditor, 4 decimals precision.
    39	     */
    40	    function getRiskFactors(address creditor, address asset, uint256 assetId) external view returns (uint16, uint16);
    41	
    42	    /**
    43	     * @notice Increases the exposure to an asset on a direct deposit.
    44	     * @param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
    45	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
    46	     * @param id The Id of the asset.
    47	     * @param amount The amount of tokens.
    48	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
    49	     */
    50	    function processDirectDeposit(address creditor, address asset, uint256 id, uint256 amount)
    51	        external
    52	        returns (uint256);
    53	
    54	    /**
    55	     * @notice Increases the exposure to an asset on an indirect deposit.
    56	     * @param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
    57	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
    58	     * @param id The Id of the asset.
    59	     * @param exposureUpperAssetToAsset The amount of exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module.
    60	     * @param deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module since last interaction.
    61	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
    62	     * @return usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset The Usd value of the exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module, 18 decimals precision.
    63	     */
    64	    function processIndirectDeposit(
    65	        address creditor,
    66	        address asset,
    67	        uint256 id,
    68	        uint256 exposureUpperAssetToAsset,
    69	        int256 deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
    70	    ) external returns (uint256, uint256);
    71	
    72	    /**
    73	     * @notice Decreases the exposure to an asset on a direct withdrawal.
    74	     * @param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
    75	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
    76	     * @param id The Id of the asset.
    77	     * @param amount The amount of tokens.
    78	     */
    79	    function processDirectWithdrawal(address creditor, address asset, uint256 id, uint256 amount) external;
    80	
    81	    /**
    82	     * @notice Decreases the exposure to an asset on an indirect withdrawal.
    83	     * @param creditor The contract address of the creditor.
    84	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
    85	     * @param id The Id of the asset.
    86	     * @param exposureUpperAssetToAsset The amount of exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module.
    87	     * @param deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module since last interaction.
    88	     * @return usdExposureUpperAssetToAsset The Usd value of the exposure of the upper asset to the asset of this Asset Module, 18 decimals precision.
    89	     */
    90	    function processIndirectWithdrawal(
    91	        address creditor,
    92	        address asset,
    93	        uint256 id,
    94	        uint256 exposureUpperAssetToAsset,
    95	        int256 deltaExposureUpperAssetToAsset
    96	    ) external returns (uint256);
    97	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/interfaces/IPermit2.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.0;
     6	
     7	interface IPermit2 {
     8	    /**
     9	     * @notice The token and amount details for a transfer signed in the permit transfer signature
    10	     */
    11	    struct TokenPermissions {
    12	        // ERC20 token address
    13	        address token;
    14	        // the maximum amount that can be spent
    15	        uint256 amount;
    16	    }
    17	
    18	    /**
    19	     * @notice Used to reconstruct the signed permit message for multiple token transfers
    20	     * @dev Do not need to pass in spender address as it is required that it is msg.sender
    21	     * @dev Note that a user still signs over a spender address
    22	     */
    23	    struct PermitBatchTransferFrom {
    24	        // the tokens and corresponding amounts permitted for a transfer
    25	        TokenPermissions[] permitted;
    26	        // a unique value for every token owner's signature to prevent signature replays
    27	        uint256 nonce;
    28	        // deadline on the permit signature
    29	        uint256 deadline;
    30	    }
    31	
    32	    /**
    33	     * @notice Specifies the recipient address and amount for batched transfers.
    34	     * @dev Recipients and amounts correspond to the index of the signed token permissions array.
    35	     * @dev Reverts if the requested amount is greater than the permitted signed amount.
    36	     */
    37	    struct SignatureTransferDetails {
    38	        // recipient address
    39	        address to;
    40	        // spender requested amount
    41	        uint256 requestedAmount;
    42	    }
    43	
    44	    /**
    45	     * @notice Transfers multiple tokens using a signed permit message
    46	     * @param permit The permit data signed over by the owner
    47	     * @param owner The owner of the tokens to transfer
    48	     * @param transferDetails Specifies the recipient and requested amount for the token transfer
    49	     * @param signature The signature to verify
    50	     */
    51	    function permitTransferFrom(
    52	        PermitBatchTransferFrom memory permit,
    53	        SignatureTransferDetails[] calldata transferDetails,
    54	        address owner,
    55	        bytes calldata signature
    56	    ) external;
    57	}
```

```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	// Struct with risk and valuation related information for a certain asset.
     8	struct AssetValueAndRiskFactors {
     9	    // The value of the asset.
    10	    uint256 assetValue;
    11	    // The collateral factor of the asset, for a given creditor.
    12	    uint256 collateralFactor;
    13	    // The liquidation factor of the asset, for a given creditor.
    14	    uint256 liquidationFactor;
    15	}
    16	
    17	/**
    18	 * @title Asset Valuation Library
    19	 * @author Pragma Labs
    20	 * @notice The Asset Valuation Library is responsible for calculating the risk weighted values of combinations of assets.
    21	 */
    22	library AssetValuationLib {
    23	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    24	                        CONSTANTS
    25	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    26	
    27	    uint256 internal constant ONE_4 = 10_000;
    28	
    29	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    30	                        RISK FACTORS
    31	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    32	
    33	    /**
    34	     * @notice Calculates the collateral value given a combination of asset values and corresponding collateral factors.
    35	     * @param valuesAndRiskFactors Array of asset values and corresponding collateral factors.
    36	     * @return collateralValue The collateral value of the given assets.
    37	     */
    38	    function _calculateCollateralValue(AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory valuesAndRiskFactors)
    39	        internal
    40	        pure
    41	        returns (uint256 collateralValue)
    42	    {
    43	        for (uint256 i; i < valuesAndRiskFactors.length; ++i) {
    44	            collateralValue += valuesAndRiskFactors[i].assetValue * valuesAndRiskFactors[i].collateralFactor;
    45	        }
    46	        collateralValue = collateralValue / ONE_4;
    47	    }
    48	
    49	    /**
    50	     * @notice Calculates the liquidation value given a combination of asset values and corresponding liquidation factors.
    51	     * @param valuesAndRiskFactors List of asset values and corresponding liquidation factors.
    52	     * @return liquidationValue The liquidation value of the given assets.
    53	     */
    54	    function _calculateLiquidationValue(AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory valuesAndRiskFactors)
    55	        internal
    56	        pure
    57	        returns (uint256 liquidationValue)
    58	    {
    59	        for (uint256 i; i < valuesAndRiskFactors.length; ++i) {
    60	            liquidationValue += valuesAndRiskFactors[i].assetValue * valuesAndRiskFactors[i].liquidationFactor;
    61	        }
    62	        liquidationValue = liquidationValue / ONE_4;
    63	    }
    64	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/libraries/BitPackingLib.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	/**
     8	 * @title Library for packing sequences of oracles in a single bytes32-object
     9	 * @author Pragma Labs
    10	 */
    11	library BitPackingLib {
    12	    /**
    13	     * @notice Packs sequences of oracles in a single bytes32-object.
    14	     * @param boolValues Array with the direction of the rate for each oracle:
    15	     *  - 0 prices the BaseAsset in units of QuoteAsset.
    16	     *  - 1 prices the QuoteAsset in units of BaseAsset.
    17	     * @param uintValues Array with the unique identifier of each oracle.
    18	     * @return packedData The packed oracle data.
    19	     * @dev Both arrays always have equal length and length is smaller than or equal to 3.
    20	     */
    21	    function pack(bool[] memory boolValues, uint80[] memory uintValues) internal pure returns (bytes32 packedData) {
    22	        assembly {
    23	            // Get the length of the arrays.
    24	            let length := mload(boolValues)
    25	
    26	            // Store the total length in the two right most bits
    27	            // Length is always smaller than or equal to 3.
    28	            packedData := length
    29	
    30	            // Loop to pack the array-elements.
    31	            for { let i := 0 } lt(i, length) { i := add(i, 1) } {
    32	                // Calculate the offset for elements at index i.
    33	                let offset := mul(32, add(i, 1))
    34	
    35	                // Read the value of the boolean at index i.
    36	                let boolValue := mload(add(boolValues, offset))
    37	
    38	                // Read the value of the uint80 at index i.
    39	                let uintValue := mload(add(uintValues, offset))
    40	
    41	                // Shift the boolValue to the left by 2 + i * 80 bits.
    42	                // Then OR the result with packedData.
    43	                packedData := or(packedData, shl(add(mul(i, 81), 2), boolValue))
    44	
    45	                // Shift the uintValue to the left by 3 + i * 80 bits.
    46	                // Then OR the result with packedData.
    47	                packedData := or(packedData, shl(add(mul(i, 81), 3), uintValue))
    48	            }
    49	        }
    50	    }
    51	
    52	    /**
    53	     * @notice Unpacks a sequence of oracles from the bytes32-object.
    54	     * @param packedData The packed oracle data.
    55	     * @return boolValues Array with the direction of the rate for each oracle:
    56	     *  - 0 prices the BaseAsset in units of QuoteAsset.
    57	     *  - 1 prices the QuoteAsset in units of BaseAsset.
    58	     * @return uintValues Array with the unique identifier of each oracle.
    59	     * @dev Both arrays always have equal length and length is smaller than or equal to 3.
    60	     * @dev There are three ways the object can be packed, depending on the value of the rightmost two bits:
    61	     * uint80, bool, uint2 (=01) or
    62	     * uint80, bool uint80, bool, uint2 (=10) or
    63	     * uint80, bool, uint80, bool uint80, bool, uint2 (=11).
    64	     */
    65	    function unpack(bytes32 packedData) internal pure returns (bool[] memory boolValues, uint256[] memory uintValues) {
    66	        assembly {
    67	            // Use bitmask to extract the array length from the rightmost 2 bits.
    68	            // Length is always smaller than or equal to 3.
    69	            let length := and(packedData, 0x3)
    70	
    71	            // Calculate the total memory size of each array.
    72	            // 32 bytes per index of the array + 32 bytes for the array length.
    73	            let memSize := mul(add(length, 1), 32)
    74	
    75	            // Initiate the boolean array at the next free memory slot.
    76	            boolValues := mload(0x40)
    77	
    78	            // Initiate the uint80 array after the boolean array.
    79	            uintValues := add(boolValues, memSize)
    80	
    81	            // Update the free memory pointer to the next free memory slot.
    82	            mstore(0x40, add(uintValues, memSize))
    83	
    84	            // Store the sizes of the arrays at the first slot of each array.
    85	            mstore(boolValues, length)
    86	            mstore(uintValues, length)
    87	
    88	            // Loop to unpack the array-elements.
    89	            for { let i := 0 } lt(i, length) { i := add(i, 1) } {
    90	                // Shift to the right by 2 + i * 81 bits.
    91	                // Then use bitmask to extract the boolean at index i from the rightmost bit.
    92	                let boolValue := and(shr(add(mul(i, 81), 2), packedData), 0x1)
    93	
    94	                // Shift to the right by 3 + i * 81 bits.
    95	                // Then use bitmask to extract the uint80 at index i from the rightmost 80 bits.
    96	                let uintValue := and(shr(add(mul(i, 81), 3), packedData), 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF)
    97	
    98	                // Calculate the offset for elements at index i.
    99	                let offset := mul(32, add(i, 1))
   100	
   101	                // Store the value of the boolean at index i.
   102	                mstore(add(boolValues, offset), boolValue)
   103	
   104	                // Store the value of the boolean at index i.
   105	                mstore(add(uintValues, offset), uintValue)
   106	            }
   107	        }
   108	    }
   109	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/libraries/CreateProxyLib.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	/**
     8	 * @title Library for creating Arcadia Proxy Contracts
     9	 * @author Pragma Labs
    10	 */
    11	library CreateProxyLib {
    12	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    13	                                CONSTANTS
    14	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    15	
    16	    // The bytecode of the Proxy contract.
    17	    bytes internal constant PROXY_BYTECODE =
    18	        hex"";
    19	
    20	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    21	                                ERRORS
    22	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    23	
    24	    error ProxyCreationFailed();
    25	
    26	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    27	                            CREATION LOGIC
    28	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    29	
    30	    /**
    31	     * @notice Creates a new Proxy.
    32	     * @param salt The create2 salt.
    33	     * @param implementation The implementation contract of the Proxy.
    34	     * @return proxy The contract address of the Proxy.
    35	     */
    36	    function createProxy(uint256 salt, address implementation) internal returns (address proxy) {
    37	        bytes memory runtimeBytecode = abi.encodePacked(PROXY_BYTECODE, implementation);
    38	        assembly {
    39	            proxy := create2(0, add(runtimeBytecode, 0x20), mload(runtimeBytecode), salt)
    40	        }
    41	        if (proxy.code.length == 0) revert ProxyCreationFailed();
    42	    }
    43	
    44	    /**
    45	     * @notice Computes the address of a Proxy contract.
    46	     * @param salt The create2 salt.
    47	     * @param implementation The implementation contract of the Proxy.
    48	     * @return proxy The contract address of the Proxy.
    49	     */
    50	    function getProxyAddress(uint256 salt, address implementation) internal view returns (address proxy) {
    51	        bytes memory runtimeBytecode = abi.encodePacked(PROXY_BYTECODE, implementation);
    52	        proxy = address(
    53	            uint160(uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(hex"ff", address(this), salt, keccak256(runtimeBytecode)))))
    54	        );
    55	    }
    56	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/libraries/Strings.sol
```solidity
     1	// SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only
     2	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     3	
     4	// forge-lint: disable-next-item(unsafe-typecast)
     5	library Strings {
     6	    /**
     7	     * @dev Converts a `uint256` to its ASCII `string` decimal representation.
     8	     */
     9	    function toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
    10	        // Inspired by OraclizeAPI's implementation - MIT license
    11	        // https://github.com/oraclize/ethereum-api/blob/b42146b063c7d6ee1358846c198246239e9360e8/oraclizeAPI_0.4.25.sol
    12	
    13	        if (value == 0) {
    14	            return "0";
    15	        }
    16	        uint256 temp = value;
    17	        uint256 digits;
    18	        while (temp != 0) {
    19	            digits++;
    20	            temp /= 10;
    21	        }
    22	        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
    23	        while (value != 0) {
    24	            digits -= 1;
    25	            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(value % 10)));
    26	            value /= 10;
    27	        }
    28	        return string(buffer);
    29	    }
    30	}
```

### accounts-v2/src/oracle-modules/ChainlinkOM.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { OracleModule } from "./abstracts/AbstractOM.sol";
     8	import { IChainLinkData } from "../interfaces/IChainLinkData.sol";
     9	import { IRegistry } from "./interfaces/IRegistry.sol";
    10	
    11	/**
    12	 * @title Chainlink Oracle Module
    13	 * @author Pragma Labs
    14	 * @notice Oracle Module for Chainlink Oracles.
    15	 */
    16	contract ChainlinkOM is OracleModule {
    17	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    18	                                STORAGE
    19	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    20	
    21	    // Map oracle => flag.
    22	    mapping(address => bool) internal inOracleModule;
    23	
    24	    // Map oracle => oracle identifier.
    25	    mapping(address => uint256) public oracleToOracleId;
    26	
    27	    // Map oracle identifier => oracle information.
    28	    mapping(uint256 => OracleInformation) public oracleInformation;
    29	
    30	    struct OracleInformation {
    31	        // The cutoff time after which an oracle is considered stale.
    32	        uint32 cutOffTime;
    33	        // The correction with which the oracle-rate has to be multiplied to get a precision of 18 decimals.
    34	        uint64 unitCorrection;
    35	        // The contract address of the oracle.
    36	        address oracle;
    37	    }
    38	
    39	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    40	                                ERRORS
    41	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    42	
    43	    error Max18Decimals();
    44	
    45	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    46	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    47	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    48	
    49	    /**
    50	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    51	     * @param registry_ The contract address of the Registry.
    52	     */
    53	    constructor(address owner_, address registry_) OracleModule(owner_, registry_) { }
    54	
    55	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    56	                          ORACLE MANAGEMENT
    57	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    58	
    59	    /**
    60	     * @notice Adds a new oracle to this Oracle Module.
    61	     * @param oracle The contract address of the oracle.
    62	     * @param baseAsset Label for the base asset.
    63	     * @param quoteAsset Label for the quote asset.
    64	     * @return oracleId Unique identifier of the oracle.
    65	     */
    66	    function addOracle(address oracle, bytes16 baseAsset, bytes16 quoteAsset, uint32 cutOffTime)
    67	        external
    68	        onlyOwner
    69	        returns (uint256 oracleId)
    70	    {
    71	        if (inOracleModule[oracle]) revert OracleAlreadyAdded();
    72	
    73	        uint256 decimals = IChainLinkData(oracle).decimals();
    74	        if (decimals > 18) revert Max18Decimals();
    75	
    76	        inOracleModule[oracle] = true;
    77	        oracleId = IRegistry(REGISTRY).addOracle();
    78	
    79	        oracleToOracleId[oracle] = oracleId;
    80	        assetPair[oracleId] = AssetPair({ baseAsset: baseAsset, quoteAsset: quoteAsset });
    81	        oracleInformation[oracleId] = OracleInformation({
    82	            cutOffTime: cutOffTime, unitCorrection: uint64(10 ** (18 - decimals)), oracle: oracle
    83	        });
    84	    }
    85	
    86	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    87	                        ORACLE INFORMATION
    88	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    89	
    90	    /**
    91	     * @notice Returns the state of an oracle.
    92	     * @param oracleId The identifier of the oracle to be checked.
    93	     * @return oracleIsActive Boolean indicating if the oracle is active or not.
    94	     */
    95	    function isActive(uint256 oracleId) external view override returns (bool oracleIsActive) {
    96	        (oracleIsActive,) = _getLatestAnswer(oracleInformation[oracleId]);
    97	    }
    98	
    99	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   100	                          PRICING LOGIC
   101	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   102	
   103	    /**
   104	     * @notice Retrieves answer from oracle and does sanity and staleness checks (BaseAsset/QuoteAsset).
   105	     * @param oracleInformation_ Struct will all the necessary information of the oracle.
   106	     * @return success Bool indicating is the oracle is still active and performing as expected.
   107	     * @return answer The latest oracle value.
   108	     * @dev The following checks are done:
   109	     * - A call to the oracle contract does not revert.
   110	     * - The roundId is not zero.
   111	     * - The answer is not negative.
   112	     * - The oracle is not stale (last update was longer than the cutoff time ago).
   113	     * - The oracle update was not done in the future.
   114	     */
   115	    function _getLatestAnswer(OracleInformation memory oracleInformation_)
   116	        internal
   117	        view
   118	        returns (bool success, uint256 answer)
   119	    {
   120	        try IChainLinkData(oracleInformation_.oracle).latestRoundData() returns (
   121	            uint80 roundId, int256 answer_, uint256, uint256 updatedAt, uint80
   122	        ) {
   123	            // forge-lint: disable-next-item(block-timestamp)
   124	            if (
   125	                roundId > 0 && answer_ >= 0 && updatedAt > block.timestamp - oracleInformation_.cutOffTime
   126	                    && updatedAt <= block.timestamp
   127	            ) {
   128	                success = true;
   129	                // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   130	                answer = uint256(answer_);
   131	            }
   132	        } catch { }
   133	    }
   134	
   135	    /**
   136	     * @notice Returns the rate of the BaseAsset in units of QuoteAsset (BaseAsset/QuoteAsset).
   137	     * @param oracleId The identifier of the oracle.
   138	     * @return oracleRate The rate of the BaseAsset in units of QuoteAsset, with 18 decimals precision.
   139	     * @dev The oracle rate expresses how much tokens of the QuoteAsset are required
   140	     * to buy 1 token of the BaseAsset, with 18 decimals precision.
   141	     * Example: If you have an oracle (WBTC/USDC) and assume an exchange rate from Bitcoin to USD of $30 000.
   142	     *  -> You need 30 000 tokens of USDC to buy one token of WBTC.
   143	     *  -> Since we use 18 decimals precision, the oracleRate will be 30 000 * 10**18.
   144	     */
   145	    function getRate(uint256 oracleId) external view override returns (uint256 oracleRate) {
   146	        OracleInformation memory oracleInformation_ = oracleInformation[oracleId];
   147	
   148	        (bool success, uint256 answer) = _getLatestAnswer(oracleInformation_);
   149	
   150	        // If the oracle is not active, the transactions revert.
   151	        // This implies that no new credit can be taken against assets that use the decommissioned oracle,
   152	        // but at the same time positions with these assets cannot be liquidated.
   153	        // A new oracleSequence for these assets must be set ASAP in their Asset Modules by the protocol owner.
   154	        if (!success) revert InactiveOracle();
   155	
   156	        // Only overflows at absurdly large rates, when rate > type(uint256).max / 10 ** (18 - decimals).
   157	        // This is 1.1579209e+59 for an oracle with 0 decimals.
   158	        unchecked {
   159	            oracleRate = answer * oracleInformation_.unitCorrection;
   160	        }
   161	    }
   162	}
```

```solidity
     1	/**
```

```solidity
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.0;
     6	
     7	interface IRegistry {
     8	    /**
     9	     * @notice Adds a new oracle to the Registry.
    10	     * @return oracleId Unique identifier of the oracle.
    11	     */
    12	    function addOracle() external returns (uint256 oracleId);
    13	}
```

```solidity
    20	/**
    21	 * @title Registry for L1s
    22	 * @author Pragma Labs
    23	 * @notice The Registry has a number of responsibilities, all related to the management of Assets and Oracles:
    24	 *  - It stores the mapping between assets and their respective Asset Modules.
    25	 *  - It stores the mapping between oracles and their respective Oracle Modules.
    26	 *  - It orchestrates the pricing of a basket of assets in a single unit of account.
    27	 *  - It orchestrates deposits and withdrawals of an Account per Creditor.
    28	 *  - It manages the risk parameters of all assets per Creditor.
    29	 */
    30	contract RegistryL1 is IRegistry, RegistryGuardian {
    31	    using AssetValuationLib for AssetValueAndRiskFactors[];
    32	    using BitPackingLib for bytes32;
    33	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;

    57	    // Map asset => Asset Information.

    59	    // Map with the risk parameters for each Creditor.

   136	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

   144	    function addAssetModule(address assetModule) external onlyOwner {

   162	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   163	                        ASSET MANAGEMENT

   165	
   166	    /**
   167	     * @notice Checks if an asset is allowed.
   168	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.

   170	     * @return A boolean, indicating if the asset is allowed.
   171	     */
   172	    function isAllowed(address asset, uint256 assetId) external view returns (bool) {
   173	        address assetModule = assetToAssetInformation[asset].assetModule;
   174	
   175	        // For unknown assets, assetModule will equal the zero-address.
   176	        if (assetModule == address(0)) return false;
   177	
   178	        return IAssetModule(assetModule).isAllowed(asset, assetId);
   179	    }

   181	    /**
   182	     * @notice Adds a new asset to the Registry.
   183	     * @param assetType Identifier for the type of the asset.
   184	     * @param assetAddress The contract address of the asset.
   185	     * @dev Assets that are already in the registry cannot be overwritten,
   186	     * as that would make it possible for devs to change the asset pricing.
   187	     */
   188	    function addAsset(uint96 assetType, address assetAddress) external onlyAssetModule {
   189	        if (assetType == 0) revert RegistryErrors.InvalidAssetType();
   190	        if (inRegistry[assetAddress]) revert RegistryErrors.AssetAlreadyInRegistry();
   191	
   192	        inRegistry[assetAddress] = true;
   193	        assetToAssetInformation[assetAddress] = AssetInformation({ assetType: assetType, assetModule: msg.sender });
   194	
   195	        emit AssetAdded(assetAddress, msg.sender);
   196	    }

   198	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   199	                        ORACLE MANAGEMENT
   200	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   201	
   202	    /**
   203	     * @notice Adds a new oracle to the Registry.
   204	     * @return oracleId Unique identifier of the oracle.
   205	     */
   206	    function addOracle() external onlyOracleModule returns (uint256 oracleId) {
   207	        // Get next id.
   208	        oracleId = oracleCounter;
   209	
   210	        unchecked {
   211	            ++oracleCounter;
   212	        }
   213	
   214	        emit OracleAdded(oracleId, oracleToOracleModule[oracleId] = msg.sender);
   215	    }
   216	
   217	    /**
   218	     * @notice Verifies whether a sequence of oracles complies with a predetermined set of criteria.
   219	     * @param oracleSequence The sequence of the oracles to price a certain asset in USD,
   220	     * packed in a single bytes32 object.
   221	     * @return A boolean, indicating if the sequence complies with the set of criteria.
   222	     * @dev The following checks are performed:
   223	     * - The oracle must be previously added to the Registry and must still be active.
   224	     * - The last Asset of oracles (except for the last oracle) must be equal to the first asset of the next oracle.
   225	     * - The last Asset of the last oracle must be USD.
   226	     */
   227	    function checkOracleSequence(bytes32 oracleSequence) external view returns (bool) {
   228	        (bool[] memory baseToQuoteAsset, uint256[] memory oracles) = oracleSequence.unpack();
   229	        uint256 length = oracles.length;
   230	        if (length == 0) revert RegistryErrors.Min1Oracle();
   231	        // Length can be maximally 3, but no need to explicitly check it.
   232	        // BitPackingLib.unpack() can maximally return arrays of length 3.
   233	
   234	        address oracleModule;
   235	        bytes16 baseAsset;
   236	        bytes16 quoteAsset;
   237	        bytes16 lastAsset;
   238	        for (uint256 i; i < length; ++i) {
   239	            oracleModule = oracleToOracleModule[oracles[i]];
   240	
   241	            if (!IOracleModule(oracleModule).isActive(oracles[i])) return false;
   242	            (baseAsset, quoteAsset) = IOracleModule(oracleModule).assetPair(oracles[i]);
   243	
   244	            if (i == 0) {
   245	                lastAsset = baseToQuoteAsset[i] ? quoteAsset : baseAsset;
   246	            } else {
   247	                // Last asset of an oracle must match with the first asset of the next oracle.
   248	                if (baseToQuoteAsset[i]) {
   249	                    if (lastAsset != baseAsset) return false;
   250	                    lastAsset = quoteAsset;
   251	                } else {
   252	                    if (lastAsset != quoteAsset) return false;
   253	                    lastAsset = baseAsset;
   254	                }
   255	            }
   256	            // Last asset in the sequence must end with "USD".
   257	            if (i == length - 1 && lastAsset != "USD") return false;
   258	        }
   259	
   260	        return true;
   261	    }

   264	                    RISK VARIABLES MANAGEMENT

   267	    /**
   268	     * @notice Returns the risk factors per asset for a given Creditor.
   269	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   270	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   271	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   272	     * @return collateralFactors Array of the collateral factors of the assets for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   273	     * @return liquidationFactors Array of the liquidation factors of the assets for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   274	     */
   275	    function getRiskFactors(address creditor, address[] calldata assetAddresses, uint256[] calldata assetIds)
   276	        external
   277	        view
   278	        returns (uint16[] memory collateralFactors, uint16[] memory liquidationFactors)
   279	    {
   280	        uint256 length = assetAddresses.length;
   281	        collateralFactors = new uint16[](length);
   282	        liquidationFactors = new uint16[](length);
   283	        for (uint256 i; i < length; ++i) {
   284	            (collateralFactors[i], liquidationFactors[i]) = IAssetModule(
   285	                    assetToAssetInformation[assetAddresses[i]].assetModule
   286	                ).getRiskFactors(creditor, assetAddresses[i], assetIds[i]);
   287	        }
   288	    }

   290	    /**
   291	     * @notice Sets the risk parameters for a given Creditor.
   292	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   293	     * @param minUsdValue The minimum USD-value of assets that are taken into account for the Creditor,
   294	     * denominated in USD with 18 decimals precision.
   295	     * @param maxRecursiveCalls The maximum number of calls to different asset modules that are required to process
   296	     * the deposit/withdrawal/pricing of a single asset.

   298	     */
   299	    function setRiskParameters(address creditor, uint128 minUsdValue, uint64 maxRecursiveCalls)
   300	        external
   301	        onlyRiskManager(creditor)
   302	    {
   303	        riskParams[creditor] = RiskParameters({ minUsdValue: minUsdValue, maxRecursiveCalls: maxRecursiveCalls });
   304	    }
   305	
   306	    /**
   307	     * @notice Sets the risk parameters for a Primary Asset for a given Creditor.
   308	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   309	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   310	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   311	     * @param maxExposure The maximum exposure of a Creditor to the asset.
   312	     * @param collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   313	     * @param liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   314	     * @dev Any Creditor can set risk parameters for any asset, does not have any influence on risk parameters
   315	     * set by other Creditors.
   316	     */
   317	    function setRiskParametersOfPrimaryAsset(
   318	        address creditor,
   319	        address asset,
   320	        uint256 assetId,
   321	        uint112 maxExposure,
   322	        uint16 collateralFactor,
   323	        uint16 liquidationFactor
   324	    ) external onlyRiskManager(creditor) {

   326	            .setRiskParameters(creditor, asset, assetId, maxExposure, collateralFactor, liquidationFactor);

   331	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   332	     * @param assetModule The contract address of the Derived Asset Module.
   333	     * @param maxUsdExposureProtocol The maximum USD exposure of the protocol for each Creditor,
   334	     * denominated in USD with 18 decimals precision.
   335	     * @param riskFactor The risk factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   336	     */
   337	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function)
   338	    function setRiskParametersOfDerivedAM(
   339	        address creditor,
   340	        address assetModule,
   341	        uint112 maxUsdExposureProtocol,
   342	        uint16 riskFactor

   347	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   348	                    WITHDRAWALS AND DEPOSITS
   349	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   350	
   351	    /**
   352	     * @notice Batch retrieves the asset types.
   353	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   354	     * @return assetTypes Array with the types of the assets.
   355	     * 0 = Unknown asset.
   356	     * 1 = ERC20.
   357	     * 2 = ERC721.
   358	     * 3 = ERC1155.
   359	     * ...
   360	     */
   361	    function batchGetAssetTypes(address[] calldata assetAddresses) external view returns (uint256[] memory assetTypes) {
   362	        uint256 addrLength = assetAddresses.length;
   363	        assetTypes = new uint256[](addrLength);
   364	
   365	        for (uint256 i; i < addrLength; ++i) {
   366	            assetTypes[i] = assetToAssetInformation[assetAddresses[i]].assetType;
   367	
   368	            if (assetTypes[i] == 0) revert RegistryErrors.UnknownAsset();
   369	        }
   370	    }
   371	
   372	    /**
   373	     * @notice Batch deposits multiple assets.
   374	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   375	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   376	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   377	     * @param amounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   378	     * @dev If no Creditor is set, only check that the assets are allowed (= can be priced).
   379	     * @dev If a Creditor is set, processDirectDeposit in the Asset Module checks and updates the exposure for each asset
   380	     * and if applicable, its underlying asset(s).
   381	     */
   382	    function batchProcessDeposit(
   383	        address creditor,
   384	        address[] calldata assetAddresses,
   385	        uint256[] calldata assetIds,
   386	        uint256[] calldata amounts
   387	    ) external whenDepositNotPaused onlyAccount {
   388	        uint256 addrLength = assetAddresses.length;
   389	        if (addrLength != assetIds.length || addrLength != amounts.length) revert RegistryErrors.LengthMismatch();
   390	
   391	        address assetAddress;
   392	        if (creditor == address(0)) {
   393	            for (uint256 i; i < addrLength; ++i) {
   394	                assetAddress = assetAddresses[i];
   395	                // For unknown assets, assetModule will equal the zero-address and call reverts.
   396	                if (!IAssetModule(assetToAssetInformation[assetAddress].assetModule)
   397	                        .isAllowed(assetAddress, assetIds[i])) revert RegistryErrors.AssetNotAllowed();
   398	            }
   399	        } else {
   400	            uint256 recursiveCalls;
   401	            uint256 maxRecursiveCalls = riskParams[creditor].maxRecursiveCalls;
   402	            for (uint256 i; i < addrLength; ++i) {
   403	                assetAddress = assetAddresses[i];
   404	                // For unknown assets, assetModule will equal the zero-address and call reverts.
   405	                recursiveCalls = IAssetModule(assetToAssetInformation[assetAddress].assetModule)
   406	                    .processDirectDeposit(creditor, assetAddress, assetIds[i], amounts[i]);
   407	                if (recursiveCalls > maxRecursiveCalls) revert RegistryErrors.MaxRecursiveCallsReached();
   408	            }
   409	        }
   410	    }
   411	
   412	    /**
   413	     * @notice Batch withdraws multiple assets.
   414	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   415	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   416	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   417	     * @param amounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   418	     * @return assetTypes Array with the types of the assets.
   419	     * 0 = Unknown asset.
   420	     * 1 = ERC20.
   421	     * 2 = ERC721.
   422	     * 3 = ERC1155.
   423	     * ...
   424	     * @dev If a Creditor is set, processDirectWithdrawal in the Asset Module updates the exposure for each asset and underlying asset.
   425	     */
   426	    function batchProcessWithdrawal(
   427	        address creditor,
   428	        address[] calldata assetAddresses,
   429	        uint256[] calldata assetIds,
   430	        uint256[] calldata amounts
   431	    ) external whenWithdrawNotPaused onlyAccount returns (uint256[] memory assetTypes) {
   432	        uint256 addrLength = assetAddresses.length;
   433	        if (addrLength != assetIds.length || addrLength != amounts.length) revert RegistryErrors.LengthMismatch();
   434	
   435	        assetTypes = new uint256[](addrLength);
   436	        address assetAddress;
   437	        if (creditor == address(0)) {
   438	            for (uint256 i; i < addrLength; ++i) {
   439	                assetTypes[i] = assetToAssetInformation[assetAddresses[i]].assetType;
   440	
   441	                if (assetTypes[i] == 0) revert RegistryErrors.UnknownAsset();
   442	            }
   443	        } else {
   444	            for (uint256 i; i < addrLength; ++i) {
   445	                assetAddress = assetAddresses[i];
   446	                // For unknown assets, assetModule will equal the zero-address and call reverts.
   447	                assetTypes[i] = assetToAssetInformation[assetAddress].assetType;
   448	                IAssetModule(assetToAssetInformation[assetAddress].assetModule)
   449	                    .processDirectWithdrawal(creditor, assetAddress, assetIds[i], amounts[i]);
   450	            }
   451	        }
   452	    }
   453	
   454	    /**
   455	     * @notice This function is called by Asset Modules of non-primary assets
   456	     * in order to update the exposure of an underlying asset after a deposit.
   457	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   458	     * @param underlyingAsset The underlying asset.
   459	     * @param underlyingAssetId The underlying asset id.
   460	     * @param exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The amount of exposure of the asset to the underlying asset.
   461	     * @param deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the asset to the underlying asset
   462	     * since the last interaction.
   463	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
   464	     * @return usdExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The USD-value of the exposure of the asset to its underlying asset,
   465	     * 18 decimals precision.
   466	     */
   467	    function getUsdValueExposureToUnderlyingAssetAfterDeposit(
   468	        address creditor,
   469	        address underlyingAsset,
   470	        uint256 underlyingAssetId,
   471	        uint256 exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset,
   472	        int256 deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset
   473	    ) external onlyAssetModule returns (uint256 recursiveCalls, uint256 usdExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset) {
   474	        (recursiveCalls, usdExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset) = IAssetModule(
   475	                assetToAssetInformation[underlyingAsset].assetModule
   476	            )
   477	            .processIndirectDeposit(
   478	                creditor,
   479	                underlyingAsset,
   480	                underlyingAssetId,
   481	                exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset,
   482	                deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset
   483	            );
   484	    }
   485	
   486	    /**
   487	     * @notice This function is called by Asset Modules of non-primary assets
   488	     * in order to update the exposure of an underlying asset after a withdrawal.
   489	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   490	     * @param underlyingAsset The underlying asset.
   491	     * @param underlyingAssetId The underlying asset id.
   492	     * @param exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The amount of exposure of the asset to the underlying asset.
   493	     * @param deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the asset to the underlying asset
   494	     * since the last interaction.
   495	     * @return usdExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The Usd value of the exposure of the asset to its underlying asset,
   496	     * 18 decimals precision.
   497	     */
   498	    function getUsdValueExposureToUnderlyingAssetAfterWithdrawal(
   499	        address creditor,
   500	        address underlyingAsset,
   501	        uint256 underlyingAssetId,
   502	        uint256 exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset,
   503	        int256 deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset
   504	    ) external onlyAssetModule returns (uint256 usdExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset) {
   505	        usdExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset = IAssetModule(assetToAssetInformation[underlyingAsset].assetModule)
   506	            .processIndirectWithdrawal(
   507	                creditor,
   508	                underlyingAsset,
   509	                underlyingAssetId,
   510	                exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset,
   511	                deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset

   513	    }
```
