```solidity
   515	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   516	                          PRICING LOGIC
   517	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   518	
   519	    /**
   520	     * @notice Returns the rate of a certain primary asset in USD.
   521	     * @param oracleSequence The sequence of the oracles to price the asset in USD,
   522	     * packed in a single bytes32 object.
   523	     * @return rate The USD rate of an asset, 18 decimals precision.
   524	     * @dev The oracle rate expresses how much USD (18 decimals precision) is required
   525	     * to buy 1 token of the asset.
   526	     */
   527	    function getRateInUsd(bytes32 oracleSequence) external view returns (uint256 rate) {
   528	        (bool[] memory baseToQuoteAsset, uint256[] memory oracles) = oracleSequence.unpack();
   529	
   530	        rate = 1e18;
   531	
   532	        uint256 length = oracles.length;
   533	        for (uint256 i; i < length; ++i) {
   534	            // Each Oracle has a fixed base asset and quote asset.
   535	            // The oracle-rate expresses how much tokens of the quote asset (18 decimals precision) are required
   536	            // to buy 1 token of the BaseAsset.
   537	            if (baseToQuoteAsset[i]) {
   538	                // "Normal direction" (how much of the QuoteAsset is required to buy 1 token of the BaseAsset).
   539	                // -> Multiply with the oracle-rate.
   540	                rate = rate.mulDivDown(IOracleModule(oracleToOracleModule[oracles[i]]).getRate(oracles[i]), 1e18);
   541	            } else {
   542	                // "Inverse direction" (how much of the BaseAsset is required to buy 1 token of the QuoteAsset).
   543	                // -> Divide by the oracle-rate.
   544	                rate = rate.mulDivDown(1e18, IOracleModule(oracleToOracleModule[oracles[i]]).getRate(oracles[i]));
   545	            }
   546	        }
   547	    }
   548	
   549	    /**
   550	     * @notice Calculates the USD values of underlying assets.
   551	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   552	     * @param assets Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   553	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   554	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   555	     * @return valuesAndRiskFactors The values of the assets, denominated in USD with 18 Decimals precision
   556	     * and the corresponding risk factors for each asset for the given Creditor.
   557	     * @dev The function getValuesInUsdRecursive should only be called by Derived Asset Modules for recursive pricing of assets
   558	     * and should NOT be used by external contracts.
   559	     * This function does not do sanity checks such as checking if the value of the asset exceeds a minimal value to prevent dust attacks.
   560	     */
   561	    function getValuesInUsdRecursive(
   562	        address creditor,
   563	        address[] calldata assets,
   564	        uint256[] calldata assetIds,
   565	        uint256[] calldata assetAmounts
   566	    ) external view returns (AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory valuesAndRiskFactors) {
   567	        uint256 length = assets.length;
   568	        valuesAndRiskFactors = new AssetValueAndRiskFactors[](length);
   569	        for (uint256 i; i < length; ++i) {
   570	            (
   571	                valuesAndRiskFactors[i].assetValue,
   572	                valuesAndRiskFactors[i].collateralFactor,
   573	                valuesAndRiskFactors[i].liquidationFactor
   574	            ) =
   575	                IAssetModule(assetToAssetInformation[assets[i]].assetModule)
   576	                    .getValue(creditor, assets[i], assetIds[i], assetAmounts[i]);
   577	        }
   578	    }
   579	
   580	    /**
   581	     * @notice Calculates the USD-values per asset.
   582	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   583	     * @param assets Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   584	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   585	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   586	     * @return valuesAndRiskFactors The values of the assets, denominated in USD with 18 Decimals precision
   587	     * and the corresponding risk factors for each asset for the given Creditor.
   588	     * @dev getValuesInUsd is a function for internal calculations and should NOT be used by external contracts.
   589	     * The function has a visibility public since it is also called by Derived Asset Modules for recursive pricing of assets.
   590	     */
   591	    function getValuesInUsd(
   592	        address creditor,
   593	        address[] calldata assets,
   594	        uint256[] calldata assetIds,
   595	        uint256[] calldata assetAmounts
   596	    ) public view returns (AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory valuesAndRiskFactors) {
   597	        uint256 length = assets.length;
   598	        valuesAndRiskFactors = new AssetValueAndRiskFactors[](length);
   599	
   600	        uint256 minUsdValue = riskParams[creditor].minUsdValue;
   601	        for (uint256 i; i < length; ++i) {
   602	            (
   603	                valuesAndRiskFactors[i].assetValue,
   604	                valuesAndRiskFactors[i].collateralFactor,
   605	                valuesAndRiskFactors[i].liquidationFactor
   606	            ) =
   607	                IAssetModule(assetToAssetInformation[assets[i]].assetModule)
   608	                    .getValue(creditor, assets[i], assetIds[i], assetAmounts[i]);
   609	            // If asset value is too low, set to zero.
   610	            // This is done to prevent dust attacks which may make liquidations unprofitable.
   611	            if (valuesAndRiskFactors[i].assetValue < minUsdValue) valuesAndRiskFactors[i].assetValue = 0;
   612	        }
   613	    }
   614	
   615	    /**
   616	     * @notice Calculates the values per asset, denominated in a given Numeraire.
   617	     * @param numeraire The contract address of the Numeraire.
   618	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   619	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   620	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   621	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   622	     * @return valuesAndRiskFactors The array of values per assets, denominated in the Numeraire.
   623	     * @dev No need to check equality of length of arrays, since they are generated by the Account.
   624	     * @dev No need to check the Numeraire, since getValue()-call will revert for unknown assets.
   625	     * @dev Only fungible tokens can be used as Numeraire.
   626	     */
   627	    function getValuesInNumeraire(
   628	        address numeraire,
   629	        address creditor,
   630	        address[] calldata assetAddresses,
   631	        uint256[] calldata assetIds,
   632	        uint256[] calldata assetAmounts
   633	    ) external view returns (AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory valuesAndRiskFactors) {
   634	        valuesAndRiskFactors = getValuesInUsd(creditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   635	
   636	        // Convert the USD-values to values in Numeraire if the Numeraire is different from USD (0-address).
   637	        if (numeraire != address(0)) {
   638	            // We use the USD price per 10^18 tokens instead of the price per token to guarantee sufficient precision.
   639	            (uint256 rateNumeraireToUsd,,) =
   640	                IAssetModule(assetToAssetInformation[numeraire].assetModule).getValue(address(0), numeraire, 0, 1e18);
   641	
   642	            uint256 length = assetAddresses.length;
   643	            for (uint256 i; i < length; ++i) {
   644	                // "valuesAndRiskFactors.assetValue" is the USD-value of the asset with 18 decimals precision.
   645	                // "rateNumeraireToUsd" is the USD-value of 10 ** 18 tokens of Numeraire with 18 decimals precision.
   646	                // To get the asset value denominated in the Numeraire, we have to multiply USD-value of "assetValue" with 10**18
   647	                // and divide by "rateNumeraireToUsd".
   648	                valuesAndRiskFactors[i].assetValue =
   649	                    valuesAndRiskFactors[i].assetValue.mulDivDown(1e18, rateNumeraireToUsd);
   650	            }
   651	        }
   652	    }
   653	
   654	    /**
   655	     * @notice Calculates the combined value of a combination of assets, denominated in a given Numeraire.
   656	     * @param numeraire The contract address of the Numeraire.
   657	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   658	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   659	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   660	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   661	     * @return assetValue The combined value of the assets, denominated in the Numeraire.
   662	     * @dev No need to check equality of length of arrays, since they are generated by the Account.
   663	     * @dev No need to check the Numeraire, since getValue()-call will revert for unknown assets.
   664	     * @dev Only fungible tokens can be used as Numeraire.
   665	     */
   666	    function getTotalValue(
   667	        address numeraire,
   668	        address creditor,
   669	        address[] calldata assetAddresses,
   670	        uint256[] calldata assetIds,
   671	        uint256[] calldata assetAmounts
   672	    ) external view returns (uint256 assetValue) {
   673	        AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory valuesAndRiskFactors =
   674	            getValuesInUsd(creditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   675	
   676	        uint256 length = assetAddresses.length;
   677	        for (uint256 i = 0; i < length; ++i) {
   678	            assetValue += valuesAndRiskFactors[i].assetValue;
   679	        }
   680	
   681	        // Convert the USD-value to the value in Numeraire if the Numeraire is different from USD (0-address).
   682	        if (numeraire != address(0)) assetValue = _convertValueInUsdToValueInNumeraire(numeraire, assetValue);
   683	    }
   684	
   685	    /**
   686	     * @notice Calculates the collateral value of a combination of assets, denominated in a given Numeraire.
   687	     * @param numeraire The contract address of the Numeraire.
   688	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   689	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   690	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   691	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   692	     * @return collateralValue The collateral value of the assets, denominated in the Numeraire.
   693	     * @dev No need to check equality of length of arrays, since they are generated by the Account.
   694	     * @dev No need to check the Numeraire, since getValue()-call will revert for unknown assets.
   695	     * @dev Only fungible tokens can be used as Numeraire.
   696	     * @dev The collateral value is equal to the spot value of the assets,
   697	     * discounted by a haircut (the collateral factor).
   698	     */
   699	    function getCollateralValue(
   700	        address numeraire,
   701	        address creditor,
   702	        address[] calldata assetAddresses,
   703	        uint256[] calldata assetIds,
   704	        uint256[] calldata assetAmounts
   705	    ) external view returns (uint256 collateralValue) {
   706	        AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory valuesAndRiskFactors =
   707	            getValuesInUsd(creditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   708	
   709	        // Calculate the "collateralValue" in USD with 18 decimals precision.
   710	        collateralValue = valuesAndRiskFactors._calculateCollateralValue();
   711	
   712	        // Convert the USD-value to the value in Numeraire if the Numeraire is different from USD (0-address).
   713	        if (numeraire != address(0)) {
   714	            collateralValue = _convertValueInUsdToValueInNumeraire(numeraire, collateralValue);
   715	        }
   716	    }
   717	
   718	    /**
   719	     * @notice Calculates the getLiquidationValue of a combination of assets, denominated in a given Numeraire.
   720	     * @param numeraire The contract address of the Numeraire.
   721	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   722	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   723	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   724	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   725	     * @return liquidationValue The liquidation value of the assets, denominated in the Numeraire.
   726	     * @dev No need to check equality of length of arrays, since they are generated by the Account.
   727	     * @dev No need to check the Numeraire, since getValue()-call will revert for unknown assets.
   728	     * @dev Only fungible tokens can be used as Numeraire.
   729	     * @dev The liquidation value is equal to the spot value of the assets,
   730	     * discounted by a haircut (the liquidation factor).
   731	     */
   732	    function getLiquidationValue(
   733	        address numeraire,
   734	        address creditor,
   735	        address[] calldata assetAddresses,
   736	        uint256[] calldata assetIds,
   737	        uint256[] calldata assetAmounts
   738	    ) external view returns (uint256 liquidationValue) {
   739	        AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory valuesAndRiskFactors =
   740	            getValuesInUsd(creditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   741	
   742	        // Calculate the "liquidationValue" in USD with 18 decimals precision.
   743	        liquidationValue = valuesAndRiskFactors._calculateLiquidationValue();
   744	
   745	        // Convert the USD-value to the value in Numeraire if the Numeraire is different from USD (0-address).
   746	        if (numeraire != address(0)) {
   747	            liquidationValue = _convertValueInUsdToValueInNumeraire(numeraire, liquidationValue);
   748	        }
   749	    }
   750	
   751	    /**
   752	     * @notice Converts a value denominated in USD to a value denominated in the Numeraire.
   753	     * @param numeraire The contract address of the Numeraire.
   754	     * @param valueInUsd The value in USD, with 18 decimals precision.
   755	     * @return valueInNumeraire The value denominated in the Numeraire.
   756	     */
   757	    function _convertValueInUsdToValueInNumeraire(address numeraire, uint256 valueInUsd)
   758	        internal
   759	        view
   760	        returns (uint256 valueInNumeraire)
   761	    {
   762	        // We use the USD price per 10^18 tokens instead of the price per token to guarantee sufficient precision.
   763	        (uint256 rateNumeraireToUsd,,) =
   764	            IAssetModule(assetToAssetInformation[numeraire].assetModule).getValue(address(0), numeraire, 0, 1e18);
   765	
   766	        // "valueInUsd" is the USD-value of the assets with 18 decimals precision.
   767	        // "rateNumeraireToUsd" is the USD-value of 10 ** 18 tokens of Numeraire with 18 decimals precision.
   768	        // To get the value of the asset denominated in the Numeraire, we have to multiply USD-value of "valueInUsd" with 10**18
   769	        // and divide by "rateNumeraireToUsd".
   770	        valueInNumeraire = valueInUsd.mulDivDown(1e18, rateNumeraireToUsd);
   771	    }
   772	}
```

```solidity
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;

     7	import { BitPackingLib } from "../libraries/BitPackingLib.sol";
     8	import { FixedPointMathLib } from "../../lib/solmate/src/utils/FixedPointMathLib.sol";
     9	import { IChainLinkData } from "../interfaces/IChainLinkData.sol";
    10	import { IDerivedAM } from "../interfaces/IDerivedAM.sol";
    11	import { IFactory } from "../interfaces/IFactory.sol";
    12	import { IRegistry } from "../interfaces/IRegistry.sol";
    13	import { IOracleModule } from "../interfaces/IOracleModule.sol";
    14	import { IAssetModule } from "../interfaces/IAssetModule.sol";
    15	import { IPrimaryAM } from "../interfaces/IPrimaryAM.sol";
    16	import { ICreditor } from "../interfaces/ICreditor.sol";
    17	import { RegistryGuardian } from "../guardians/RegistryGuardian.sol";
    18	import { AssetValuationLib, AssetValueAndRiskFactors } from "../libraries/AssetValuationLib.sol";

    21	/**
    22	 * @title Registry for L2s
    23	 * @author Pragma Labs
    24	 * @notice The Registry has a number of responsibilities, all related to the management of Assets and Oracles:
    25	 *  - It stores the mapping between assets and their respective Asset Modules.
    26	 *  - It stores the mapping between oracles and their respective Oracle Modules.
    27	 *  - It orchestrates the pricing of a basket of assets in a single unit of account.
    28	 *  - It orchestrates deposits and withdrawals of an Account per Creditor.
    29	 *  - It manages the risk parameters of all assets per Creditor.
    30	 */
    31	contract RegistryL2 is IRegistry, RegistryGuardian {
    32	    using AssetValuationLib for AssetValueAndRiskFactors[];
    33	    using BitPackingLib for bytes32;
    34	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    35	
    36	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    37	                               CONSTANTS
    38	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    39	
    40	    // The contract address of the Arcadia Accounts Factory.
    41	    address public immutable FACTORY;
    42	
    43	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    44	                                STORAGE
    45	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    46	
    47	    // Counter with the number of oracles in the Registry.
    48	    uint256 internal oracleCounter;
    49	
    50	    // The contract address of the sequencer uptime oracle.
    51	    address internal sequencerUptimeOracle;
    52	
    53	    // Map registry => flag.
    54	    mapping(address => bool) public inRegistry;
    55	    // Map assetModule => flag.
    56	    mapping(address => bool) public isAssetModule;
    57	    // Map oracleModule => flag.
    58	    mapping(address => bool) public isOracleModule;
    59	    // Map oracle identifier => oracleModule.
    60	    mapping(uint256 => address) public oracleToOracleModule;
    61	    // Map asset => Asset Information.
    62	    mapping(address => AssetInformation) public assetToAssetInformation;
    63	    // Map with the risk parameters for each Creditor.
    64	    mapping(address creditor => RiskParameters) public riskParams;
    65	
    66	    // Struct with asset specific information.
    67	    struct AssetInformation {
    68	        // Identifier for the type of the asset.
    69	        uint96 assetType;
    70	        // The contract address of the Asset Module of the asset.
    71	        address assetModule;
    72	    }
    73	
    74	    // Struct with the risk parameters for a specific Creditor.
    75	    struct RiskParameters {
    76	        // The minimum USD-value of assets that are taken into account, 18 decimals precision.
    77	        uint128 minUsdValue;
    78	        // The grace period after the sequencer is back up,
    79	        // during which no transactions relying on pricing logic can be executed
    80	        // (increasing open positions, withdrawing collateral and liquidations).
    81	        uint64 gracePeriod;
    82	        // The maximum number of recursive calls while processing an asset.
    83	        uint64 maxRecursiveCalls;
    84	    }
    85	
    86	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    87	                                EVENTS
    88	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    89	
    90	    event AssetAdded(address indexed assetAddress, address indexed assetModule);
    91	    event AssetModuleAdded(address assetModule);
    92	    event OracleAdded(uint256 indexed oracleId, address indexed oracleModule);
    93	    event OracleModuleAdded(address oracleModule);
    94	
    95	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    96	                                MODIFIERS
    97	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    98	
    99	    /**
   100	     * @dev Only Accounts can call functions with this modifier.
   101	     */
   102	    modifier onlyAccount() {
   103	        if (!IFactory(FACTORY).isAccount(msg.sender)) revert RegistryErrors.OnlyAccount();
   104	        _;
   105	    }
   106	
   107	    /**
   108	     * @dev Only Asset Modules can call functions with this modifier.
   109	     */
   110	    modifier onlyAssetModule() {
   111	        if (!isAssetModule[msg.sender]) revert RegistryErrors.OnlyAssetModule();
   112	        _;
   113	    }
   114	
   115	    /**
   116	     * @dev Only Oracle Modules can call functions with this modifier.
   117	     */
   118	    modifier onlyOracleModule() {
   119	        if (!isOracleModule[msg.sender]) revert RegistryErrors.OnlyOracleModule();
   120	        _;
   121	    }
   122	
   123	    /**
   124	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   125	     * @dev Only the Risk Manager of a Creditor can call functions with this modifier.
   126	     */
   127	    modifier onlyRiskManager(address creditor) {
   128	        if (msg.sender != ICreditor(creditor).riskManager()) revert RegistryErrors.Unauthorized();
   129	        _;
   130	    }
   131	
   132	    /**
   133	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   134	     * @dev Throws if the sequencer is down,
   135	     * or the Creditor specific grace period after sequencer is back up did not pass.
   136	     */
   137	    modifier sequencerNotDown(address creditor) {
   138	        (, bool sequencerDown) = _isSequencerDown(creditor);
   139	        if (sequencerDown) revert RegistryErrors.SequencerDown();
   140	        _;
   141	    }
   142	
   143	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   144	                                CONSTRUCTOR
   145	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   146	
   147	    /**
   148	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
   149	     * @param factory The contract address of the Arcadia Accounts Factory.
   150	     * @param sequencerUptimeOracle_ The contract address of the sequencer uptime oracle.
   151	     */
   152	    constructor(address owner_, address factory, address sequencerUptimeOracle_) RegistryGuardian(owner_) {
   153	        FACTORY = factory;
   154	        sequencerUptimeOracle = sequencerUptimeOracle_;
   155	
   156	        // Check that the sequencer uptime oracle is not reverting.
   157	        (bool success,) = _isSequencerDown(address(0));
   158	        if (!success) revert RegistryErrors.OracleReverting();
   159	    }
   160	
   161	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   162	                             L2 LOGIC
   163	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   164	
   165	    /**
   166	     * @notice Checks that the sequencer is not down, and that it is back up for longer than the grace period.
   167	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   168	     * @return success Boolean indicating whether the sequencer uptime oracle is not reverting.
   169	     * @return sequencerDown Boolean indicating whether the sequencer is down, or is still within the grace period.
   170	     * @dev This check guarantees that no stale oracles are consumed when the sequencer is down,
   171	     * and that Account owners have time (the grace period) to bring their Account back in a healthy state.
   172	     * @dev If the sequencer uptime oracle itself is reverting, the sequencer is assumed to be still up.
   173	     */
   174	    function _isSequencerDown(address creditor) internal view returns (bool success, bool sequencerDown) {
   175	        // This guarantees that no stale oracles are consumed when the sequencer is down,
   176	        // and that Account owners have time (the grace period) to bring their Account back in a healthy state.
   177	        try IChainLinkData(sequencerUptimeOracle).latestRoundData() returns (
   178	            uint80, int256 answer, uint256 startedAt, uint256, uint80
   179	        ) {
   180	            success = true;
   181	            // forge-lint: disable-next-line(block-timestamp)
   182	            if (answer == 1 || block.timestamp - startedAt < riskParams[creditor].gracePeriod) {
   183	                sequencerDown = true;
   184	            }
   185	        } catch { }
   186	    }
   187	
   188	    /**
   189	     * @notice Sets a new sequencer uptime oracle in the case the current oracle is reverting.
   190	     * @param sequencerUptimeOracle_ The contract address of the new sequencer uptime oracle.
   191	     */
   192	    function setSequencerUptimeOracle(address sequencerUptimeOracle_) external onlyOwner {
   193	        // Check that the current sequencer uptime oracle is reverting.
   194	        (bool success,) = _isSequencerDown(address(0));
   195	        if (success) revert RegistryErrors.OracleNotReverting();
   196	
   197	        // Set the new sequencer uptime oracle.
   198	        sequencerUptimeOracle = sequencerUptimeOracle_;
   199	
   200	        // Check that the new sequencer uptime oracle is not reverting.
   201	        (success,) = _isSequencerDown(address(0));
   202	        if (!success) revert RegistryErrors.OracleReverting();
   203	    }
   204	
   205	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   206	                        MODULE MANAGEMENT
   207	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   208	
   209	    /**
   210	     * @notice Adds a new Asset Module to the Registry.
   211	     * @param assetModule The contract address of the Asset Module.
   212	     */
   213	    function addAssetModule(address assetModule) external onlyOwner {
   214	        if (isAssetModule[assetModule]) revert RegistryErrors.AssetModNotUnique();
   215	        isAssetModule[assetModule] = true;
   216	
   217	        emit AssetModuleAdded(assetModule);
   218	    }
   219	
   220	    /**
   221	     * @notice Adds a new Oracle Module to the Registry.
   222	     * @param oracleModule The contract address of the Oracle Module.
   223	     */
   224	    function addOracleModule(address oracleModule) external onlyOwner {
   225	        if (isOracleModule[oracleModule]) revert RegistryErrors.OracleModNotUnique();
   226	        isOracleModule[oracleModule] = true;
   227	
   228	        emit OracleModuleAdded(oracleModule);
   229	    }
   230	
   231	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   232	                        ASSET MANAGEMENT
   233	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   234	
   235	    /**
   236	     * @notice Checks if an asset is allowed.
   237	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   238	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   239	     * @return A boolean, indicating if the asset is allowed.
   240	     */
   241	    function isAllowed(address asset, uint256 assetId) external view returns (bool) {
   242	        address assetModule = assetToAssetInformation[asset].assetModule;
   243	
   244	        // For unknown assets, assetModule will equal the zero-address.
   245	        if (assetModule == address(0)) return false;
   246	
   247	        return IAssetModule(assetModule).isAllowed(asset, assetId);
   248	    }
   249	
   250	    /**
   251	     * @notice Adds a new asset to the Registry.
   252	     * @param assetType Identifier for the type of the asset.
   253	     * @param assetAddress The contract address of the asset.
   254	     * @dev Assets that are already in the registry cannot be overwritten,
   255	     * as that would make it possible for devs to change the asset pricing.
   256	     */
   257	    function addAsset(uint96 assetType, address assetAddress) external onlyAssetModule {
   258	        if (assetType == 0) revert RegistryErrors.InvalidAssetType();
   259	        if (inRegistry[assetAddress]) revert RegistryErrors.AssetAlreadyInRegistry();
   260	
   261	        inRegistry[assetAddress] = true;
   262	        assetToAssetInformation[assetAddress] = AssetInformation({ assetType: assetType, assetModule: msg.sender });
   263	
   264	        emit AssetAdded(assetAddress, msg.sender);
   265	    }
   266	
   267	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   268	                        ORACLE MANAGEMENT
   269	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   270	
   271	    /**
   272	     * @notice Adds a new oracle to the Registry.
   273	     * @return oracleId Unique identifier of the oracle.
   274	     */
   275	    function addOracle() external onlyOracleModule returns (uint256 oracleId) {
   276	        // Get next id.
   277	        oracleId = oracleCounter;
   278	
   279	        unchecked {
   280	            ++oracleCounter;
   281	        }
   282	
   283	        emit OracleAdded(oracleId, oracleToOracleModule[oracleId] = msg.sender);
   284	    }
   285	
   286	    /**
   287	     * @notice Verifies whether a sequence of oracles complies with a predetermined set of criteria.
   288	     * @param oracleSequence The sequence of the oracles to price a certain asset in USD,
   289	     * packed in a single bytes32 object.
   290	     * @return A boolean, indicating if the sequence complies with the set of criteria.
   291	     * @dev The following checks are performed:
   292	     * - The oracle must be previously added to the Registry and must still be active.
   293	     * - The last Asset of oracles (except for the last oracle) must be equal to the first asset of the next oracle.
   294	     * - The last Asset of the last oracle must be USD.
   295	     */
   296	    function checkOracleSequence(bytes32 oracleSequence) external view returns (bool) {
   297	        (bool[] memory baseToQuoteAsset, uint256[] memory oracles) = oracleSequence.unpack();
   298	        uint256 length = oracles.length;
   299	        if (length == 0) revert RegistryErrors.Min1Oracle();
   300	        // Length can be maximally 3, but no need to explicitly check it.
   301	        // BitPackingLib.unpack() can maximally return arrays of length 3.
   302	
   303	        address oracleModule;
   304	        bytes16 baseAsset;
   305	        bytes16 quoteAsset;
   306	        bytes16 lastAsset;
   307	        for (uint256 i; i < length; ++i) {
   308	            oracleModule = oracleToOracleModule[oracles[i]];
   309	
   310	            if (!IOracleModule(oracleModule).isActive(oracles[i])) return false;
   311	            (baseAsset, quoteAsset) = IOracleModule(oracleModule).assetPair(oracles[i]);
   312	
   313	            if (i == 0) {
   314	                lastAsset = baseToQuoteAsset[i] ? quoteAsset : baseAsset;
   315	            } else {
   316	                // Last asset of an oracle must match with the first asset of the next oracle.
   317	                if (baseToQuoteAsset[i]) {
   318	                    if (lastAsset != baseAsset) return false;
   319	                    lastAsset = quoteAsset;
   320	                } else {
   321	                    if (lastAsset != quoteAsset) return false;
   322	                    lastAsset = baseAsset;
   323	                }
   324	            }
   325	            // Last asset in the sequence must end with "USD".
   326	            if (i == length - 1 && lastAsset != "USD") return false;
   327	        }
   328	
   329	        return true;
   330	    }

   333	                    RISK VARIABLES MANAGEMENT

   335	
   336	    /**
   337	     * @notice Returns the risk factors per asset for a given Creditor.
   338	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   339	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   340	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   341	     * @return collateralFactors Array of the collateral factors of the assets for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   342	     * @return liquidationFactors Array of the liquidation factors of the assets for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   343	     */
   344	    function getRiskFactors(address creditor, address[] calldata assetAddresses, uint256[] calldata assetIds)
   345	        external
   346	        view
   347	        returns (uint16[] memory collateralFactors, uint16[] memory liquidationFactors)
   348	    {
   349	        uint256 length = assetAddresses.length;
   350	        collateralFactors = new uint16[](length);
   351	        liquidationFactors = new uint16[](length);
   352	        for (uint256 i; i < length; ++i) {
   353	            (collateralFactors[i], liquidationFactors[i]) = IAssetModule(
   354	                    assetToAssetInformation[assetAddresses[i]].assetModule
   355	                ).getRiskFactors(creditor, assetAddresses[i], assetIds[i]);
   356	        }
   357	    }
   358	
   359	    /**
   360	     * @notice Sets the risk parameters for a given Creditor.
   361	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   362	     * @param minUsdValue The minimum USD-value of assets that are taken into account for the Creditor,
   363	     * denominated in USD with 18 decimals precision.
   364	     * @param gracePeriod The grace period after the sequencer is back up,
   365	     * during which no transactions relying on pricing logic can be executed
   366	     * (increasing open positions, withdrawing collateral and liquidations).
   367	     * @param maxRecursiveCalls The maximum number of calls to different asset modules that are required to process
   368	     * the deposit/withdrawal/pricing of a single asset.
   369	     * @dev A minimum USD-value will help to avoid remaining dust amounts in Accounts, which couldn't be liquidated.
   370	     */
   371	    function setRiskParameters(address creditor, uint128 minUsdValue, uint64 gracePeriod, uint64 maxRecursiveCalls)
   372	        external
   373	        onlyRiskManager(creditor)
   374	    {
   375	        riskParams[creditor] = RiskParameters({
   376	            minUsdValue: minUsdValue, gracePeriod: gracePeriod, maxRecursiveCalls: maxRecursiveCalls
   377	        });
   378	    }
   379	
   380	    /**
   381	     * @notice Sets the risk parameters for a Primary Asset for a given Creditor.
   382	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   383	     * @param asset The contract address of the asset.
   384	     * @param assetId The id of the asset.
   385	     * @param maxExposure The maximum exposure of a Creditor to the asset.
   386	     * @param collateralFactor The collateral factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   387	     * @param liquidationFactor The liquidation factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   388	     * @dev Any Creditor can set risk parameters for any asset, does not have any influence on risk parameters
   389	     * set by other Creditors.
   390	     */
   391	    function setRiskParametersOfPrimaryAsset(
   392	        address creditor,
   393	        address asset,
   394	        uint256 assetId,
   395	        uint112 maxExposure,
   396	        uint16 collateralFactor,
   397	        uint16 liquidationFactor
   398	    ) external onlyRiskManager(creditor) {
   399	        IPrimaryAM(assetToAssetInformation[asset].assetModule)
   400	            .setRiskParameters(creditor, asset, assetId, maxExposure, collateralFactor, liquidationFactor);
   401	    }
   402	
   403	    /**
   404	     * @notice Sets the risk parameters for the protocol of the Derived Asset Module for a given Creditor.
   405	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   406	     * @param assetModule The contract address of the Derived Asset Module.
   407	     * @param maxUsdExposureProtocol The maximum USD exposure of the protocol for each Creditor,
   408	     * denominated in USD with 18 decimals precision.
   409	     * @param riskFactor The risk factor of the asset for the Creditor, 4 decimals precision.
   410	     */
   411	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-function)
   412	    function setRiskParametersOfDerivedAM(
   413	        address creditor,
   414	        address assetModule,
   415	        uint112 maxUsdExposureProtocol,
   416	        uint16 riskFactor
   417	    ) external onlyRiskManager(creditor) {
   418	        IDerivedAM(assetModule).setRiskParameters(creditor, maxUsdExposureProtocol, riskFactor);

   421	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   422	                    WITHDRAWALS AND DEPOSITS
   423	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   424	
   425	    /**
   426	     * @notice Batch retrieves the asset types.
   427	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   428	     * @return assetTypes Array with the types of the assets.
   429	     * 0 = Unknown asset.
   430	     * 1 = ERC20.
   431	     * 2 = ERC721.
   432	     * 3 = ERC1155.
   433	     * ...
   434	     */
   435	    function batchGetAssetTypes(address[] calldata assetAddresses) external view returns (uint256[] memory assetTypes) {
   436	        uint256 addrLength = assetAddresses.length;
   437	        assetTypes = new uint256[](addrLength);
   438	
   439	        for (uint256 i; i < addrLength; ++i) {
   440	            assetTypes[i] = assetToAssetInformation[assetAddresses[i]].assetType;
   441	
   442	            if (assetTypes[i] == 0) revert RegistryErrors.UnknownAsset();
   443	        }
   444	    }
   445	
   446	    /**
   447	     * @notice Batch deposits multiple assets.
   448	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   449	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   450	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   451	     * @param amounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   452	     * @dev If no Creditor is set, only check that the assets are allowed (= can be priced).
   453	     * @dev If a Creditor is set, processDirectDeposit in the Asset Module checks and updates the exposure for each asset
   454	     * and if applicable, its underlying asset(s).
   455	     */
   456	    function batchProcessDeposit(
   457	        address creditor,
   458	        address[] calldata assetAddresses,
   459	        uint256[] calldata assetIds,
   460	        uint256[] calldata amounts
   461	    ) external whenDepositNotPaused onlyAccount {
   462	        uint256 addrLength = assetAddresses.length;
   463	        if (addrLength != assetIds.length || addrLength != amounts.length) revert RegistryErrors.LengthMismatch();
   464	
   465	        address assetAddress;
   466	        if (creditor == address(0)) {
   467	            for (uint256 i; i < addrLength; ++i) {
   468	                assetAddress = assetAddresses[i];
   469	                // For unknown assets, assetModule will equal the zero-address and call reverts.
   470	                if (!IAssetModule(assetToAssetInformation[assetAddress].assetModule)
   471	                        .isAllowed(assetAddress, assetIds[i])) revert RegistryErrors.AssetNotAllowed();
   472	            }
   473	        } else {
   474	            uint256 recursiveCalls;
   475	            uint256 maxRecursiveCalls = riskParams[creditor].maxRecursiveCalls;
   476	            for (uint256 i; i < addrLength; ++i) {
   477	                assetAddress = assetAddresses[i];
   478	                // For unknown assets, assetModule will equal the zero-address and call reverts.
   479	                recursiveCalls = IAssetModule(assetToAssetInformation[assetAddress].assetModule)
   480	                    .processDirectDeposit(creditor, assetAddress, assetIds[i], amounts[i]);
   481	                if (recursiveCalls > maxRecursiveCalls) revert RegistryErrors.MaxRecursiveCallsReached();
   482	            }
   483	        }
   484	    }
   485	
   486	    /**
   487	     * @notice Batch withdraws multiple assets.
   488	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   489	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   490	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   491	     * @param amounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   492	     * @return assetTypes Array with the types of the assets.
   493	     * 0 = Unknown asset.
   494	     * 1 = ERC20.
   495	     * 2 = ERC721.
   496	     * 3 = ERC1155.
   497	     * ...
   498	     * @dev If a Creditor is set, processDirectWithdrawal in the Asset Module updates the exposure for each asset and underlying asset.
   499	     */
   500	    function batchProcessWithdrawal(
   501	        address creditor,
   502	        address[] calldata assetAddresses,
   503	        uint256[] calldata assetIds,
   504	        uint256[] calldata amounts
   505	    ) external whenWithdrawNotPaused onlyAccount returns (uint256[] memory assetTypes) {
   506	        uint256 addrLength = assetAddresses.length;
   507	        if (addrLength != assetIds.length || addrLength != amounts.length) revert RegistryErrors.LengthMismatch();
   508	
   509	        assetTypes = new uint256[](addrLength);
   510	        address assetAddress;
   511	        if (creditor == address(0)) {
   512	            for (uint256 i; i < addrLength; ++i) {
   513	                assetTypes[i] = assetToAssetInformation[assetAddresses[i]].assetType;
   514	
   515	                if (assetTypes[i] == 0) revert RegistryErrors.UnknownAsset();
   516	            }
   517	        } else {
   518	            for (uint256 i; i < addrLength; ++i) {
   519	                assetAddress = assetAddresses[i];
   520	                // For unknown assets, assetModule will equal the zero-address and call reverts.
   521	                assetTypes[i] = assetToAssetInformation[assetAddress].assetType;
   522	                IAssetModule(assetToAssetInformation[assetAddress].assetModule)
   523	                    .processDirectWithdrawal(creditor, assetAddress, assetIds[i], amounts[i]);
   524	            }
   525	        }
   526	    }
   527	
   528	    /**
   529	     * @notice This function is called by Asset Modules of non-primary assets
   530	     * in order to update the exposure of an underlying asset after a deposit.
   531	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   532	     * @param underlyingAsset The underlying asset.
   533	     * @param underlyingAssetId The underlying asset id.
   534	     * @param exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The amount of exposure of the asset to the underlying asset.
   535	     * @param deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the asset to the underlying asset
   536	     * since the last interaction.
   537	     * @return recursiveCalls The number of calls done to different asset modules to process the deposit/withdrawal of the asset.
   538	     * @return usdExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The USD-value of the exposure of the asset to its underlying asset,
   539	     * 18 decimals precision.
   540	     */
   541	    function getUsdValueExposureToUnderlyingAssetAfterDeposit(
   542	        address creditor,
   543	        address underlyingAsset,
   544	        uint256 underlyingAssetId,
   545	        uint256 exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset,
   546	        int256 deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset
   547	    ) external onlyAssetModule returns (uint256 recursiveCalls, uint256 usdExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset) {
   548	        (recursiveCalls, usdExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset) = IAssetModule(
   549	                assetToAssetInformation[underlyingAsset].assetModule
   550	            )
   551	            .processIndirectDeposit(
   552	                creditor,
   553	                underlyingAsset,
   554	                underlyingAssetId,
   555	                exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset,
   556	                deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset
   557	            );
   558	    }
   559	
   560	    /**
   561	     * @notice This function is called by Asset Modules of non-primary assets
   562	     * in order to update the exposure of an underlying asset after a withdrawal.
   563	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   564	     * @param underlyingAsset The underlying asset.
   565	     * @param underlyingAssetId The underlying asset id.
   566	     * @param exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The amount of exposure of the asset to the underlying asset.
   567	     * @param deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The increase or decrease in exposure of the asset to the underlying asset
   568	     * since the last interaction.
   569	     * @return usdExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset The Usd value of the exposure of the asset to its underlying asset,
   570	     * 18 decimals precision.
   571	     */
   572	    function getUsdValueExposureToUnderlyingAssetAfterWithdrawal(
   573	        address creditor,
   574	        address underlyingAsset,
   575	        uint256 underlyingAssetId,
   576	        uint256 exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset,
   577	        int256 deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset
   578	    ) external onlyAssetModule returns (uint256 usdExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset) {
   579	        usdExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset = IAssetModule(assetToAssetInformation[underlyingAsset].assetModule)
   580	            .processIndirectWithdrawal(
   581	                creditor,
   582	                underlyingAsset,
   583	                underlyingAssetId,
   584	                exposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset,
   585	                deltaExposureAssetToUnderlyingAsset
   586	            );
   587	    }
   588	
   589	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   590	                          PRICING LOGIC
   591	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   592	
   593	    /**
   594	     * @notice Returns the rate of a certain primary asset in USD.
   595	     * @param oracleSequence The sequence of the oracles to price the asset in USD,
   596	     * packed in a single bytes32 object.
   597	     * @return rate The USD rate of an asset, 18 decimals precision.
   598	     * @dev The oracle rate expresses how much USD (18 decimals precision) is required
   599	     * to buy 1 token of the asset.
   600	     */
   601	    function getRateInUsd(bytes32 oracleSequence) external view returns (uint256 rate) {
   602	        (bool[] memory baseToQuoteAsset, uint256[] memory oracles) = oracleSequence.unpack();
   603	
   604	        rate = 1e18;
   605	
   606	        uint256 length = oracles.length;
   607	        for (uint256 i; i < length; ++i) {
   608	            // Each Oracle has a fixed base asset and quote asset.
   609	            // The oracle-rate expresses how much tokens of the quote asset (18 decimals precision) are required
   610	            // to buy 1 token of the BaseAsset.
   611	            if (baseToQuoteAsset[i]) {
   612	                // "Normal direction" (how much of the QuoteAsset is required to buy 1 token of the BaseAsset).
   613	                // -> Multiply with the oracle-rate.
   614	                rate = rate.mulDivDown(IOracleModule(oracleToOracleModule[oracles[i]]).getRate(oracles[i]), 1e18);
   615	            } else {
   616	                // "Inverse direction" (how much of the BaseAsset is required to buy 1 token of the QuoteAsset).
   617	                // -> Divide by the oracle-rate.
   618	                rate = rate.mulDivDown(1e18, IOracleModule(oracleToOracleModule[oracles[i]]).getRate(oracles[i]));
   619	            }
   620	        }
   621	    }
   622	
   623	    /**
   624	     * @notice Calculates the USD values of underlying assets.
   625	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   626	     * @param assets Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   627	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   628	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   629	     * @return valuesAndRiskFactors The values of the assets, denominated in USD with 18 Decimals precision
   630	     * and the corresponding risk factors for each asset for the given Creditor.
   631	     * @dev The function getValuesInUsdRecursive should only be called by Derived Asset Modules for recursive pricing of assets
   632	     * and should NOT be used by external contracts.
   633	     * This function does not do sanity checks such as:
   634	     *  - Check if the sequencer is down or is back up less than the grace period.
   635	     *  - Check if the value of the asset exceeds a minimal value to prevent dust attacks.
   636	     */
   637	    function getValuesInUsdRecursive(
   638	        address creditor,
   639	        address[] calldata assets,
   640	        uint256[] calldata assetIds,
   641	        uint256[] calldata assetAmounts
   642	    ) external view returns (AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory valuesAndRiskFactors) {
   643	        uint256 length = assets.length;
   644	        valuesAndRiskFactors = new AssetValueAndRiskFactors[](length);
   645	        for (uint256 i; i < length; ++i) {
   646	            (
   647	                valuesAndRiskFactors[i].assetValue,
   648	                valuesAndRiskFactors[i].collateralFactor,
   649	                valuesAndRiskFactors[i].liquidationFactor
   650	            ) =
   651	                IAssetModule(assetToAssetInformation[assets[i]].assetModule)
   652	                    .getValue(creditor, assets[i], assetIds[i], assetAmounts[i]);
   653	        }
   654	    }
   655	
   656	    /**
   657	     * @notice Calculates the USD-values per asset.
   658	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   659	     * @param assets Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   660	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   661	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   662	     * @return valuesAndRiskFactors The values of the assets, denominated in USD with 18 Decimals precision
   663	     * and the corresponding risk factors for each asset for the given Creditor.
   664	     * @dev getValuesInUsd is a function for internal calculations and should NOT be used by external contracts.
   665	     * The function has a visibility public since it is also called by Derived Asset Modules for recursive pricing of assets.
   666	     */
   667	    function getValuesInUsd(
   668	        address creditor,
   669	        address[] calldata assets,
   670	        uint256[] calldata assetIds,
   671	        uint256[] calldata assetAmounts
   672	    ) public view sequencerNotDown(creditor) returns (AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory valuesAndRiskFactors) {
   673	        uint256 length = assets.length;
   674	        valuesAndRiskFactors = new AssetValueAndRiskFactors[](length);
   675	
   676	        uint256 minUsdValue = riskParams[creditor].minUsdValue;
   677	        for (uint256 i; i < length; ++i) {
   678	            (
   679	                valuesAndRiskFactors[i].assetValue,
   680	                valuesAndRiskFactors[i].collateralFactor,
   681	                valuesAndRiskFactors[i].liquidationFactor
   682	            ) =
   683	                IAssetModule(assetToAssetInformation[assets[i]].assetModule)
   684	                    .getValue(creditor, assets[i], assetIds[i], assetAmounts[i]);
   685	            // If asset value is too low, set to zero.
   686	            // This is done to prevent dust attacks which may make liquidations unprofitable.
   687	            if (valuesAndRiskFactors[i].assetValue < minUsdValue) valuesAndRiskFactors[i].assetValue = 0;
   688	        }
   689	    }
   690	
   691	    /**
   692	     * @notice Calculates the values per asset, denominated in a given Numeraire.
   693	     * @param numeraire The contract address of the Numeraire.
   694	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   695	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   696	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   697	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   698	     * @return valuesAndRiskFactors The array of values per assets, denominated in the Numeraire.
   699	     * @dev No need to check equality of length of arrays, since they are generated by the Account.
   700	     * @dev No need to check the Numeraire, since getValue()-call will revert for unknown assets.
   701	     * @dev Only fungible tokens can be used as Numeraire.
   702	     */
   703	    function getValuesInNumeraire(
   704	        address numeraire,
   705	        address creditor,
   706	        address[] calldata assetAddresses,
   707	        uint256[] calldata assetIds,
   708	        uint256[] calldata assetAmounts
   709	    ) external view returns (AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory valuesAndRiskFactors) {
   710	        // getValuesInUsd() checks if the sequencer is down.
   711	        valuesAndRiskFactors = getValuesInUsd(creditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   712	
   713	        // Convert the USD-values to values in Numeraire if the Numeraire is different from USD (0-address).
   714	        if (numeraire != address(0)) {
   715	            // We use the USD price per 10^18 tokens instead of the price per token to guarantee sufficient precision.
   716	            (uint256 rateNumeraireToUsd,,) =
   717	                IAssetModule(assetToAssetInformation[numeraire].assetModule).getValue(address(0), numeraire, 0, 1e18);
   718	
   719	            uint256 length = assetAddresses.length;
   720	            for (uint256 i; i < length; ++i) {
   721	                // "valuesAndRiskFactors.assetValue" is the USD-value of the asset with 18 decimals precision.
   722	                // "rateNumeraireToUsd" is the USD-value of 10 ** 18 tokens of Numeraire with 18 decimals precision.
   723	                // To get the asset value denominated in the Numeraire, we have to multiply USD-value of "assetValue" with 10**18
   724	                // and divide by "rateNumeraireToUsd".
   725	                valuesAndRiskFactors[i].assetValue =
   726	                    valuesAndRiskFactors[i].assetValue.mulDivDown(1e18, rateNumeraireToUsd);
   727	            }
   728	        }
   729	    }
   730	
   731	    /**
   732	     * @notice Calculates the combined value of a combination of assets, denominated in a given Numeraire.
   733	     * @param numeraire The contract address of the Numeraire.
   734	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   735	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   736	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   737	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   738	     * @return assetValue The combined value of the assets, denominated in the Numeraire.
   739	     * @dev No need to check equality of length of arrays, since they are generated by the Account.
   740	     * @dev No need to check the Numeraire, since getValue()-call will revert for unknown assets.
   741	     * @dev Only fungible tokens can be used as Numeraire.
   742	     */
   743	    function getTotalValue(
   744	        address numeraire,
   745	        address creditor,
   746	        address[] calldata assetAddresses,
   747	        uint256[] calldata assetIds,
   748	        uint256[] calldata assetAmounts
   749	    ) external view returns (uint256 assetValue) {
   750	        // getValuesInUsd() checks if the sequencer is down.
   751	        AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory valuesAndRiskFactors =
   752	            getValuesInUsd(creditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   753	
   754	        uint256 length = assetAddresses.length;
   755	        for (uint256 i = 0; i < length; ++i) {
   756	            assetValue += valuesAndRiskFactors[i].assetValue;
   757	        }
   758	
   759	        // Convert the USD-value to the value in Numeraire if the Numeraire is different from USD (0-address).
   760	        if (numeraire != address(0)) assetValue = _convertValueInUsdToValueInNumeraire(numeraire, assetValue);
   761	    }
   762	
   763	    /**
   764	     * @notice Calculates the collateral value of a combination of assets, denominated in a given Numeraire.
   765	     * @param numeraire The contract address of the Numeraire.
   766	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   767	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   768	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   769	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   770	     * @return collateralValue The collateral value of the assets, denominated in the Numeraire.
   771	     * @dev No need to check equality of length of arrays, since they are generated by the Account.
   772	     * @dev No need to check the Numeraire, since getValue()-call will revert for unknown assets.
   773	     * @dev Only fungible tokens can be used as Numeraire.
   774	     * @dev The collateral value is equal to the spot value of the assets,
   775	     * discounted by a haircut (the collateral factor).
   776	     */
   777	    function getCollateralValue(
   778	        address numeraire,
   779	        address creditor,
   780	        address[] calldata assetAddresses,
   781	        uint256[] calldata assetIds,
   782	        uint256[] calldata assetAmounts
   783	    ) external view returns (uint256 collateralValue) {
   784	        // getValuesInUsd() checks if the sequencer is down.
   785	        AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory valuesAndRiskFactors =
   786	            getValuesInUsd(creditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   787	
   788	        // Calculate the "collateralValue" in USD with 18 decimals precision.
   789	        collateralValue = valuesAndRiskFactors._calculateCollateralValue();
   790	
   791	        // Convert the USD-value to the value in Numeraire if the Numeraire is different from USD (0-address).
   792	        if (numeraire != address(0)) {
   793	            collateralValue = _convertValueInUsdToValueInNumeraire(numeraire, collateralValue);
   794	        }
   795	    }
   796	
   797	    /**
   798	     * @notice Calculates the getLiquidationValue of a combination of assets, denominated in a given Numeraire.
   799	     * @param numeraire The contract address of the Numeraire.
   800	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor.
   801	     * @param assetAddresses Array of the contract addresses of the assets.
   802	     * @param assetIds Array of the ids of the assets.
   803	     * @param assetAmounts Array with the amounts of the assets.
   804	     * @return liquidationValue The liquidation value of the assets, denominated in the Numeraire.
   805	     * @dev No need to check equality of length of arrays, since they are generated by the Account.
   806	     * @dev No need to check the Numeraire, since getValue()-call will revert for unknown assets.
   807	     * @dev Only fungible tokens can be used as Numeraire.
   808	     * @dev The liquidation value is equal to the spot value of the assets,
   809	     * discounted by a haircut (the liquidation factor).
   810	     */
   811	    function getLiquidationValue(
   812	        address numeraire,
   813	        address creditor,
   814	        address[] calldata assetAddresses,
   815	        uint256[] calldata assetIds,
   816	        uint256[] calldata assetAmounts
   817	    ) external view returns (uint256 liquidationValue) {
   818	        // getValuesInUsd() checks if the sequencer is down.
   819	        AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory valuesAndRiskFactors =
   820	            getValuesInUsd(creditor, assetAddresses, assetIds, assetAmounts);
   821	
   822	        // Calculate the "liquidationValue" in USD with 18 decimals precision.
   823	        liquidationValue = valuesAndRiskFactors._calculateLiquidationValue();
   824	
   825	        // Convert the USD-value to the value in Numeraire if the Numeraire is different from USD (0-address).
   826	        if (numeraire != address(0)) {
   827	            liquidationValue = _convertValueInUsdToValueInNumeraire(numeraire, liquidationValue);
   828	        }
   829	    }
   830	
   831	    /**
   832	     * @notice Converts a value denominated in USD to a value denominated in the Numeraire.
   833	     * @param numeraire The contract address of the Numeraire.
   834	     * @param valueInUsd The value in USD, with 18 decimals precision.
   835	     * @return valueInNumeraire The value denominated in the Numeraire.
   836	     */
   837	    function _convertValueInUsdToValueInNumeraire(address numeraire, uint256 valueInUsd)
   838	        internal
   839	        view
   840	        returns (uint256 valueInNumeraire)
   841	    {
   842	        // We use the USD price per 10^18 tokens instead of the price per token to guarantee sufficient precision.
   843	        (uint256 rateNumeraireToUsd,,) =
   844	            IAssetModule(assetToAssetInformation[numeraire].assetModule).getValue(address(0), numeraire, 0, 1e18);
   845	
   846	        // "valueInUsd" is the USD-value of the assets with 18 decimals precision.
   847	        // "rateNumeraireToUsd" is the USD-value of 10 ** 18 tokens of Numeraire with 18 decimals precision.
   848	        // To get the value of the asset denominated in the Numeraire, we have to multiply USD-value of "valueInUsd" with 10**18
   849	        // and divide by "rateNumeraireToUsd".
   850	        valueInNumeraire = valueInUsd.mulDivDown(1e18, rateNumeraireToUsd);
   851	    }
   852	}
```

```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { DebtTokenErrors } from "./libraries/Errors.sol";
     8	import { ERC20, ERC4626 } from "../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/tokens/ERC4626.sol";
     9	import { FixedPointMathLib } from "../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/FixedPointMathLib.sol";
    10	
    11	/**
    12	 * @title Debt Token.
    13	 * @author Pragma Labs
    14	 * @notice The Logic to do the debt accounting for a lending pool for a certain ERC20 token.
    15	 * @dev Protocol is according the ERC4626 standard, with a certain ERC20 as underlying.
    16	 * @dev Implementation slightly deviates from the ERC4626 specifications,
    17	 * maxDeposit() and maxMint() are not implemented.
    18	 */
    19	abstract contract DebtToken is ERC4626 {
    20	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    21	
    22	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    23	                                STORAGE
    24	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    25	
    26	    // Total amount of `underlying asset` that debtors have in debt, does not take into account pending interests.
    27	    uint256 internal realisedDebt;
    28	
    29	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    30	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    31	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    32	
    33	    /**
    34	     * @notice The constructor for the debt token.
    35	     * @param asset_ The underlying ERC20 token in which the debt is denominated.
    36	     */
    37	    constructor(ERC20 asset_)
    38	        ERC4626(
    39	            asset_,
    40	            string(abi.encodePacked("ArcadiaV2 ", asset_.name(), " Debt")),
    41	            string(abi.encodePacked("darcV2", asset_.symbol()))
    42	        )
    43	    { }
    44	
    45	    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    46	                            ACCOUNTING LOGIC
    47	    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    48	
    49	    /**
    50	     * @notice Returns the total amount of outstanding debt in the underlying asset.
    51	     * @return totalDebt The total debt in underlying assets.
    52	     * @dev Implementation overwritten in LendingPool.sol which inherits DebtToken.sol.
    53	     * Implementation not vulnerable to ERC4626 inflation attacks,
    54	     * totalAssets() does not rely on balanceOf call.
    55	     */
    56	    function totalAssets() public view virtual override returns (uint256);
    57	
    58	    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    59	                        DEPOSIT/WITHDRAWAL LOGIC
    60	    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
    61	
    62	    /**
    63	     * @notice Modification of the standard ERC4626 deposit implementation.
    64	     * @dev No public deposit allowed.
    65	     */
    66	    function deposit(uint256, address) public pure override returns (uint256) {
    67	        revert DebtTokenErrors.FunctionNotImplemented();
    68	    }
    69	
    70	    /**
    71	     * @notice Modification of the standard ERC4626 deposit implementation.
    72	     * @param assets The amount of assets of the underlying ERC20 token being loaned out.
    73	     * @param receiver The Arcadia Account with collateral covering the debt.
    74	     * @return shares The corresponding amount of debt shares minted.
    75	     * @dev Only the Lending Pool (which inherits this contract) can issue debt.
    76	     */
    77	    function _deposit(uint256 assets, address receiver) internal returns (uint256 shares) {
    78	        // No need to check for rounding error, previewDeposit rounds up.
    79	        shares = previewDeposit(assets);
    80	
    81	        _mint(receiver, shares);
    82	
    83	        realisedDebt += assets;
    84	
    85	        emit Deposit(msg.sender, receiver, assets, shares);
    86	    }
    87	
    88	    /**
    89	     * @notice Modification of the standard ERC4626 deposit implementation.
    90	     * @dev No public mint allowed.
    91	     */
    92	    function mint(uint256, address) public pure override returns (uint256) {
    93	        revert DebtTokenErrors.FunctionNotImplemented();
    94	    }
    95	
    96	    /**
    97	     * @notice Modification of the standard ERC4626 withdraw implementation.
    98	     * @dev No public withdraw allowed.
    99	     */
   100	    function withdraw(uint256, address, address) public pure override returns (uint256) {
   101	        revert DebtTokenErrors.FunctionNotImplemented();
   102	    }
   103	
   104	    /**
   105	     * @notice Modification of the standard ERC4626 withdraw implementation.
   106	     * @param assets The amount of assets of the underlying ERC20 token being paid back.
   107	     * @param receiver Will always be the Lending Pool.
   108	     * @param account The Arcadia Account with collateral covering the debt.
   109	     * @return shares The corresponding amount of debt shares redeemed.
   110	     * @dev Only the Lending Pool (which inherits this contract) can issue debt.
   111	     */
   112	    function _withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address account) internal returns (uint256 shares) {
   113	        // Check for rounding error since we round down in previewWithdraw.
   114	        if ((shares = previewWithdraw(assets)) == 0) revert DebtTokenErrors.ZeroShares();
   115	
   116	        _burn(account, shares);
   117	
   118	        realisedDebt -= assets;
   119	
   120	        emit Withdraw(msg.sender, receiver, account, assets, shares);
   121	    }
   122	
   123	    /**
   124	     * @notice Modification of the standard ERC4626 redeem implementation.
   125	     * @dev No public redeem allowed.
   126	     */
   127	    function redeem(uint256, address, address) public pure override returns (uint256) {
   128	        revert DebtTokenErrors.FunctionNotImplemented();
   129	    }
   130	
   131	    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   132	                            ACCOUNTING LOGIC
   133	    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   134	
   135	    /**
   136	     * @notice Modification of the standard ERC4626 convertToShares implementation.
   137	     * @dev Since debt is a liability instead of an asset, roundUp and roundDown are inverted compared to the standard implementation.
   138	     */
   139	    function convertToShares(uint256 assets) public view override returns (uint256) {
   140	        // Cache totalSupply.
   141	        uint256 supply = totalSupply;
   142	
   143	        return supply == 0 ? assets : assets.mulDivUp(supply, totalAssets());
   144	    }
   145	
   146	    /**
   147	     * @notice Modification of the standard ERC4626 convertToShares implementation.
   148	     * @dev Since debt is a liability instead of an asset, roundUp and roundDown are inverted compared to the standard implementation.
   149	     */
   150	    function convertToAssets(uint256 shares) public view override returns (uint256) {
   151	        // Cache totalSupply.
   152	        uint256 supply = totalSupply;
   153	
   154	        return supply == 0 ? shares : shares.mulDivUp(totalAssets(), supply);
   155	    }
   156	
   157	    /**
   158	     * @notice Modification of the standard ERC4626 previewMint implementation.
   159	     * @dev Since debt is a liability instead of an asset, roundUp and roundDown are inverted compared to the standard implementation.
   160	     */
   161	    function previewMint(uint256 shares) public view override returns (uint256) {
   162	        // Cache totalSupply.
   163	        uint256 supply = totalSupply;
   164	
   165	        return supply == 0 ? shares : shares.mulDivDown(totalAssets(), supply);
   166	    }
   167	
   168	    /**
   169	     * @notice Modification of the standard ERC4626 previewWithdraw implementation.
   170	     * @dev Since debt is a liability instead of an asset, roundUp and roundDown are inverted compared to the standard implementation.
   171	     */
   172	    function previewWithdraw(uint256 assets) public view override returns (uint256) {
   173	        // Cache totalSupply.
   174	        uint256 supply = totalSupply;
   175	
   176	        return supply == 0 ? assets : assets.mulDivDown(supply, totalAssets());
   177	    }
   178	
   179	    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   180	                            TRANSFER LOGIC
   181	    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   182	
   183	    /**
   184	     * @notice Modification of the standard ERC4626 transfer implementation.
   185	     * @dev No public transfer allowed.
   186	     */
   187	    function transfer(address, uint256) public pure override returns (bool) {
   188	        revert DebtTokenErrors.FunctionNotImplemented();
   189	    }
   190	
   191	    /**
   192	     * @notice Modification of the standard ERC4626 transferFrom implementation.
   193	     * @dev No public transferFrom allowed.
   194	     * @dev The functions approve() and permit() will not revert, but since transferFrom() reverts,
   195	     * it can never be used to transfer tokens.
   196	     */
   197	    function transferFrom(address, address, uint256) public pure override returns (bool) {
   198	        revert DebtTokenErrors.FunctionNotImplemented();
   199	    }
   200	}
```
