### lending-v2/src/LendingPool.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { Creditor } from "../lib/accounts-v2/src/abstracts/Creditor.sol";
     8	import { DebtToken, ERC20 } from "./DebtToken.sol";
     9	import { FixedPointMathLib } from "../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/FixedPointMathLib.sol";
    10	import { IAccount } from "./interfaces/IAccount.sol";
    11	import { IFactory } from "./interfaces/IFactory.sol";
    12	import { ILendingPool } from "./interfaces/ILendingPool.sol";
    13	import { ITranche } from "./interfaces/ITranche.sol";
    14	import { LendingPoolErrors } from "./libraries/Errors.sol";
    15	import { LendingPoolGuardian } from "./guardians/LendingPoolGuardian.sol";
    16	import { LogExpMath } from "./libraries/LogExpMath.sol";
    17	import { SafeCastLib } from "../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/SafeCastLib.sol";
    18	import { SafeTransferLib } from "../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/SafeTransferLib.sol";
    19	
    20	/**
    21	 * @title Arcadia LendingPool.
    22	 * @author Pragma Labs
    23	 * @notice The Lending pool is responsible for the:
    24	 * - Accounting of the liabilities of borrowers via the debtTokens (ERC4626).
    25	 * - Accounting of the liquidity of the Liquidity Providers, via one or more Tranche(s) (ERC4626).
    26	 * - Management of issuing and repaying debt.
    27	 * - Management of interest payments.
    28	 * - Settlement of liquidations and default events.
    29	 */
    30	contract LendingPool is LendingPoolGuardian, Creditor, DebtToken, ILendingPool {
    31	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    32	    using SafeTransferLib for ERC20;
    33	
    34	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    35	                                CONSTANTS
    36	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    37	
    38	    // Seconds per year, leap years ignored.
    39	    uint256 internal constant YEARLY_SECONDS = 31_536_000;
    40	    // Contract address of the Arcadia Account Factory.
    41	    address internal immutable ACCOUNT_FACTORY;
    42	    // Contract address of the Liquidator contract.
    43	    address internal immutable LIQUIDATOR;
    44	    // The unit for fixed point numbers with 4 decimals precision.
    45	    uint256 internal constant ONE_4 = 10_000;
    46	    // Maximum total liquidation penalty, 4 decimal precision.
    47	    uint256 internal constant MAX_TOTAL_PENALTY = 1100;
    48	
    49	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    50	                                STORAGE
    51	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    52	
    53	    // The current interest rate, 18 decimals precision.
    54	    uint80 public interestRate;
    55	    // The interest rate when utilisation is 0.
    56	    // 18 decimals precision.
    57	    uint72 internal baseRatePerYear;
    58	    // The slope of the first curve, defined as the delta in interest rate for a delta in utilisation of 100%.
    59	    // 18 decimals precision.
    60	    uint72 internal lowSlopePerYear;
    61	    // The slope of the second curve, defined as the delta in interest rate for a delta in utilisation of 100%.
    62	    // 18 decimals precision.
    63	    uint72 internal highSlopePerYear;
    64	    // The optimal capital utilisation, where we go from the first curve to the steeper second curve.
    65	    // 4 decimal precision.
    66	    uint16 internal utilisationThreshold;
    67	    // Last timestamp that interests were realized.
    68	    uint32 internal lastSyncedTimestamp;
    69	    // Fee issued upon taking debt, 4 decimals precision (10 equals 0.001 or 0.1%), capped at 255 (2.55%).
    70	    uint8 public originationFee;
    71	    // Sum of all the interest weights of the tranches + treasury.
    72	    uint24 internal totalInterestWeight;
    73	    // Fraction (interestWeightTreasury / totalInterestWeight) of the interest fees that go to the treasury.
    74	    uint16 internal interestWeightTreasury;
    75	    // Fraction (liquidationWeightTreasury / totalLiquidationWeight) of the liquidation fees that goes to the treasury.
    76	    uint16 internal liquidationWeightTreasury;
    77	    // Fraction (liquidationWeightTranche / totalLiquidationWeight) of the liquidation fees that goes to the most Junior Tranche.
    78	    uint16 internal liquidationWeightTranche;
    79	
    80	    // Total amount of `underlying asset` that is claimable by the LPs. Does not take into account pending interests.
    81	    uint128 internal totalRealisedLiquidity;
    82	    // The minimum amount of collateral that must be held in an Account before a position can be opened.
    83	    uint96 internal minimumMargin;
    84	
    85	    // Address of the protocol treasury.
    86	    address internal treasury;
    87	    // Number of auctions that are currently in progress.
    88	    uint16 internal auctionsInProgress;
    89	    // Maximum amount of `underlying asset` that is paid as fee to the initiator/terminator of a liquidation.
    90	    uint80 internal maxReward;
    91	    // Minimum initiation and termination reward, relative to the minimumMargin, 4 decimal precision.
    92	    uint16 internal minRewardWeight;
    93	    // Fee paid to the Liquidation Initiator.
    94	    // Defined as a fraction of the openDebt with 4 decimals precision.
    95	    // Absolute fee can be further capped to a max amount by the creditor.
    96	    uint16 internal initiationWeight;
    97	    // Penalty the Account owner has to pay to the Creditor on top of the open Debt for being liquidated.
    98	    // Defined as a fraction of the openDebt with 4 decimals precision.
    99	    uint16 internal penaltyWeight;
   100	    // Fee paid to the address that is ending an auction.
   101	    // Defined as a fraction of the openDebt with 4 decimals precision.
   102	    uint16 internal terminationWeight;
   103	
   104	    // Array of the interest weights of each Tranche.
   105	    // Fraction (interestWeightTranches[i] / totalInterestWeight) of the interest fees that go to Tranche i.
   106	    uint16[] internal interestWeightTranches;
   107	    // Array of the contract addresses of the Tranches.
   108	    address[] internal tranches;
   109	
   110	    // Map tranche => status.
   111	    mapping(address => bool) internal isTranche;
   112	    // Map tranche => interestWeight.
   113	    // Fraction (interestWeightTranches[i] / totalInterestWeight) of the interest fees that go to Tranche i.
   114	    mapping(address => uint256) internal interestWeight;
   115	    // Map tranche => realisedLiquidity.
   116	    // Amount of `underlying asset` that is claimable by the liquidity providers.
   117	    // Does not take into account pending interests.
   118	    mapping(address => uint256) internal realisedLiquidityOf;
   119	    // Map Account => owner => beneficiary => amount.
   120	    // Stores the credit allowances for a beneficiary per Account and per Owner.
   121	    mapping(address => mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256))) public creditAllowance;
   122	
   123	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   124	                                EVENTS
   125	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   126	
   127	    event AuctionStarted(address indexed account, address indexed creditor, uint128 openDebt);
   128	    event AuctionFinished(
   129	        address indexed account,
   130	        address indexed creditor,
   131	        uint256 startDebt,
   132	        uint256 initiationReward,
   133	        uint256 terminationReward,
   134	        uint256 penalty,
   135	        uint256 badDebt,
   136	        uint256 surplus
   137	    );
   138	    event Borrow(
   139	        address indexed account, address indexed by, address to, uint256 amount, uint256 fee, bytes3 indexed referrer
   140	    );
   141	    event CreditApproval(address indexed account, address indexed owner, address indexed beneficiary, uint256 amount);
   142	    event InterestSynced(uint256 interest);
   143	    event InterestWeightTrancheUpdated(address indexed tranche, uint8 indexed trancheIndex, uint16 interestWeight);
   144	    event LiquidationWeightTrancheUpdated(uint16 liquidationWeight);
   145	    event PoolStateUpdated(uint256 totalDebt, uint256 totalLiquidity, uint80 interestRate);
   146	    event Repay(address indexed account, address indexed from, uint256 amount);
   147	    event TranchePopped(address tranche);
   148	    event TreasuryWeightsUpdated(uint16 interestWeight, uint16 liquidationWeight);
   149	
   150	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   151	                                MODIFIERS
   152	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   153	
   154	    /**
   155	     * @notice Checks if caller is the Liquidator.
   156	     */
   157	    modifier onlyLiquidator() {
   158	        if (LIQUIDATOR != msg.sender) revert LendingPoolErrors.Unauthorized();
   159	        _;
   160	    }
   161	
   162	    /**
   163	     * @notice Checks if caller is a Tranche.
   164	     */
   165	    modifier onlyTranche() {
   166	        if (!isTranche[msg.sender]) revert LendingPoolErrors.Unauthorized();
   167	        _;
   168	    }
   169	
   170	    /**
   171	     * @notice Syncs interest to LPs and treasury and updates the interest rate.
   172	     */
   173	    modifier processInterests() {
   174	        _syncInterests();
   175	        _;
   176	        // _updateInterestRate() modifies the state (effect), but can safely be called after interactions.
   177	        // Cannot be exploited by reentrancy attack.
   178	        _updateInterestRate(realisedDebt, totalRealisedLiquidity);
   179	    }
   180	
   181	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   182	                                CONSTRUCTOR
   183	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   184	
   185	    /**
   186	     * @notice The constructor for a lending pool.
   187	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
   188	     * @param riskManager_ The address of the new Risk Manager.
   189	     * @param asset_ The underlying ERC20 token of the Lending Pool.
   190	     * @param treasury_ The address of the protocol treasury.
   191	     * @param accountFactory The contract address of the Arcadia Account Factory.
   192	     * @param liquidator The contract address of the Liquidator.
   193	     * @dev The name and symbol of the DebtToken are automatically generated, based on the name and symbol of the underlying token.
   194	     */
   195	    constructor(
   196	        address owner_,
   197	        address riskManager_,
   198	        ERC20 asset_,
   199	        address treasury_,
   200	        address accountFactory,
   201	        address liquidator
   202	    ) LendingPoolGuardian(owner_) Creditor(riskManager_) DebtToken(asset_) {
   203	        treasury = treasury_;
   204	        ACCOUNT_FACTORY = accountFactory;
   205	        LIQUIDATOR = liquidator;
   206	    }
   207	
   208	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   209	                            TRANCHES LOGIC
   210	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   211	
   212	    /**
   213	     * @notice Adds a tranche to the Lending Pool.
   214	     * @param tranche The address of the Tranche.
   215	     * @param interestWeight_ The interest weight of the specific Tranche.
   216	     * @dev The order of the tranches is important, the most senior tranche is added first at index 0, the most junior at the last index.
   217	     * @dev Each Tranche is an ERC4626 contract.
   218	     * @dev The interest weight of each Tranche determines the relative share of the yield (interest payments) that goes to its Liquidity providers.
   219	     */
   220	    function addTranche(address tranche, uint16 interestWeight_) external onlyOwner processInterests {
   221	        if (auctionsInProgress > 0) revert LendingPoolErrors.AuctionOngoing();
   222	        if (isTranche[tranche]) revert LendingPoolErrors.TrancheAlreadyExists();
   223	        if (tranche == treasury) revert LendingPoolErrors.InvalidTreasury();
   224	
   225	        totalInterestWeight += interestWeight_;
   226	        interestWeightTranches.push(interestWeight_);
   227	        interestWeight[tranche] = interestWeight_;
   228	
   229	        uint8 trancheIndex = uint8(tranches.length);
   230	        tranches.push(tranche);
   231	        isTranche[tranche] = true;
   232	
   233	        emit InterestWeightTrancheUpdated(tranche, trancheIndex, interestWeight_);
   234	    }
   235	
   236	    /**
   237	     * @notice Changes the interest weight of a specific Tranche.
   238	     * @param index The index of the Tranche for which a new interest weight is being set.
   239	     * @param interestWeight_ The new interest weight of the Tranche at the index.
   240	     * @dev The interest weight of each Tranche determines the relative share of yield (interest payments) that goes to its Liquidity providers.
   241	     */
   242	    function setInterestWeightTranche(uint256 index, uint16 interestWeight_) external onlyOwner processInterests {
   243	        if (index >= tranches.length) revert LendingPoolErrors.NonExistingTranche();
   244	        totalInterestWeight = totalInterestWeight - interestWeightTranches[index] + interestWeight_;
   245	        interestWeightTranches[index] = interestWeight_;
   246	        address tranche = tranches[index];
   247	        interestWeight[tranche] = interestWeight_;
   248	
   249	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   250	        emit InterestWeightTrancheUpdated(tranche, uint8(index), interestWeight_);
   251	    }
   252	
   253	    /**
   254	     * @notice Changes the liquidation weight of the most Junior Tranche.
   255	     * @param liquidationWeight The new liquidation weight of the Tranche at the highest index.
   256	     * @dev The liquidation weight determines the relative share of liquidation fees that goes to the most Junior Tranche.
   257	     */
   258	    function setLiquidationWeightTranche(uint16 liquidationWeight) external onlyOwner {
   259	        emit LiquidationWeightTrancheUpdated(liquidationWeightTranche = liquidationWeight);
   260	    }
   261	
   262	    /**
   263	     * @notice Removes the Tranche at the last index (most junior).
   264	     * @param index The index of the last Tranche.
   265	     * @param tranche The address of the last Tranche.
   266	     * @dev This function can only be called by the function _processDefault(uint256 assets),
   267	     * when there is a default as big as (or bigger than) the complete amount of liquidity of the most junior Tranche.
   268	     * @dev Passing the input parameters to the function saves gas compared to reading the address and index of the last Tranche from storage.
   269	     * No need to check if index and Tranche are indeed of the last tranche since function is only called by _processDefault.
   270	     */
   271	    function _popTranche(uint256 index, address tranche) internal {
   272	        unchecked {
   273	            totalInterestWeight -= interestWeightTranches[index];
   274	        }
   275	        isTranche[tranche] = false;
   276	        interestWeightTranches.pop();
   277	        tranches.pop();
   278	        interestWeight[tranche] = 0;
   279	
   280	        emit TranchePopped(tranche);
   281	    }

   283	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   284	                    TREASURY FEE CONFIGURATION
   285	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   286	
   287	    /**
   288	     * @notice Changes the interest and liquidation weight of the Treasury.
   289	     * @param interestWeight_ The new interestWeight of the treasury.
   290	     * @param liquidationWeight The new liquidationWeight of the treasury.
   291	     * @dev The interestWeight determines the relative share of the yield (interest payments) that goes to the protocol treasury.
   292	     * @dev Setting interestWeightTreasury to a very high value will cause the treasury to collect all interest fees from that moment on.
   293	     * Although this will affect the future profits of liquidity providers, no funds nor realized interest are at risk for LPs.
   294	     */
   295	    function setTreasuryWeights(uint16 interestWeight_, uint16 liquidationWeight) external onlyOwner processInterests {
   296	        totalInterestWeight = totalInterestWeight - interestWeightTreasury + interestWeight_;
   297	        interestWeight[treasury] = interestWeight_;
   298	
   299	        emit TreasuryWeightsUpdated(
   300	            interestWeightTreasury = interestWeight_, liquidationWeightTreasury = liquidationWeight
   301	        );
   302	    }
   303	
   304	    /**
   305	     * @notice Sets new treasury address.
   306	     * @param treasury_ The new address of the treasury.
   307	     */
   308	    function setTreasury(address treasury_) external onlyOwner processInterests {
   309	        if (isTranche[treasury_]) revert LendingPoolErrors.InvalidTreasury();
   310	
   311	        // Set interestWeight to the new treasury.
   312	        interestWeight[treasury_] = interestWeight[treasury];
   313	        interestWeight[treasury] = 0;
   314	
   315	        treasury = treasury_;
   316	    }

   318	    /**
   319	     * @notice Sets the new origination fee.
   320	     * @param originationFee_ The new origination fee.
   321	     * @dev originationFee is limited by being a uint8 -> max value is 2.55%
   322	     * 4 decimal precision (10 = 0.1%).
   323	     */
   324	    function setOriginationFee(uint8 originationFee_) external onlyOwner {
   325	        originationFee = originationFee_;
   326	    }

   328	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   329	                        DEPOSIT/WITHDRAWAL LOGIC
   330	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   331	
   332	    /**
   333	     * @notice Deposit assets in the Lending Pool.
   334	     * @param assets The amount of assets of the underlying ERC20 tokens being deposited.
   335	     * @param from The address of the Liquidity Provider who deposits the underlying ERC20 token via a Tranche.
   336	     * @dev This function can only be called by Tranches.
   337	     */
   338	    function depositInLendingPool(uint256 assets, address from)
   339	        external
   340	        whenDepositNotPaused
   341	        onlyTranche
   342	        processInterests
   343	    {
   344	        // Need to transfer before minting or ERC777s could reenter.
   345	        // Address(this) is trusted -> no risk on reentrancy attack after transfer.
   346	        asset.safeTransferFrom(from, address(this), assets);
   347	
   348	        unchecked {
   349	            realisedLiquidityOf[msg.sender] += assets;
   350	            totalRealisedLiquidity = SafeCastLib.safeCastTo128(assets + totalRealisedLiquidity);
   351	        }
   352	    }
   353	
   354	    /**
   355	     * @notice Donate assets to the Lending Pool.
   356	     * @param trancheIndex The index of the tranche to donate to.
   357	     * @param assets The amount of assets of the underlying ERC20 tokens being deposited.
   358	     * @dev Can be used by anyone to donate assets to the Lending Pool.
   359	     * It is supposed to serve as a way to compensate the jrTranche after an
   360	     * auction didn't get sold and was manually liquidated after cutoffTime.
   361	     * @dev Inflation attacks by the first depositor in the Tranches have to be prevented with virtual assets/shares.
   362	     */
   363	    function donateToTranche(uint256 trancheIndex, uint256 assets) external whenDepositNotPaused processInterests {
   364	        if (assets == 0) revert LendingPoolErrors.ZeroAmount();
   365	
   366	        address tranche = tranches[trancheIndex];
   367	
   368	        // Need to transfer before donating or ERC777s could reenter.
   369	        // Address(this) is trusted -> no risk on reentrancy attack after transfer.
   370	        asset.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), assets);
   371	
   372	        unchecked {
   373	            realisedLiquidityOf[tranche] += assets; //[̲̅$̲̅(̲̅ ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°̲̅)̲̅$̲̅]
   374	            totalRealisedLiquidity = SafeCastLib.safeCastTo128(assets + totalRealisedLiquidity);
   375	        }
   376	    }
   377	
   378	    /**
   379	     * @notice Withdraw assets from the Lending Pool.
   380	     * @param assets The amount of assets of the underlying ERC20 tokens being withdrawn.
   381	     * @param receiver The address of the receiver of the underlying ERC20 tokens.
   382	     * @dev This function can be called by anyone with an open balance (realisedLiquidityOf[address] bigger than 0),
   383	     * which can be both Tranches as other address (treasury, Liquidation Initiators, Liquidated Account Owner...).
   384	     */
   385	    function withdrawFromLendingPool(uint256 assets, address receiver) external whenWithdrawNotPaused processInterests {
   386	        if (realisedLiquidityOf[msg.sender] < assets) revert LendingPoolErrors.AmountExceedsBalance();
   387	
   388	        unchecked {
   389	            realisedLiquidityOf[msg.sender] -= assets;
   390	            totalRealisedLiquidity = SafeCastLib.safeCastTo128(totalRealisedLiquidity - assets);
   391	        }
   392	
   393	        asset.safeTransfer(receiver, assets);
   394	    }

   396	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   397	                            LENDING LOGIC
   398	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   399	
   400	    /**
   401	     * @notice Approve a beneficiary to take out debt against an Arcadia Account.
   402	     * @param beneficiary The address of the beneficiary who can take out debt backed by an Arcadia Account.
   403	     * @param amount The amount of underlying ERC20 tokens to be lent out.
   404	     * @param account The address of the Arcadia Account backing the debt.
   405	     */
   406	    function approveBeneficiary(address beneficiary, uint256 amount, address account) external {
   407	        // If Account is not an actual address of an Arcadia Account, ownerOfAccount(address) will return the zero address.
   408	        if (IFactory(ACCOUNT_FACTORY).ownerOfAccount(account) != msg.sender) revert LendingPoolErrors.Unauthorized();
   409	
   410	        creditAllowance[account][msg.sender][beneficiary] = amount;
   411	
   412	        emit CreditApproval(account, msg.sender, beneficiary, amount);
   413	    }
   414	
   415	    /**
   416	     * @notice Takes out debt backed by collateral in an Arcadia Account.
   417	     * @param amount The amount of underlying ERC20 tokens to be lent out.
   418	     * @param account The address of the Arcadia Account backing the debt.
   419	     * @param to The address who receives the lent out underlying tokens.
   420	     * @param referrer A unique identifier of the referrer, who will receive part of the fees generated by this transaction.
   421	     * @dev The sender might be different than the owner if they have the proper allowances.
   422	     */
   423	    function borrow(uint256 amount, address account, address to, bytes3 referrer)
   424	        external
   425	        whenBorrowNotPaused
   426	        processInterests
   427	    {
   428	        if (amount == 0) revert LendingPoolErrors.ZeroAmount();
   429	
   430	        // If Account is not an actual address of an Account, ownerOfAccount(address) will return the zero address.
   431	        address accountOwner = IFactory(ACCOUNT_FACTORY).ownerOfAccount(account);
   432	        if (accountOwner == address(0)) revert LendingPoolErrors.IsNotAnAccount();
   433	
   434	        uint256 amountWithFee = amount + amount.mulDivUp(originationFee, ONE_4);
   435	
   436	        // Check allowances to take debt.
   437	        if (accountOwner != msg.sender) {
   438	            uint256 allowed = creditAllowance[account][accountOwner][msg.sender];
   439	            if (allowed != type(uint256).max) {
   440	                creditAllowance[account][accountOwner][msg.sender] = allowed - amountWithFee;
   441	            }
   442	        }
   443	
   444	        // Mint debt tokens to the Account.
   445	        _deposit(amountWithFee, account);
   446	
   447	        // Add origination fee to the treasury.
   448	        unchecked {
   449	            if (amountWithFee - amount > 0) {
   450	                totalRealisedLiquidity = SafeCastLib.safeCastTo128(amountWithFee + totalRealisedLiquidity - amount);
   451	                realisedLiquidityOf[treasury] += amountWithFee - amount;
   452	            }
   453	        }
   454	
   455	        // UpdateOpenPosition checks that the Account indeed has opened a margin account for this Lending Pool and
   456	        // checks that it is still healthy after the debt is increased with amountWithFee.
   457	        // Reverts in Account if one of the checks fails.
   458	        uint256 accountVersion = IAccount(account).increaseOpenPosition(maxWithdraw(account));
   459	        if (!isValidVersion[accountVersion]) revert LendingPoolErrors.InvalidVersion();
   460	
   461	        // Transfer fails if there is insufficient liquidity in the pool.
   462	        asset.safeTransfer(to, amount);
   463	
   464	        unchecked {
   465	            emit Borrow(account, msg.sender, to, amount, amountWithFee - amount, referrer);
   466	        }
   467	    }
   468	
   469	    /**
   470	     * @notice Repays debt.
   471	     * @param amount The amount of underlying ERC20 tokens to be repaid.
   472	     * @param account The contract address of the Arcadia Account backing the debt.
   473	     * @dev if Account is not an actual address of an Arcadia Account, maxWithdraw(account) will always return 0.
   474	     * Function will not revert, but amount is always 0.
   475	     * @dev Anyone (EOAs and contracts) can repay debt in the name of an Account.
   476	     */
   477	    function repay(uint256 amount, address account) external whenRepayNotPaused processInterests {
   478	        uint256 accountDebt = maxWithdraw(account);
   479	        amount = accountDebt > amount ? amount : accountDebt;
   480	
   481	        // Need to transfer before burning debt or ERC777s could reenter.
   482	        // Address(this) is trusted -> no risk on reentrancy attack after transfer.
   483	        asset.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);
   484	
   485	        _withdraw(amount, address(this), account);
   486	
   487	        emit Repay(account, msg.sender, amount);
   488	    }
   489	
   490	    /**
   491	     * @notice Repays debt via an auction.
   492	     * @param startDebt The amount of debt of the Account the moment the liquidation was initiated.
   493	     * @param minimumMargin_ The minimum margin of the Account.
   494	     * @param amount The amount repaid by a bidder during the auction.
   495	     * @param account The contract address of the Arcadia Account backing the debt.
   496	     * @param bidder The address of the bidder.
   497	     * @return earlyTerminate Bool indicating whether the full amount of debt was repaid.
   498	     * @dev This function allows a liquidator to repay a specified amount of debt for a user.
   499	     */
   500	    function auctionRepay(uint256 startDebt, uint256 minimumMargin_, uint256 amount, address account, address bidder)
   501	        external
   502	        whenLiquidationNotPaused
   503	        onlyLiquidator
   504	        processInterests
   505	        returns (bool earlyTerminate)
   506	    {
   507	        // Need to transfer before burning debt or ERC777s could reenter.
   508	        // Address(this) is trusted -> no risk on reentrancy attack after transfer.
   509	        asset.safeTransferFrom(bidder, address(this), amount);
   510	
   511	        uint256 accountDebt = maxWithdraw(account);
   512	        if (accountDebt == 0) revert LendingPoolErrors.IsNotAnAccountWithDebt();
   513	        if (accountDebt <= amount) {
   514	            // The amount recovered by selling assets during the auction is bigger than the total debt of the Account.
   515	            // -> Terminate the auction and make the surplus available to the Account-Owner.
   516	            earlyTerminate = true;
   517	            unchecked {
   518	                _settleLiquidationHappyFlow(account, startDebt, minimumMargin_, bidder, (amount - accountDebt));
   519	            }
   520	            amount = accountDebt;
   521	        }
   522	
   523	        _withdraw(amount, address(this), account);
   524	
   525	        emit Repay(account, bidder, amount);
   526	    }
   527	
   528	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   529	                        LEVERAGED ACTIONS LOGIC
   530	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   531	
   532	    /**
   533	     * @notice Execute and interact with external logic on leverage.
   534	     * @param amountBorrowed The amount of underlying ERC20 tokens to be lent out.
   535	     * @param account The address of the Arcadia Account backing the debt.
   536	     * @param actionTarget The address of the Action Target to call.
   537	     * @param actionData A bytes object containing three actionAssetData structs, an address array and a bytes array.
   538	     * @param referrer A unique identifier of the referrer, who will receive part of the fees generated by this transaction.
   539	     * @dev The sender might be different than the owner if they have the proper allowances.
   540	     * @dev accountManagementAction() works similar to flash loans, this function optimistically calls external logic and checks for the Account state at the very end.
   541	     */
   542	    function flashAction(
   543	        uint256 amountBorrowed,
   544	        address account,
   545	        address actionTarget,
   546	        bytes calldata actionData,
   547	        bytes3 referrer
   548	    ) external whenBorrowNotPaused processInterests {
   549	        // If Account is not an actual address of a Account, ownerOfAccount(address) will return the zero address.
   550	        address accountOwner = IFactory(ACCOUNT_FACTORY).ownerOfAccount(account);
   551	        if (accountOwner == address(0)) revert LendingPoolErrors.IsNotAnAccount();
   552	
   553	        // Check allowances to take debt.
   554	        if (accountOwner != msg.sender) {
   555	            // Calling flashActionByCreditor() gives the sender full control over all assets in the Account,
   556	            // Only Beneficiaries with maximum allowance can call the flashAction function.
   557	            if (creditAllowance[account][accountOwner][msg.sender] != type(uint256).max) {
   558	                revert LendingPoolErrors.Unauthorized();
   559	            }
   560	        }
   561	
   562	        // Prepare callback of the Account.
   563	        // The borrowing of funds during a flashAction has to be executed via a callback of the Account.
   564	        // As such the Account cannot be reentered in between the time that funds are borrowed and the final health check is done.
   565	        callbackAccount = account;
   566	        bytes memory callbackData = abi.encode(amountBorrowed, actionTarget, msg.sender, referrer);
   567	
   568	        // The Action Target will use the borrowed funds (optionally with additional assets withdrawn from the Account)
   569	        // to execute one or more actions (swap, deposit, mint...).
   570	        // Next the action Target will deposit any of the remaining funds or any of the recipient token
   571	        // resulting from the actions back into the Account.
   572	        // As last step, after all assets are deposited back into the Account a final health check is done:
   573	        // The Collateral Value of all assets in the Account must be bigger than the total liabilities against the Account (including the debt taken during this function).
   574	        // flashActionByCreditor also checks that the Account indeed has opened a margin account for this Lending Pool.
   575	        {
   576	            uint256 accountVersion = IAccount(account).flashActionByCreditor(callbackData, actionTarget, actionData);
   577	            if (!isValidVersion[accountVersion]) revert LendingPoolErrors.InvalidVersion();
   578	        }
   579	    }
   580	
   581	    /**
   582	     * @notice Callback of the Account during a flashAction.
   583	     * @param account The contract address of the Arcadia Account.
   584	     * @param callbackData The data for the borrow during a flashAction.
   585	     * @dev During the callback, the Account cannot be reentered and the actionTimestamp is updated.
   586	     */
   587	    function _flashActionCallback(address account, bytes calldata callbackData) internal override {
   588	        (uint256 amountBorrowed, address actionTarget, address sender, bytes3 referrer) =
   589	            abi.decode(callbackData, (uint256, address, address, bytes3));
   590	
   591	        uint256 amountBorrowedWithFee = amountBorrowed + amountBorrowed.mulDivUp(originationFee, ONE_4);
   592	
   593	        // Mint debt tokens to the Account.
   594	        _deposit(amountBorrowedWithFee, account);
   595	
   596	        // Add origination fee to the treasury.
   597	        unchecked {
   598	            if (amountBorrowedWithFee - amountBorrowed > 0) {
   599	                totalRealisedLiquidity =
   600	                    SafeCastLib.safeCastTo128(amountBorrowedWithFee + totalRealisedLiquidity - amountBorrowed);
   601	                realisedLiquidityOf[treasury] += amountBorrowedWithFee - amountBorrowed;
   602	            }
   603	        }
   604	
   605	        // Send Borrowed funds to the actionTarget.
   606	        // Transfer fails if there is insufficient liquidity in the pool.
   607	        asset.safeTransfer(actionTarget, amountBorrowed);
   608	
   609	        unchecked {
   610	            emit Borrow(account, sender, actionTarget, amountBorrowed, amountBorrowedWithFee - amountBorrowed, referrer);
   611	        }
   612	    }
   613	
   614	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   615	                            ACCOUNTING LOGIC
   616	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   617	
   618	    /**
   619	     * @notice Returns the total amount of outstanding debt in the underlying asset.
   620	     * @return totalDebt The total debt in underlying assets.
   621	     */
   622	    function totalAssets() public view override returns (uint256 totalDebt) {
   623	        // Avoid a second calculation of unrealised debt (expensive)
   624	        // if interests are already synced this block.
   625	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(block-timestamp)
   626	        if (lastSyncedTimestamp != uint32(block.timestamp)) {
   627	            totalDebt = realisedDebt + calcUnrealisedDebt();
   628	        } else {
   629	            totalDebt = realisedDebt;
   630	        }
   631	    }
   632	
   633	    /**
   634	     * @notice Returns the total redeemable amount of liquidity in the underlying asset.
   635	     * @return totalLiquidity_ The total redeemable amount of liquidity in the underlying asset.
   636	     */
   637	    function totalLiquidity() external view returns (uint256 totalLiquidity_) {
   638	        // Avoid a second calculation of unrealised debt (expensive)
   639	        // if interests are already synced this block.
   640	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(block-timestamp)
   641	        if (lastSyncedTimestamp != uint32(block.timestamp)) {
   642	            // The total liquidity equals the sum of the realised liquidity, and the pending interests.
   643	            unchecked {
   644	                totalLiquidity_ = totalRealisedLiquidity + calcUnrealisedDebt();
   645	            }
   646	        } else {
   647	            totalLiquidity_ = totalRealisedLiquidity;
   648	        }
   649	    }
   650	
   651	    /**
   652	     * @notice Returns the redeemable amount of liquidity in the underlying asset of an address.
   653	     * @param owner_ The address of the liquidity provider.
   654	     * @return assets The redeemable amount of liquidity in the underlying asset.
   655	     * @dev This function syncs the interests to prevent calculating UnrealisedDebt twice when depositing/withdrawing through the Tranches.
   656	     * @dev After calling this function, the interest rate will not be updated until the next processInterests() call.
   657	     */
   658	    function liquidityOfAndSync(address owner_) external returns (uint256 assets) {
   659	        _syncInterests();
   660	        assets = realisedLiquidityOf[owner_];
   661	    }
   662	
   663	    /**
   664	     * @notice Returns the redeemable amount of liquidity in the underlying asset of an address.
   665	     * @param owner_ The address of the liquidity provider.
   666	     * @return assets The redeemable amount of liquidity in the underlying asset.
   667	     *  ¨* @dev liquidityOf() might deviate from the actual liquidityOf after interests are synced in the following situations:
   668	     *   - liquidityOf() the treasury will be slightly underestimated, since all rounding errors of all tranches will go to the treasury.
   669	     *   - Tranches with 0 liquidity don't earn any interests, interests will go to treasury instead.
   670	     *   - If totalInterestWeight is 0 (will never happen) all interests will go to treasury instead.
   671	     */
   672	    function liquidityOf(address owner_) external view returns (uint256 assets) {
   673	        // Avoid a second calculation of unrealised debt (expensive).
   674	        // if interests are already synced this block.
   675	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(block-timestamp)
   676	        if (lastSyncedTimestamp != uint32(block.timestamp)) {
   677	            // The total liquidity of a tranche equals the sum of the realised liquidity
   678	            // of the tranche, and its pending interests.
   679	            uint256 interest = calcUnrealisedDebt().mulDivDown(interestWeight[owner_], totalInterestWeight);
   680	            unchecked {
   681	                assets = realisedLiquidityOf[owner_] + interest;
   682	            }
   683	        } else {
   684	            assets = realisedLiquidityOf[owner_];
   685	        }
   686	    }
   687	
   688	    /**
   689	     * @notice Skims any surplus funds in the LendingPool to the treasury.
   690	     * @dev In normal conditions (when there are no ongoing auctions), the total Claimable Liquidity should be equal
   691	     * to the sum of the available funds (the balanceOf() the underlying asset) in the pool and the total open debt.
   692	     * In practice the actual sum of available funds and total open debt will always be bigger than the total Claimable Liquidity.
   693	     * This because of the rounding errors of the ERC4626 calculations (conversions between assets and shares),
   694	     * or because someone accidentally sent funds directly to the pool instead of depositing via a Tranche.
   695	     * This functions makes the surplus available to the Treasury (otherwise they would be lost forever).
   696	     * @dev In case you accidentally sent funds to the pool, contact the current treasury manager.
   697	     */
   698	    function skim() external processInterests {
   699	        // During auction initiation, debt tokens representing the liquidation incentives are minted at start of the auction
   700	        // yet not accounted for in the totalRealisedLiquidity.
   701	        // -> skim function must be blocked during auctions.
   702	        if (auctionsInProgress != 0) revert LendingPoolErrors.AuctionOngoing();
   703	
   704	        // Pending interests are synced via the processInterests modifier.
   705	        uint256 delta = asset.balanceOf(address(this)) + realisedDebt - totalRealisedLiquidity;
   706	
   707	        // Add difference to the treasury.
   708	        unchecked {
   709	            totalRealisedLiquidity = SafeCastLib.safeCastTo128(delta + totalRealisedLiquidity);
   710	            realisedLiquidityOf[treasury] += delta;
   711	        }
   712	    }
   713	
   714	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   715	                            INTERESTS LOGIC
   716	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   717	
   718	    /**
   719	     * @notice Syncs all unrealised debt (= interest for LP and treasury).
   720	     * @dev Calculates the unrealised debt since last sync, and realises it by minting an equal amount of
   721	     * debt tokens to all debt holders and interests to LPs and the treasury.
   722	     */
   723	    function _syncInterests() internal {
   724	        // Only Sync interests once per block.
   725	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(block-timestamp)
   726	        if (lastSyncedTimestamp != uint32(block.timestamp)) {
   727	            uint256 unrealisedDebt = calcUnrealisedDebt();
   728	            lastSyncedTimestamp = uint32(block.timestamp);
   729	
   730	            // Sync interests for borrowers.
   731	            unchecked {
   732	                realisedDebt += unrealisedDebt;
   733	            }
   734	
   735	            // Sync interests for LPs and Protocol Treasury.
   736	            _syncInterestsToLiquidityProviders(unrealisedDebt);
   737	
   738	            emit InterestSynced(unrealisedDebt);
   739	        }
   740	    }
   741	
   742	    /**
   743	     * @notice Calculates the unrealised debt (interests).
   744	     * @return unrealisedDebt The unrealised debt.
   745	     * @dev To calculate the unrealised debt over an amount of time, you need to calculate D[(1+r)^x-1].
   746	     * The base of the exponential: 1 + r, is a 18 decimals fixed point number
   747	     * with r the yearly interest rate.
   748	     * The exponent of the exponential: x, is a 18 decimals fixed point number.
   749	     * The exponent x is calculated as: the amount of seconds passed since last sync timestamp divided by
   750	     * the average of seconds per year.
   751	     */
   752	    function calcUnrealisedDebt() public view returns (uint256 unrealisedDebt) {
   753	        unchecked {
   754	            //gas: Can't overflow for reasonable interest rates.
   755	            uint256 base = 1e18 + interestRate;
   756	
   757	            // gas: Only overflows when (block.timestamp - lastSyncedBlockTimestamp) > 1e59
   758	            // in practice: exponent in LogExpMath lib is limited to 130e18,
   759	            // Corresponding to a delta of timestamps of 4099680000 (or 130 years),
   760	            // much bigger than any realistic time difference between two syncs.
   761	            uint256 exponent = ((block.timestamp - lastSyncedTimestamp) * 1e18) / YEARLY_SECONDS;
   762	
   763	            // gas: Taking an imaginary worst-case scenario with max interest of 1000%
   764	            // over a period of 5 years.
   765	            // This won't overflow as long as openDebt < 3402823669209384912995114146594816
   766	            // which is 3.4 million billion *10**18 decimals.
   767	            unrealisedDebt = (realisedDebt * (LogExpMath.pow(base, exponent) - 1e18)) / 1e18;
   768	        }
   769	
   770	        return SafeCastLib.safeCastTo128(unrealisedDebt);
   771	    }

   773	    /**
   774	     * @notice Syncs interest payments to the liquidity providers and the treasury.
   775	     * @param assets The total amount of underlying assets to be paid out as interests.
   776	     * @dev The interest weight of each Tranche determines the relative share of yield (interest payments)
   777	     * that goes to its liquidity providers.
   778	     * @dev If the total interest weight is 0, all interests will go to the treasury.
   779	     */
   780	    function _syncInterestsToLiquidityProviders(uint256 assets) internal {
   781	        uint256 remainingAssets = assets;
   782	
   783	        uint256 totalInterestWeight_ = totalInterestWeight;
   784	        if (totalInterestWeight_ > 0) {
   785	            uint256 realisedLiquidity;
   786	            uint256 trancheShare;
   787	            uint256 trancheLength = tranches.length;
   788	            for (uint256 i; i < trancheLength; ++i) {
   789	                realisedLiquidity = realisedLiquidityOf[tranches[i]];
   790	                // Don't pay interests to Tranches without liquidity.
   791	                // Interests will go to treasury instead.
   792	                if (realisedLiquidity == 0) continue;
   793	                trancheShare = assets.mulDivDown(interestWeightTranches[i], totalInterestWeight_);
   794	                unchecked {
   795	                    realisedLiquidityOf[tranches[i]] = realisedLiquidity + trancheShare;
   796	                    remainingAssets -= trancheShare;
   797	                }
   798	            }
   799	        }
   800	        unchecked {
   801	            totalRealisedLiquidity = SafeCastLib.safeCastTo128(totalRealisedLiquidity + assets);
   802	
   803	            // Add the remainingAssets to the treasury balance.
   804	            realisedLiquidityOf[treasury] += remainingAssets;
   805	        }
   806	    }

   812	    /**
   813	     * @notice Sets the interest configuration parameters.
   814	     * @param baseRatePerYear_ The base interest rate per year.
   815	     * @param lowSlopePerYear_ The slope of the interest rate per year when the utilization rate is below the utilization threshold.
   816	     * @param highSlopePerYear_ The slope of the interest rate per year when the utilization rate exceeds the utilization threshold.
   817	     * @param utilisationThreshold_ The utilization threshold for determining the interest rate slope change.
   818	     * @dev We cannot use a struct to store all variables, since this would cause the contract size to exceed the maximum size.
   819	     */
   820	    function setInterestParameters(
   821	        uint72 baseRatePerYear_,
   822	        uint72 lowSlopePerYear_,
   823	        uint72 highSlopePerYear_,
   824	        uint16 utilisationThreshold_
   825	    ) external processInterests onlyOwner {
   826	        baseRatePerYear = baseRatePerYear_;
   827	        lowSlopePerYear = lowSlopePerYear_;
   828	        highSlopePerYear = highSlopePerYear_;
   829	        utilisationThreshold = utilisationThreshold_;
   830	    }
   831	
   832	    /**
   833	     * @notice Updates the interest rate.
   834	     * @dev Any address can call this, it will sync unrealised interests and update the interest rate.
   835	     */
   836	    function updateInterestRate() external processInterests { }
   837	
   838	    /**
   839	     * @notice Updates the interest rate.
   840	     * @param totalDebt Total amount of debt.
   841	     * @param totalLiquidity_ Total amount of Liquidity (sum of borrowed out assets and assets still available in the Lending Pool).
   842	     */
   843	    function _updateInterestRate(uint256 totalDebt, uint256 totalLiquidity_) internal {
   844	        uint256 utilisation; // 4 decimals precision
   845	        unchecked {
   846	            // This doesn't overflow since totalDebt is a uint128: uint128 * 10_000 < type(uint256).max.
   847	            if (totalLiquidity_ > 0) utilisation = totalDebt * ONE_4 / totalLiquidity_;
   848	        }
   849	        // Cap utilisation to 100%.
   850	        utilisation = utilisation <= ONE_4 ? utilisation : ONE_4;
   851	
   852	        emit PoolStateUpdated(totalDebt, totalLiquidity_, interestRate = _calculateInterestRate(utilisation));
   853	    }
   854	
   855	    /**
   856	     * @notice Calculates the interest rate.
   857	     * @param utilisation Utilisation rate, 4 decimal precision.
   858	     * @return interestRate_ The current interest rate, 18 decimal precision.
   859	     * @dev The interest rate is a function of the utilisation of the Lending Pool.
   860	     * We use two linear curves: one below the optimal utilisation with low slope and a steep one above.
   861	     */
   862	    function _calculateInterestRate(uint256 utilisation) internal view returns (uint80 interestRate_) {
   863	        // While repays are paused, interest rate is set to 0.
   864	        if (repayPaused) return 0;
   865	
   866	        // forge-lint: disable-next-item(unsafe-typecast)
   867	        unchecked {
   868	            if (utilisation >= utilisationThreshold) {
   869	                // lsIR (1e22) = uT (1e4) * ls (1e18).
   870	                uint256 lowSlopeInterest = uint256(utilisationThreshold) * lowSlopePerYear;
   871	                // hsIR (1e22) = (u - uT) (1e4) * hs (e18).
   872	                uint256 highSlopeInterest = uint256(utilisation - utilisationThreshold) * highSlopePerYear;
   873	                // i (1e18) =  (lsIR (e22) + hsIR (1e22)) / 1e4 + bs (1e18).
   874	                interestRate_ = uint80((lowSlopeInterest + highSlopeInterest) / ONE_4 + baseRatePerYear);
   875	            } else {
   876	                // i (1e18) = (u (1e4) * ls (1e18)) / 1e4 + br (1e18).
   877	                interestRate_ = uint80(utilisation * lowSlopePerYear / ONE_4 + baseRatePerYear);
   878	            }
   879	        }
   880	    }

   883	                        LIQUIDATION LOGIC

   886	    /**
   887	     * @notice Initiates the liquidation process for an Account.
   888	     * @param initiator The address of the liquidation initiator.
   889	     * @param minimumMargin_ The minimum margin of the Account.
   890	     * @return startDebt The initial debt of the liquidated Account.
   891	     * @dev This function is only callable by an Arcadia Account with debt.
   892	     * The liquidation process involves assessing the Account's debt and calculating liquidation incentives,
   893	     * which are considered as extra debt.
   894	     * The extra debt is then minted towards the Account to encourage the liquidation process and bring the Account to a healthy state.
   895	     * @dev Only Accounts with non-zero balances can have debt, and debtTokens are non-transferrable.

   897	     */

   901	        whenLiquidationNotPaused

   906	        // Hence by checking that the balance of the msg.sender is not 0,

   912	        // as extra debt to the Account.

   914	            _calculateRewards(startDebt, minimumMargin_);

   916	        // Mint the liquidation incentives as extra debt towards the Account.
   917	        _deposit(initiationReward + liquidationPenalty + terminationReward, msg.sender);

   919	        // Increase the realised liquidity for the initiator.
   920	        // The other incentives will only be added as realised liquidity for the respective actors
   921	        // after the auction is finished.
   922	        realisedLiquidityOf[initiator] += initiationReward;

   925	        // If this is the sole ongoing auction, prevent any deposits and withdrawals in the most jr tranche
   926	        if (auctionsInProgress == 0 && tranches.length > 0) {
   927	            unchecked {
   928	                ITranche(tranches[tranches.length - 1]).setAuctionInProgress(true);
   929	            }
   930	        }
   931	
   932	        unchecked {
   933	            ++auctionsInProgress;
   934	        }
   935	
   936	        // Emit event
   937	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   938	        emit AuctionStarted(msg.sender, address(this), uint128(startDebt));
   939	    }

   941	    /**

   960	    /**
   961	     * @notice Ends the liquidation process for a specific Account and settles the liquidation incentives.
   962	     * @param account The address of the Account undergoing liquidation settlement.
   963	     * @param startDebt The initial debt amount of the liquidated Account.
   964	     * @param minimumMargin_ The minimum margin of the Account.

   968	     *  to bring the Account in a healthy position, and pay out all liquidation incentives to the
   969	     *  relevant actors.

   972	     *   - The "liquidationFee", going towards LPs and the Treasury.

   984	            _calculateRewards(startDebt, minimumMargin_);

   989	        totalRealisedLiquidity =

   992	        unchecked {
   993	            // Pay out any surplus to the current Account Owner.
   994	            if (surplus > 0) realisedLiquidityOf[IAccount(account).owner()] += surplus;

   996	            realisedLiquidityOf[terminator] += terminationReward;
   997	        }

   999	        _endLiquidation();
  1000	
  1001	        emit AuctionFinished(
  1002	            account, address(this), startDebt, initiationReward, terminationReward, liquidationPenalty, 0, surplus
  1003	        );
  1004	    }

  1006	    /**
  1007	     * @notice Ends the liquidation process for a specific Account and settles the liquidation incentives/bad debt.

  1188	    {
  1189	        uint256 maxReward_ = maxReward;
  1190	        // The minimum reward, for both the initiation- and terminationReward, is defined as a fixed percentage of the minimumMargin.
  1191	        uint256 minReward = minimumMargin_.mulDivUp(minRewardWeight, ONE_4);
  1192	
  1193	        // Initiation reward must be between minReward and maxReward.
  1194	        initiationReward = debt.mulDivDown(initiationWeight, ONE_4);
  1195	        initiationReward = initiationReward > minReward ? initiationReward : minReward;
  1196	        initiationReward = initiationReward > maxReward_ ? maxReward_ : initiationReward;
  1197	
  1198	        // Termination reward must be between minReward and maxReward.
  1199	        terminationReward = debt.mulDivDown(terminationWeight, ONE_4);
  1200	        terminationReward = terminationReward > minReward ? terminationReward : minReward;
  1201	        terminationReward = terminationReward > maxReward_ ? maxReward_ : terminationReward;
  1202	
  1203	        liquidationPenalty = debt.mulDivUp(penaltyWeight, ONE_4);
  1204	    }
  1205	
  1206	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
  1207	                        MANAGE AUCTION SETTINGS
  1208	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
  1209	
  1210	    /**
  1211	     * @notice Sets the liquidation parameters.
  1212	     * @param initiationWeight_ Reward paid to the Liquidation Initiator.
  1213	     * @param penaltyWeight_ Penalty paid by the Account owner to the Creditor.
  1214	     * @param terminationWeight_ Reward paid to the Liquidation closer.
  1215	     * @param minRewardWeight_ The minimum reward that is paid to the initiator/terminator of a liquidation.
  1216	     * @param maxReward_ The maximum reward that is paid to the initiator/terminator of a liquidation.
  1217	     * @dev Each weight has 4 decimals precision (50 equals 0,005 or 0,5%).
  1218	     * @dev Each weight sets the % of the debt that is paid as reward to the initiator and terminator of a liquidation.
  1219	     * This reward is capped in absolute value by the maxReward respectively maxReward.
  1220	     * @dev We cannot use a struct to store all variables, since this would cause the contract size to exceed the maximum size.
  1221	     */
  1222	    function setLiquidationParameters(
  1223	        uint16 initiationWeight_,
  1224	        uint16 penaltyWeight_,
  1225	        uint16 terminationWeight_,
  1226	        uint16 minRewardWeight_,
  1227	        uint80 maxReward_
  1228	    ) external onlyOwner {
  1229	        // When auctions are ongoing, it is not allowed to modify the auction parameters,
  1230	        // as that would corrupt the rewards and penalties calculated by _calculateRewards().
  1231	        if (auctionsInProgress != 0) revert LendingPoolErrors.AuctionOngoing();
  1232	
  1233	        // Total penalties/rewards, paid by the Account cannot exceed MAX_TOTAL_PENALTY.
  1234	        if (uint256(initiationWeight_) + penaltyWeight_ + terminationWeight_ > MAX_TOTAL_PENALTY) {
  1235	            revert LendingPoolErrors.LiquidationWeightsTooHigh();
  1236	        }
  1237	
  1238	        // Sum of the initiationReward and terminationReward cannot exceed minimumMargin of the Account.
  1239	        // -> minRewardWeight is capped to 50%.
  1240	        if (minRewardWeight_ > 5000) revert LendingPoolErrors.LiquidationWeightsTooHigh();
  1241	
  1242	        // Store new parameters.
  1243	        initiationWeight = initiationWeight_;
  1244	        penaltyWeight = penaltyWeight_;
  1245	        terminationWeight = terminationWeight_;
  1246	        minRewardWeight = minRewardWeight_;
  1247	        maxReward = maxReward_;
  1248	    }
  1249	
  1250	    /**
  1251	     * @notice Sets the minimum amount of collateral that must be held in an Account before a position can be opened.
  1252	     * @param minimumMargin_ The new minimumMargin.
  1253	     * @dev The minimum margin should be a conservative upper estimate of the maximal gas cost to liquidate a position (fixed cost, independent of openDebt).
  1254	     * The minimumMargin prevents dusting attacks, and ensures that upon liquidations positions are big enough to cover
  1255	     * network transaction costs while remaining attractive to liquidate.
  1256	     */
  1257	    function setMinimumMargin(uint96 minimumMargin_) external onlyOwner {
  1258	        minimumMargin = minimumMargin_;
  1259	    }
  1260	
  1261	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
  1262	                            ACCOUNT LOGIC
  1263	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
  1264	
  1265	    /**
  1266	     * @notice Sets a new Risk Manager.
  1267	     * @param riskManager_ The address of the new Risk Manager.
  1268	     */
  1269	    function setRiskManager(address riskManager_) external onlyOwner {
  1270	        _setRiskManager(riskManager_);
  1271	    }
  1272	
  1273	    /**
  1274	     * @notice Enables or disables a certain Account version to be used as margin account.
  1275	     * @param accountVersion the Account version to be enabled/disabled.
  1276	     * @param valid The validity of the respective accountVersion.
  1277	     */
  1278	    function setAccountVersion(uint256 accountVersion, bool valid) external onlyOwner {
  1279	        _setAccountVersion(accountVersion, valid);
  1280	    }
  1281	
  1282	    /**
  1283	     * @inheritdoc Creditor
  1284	     */
  1285	    function openMarginAccount(uint256 accountVersion)
  1286	        external
  1287	        view
  1288	        override
  1289	        returns (bool success, address numeraire, address liquidator_, uint256 minimumMargin_)
  1290	    {
  1291	        if (isValidVersion[accountVersion]) {
  1292	            success = true;
  1293	            numeraire = address(asset);
  1294	            liquidator_ = LIQUIDATOR;
  1295	            minimumMargin_ = minimumMargin;
  1296	        }
  1297	    }
  1298	
  1299	    /**
  1300	     * @inheritdoc Creditor
  1301	     */
  1302	    function closeMarginAccount(address account) external view override {
  1303	        if (maxWithdraw(account) != 0) revert LendingPoolErrors.OpenPositionNonZero();
  1304	    }
  1305	
  1306	    /**
  1307	     * @inheritdoc Creditor
  1308	     */
  1309	    function getOpenPosition(address account) external view override returns (uint256 openPosition) {
  1310	        openPosition = maxWithdraw(account);
  1311	    }
  1312	
  1313	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
  1314	                            HELPER FUNCTIONS
  1315	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
  1316	    /**
  1317	     * @notice Returns the configuration of the interest rate slopes.
  1318	     * @return baseRatePerYear The base interest rate per year.
  1319	     * @return lowSlopePerYear The slope of the interest rate per year when the utilization rate is below the utilization threshold.
  1320	     * @return highSlopePerYear The slope of the interest rate per year when the utilization rate exceeds the utilization threshold.
  1321	     * @return utilisationThreshold The utilization threshold for determining the interest rate slope change.
  1322	     */
  1323	    function getInterestRateConfig() external view returns (uint72, uint72, uint72, uint16) {
  1324	        return (baseRatePerYear, lowSlopePerYear, highSlopePerYear, utilisationThreshold);
  1325	    }
  1326	
  1327	    /**
  1328	     * @notice Returns the liquidation parameters.
  1329	     * @return initiationWeight Reward paid to the Liquidation Initiator.
  1330	     * @return penaltyWeight Penalty paid by the Account owner to the Creditor.
  1331	     * @return terminationWeight Reward paid to the Liquidation closer.
  1332	     * @return minRewardWeight The minimum reward that is paid to the initiator/terminator of a liquidation.
  1333	     * @return maxReward The maximum reward that is paid to the initiator/terminator of a liquidation.
  1334	     */
  1335	    function getLiquidationParameters() external view returns (uint16, uint16, uint16, uint16, uint80) {
  1336	        return (initiationWeight, penaltyWeight, terminationWeight, minRewardWeight, maxReward);
  1337	    }
  1338	}
```

```solidity
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;

     7	import { ERC4626 } from "../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/tokens/ERC4626.sol";
```
