```solidity
    23	/**
    24	 * @title Liquidator for L2s.
    25	 * @author Pragma Labs
    26	 * @notice The Liquidator manages the Dutch auctions, used to sell collateral of unhealthy Arcadia Accounts.
    27	 */
    28	contract LiquidatorL2 is Owned, ReentrancyGuard, ILiquidator {
    29	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    30	    using SafeTransferLib for ERC20;
    31	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    32	                               CONSTANTS
    33	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    34	
    35	    // The unit for fixed point numbers with 4 decimals precision.
    36	    uint16 internal constant ONE_4 = 10_000;
    37	    // Contract address of the Arcadia Account Factory.
    38	    address internal immutable ACCOUNT_FACTORY;
    39	
    40	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    41	                                STORAGE
    42	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    43	
    44	    // The base of the auction price curve (decreasing power function).
    45	    // Determines in what time the auction price halves, 18 decimals precision.
    46	    uint64 internal base;
    47	    // The time duration after which the auction is considered failed and can be bought in, in seconds.
    48	    uint32 internal cutoffTime;
    49	    // Sets the begin price of the auction, 4 decimals precision.
    50	    uint16 internal startPriceMultiplier;
    51	    // Sets the minimum price the auction converges to, 4 decimals precision.
    52	    uint16 internal minPriceMultiplier;
    53	
    54	    // The contract address of the sequencer uptime oracle.
    55	    address internal sequencerUptimeOracle;
    56	
    57	    // Map of creditor to address to which all assets are transferred to after an unsuccessful auction.
    58	    mapping(address => address) internal creditorToAccountRecipient;
    59	    // Map Account => auctionInformation.
    60	    mapping(address => AuctionInformation) public auctionInformation;
    61	
    62	    // Struct with additional information about the auction of a specific Account.
    63	    struct AuctionInformation {
    64	        // The open debt, denominated in the Creditor's Numeraire.
    65	        uint128 startDebt;
    66	        // The base of the auction price curve.
    67	        uint64 base;
    68	        // The time duration after which the auction is considered failed and can be bought in, in seconds.
    69	        uint32 cutoffTime;
    70	        // The timestamp the auction started.
    71	        uint32 startTime;
    72	        // The contract address of the Creditor.
    73	        address creditor;
    74	        // The minimum margin of the Account.
    75	        uint96 minimumMargin;
    76	        // Sets the begin price of the auction, 4 decimals precision.
    77	        uint16 startPriceMultiplier;
    78	        // Sets the minimum price the auction converges to, 4 decimals precision.
    79	        uint16 minPriceMultiplier;
    80	        // Flag indicating if the auction is still ongoing.
    81	        bool inAuction;
    82	        // The contract address of each asset in the Account, at the moment the liquidation was initiated.
    83	        address[] assetAddresses;
    84	        // The relative value of each asset in the Account (the "assetShare") with respect to the total value of the Account,
    85	        // at the moment the liquidation was initiated, 4 decimals precision.
    86	        uint32[] assetShares;
    87	        // The amount of each asset in the Account, at the moment the liquidation was initiated.
    88	        uint256[] assetAmounts;
    89	        // The ids of each asset in the Account, at the moment the liquidation was initiated.
    90	        uint256[] assetIds;
    91	    }
    92	
    93	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    94	                                EVENTS
    95	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    96	
    97	    event AuctionCurveParametersSet(
    98	        uint64 base, uint32 cutoffTime, uint16 startPriceMultiplier, uint16 minPriceMultiplier
    99	    );
   100	
   101	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   102	                                CONSTRUCTOR
   103	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   104	
   105	    /**
   106	     * @notice The constructor for the Liquidator.
   107	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
   108	     * @param accountFactory The contract address of the Arcadia Account Factory.
   109	     * @param sequencerUptimeOracle_ The contract address of the sequencer uptime oracle.
   110	     */
   111	    constructor(address owner_, address accountFactory, address sequencerUptimeOracle_) Owned(owner_) {
   112	        ACCOUNT_FACTORY = accountFactory;
   113	        sequencerUptimeOracle = sequencerUptimeOracle_;
   114	
   115	        // Check that the sequencer uptime oracle is not reverting.
   116	        (bool success,) = _getSequencerUpTime();
   117	        if (!success) revert LiquidatorErrors.OracleReverting();
   118	
   119	        // Half life of 3600s.
   120	        base = 999_807_477_651_317_446;
   121	        // 4 hours.
   122	        cutoffTime = 14_400;
   123	        // 150%.
   124	        startPriceMultiplier = 15_000;
   125	        // 60%.
   126	        minPriceMultiplier = 6000;
   127	
   128	        emit AuctionCurveParametersSet(999_807_477_651_317_446, 14_400, 15_000, 6000);
   129	    }
   130	
   131	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   132	                             L2 LOGIC
   133	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   134	
   135	    /**
   136	     * @notice Checks that the sequencer is not down, and returns the last time the sequencer went back up.
   137	     * @return success Boolean indicating whether the sequencer uptime oracle is not reverting.
   138	     * @return startedAt Timestamp of the last time the sequencer went back up.
   139	     * @dev This check guarantees that ongoing auctions do not continue while the sequencer is down.
   140	     * @dev If the sequencer uptime oracle itself is reverting, the sequencer is assumed to be still up,
   141	     * startedAt will be 0 in this case.
   142	     */
   143	    function _getSequencerUpTime() internal view returns (bool success, uint256 startedAt) {
   144	        try IChainLinkData(sequencerUptimeOracle).latestRoundData() returns (
   145	            uint80, int256 answer, uint256 startedAt_, uint256, uint80
   146	        ) {
   147	            if (answer == 1) revert LiquidatorErrors.SequencerDown();
   148	
   149	            success = true;
   150	            startedAt = startedAt_;
   151	        } catch {
   152	            // If sequencer uptime oracle itself is reverting, startedAt is 0.
   153	        }
   154	    }
   155	
   156	    /**
   157	     * @notice Sets a new sequencer uptime oracle in the case the current oracle is reverting.
   158	     * @param sequencerUptimeOracle_ The contract address of the new sequencer uptime oracle.
   159	     */
   160	    function setSequencerUptimeOracle(address sequencerUptimeOracle_) external onlyOwner {
   161	        // Check that the current sequencer uptime oracle is reverting.
   162	        (bool success,) = _getSequencerUpTime();
   163	        if (success) revert LiquidatorErrors.OracleNotReverting();
   164	
   165	        // Set the new sequencer uptime oracle.
   166	        sequencerUptimeOracle = sequencerUptimeOracle_;
   167	
   168	        // Check that the new sequencer uptime oracle is not reverting.
   169	        (success,) = _getSequencerUpTime();
   170	        if (!success) revert LiquidatorErrors.OracleReverting();
   171	    }
   172	
   173	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   174	                    AUCTION ACCOUNT RECIPIENT
   175	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   176	
   177	    /**
   178	     * @notice The Account recipient receives the Accounts after an unsuccessful auction.
   179	     * @param creditor The contract address of the Creditor for which the Account recipient is set.
   180	     * @param accountRecipient The address of the new Account recipient for a given creditor.
   181	     * @dev This function can only be called by the Risk Manager of the Creditor.
   182	     * @dev Accounts themselves must never be set as accountRecipient,
   183	     * since ownership transfers of Accounts to themselves will revert.
   184	     * A check on "isAccount()" would not be sufficient to prevent this from happening,
   185	     * since account addresses can be pre-computed before deployment.
   186	     */
   187	    function setAccountRecipient(address creditor, address accountRecipient) external {
   188	        if (msg.sender != ICreditor(creditor).riskManager()) revert LiquidatorErrors.NotAuthorized();
   189	        creditorToAccountRecipient[creditor] = accountRecipient;
   190	    }
   191	
   192	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   193	                    AUCTION PRICE CURVE PARAMETERS
   194	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   195	
   196	    /**
   197	     * @notice Sets the parameters of the auction price curve (decreasing power function).
   198	     * @param halfLifeTime The base is not set directly, but it's derived from a more intuitive parameter, the halfLifeTime:
   199	     * The time ΔT_hl (in seconds with 0 decimals) it takes for the power function to halve in value.
   200	     * @param cutoffTime_ The time after which the auction is considered not successful.
   201	     * After the cutoffTime, the remaining assets are transferred to the protocol owner to be sold manually.
   202	     * @param startPriceMultiplier_ The start price multiplier, with 4 decimals precision.
   203	     * @param minPriceMultiplier_ The minimum price multiplier, with 4 decimals precision.
   204	     * @dev The relation between the base and the halfLife time (ΔT_hl):
   205	     * The power function is defined as: N(t) = N(0) * (1/2)^(t/ΔT_hl).
   206	     * Or simplified: N(t) = N(O) * base^t => base = 1/[2^(1/ΔT_hl)].
   207	     * @dev Setting a very short cutoffTime can be used by rogue owners to rug the most junior tranche(s)!!
   208	     * Therefore the cutoffTime has hardcoded constraints.
   209	     * @dev The start price multiplier is a multiplier that is used to increase the initial price of the auction.
   210	     * Since the value of all assets are discounted with the liquidation factor, and because pricing modules will take a conservative
   211	     * approach to price assets (eg. floor-prices for NFTs), the actual value of the assets being auctioned might be substantially higher
   212	     * than the open debt. Hence the auction starts at a multiplier of the openDebt, but decreases rapidly (exponential decay).
   213	     * @dev The minimum price multiplier sets a lower bound to which the auction price converges.
   214	     * @dev All calculations are done with 18 decimals precision.
   215	     */
   216	    function setAuctionCurveParameters(
   217	        uint32 halfLifeTime,
   218	        uint32 cutoffTime_,
   219	        uint16 startPriceMultiplier_,
   220	        uint16 minPriceMultiplier_
   221	    ) external onlyOwner {
   222	        // Checks that halfLifeTime and cutoffTime_ are within reasonable boundaries.
   223	        if (halfLifeTime < 120) revert LiquidatorErrors.HalfLifeTimeTooLow(); // 2 minutes.
   224	        if (halfLifeTime > 28_800) revert LiquidatorErrors.HalfLifeTimeTooHigh(); // 8 hours.
   225	        if (cutoffTime_ < 3600) revert LiquidatorErrors.CutOffTooLow(); // 1 hour.
   226	        if (cutoffTime_ > 64_800) revert LiquidatorErrors.CutOffTooHigh(); // 18 hours.
   227	
   228	        // Derive base from the halfLifeTime.
   229	        uint64 base_ = uint64(1e18 * 1e18 / LogExpMath.pow(2 * 1e18, 1e18 / halfLifeTime));
   230	
   231	        // Check that LogExpMath.pow(base, timePassed) does not error at cutoffTime (due to numbers smaller than minimum precision).
   232	        // Since LogExpMath.pow is a strictly decreasing function checking the power function at cutoffTime
   233	        // guarantees that the function does not revert on all timestamps between start of the auction and the cutoffTime.
   234	        LogExpMath.pow(base_, uint256(cutoffTime_) * 1e18);
   235	
   236	        // Checks that startPriceMultiplier_ and minPriceMultiplier_ are within reasonable boundaries.
   237	        if (startPriceMultiplier_ < 10_000) revert LiquidatorErrors.MultiplierTooLow();
   238	        if (startPriceMultiplier_ > 30_000) revert LiquidatorErrors.MultiplierTooHigh();
   239	        if (minPriceMultiplier_ > 9000) revert LiquidatorErrors.MultiplierTooHigh();
   240	
   241	        // Store the new parameters.
   242	        emit AuctionCurveParametersSet(
   243	            base = base_,
   244	            cutoffTime = cutoffTime_,
   245	            startPriceMultiplier = startPriceMultiplier_,
   246	            minPriceMultiplier = minPriceMultiplier_
   247	        );
   248	    }
   249	
   250	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   251	                      LIQUIDATION INITIATION
   252	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   253	
   254	    /**
   255	     * @notice Initiate the liquidation of an Account.
   256	     * @param account The contract address of the Account to be liquidated.
   257	     */
   258	    function liquidateAccount(address account) external nonReentrant {
   259	        if (!IFactory(ACCOUNT_FACTORY).isAccount(account)) revert LiquidatorErrors.IsNotAnAccount();
   260	
   261	        AuctionInformation storage auctionInformation_ = auctionInformation[account];
   262	
   263	        // Check if the account is already being auctioned.
   264	        if (auctionInformation_.inAuction) revert LiquidatorErrors.AuctionOngoing();
   265	
   266	        // Set the inAuction flag to true.
   267	        auctionInformation_.inAuction = true;
   268	
   269	        // Store the auction price-curve parameters.
   270	        // This ensures that changes of the price-curve parameters do not impact ongoing auctions.
   271	        auctionInformation_.base = base;
   272	        auctionInformation_.startTime = uint32(block.timestamp);
   273	        auctionInformation_.cutoffTime = cutoffTime;
   274	        auctionInformation_.startPriceMultiplier = startPriceMultiplier;
   275	        auctionInformation_.minPriceMultiplier = minPriceMultiplier;
   276	
   277	        // Check if the Account is insolvent and if it is, start the liquidation in the Account.
   278	        // startLiquidation will revert if the Account is still solvent.
   279	        // startLiquidation will revert if the sequencer is down, or if less then the grace period,
   280	        // set by the Creditor, has passed.
   281	        (
   282	            address[] memory assetAddresses,
   283	            uint256[] memory assetIds,
   284	            uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
   285	            address creditor,
   286	            uint96 minimumMargin,
   287	            uint256 debt,
   288	            AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory assetValues
   289	        ) = IAccount(account).startLiquidation(msg.sender);
   290	
   291	        // Store the Account information.
   292	        auctionInformation_.assetAddresses = assetAddresses;
   293	        auctionInformation_.assetIds = assetIds;
   294	        auctionInformation_.assetAmounts = assetAmounts;
   295	        auctionInformation_.creditor = creditor;
   296	        auctionInformation_.minimumMargin = minimumMargin;
   297	        auctionInformation_.startDebt = SafeCastLib.safeCastTo128(debt);
   298	
   299	        // Store the relative value of each asset (the "assetShare"), with respect to the total value of the Account.
   300	        // These will be used to calculate the price of bids to partially liquidate the Account.
   301	        auctionInformation_.assetShares = _getAssetShares(assetValues);
   302	    }
   303	
   304	    /**
   305	     * @notice Calculate the relative value of each asset, with respect to the total value of the Account.
   306	     * @param assetValues An array with the values of each asset in the Account.
   307	     * @return assetShares An array of asset shares, with 4 decimals precision.
   308	     */
   309	    function _getAssetShares(AssetValueAndRiskFactors[] memory assetValues)
   310	        internal
   311	        pure
   312	        returns (uint32[] memory assetShares)
   313	    {
   314	        uint256 length = assetValues.length;
   315	        uint256 totalValue;
   316	        for (uint256 i; i < length; ++i) {
   317	            unchecked {
   318	                totalValue += assetValues[i].assetValue;
   319	            }
   320	        }
   321	        assetShares = new uint32[](length);
   322	
   323	        if (totalValue == 0) return assetShares;
   324	
   325	        for (uint256 i; i < length; ++i) {
   326	            // The asset shares are calculated relative to the total value of the Account.
   327	            assetShares[i] = uint32(assetValues[i].assetValue.mulDivUp(ONE_4, totalValue));
   328	        }
   329	    }
   330	
   331	    /**
   332	     * @notice Gets the asset arrays from a liquidated Account.
   333	     * @param account The contract address of the Account being liquidated.
   334	     * @return assetAddresses The contract address of each asset in the Account, at the moment the liquidation was initiated.
   335	     * @return assetIds The ids of each asset in the Account, at the moment the liquidation was initiated.
   336	     * @return assetAmounts The amount of each asset in the Account, at the moment the liquidation was initiated.
   337	     * @return assetShares The relative value of each asset in the Account (the "assetShare") with respect to the total value of the Account,
   338	     * at the moment the liquidation was initiated, 4 decimals precision.
   339	     * @dev We need a separate getter functions for the dynamic arrays,
   340	     * since public mappings of structs with dynamic arrays do not returns the arrays.
   341	     */
   342	    function getAuctionInformationArrays(address account)
   343	        external
   344	        view
   345	        returns (
   346	            address[] memory assetAddresses,
   347	            uint256[] memory assetIds,
   348	            uint256[] memory assetAmounts,
   349	            uint32[] memory assetShares
   350	        )
   351	    {
   352	        AuctionInformation storage auctionInformation_ = auctionInformation[account];
   353	        assetAddresses = auctionInformation_.assetAddresses;
   354	        assetIds = auctionInformation_.assetIds;
   355	        assetAmounts = auctionInformation_.assetAmounts;
   356	        assetShares = auctionInformation_.assetShares;
   357	    }
   358	
   359	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   360	                      LIQUIDATION BIDS
   361	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   362	
   363	    /**
   364	     * @notice Places a bid.
   365	     * @param account The contract address of the Account being liquidated.
   366	     * @param bidAmounts Array with the assets-amounts the bidder wants to buy.
   367	     * @param endAuction_ Bool indicating that the auction can be ended after the bid.
   368	     * @param data Data passed through back to the bidder via the bidCallback() call.
   369	     * @dev We use a Dutch auction: price of the assets constantly decreases.
   370	     * @dev The "bidAmounts" array should have equal length as the stored "assetAmounts" array.
   371	     * An amount 0 should be passed for assets the bidder does not want to buy.
   372	     * If the length of "bidAmounts" does not equal "assetAmounts", the function will revert in the Registry.
   373	     * @dev The bidder is not obliged to set endAuction to True if the account is healthy after the bid,
   374	     * but they are incentivised to do so by earning an additional "auctionTerminationReward".
   375	     * @dev If the bidder is a contract, it must implement the IBidCallback interface.
   376	     */
   377	    function bid(address account, uint256[] memory bidAmounts, bool endAuction_, bytes calldata data)
   378	        external
   379	        nonReentrant
   380	    {
   381	        AuctionInformation storage auctionInformation_ = auctionInformation[account];
   382	        if (!auctionInformation_.inAuction) revert LiquidatorErrors.NotForSale();
   383	
   384	        // Restart pending auctions if the sequencer went down during the auction.
   385	        (, uint256 sequencerStartedAt) = _getSequencerUpTime();
   386	        if (sequencerStartedAt > auctionInformation_.startTime) {
   387	            // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   388	            auctionInformation_.startTime = uint32(sequencerStartedAt);
   389	        }
   390	
   391	        // Transfer the assets to the bidder, returns updated bidAmounts with the actual bought assets.
   392	        // The actual bought assets are equal or smaller than the asked assets.
   393	        bidAmounts = IAccount(account)
   394	            .auctionBid(auctionInformation_.assetAddresses, auctionInformation_.assetIds, bidAmounts, msg.sender);
   395	
   396	        // Calculate the current auction price of the assets bought.
   397	        uint256 totalShare = _calculateTotalShare(auctionInformation_, bidAmounts);
   398	        uint256 price = _calculateBidPrice(auctionInformation_, totalShare);
   399	
   400	        // Hook back to the bidder with the actual amounts of bought assets and the actual bid price.
   401	        // Bidders can optionally first liquidate the assets before repaying the debt.
   402	        // Bidders should NOT call a LendingPool.repay() or LendingPool.auctionRepay() within the callback,
   403	        // as this will cause the bidder to pay twice!
   404	        if (msg.sender.code.length > 0) IBidCallback(msg.sender).bidCallback(bidAmounts, price, data);
   405	
   406	        // Transfer an amount of "price" in "Numeraire" to the LendingPool to repay the Accounts debt.
   407	        // The LendingPool will call a "transferFrom" from the bidder to the pool -> the bidder must approve the LendingPool.
   408	        // If the amount transferred would exceed the debt, the surplus is paid out to the Account Owner and earlyTerminate is True.
   409	        bool earlyTerminate = ILendingPool(auctionInformation_.creditor)
   410	            .auctionRepay(auctionInformation_.startDebt, auctionInformation_.minimumMargin, price, account, msg.sender);
   411	
   412	        // If all the debt is repaid, the auction must be ended, even if the bidder did not set endAuction to true.
   413	        if (earlyTerminate) {
   414	            // Stop the auction, no need to do a health check for the account since it has no debt anymore.
   415	            _endAuction(account);
   416	        }
   417	        // If not all debt is repaid, the bidder can still earn a termination incentive by ending the auction
   418	        // if one of the conditions to end the auction is met.
   419	        // "_endAuction()" will silently fail without reverting, if the auction was not successfully ended.
   420	        else if (endAuction_) {
   421	            if (_settleAuction(account, auctionInformation_)) _endAuction(account);
   422	        }
   423	    }
   424	
   425	    /**
   426	     * @notice Gets the bid price for amount of assets asked.
   427	     * @param account The contract address of the Account being liquidated.
   428	     * @param askedAssetAmounts Array with the assets-amounts the bidder wants to buy.
   429	     * @return price The price for which the bid can be purchased, denominated in the Numeraire.
   430	     * @return inAuction return false when the Account is not being Auctioned.
   431	     * @dev We use a Dutch auction: price of the assets constantly decreases.
   432	     * @dev The "askedAssetAmounts" array should have equal length as the stored "assetAmounts" array.
   433	     * An amount 0 should be passed for assets the bidder does not want to buy.
   434	     * @dev Only use as off-chain view function!
   435	     * getBidPrice() will not be accurate if the sequencer went down during the auction.
   436	     */
   437	    function getBidPrice(address account, uint256[] memory askedAssetAmounts)
   438	        external
   439	        view
   440	        returns (uint256 price, bool inAuction)
   441	    {
   442	        AuctionInformation storage auctionInformation_ = auctionInformation[account];
   443	        inAuction = auctionInformation_.inAuction;
   444	        if (!inAuction) return (0, false);
   445	        // Calculate the current auction price of the assets being bought.
   446	        uint256 totalShare = _calculateTotalShare(auctionInformation_, askedAssetAmounts);
   447	        price = _calculateBidPrice(auctionInformation_, totalShare);
   448	    }
   449	
   450	    /**
   451	     * @notice Calculates the share of the initial assets the bidder wants to buy.
   452	     * @param auctionInformation_ The auction information.
   453	     * @param bidAmounts Array with the assets-amounts the bidder wants to buy.
   454	     * @return totalShare The share of initial assets the bidder wants to buy, 4 decimals precision.
   455	     * @dev totalShare is calculated based on the relative value of the assets when the auction was initiated.
   456	     */
   457	    function _calculateTotalShare(AuctionInformation storage auctionInformation_, uint256[] memory bidAmounts)
   458	        internal
   459	        view
   460	        returns (uint256 totalShare)
   461	    {
   462	        uint256[] memory assetAmounts = auctionInformation_.assetAmounts;
   463	        uint32[] memory assetShares = auctionInformation_.assetShares;
   464	
   465	        // If the length of "bidAmounts" did not equal "assetAmounts", the function would have reverted on the withdraw in the Registry.
   466	        for (uint256 i; i < assetAmounts.length; ++i) {
   467	            unchecked {
   468	                totalShare += bidAmounts[i].mulDivUp(assetShares[i], assetAmounts[i]);
   469	            }
   470	        }
   471	    }
   472	
   473	    /**
   474	     * @notice Function returns the current auction price given time passed and a bid.
   475	     * @param auctionInformation_ The auction information.
   476	     * @param totalShare The share of initial assets the bidder wants to buy,
   477	     * calculated based on the relative value of the assets when the auction was initiated.
   478	     * @return price The price for which the bid can be purchased, denominated in the Numeraire.
   479	     * @dev We use a Dutch auction: price of the assets constantly decreases.
   480	     * @dev Price P(t) decreases exponentially over time: P(t) = Debt * S * [(SPM - MPM) * base^t + MPM]:
   481	     * Debt: The total debt of the Account at the moment the auction was initiated.
   482	     * S: The share of the assets being bought in the bid.
   483	     * SPM: The startPriceMultiplier defines the initial price: P(0) = Debt * S * SPM (4 decimals precision).
   484	     * MPM: The minPriceMultiplier defines the asymptotic end price for P(∞) = Debt * MPM (4 decimals precision).
   485	     * base: defines how fast the exponential curve decreases (18 decimals precision).
   486	     * t: time passed since start auction (in seconds, 18 decimals precision).
   487	     * @dev LogExpMath was made in solidity 0.7, where operations were unchecked.
   488	     * @dev Successful bids are only guaranteed until the cutoffTime.
   489	     * Calculating the bid price after the cutoffTime will revert at some point (due to too low precision of the LogExpMath library).
   490	     * Take this into account for bids done after the cutoffTime.
   491	     */
   492	    function _calculateBidPrice(AuctionInformation storage auctionInformation_, uint256 totalShare)
   493	        internal
   494	        view
   495	        returns (uint256 price)
   496	    {
   497	        unchecked {
   498	            // Calculate the time passed since the auction started and bring to 18 decimals precision,
   499	            // as required by LogExpMath.pow()
   500	            // No overflow possible: uint32 * uint64.
   501	            uint256 timePassed = (block.timestamp - auctionInformation_.startTime) * 1e18;
   502	
   503	            // Cache minPriceMultiplier.
   504	            uint256 minPriceMultiplier_ = auctionInformation_.minPriceMultiplier;
   505	
   506	            // Calculate askPrice as: P = Debt * S * [(SPM - MPM) * base^t + MPM]
   507	            // P: price, denominated in the Numeraire.
   508	            // Debt: The initial debt of the Account, denominated in the Numeraire.
   509	            // S: The share of assets being bought, 4 decimals precision
   510	            // SPM and MPM: multipliers to scale the price curve, 4 decimals precision.
   511	            // base^t: the exponential decay over time of the price (strictly smaller than 1), has 18 decimals precision.
   512	            // Since the result must be denominated in the Numeraire, we need to divide by 1e26 (1e18 + 1e4 + 1e4).
   513	            // No overflow possible: uint128 * uint32 * uint18 * uint18.
   514	            price =
   515	                (auctionInformation_.startDebt
   516	                        * totalShare
   517	                        * (LogExpMath.pow(auctionInformation_.base, timePassed)
   518	                            * (auctionInformation_.startPriceMultiplier - minPriceMultiplier_)
   519	                            + 1e18
   520	                            * uint256(minPriceMultiplier_))) / 1e26;
   521	        }
   522	    }
   523	
   524	    /*///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   525	                    LIQUIDATION TERMINATION
   526	    ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   527	
   528	    /**
   529	     * @notice Ends an auction and settles the liquidation.
   530	     * @param account The contract address of the account in liquidation.
   531	     */
   532	    function endAuction(address account) external nonReentrant {
   533	        AuctionInformation storage auctionInformation_ = auctionInformation[account];
   534	
   535	        // Check if the account is being auctioned.
   536	        if (!auctionInformation_.inAuction) revert LiquidatorErrors.NotForSale();
   537	
   538	        // Restart pending auctions if the sequencer went down during the auction.
   539	        (, uint256 sequencerStartedAt) = _getSequencerUpTime();
   540	        if (sequencerStartedAt > auctionInformation_.startTime) {
   541	            // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   542	            auctionInformation_.startTime = uint32(sequencerStartedAt);
   543	        }
   544	
   545	        if (!_settleAuction(account, auctionInformation_)) revert LiquidatorErrors.EndAuctionFailed();
   546	
   547	        _endAuction(account);
   548	    }
   549	
   550	    /**
   551	     * @notice Ends an auction and settles the liquidation.
   552	     * @param account The contract address of the account in liquidation.
   553	     * @param auctionInformation_ The struct containing all the auction information.
   554	     * @dev There are four different conditions on which an auction can be successfully ended.
   555	     * This function will check three of the four conditions (the fourth is already checked in the bid-function):
   556	     *  1) The Auction did not finish within the cutoff-period.
   557	     *  2) The Account is back in a healthy state (collateral value is equal or bigger than the used margin).
   558	     *  3) There are no remaining assets in the Account left to sell.
   559	     *  4) All open debt was repaid (not checked within this function).
   560	     * @dev If the first condition is met, an emergency process is triggered.
   561	     * The auction will be stopped and the remaining assets of the Account will be transferred to the Liquidator owner.
   562	     * The Tranches of the liquidity pool will pay for the bad debt.
   563	     * The protocol will sell/auction the assets manually to recover the debt.
   564	     * The protocol will later "donate" these proceeds back to the
   565	     * impacted Tranches, this last step is not enforced by the smart contracts.
   566	     * While this process is not fully trustless, it is the only way to solve an extreme unhappy flow,
   567	     * where an auction did not end within cutoffTime (due to market or technical reasons).
   568	     */
   569	    function _settleAuction(address account, AuctionInformation storage auctionInformation_)
   570	        internal
   571	        returns (bool success)
   572	    {
   573	        // Cache variables.
   574	        uint256 startDebt = auctionInformation_.startDebt;
   575	        address creditor = auctionInformation_.creditor;
   576	        uint96 minimumMargin = auctionInformation_.minimumMargin;
   577	
   578	        // Check the different conditions to end the auction.
   579	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(block-timestamp)
   580	        if (block.timestamp > auctionInformation_.startTime + auctionInformation_.cutoffTime) {
   581	            // Unhappy flow: Auction did not end within the cutoffTime.
   582	            ILendingPool(creditor).settleLiquidationUnhappyFlow(account, startDebt, minimumMargin, msg.sender);
   583	            // All remaining assets are transferred to the asset recipient,
   584	            // and a manual (trusted) liquidation has to be done.
   585	            IAccount(account).auctionBoughtIn(creditorToAccountRecipient[creditor]);
   586	        } else {
   587	            uint256 collateralValue = IAccount(account).getCollateralValue();
   588	            uint256 usedMargin = IAccount(account).getUsedMargin();
   589	            if (collateralValue >= usedMargin || usedMargin == minimumMargin) {
   590	                // Happy flow: Account is back in a healthy state.
   591	                // An Account is healthy if the collateral value is equal or greater than the used margin.
   592	                // If usedMargin is equal to minimumMargin, the open liabilities are 0 and the Account is always healthy.
   593	                ILendingPool(creditor).settleLiquidationHappyFlow(account, startDebt, minimumMargin, msg.sender);
   594	            } else if (collateralValue == 0) {
   595	                // Unhappy flow: All collateral is sold.
   596	                ILendingPool(creditor).settleLiquidationUnhappyFlow(account, startDebt, minimumMargin, msg.sender);
   597	            } else {
   598	                // None of the conditions to end the auction are met.
   599	                return false;
   600	            }
   601	        }
   602	        // One of the conditions to end the auction was met.
   603	        return true;
   604	    }
   605	
   606	    /**
   607	     * @notice Ends the liquidation on the Account and removes data stored related to the auction.
   608	     */
   609	    function _endAuction(address account) internal {
   610	        delete auctionInformation[account];
   611	        IAccount(account).endAuction();
   612	    }
   613	}
```

```solidity
     1	/**

     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { ERC20 } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/tokens/ERC20.sol";
     8	import { ERC4626 } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/tokens/ERC4626.sol";
     9	import { FixedPointMathLib } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/FixedPointMathLib.sol";
    10	import { ITranche } from "./interfaces/ITranche.sol";
    11	import { SafeTransferLib } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/SafeTransferLib.sol";
    12	
    13	/**
    14	 * @title Tranche Wrapper
    15	 * @notice This contract wraps an Arcadia Tranche to make it ERC4626 compliant.
    16	 * @dev Shares minted via the wrapper have a 1:1 ratio to shares minted on the Tranche.
    17	 * All view functions can be called directly on the Tranche view functions.
    18	 * @dev Deposit and Mint functions approve the LendingPool, not the Tranche.
    19	 */
    20	contract TrancheWrapper is ERC4626 {
    21	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    22	    using SafeTransferLib for ERC20;
    23	
    24	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    25	                                CONSTANTS
    26	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    27	
    28	    // The contract address of the underlying Arcadia Lending Pool.
    29	    address public immutable LENDING_POOL;
    30	    // The contract address of the underlying Arcadia Tranche.
    31	    address public immutable TRANCHE;
    32	
    33	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    34	                              CONSTRUCTOR
    35	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    36	
    37	    /**
    38	     * @notice The constructor for a TrancheWrapper.
    39	     * @param tranche The contract address of the Tranche.
    40	     */
    41	    constructor(address tranche)
    42	        ERC4626(
    43	            ERC4626(tranche).asset(),
    44	            string(abi.encodePacked("Wrapped ", ERC4626(tranche).name())),
    45	            string(abi.encodePacked("w", ERC4626(tranche).symbol()))
    46	        )
    47	    {
    48	        TRANCHE = tranche;
    49	        LENDING_POOL = ITranche(tranche).LENDING_POOL();
    50	    }
    51	
    52	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    53	                                FUNCTIONS
    54	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    55	
    56	    /**
    57	     * @notice Deposits assets in the underlying Tranche.
    58	     * @param assets The amount of assets of the underlying ERC20 token being deposited.
    59	     * @param receiver The address that receives the minted shares.
    60	     * @return shares The amount of shares minted.
    61	     */
    62	    function deposit(uint256 assets, address receiver) public override returns (uint256 shares) {
    63	        asset.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), assets);
    64	
    65	        // Approval has to be given to the Lending Pool, not the Tranche.
    66	        asset.safeApprove(LENDING_POOL, assets);
    67	
    68	        shares = ERC4626(TRANCHE).deposit(assets, address(this));
    69	        _mint(receiver, shares);
    70	
    71	        emit Deposit(msg.sender, receiver, assets, shares);
    72	    }
    73	
    74	    /**
    75	     * @notice Mints shares of the underlying Tranche.
    76	     * @param shares The amount of shares minted.
    77	     * @param receiver The address that receives the minted shares.
    78	     * @return assets The amount of assets of the underlying ERC20 token being deposited.
    79	     */
    80	    function mint(uint256 shares, address receiver) public override returns (uint256 assets) {
    81	        assets = ITranche(TRANCHE).previewMintAndSync(shares);
    82	        asset.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), assets);
    83	
    84	        // Approval has to be given to the Lending Pool, not the Tranche.
    85	        asset.safeApprove(LENDING_POOL, assets);
    86	
    87	        ERC4626(TRANCHE).mint(shares, address(this));
    88	        _mint(receiver, shares);
    89	
    90	        emit Deposit(msg.sender, receiver, assets, shares);
    91	    }
    92	
    93	    /**
    94	     * @notice Withdraws assets from the underlying Tranche.
    95	     * @param assets The amount of assets of the underlying ERC20 token being withdrawn.
    96	     * @param receiver The address of the receiver of the underlying ERC20 tokens.
    97	     * @param owner The address of the owner of the assets being withdrawn.
    98	     * @return shares The corresponding amount of shares redeemed.
    99	     */
   100	    function withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner) public override returns (uint256 shares) {
   101	        shares = ITranche(TRANCHE).previewWithdrawAndSync(assets);
   102	
   103	        if (msg.sender != owner) {
   104	            uint256 allowed = allowance[owner][msg.sender];
   105	            if (allowed != type(uint256).max) allowance[owner][msg.sender] = allowed - shares;
   106	        }
   107	
   108	        _burn(owner, shares);
   109	        ERC4626(TRANCHE).withdraw(assets, address(this), address(this));
   110	        asset.safeTransfer(receiver, assets);
   111	
   112	        emit Withdraw(msg.sender, receiver, owner, assets, shares);
   113	    }
   114	
   115	    /**
   116	     * @notice Redeems shares of the underlying Tranche.
   117	     * @param shares The amount of shares being redeemed.
   118	     * @param receiver The address of the receiver of the underlying ERC20 tokens.
   119	     * @param owner The address of the owner of the shares being redeemed.
   120	     * @return assets The corresponding amount of assets withdrawn.
   121	     */
   122	    function redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner) public override returns (uint256 assets) {
   123	        if (msg.sender != owner) {
   124	            uint256 allowed = allowance[owner][msg.sender];
   125	            if (allowed != type(uint256).max) allowance[owner][msg.sender] = allowed - shares;
   126	        }
   127	
   128	        _burn(owner, shares);
   129	        assets = ERC4626(TRANCHE).redeem(shares, address(this), address(this));
   130	        asset.safeTransfer(receiver, assets);
   131	
   132	        emit Withdraw(msg.sender, receiver, owner, assets, shares);
   133	    }
   134	
   135	    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   136	                            ACCOUNTING LOGIC
   137	    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   138	
   139	    /**
   140	     * @notice Returns the total amount of underlying assets.
   141	     * @return assets The total amount of underlying assets.
   142	     */
   143	    function totalAssets() public view override returns (uint256 assets) {
   144	        assets = ERC4626(TRANCHE).convertToAssets(totalSupply);
   145	    }
   146	
   147	    /**
   148	     * @notice Conversion rate from assets to shares.
   149	     * @param assets The amount of underlying assets.
   150	     * @return shares The amount of shares.
   151	     */
   152	    function convertToShares(uint256 assets) public view override returns (uint256 shares) {
   153	        shares = ERC4626(TRANCHE).convertToShares(assets);
   154	    }
   155	
   156	    /**
   157	     * @notice Conversion rate from shares to assets.
   158	     * @param shares The amount of shares.
   159	     * @return assets The amount of underlying assets.
   160	     */
   161	    function convertToAssets(uint256 shares) public view override returns (uint256 assets) {
   162	        assets = ERC4626(TRANCHE).convertToAssets(shares);
   163	    }
   164	
   165	    /**
   166	     * @notice Returns the amount of underlying assets deposited that correspond to a certain amount of shares minted.
   167	     * @param shares The amount of shares minted.
   168	     * @return assets The amount of underlying assets deposited.
   169	     */
   170	    function previewMint(uint256 shares) public view override returns (uint256 assets) {
   171	        assets = ERC4626(TRANCHE).previewMint(shares);
   172	    }
   173	
   174	    /**
   175	     * @notice Returns the amount of shares redeemed that correspond to a certain amount of underlying assets withdrawn.
   176	     * @param assets The amount of underlying assets withdrawn.
   177	     * @return shares The amount of shares redeemed.
   178	     */
   179	    function previewWithdraw(uint256 assets) public view override returns (uint256 shares) {
   180	        shares = ERC4626(TRANCHE).previewWithdraw(assets);
   181	    }
   182	
   183	    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   184	                     DEPOSIT/WITHDRAWAL LIMIT LOGIC
   185	    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
   186	
   187	    /**
   188	     * @notice Returns the maximum amount of assets that can be deposited.
   189	     * @param owner The address of the depositor.
   190	     * @return maxAssets The maximum amount of assets that can be deposited.
   191	     */
   192	    function maxDeposit(address owner) public view override returns (uint256 maxAssets) {
   193	        maxAssets = ERC4626(TRANCHE).maxDeposit(owner);
   194	    }
   195	
   196	    /**
   197	     * @notice Returns the maximum amount of shares that can be minted.
   198	     * @param owner The address of the minter.
   199	     * @return maxShares The maximum amount of shares that can be minted.
   200	     */
   201	    function maxMint(address owner) public view override returns (uint256 maxShares) {
   202	        maxShares = ERC4626(TRANCHE).maxMint(owner);
   203	    }
   204	
   205	    /**
   206	     * @notice Returns the maximum amount of assets that can be withdrawn.
   207	     * @param owner The address from who the assets are withdrawn.
   208	     * @return maxAssets The maximum amount of assets that can be withdrawn.
   209	     */
   210	    function maxWithdraw(address owner) public view override returns (uint256 maxAssets) {
   211	        uint256 availableAssets = ERC4626(TRANCHE).maxWithdraw(address(this));
   212	        uint256 claimableAssets = convertToAssets(balanceOf[owner]);
   213	
   214	        maxAssets = availableAssets < claimableAssets ? availableAssets : claimableAssets;
   215	    }
   216	
   217	    /**
   218	     * @notice Returns the maximum amount of shares that can be redeemed.
   219	     * @param owner The address from who the shares are redeemed.
   220	     * @return maxShares The maximum amount of shares that can be redeemed.
   221	     */
   222	    function maxRedeem(address owner) public view override returns (uint256 maxShares) {
   223	        uint256 availableShares = ERC4626(TRANCHE).maxRedeem(address(this));
   224	        uint256 claimableShares = balanceOf[owner];
   225	
   226	        maxShares = availableShares < claimableShares ? availableShares : claimableShares;
   227	    }
   228	}
```

### asset-managers/src/cl-managers/RouterTrampoline.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { ERC20, SafeTransferLib } from "../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/SafeTransferLib.sol";
     8	import { ReentrancyGuard } from "../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol";
     9	import { SafeApprove } from "../libraries/SafeApprove.sol";
    10	
    11	/**
    12	 * @title Trampoline to forward calls to routers.
    13	 * @author Pragma Labs
    14	 */
    15	contract RouterTrampoline is ReentrancyGuard {
    16	    using SafeApprove for ERC20;
    17	    using SafeTransferLib for ERC20;
    18	
    19	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    20	                                LOGIC
    21	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    22	
    23	    /**
    24	     * @notice Forwards a swap via an arbitrary router.
    25	     * @param router The contract address of the router.
    26	     * @param callData The calldata for the swap.
    27	     * @param tokenIn The contract address of the token to swap from.
    28	     * @param tokenOut The contract address of the token to swap to.
    29	     * @param amountIn The maximum amount of tokenIn to swap.
    30	     * @return balanceIn The balance of tokenIn after the swap.
    31	     * @return balanceOut The balance of tokenOut after the swap.
    32	     * @dev TokenIn must be send to the RouterTrampoline before the swap.
    33	     */
    34	    function execute(address router, bytes calldata callData, address tokenIn, address tokenOut, uint256 amountIn)
    35	        external
    36	        nonReentrant
    37	        returns (uint256 balanceIn, uint256 balanceOut)
    38	    {
    39	        // Approve tokenIn to swap.
    40	        ERC20(tokenIn).safeApproveWithRetry(router, amountIn);
    41	
    42	        // Execute swap.
    43	        (bool success, bytes memory result) = router.call(callData);
    44	        require(success, string(result));
    45	
    46	        // Transfer the tokens back to the caller.
    47	        balanceIn = ERC20(tokenIn).balanceOf(address(this));
    48	        balanceOut = ERC20(tokenOut).balanceOf(address(this));
    49	        if (balanceIn > 0) ERC20(tokenIn).safeTransfer(msg.sender, balanceIn);
    50	        if (balanceOut > 0) ERC20(tokenOut).safeTransfer(msg.sender, balanceOut);
    51	    }
    52	}
```

### asset-managers/src/cl-managers/base/Slipstream.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { AbstractBase } from "./AbstractBase.sol";
     8	import { ICLPositionManager } from "../interfaces/ICLPositionManager.sol";
     9	import { CLMath } from "../libraries/CLMath.sol";
    10	import { ERC20, SafeTransferLib } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/SafeTransferLib.sol";
    11	import { FixedPointMathLib } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/FixedPointMathLib.sol";
    12	import { ICLPool } from "../interfaces/ICLPool.sol";
    13	import { IStakedSlipstream } from "../interfaces/IStakedSlipstream.sol";
    14	import { PositionState } from "../state/PositionState.sol";
    15	import { SlipstreamLogic } from "../libraries/SlipstreamLogic.sol";
    16	import { SafeApprove } from "../../libraries/SafeApprove.sol";
    17	
    18	/**
    19	 * @title Base implementation for managing Slipstream Liquidity Positions.
    20	 */
    21	abstract contract Slipstream is AbstractBase {
    22	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    23	    using SafeApprove for ERC20;
    24	    using SafeTransferLib for ERC20;
    25	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    26	                                CONSTANTS
    27	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    28	
    29	    // The contract address of the Slipstream Factory.
    30	    address internal immutable CL_FACTORY;
    31	
    32	    // The contract address of the Slipstream Position Manager.
    33	    ICLPositionManager internal immutable POSITION_MANAGER;
    34	
    35	    // The contract address of the Slipstream Pool Implementation.
    36	    address internal immutable POOL_IMPLEMENTATION;
    37	
    38	    // The contract address of the Reward Token (Aero).
    39	    address internal immutable REWARD_TOKEN;
    40	
    41	    // The contract address of the Staked Slipstream Asset Module.
    42	    address internal immutable STAKED_SLIPSTREAM_AM;
    43	
    44	    // The contract address of the Staked Slipstream Wrapper.
    45	    address internal immutable STAKED_SLIPSTREAM_WRAPPER;
    46	
    47	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    48	                                ERRORS
    49	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    50	
    51	    error OnlyPool();
    52	
    53	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    54	                            CONSTRUCTOR
    55	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    56	
    57	    /**
    58	     * @param positionManager The contract address of the Slipstream Position Manager.
    59	     * @param cLFactory The contract address of the Slipstream Factory.
    60	     * @param poolImplementation The contract address of the Slipstream Pool Implementation.
    61	     * @param rewardToken The contract address of the Reward Token (Aero).
    62	     * @param stakedSlipstreamAm The contract address of the Staked Slipstream Asset Module.
    63	     * @param stakedSlipstreamWrapper The contract address of the Staked Slipstream Wrapper.
    64	     */
    65	    constructor(
    66	        address positionManager,
    67	        address cLFactory,
    68	        address poolImplementation,
    69	        address rewardToken,
    70	        address stakedSlipstreamAm,
    71	        address stakedSlipstreamWrapper
    72	    ) {
    73	        POSITION_MANAGER = ICLPositionManager(positionManager);
    74	        CL_FACTORY = cLFactory;
    75	        POOL_IMPLEMENTATION = poolImplementation;
    76	        REWARD_TOKEN = rewardToken;
    77	        STAKED_SLIPSTREAM_AM = stakedSlipstreamAm;
    78	        STAKED_SLIPSTREAM_WRAPPER = stakedSlipstreamWrapper;
    79	    }
    80	
    81	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    82	                            POSITION VALIDATION
    83	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    84	
    85	    /**
    86	     * @notice Returns if a position manager matches the position manager(s) of Slipstream.
    87	     * @param positionManager the contract address of the position manager to check.
    88	     */
    89	    function isPositionManager(address positionManager) public view virtual override returns (bool) {
    90	        return (positionManager == address(STAKED_SLIPSTREAM_AM)
    91	                || positionManager == address(STAKED_SLIPSTREAM_WRAPPER)
    92	                || positionManager == address(POSITION_MANAGER));
    93	    }
    94	
    95	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    96	                              GETTERS
    97	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    98	
    99	    /**
   100	     * @notice Returns the underlying assets of the pool.
   101	     * param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   102	     * @param id The id of the Liquidity Position.
   103	     * @return token0 The contract address of token0.
   104	     * @return token1 The contract address of token1.
   105	     */
   106	    function _getUnderlyingTokens(address, uint256 id)
   107	        internal
   108	        view
   109	        virtual
   110	        override
   111	        returns (address token0, address token1)
   112	    {
   113	        (,, token0, token1,,,,,,,,) = POSITION_MANAGER.positions(id);
   114	    }
   115	
   116	    /**
   117	     * @notice Returns the position and pool related state.
   118	     * @param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   119	     * @param id The id of the Liquidity Position.
   120	     * @return position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   121	     */
   122	    function _getPositionState(address positionManager, uint256 id)
   123	        internal
   124	        view
   125	        virtual
   126	        override
   127	        returns (PositionState memory position)
   128	    {
   129	        // Get data of the Liquidity Position.
   130	        position.id = id;
   131	        address token0;
   132	        address token1;
   133	        (,, token0, token1, position.tickSpacing, position.tickLower, position.tickUpper, position.liquidity,,,,) =
   134	            POSITION_MANAGER.positions(id);
   135	
   136	        // If it is a non staked position, or the position is staked and the reward token is the same as one of the underlying tokens,
   137	        // there are two underlying assets, otherwise there are three.
   138	        if (positionManager == address(POSITION_MANAGER) || token0 == REWARD_TOKEN || token1 == REWARD_TOKEN) {
   139	            // Positions have two underlying tokens.
   140	            position.tokens = new address[](2);
   141	        } else {
   142	            // Positions have three underlying tokens.
   143	            position.tokens = new address[](3);
   144	            position.tokens[2] = REWARD_TOKEN;
   145	        }
   146	        position.tokens[0] = token0;
   147	        position.tokens[1] = token1;
   148	
   149	        // Get data of the Liquidity Pool.
   150	        position.pool =
   151	            SlipstreamLogic.computeAddress(POOL_IMPLEMENTATION, CL_FACTORY, token0, token1, position.tickSpacing);
   152	        (position.sqrtPrice, position.tickCurrent,,,,) = ICLPool(position.pool).slot0();
   153	        position.fee = ICLPool(position.pool).fee();
   154	    }
   155	
   156	    /**
   157	     * @notice Returns the liquidity of the Pool.
   158	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   159	     * @return liquidity The liquidity of the Pool.
   160	     */
   161	    function _getPoolLiquidity(PositionState memory position)
   162	        internal
   163	        view
   164	        virtual
   165	        override
   166	        returns (uint128 liquidity)
   167	    {
   168	        liquidity = ICLPool(position.pool).liquidity();
   169	    }
   170	
   171	    /**
   172	     * @notice Returns the sqrtPrice of the Pool.
   173	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   174	     * @return sqrtPrice The sqrtPrice of the Pool.
   175	     */
   176	    function _getSqrtPrice(PositionState memory position) internal view virtual override returns (uint160 sqrtPrice) {
   177	        (sqrtPrice,,,,,) = ICLPool(position.pool).slot0();
   178	    }
   179	
   180	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   181	                            CLAIM LOGIC
   182	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   183	
   184	    /**
   185	     * @notice Claims fees/rewards from a Liquidity Position.
   186	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens.
   187	     * @param fees The fees of the underlying tokens to be paid to the initiator.
   188	     * @param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   189	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   190	     * @param claimFee The fee charged on the claimed fees of the liquidity position, with 18 decimals precision.
   191	     */
   192	    function _claim(
   193	        uint256[] memory balances,
   194	        uint256[] memory fees,
   195	        address positionManager,
   196	        PositionState memory position,
   197	        uint256 claimFee
   198	    ) internal virtual override {
   199	        if (positionManager != address(POSITION_MANAGER)) {
   200	            // If position is a staked slipstream position, claim the rewards.
   201	            uint256 rewards = IStakedSlipstream(positionManager).claimReward(position.id);
   202	
   203	            uint256 fee = rewards.mulDivDown(claimFee, 1e18);
   204	            if (balances.length == 3) {
   205	                (balances[2], fees[2]) = (balances[2] + rewards, fees[2] + fee);
   206	                emit YieldClaimed(msg.sender, position.tokens[2], rewards);
   207	            }
   208	            // If rewardToken is an underlying token of the position, add it to the balances.
   209	            else if (position.tokens[0] == REWARD_TOKEN) {
   210	                (balances[0], fees[0]) = (balances[0] + rewards, fees[0] + fee);
   211	                emit YieldClaimed(msg.sender, position.tokens[0], rewards);
   212	            } else {
   213	                (balances[1], fees[1]) = (balances[1] + rewards, fees[1] + fee);
   214	                emit YieldClaimed(msg.sender, position.tokens[1], rewards);
   215	            }
   216	        } else {
   217	            // We assume that the amount of tokens to collect never exceeds type(uint128).max.
   218	            (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) = POSITION_MANAGER.collect(
   219	                ICLPositionManager.CollectParams({
   220	                    tokenId: position.id,
   221	                    recipient: address(this),
   222	                    amount0Max: type(uint128).max,
   223	                    amount1Max: type(uint128).max
   224	                })
   225	            );
   226	            balances[0] += amount0;
   227	            balances[1] += amount1;
   228	
   229	            // Calculate claim fees.
   230	            fees[0] += amount0.mulDivDown(claimFee, 1e18);
   231	            fees[1] += amount1.mulDivDown(claimFee, 1e18);
   232	
   233	            emit YieldClaimed(msg.sender, position.tokens[0], amount0);
   234	            emit YieldClaimed(msg.sender, position.tokens[1], amount1);
   235	        }
   236	    }
   237	
   238	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   239	                          STAKING LOGIC
   240	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   241	
   242	    /**
   243	     * @notice Stakes a Liquidity Position.
   244	     * param balances The balances of the underlying tokens.
   245	     * @param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   246	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   247	     */
   248	    function _stake(uint256[] memory, address positionManager, PositionState memory position)
   249	        internal
   250	        virtual
   251	        override
   252	    {
   253	        // If position is a staked slipstream position, stake the position.
   254	        if (positionManager != address(POSITION_MANAGER)) {
   255	            POSITION_MANAGER.approve(positionManager, position.id);
   256	            IStakedSlipstream(positionManager).mint(position.id);
   257	        }
   258	    }
   259	
   260	    /**
   261	     * @notice Unstakes a Liquidity Position.
   262	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens.
   263	     * @param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   264	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   265	     * @dev Does not emit YieldClaimed event, if necessary first call _claim() to emit the event before unstaking.
   266	     */
   267	    function _unstake(uint256[] memory balances, address positionManager, PositionState memory position)
   268	        internal
   269	        virtual
   270	        override
   271	    {
   272	        // If position is a staked slipstream position, unstake the position.
   273	        if (positionManager != address(POSITION_MANAGER)) {
   274	            uint256 rewards = IStakedSlipstream(positionManager).burn(position.id);
   275	            if (rewards > 0) {
   276	                if (balances.length == 3) balances[2] = rewards;
   277	                // If rewardToken is an underlying token of the position, add it to the balances.
   278	                else if (position.tokens[0] == REWARD_TOKEN) balances[0] += rewards;
   279	                else balances[1] += rewards;
   280	            }
   281	        }
   282	    }
   283	
   284	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   285	                             BURN LOGIC
   286	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   287	
   288	    /**
   289	     * @notice Burns the Liquidity Position.
   290	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens.
   291	     * param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   292	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   293	     * @dev Does not emit YieldClaimed event, if necessary first call _claim() to emit the event before unstaking.
   294	     */
   295	    function _burn(uint256[] memory balances, address, PositionState memory position) internal virtual override {
   296	        // Remove liquidity of the position and claim outstanding fees.
   297	        _decreaseLiquidity(balances, address(0), position, position.liquidity);
   298	
   299	        // Burn the position.
   300	        POSITION_MANAGER.burn(position.id);
   301	    }
   302	
   303	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   304	                    DECREASE LIQUIDITY LOGIC
   305	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   306	
   307	    /**
   308	     * @notice Decreases liquidity of the Liquidity Position.
   309	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens.
   310	     * param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   311	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   312	     * @param liquidity The amount of liquidity to decrease.
   313	     * @dev Must update the balances and delta liquidity after the decrease.
   314	     */
   315	    function _decreaseLiquidity(uint256[] memory balances, address, PositionState memory position, uint128 liquidity)
   316	        internal
   317	        virtual
   318	        override
   319	    {
   320	        // Remove liquidity of the position and claim outstanding fees.
   321	        POSITION_MANAGER.decreaseLiquidity(
   322	            ICLPositionManager.DecreaseLiquidityParams({
   323	                tokenId: position.id, liquidity: liquidity, amount0Min: 0, amount1Min: 0, deadline: block.timestamp
   324	            })
   325	        );
   326	
   327	        // We assume that the amount of tokens to collect never exceeds type(uint128).max.
   328	        (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) = POSITION_MANAGER.collect(
   329	            ICLPositionManager.CollectParams({
   330	                tokenId: position.id,
   331	                recipient: address(this),
   332	                amount0Max: type(uint128).max,
   333	                amount1Max: type(uint128).max
   334	            })
   335	        );
   336	        balances[0] += amount0;
   337	        balances[1] += amount1;
   338	    }
   339	
   340	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   341	                             SWAP LOGIC
   342	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   343	
   344	    /**
   345	     * @notice Swaps one token for another, directly through the pool itself.
   346	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens.
   347	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   348	     * @param zeroToOne Bool indicating if token0 has to be swapped to token1 or opposite.
   349	     * @param amountOut The amount of tokenOut that must be swapped to.
   350	     */
   351	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(unsafe-typecast)
   352	    function _swapViaPool(uint256[] memory balances, PositionState memory position, bool zeroToOne, uint256 amountOut)
   353	        internal
   354	        virtual
   355	        override
   356	    {
   357	        // Do the swap.
   358	        (int256 deltaAmount0, int256 deltaAmount1) = ICLPool(position.pool)
   359	            .swap(
   360	                address(this),
   361	                zeroToOne,
   362	                -int256(amountOut),
   363	                zeroToOne ? CLMath.MIN_SQRT_PRICE_LIMIT : CLMath.MAX_SQRT_PRICE_LIMIT,
   364	                abi.encode(position.tokens[0], position.tokens[1], position.tickSpacing)
   365	            );
   366	
   367	        // Update the balances.
   368	        balances[0] = zeroToOne ? balances[0] - uint256(deltaAmount0) : balances[0] + uint256(-deltaAmount0);
   369	        balances[1] = zeroToOne ? balances[1] + uint256(-deltaAmount1) : balances[1] - uint256(deltaAmount1);
   370	    }
   371	
   372	    /**
   373	     * @notice Callback after executing a swap via ICLPool.swap.
   374	     * @param amount0Delta The amount of token0 that was sent (negative) or must be received (positive) by the pool by
   375	     * the end of the swap. If positive, the callback must send that amount of token0 to the position.
   376	     * @param amount1Delta The amount of token1 that was sent (negative) or must be received (positive) by the pool by
   377	     * the end of the swap. If positive, the callback must send that amount of token1 to the position.
   378	     * @param data Any data passed by this contract via the ICLPool.swap() call.
   379	     */
   380	    function uniswapV3SwapCallback(int256 amount0Delta, int256 amount1Delta, bytes calldata data) external virtual {
   381	        // Check that callback came from an actual Slipstream Pool.
   382	        (address token0, address token1, int24 tickSpacing) = abi.decode(data, (address, address, int24));
   383	
   384	        if (SlipstreamLogic.computeAddress(POOL_IMPLEMENTATION, CL_FACTORY, token0, token1, tickSpacing) != msg.sender)
   385	        {
   386	            revert OnlyPool();
   387	        }
   388	
   389	        // forge-lint: disable-next-item(unsafe-typecast)
   390	        if (amount0Delta > 0) {
   391	            ERC20(token0).safeTransfer(msg.sender, uint256(amount0Delta));
   392	        } else if (amount1Delta > 0) {
   393	            ERC20(token1).safeTransfer(msg.sender, uint256(amount1Delta));
   394	        }
   395	    }
   396	
   397	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   398	                             MINT LOGIC
   399	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   400	
   401	    /**
   402	     * @notice Mints a new Liquidity Position.
   403	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens.
   404	     * param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   405	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   406	     * @param amount0Desired The desired amount of token0 to mint as liquidity.
   407	     * @param amount1Desired The desired amount of token1 to mint as liquidity.
   408	     */
   409	    function _mint(
   410	        uint256[] memory balances,
   411	        address,
   412	        PositionState memory position,
   413	        uint256 amount0Desired,
   414	        uint256 amount1Desired
   415	    ) internal virtual override {
   416	        ERC20(position.tokens[0]).safeApproveWithRetry(address(POSITION_MANAGER), amount0Desired);
   417	        ERC20(position.tokens[1]).safeApproveWithRetry(address(POSITION_MANAGER), amount1Desired);
   418	
   419	        uint256 amount0;
   420	        uint256 amount1;
   421	        (position.id, position.liquidity, amount0, amount1) = POSITION_MANAGER.mint(
   422	            ICLPositionManager.MintParams({
   423	                token0: position.tokens[0],
   424	                token1: position.tokens[1],
   425	                tickSpacing: position.tickSpacing,
   426	                tickLower: position.tickLower,
   427	                tickUpper: position.tickUpper,
   428	                amount0Desired: amount0Desired,
   429	                amount1Desired: amount1Desired,
   430	                amount0Min: 0,
   431	                amount1Min: 0,
   432	                recipient: address(this),
   433	                deadline: block.timestamp,
   434	                sqrtPrice: 0
   435	            })
   436	        );
   437	
   438	        balances[0] -= amount0;
   439	        balances[1] -= amount1;
   440	    }
   441	
   442	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   443	                    INCREASE LIQUIDITY LOGIC
   444	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   445	
   446	    /**
   447	     * @notice Increases liquidity of the Liquidity Position.
   448	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens.
   449	     * param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   450	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   451	     * @param amount0Desired The desired amount of token0 to add as liquidity.
   452	     * @param amount1Desired The desired amount of token1 to add as liquidity.
   453	     */
   454	    function _increaseLiquidity(
   455	        uint256[] memory balances,
   456	        address,
   457	        PositionState memory position,
   458	        uint256 amount0Desired,
   459	        uint256 amount1Desired
   460	    ) internal virtual override {
   461	        ERC20(position.tokens[0]).safeApproveWithRetry(address(POSITION_MANAGER), amount0Desired);
   462	        ERC20(position.tokens[1]).safeApproveWithRetry(address(POSITION_MANAGER), amount1Desired);
   463	
   464	        uint256 amount0;
   465	        uint256 amount1;
   466	        (position.liquidity, amount0, amount1) = POSITION_MANAGER.increaseLiquidity(
   467	            ICLPositionManager.IncreaseLiquidityParams({
   468	                tokenId: position.id,
   469	                amount0Desired: amount0Desired,
   470	                amount1Desired: amount1Desired,
   471	                amount0Min: 0,
   472	                amount1Min: 0,
   473	                deadline: block.timestamp
   474	            })
   475	        );
   476	
   477	        balances[0] -= amount0;
   478	        balances[1] -= amount1;
   479	    }
   480	
   481	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   482	                      NATIVE ETH HANDLER
   483	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   484	
   485	    /**
   486	     * @notice Receives native ether.
   487	     */
   488	    receive() external payable { }
   489	}
```

```solidity
   292	    /**
   293	     * @notice Callback after executing a swap via IUniswapV3Pool.swap.
   294	     * @param amount0Delta The amount of token0 that was sent (negative) or must be received (positive) by the pool by
   295	     * the end of the swap. If positive, the callback must send that amount of token0 to the position.
   296	     * @param amount1Delta The amount of token1 that was sent (negative) or must be received (positive) by the pool by
   297	     * the end of the swap. If positive, the callback must send that amount of token1 to the position.
   298	     * @param data Any data passed by this contract via the IUniswapV3Pool.swap() call.
   299	     */
   300	    function uniswapV3SwapCallback(int256 amount0Delta, int256 amount1Delta, bytes calldata data) external virtual {
   301	        // Check that callback came from an actual Uniswap V3 Pool.
   302	        (address token0, address token1, uint24 fee) = abi.decode(data, (address, address, uint24));
   303	
   304	        if (PoolAddress.computeAddress(UNISWAP_V3_FACTORY, token0, token1, fee) != msg.sender) revert OnlyPool();
   305	
   306	        // forge-lint: disable-next-item(unsafe-typecast)
   307	        if (amount0Delta > 0) {
   308	            ERC20(token0).safeTransfer(msg.sender, uint256(amount0Delta));
   309	        } else if (amount1Delta > 0) {
   310	            ERC20(token1).safeTransfer(msg.sender, uint256(amount1Delta));
   311	        }
   312	    }
   313	
   314	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   315	                             MINT LOGIC
   316	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   317	
   318	    /**
   319	     * @notice Mints a new Liquidity Position.
   320	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens.
   321	     * param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   322	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   323	     * @param amount0Desired The desired amount of token0 to mint as liquidity.
   324	     * @param amount1Desired The desired amount of token1 to mint as liquidity.
   325	     */
   326	    function _mint(
   327	        uint256[] memory balances,
   328	        address,
   329	        PositionState memory position,
   330	        uint256 amount0Desired,
   331	        uint256 amount1Desired
   332	    ) internal virtual override {
   333	        ERC20(position.tokens[0]).safeApproveWithRetry(address(POSITION_MANAGER), amount0Desired);
   334	        ERC20(position.tokens[1]).safeApproveWithRetry(address(POSITION_MANAGER), amount1Desired);
   335	
   336	        uint256 amount0;
   337	        uint256 amount1;
   338	        (position.id, position.liquidity, amount0, amount1) = POSITION_MANAGER.mint(
   339	            IPositionManagerV3.MintParams({
   340	                token0: position.tokens[0],
   341	                token1: position.tokens[1],
   342	                fee: position.fee,
   343	                tickLower: position.tickLower,
   344	                tickUpper: position.tickUpper,
   345	                amount0Desired: amount0Desired,
   346	                amount1Desired: amount1Desired,
   347	                amount0Min: 0,
   348	                amount1Min: 0,
   349	                recipient: address(this),
   350	                deadline: block.timestamp
   351	            })
   352	        );
   353	
   354	        balances[0] -= amount0;
   355	        balances[1] -= amount1;
   356	    }
   357	
   358	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   359	                    INCREASE LIQUIDITY LOGIC
   360	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   361	
   362	    /**
   363	     * @notice Increases liquidity of the Liquidity Position.
   364	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens.
   365	     * param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   366	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   367	     * @param amount0Desired The desired amount of token0 to add as liquidity.
   368	     * @param amount1Desired The desired amount of token1 to add as liquidity.
   369	     */
   370	    function _increaseLiquidity(
   371	        uint256[] memory balances,
   372	        address,
   373	        PositionState memory position,
   374	        uint256 amount0Desired,
   375	        uint256 amount1Desired
   376	    ) internal virtual override {
   377	        ERC20(position.tokens[0]).safeApproveWithRetry(address(POSITION_MANAGER), amount0Desired);
   378	        ERC20(position.tokens[1]).safeApproveWithRetry(address(POSITION_MANAGER), amount1Desired);
   379	
   380	        uint256 amount0;
   381	        uint256 amount1;
   382	        (position.liquidity, amount0, amount1) = POSITION_MANAGER.increaseLiquidity(
   383	            IPositionManagerV3.IncreaseLiquidityParams({
   384	                tokenId: position.id,
   385	                amount0Desired: amount0Desired,
   386	                amount1Desired: amount1Desired,
   387	                amount0Min: 0,
   388	                amount1Min: 0,
   389	                deadline: block.timestamp
   390	            })
   391	        );
   392	
   393	        balances[0] -= amount0;
   394	        balances[1] -= amount1;
   395	    }
   396	}
```
