```solidity
   106	    function _getUnderlyingTokens(address, uint256 id)
   107	        internal
   108	        view
   109	        virtual
   110	        override
   111	        returns (address token0, address token1)
   112	    {
   113	        (PoolKey memory poolKey,) = POSITION_MANAGER.getPoolAndPositionInfo(id);
   114	        token0 = Currency.unwrap(poolKey.currency0);
   115	        token1 = Currency.unwrap(poolKey.currency1);
   116	
   117	        // If token0 is in native ETH, we need to withdraw wrapped eth from the Account.
   118	        if (token0 == address(0)) {

   125	    /**
   126	     * @notice Returns the position and pool related state.

   131	    function _getPositionState(address, uint256 id) internal view virtual override returns (PositionState memory) {
   132	        // Positions have two underlying tokens.
   133	        PositionState memory position;
   134	        position.tokens = new address[](2);
   135	
   136	        // Get data of the Liquidity Position.
   137	        position.id = id;
   138	        (PoolKey memory poolKey, PositionInfo info) = POSITION_MANAGER.getPoolAndPositionInfo(id);
   139	        position.tickLower = info.tickLower();
   140	        position.tickUpper = info.tickUpper();
   141	        bytes32 positionId =
   142	            keccak256(abi.encodePacked(address(POSITION_MANAGER), info.tickLower(), info.tickUpper(), bytes32(id)));
   143	        position.liquidity = POOL_MANAGER.getPositionLiquidity(poolKey.toId(), positionId);
   144	
   145	        // Get data of the Liquidity Pool.
   146	        position.pool = address(poolKey.hooks);
   147	        position.tokens[0] = Currency.unwrap(poolKey.currency0);
   148	        position.tokens[1] = Currency.unwrap(poolKey.currency1);
   149	        position.fee = poolKey.fee;
   150	        position.tickSpacing = poolKey.tickSpacing;

   196	
   197	    /**
   198	     * @notice Claims fees/rewards from a Liquidity Position.
   199	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens.
   200	     * @param fees The fees of the underlying tokens to be paid to the initiator.
   201	     * param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   202	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   203	     */
   204	    function _claim(
   205	        uint256[] memory balances,
   206	        uint256[] memory fees,
   207	        address,
   208	        PositionState memory position,
   209	        uint256 claimFee
   210	    ) internal virtual override {
   211	        // Cache the currencies.
   212	        Currency currency0 = Currency.wrap(position.tokens[0]);
   213	        Currency currency1 = Currency.wrap(position.tokens[1]);
   214	
   215	        // If token0 is native ETH, we need to set the balance to 0,
   216	        // since the assets withdrawn from the account are in wet and not in native ETH.
   217	        if (position.tokens[0] == address(0)) balances[0] = 0;
   218	
   219	        // Generate calldata to collect fees (decrease liquidity with liquidityDelta = 0).
   220	        bytes memory actions = new bytes(2);
   221	        actions[0] = bytes1(uint8(Actions.DECREASE_LIQUIDITY));
   222	        actions[1] = bytes1(uint8(Actions.TAKE_PAIR));
   223	        bytes[] memory params = new bytes[](2);
   224	        params[0] = abi.encode(position.id, 0, 0, 0, "");
   225	        params[1] = abi.encode(currency0, currency1, address(this));
   226	
   227	        bytes memory decreaseLiquidityParams = abi.encode(actions, params);
   228	        POSITION_MANAGER.modifyLiquidities(decreaseLiquidityParams, block.timestamp);
   229	
   230	        // Get the balances, token0 might be native ETH.
   231	        uint256 balance0 = currency0.balanceOfSelf();
   232	        uint256 balance1 = ERC20(position.tokens[1]).balanceOf(address(this));
   233	
   234	        // Calculate claim fees.
   235	        fees[0] += (balance0 - balances[0]).mulDivDown(claimFee, 1e18);
   236	        fees[1] += (balance1 - balances[1]).mulDivDown(claimFee, 1e18);
   237	
   238	        emit YieldClaimed(msg.sender, position.tokens[0], balance0 - balances[0]);
   239	        emit YieldClaimed(msg.sender, position.tokens[1], balance1 - balances[1]);
   240	
   241	        // Update the balances.
   242	        balances[0] = balance0;
   243	        balances[1] = balance1;
   244	    }
   245	
   246	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   247	                          STAKING LOGIC
   248	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   249	
   250	    /**
   251	     * @notice Stakes a Liquidity Position.
   252	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens.

   255	     */
   256	    function _stake(uint256[] memory balances, address, PositionState memory position) internal virtual override {
   257	        // If token0 is in native ETH, wrap it.
   258	        if (position.tokens[0] == address(0)) {
   259	            position.tokens[0] = WETH;
   260	            IWETH(payable(WETH)).deposit{ value: balances[0] }();

   264	    /**
   265	     * @notice Unstakes a Liquidity Position.
   266	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens.
   267	     * param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   268	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   269	     */
   270	    function _unstake(uint256[] memory balances, address, PositionState memory position) internal virtual override {
   271	        // If token0 is in native ETH, and weth was withdrawn from the account, unwrap it.
   272	        if (position.tokens[0] == address(0)) {
   273	            uint256 wethBalance = ERC20(WETH).balanceOf(address(this));
   274	            if (wethBalance > 0) {
   275	                IWETH(WETH).withdraw(wethBalance);
   276	                balances[0] += wethBalance;
   277	            }
   278	        }
   279	    }
   280	
   281	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   282	                             BURN LOGIC
   283	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   284	
   285	    /**
   286	     * @notice Burns the Liquidity Position.
   287	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens.
   288	     * param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   289	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   290	     * @dev Does not emit YieldClaimed event, if necessary first call _claim() to emit the event before unstaking.
   291	     */
   292	    function _burn(uint256[] memory balances, address, PositionState memory position) internal virtual override {
   293	        // Cache the currencies.
   294	        Currency currency0 = Currency.wrap(position.tokens[0]);
   295	        Currency currency1 = Currency.wrap(position.tokens[1]);
   296	
   297	        // Generate calldata to burn the position and collect the underlying assets.
   298	        bytes memory actions = new bytes(2);
   299	        actions[0] = bytes1(uint8(Actions.BURN_POSITION));
   300	        actions[1] = bytes1(uint8(Actions.TAKE_PAIR));
   301	        bytes[] memory params = new bytes[](2);
   302	        params[0] = abi.encode(position.id, 0, 0, "");
   303	        params[1] = abi.encode(currency0, currency1, address(this));
   304	
   305	        bytes memory burnParams = abi.encode(actions, params);
   306	        POSITION_MANAGER.modifyLiquidities(burnParams, block.timestamp);
   307	
   308	        // Update the balances, token0 might be native ETH.
   309	        balances[0] = currency0.balanceOfSelf();
   310	        balances[1] = ERC20(position.tokens[1]).balanceOf(address(this));
   311	    }
   312	
   313	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   314	                    DECREASE LIQUIDITY LOGIC
   315	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   316	
   317	    /**
   318	     * @notice Decreases liquidity of the Liquidity Position.
   319	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens.
   320	     * param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   321	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   322	     * @param liquidity The amount of liquidity to decrease.
   323	     * @dev Must update the balances and delta liquidity after the decrease.
   324	     */
   325	    function _decreaseLiquidity(uint256[] memory balances, address, PositionState memory position, uint128 liquidity)
   326	        internal
   327	        virtual
   328	        override
   329	    {
   330	        // Cache the currencies.
   331	        Currency currency0 = Currency.wrap(position.tokens[0]);
   332	        Currency currency1 = Currency.wrap(position.tokens[1]);
   333	
   334	        // Generate calldata to burn the position and collect the underlying assets.
   335	        bytes memory actions = new bytes(2);
   336	        actions[0] = bytes1(uint8(Actions.DECREASE_LIQUIDITY));
   337	        actions[1] = bytes1(uint8(Actions.TAKE_PAIR));
   338	        bytes[] memory params = new bytes[](2);
   339	        params[0] = abi.encode(position.id, liquidity, 0, 0, "");
   340	        params[1] = abi.encode(currency0, currency1, address(this));
   341	
   342	        bytes memory decreaseLiquidityParams = abi.encode(actions, params);
   343	        POSITION_MANAGER.modifyLiquidities(decreaseLiquidityParams, block.timestamp);
   344	
   345	        // Update the balances, token0 might be native ETH.
   346	        balances[0] = currency0.balanceOfSelf();
   347	        balances[1] = ERC20(position.tokens[1]).balanceOf(address(this));
   348	    }
   349	
   350	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   351	                             SWAP LOGIC
   352	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   353	
   354	    /**
   355	     * @notice Swaps one token for another, directly through the pool itself.
   356	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens.
   357	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   358	     * @param zeroToOne Bool indicating if token0 has to be swapped to token1 or opposite.
   359	     * @param amountOut The amount of tokenOut that must be swapped to.
   360	     */
   361	    // forge-lint: disable-next-item(unsafe-typecast)
   362	    function _swapViaPool(uint256[] memory balances, PositionState memory position, bool zeroToOne, uint256 amountOut)
   363	        internal
   364	        virtual
   365	        override
   366	    {
   367	        // Do the swap.
   368	        bytes memory swapData = abi.encode(
   369	            SwapParams({
   370	                zeroForOne: zeroToOne,
   371	                amountSpecified: int256(amountOut),
   372	                sqrtPriceLimitX96: zeroToOne ? CLMath.MIN_SQRT_PRICE_LIMIT : CLMath.MAX_SQRT_PRICE_LIMIT
   373	            }),
   374	            PoolKey({
   375	                currency0: Currency.wrap(position.tokens[0]),
   376	                currency1: Currency.wrap(position.tokens[1]),
   377	                fee: position.fee,
   378	                tickSpacing: position.tickSpacing,
   379	                hooks: IHooks(position.pool)
   380	            })
   381	        );
   382	        bytes memory results = POOL_MANAGER.unlock(swapData);
   383	
   384	        // Update the balances.
   385	        BalanceDelta swapDelta = abi.decode(results, (BalanceDelta));
   386	        balances[0] = zeroToOne
   387	            ? balances[0] - uint256(-int256(swapDelta.amount0()))
   388	            : balances[0] + uint256(int256(swapDelta.amount0()));
   389	        balances[1] = zeroToOne
   390	            ? balances[1] + uint256(int256(swapDelta.amount1()))
   391	            : balances[1] - uint256(-int256(swapDelta.amount1()));
   392	    }
   393	
   394	    /**
   395	     * @notice Callback function executed during the unlock phase of a Uniswap V4 pool operation.
   396	     * @param data The encoded swap parameters and pool key.
   397	     * @return results The encoded BalanceDelta result from the swap operation.
   398	     */
   399	    function unlockCallback(bytes calldata data) external payable virtual returns (bytes memory results) {
   400	        if (msg.sender != address(POOL_MANAGER)) revert OnlyPoolManager();
   401	
   402	        (SwapParams memory params, PoolKey memory poolKey) = abi.decode(data, (SwapParams, PoolKey));
   403	
   404	        // Do the swap.
   405	        BalanceDelta delta = POOL_MANAGER.swap(poolKey, params, "");
   406	        results = abi.encode(delta);
   407	
   408	        // Processes token balance changes.
   409	        _processSwapDelta(delta, poolKey.currency0, poolKey.currency1);
   410	    }
   411	
   412	    /**
   413	     * @notice Processes token balance changes resulting from a swap operation.
   414	     * @param delta The BalanceDelta containing the positive/negative changes in token amounts.
   415	     * @param currency0 The address of the first token in the pair.
   416	     * @param currency1 The address of the second token in the pair.
   417	     * @dev Handles token transfers between the contract and the Pool Manager based on delta values:
   418	     *  - For tokens owed to the Pool Manager: transfers tokens and calls settle().
   419	     *  - For tokens owed from the Pool Manager: calls take() to receive tokens.
   420	     */
   421	    function _processSwapDelta(BalanceDelta delta, Currency currency0, Currency currency1) internal {
   422	        // Transfer tokens owed to the Pool Manager.
   423	        if (delta.amount0() < 0) {
   424	            POOL_MANAGER.sync(currency0);
   425	            if (currency0.isAddressZero()) {
   426	                POOL_MANAGER.settle{ value: uint128(-delta.amount0()) }();
   427	            } else {
   428	                // Transfer is properly handled by Currency library.
   429	                // forge-lint: disable-next-line(erc20-unchecked-transfer)
   430	                currency0.transfer(address(POOL_MANAGER), uint128(-delta.amount0()));
   431	                POOL_MANAGER.settle();
   432	            }
   433	        }
   434	        if (delta.amount1() < 0) {
   435	            POOL_MANAGER.sync(currency1);
   436	            // Transfer is properly handled by Currency library.
   437	            // forge-lint: disable-next-line(erc20-unchecked-transfer)
   438	            currency1.transfer(address(POOL_MANAGER), uint128(-delta.amount1()));
   439	            POOL_MANAGER.settle();
   440	        }
   441	
   442	        // Withdraw tokens that the Pool Manager owes.
   443	        if (delta.amount0() > 0) {
   444	            POOL_MANAGER.take(currency0, (address(this)), uint128(delta.amount0()));
   445	        }
   446	        if (delta.amount1() > 0) {
   447	            POOL_MANAGER.take(currency1, address(this), uint128(delta.amount1()));
   448	        }
   449	    }
   450	
   451	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   452	                             MINT LOGIC
   453	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   454	
   455	    /**
   456	     * @notice Mints a new Liquidity Position.
   457	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens.
   458	     * param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   459	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   460	     * @param amount0Desired The desired amount of token0 to mint as liquidity.
   461	     * @param amount1Desired The desired amount of token1 to mint as liquidity.
   462	     */
   463	    function _mint(
   464	        uint256[] memory balances,
   465	        address,
   466	        PositionState memory position,
   467	        uint256 amount0Desired,
   468	        uint256 amount1Desired
   469	    ) internal virtual override {
   470	        // Check if token0 is native ETH.
   471	        bool isNative = position.tokens[0] == address(0);
   472	
   473	        // Handle approvals.
   474	        if (!isNative) _checkAndApprovePermit2(position.tokens[0]);
   475	        _checkAndApprovePermit2(position.tokens[1]);
   476	
   477	        // Get new token id.
   478	        position.id = POSITION_MANAGER.nextTokenId();
   479	
   480	        // Calculate liquidity to be added.
   481	        position.liquidity = LiquidityAmounts.getLiquidityForAmounts(
   482	            uint160(position.sqrtPrice),
   483	            TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(position.tickLower),
   484	            TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(position.tickUpper),
   485	            amount0Desired,
   486	            amount1Desired
   487	        );
   488	
   489	        // Cache the pool key.
   490	        PoolKey memory poolKey = PoolKey({
   491	            currency0: Currency.wrap(position.tokens[0]),
   492	            currency1: Currency.wrap(position.tokens[1]),
   493	            fee: position.fee,
   494	            tickSpacing: position.tickSpacing,
   495	            hooks: IHooks(position.pool)
   496	        });
   497	
   498	        // Generate calldata to mint new position.
   499	        bytes memory actions = new bytes(3);
   500	        actions[0] = bytes1(uint8(Actions.MINT_POSITION));
   501	        actions[1] = bytes1(uint8(Actions.SETTLE_PAIR));
   502	        actions[2] = bytes1(uint8(Actions.SWEEP));
   503	        bytes[] memory params = new bytes[](3);
   504	        params[0] = abi.encode(
   505	            poolKey,
   506	            position.tickLower,
   507	            position.tickUpper,
   508	            position.liquidity,
   509	            type(uint128).max,
   510	            type(uint128).max,
   511	            address(this),
   512	            ""
   513	        );
   514	        params[1] = abi.encode(poolKey.currency0, poolKey.currency1);
   515	        params[2] = abi.encode(poolKey.currency0, address(this));
   516	
   517	        // Mint the new position.
   518	        uint256 ethValue = isNative ? amount0Desired : 0;
   519	        bytes memory mintParams = abi.encode(actions, params);
   520	        POSITION_MANAGER.modifyLiquidities{ value: ethValue }(mintParams, block.timestamp);
   521	
   522	        // Update the balances, token0 might be native ETH.
   523	        balances[0] = poolKey.currency0.balanceOfSelf();
   524	        balances[1] = ERC20(position.tokens[1]).balanceOf(address(this));
   525	    }
   526	
   527	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   528	                    INCREASE LIQUIDITY LOGIC
   529	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   530	
   531	    /**
   532	     * @notice Increases liquidity of the Liquidity Position.
   533	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens.
   534	     * param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   535	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   536	     * @param amount0Desired The desired amount of token0 to add as liquidity.
   537	     * @param amount1Desired The desired amount of token1 to add as liquidity.
   538	     */
   539	    function _increaseLiquidity(
   540	        uint256[] memory balances,
   541	        address,
   542	        PositionState memory position,
   543	        uint256 amount0Desired,
   544	        uint256 amount1Desired
   545	    ) internal virtual override {
   546	        // Check if token0 is native ETH.
   547	        bool isNative = position.tokens[0] == address(0);
   548	
   549	        // Handle approvals.
   550	        if (!isNative) _checkAndApprovePermit2(position.tokens[0]);
   551	        _checkAndApprovePermit2(position.tokens[1]);
   552	
   553	        // Calculate liquidity to be added.
   554	        position.liquidity = LiquidityAmounts.getLiquidityForAmounts(
   555	            uint160(position.sqrtPrice),
   556	            TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(position.tickLower),
   557	            TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(position.tickUpper),
   558	            amount0Desired,
   559	            amount1Desired
   560	        );
   561	
   562	        // Cache the currencies.
   563	        Currency currency0 = Currency.wrap(position.tokens[0]);
   564	        Currency currency1 = Currency.wrap(position.tokens[1]);
   565	
   566	        // Generate calldata to mint new position.
   567	        bytes memory actions = new bytes(3);
   568	        actions[0] = bytes1(uint8(Actions.INCREASE_LIQUIDITY));
   569	        actions[1] = bytes1(uint8(Actions.SETTLE_PAIR));
   570	        actions[2] = bytes1(uint8(Actions.SWEEP));
   571	        bytes[] memory params = new bytes[](3);
   572	        params[0] = abi.encode(position.id, position.liquidity, type(uint128).max, type(uint128).max, "");
   573	        params[1] = abi.encode(currency0, currency1);
   574	        params[2] = abi.encode(currency0, address(this));
   575	
   576	        // Mint the new position.
   577	        uint256 ethValue = isNative ? amount0Desired : 0;
   578	        bytes memory increaseLiquidityParams = abi.encode(actions, params);
   579	        POSITION_MANAGER.modifyLiquidities{ value: ethValue }(increaseLiquidityParams, block.timestamp);
   580	
   581	        // Update the balances, token0 might be native ETH.
   582	        balances[0] = currency0.balanceOfSelf();
   583	        balances[1] = ERC20(position.tokens[1]).balanceOf(address(this));
   584	    }
   585	
   586	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   587	                               HELPERS
   588	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   589	
   590	    /**
   591	     * @notice Ensures that the Permit2 contract has sufficient approval to spend a given token.
   592	     * @param token The contract address of the token.
   593	     */
   594	    function _checkAndApprovePermit2(address token) internal {
   595	        if (!approved[token]) {
   596	            approved[token] = true;
   597	            ERC20(token).safeApproveWithRetry(address(PERMIT_2), type(uint256).max);
   598	            PERMIT_2.approve(token, address(POSITION_MANAGER), type(uint160).max, type(uint48).max);
   599	        }
   600	    }
   601	
   602	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   603	                      NATIVE ETH HANDLER
   604	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   605	
   606	    /**
   607	     * @notice Receives native ether.
   608	     */
   609	    receive() external payable { }
   610	}
```

```solidity
    23	/**
    24	 * @title Abstract Compounder for Concentrated Liquidity Positions.
    25	 * @author Pragma Labs
    26	 * @notice The Compounder will act as an Asset Manager for Arcadia Accounts.
    27	 * It will allow third parties (initiators) to trigger the compounding functionality for a Liquidity Position in the Account.
    28	 * The Arcadia Account owner must set a specific initiator that will be permissioned to compound the positions in their Account.
    29	 * Compounding can only be triggered if certain conditions are met and the initiator will get a small fee for the service provided.
    30	 * The compounding will collect the fees earned by a position and increase the liquidity of the position by those fees.
    31	 * Depending on current tick of the pool and the position range, fees will be deposited in appropriate ratio.
    32	 * @dev The initiator will provide a trusted sqrtPrice input at the time of compounding to mitigate frontrunning risks.
    33	 * This input serves as a reference point for calculating the maximum allowed deviation during the compounding process,
    34	 * ensuring that the execution remains within a controlled price range.
    35	 */
    36	abstract contract Compounder is IActionBase, AbstractBase, Guardian {
    37	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    38	    using SafeApprove for ERC20;
    39	    using SafeTransferLib for ERC20;
    40	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    41	                                CONSTANTS
    42	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    43	
    44	    // The contract address of the Arcadia Factory.
    45	    IArcadiaFactory internal immutable ARCADIA_FACTORY;
    46	
    47	    // The contract address of the Router Trampoline.
    48	    IRouterTrampoline internal immutable ROUTER_TRAMPOLINE;
    49	
    50	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    51	                                STORAGE
    52	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    53	
    54	    // The Account to compound the fees for, used as transient storage.
    55	    address internal account;
    56	
    57	    // A mapping from account to account specific information.
    58	    mapping(address account => AccountInfo) public accountInfo;
    59	
    60	    // A mapping from account to custom metadata.
    61	    mapping(address account => bytes data) public metaData;
    62	
    63	    // A mapping that sets the approved initiator per owner per account.
    64	    mapping(address accountOwner => mapping(address account => address initiator)) public accountToInitiator;
    65	
    66	    // A struct with the account specific parameters.
    67	    struct AccountInfo {
    68	        // The maximum fee charged on the claimed fees of the liquidity position, with 18 decimals precision.
    69	        uint64 maxClaimFee;
    70	        // The maximum fee charged on the ideal (without slippage) amountIn by the initiator, with 18 decimals precision.
    71	        uint64 maxSwapFee;
    72	        // The maximum relative deviation the pool can have from the trustedSqrtPrice, with 18 decimals precision.
    73	        uint64 upperSqrtPriceDeviation;
    74	        // The minimum relative deviation the pool can have from the trustedSqrtPrice, with 18 decimals precision.
    75	        uint64 lowerSqrtPriceDeviation;
    76	        // The ratio that limits the amount of slippage of the swap, with 18 decimals precision.
    77	        uint64 minLiquidityRatio;
    78	    }
    79	
    80	    // A struct with the initiator parameters.
    81	    struct InitiatorParams {
    82	        // The contract address of the position manager.
    83	        address positionManager;
    84	        // The id of the position.
    85	        uint96 id;
    86	        // The amount of token0 withdrawn from the account.
    87	        uint128 amount0;
    88	        // The amount of token1 withdrawn from the account.
    89	        uint128 amount1;
    90	        // The sqrtPrice the pool should have, given by the initiator.
    91	        uint256 trustedSqrtPrice;
    92	        // The fee charged on the claimed fees of the liquidity position, with 18 decimals precision.
    93	        uint64 claimFee;
    94	        // The fee charged on the ideal (without slippage) amountIn by the initiator, with 18 decimals precision.
    95	        uint64 swapFee;
    96	        // Calldata provided by the initiator to execute the swap.
    97	        bytes swapData;
    98	    }
    99	
   100	    // A struct with cached variables.
   101	    struct Cache {

   103	        uint256 lowerBoundSqrtPrice;
   104	        // The lower bound the sqrtPrice can have for the pool to be balanced.

   107	        uint160 sqrtRatioLower;

   134	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

   137	
   138	    /**
   139	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.

   141	     * @param routerTrampoline The contract address of the Router Trampoline.

   143	    constructor(address owner_, address arcadiaFactory, address routerTrampoline) Guardian(owner_) {

   151	
   152	    /**
   153	     * @notice Optional hook called by the Arcadia Account when calling "setAssetManager()".
   154	     * @param accountOwner The current owner of the Arcadia Account.
   155	     * param status Bool indicating if the Asset Manager is enabled or disabled.

   160	    function onSetAssetManager(address accountOwner, bool, bytes calldata data) external {
   161	        if (account != address(0)) revert Reentered();
   162	        if (!ARCADIA_FACTORY.isAccount(msg.sender)) revert NotAnAccount();
   163	
   164	        (

   177	    /**
   178	     * @notice Sets the required information for an Account.
   179	     * @param account_ The contract address of the Arcadia Account to set the information for.

   181	     * @param maxClaimFee The maximum fee charged on claimed fees/rewards by the initiator, with 18 decimals precision.
   182	     * @param maxSwapFee The maximum fee charged on the ideal (without slippage) amountIn by the initiator, with 18 decimals precision.
   183	     * @param maxTolerance The maximum allowed deviation of the actual pool price for any initiator,
   184	     * relative to the price calculated with trusted external prices of both assets, with 18 decimals precision.
   185	     * @param minLiquidityRatio The ratio of the minimum amount of liquidity that must be minted,
   186	     * relative to the hypothetical amount of liquidity when we rebalance without slippage, with 18 decimals precision.
   187	     * @param metaData_ Custom metadata to be stored with the account.
   188	     */
   189	    function setAccountInfo(
   190	        address account_,
   191	        address initiator,
   192	        uint256 maxClaimFee,
   193	        uint256 maxSwapFee,
   194	        uint256 maxTolerance,
   195	        uint256 minLiquidityRatio,
   196	        bytes calldata metaData_
   197	    ) external {
   198	        if (account != address(0)) revert Reentered();
   199	        if (!ARCADIA_FACTORY.isAccount(account_)) revert NotAnAccount();
   200	        address accountOwner = IAccount(account_).owner();
   201	        if (msg.sender != accountOwner) revert OnlyAccountOwner();
   202	        // Block Account versions without cross account reentrancy guard.
   203	        if (IAccount(account_).ACCOUNT_VERSION() < 3) revert InvalidAccountVersion();
   204	
   205	        _setAccountInfo(
   206	            account_, accountOwner, initiator, maxClaimFee, maxSwapFee, maxTolerance, minLiquidityRatio, metaData_
   207	        );
   208	    }
   209	
   210	    /**
   211	     * @notice Sets the required information for an Account.
   212	     * @param account_ The contract address of the Arcadia Account to set the information for.
   213	     * @param accountOwner The current owner of the Arcadia Account.
   214	     * @param initiator The address of the initiator.
   215	     * @param maxClaimFee The maximum fee charged on claimed fees/rewards by the initiator, with 18 decimals precision.
   216	     * @param maxSwapFee The maximum fee charged on the ideal (without slippage) amountIn by the initiator, with 18 decimals precision.
   217	     * @param maxTolerance The maximum allowed deviation of the actual pool price for any initiator,
   218	     * relative to the price calculated with trusted external prices of both assets, with 18 decimals precision.
   219	     * @param minLiquidityRatio The ratio of the minimum amount of liquidity that must be minted,
   220	     * relative to the hypothetical amount of liquidity when we rebalance without slippage, with 18 decimals precision.
   221	     * @param metaData_ Custom metadata to be stored with the account.
   222	     */
   223	    function _setAccountInfo(
   224	        address account_,
   225	        address accountOwner,
   226	        address initiator,
   227	        uint256 maxClaimFee,
   228	        uint256 maxSwapFee,
   229	        uint256 maxTolerance,
   230	        uint256 minLiquidityRatio,
   231	        bytes memory metaData_
   232	    ) internal {
   233	        if (maxClaimFee > 1e18 || maxSwapFee > 1e18 || maxTolerance > 1e18 || minLiquidityRatio > 1e18) {
   234	            revert InvalidValue();
   235	        }
   236	
   237	        accountToInitiator[accountOwner][account_] = initiator;
   238	        // unsafe cast: fees <= 1e18 < type(uint64).max.
   239	        // unsafe cast: upperSqrtPriceDeviation <= √2 * 1e18 < type(uint64).max.
   240	        // forge-lint: disable-next-item(unsafe-typecast)
   241	        accountInfo[account_] = AccountInfo({
   242	            maxClaimFee: uint64(maxClaimFee),
   243	            maxSwapFee: uint64(maxSwapFee),
   244	            upperSqrtPriceDeviation: uint64(FixedPointMathLib.sqrt((1e18 + maxTolerance) * 1e18)),
   245	            lowerSqrtPriceDeviation: uint64(FixedPointMathLib.sqrt((1e18 - maxTolerance) * 1e18)),
   246	            minLiquidityRatio: uint64(minLiquidityRatio)
   247	        });
   248	        metaData[account_] = metaData_;
   249	
   250	        emit AccountInfoSet(account_, initiator);
   251	    }
   252	
   253	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   254	                             COMPOUND LOGIC
   255	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   256	
   257	    /**
   258	     * @notice Compounds a Concentrated Liquidity Positions, owned by an Arcadia Account.
   259	     * @param account_ The contract address of the account.
   260	     * @param initiatorParams A struct with the initiator parameters.
   261	     */
   262	    function compound(address account_, InitiatorParams calldata initiatorParams) external whenNotPaused {
   263	        // Store Account address, used to validate the caller of the executeAction() callback and serves as a reentrancy guard.
   264	        if (account != address(0)) revert Reentered();
   265	        account = account_;
   266	
   267	        // If the initiator is set, account_ is an actual Arcadia Account.
   268	        if (accountToInitiator[IAccount(account_).owner()][account_] != msg.sender) revert InvalidInitiator();
   269	        if (!isPositionManager(initiatorParams.positionManager)) revert InvalidPositionManager();
   270	
   271	        // If leftovers have to be withdrawn from account, get token0 and token1.
   272	        address token0;
   273	        address token1;
   274	        if (initiatorParams.amount0 > 0 || initiatorParams.amount1 > 0) {
   275	            (token0, token1) = _getUnderlyingTokens(initiatorParams.positionManager, initiatorParams.id);
   276	        }
   277	
   278	        // Encode data for the flash-action.
   279	        bytes memory actionData = ArcadiaLogic._encodeAction(
   280	            initiatorParams.positionManager,
   281	            initiatorParams.id,
   282	            token0,
   283	            token1,
   284	            initiatorParams.amount0,
   285	            initiatorParams.amount1,
   286	            abi.encode(msg.sender, initiatorParams)
   287	        );
   288	
   289	        // Call flashAction() with this contract as actionTarget.
   290	        IAccount(account_).flashAction(address(this), actionData);
   291	
   292	        // Reset account.
   293	        account = address(0);
   294	    }
   295	
   296	    /**
   297	     * @notice Callback function called by the Arcadia Account during the flashAction.
   298	     * @param actionTargetData A bytes object containing the initiator and initiatorParams.
   299	     * @return depositData A struct with the asset data of the Liquidity Position and with the leftovers after mint, if any.
   300	     * @dev The Liquidity Position is already transferred to this contract before executeAction() is called.
   301	     * @dev When rebalancing we will burn the current Liquidity Position and mint a new one with a new tokenId.
   302	     */
   303	    function executeAction(bytes calldata actionTargetData) external override returns (ActionData memory depositData) {
   304	        // Caller should be the Account, provided as input in rebalance().
   305	        if (msg.sender != account) revert OnlyAccount();
   306	
   307	        // Cache accountInfo.
   308	        AccountInfo memory accountInfo_ = accountInfo[msg.sender];
   309	
   310	        // Decode actionTargetData.
   311	        (address initiator, InitiatorParams memory initiatorParams) =
   312	            abi.decode(actionTargetData, (address, InitiatorParams));
   313	        address positionManager = initiatorParams.positionManager;
   314	
   315	        // Validate initiatorParams.
   316	        if (initiatorParams.claimFee > accountInfo_.maxClaimFee || initiatorParams.swapFee > accountInfo_.maxSwapFee) {
   317	            revert InvalidValue();
   318	        }
   319	
   320	        // Get all pool and position related state.
   321	        PositionState memory position = _getPositionState(positionManager, initiatorParams.id);
   322	
   323	        // Compounder has withdrawn the underlying tokens from the Account.
   324	        uint256[] memory balances = new uint256[](position.tokens.length);
   325	        balances[0] = initiatorParams.amount0;
   326	        balances[1] = initiatorParams.amount1;
   327	        uint256[] memory fees = new uint256[](balances.length);
   328	
   329	        // Cache variables that are gas expensive to calculate and used multiple times.
   330	        Cache memory cache = _getCache(accountInfo_, position, initiatorParams.trustedSqrtPrice);
   331	
   332	        // Check that pool is initially balanced.
   333	        // Prevents sandwiching attacks when swapping and/or adding liquidity.
   334	        if (!isPoolBalanced(position.sqrtPrice, cache)) revert UnbalancedPool();
   335	
   336	        // Claim pending yields and update balances.
   337	        _claim(balances, fees, positionManager, position, initiatorParams.claimFee);
   338	
   339	        // If the position is staked, unstake it.
   340	        _unstake(balances, positionManager, position);
   341	
   342	        // Get the rebalance parameters, based on a hypothetical swap through the pool itself without slippage.
   343	        RebalanceParams memory rebalanceParams = RebalanceLogic._getRebalanceParams(
   344	            accountInfo_.minLiquidityRatio,
   345	            position.fee,
   346	            initiatorParams.swapFee,
   347	            position.sqrtPrice,
   348	            cache.sqrtRatioLower,
   349	            cache.sqrtRatioUpper,
   350	            balances[0] - fees[0],
   351	            balances[1] - fees[1]
   352	        );
   353	        if (rebalanceParams.zeroToOne) fees[0] += rebalanceParams.amountInitiatorFee;
   354	        else fees[1] += rebalanceParams.amountInitiatorFee;
   355	
   356	        // Do the swap to rebalance the position.
   357	        // This can be done either directly through the pool, or via a router with custom swap data.
   358	        // For swaps directly through the pool, if slippage is bigger than calculated, the transaction will not immediately revert,
   359	        // but excess slippage will be subtracted from the initiatorFee.
   360	        // For swaps via a router, tokenOut should be the limiting factor when increasing liquidity.
   361	        // Update balances after the swap.
   362	        _swap(balances, fees, initiatorParams, position, rebalanceParams, cache);
   363	
   364	        // Check that the pool is still balanced after the swap.
   365	        // Since the swap went potentially through the pool itself (but does not have to),
   366	        // the sqrtPrice might have moved and brought the pool out of balance.
   367	        position.sqrtPrice = _getSqrtPrice(position);
   368	        if (!isPoolBalanced(position.sqrtPrice, cache)) revert UnbalancedPool();
   369	
   370	        // As explained before _swap(), tokenOut should be the limiting factor when increasing liquidity
   371	        // therefore we only subtract the initiator fee from the amountOut, not from the amountIn.
   372	        // Increase liquidity, update balances and delta liquidity.
   373	        (uint256 amount0Desired, uint256 amount1Desired) =
   374	            rebalanceParams.zeroToOne ? (balances[0], balances[1] - fees[1]) : (balances[0] - fees[0], balances[1]);
   375	        // Increase liquidity, update balances and liquidity
   376	        _increaseLiquidity(balances, positionManager, position, amount0Desired, amount1Desired);
   377	
   378	        // Check that the actual liquidity of the position is above the minimum threshold.
   379	        // This prevents loss of principal of the liquidity position due to slippage,
   380	        // or malicious initiators who remove liquidity during a custom swap.
   381	        if (position.liquidity < rebalanceParams.minLiquidity) revert InsufficientLiquidity();
   382	
   383	        // If the position was staked, stake it.
   384	        _stake(balances, positionManager, position);
   385	
   386	        // Approve the liquidity position and leftovers to be deposited back into the Account.
   387	        // And transfer the initiator fees to the initiator.
   388	        uint256 count = _approveAndTransfer(initiator, balances, fees, positionManager, position);
   389	
   390	        // Encode deposit data for the flash-action.
   391	        depositData = ArcadiaLogic._encodeDeposit(positionManager, position.id, position.tokens, balances, count);
   392	
   393	        emit Compound(msg.sender, positionManager, position.id);
   394	    }
   395	
   396	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   397	                            POSITION VALIDATION
   398	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   399	
   400	    /**
   401	     * @notice Returns if the pool of a Liquidity Position is balanced.
   402	     * @param sqrtPrice The sqrtPrice of the pool.
   403	     * @param cache A struct with cached variables.
   404	     * @return isBalanced Bool indicating if the pool is balanced.
   405	     */
   406	    function isPoolBalanced(uint256 sqrtPrice, Cache memory cache) public pure returns (bool isBalanced) {
   407	        // Check if current price of the Pool is within accepted tolerance of the calculated trusted price.
   408	        isBalanced = sqrtPrice > cache.lowerBoundSqrtPrice && sqrtPrice < cache.upperBoundSqrtPrice;
   409	    }
   410	
   411	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   412	                              GETTERS
   413	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   414	
   415	    /**
   416	     * @notice Returns the cached variables.
   417	     * @param accountInfo_ A struct with the account specific parameters.
   418	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   419	     * @param trustedSqrtPrice The sqrtPrice the pool should have, given by the initiator.
   420	     * @return cache A struct with cached variables.
   421	     */
   422	    function _getCache(AccountInfo memory accountInfo_, PositionState memory position, uint256 trustedSqrtPrice)
   423	        internal
   424	        view
   425	        virtual
   426	        returns (Cache memory cache)
   427	    {
   428	        // We do not handle the edge cases where the bounds of the sqrtPrice exceed MIN_SQRT_RATIO or MAX_SQRT_RATIO.
   429	        // This will result in a revert during swapViaPool, if ever needed a different Compounder has to be deployed.
   430	        cache = Cache({
   431	            lowerBoundSqrtPrice: trustedSqrtPrice.mulDivDown(accountInfo_.lowerSqrtPriceDeviation, 1e18),
   432	            upperBoundSqrtPrice: trustedSqrtPrice.mulDivDown(accountInfo_.upperSqrtPriceDeviation, 1e18),
   433	            sqrtRatioLower: TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(position.tickLower),
   434	            sqrtRatioUpper: TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(position.tickUpper)
   435	        });
   436	    }
   437	
   438	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   439	                             SWAP LOGIC
   440	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   441	
   442	    /**
   443	     * @notice Swaps one token for another to rebalance the Liquidity Position.
   444	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens held by the Compounder.
   445	     * @param fees The fees of the underlying tokens to be paid to the initiator.
   446	     * @param initiatorParams A struct with the initiator parameters.
   447	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   448	     * @param rebalanceParams A struct with the rebalance parameters.
   449	     * @param cache A struct with cached variables.
   450	     * @dev Must update the balances and sqrtPrice after the swap.
   451	     */
   452	    function _swap(
   453	        uint256[] memory balances,
   454	        uint256[] memory fees,
   455	        InitiatorParams memory initiatorParams,
   456	        PositionState memory position,
   457	        RebalanceParams memory rebalanceParams,
   458	        Cache memory cache
   459	    ) internal virtual {
   460	        // Don't do swaps with zero amount.
   461	        if (rebalanceParams.amountIn == 0) return;
   462	
   463	        // Do the actual swap to rebalance the position.
   464	        // This can be done either directly through the pool, or via a router with custom swap data.
   465	        if (initiatorParams.swapData.length == 0) {
   466	            // Calculate a more accurate amountOut, with slippage.
   467	            uint256 amountOut = RebalanceOptimizationMath._getAmountOutWithSlippage(
   468	                rebalanceParams.zeroToOne,
   469	                position.fee,
   470	                _getPoolLiquidity(position),
   471	                uint160(position.sqrtPrice),
   472	                cache.sqrtRatioLower,
   473	                cache.sqrtRatioUpper,
   474	                balances[0] - fees[0],
   475	                balances[1] - fees[1],
   476	                rebalanceParams.amountIn,
   477	                rebalanceParams.amountOut
   478	            );
   479	            // Don't do swaps with zero amount.
   480	            if (amountOut == 0) return;
   481	            _swapViaPool(balances, position, rebalanceParams.zeroToOne, amountOut);
   482	        } else {
   483	            _swapViaRouter(balances, position, rebalanceParams.zeroToOne, initiatorParams.swapData);
   484	        }
   485	    }
   486	
   487	    /**
   488	     * @notice Swaps one token for another, via a router with custom swap data.
   489	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens held by the Compounder.
   490	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   491	     * @param zeroToOne Bool indicating if token0 has to be swapped to token1 or opposite.
   492	     * @param swapData Arbitrary calldata provided by an initiator for the swap.
   493	     * @dev Initiator has to route swap in such a way that at least minLiquidity of liquidity is added to the position after the swap.
   494	     * And leftovers must be in tokenIn, otherwise the total tokenIn balance will be added as liquidity,
   495	     * and the initiator fee will be 0 (but the transaction will not revert).
   496	     */
   497	    function _swapViaRouter(
   498	        uint256[] memory balances,
   499	        PositionState memory position,
   500	        bool zeroToOne,
   501	        bytes memory swapData
   502	    ) internal virtual {
   503	        // Decode the swap data.
   504	        (address router, uint256 amountIn, bytes memory data) = abi.decode(swapData, (address, uint256, bytes));
   505	
   506	        (address tokenIn, address tokenOut) =
   507	            zeroToOne ? (position.tokens[0], position.tokens[1]) : (position.tokens[1], position.tokens[0]);
   508	
   509	        // Send tokens to the Router Trampoline.
   510	        ERC20(tokenIn).safeTransfer(address(ROUTER_TRAMPOLINE), amountIn);
   511	
   512	        // Execute swap.
   513	        (uint256 balanceIn, uint256 balanceOut) = ROUTER_TRAMPOLINE.execute(router, data, tokenIn, tokenOut, amountIn);
   514	
   515	        // Update the balances.
   516	        (balances[0], balances[1]) = zeroToOne
   517	            ? (balances[0] - amountIn + balanceIn, balances[1] + balanceOut)
   518	            : (balances[0] + balanceOut, balances[1] - amountIn + balanceIn);
   519	    }
   520	
   521	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   522	                    APPROVE AND TRANSFER LOGIC
   523	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   524	
   525	    /**
   526	     * @notice Approves the liquidity position and leftovers to be deposited back into the Account
   527	     * and transfers the initiator fees to the initiator.
   528	     * @param initiator The address of the initiator.
   529	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens held by the Compounder.
   530	     * @param fees The fees of the underlying tokens to be paid to the initiator.
   531	     * @param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   532	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   533	     * @return count The number of assets approved.
   534	     */
   535	    function _approveAndTransfer(
   536	        address initiator,
   537	        uint256[] memory balances,
   538	        uint256[] memory fees,
   539	        address positionManager,
   540	        PositionState memory position
   541	    ) internal returns (uint256 count) {
   542	        // Approve the Liquidity Position.
   543	        ERC721(positionManager).approve(msg.sender, position.id);
   544	
   545	        // Transfer Initiator fees and approve the leftovers.
   546	        address token;
   547	        count = 1;
   548	        for (uint256 i; i < balances.length; i++) {
   549	            token = position.tokens[i];
   550	            // If there are leftovers, deposit them back into the Account.
   551	            if (balances[i] > fees[i]) {
   552	                balances[i] = balances[i] - fees[i];
   553	                ERC20(token).safeApproveWithRetry(msg.sender, balances[i]);
   554	                count++;
   555	            } else {
   556	                fees[i] = balances[i];
   557	                balances[i] = 0;
   558	            }
   559	
   560	            // Transfer Initiator fees to the initiator.
   561	            if (fees[i] > 0) ERC20(token).safeTransfer(initiator, fees[i]);
   562	            emit FeePaid(msg.sender, initiator, token, fees[i]);
   563	        }
   564	    }
   565	
   566	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   567	                             SKIM LOGIC
   568	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   569	
   570	    /**
   571	     * @notice Recovers any native or ERC20 tokens left on the contract.
   572	     * @param token The contract address of the token, or address(0) for native tokens.
   573	     */
   574	    function skim(address token) external onlyOwner whenNotPaused {
   575	        if (account != address(0)) revert Reentered();
   576	
   577	        if (token == address(0)) {
   578	            (bool success, bytes memory result) = payable(msg.sender).call{ value: address(this).balance }("");
   579	            require(success, string(result));
   580	        } else {
   581	            ERC20(token).safeTransfer(msg.sender, ERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this)));
   582	        }
   583	    }
   584	}
```

```solidity
    10	/**
    11	 * @title Compounder for Slipstream Liquidity Positions.
    12	 * @author Pragma Labs
    13	 * @notice The Compounder will act as an Asset Manager for Arcadia Accounts.
    14	 * It will allow third parties (initiators) to trigger the compounding functionality for a Liquidity Position in the Account.
    15	 * The Arcadia Account owner must set a specific initiator that will be permissioned to compound the positions in their Account.
    16	 * Compounding can only be triggered if certain conditions are met and the initiator will get a small fee for the service provided.
    17	 * The compounding will collect the fees earned by a position and increase the liquidity of the position by those fees.
    18	 * Depending on current tick of the pool and the position range, fees will be deposited in appropriate ratio.
    19	 * @dev The initiator will provide a trusted sqrtPrice input at the time of compounding to mitigate frontrunning risks.
    20	 * This input serves as a reference point for calculating the maximum allowed deviation during the compounding process,
    21	 * ensuring that the execution remains within a controlled price range.
    22	 */
    23	contract CompounderSlipstream is Compounder, Slipstream {
    24	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    25	                                CONSTANTS
    26	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    27	
    28	    // The version of the Asset Manager.
    29	    string public constant VERSION = "2.1.0";
    30	
    31	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    32	                            CONSTRUCTOR
    33	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    34	
    35	    /**
    36	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    37	     * @param arcadiaFactory The contract address of the Arcadia Factory.
    38	     * @param routerTrampoline The contract address of the Router Trampoline.
    39	     * @param positionManager The contract address of the Slipstream Position Manager.
    40	     * @param cLFactory The contract address of the Slipstream Factory.
    41	     * @param poolImplementation The contract address of the Slipstream Pool Implementation.
    42	     * @param rewardToken The contract address of the Reward Token (Aero).
    43	     * @param stakedSlipstreamAm The contract address of the Staked Slipstream Asset Module.
    44	     * @param stakedSlipstreamWrapper The contract address of the Staked Slipstream Wrapper.
    45	     */
    46	    constructor(
    47	        address owner_,
    48	        address arcadiaFactory,
    49	        address routerTrampoline,
    50	        address positionManager,
    51	        address cLFactory,
    52	        address poolImplementation,
    53	        address rewardToken,
    54	        address stakedSlipstreamAm,
    55	        address stakedSlipstreamWrapper
    56	    )
    57	        Compounder(owner_, arcadiaFactory, routerTrampoline)
    58	        Slipstream(
    59	            positionManager, cLFactory, poolImplementation, rewardToken, stakedSlipstreamAm, stakedSlipstreamWrapper
    60	        )
    61	    { }
    62	}
```

```solidity
    11	import { UniswapV4 } from "../base/UniswapV4.sol";
    12	
    13	/**
    14	 * @title Compounder for Uniswap V4 Liquidity Positions.
    15	 * @author Pragma Labs
    16	 * @notice The Compounder will act as an Asset Manager for Arcadia Accounts.
    17	 * It will allow third parties (initiators) to trigger the compounding functionality for a Liquidity Position in the Account.
    18	 * The Arcadia Account owner must set a specific initiator that will be permissioned to compound the positions in their Account.
    19	 * Compounding can only be triggered if certain conditions are met and the initiator will get a small fee for the service provided.
    20	 * The compounding will collect the fees earned by a position and increase the liquidity of the position by those fees.
    21	 * Depending on current tick of the pool and the position range, fees will be deposited in appropriate ratio.
    22	 * @dev The initiator will provide a trusted sqrtPrice input at the time of compounding to mitigate frontrunning risks.
    23	 * This input serves as a reference point for calculating the maximum allowed deviation during the compounding process,
    24	 * ensuring that the execution remains within a controlled price range.
    25	 */
    26	contract CompounderUniswapV4 is Compounder, UniswapV4 {
    27	    using SafeTransferLib for ERC20;
    28	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    29	                                CONSTANTS
    30	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    31	
    32	    // The version of the Asset Manager.
    33	    string public constant VERSION = "2.1.0";
    34	
    35	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    36	                            CONSTRUCTOR
    37	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    38	
    39	    /**
    40	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    41	     * @param arcadiaFactory The contract address of the Arcadia Factory.
    42	     * @param routerTrampoline The contract address of the Router Trampoline.
    43	     * @param positionManager The contract address of the Uniswap v4 Position Manager.
    44	     * @param permit2 The contract address of Permit2.
    45	     * @param poolManager The contract address of the Uniswap v4 Pool Manager.
    46	     * @param weth The contract address of WETH.
    47	     */
    48	    constructor(
    49	        address owner_,
    50	        address arcadiaFactory,
    51	        address routerTrampoline,
    52	        address positionManager,
    53	        address permit2,
    54	        address poolManager,
    55	        address weth
    56	    ) Compounder(owner_, arcadiaFactory, routerTrampoline) UniswapV4(positionManager, permit2, poolManager, weth) { }
    57	
    58	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    59	                             SWAP LOGIC
    60	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    61	
    62	    /**
    63	     * @notice Swaps one token for another, via a router with custom swap data.
    64	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens.
    65	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
    66	     * @param zeroToOne Bool indicating if token0 has to be swapped to token1 or opposite.
    67	     * @param swapData Arbitrary calldata provided by an initiator for the swap.
    68	     * @dev Initiator has to route swap in such a way that at least minLiquidity of liquidity is added to the position after the swap.
    69	     * And leftovers must be in tokenIn, otherwise the total tokenIn balance will be added as liquidity,
    70	     * and the initiator fee will be 0 (but the transaction will not revert).
    71	     */
    72	    function _swapViaRouter(
    73	        uint256[] memory balances,
    74	        PositionState memory position,
    75	        bool zeroToOne,
    76	        bytes memory swapData
    77	    ) internal override {
    78	        // Decode the swap data.
    79	        (address router, uint256 amountIn, bytes memory data) = abi.decode(swapData, (address, uint256, bytes));
    80	
    81	        (address tokenIn, address tokenOut) =
    82	            zeroToOne ? (position.tokens[0], position.tokens[1]) : (position.tokens[1], position.tokens[0]);
    83	
    84	        // Handle pools with native ETH.
    85	        bool isNative = position.tokens[0] == address(0);
    86	        if (isNative) {
    87	            if (zeroToOne) {
    88	                tokenIn = WETH;
    89	                IWETH(WETH).deposit{ value: amountIn }();
    90	            } else {
    91	                tokenOut = WETH;
    92	            }
    93	        }
    94	
    95	        // Send tokens to the Router Trampoline.
    96	        ERC20(tokenIn).safeTransfer(address(ROUTER_TRAMPOLINE), amountIn);
    97	
    98	        // Execute swap.
    99	        (uint256 balanceIn, uint256 balanceOut) = ROUTER_TRAMPOLINE.execute(router, data, tokenIn, tokenOut, amountIn);
   100	
   101	        // Handle pools with native ETH.
   102	        if (isNative) {
   103	            uint256 wethBalance = zeroToOne ? balanceIn : balanceOut;
   104	            if (wethBalance > 0) IWETH(WETH).withdraw(wethBalance);
   105	        }
   106	
   107	        // Update the balances.
   108	        (balances[0], balances[1]) = zeroToOne
   109	            ? (balances[0] - amountIn + balanceIn, balances[1] + balanceOut)
   110	            : (balances[0] + balanceOut, balances[1] - amountIn + balanceIn);
   111	    }
   112	}
```

```solidity
     1	// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
     2	pragma solidity ^0.8.0;
```

```solidity
     1	/**

     7	interface IPermit2 {

    10	    /// @dev Setting amount to type(uint160).max sets an unlimited approval
    11	    struct PackedAllowance {
    12	        // amount allowed
    13	        uint160 amount;
    14	        // permission expiry
    15	        uint48 expiration;
    16	        // an incrementing value indexed per owner,token,and spender for each signature

    18	    }
    19	
    20	    /// @notice Approves the spender to use up to amount of the specified token up until the expiration
    21	    /// @param token The token to approve
    22	    /// @param spender The spender address to approve
    23	    /// @param amount The approved amount of the token
    24	    /// @param expiration The timestamp at which the approval is no longer valid
    25	    /// @dev The packed allowance also holds a nonce, which will stay unchanged in approve
    26	    /// @dev Setting amount to type(uint160).max sets an unlimited approval
    27	    function approve(address token, address spender, uint160 amount, uint48 expiration) external;
    28	
    29	    /// @notice Maps users to tokens to spender addresses and information about the approval on the token
    30	    /// @dev Indexed in the order of token owner address, token address, spender address
    31	    /// @dev The stored word saves the allowed amount, expiration on the allowance, and nonce
    32	    function allowance(address user, address token, address spender) external returns (PackedAllowance memory);
```

### asset-managers/src/cl-managers/libraries/ArcadiaLogic.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { ActionData } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/src/interfaces/IActionBase.sol";
     8	import { IPermit2 } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/src/interfaces/IPermit2.sol";
     9	
    10	library ArcadiaLogic {
    11	    /**
    12	     * @notice Encodes the action data for the flash-action used to manage a Liquidity Position.
    13	     * @param positionManager The address of the position manager.
    14	     * @param id The id of the Liquidity Position.
    15	     * @param token0 The contract address of token0.
    16	     * @param token1 The contract address of token1.
    17	     * @param amount0 The amount of token0 to transfer.
    18	     * @param amount1 The amount of token1 to transfer.
    19	     * @param actionTargetData The data to be passed to the action target.
    20	     * @return actionData Bytes string with the encoded data.
    21	     */
    22	    function _encodeAction(
    23	        address positionManager,
    24	        uint256 id,
    25	        address token0,
    26	        address token1,
    27	        uint256 amount0,
    28	        uint256 amount1,
    29	        bytes memory actionTargetData
    30	    ) internal pure returns (bytes memory actionData) {
    31	        // Calculate the number of assets to encode.
    32	        uint256 count = 1;
    33	        if (amount0 > 0) count++;
    34	        if (amount1 > 0) count++;
    35	
    36	        address[] memory assets = new address[](count);
    37	        uint256[] memory ids = new uint256[](count);
    38	        uint256[] memory amounts = new uint256[](count);
    39	        uint256[] memory types = new uint256[](count);
    40	
    41	        // Encode liquidity position.
    42	        assets[0] = positionManager;
    43	        ids[0] = id;
    44	        amounts[0] = 1;
    45	        types[0] = 2;
    46	
    47	        // Encode underlying assets of the liquidity position.
    48	        uint256 index = 1;
    49	        if (amount0 > 0) {
    50	            assets[1] = token0;
    51	            amounts[1] = amount0;
    52	            types[1] = 1;
    53	            index = 2;
    54	        }
    55	        if (amount1 > 0) {
    56	            assets[index] = token1;
    57	            amounts[index] = amount1;
    58	            types[index] = 1;
    59	        }
    60	
    61	        ActionData memory assetData =
    62	            ActionData({ assets: assets, assetIds: ids, assetAmounts: amounts, assetTypes: types });
    63	
    64	        // Empty data objects that have to be encoded when calling flashAction(), but that are not used for this specific flash-action.
    65	        bytes memory signature;
    66	        ActionData memory transferFromOwner;
    67	        IPermit2.PermitBatchTransferFrom memory permit;
    68	
    69	        // Encode the actionData.
    70	        actionData = abi.encode(assetData, transferFromOwner, permit, signature, actionTargetData);
    71	    }
    72	
    73	    /**
    74	     * @notice Encodes the deposit data after the flash-action is executed.
    75	     * @param positionManager The address of the position manager.
    76	     * @param id The id of the Liquidity Position.
    77	     * @param tokens The contract addresses of the tokens to deposit.
    78	     * @param balances The balances of the tokens to deposit.
    79	     * @param count The number of tokens to deposit.
    80	     * @return depositData Bytes string with the encoded data.
    81	     */
    82	    function _encodeDeposit(
    83	        address positionManager,
    84	        uint256 id,
    85	        address[] memory tokens,
    86	        uint256[] memory balances,
    87	        uint256 count
    88	    ) internal pure returns (ActionData memory depositData) {
    89	        address[] memory assets = new address[](count);
    90	        uint256[] memory ids = new uint256[](count);
    91	        uint256[] memory amounts = new uint256[](count);
    92	        uint256[] memory types = new uint256[](count);
    93	
    94	        // Encode liquidity position.
    95	        uint256 i;
    96	        if (id > 0) {
    97	            assets[0] = positionManager;
    98	            ids[0] = id;
    99	            amounts[0] = 1;
   100	            types[0] = 2;
   101	            i = 1;
   102	        }
   103	
   104	        // Encode underlying assets of the liquidity position.
   105	        for (uint256 j; j < balances.length; j++) {
   106	            if (balances[j] > 0) {
   107	                assets[i] = tokens[j];
   108	                amounts[i] = balances[j];
   109	                types[i] = 1;
   110	                i++;
   111	            }
   112	        }
   113	
   114	        depositData = ActionData({ assets: assets, assetIds: ids, assetAmounts: amounts, assetTypes: types });
   115	    }
   116	}
```

### asset-managers/src/cl-managers/libraries/CLMath.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { FixedPoint96 } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/v4-periphery/lib/v4-core/src/libraries/FixedPoint96.sol";
     8	import { FixedPointMathLib } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/FixedPointMathLib.sol";
     9	import { FullMath } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/v4-periphery/lib/v4-core/src/libraries/FullMath.sol";
    10	import { TickMath } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/v4-periphery/lib/v4-core/src/libraries/TickMath.sol";
    11	
    12	library CLMath {
    13	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    14	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    15	                                CONSTANTS
    16	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    17	
    18	    // The minimum sqrtPriceLimit for a swap.
    19	    uint160 internal constant MIN_SQRT_PRICE_LIMIT = TickMath.MIN_SQRT_PRICE + 1;
    20	
    21	    // The maximum sqrtPriceLimit for a swap.
    22	    uint160 internal constant MAX_SQRT_PRICE_LIMIT = TickMath.MAX_SQRT_PRICE - 1;
    23	
    24	    // The binary precision of sqrtPrice squared.
    25	    uint256 internal constant Q192 = FixedPoint96.Q96 ** 2;
    26	
    27	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    28	                                MATHS
    29	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    30	
    31	    /**
    32	     * @notice Calculates the swap parameters, calculated based on a hypothetical swap (in the pool itself with fees but without slippage).
    33	     * that maximizes the amount of liquidity that can be added to the positions (no leftovers of either token0 or token1).
    34	     * @param sqrtPrice The square root of the price (token1/token0), with 96 binary precision.
    35	     * @param sqrtRatioLower The square root price of the lower tick of the liquidity position, with 96 binary precision.
    36	     * @param sqrtRatioUpper The square root price of the upper tick of the liquidity position, with 96 binary precision.
    37	     * @param balance0 The amount of token0 that is available for the rebalance.
    38	     * @param balance1 The amount of token1 that is available for the rebalance.
    39	     * @param fee The swapping fees, with 18 decimals precision.
    40	     * @return zeroToOne Bool indicating if token0 has to be swapped to token1 or opposite.
    41	     * @return amountIn An approximation of the amount of tokenIn, based on the optimal swap through the pool itself without slippage.
    42	     * @return amountOut An approximation of the amount of tokenOut, based on the optimal swap through the pool itself without slippage.
    43	     * @dev The swap parameters are derived as follows:
    44	     * 1) First we check if the position is in or out of range.
    45	     *   - If the current price is above the position, the solution is trivial: we swap the full position to token1.
    46	     *   - If the current price is below the position, similar, we swap the full position to token0.
    47	     *   - If the position is in range we proceed with step 2.
    48	     *
    49	     * 2) If the position is in range, we start with calculating the "Target Ratio" and "Current Ratio".
    50	     *    Both ratio's are defined as the value of the amount of token1 compared to the total value of the position:
    51	     *    R = valueToken1 / [valueToken0 + valueToken1]
    52	     *    If we express all values in token1 and use the current pool price to denominate token0 in token1:
    53	     *    R = amount1 / [amount0 * sqrtPrice² + amount1]
    54	     *
    55	     *    a) The "Target Ratio" (R_target) is the ratio of the new liquidity position.
    56	     *       It is calculated with the current price and the upper and lower prices of the liquidity position,
    57	     *       see _getTargetRatio() for the derivation.
    58	     *       To maximize the liquidity of the new position, the balances after the swap should approximate it as close as possible to not have any leftovers.
    59	     *    b) The "Current Ratio" (R_current) is the ratio of the current token balances, it is calculated as follows:
    60	     *       R_current = balance1 / [balance0 * sqrtPrice² + balance1].
    61	     *
    62	     * 3) From R_target and R_current we can finally derive the direction of the swap, amountIn and amountOut.
    63	     *    If R_current is smaller than R_target, we have to swap an amount of token0 to token1, and vice versa.
    64	     *    amountIn and amountOut can be found by solving the following equalities:
    65	     *      a) The ratio of the token balances after the swap equal the "Target Ratio".
    66	     *      b) The swap between token0 and token1 is done in the pool itself,
    67	     *         taking into account fees, but ignoring slippage (-> sqrtPrice remains constant).
    68	     *
    69	     *    If R_current < R_target (swap token0 to token1):
    70	     *      a) R_target = [amount1 + amountOut] / [(amount0 - amountIn) * sqrtPrice² + (amount1 + amountOut)].
    71	     *      b) amountOut = (1 - fee) * amountIn * sqrtPrice².
    72	     *         => amountOut = [(R_target - R_current) * (amount0 * sqrtPrice² + amount1)] / [1 + R_target * fee / (1 - fee)].
    73	     *
    74	     *    If R_current > R_target (swap token1 to token0):
    75	     *      a) R_target = [(amount1 - amountIn)] / [(amount0 + amountOut) * sqrtPrice² + (amount1 - amountIn)].
    76	     *      b) amountOut = (1 - fee) * amountIn / sqrtPrice².
    77	     *         => amountIn = [(R_current - R_target) * (amount0 * sqrtPrice² + amount1)] / (1 - R_target * fee).
    78	     */
    79	    function _getSwapParams(
    80	        uint256 sqrtPrice,
    81	        uint256 sqrtRatioLower,
    82	        uint256 sqrtRatioUpper,
    83	        uint256 balance0,
    84	        uint256 balance1,
    85	        uint256 fee
    86	    ) internal pure returns (bool zeroToOne, uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOut) {
    87	        if (sqrtPrice >= sqrtRatioUpper) {
    88	            // New position is out of range and fully in token 1.
    89	            // Rebalance to a single-sided liquidity position in token 1.
    90	            zeroToOne = true;
    91	            amountIn = balance0;
    92	            amountOut = _getAmountOut(sqrtPrice, true, balance0, fee);
    93	        } else if (sqrtPrice <= sqrtRatioLower) {
    94	            // New position is out of range and fully in token 0.
    95	            // Rebalance to a single-sided liquidity position in token 0.
    96	            amountIn = balance1;
    97	            amountOut = _getAmountOut(sqrtPrice, false, balance1, fee);
    98	        } else {
    99	            // Get target ratio in token1 terms.
   100	            uint256 targetRatio = _getTargetRatio(sqrtPrice, sqrtRatioLower, sqrtRatioUpper);
   101	
   102	            // Calculate the total position value in token1 equivalent:
   103	            uint256 token0ValueInToken1 = _getSpotValue(sqrtPrice, true, balance0);
   104	            uint256 totalValueInToken1 = balance1 + token0ValueInToken1;

   106	            unchecked {

   109	                if (currentRatio < targetRatio) {
   110	                    // Swap token0 partially to token1.
   111	                    zeroToOne = true;

   113	                        uint256 denominator = 1e18 + targetRatio.mulDivDown(fee, 1e18 - fee);
   114	                        amountOut = (targetRatio - currentRatio).mulDivDown(totalValueInToken1, denominator);
   115	                    }
   116	                    amountIn = _getAmountIn(sqrtPrice, true, amountOut, fee);
   117	                } else {

   119	                    zeroToOne = false;

   121	                        uint256 denominator = 1e18 - targetRatio.mulDivDown(fee, 1e18);
   122	                        amountIn = (currentRatio - targetRatio).mulDivDown(totalValueInToken1, denominator);

   126	            }

   128	    }

   130	    /**
   131	     * @notice Calculates the value of one token in the other token for a given amountIn and sqrtPrice.
   132	     * Does not take into account slippage and fees.
   133	     * @param sqrtPrice The square root of the price (token1/token0), with 96 binary precision.
   134	     * @param zeroToOne Bool indicating if token0 has to be swapped to token1 or opposite.
   135	     * @param amountIn The amount that of tokenIn that must be swapped to tokenOut.
   136	     * @return amountOut The amount of tokenOut.
   137	     * @dev Function will revert for all pools where the sqrtPrice is bigger than type(uint128).max.
   138	     * type(uint128).max is currently more than enough for all supported pools.
   139	     * If ever the sqrtPrice of a pool exceeds type(uint128).max, a different contract has to be deployed,
   140	     * which does two consecutive mulDivs.
   141	     */
   142	    function _getSpotValue(uint256 sqrtPrice, bool zeroToOne, uint256 amountIn)
   143	        internal
   144	        pure
   145	        returns (uint256 amountOut)
   146	    {
   147	        amountOut = zeroToOne
   148	            ? FullMath.mulDiv(amountIn, sqrtPrice ** 2, Q192)

   150	    }
   151	
   152	    /**
   153	     * @notice Calculates the amountOut for a given amountIn and sqrtPrice for a hypothetical
   154	     * swap though the pool itself with fees but without slippage.
   155	     * @param sqrtPrice The square root of the price (token1/token0), with 96 binary precision.
   156	     * @param zeroToOne Bool indicating if token0 has to be swapped to token1 or opposite.
   157	     * @param amountIn The amount of tokenIn that must be swapped to tokenOut.
   158	     * @param fee The total fee on amountIn, with 18 decimals precision.
   159	     * @return amountOut The amount of tokenOut.
   160	     * @dev Function will revert for all pools where the sqrtPrice is bigger than type(uint128).max.
   161	     * type(uint128).max is currently more than enough for all supported pools.
   162	     * If ever the sqrtPrice of a pool exceeds type(uint128).max, a different contract has to be deployed,
   163	     * which does two consecutive mulDivs.

   167	        pure
   168	        returns (uint256 amountOut)
   169	    {
   170	        require(sqrtPrice <= type(uint128).max);

   172	            uint256 amountInWithoutFees = (1e18 - fee).mulDivDown(amountIn, 1e18);
```
