```solidity
   174	                ? FullMath.mulDiv(amountInWithoutFees, sqrtPrice ** 2, Q192)
   175	                : FullMath.mulDiv(amountInWithoutFees, Q192, sqrtPrice ** 2);
   176	        }
   177	    }
   178	
   179	    /**
   180	     * @notice Calculates the amountIn for a given amountOut and sqrtPrice for a hypothetical
   181	     * swap though the pool itself with fees but without slippage.
   182	     * @param sqrtPrice The square root of the price (token1/token0), with 96 binary precision.
   183	     * @param zeroToOne Bool indicating if token0 has to be swapped to token1 or opposite.
   184	     * @param amountOut The amount that tokenOut that must be swapped.
   185	     * @param fee The total fee on amountIn, with 18 decimals precision.
   186	     * @return amountIn The amount of tokenIn.
   187	     * @dev Function will revert for all pools where the sqrtPrice is bigger than type(uint128).max.
   188	     * type(uint128).max is currently more than enough for all supported pools.
   189	     * If ever the sqrtPrice of a pool exceeds type(uint128).max, a different contract has to be deployed,
   190	     * which does two consecutive mulDivs.
   191	     */
   192	    function _getAmountIn(uint256 sqrtPrice, bool zeroToOne, uint256 amountOut, uint256 fee)
   193	        internal
   194	        pure
   195	        returns (uint256 amountIn)
   196	    {
   197	        require(sqrtPrice <= type(uint128).max);
   198	        unchecked {
   199	            uint256 amountInWithoutFees = zeroToOne
   200	                ? FullMath.mulDiv(amountOut, Q192, sqrtPrice ** 2)
   201	                : FullMath.mulDiv(amountOut, sqrtPrice ** 2, Q192);
   202	            amountIn = amountInWithoutFees.mulDivDown(1e18, 1e18 - fee);
   203	        }
   204	    }
   205	
   206	    /**
   207	     * @notice Calculates the ratio of how much of the total value of a liquidity position has to be provided in token1.
   208	     * @param sqrtPrice The square root of the current pool price (token1/token0), with 96 binary precision.
   209	     * @param sqrtRatioLower The square root price of the lower tick of the liquidity position, with 96 binary precision.
   210	     * @param sqrtRatioUpper The square root price of the upper tick of the liquidity position, with 96 binary precision.
   211	     * @return targetRatio The ratio of the value of token1 compared to the total value of the position, with 18 decimals precision.
   212	     * @dev Function will revert for all pools where the sqrtPrice is bigger than type(uint128).max.
   213	     * type(uint128).max is currently more than enough for all supported pools.
   214	     * If ever the sqrtPrice of a pool exceeds type(uint128).max, a different contract has to be deployed,
   215	     * which does two consecutive mulDivs.
   216	     * @dev Derivation of the formula:
   217	     * 1) The ratio is defined as:
   218	     *    R = valueToken1 / [valueToken0 + valueToken1]
   219	     *    If we express all values in token1 and use the current pool price to denominate token0 in token1:
   220	     *    R = amount1 / [amount0 * sqrtPrice² + amount1]
   221	     * 2) Amount0 for a given liquidity position of a Uniswap V3 pool is given as:
   222	     *    Amount0 = liquidity * (sqrtRatioUpper - sqrtPrice) / (sqrtRatioUpper * sqrtPrice)
   223	     * 3) Amount1 for a given liquidity position of a Uniswap V3 pool is given as:
   224	     *    Amount1 = liquidity * (sqrtPrice - sqrtRatioLower)
   225	     * 4) Combining 1), 2) and 3) and simplifying we get:
   226	     *    R = [sqrtPrice - sqrtRatioLower] / [2 * sqrtPrice - sqrtRatioLower - sqrtPrice² / sqrtRatioUpper]
   227	     */
   228	    function _getTargetRatio(uint256 sqrtPrice, uint256 sqrtRatioLower, uint256 sqrtRatioUpper)
   229	        internal
   230	        pure
   231	        returns (uint256 targetRatio)
   232	    {
   233	        require(sqrtPrice <= type(uint128).max);
   234	        // Unchecked: sqrtPrice is always bigger than sqrtRatioLower.
   235	        // Unchecked: sqrtPrice is always smaller than sqrtRatioUpper -> sqrtPrice > sqrtPrice ** 2 / sqrtRatioUpper.
   236	        unchecked {
   237	            uint256 numerator = sqrtPrice - sqrtRatioLower;
   238	            uint256 denominator = 2 * sqrtPrice - sqrtRatioLower - sqrtPrice ** 2 / sqrtRatioUpper;
   239	
   240	            targetRatio = numerator.mulDivDown(1e18, denominator);
   241	        }
   242	    }
   243	}
```

```solidity
    10	/**
    11	 * @title Liquidity amount functions
    12	 * @notice Provides functions for computing liquidity amounts from token amounts and prices
    13	 */
    14	// forge-lint: disable-next-item(mixed-case-variable,unsafe-typecast)
    15	library LiquidityAmounts {
    16	    /**
    17	     *  @notice Downcasts uint256 to uint128
    18	     *  @param x The uint258 to be downcasted
    19	     *  @return y The passed value, downcasted to uint128
    20	     */
    21	    function toUint128(uint256 x) internal pure returns (uint128 y) {
    22	        require((y = uint128(x)) == x);
    23	    }
    24	
    25	    /**
    26	     *  @notice Computes the amount of liquidity received for a given amount of token0 and price range
    27	     *  @dev Calculates amount0 * (sqrt(upper) * sqrt(lower)) / (sqrt(upper) - sqrt(lower))
    28	     *  @param sqrtRatioAX96 A sqrt price representing the first tick boundary
    29	     *  @param sqrtRatioBX96 A sqrt price representing the second tick boundary
    30	     *  @param amount0 The amount0 being sent in
    31	     *  @return liquidity The amount of returned liquidity
    32	     */
    33	    function getLiquidityForAmount0(uint160 sqrtRatioAX96, uint160 sqrtRatioBX96, uint256 amount0)
    34	        internal
    35	        pure
    36	        returns (uint256 liquidity)
    37	    {
    38	        unchecked {
    39	            if (sqrtRatioAX96 > sqrtRatioBX96) (sqrtRatioAX96, sqrtRatioBX96) = (sqrtRatioBX96, sqrtRatioAX96);
    40	            uint256 intermediate = FullMath.mulDiv(sqrtRatioAX96, sqrtRatioBX96, FixedPoint96.Q96);
    41	            return FullMath.mulDiv(amount0, intermediate, sqrtRatioBX96 - sqrtRatioAX96);
    42	        }
    43	    }
    44	
    45	    /**
    46	     *  @notice Computes the amount of liquidity received for a given amount of token1 and price range
    47	     *  @dev Calculates amount1 / (sqrt(upper) - sqrt(lower)).
    48	     *  @param sqrtRatioAX96 A sqrt price representing the first tick boundary
    49	     *  @param sqrtRatioBX96 A sqrt price representing the second tick boundary
    50	     *  @param amount1 The amount1 being sent in
    51	     *  @return liquidity The amount of returned liquidity
    52	     */
    53	    function getLiquidityForAmount1(uint160 sqrtRatioAX96, uint160 sqrtRatioBX96, uint256 amount1)
    54	        internal
    55	        pure
    56	        returns (uint256 liquidity)
    57	    {
    58	        unchecked {
    59	            if (sqrtRatioAX96 > sqrtRatioBX96) (sqrtRatioAX96, sqrtRatioBX96) = (sqrtRatioBX96, sqrtRatioAX96);
    60	            return FullMath.mulDiv(amount1, FixedPoint96.Q96, sqrtRatioBX96 - sqrtRatioAX96);
    61	        }
    62	    }
    63	
    64	    /**
    65	     *  @notice Computes the maximum amount of liquidity received for a given amount of token0, token1, the current
    66	     *  pool prices and the prices at the tick boundaries
    67	     *  @param sqrtRatioX96 A sqrt price representing the current pool prices
    68	     *  @param sqrtRatioAX96 A sqrt price representing the first tick boundary
    69	     *  @param sqrtRatioBX96 A sqrt price representing the second tick boundary
    70	     *  @param amount0 The amount of token0 being sent in
    71	     *  @param amount1 The amount of token1 being sent in
    72	     *  @return liquidity The maximum amount of liquidity received

    74	    function getLiquidityForAmounts(
    75	        uint160 sqrtRatioX96,
    76	        uint160 sqrtRatioAX96,
    77	        uint160 sqrtRatioBX96,

    82	            (sqrtRatioAX96, sqrtRatioBX96) = (sqrtRatioBX96, sqrtRatioAX96);
    83	        }

    94	        }
    95	    }
    96	
    97	    /**

   118	    /**

   120	     *  @param sqrtRatioAX96 A sqrt price representing the first tick boundary
   121	     *  @param sqrtRatioBX96 A sqrt price representing the second tick boundary

   135	    }

   139	     *  pool prices and the prices at the tick boundaries
   140	     *  @param sqrtRatioX96 A sqrt price representing the current pool prices
   141	     *  @param sqrtRatioAX96 A sqrt price representing the first tick boundary
   142	     *  @param sqrtRatioBX96 A sqrt price representing the second tick boundary
   143	     *  @param liquidity The liquidity being valued
   144	     *  @return amount0 The amount of token0
   145	     *  @return amount1 The amount of token1
   146	     */
   147	    function getAmountsForLiquidity(

   150	        uint160 sqrtRatioBX96,
   151	        uint128 liquidity
   152	    ) internal pure returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) {
   153	        if (sqrtRatioAX96 > sqrtRatioBX96) {
   154	            (sqrtRatioAX96, sqrtRatioBX96) = (sqrtRatioBX96, sqrtRatioAX96);
```

```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { FixedPointMathLib } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/FixedPointMathLib.sol";
     8	import { LiquidityAmounts } from "./LiquidityAmounts.sol";
     9	import { CLMath } from "./CLMath.sol";
    10	
    11	struct RebalanceParams {
    12	    // Bool indicating if token0 has to be swapped to token1 or opposite.
    13	    bool zeroToOne;
    14	    // The amount of initiator fee, in tokenIn.
    15	    uint256 amountInitiatorFee;
    16	    // The minimum amount of liquidity that must be added to the position.
    17	    uint256 minLiquidity;
    18	    // An approximation of the amount of tokenIn, based on the optimal swap through the pool itself without slippage.
    19	    uint256 amountIn;
    20	    // An approximation of the amount of tokenOut, based on the optimal swap through the pool itself without slippage.
    21	    uint256 amountOut;
    22	}
    23	
    24	library RebalanceLogic {
    25	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    26	
    27	    /**
    28	     * @notice Returns the parameters and constraints to rebalance the position.
    29	     * Both parameters and constraints are calculated based on a hypothetical swap (in the pool itself with fees but without slippage),
    30	     * that maximizes the amount of liquidity that can be added to the positions (no leftovers of either token0 or token1).
    31	     * @param minLiquidityRatio The ratio of the minimum amount of liquidity that must be minted,
    32	     * relative to the hypothetical amount of liquidity when we rebalance without slippage, with 18 decimals precision.
    33	     * @param poolFee The fee of the pool, with 6 decimals precision.
    34	     * @param initiatorFee The fee of the initiator, with 18 decimals precision.
    35	     * @param sqrtPrice The square root of the price (token1/token0), with 96 binary precision.
    36	     * @param sqrtRatioLower The square root price of the lower tick of the liquidity position, with 96 binary precision.
    37	     * @param sqrtRatioUpper The square root price of the upper tick of the liquidity position, with 96 binary precision.
    38	     * @param balance0 The amount of token0 that is available for the rebalance.
    39	     * @param balance1 The amount of token1 that is available for the rebalance.
    40	     * @return rebalanceParams A struct with the rebalance parameters.
    41	     */
    42	    function _getRebalanceParams(
    43	        uint256 minLiquidityRatio,
    44	        uint256 poolFee,
    45	        uint256 initiatorFee,
    46	        uint256 sqrtPrice,
    47	        uint256 sqrtRatioLower,
    48	        uint256 sqrtRatioUpper,
    49	        uint256 balance0,
    50	        uint256 balance1
    51	    ) internal pure returns (RebalanceParams memory rebalanceParams) {
    52	        // Total fee is pool fee + initiator fee, with 18 decimals precision.
    53	        // Since Uniswap uses 6 decimals precision for the fee, we have to multiply the pool fee by 1e12.
    54	        uint256 fee;
    55	        unchecked {
    56	            fee = initiatorFee + poolFee * 1e12;
    57	        }
    58	
    59	        // Calculate the swap parameters
    60	        (bool zeroToOne, uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOut) =
    61	            CLMath._getSwapParams(sqrtPrice, sqrtRatioLower, sqrtRatioUpper, balance0, balance1, fee);
    62	
    63	        // Calculate the maximum amount of liquidity that can be added to the position.
    64	        uint256 minLiquidity;
    65	        {
    66	            // forge-lint: disable-next-item(unsafe-typecast)
    67	            uint256 liquidity = LiquidityAmounts.getLiquidityForAmounts(
    68	                uint160(sqrtPrice),
    69	                uint160(sqrtRatioLower),
    70	                uint160(sqrtRatioUpper),
    71	                zeroToOne ? balance0 - amountIn : balance0 + amountOut,
    72	                zeroToOne ? balance1 + amountOut : balance1 - amountIn
    73	            );
    74	            minLiquidity = liquidity.mulDivDown(minLiquidityRatio, 1e18);
    75	        }
    76	
    77	        // Get initiator fee amount and the actual amountIn of the swap (without initiator fee).
    78	        uint256 amountInitiatorFee;
    79	        unchecked {
    80	            amountInitiatorFee = amountIn.mulDivDown(initiatorFee, 1e18);
    81	            amountIn = amountIn - amountInitiatorFee;
    82	        }
    83	
    84	        rebalanceParams = RebalanceParams({
    85	            zeroToOne: zeroToOne,
    86	            amountInitiatorFee: amountInitiatorFee,
    87	            minLiquidity: minLiquidity,
    88	            amountIn: amountIn,
    89	            amountOut: amountOut
    90	        });
    91	    }
    92	}
```

```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { FixedPointMathLib } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/FixedPointMathLib.sol";
     8	import { LiquidityAmounts } from "./LiquidityAmounts.sol";
     9	import { SqrtPriceMath } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/v4-periphery/lib/v4-core/src/libraries/SqrtPriceMath.sol";
    10	
    11	library RebalanceOptimizationMath {
    12	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    13	
    14	    // The minimal relative difference between liquidity0 and liquidity1, with 18 decimals precision.
    15	    uint256 internal constant CONVERGENCE_THRESHOLD = 1e6;
    16	
    17	    // The maximal number of iterations to find the optimal swap parameters.
    18	    uint256 internal constant MAX_ITERATIONS = 100;
    19	
    20	    /**
    21	     * @notice Iteratively calculates the amountOut for a swap through the pool itself, that maximizes the amount of liquidity that is added.
    22	     * The calculations take both fees and slippage into account, but assume constant liquidity.
    23	     * @param zeroToOne Bool indicating if token0 has to be swapped to token1 or opposite.
    24	     * @param fee The fee of the pool, with 6 decimals precision.
    25	     * @param usableLiquidity The amount of active liquidity in the pool, at the current tick.
    26	     * @param sqrtPriceOld The square root of the pool price (token1/token0) before the swap, with 96 binary precision.
    27	     * @param sqrtRatioLower The square root price of the lower tick of the liquidity position, with 96 binary precision.
    28	     * @param sqrtRatioUpper The square root price of the upper tick of the liquidity position, with 96 binary precision.
    29	     * @param amount0 The balance of token0 before the swap.
    30	     * @param amount1 The balance of token1 before the swap.
    31	     * @param amountIn An approximation of the amount of tokenIn, based on the optimal swap through the pool itself without slippage.
    32	     * @param amountOut An approximation of the amount of tokenOut, based on the optimal swap through the pool itself without slippage.
    33	     * @return amountOut The amount of tokenOut.
    34	     * @dev The optimal amountIn and amountOut are defined as the amounts that maximize the amount of liquidity that can be added to the position.
    35	     * This means that there are no leftovers of either token0 or token1,
    36	     * and liquidity0 (calculated via getLiquidityForAmount0) will be exactly equal to liquidity1 (calculated via getLiquidityForAmount1).
    37	     * @dev The optimal amountIn and amountOut depend on the sqrtPrice of the pool via the liquidity calculations,
    38	     * but the sqrtPrice in turn depends on the amountIn and amountOut via the swap calculations.
    39	     * Since both are highly non-linear, this problem is (according to our understanding) not analytically solvable.
    40	     * Therefore we use an iterative approach to find the optimal swap parameters.
    41	     * The stop criterion is defined when the relative difference between liquidity0 and liquidity1 is below the convergence threshold.
    42	     * @dev Convergence is not guaranteed, worst case or the transaction reverts, or a non-optimal swap is performed,
    43	     * But then minLiquidity enforces that either enough liquidity is minted or the transaction will revert.
    44	     * @dev We assume constant active liquidity when calculating the swap parameters.
    45	     * For illiquid pools, or positions that are large relatively to the pool liquidity, this might result in reverting rebalances.
    46	     * But since a minimum amount of liquidity is enforced, should not lead to loss of principal.
    47	     */
    48	    function _getAmountOutWithSlippage(
    49	        bool zeroToOne,
    50	        uint256 fee,
    51	        uint128 usableLiquidity,
    52	        uint160 sqrtPriceOld,
    53	        uint160 sqrtRatioLower,
    54	        uint160 sqrtRatioUpper,
    55	        uint256 amount0,
    56	        uint256 amount1,
    57	        uint256 amountIn,
    58	        uint256 amountOut
    59	    ) internal pure returns (uint256) {
    60	        uint160 sqrtPriceNew;
    61	        bool stopCondition;
    62	        // We iteratively solve for sqrtPrice, amountOut and amountIn, so that the maximal amount of liquidity can be added to the position.
    63	        for (uint256 i = 0; i < MAX_ITERATIONS; ++i) {
    64	            // Find a better approximation for sqrtPrice, given the best approximations for the optimal amountIn and amountOut.
    65	            sqrtPriceNew = _approximateSqrtPriceNew(zeroToOne, fee, usableLiquidity, sqrtPriceOld, amountIn, amountOut);
    66	
    67	            // If the position is out of range, we can calculate the exact solution.
    68	            if (sqrtPriceNew >= sqrtRatioUpper) {
    69	                // New position is out of range and fully in token 1.
    70	                // Rebalance to a single-sided liquidity position in token 1.
    71	                // We ignore one edge case: Swapping token0 to token1 decreases the sqrtPrice,
    72	                // hence a swap for a position that is just out of range might become in range due to slippage.
    73	                // This might lead to a suboptimal rebalance, which worst case results in too little liquidity and the rebalance reverts.
    74	                return _getAmount1OutFromAmount0In(fee, usableLiquidity, sqrtPriceOld, amount0);
    75	            } else if (sqrtPriceNew <= sqrtRatioLower) {
    76	                // New position is out of range and fully in token 0.
    77	                // Rebalance to a single-sided liquidity position in token 0.
    78	                // We ignore one edge case: Swapping token1 to token0 increases the sqrtPrice,
    79	                // hence a swap for a position that is just out of range might become in range due to slippage.
    80	                // This might lead to a suboptimal rebalance, which worst case results in too little liquidity and the rebalance reverts.
    81	                return _getAmount0OutFromAmount1In(fee, usableLiquidity, sqrtPriceOld, amount1);
    82	            }
    83	
    84	            // If the position is not out of range, calculate the amountIn and amountOut, given the new approximated sqrtPrice.
    85	            (amountIn, amountOut) = _getSwapParamsExact(zeroToOne, fee, usableLiquidity, sqrtPriceOld, sqrtPriceNew);
    86	
    87	            // Given the new approximated sqrtPriceNew and its swap amounts,
    88	            // calculate a better approximation for the optimal amountIn and amountOut, that would maximize the liquidity provided
    89	            // (no leftovers of either token0 or token1).
    90	            (stopCondition, amountIn, amountOut) = _approximateOptimalSwapAmounts(
    91	                zeroToOne, sqrtRatioLower, sqrtRatioUpper, amount0, amount1, amountIn, amountOut, sqrtPriceNew
    92	            );
    93	
    94	            // Check if stop condition of iteration is met:
    95	            // The relative difference between liquidity0 and liquidity1 is below the convergence threshold.
    96	            if (stopCondition) return amountOut;
    97	            // If not, we do an extra iteration with our better approximated amountIn and amountOut.
    98	        }
    99	        // If solution did not converge within MAX_ITERATIONS steps, we use the amountOut of the last iteration step.
   100	        return amountOut;
   101	    }
   102	
   103	    /**
   104	     * @notice Approximates the SqrtPrice after the swap, given an approximation for the amountIn and amountOut that maximize liquidity added.
   105	     * @param zeroToOne Bool indicating if token0 has to be swapped to token1 or opposite.
   106	     * @param fee The fee of the pool, with 6 decimals precision.
   107	     * @param usableLiquidity The amount of active liquidity in the pool, at the current tick.
   108	     * @param sqrtPriceOld The SqrtPrice before the swap.
   109	     * @param amountIn An approximation of the amount of tokenIn, that maximize liquidity added.
   110	     * @param amountOut An approximation of the amount of tokenOut, that maximize liquidity added.
   111	     * @return sqrtPriceNew The approximation of the SqrtPrice after the swap.
   112	     */
   113	    function _approximateSqrtPriceNew(
   114	        bool zeroToOne,
   115	        uint256 fee,
   116	        uint128 usableLiquidity,
   117	        uint160 sqrtPriceOld,
   118	        uint256 amountIn,
   119	        uint256 amountOut
   120	    ) internal pure returns (uint160 sqrtPriceNew) {
   121	        unchecked {
   122	            // Calculate the exact sqrtPriceNew for both amountIn and amountOut.
   123	            // Both solutions will be different, but they will converge with every iteration closer to the same solution.
   124	            uint256 amountInLessFee = amountIn.mulDivDown(1e6 - fee, 1e6);
   125	            uint256 sqrtPriceNew0;
   126	            uint256 sqrtPriceNew1;
   127	            if (zeroToOne) {
   128	                sqrtPriceNew0 = SqrtPriceMath.getNextSqrtPriceFromAmount0RoundingUp(
   129	                    sqrtPriceOld, usableLiquidity, amountInLessFee, true
   130	                );
   131	                sqrtPriceNew1 = SqrtPriceMath.getNextSqrtPriceFromAmount1RoundingDown(
   132	                    sqrtPriceOld, usableLiquidity, amountOut, false
   133	                );
   134	            } else {
   135	                sqrtPriceNew0 = SqrtPriceMath.getNextSqrtPriceFromAmount0RoundingUp(
   136	                    sqrtPriceOld, usableLiquidity, amountOut, false
   137	                );
   138	                sqrtPriceNew1 = SqrtPriceMath.getNextSqrtPriceFromAmount1RoundingDown(
   139	                    sqrtPriceOld, usableLiquidity, amountInLessFee, true
   140	                );
   141	            }
   142	            // Calculate the new best approximation as the arithmetic average of both solutions (rounded towards current price).
   143	            // We could as well use the geometric average, but empirically we found no difference in conversion speed,
   144	            // and the geometric average is more expensive to calculate.
   145	            // Unchecked + unsafe cast: sqrtPriceNew0 and sqrtPriceNew1 are always smaller than type(uint160).max.
   146	            sqrtPriceNew = zeroToOne
   147	                ? uint160(FixedPointMathLib.unsafeDiv(sqrtPriceNew0 + sqrtPriceNew1, 2))
   148	                : uint160(FixedPointMathLib.unsafeDivUp(sqrtPriceNew0 + sqrtPriceNew1, 2));
   149	        }
   150	    }
   151	
   152	    /**
   153	     * @notice Calculates the amountOut of token1, for a given amountIn of token0.
   154	     * @param fee The fee of the pool, with 6 decimals precision.
   155	     * @param usableLiquidity The amount of active liquidity in the pool, at the current tick.
   156	     * @param sqrtPriceOld The SqrtPrice before the swap.
   157	     * @param amount0 The balance of token0 before the swap.
   158	     * @return amountOut The amount of token1 that is swapped to.
   159	     * @dev The calculations take both fees and slippage into account, but assume constant liquidity.
   160	     */
   161	    function _getAmount1OutFromAmount0In(uint256 fee, uint128 usableLiquidity, uint160 sqrtPriceOld, uint256 amount0)
   162	        internal
   163	        pure
   164	        returns (uint256 amountOut)
   165	    {
   166	        unchecked {
   167	            uint256 amountInLessFee = amount0.mulDivUp(1e6 - fee, 1e6);
   168	            uint160 sqrtPriceNew = SqrtPriceMath.getNextSqrtPriceFromAmount0RoundingUp(
   169	                sqrtPriceOld, usableLiquidity, amountInLessFee, true
   170	            );
   171	            amountOut = SqrtPriceMath.getAmount1Delta(sqrtPriceNew, sqrtPriceOld, usableLiquidity, false);
   172	        }
   173	    }
   174	
   175	    /**
   176	     * @notice Calculates the amountOut of token0, for a given amountIn of token1.
   177	     * @param fee The fee of the pool, with 6 decimals precision.
   178	     * @param usableLiquidity The amount of active liquidity in the pool, at the current tick.
   179	     * @param sqrtPriceOld The SqrtPrice before the swap.
   180	     * @param amount1 The balance of token1 before the swap.
   181	     * @return amountOut The amount of token0 that is swapped to.
   182	     * @dev The calculations take both fees and slippage into account, but assume constant liquidity.
   183	     */
   184	    function _getAmount0OutFromAmount1In(uint256 fee, uint128 usableLiquidity, uint160 sqrtPriceOld, uint256 amount1)
   185	        internal
   186	        pure
   187	        returns (uint256 amountOut)
   188	    {
   189	        unchecked {
   190	            uint256 amountInLessFee = amount1.mulDivUp(1e6 - fee, 1e6);
   191	            uint160 sqrtPriceNew = SqrtPriceMath.getNextSqrtPriceFromAmount1RoundingDown(
   192	                sqrtPriceOld, usableLiquidity, amountInLessFee, true
   193	            );
   194	            amountOut = SqrtPriceMath.getAmount0Delta(sqrtPriceOld, sqrtPriceNew, usableLiquidity, false);
   195	        }
   196	    }
   197	
   198	    /**
   199	     * @notice Calculates the amountIn and amountOut of token0, for a given SqrtPrice after the swap.
   200	     * @param zeroToOne Bool indicating if token0 has to be swapped to token1 or opposite.
   201	     * @param fee The fee of the pool, with 6 decimals precision.
   202	     * @param usableLiquidity The amount of active liquidity in the pool, at the current tick.
   203	     * @param sqrtPriceOld The SqrtPrice before the swap.
   204	     * @param sqrtPriceNew The SqrtPrice after the swap.
   205	     * @return amountIn The amount of tokenIn.
   206	     * @return amountOut The amount of tokenOut.
   207	     * @dev The calculations take both fees and slippage into account, but assume constant liquidity.
   208	     */
   209	    function _getSwapParamsExact(
   210	        bool zeroToOne,
   211	        uint256 fee,
   212	        uint128 usableLiquidity,
   213	        uint160 sqrtPriceOld,
   214	        uint160 sqrtPriceNew
   215	    ) internal pure returns (uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOut) {
   216	        unchecked {
   217	            if (zeroToOne) {
   218	                uint256 amountInLessFee =
   219	                    SqrtPriceMath.getAmount0Delta(sqrtPriceNew, sqrtPriceOld, usableLiquidity, true);
   220	                amountIn = amountInLessFee.mulDivUp(1e6, 1e6 - fee);
   221	                amountOut = SqrtPriceMath.getAmount1Delta(sqrtPriceNew, sqrtPriceOld, usableLiquidity, false);
   222	            } else {
   223	                uint256 amountInLessFee =
   224	                    SqrtPriceMath.getAmount1Delta(sqrtPriceOld, sqrtPriceNew, usableLiquidity, true);
   225	                amountIn = amountInLessFee.mulDivUp(1e6, 1e6 - fee);
   226	                amountOut = SqrtPriceMath.getAmount0Delta(sqrtPriceOld, sqrtPriceNew, usableLiquidity, false);
   227	            }
   228	        }
   229	    }
   230	
   231	    /**
   232	     * @notice Approximates the amountIn and amountOut that maximize liquidity added,
   233	     * given an approximation for the SqrtPrice after the swap and an approximation of the balances of token0 and token1 after the swap.
   234	     * @param zeroToOne Bool indicating if token0 has to be swapped to token1 or opposite.
   235	     * @param sqrtRatioLower The square root price of the lower tick of the liquidity position, with 96 binary precision.
   236	     * @param sqrtRatioUpper The square root price of the upper tick of the liquidity position, with 96 binary precision.
   237	     * @param amount0 The balance of token0 before the swap.
   238	     * @param amount1 The balance of token1 before the swap.
   239	     * @param amountIn An approximation of the amount of tokenIn, used to calculate the approximated balances after the swap.
   240	     * @param amountOut An approximation of the amount of tokenOut, used to calculate the approximated balances after the swap.
   241	     * @param sqrtPrice An approximation of the SqrtPrice after the swap.
   242	     * @return converged Bool indicating if the stop criterion of iteration is met.
   243	     * @return amountIn_ The new approximation of the amount of tokenIn that maximize liquidity added.
   244	     * @return amountOut_ The new approximation of the amount of amountOut that maximize liquidity added.
   245	     */
   246	    function _approximateOptimalSwapAmounts(
   247	        bool zeroToOne,
   248	        uint160 sqrtRatioLower,
   249	        uint160 sqrtRatioUpper,
   250	        uint256 amount0,
   251	        uint256 amount1,
   252	        uint256 amountIn,
   253	        uint256 amountOut,
   254	        uint160 sqrtPrice
   255	    ) internal pure returns (bool, uint256, uint256) {
   256	        unchecked {
   257	            // Calculate the liquidity for the given approximated sqrtPrice and the approximated balances of token0 and token1 after the swap.
   258	            uint256 liquidity0;
   259	            uint256 liquidity1;
   260	            if (zeroToOne) {
   261	                liquidity0 = LiquidityAmounts.getLiquidityForAmount0(
   262	                    sqrtPrice, sqrtRatioUpper, amount0 > amountIn ? amount0 - amountIn : 0
   263	                );
   264	                liquidity1 = LiquidityAmounts.getLiquidityForAmount1(sqrtRatioLower, sqrtPrice, amount1 + amountOut);
   265	            } else {
   266	                liquidity0 = LiquidityAmounts.getLiquidityForAmount0(sqrtPrice, sqrtRatioUpper, amount0 + amountOut);
   267	                liquidity1 = LiquidityAmounts.getLiquidityForAmount1(
   268	                    sqrtRatioLower, sqrtPrice, amount1 > amountIn ? amount1 - amountIn : 0
   269	                );
   270	            }
   271	
   272	            // Calculate the relative difference of liquidity0 and liquidity1.
   273	            uint256 relDiff = 1e18
   274	                - (liquidity0 < liquidity1
   275	                        ? liquidity0.mulDivDown(1e18, liquidity1)
   276	                        : liquidity1.mulDivDown(1e18, liquidity0));
   277	            // In the optimal solution liquidity0 equals liquidity1,
   278	            // and there are no leftovers for token0 or token1 after minting the liquidity.
   279	            // Hence the relative distance between liquidity0 and liquidity1
   280	            // is a good estimator how close we are to the optimal solution.
   281	            bool converged = relDiff < CONVERGENCE_THRESHOLD;
   282	
   283	            // The new approximated liquidity is the minimum of liquidity0 and liquidity1.
   284	            // Calculate the new approximated amountIn or amountOut,
   285	            // for which this liquidity would be the optimal solution.
   286	            if (liquidity0 < liquidity1) {
   287	                uint256 amount1New = SqrtPriceMath.getAmount1Delta(
   288	                    sqrtRatioLower, sqrtPrice, LiquidityAmounts.toUint128(liquidity0), true
   289	                );
   290	                zeroToOne
   291	                    // Since amountOut can't be negative, we use 90% of the previous amountOut as a fallback.
   292	                    ? amountOut = amount1New > amount1 ? amount1New - amount1 : amountOut.mulDivDown(9, 10)
   293	                    : amountIn = amount1 - amount1New;
   294	            } else {
   295	                uint256 amount0New = SqrtPriceMath.getAmount0Delta(
   296	                    sqrtPrice, sqrtRatioUpper, LiquidityAmounts.toUint128(liquidity1), true
   297	                );
   298	                zeroToOne
   299	                    ? amountIn = amount0 - amount0New
   300	                    // Since amountOut can't be negative, we use 90% of the previous amountOut as a fallback.
   301	                    : amountOut = amount0New > amount0 ? amount0New - amount0 : amountOut.mulDivDown(9, 10);
   302	            }
   303	
   304	            return (converged, amountIn, amountOut);
   305	        }
   306	    }
   307	}
```

### asset-managers/src/cl-managers/libraries/SlipstreamLogic.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	library SlipstreamLogic {
     8	    /**
     9	     *  @notice Deterministically computes the pool address.
    10	     *  @param poolImplementation The contract address of the Slipstream Pool implementation.
    11	     *  @param factory The contract address of the Slipstream factory.
    12	     *  @param token0 Contract address of token0.
    13	     *  @param token1 Contract address of token1.
    14	     *  @param tickSpacing The tick spacing of the pool.
    15	     *  @return pool The contract address of the pool.
    16	     */
    17	    function computeAddress(
    18	        address poolImplementation,
    19	        address factory,
    20	        address token0,
    21	        address token1,
    22	        int24 tickSpacing
    23	    ) internal pure returns (address pool) {
    24	        require(token0 < token1);
    25	        pool = predictDeterministicAddress({
    26	            master: poolImplementation, salt: keccak256(abi.encode(token0, token1, tickSpacing)), deployer: factory
    27	        });
    28	    }
    29	
    30	    /**
    31	     * @notice Computes the address of a clone deployed.
    32	     * @param master The contract address of the master.
    33	     * @param salt The salt of the clone.
    34	     * @param deployer The deployer of the clone.
    35	     * @return predicted The predicted address of the clone.
    36	     */
    37	    function predictDeterministicAddress(address master, bytes32 salt, address deployer)
    38	        internal
    39	        pure
    40	        returns (address predicted)
    41	    {
    42	        // solhint-disable-next-line no-inline-assembly
    43	        assembly {
    44	            let ptr := mload(0x40)
    45	            mstore(ptr, 0x3d602d80600a3d3981f3363d3d373d3d3d363d73000000000000000000000000)
    46	            mstore(add(ptr, 0x14), shl(0x60, master))
    47	            mstore(add(ptr, 0x28), 0x5af43d82803e903d91602b57fd5bf3ff00000000000000000000000000000000)
    48	            mstore(add(ptr, 0x38), shl(0x60, deployer))
    49	            mstore(add(ptr, 0x4c), salt)
    50	            mstore(add(ptr, 0x6c), keccak256(ptr, 0x37))
    51	            predicted := keccak256(add(ptr, 0x37), 0x55)
    52	        }
    53	    }
    54	}
```

### asset-managers/src/cl-managers/rebalancers/Rebalancer.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs

     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { AbstractBase } from "../base/AbstractBase.sol";
     8	import { ActionData, IActionBase } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/src/interfaces/IActionBase.sol";
     9	import { ArcadiaLogic } from "../libraries/ArcadiaLogic.sol";
    10	import { ERC20, SafeTransferLib } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/SafeTransferLib.sol";
    11	import { ERC721 } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/tokens/ERC721.sol";
    12	import { FixedPointMathLib } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/FixedPointMathLib.sol";
    13	import { Guardian } from "../../guardian/Guardian.sol";
    14	import { IAccount } from "../../interfaces/IAccount.sol";
    15	import { IArcadiaFactory } from "../../interfaces/IArcadiaFactory.sol";
    16	import { IRouterTrampoline } from "../interfaces/IRouterTrampoline.sol";
    17	import { IStrategyHook } from "../interfaces/IStrategyHook.sol";
    18	import { PositionState } from "../state/PositionState.sol";
    19	import { RebalanceLogic, RebalanceParams } from "../libraries/RebalanceLogic.sol";
    20	import { RebalanceOptimizationMath } from "../libraries/RebalanceOptimizationMath.sol";
    21	import { SafeApprove } from "../../libraries/SafeApprove.sol";
    22	import { SafeCastLib } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/SafeCastLib.sol";
    23	import { TickMath } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/v4-periphery/lib/v4-core/src/libraries/TickMath.sol";
    24	
    25	/**
    26	 * @title Abstract Rebalancer for Concentrated Liquidity Positions.
    27	 * @notice The Rebalancer is an Asset Manager for Arcadia Accounts.
    28	 * It will allow third parties to trigger the rebalancing functionality for a Liquidity Position in the Account.
    29	 * The owner of an Arcadia Account should set an initiator via setAccountInfo() that will be permissioned to rebalance
    30	 * all Liquidity Positions held in that Account.
    31	 * @dev The initiator will provide a trusted sqrtPrice input at the time of rebalance to mitigate frontrunning risks.
    32	 * This input serves as a reference point for calculating the maximum allowed deviation during the rebalancing process,
    33	 * ensuring that rebalancing remains within a controlled price range.
    34	 * @dev The contract guarantees a limited slippage with each rebalance by enforcing a minimum amount of liquidity that must be added,
    35	 * based on a hypothetical optimal swap through the pool itself without slippage.
    36	 * This protects the Account owners from incompetent or malicious initiators who route swaps poorly, or try to skim off liquidity from the position.
    37	 */
    38	abstract contract Rebalancer is IActionBase, AbstractBase, Guardian {
    39	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    40	    using SafeApprove for ERC20;
    41	    using SafeCastLib for uint256;
    42	    using SafeTransferLib for ERC20;
    43	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    44	                                CONSTANTS
    45	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    46	
    47	    // The contract address of the Arcadia Factory.
    48	    IArcadiaFactory internal immutable ARCADIA_FACTORY;
    49	
    50	    // The contract address of the Router Trampoline.
    51	    IRouterTrampoline internal immutable ROUTER_TRAMPOLINE;
    52	
    53	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    54	                                STORAGE
    55	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    56	
    57	    // The Account to rebalance, used as transient storage.
    58	    address internal account;
    59	
    60	    // A mapping from account to account specific information.
    61	    mapping(address account => AccountInfo) public accountInfo;
    62	
    63	    // A mapping from account to custom metadata.
    64	    mapping(address account => bytes data) public metaData;
    65	
    66	    // A mapping that sets the approved initiator per owner per account.
    67	    mapping(address accountOwner => mapping(address account => address initiator)) public accountToInitiator;
    68	
    69	    // A struct with the account specific parameters.
    70	    struct AccountInfo {
    71	        // The maximum fee charged on the claimed fees of the liquidity position, with 18 decimals precision.
    72	        uint64 maxClaimFee;
    73	        // The maximum fee charged on the ideal (without slippage) amountIn by the initiator, with 18 decimals precision.
    74	        uint64 maxSwapFee;
    75	        // The maximum relative deviation the pool can have from the trustedSqrtPrice, with 18 decimals precision.
    76	        uint64 upperSqrtPriceDeviation;
    77	        // The minimum relative deviation the pool can have from the trustedSqrtPrice, with 18 decimals precision.
    78	        uint64 lowerSqrtPriceDeviation;
    79	        // The ratio that limits the amount of slippage of the swap, with 18 decimals precision.
    80	        uint64 minLiquidityRatio;
    81	        // The contract address of the strategy hook.
    82	        address strategyHook;
    83	    }
    84	
    85	    // A struct with the initiator parameters.
    86	    struct InitiatorParams {
    87	        // The contract address of the position manager.
    88	        address positionManager;
    89	        // The id of the position.
    90	        uint96 oldId;
    91	        // The amount of token0 withdrawn from the account.
    92	        uint128 amountIn0;
    93	        // The amount of token1 withdrawn from the account.
    94	        uint128 amountIn1;
    95	        // The amount of token0 to send to the account.
    96	        uint128 amountOut0;
    97	        // The amount of token1 to send to the account.
    98	        uint128 amountOut1;
    99	        // The sqrtPrice the pool should have, given by the initiator.
   100	        uint256 trustedSqrtPrice;
   101	        // The fee charged on the claimed fees of the liquidity position, with 18 decimals precision.
   102	        uint64 claimFee;
   103	        // The fee charged on the ideal (without slippage) amountIn by the initiator, with 18 decimals precision.
   104	        uint64 swapFee;
   105	        // Calldata provided by the initiator to execute the swap.
   106	        bytes swapData;
   107	        // Strategy specific Calldata provided by the initiator.
   108	        bytes strategyData;
   109	    }
   110	
   111	    // A struct with cached variables.
   112	    struct Cache {
   113	        // The lower bound the sqrtPrice can have for the pool to be balanced.
   114	        uint256 lowerBoundSqrtPrice;
   115	        // The lower bound the sqrtPrice can have for the pool to be balanced.
   116	        uint256 upperBoundSqrtPrice;
   117	        // The sqrtRatio of the lower tick.
   118	        uint160 sqrtRatioLower;
   119	        // The sqrtRatio of the upper tick.
   120	        uint160 sqrtRatioUpper;
   121	    }
   122	
   123	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   124	                                ERRORS
   125	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   126	
   127	    error InsufficientLiquidity();
   128	    error InvalidAccountVersion();
   129	    error InvalidInitiator();
   130	    error InvalidPositionManager();
   131	    error InvalidValue();
   132	    error NotAnAccount();
   133	    error OnlyAccount();
   134	    error OnlyAccountOwner();
   135	    error Reentered();
   136	    error UnbalancedPool();
   137	
   138	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   139	                                EVENTS
   140	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   141	
   142	    event AccountInfoSet(address indexed account, address indexed initiator, address indexed strategyHook);
   143	    event Rebalance(address indexed account, address indexed positionManager, uint256 oldId, uint256 newId);
   144	
   145	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   146	                            CONSTRUCTOR
   147	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   148	
   149	    /**
   150	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
   151	     * @param arcadiaFactory The contract address of the Arcadia Factory.
   152	     * @param routerTrampoline The contract address of the Router Trampoline.
   153	     */
   154	    constructor(address owner_, address arcadiaFactory, address routerTrampoline) Guardian(owner_) {
   155	        ARCADIA_FACTORY = IArcadiaFactory(arcadiaFactory);
   156	        ROUTER_TRAMPOLINE = IRouterTrampoline(routerTrampoline);
   157	    }
   158	
   159	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   160	                            ACCOUNT LOGIC
   161	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   162	
   163	    /**
   164	     * @notice Optional hook called by the Arcadia Account when calling "setAssetManager()".
   165	     * @param accountOwner The current owner of the Arcadia Account.
   166	     * param status Bool indicating if the Asset Manager is enabled or disabled.
   167	     * @param data Operator specific data, passed by the Account owner.
   168	     * @dev No need to check that the Account version is 3 or greater (versions with cross account reentrancy guard),
   169	     * since version 1 and 2 don't support the onSetAssetManager hook.
   170	     */
   171	    function onSetAssetManager(address accountOwner, bool, bytes calldata data) external {
   172	        if (account != address(0)) revert Reentered();
   173	        if (!ARCADIA_FACTORY.isAccount(msg.sender)) revert NotAnAccount();
   174	
   175	        (
   176	            address initiator,
   177	            uint256 maxClaimFee,
   178	            uint256 maxSwapFee,
   179	            uint256 maxTolerance,
   180	            uint256 minLiquidityRatio,
   181	            address strategyHook,
   182	            bytes memory strategyData,
   183	            bytes memory metaData_
   184	        ) = abi.decode(data, (address, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, address, bytes, bytes));
   185	        _setAccountInfo(
   186	            msg.sender,
   187	            accountOwner,
   188	            initiator,
   189	            maxClaimFee,
   190	            maxSwapFee,
   191	            maxTolerance,
   192	            minLiquidityRatio,
   193	            strategyHook,
   194	            strategyData,
   195	            metaData_
   196	        );
   197	    }
   198	
   199	    /**
   200	     * @notice Sets the required information for an Account.
   201	     * @param account_ The contract address of the Arcadia Account to set the information for.
   202	     * @param initiator The address of the initiator.
   203	     * @param maxClaimFee The maximum fee charged on claimed fees/rewards by the initiator, with 18 decimals precision.
   204	     * @param maxSwapFee The maximum fee charged on the ideal (without slippage) amountIn by the initiator, with 18 decimals precision.
   205	     * @param maxTolerance The maximum allowed deviation of the actual pool price for any initiator,
   206	     * relative to the price calculated with trusted external prices of both assets, with 18 decimals precision.
   207	     * @param minLiquidityRatio The ratio of the minimum amount of liquidity that must be minted,
   208	     * relative to the hypothetical amount of liquidity when we rebalance without slippage, with 18 decimals precision.
   209	     * @param strategyHook The contract address of the strategy hook.
   210	     * @param strategyData Strategy specific data stored in the hook.
   211	     * @param metaData_ Custom metadata to be stored with the account.
   212	     */
   213	    function setAccountInfo(
   214	        address account_,
   215	        address initiator,
   216	        uint256 maxClaimFee,
   217	        uint256 maxSwapFee,
   218	        uint256 maxTolerance,
   219	        uint256 minLiquidityRatio,
   220	        address strategyHook,
   221	        bytes calldata strategyData,
   222	        bytes calldata metaData_
   223	    ) external {
   224	        if (account != address(0)) revert Reentered();
   225	        if (!ARCADIA_FACTORY.isAccount(account_)) revert NotAnAccount();
   226	        address accountOwner = IAccount(account_).owner();
   227	        if (msg.sender != accountOwner) revert OnlyAccountOwner();
   228	        // Block Account versions without cross account reentrancy guard.
   229	        if (IAccount(account_).ACCOUNT_VERSION() < 3) revert InvalidAccountVersion();
   230	
   231	        _setAccountInfo(
   232	            account_,
   233	            accountOwner,
   234	            initiator,
   235	            maxClaimFee,
   236	            maxSwapFee,
   237	            maxTolerance,
   238	            minLiquidityRatio,
   239	            strategyHook,
   240	            strategyData,
   241	            metaData_
   242	        );
   243	    }
   244	
   245	    /**
   246	     * @notice Sets the required information for an Account.
   247	     * @param account_ The contract address of the Arcadia Account to set the information for.
   248	     * @param accountOwner The current owner of the Arcadia Account.
   249	     * @param initiator The address of the initiator.
   250	     * @param maxClaimFee The maximum fee charged on claimed fees/rewards by the initiator, with 18 decimals precision.
   251	     * @param maxSwapFee The maximum fee charged on the ideal (without slippage) amountIn by the initiator, with 18 decimals precision.
   252	     * @param maxTolerance The maximum allowed deviation of the actual pool price for any initiator,
   253	     * relative to the price calculated with trusted external prices of both assets, with 18 decimals precision.
   254	     * @param minLiquidityRatio The ratio of the minimum amount of liquidity that must be minted,
   255	     * relative to the hypothetical amount of liquidity when we rebalance without slippage, with 18 decimals precision.
   256	     * @param strategyHook The contract address of the strategy hook.
   257	     * @param strategyData Strategy specific data stored in the hook.
   258	     * @param metaData_ Custom metadata to be stored with the account.
   259	     */
   260	    function _setAccountInfo(
   261	        address account_,
   262	        address accountOwner,
   263	        address initiator,
   264	        uint256 maxClaimFee,
   265	        uint256 maxSwapFee,
   266	        uint256 maxTolerance,
   267	        uint256 minLiquidityRatio,
   268	        address strategyHook,
   269	        bytes memory strategyData,
   270	        bytes memory metaData_
   271	    ) internal {
   272	        if (maxClaimFee > 1e18 || maxSwapFee > 1e18 || maxTolerance > 1e18 || minLiquidityRatio > 1e18) {
   273	            revert InvalidValue();
   274	        }
   275	
   276	        accountToInitiator[accountOwner][account_] = initiator;
   277	        // unsafe cast: fees <= 1e18 < type(uint64).max.
   278	        // unsafe cast: upperSqrtPriceDeviation <= √2 * 1e18 < type(uint64).max.
   279	        // forge-lint: disable-next-item(unsafe-typecast)
   280	        accountInfo[account_] = AccountInfo({
   281	            maxClaimFee: uint64(maxClaimFee),
   282	            maxSwapFee: uint64(maxSwapFee),
   283	            upperSqrtPriceDeviation: uint64(FixedPointMathLib.sqrt((1e18 + maxTolerance) * 1e18)),
   284	            lowerSqrtPriceDeviation: uint64(FixedPointMathLib.sqrt((1e18 - maxTolerance) * 1e18)),
   285	            minLiquidityRatio: uint64(minLiquidityRatio),
   286	            strategyHook: strategyHook
   287	        });
   288	        metaData[account_] = metaData_;
   289	
   290	        IStrategyHook(strategyHook).setStrategy(account_, strategyData);
   291	
   292	        emit AccountInfoSet(account_, initiator, strategyHook);
   293	    }
   294	
   295	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   296	                             REBALANCING LOGIC
   297	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   298	
   299	    /**
   300	     * @notice Rebalances a Concentrated Liquidity Positions, owned by an Arcadia Account.
   301	     * @param account_ The contract address of the account.
   302	     * @param initiatorParams A struct with the initiator parameters.
   303	     * @dev The amountOuts, provided by the initiator with the initiatorParams,
   304	     * must be smaller or equal to the rebalancers balance after burning the position or the rebalance reverts.
   305	     * To withdraw the full underlying balance of a liquidity position to the account, set amountOut for that token to type(uint128).max.
   306	     */
   307	    function rebalance(address account_, InitiatorParams calldata initiatorParams) external whenNotPaused {
   308	        // Store Account address, used to validate the caller of the executeAction() callback and serves as a reentrancy guard.
   309	        if (account != address(0)) revert Reentered();
   310	        account = account_;
   311	
   312	        // If the initiator is set, account_ is an actual Arcadia Account.
   313	        if (accountToInitiator[IAccount(account_).owner()][account_] != msg.sender) revert InvalidInitiator();
   314	        if (!isPositionManager(initiatorParams.positionManager)) revert InvalidPositionManager();
   315	
   316	        // If leftovers have to be withdrawn from account, get token0 and token1.
   317	        address token0;
   318	        address token1;
   319	        if (initiatorParams.amountIn0 > 0 || initiatorParams.amountIn1 > 0) {
   320	            (token0, token1) = _getUnderlyingTokens(initiatorParams.positionManager, initiatorParams.oldId);
   321	        }
   322	
   323	        // Encode data for the flash-action.
   324	        bytes memory actionData = ArcadiaLogic._encodeAction(
   325	            initiatorParams.positionManager,
   326	            initiatorParams.oldId,
   327	            token0,
   328	            token1,
   329	            initiatorParams.amountIn0,
   330	            initiatorParams.amountIn1,
   331	            abi.encode(msg.sender, initiatorParams)
   332	        );
   333	
   334	        // Call flashAction() with this contract as actionTarget.
   335	        IAccount(account_).flashAction(address(this), actionData);
   336	
   337	        // Reset account.
   338	        account = address(0);
   339	    }
   340	
   341	    /**
   342	     * @notice Callback function called by the Arcadia Account during the flashAction.
   343	     * @param actionTargetData A bytes object containing the initiator and initiatorParams.
   344	     * @return depositData A struct with the asset data of the Liquidity Position and with the leftovers after mint, if any.
   345	     * @dev The Liquidity Position is already transferred to this contract before executeAction() is called.
   346	     * @dev When rebalancing we will burn the current Liquidity Position and mint a new one with a new tokenId.
   347	     */
   348	    function executeAction(bytes calldata actionTargetData) external override returns (ActionData memory depositData) {
   349	        // Caller should be the Account, provided as input in rebalance().
   350	        if (msg.sender != account) revert OnlyAccount();
   351	
   352	        // Cache accountInfo.
   353	        AccountInfo memory accountInfo_ = accountInfo[msg.sender];
   354	
   355	        // Decode actionTargetData.
   356	        (address initiator, InitiatorParams memory initiatorParams) =
   357	            abi.decode(actionTargetData, (address, InitiatorParams));
   358	        address positionManager = initiatorParams.positionManager;
   359	
   360	        // Validate initiatorParams.
   361	        if (initiatorParams.claimFee > accountInfo_.maxClaimFee || initiatorParams.swapFee > accountInfo_.maxSwapFee) {
   362	            revert InvalidValue();
   363	        }
   364	
   365	        // Get all pool and position related state.
   366	        PositionState memory position = _getPositionState(positionManager, initiatorParams.oldId);
   367	
   368	        // Rebalancer has withdrawn the underlying tokens from the Account.
   369	        uint256[] memory balances = new uint256[](position.tokens.length);
   370	        balances[0] = initiatorParams.amountIn0;
   371	        balances[1] = initiatorParams.amountIn1;
   372	        uint256[] memory fees = new uint256[](balances.length);
   373	
   374	        // Call the strategy hook before the rebalance (view function, cannot modify state of pool or old position).
   375	        // The strategy hook will return the new ticks of the position
   376	        // (we override ticks of the memory pointer of the old position as these are no longer needed after this call).
   377	        // Hook can be used to enforce additional strategy specific constraints, specific to the Account/Id.
   378	        // Such as:
   379	        // - Minimum Cool Down Periods.
   380	        // - Excluding rebalancing of certain positions.
   381	        // - ...
   382	        (position.tickLower, position.tickUpper) = IStrategyHook(accountInfo_.strategyHook)
   383	            .beforeRebalance(msg.sender, positionManager, position, initiatorParams.strategyData);
   384	
   385	        // Cache variables that are gas expensive to calculate and used multiple times.
   386	        Cache memory cache = _getCache(accountInfo_, position, initiatorParams.trustedSqrtPrice);
   387	
   388	        // Check that pool is initially balanced.
   389	        // Prevents sandwiching attacks when swapping and/or adding liquidity.
   390	        if (!isPoolBalanced(position.sqrtPrice, cache)) revert UnbalancedPool();
   391	
   392	        // Claim pending yields and update balances.
   393	        _claim(balances, fees, positionManager, position, initiatorParams.claimFee);
   394	
   395	        // If the position is staked, unstake it.
   396	        _unstake(balances, positionManager, position);
   397	
   398	        // Remove liquidity of the position and update balances.
   399	        _burn(balances, positionManager, position);
   400	
   401	        // Check if we want to withdraw the full underlying balance of one of the underlying tokens to the account.
   402	        if (initiatorParams.amountOut0 == type(uint128).max) {
   403	            initiatorParams.amountOut0 = (balances[0] - fees[0]).safeCastTo128();
   404	        } else if (initiatorParams.amountOut1 == type(uint128).max) {
   405	            initiatorParams.amountOut1 = (balances[1] - fees[1]).safeCastTo128();
   406	        }
   407	
   408	        // Get the rebalance parameters, based on a hypothetical swap through the pool itself without slippage.
   409	        // Reverts if balance is smaller than the required fees and amountOut.
   410	        RebalanceParams memory rebalanceParams = RebalanceLogic._getRebalanceParams(
   411	            accountInfo_.minLiquidityRatio,
   412	            position.fee,
   413	            initiatorParams.swapFee,
   414	            position.sqrtPrice,
   415	            cache.sqrtRatioLower,
   416	            cache.sqrtRatioUpper,
   417	            balances[0] - fees[0] - initiatorParams.amountOut0,
   418	            balances[1] - fees[1] - initiatorParams.amountOut1
   419	        );
   420	        if (rebalanceParams.zeroToOne) fees[0] += rebalanceParams.amountInitiatorFee;
   421	        else fees[1] += rebalanceParams.amountInitiatorFee;
   422	
   423	        // Do the swap to rebalance the position.
   424	        // This can be done either directly through the pool, or via a router with custom swap data.
   425	        // For swaps directly through the pool, if slippage is bigger than calculated, the transaction will not immediately revert,
   426	        // but excess slippage will be subtracted from the initiatorFee.
   427	        // For swaps via a router, tokenOut should be the limiting factor when increasing liquidity.
   428	        // Update balances after the swap.
   429	        _swap(balances, fees, initiatorParams, position, rebalanceParams, cache);
   430	
   431	        // Check that the pool is still balanced after the swap.
   432	        // Since the swap went potentially through the pool itself (but does not have to),
   433	        // the sqrtPrice might have moved and brought the pool out of balance.
   434	        position.sqrtPrice = _getSqrtPrice(position);
   435	        if (!isPoolBalanced(position.sqrtPrice, cache)) revert UnbalancedPool();
   436	
   437	        // As explained before _swap(), tokenOut should be the limiting factor when increasing liquidity
   438	        // therefore we only subtract the initiator fee from the amountOut, not from the amountIn.
   439	        // Update balances, id and liquidity after the mint.
   440	        (uint256 amount0Desired, uint256 amount1Desired) = rebalanceParams.zeroToOne
   441	            ? (balances[0] - initiatorParams.amountOut0, balances[1] - fees[1] - initiatorParams.amountOut1)
   442	            : (balances[0] - fees[0] - initiatorParams.amountOut0, balances[1] - initiatorParams.amountOut1);
   443	        _mint(balances, positionManager, position, amount0Desired, amount1Desired);
   444	
   445	        // Check that the actual liquidity of the position is above the minimum threshold.
   446	        // This prevents loss of principal of the liquidity position due to slippage,
   447	        // or malicious initiators who remove liquidity during a custom swap.
   448	        if (position.liquidity < rebalanceParams.minLiquidity) revert InsufficientLiquidity();
   449	
   450	        // If the position is staked, stake it.
   451	        _stake(balances, positionManager, position);
   452	
   453	        // Call the strategy hook after the rebalance (non view function).
   454	        // Can be used to check additional constraints and persist state changes on the hook.
   455	        IStrategyHook(accountInfo_.strategyHook)
   456	            .afterRebalance(msg.sender, positionManager, initiatorParams.oldId, position, initiatorParams.strategyData);
   457	
   458	        // Approve the liquidity position and leftovers to be deposited back into the Account.
   459	        // And transfer the initiator fees to the initiator.
   460	        uint256 count = _approveAndTransfer(initiator, balances, fees, initiatorParams, positionManager, position);
   461	
   462	        // Encode deposit data for the flash-action.
   463	        depositData = ArcadiaLogic._encodeDeposit(positionManager, position.id, position.tokens, balances, count);
   464	
   465	        emit Rebalance(msg.sender, positionManager, initiatorParams.oldId, position.id);
   466	    }
   467	
   468	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   469	                            POSITION VALIDATION
   470	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   471	
   472	    /**
   473	     * @notice Returns if the pool of a Liquidity Position is balanced.
   474	     * @param sqrtPrice The sqrtPrice of the pool.
   475	     * @param cache A struct with cached variables.
   476	     * @return isBalanced Bool indicating if the pool is balanced.
   477	     */
   478	    function isPoolBalanced(uint256 sqrtPrice, Cache memory cache) public pure returns (bool isBalanced) {
   479	        // Check if current price of the Pool is within accepted tolerance of the calculated trusted price.
   480	        isBalanced = sqrtPrice > cache.lowerBoundSqrtPrice && sqrtPrice < cache.upperBoundSqrtPrice;
   481	    }
   482	
   483	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   484	                              GETTERS
   485	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   486	
   487	    /**
   488	     * @notice Returns the cached variables.
   489	     * @param accountInfo_ A struct with the account specific parameters.
   490	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   491	     * @param trustedSqrtPrice The sqrtPrice the pool should have, given by the initiator.
   492	     * @return cache A struct with cached variables.
   493	     */
   494	    function _getCache(AccountInfo memory accountInfo_, PositionState memory position, uint256 trustedSqrtPrice)
   495	        internal
   496	        view
   497	        virtual
   498	        returns (Cache memory cache)
   499	    {
   500	        // We do not handle the edge cases where the bounds of the sqrtPrice exceed MIN_SQRT_RATIO or MAX_SQRT_RATIO.
   501	        // This will result in a revert during swapViaPool, if ever needed a different rebalancer has to be deployed.
   502	        cache = Cache({
   503	            lowerBoundSqrtPrice: trustedSqrtPrice.mulDivDown(accountInfo_.lowerSqrtPriceDeviation, 1e18),
   504	            upperBoundSqrtPrice: trustedSqrtPrice.mulDivDown(accountInfo_.upperSqrtPriceDeviation, 1e18),
   505	            sqrtRatioLower: TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(position.tickLower),
   506	            sqrtRatioUpper: TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(position.tickUpper)
   507	        });
   508	    }
   509	
   510	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   511	                             SWAP LOGIC
   512	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   513	
   514	    /**
   515	     * @notice Swaps one token for another to rebalance the Liquidity Position.
   516	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens held by the Rebalancer.
   517	     * @param fees The fees of the underlying tokens to be paid to the initiator.
   518	     * @param initiatorParams A struct with the initiator parameters.
   519	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   520	     * @param rebalanceParams A struct with the rebalance parameters.
   521	     * @param cache A struct with cached variables.
   522	     * @dev Must update the balances and sqrtPrice after the swap.
   523	     */
   524	    function _swap(
   525	        uint256[] memory balances,
   526	        uint256[] memory fees,
   527	        InitiatorParams memory initiatorParams,
   528	        PositionState memory position,
   529	        RebalanceParams memory rebalanceParams,
   530	        Cache memory cache
   531	    ) internal virtual {
   532	        // Don't do swaps with zero amount.
   533	        if (rebalanceParams.amountIn == 0) return;
   534	
   535	        // Do the actual swap to rebalance the position.
   536	        // This can be done either directly through the pool, or via a router with custom swap data.
   537	        if (initiatorParams.swapData.length == 0) {
   538	            // Calculate a more accurate amountOut, with slippage.
   539	            uint256 amount0 = balances[0] - fees[0] - initiatorParams.amountOut0;
   540	            uint256 amount1 = balances[1] - fees[1] - initiatorParams.amountOut1;
   541	            uint256 amountOut = RebalanceOptimizationMath._getAmountOutWithSlippage(
   542	                rebalanceParams.zeroToOne,
   543	                position.fee,
   544	                _getPoolLiquidity(position),
   545	                uint160(position.sqrtPrice),
   546	                cache.sqrtRatioLower,
   547	                cache.sqrtRatioUpper,
   548	                amount0,
   549	                amount1,
   550	                rebalanceParams.amountIn,
   551	                rebalanceParams.amountOut
   552	            );
   553	            // Don't do swaps with zero amount.
   554	            if (amountOut == 0) return;
   555	            _swapViaPool(balances, position, rebalanceParams.zeroToOne, amountOut);
   556	        } else {
   557	            _swapViaRouter(balances, position, rebalanceParams.zeroToOne, initiatorParams.swapData);
   558	        }
   559	    }
   560	
   561	    /**
   562	     * @notice Swaps one token for another, via a router with custom swap data.
   563	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens held by the Rebalancer.
   564	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   565	     * @param zeroToOne Bool indicating if token0 has to be swapped to token1 or opposite.
   566	     * @param swapData Arbitrary calldata provided by an initiator for the swap.
   567	     * @dev Initiator has to route swap in such a way that at least minLiquidity of liquidity is added to the position after the swap.
   568	     * And leftovers must be in tokenIn, otherwise the total tokenIn balance will be added as liquidity,
   569	     * and the initiator fee will be 0 (but the transaction will not revert).
   570	     */
   571	    function _swapViaRouter(
   572	        uint256[] memory balances,
   573	        PositionState memory position,
   574	        bool zeroToOne,
   575	        bytes memory swapData
   576	    ) internal virtual {
   577	        // Decode the swap data.
   578	        (address router, uint256 amountIn, bytes memory data) = abi.decode(swapData, (address, uint256, bytes));
   579	
   580	        (address tokenIn, address tokenOut) =
   581	            zeroToOne ? (position.tokens[0], position.tokens[1]) : (position.tokens[1], position.tokens[0]);
   582	
   583	        // Send tokens to the Router Trampoline.
   584	        ERC20(tokenIn).safeTransfer(address(ROUTER_TRAMPOLINE), amountIn);
   585	
   586	        // Execute swap.
   587	        (uint256 balanceIn, uint256 balanceOut) = ROUTER_TRAMPOLINE.execute(router, data, tokenIn, tokenOut, amountIn);
   588	
   589	        // Update the balances.
   590	        (balances[0], balances[1]) = zeroToOne
   591	            ? (balances[0] - amountIn + balanceIn, balances[1] + balanceOut)
   592	            : (balances[0] + balanceOut, balances[1] - amountIn + balanceIn);
   593	    }
   594	
   595	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   596	                    APPROVE AND TRANSFER LOGIC
   597	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   598	
   599	    /**
   600	     * @notice Approves the liquidity position and leftovers to be deposited back into the Account
   601	     * and transfers the initiator fees to the initiator.
   602	     * @param initiator The address of the initiator.
   603	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens held by the Rebalancer.
   604	     * @param fees The fees of the underlying tokens to be paid to the initiator.
   605	     * @param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   606	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   607	     * @return count The number of assets approved.
   608	     */
   609	    function _approveAndTransfer(
   610	        address initiator,
   611	        uint256[] memory balances,
   612	        uint256[] memory fees,
   613	        InitiatorParams memory initiatorParams,
   614	        address positionManager,
   615	        PositionState memory position
   616	    ) internal returns (uint256 count) {
   617	        // Approve the Liquidity Position.
   618	        ERC721(positionManager).approve(msg.sender, position.id);
   619	
   620	        // Transfer Initiator fees and approve amountOut and leftovers.
   621	        address token;
   622	        uint256 amountOut;
   623	        count = 1;
   624	        for (uint256 i; i < balances.length; i++) {
   625	            if (i <= 1) amountOut = i == 0 ? initiatorParams.amountOut0 : initiatorParams.amountOut1;
   626	            else amountOut = 0;
   627	
   628	            token = position.tokens[i];
   629	            // At least amountOut must be returned to the Account.
   630	            // Reverts if balance is smaller than the required amountOut.
   631	            if (balances[i] - amountOut > fees[i]) {
   632	                balances[i] = balances[i] - fees[i];
   633	            } else {
   634	                fees[i] = balances[i] - amountOut;
   635	                balances[i] = amountOut;
   636	            }
   637	
   638	            // Approve Account to deposit tokens.
   639	            if (balances[i] > 0) {
   640	                ERC20(token).safeApproveWithRetry(msg.sender, balances[i]);
   641	                count++;
   642	            }
   643	
   644	            // Transfer Initiator fees to the initiator.
   645	            if (fees[i] > 0) ERC20(token).safeTransfer(initiator, fees[i]);
   646	            emit FeePaid(msg.sender, initiator, token, fees[i]);
   647	        }
   648	    }
   649	
   650	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   651	                             SKIM LOGIC
   652	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   653	
   654	    /**
   655	     * @notice Recovers any native or ERC20 tokens left on the contract.
   656	     * @param token The contract address of the token, or address(0) for native tokens.
   657	     */
   658	    function skim(address token) external onlyOwner whenNotPaused {
   659	        if (account != address(0)) revert Reentered();
   660	
   661	        if (token == address(0)) {
   662	            (bool success, bytes memory result) = payable(msg.sender).call{ value: address(this).balance }("");
   663	            require(success, string(result));
   664	        } else {
   665	            ERC20(token).safeTransfer(msg.sender, ERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this)));
   666	        }
   667	    }
   668	}
```

```solidity
     1	/**

     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { Rebalancer } from "./Rebalancer.sol";
     8	import { Slipstream } from "../base/Slipstream.sol";
     9	
    10	/**
    11	 * @title Rebalancer for Slipstream Liquidity Positions.
    12	 * @notice The Rebalancer is an Asset Manager for Arcadia Accounts.
    13	 * It will allow third parties to trigger the rebalancing functionality for a Liquidity Position in the Account.
    14	 * The owner of an Arcadia Account should set an initiator via setAccountInfo() that will be permissioned to rebalance
    15	 * all Liquidity Positions held in that Account.
    16	 * @dev The initiator will provide a trusted sqrtPrice input at the time of rebalance to mitigate frontrunning risks.
    17	 * This input serves as a reference point for calculating the maximum allowed deviation during the rebalancing process,
    18	 * ensuring that rebalancing remains within a controlled price range.
    19	 * @dev The contract guarantees a limited slippage with each rebalance by enforcing a minimum amount of liquidity that must be added,
    20	 * based on a hypothetical optimal swap through the pool itself without slippage.
    21	 * This protects the Account owners from incompetent or malicious initiators who route swaps poorly, or try to skim off liquidity from the position.
    22	 */
    23	contract RebalancerSlipstream is Rebalancer, Slipstream {
    24	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    25	                                CONSTANTS
    26	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    27	
    28	    // The version of the Asset Manager.
    29	    string public constant VERSION = "2.1.1";
    30	
    31	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    32	                            CONSTRUCTOR
    33	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    34	
    35	    /**
    36	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    37	     * @param arcadiaFactory The contract address of the Arcadia Factory.
    38	     * @param routerTrampoline The contract address of the Router Trampoline.
    39	     * @param positionManager The contract address of the Slipstream Position Manager.
    40	     * @param cLFactory The contract address of the Slipstream Factory.
    41	     * @param poolImplementation The contract address of the Slipstream Pool Implementation.
    42	     * @param rewardToken The contract address of the Reward Token (Aero).
    43	     * @param stakedSlipstreamAm The contract address of the Staked Slipstream Asset Module.
    44	     * @param stakedSlipstreamWrapper The contract address of the Staked Slipstream Wrapper.
    45	     */
    46	    constructor(
    47	        address owner_,
    48	        address arcadiaFactory,
    49	        address routerTrampoline,
    50	        address positionManager,
    51	        address cLFactory,
    52	        address poolImplementation,
    53	        address rewardToken,
    54	        address stakedSlipstreamAm,
    55	        address stakedSlipstreamWrapper
    56	    )
    57	        Rebalancer(owner_, arcadiaFactory, routerTrampoline)
    58	        Slipstream(
    59	            positionManager, cLFactory, poolImplementation, rewardToken, stakedSlipstreamAm, stakedSlipstreamWrapper
    60	        )
    61	    { }
    62	}
```
