### asset-managers/src/cl-managers/rebalancers/RebalancerUniswapV4.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { ERC20, SafeTransferLib } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/SafeTransferLib.sol";
     8	import { IWETH } from "../interfaces/IWETH.sol";
     9	import { PositionState } from "../state/PositionState.sol";
    10	import { Rebalancer } from "./Rebalancer.sol";
    11	import { UniswapV4 } from "../base/UniswapV4.sol";
    12	
    13	/**
    14	 * @title Rebalancer for Uniswap V4 Liquidity Positions.
    15	 * @notice The Rebalancer is an Asset Manager for Arcadia Accounts.
    16	 * It will allow third parties to trigger the rebalancing functionality for a Liquidity Position in the Account.
    17	 * The owner of an Arcadia Account should set an initiator via setAccountInfo() that will be permissioned to rebalance
    18	 * all Liquidity Positions held in that Account.
    19	 * @dev The initiator will provide a trusted sqrtPrice input at the time of rebalance to mitigate frontrunning risks.
    20	 * This input serves as a reference point for calculating the maximum allowed deviation during the rebalancing process,
    21	 * ensuring that rebalancing remains within a controlled price range.
    22	 * @dev The contract guarantees a limited slippage with each rebalance by enforcing a minimum amount of liquidity that must be added,
    23	 * based on a hypothetical optimal swap through the pool itself without slippage.
    24	 * This protects the Account owners from incompetent or malicious initiators who route swaps poorly, or try to skim off liquidity from the position.
    25	 * @dev The rebalancer must not be used for Pools of native ETH - WETH.
    26	 */
    27	contract RebalancerUniswapV4 is Rebalancer, UniswapV4 {
    28	    using SafeTransferLib for ERC20;
    29	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    30	                                CONSTANTS
    31	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    32	
    33	    // The version of the Asset Manager.
    34	    string public constant VERSION = "2.1.1";
    35	
    36	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    37	                            CONSTRUCTOR
    38	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    39	
    40	    /**
    41	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    42	     * @param arcadiaFactory The contract address of the Arcadia Factory.
    43	     * @param routerTrampoline The contract address of the Router Trampoline.
    44	     * @param positionManager The contract address of the Uniswap v4 Position Manager.
    45	     * @param permit2 The contract address of Permit2.
    46	     * @param poolManager The contract address of the Uniswap v4 Pool Manager.
    47	     * @param weth The contract address of WETH.
    48	     */
    49	    constructor(
    50	        address owner_,
    51	        address arcadiaFactory,
    52	        address routerTrampoline,
    53	        address positionManager,
    54	        address permit2,
    55	        address poolManager,
    56	        address weth
    57	    ) Rebalancer(owner_, arcadiaFactory, routerTrampoline) UniswapV4(positionManager, permit2, poolManager, weth) { }
    58	
    59	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    60	                             SWAP LOGIC
    61	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    62	
    63	    /**
    64	     * @notice Swaps one token for another, via a router with custom swap data.
    65	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens held by the Rebalancer.
    66	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
    67	     * @param zeroToOne Bool indicating if token0 has to be swapped to token1 or opposite.
    68	     * @param swapData Arbitrary calldata provided by an initiator for the swap.
    69	     * @dev Initiator has to route swap in such a way that at least minLiquidity of liquidity is added to the position after the swap.
    70	     * And leftovers must be in tokenIn, otherwise the total tokenIn balance will be added as liquidity,
    71	     * and the initiator fee will be 0 (but the transaction will not revert).
    72	     */
    73	    function _swapViaRouter(
    74	        uint256[] memory balances,
    75	        PositionState memory position,
    76	        bool zeroToOne,
    77	        bytes memory swapData
    78	    ) internal override {
    79	        // Decode the swap data.
    80	        (address router, uint256 amountIn, bytes memory data) = abi.decode(swapData, (address, uint256, bytes));
    81	
    82	        (address tokenIn, address tokenOut) =
    83	            zeroToOne ? (position.tokens[0], position.tokens[1]) : (position.tokens[1], position.tokens[0]);
    84	
    85	        // Handle pools with native ETH.
    86	        bool isNative = position.tokens[0] == address(0);
    87	        if (isNative) {
    88	            if (zeroToOne) {
    89	                tokenIn = WETH;
    90	                IWETH(WETH).deposit{ value: amountIn }();
    91	            } else {
    92	                tokenOut = WETH;
    93	            }
    94	        }
    95	
    96	        // Send tokens to the Router Trampoline.
    97	        ERC20(tokenIn).safeTransfer(address(ROUTER_TRAMPOLINE), amountIn);
    98	
    99	        // Execute swap.
   100	        (uint256 balanceIn, uint256 balanceOut) = ROUTER_TRAMPOLINE.execute(router, data, tokenIn, tokenOut, amountIn);
   101	
   102	        // Handle pools with native ETH.
   103	        if (isNative) {
   104	            uint256 wethBalance = zeroToOne ? balanceIn : balanceOut;
   105	            if (wethBalance > 0) IWETH(WETH).withdraw(wethBalance);
   106	        }
   107	
   108	        // Update the balances.
   109	        (balances[0], balances[1]) = zeroToOne
   110	            ? (balances[0] - amountIn + balanceIn, balances[1] + balanceOut)
   111	            : (balances[0] + balanceOut, balances[1] - amountIn + balanceIn);
   112	    }
   113	}
```

### asset-managers/src/cl-managers/rebalancers/periphery/StrategyHook.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { PositionState } from "../../state/PositionState.sol";
     8	
     9	/**
    10	 * @title Abstract Strategy Hook.
    11	 * @notice Allows an Arcadia Account to verify custom rebalancing preferences, such as:
    12	 * - The id or the underlying tokens of the position
    13	 * - Directional Preferences.
    14	 * - Minimum Cool Down periods.
    15	 * - ...
    16	 */
    17	abstract contract StrategyHook {
    18	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    19	                            ACCOUNT LOGIC
    20	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    21	
    22	    /**
    23	     * @notice Function called by the Rebalancer to set the strategy info for an Account.
    24	     * @param account The contract address of the Arcadia Account to set the rebalance info for.
    25	     * @param strategyData Encoded data containing strategy parameters.
    26	     */
    27	    function setStrategy(address account, bytes calldata strategyData) external virtual;
    28	
    29	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    30	                        BEFORE REBALANCE HOOK
    31	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    32	
    33	    /**
    34	     * @notice Hook called before the rebalance is executed.
    35	     * @param account The contract address of the Arcadia Account.
    36	     * @param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
    37	     * @param position The state of the old position.
    38	     * @param strategyData Encoded data containing strategy parameters.
    39	     * @return tickLower The new lower tick to rebalance to.
    40	     * @return tickUpper The new upper tick to rebalance to.
    41	     */
    42	    function beforeRebalance(
    43	        address account,
    44	        address positionManager,
    45	        PositionState memory position,
    46	        bytes memory strategyData
    47	    ) external view virtual returns (int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper);
    48	
    49	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    50	                         AFTER REBALANCE HOOK
    51	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    52	
    53	    /**
    54	     * @notice Hook called after the rebalance is executed.
    55	     * @param account The contract address of the Arcadia Account.
    56	     * @param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
    57	     * @param oldId The oldId of the Liquidity Position.
    58	     * @param newPosition The state of the new position.
    59	     * @param strategyData Encoded data containing strategy parameters.
    60	     */
    61	    function afterRebalance(
    62	        address account,
    63	        address positionManager,
    64	        uint256 oldId,
    65	        PositionState memory newPosition,
    66	        bytes memory strategyData
    67	    ) external virtual;
    68	}
```

### asset-managers/src/cl-managers/yield-claimers/YieldClaimer.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { AbstractBase } from "../base/AbstractBase.sol";
     8	import { ActionData, IActionBase } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/src/interfaces/IActionBase.sol";
     9	import { ArcadiaLogic } from "../libraries/ArcadiaLogic.sol";
    10	import { ERC20, SafeTransferLib } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/SafeTransferLib.sol";
    11	import { ERC721 } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/tokens/ERC721.sol";
    12	import { Guardian } from "../../guardian/Guardian.sol";
    13	import { IAccount } from "../../interfaces/IAccount.sol";
    14	import { IArcadiaFactory } from "../../interfaces/IArcadiaFactory.sol";
    15	import { PositionState } from "../state/PositionState.sol";
    16	import { SafeApprove } from "../../libraries/SafeApprove.sol";
    17	
    18	/**
    19	 * @title Abstract Yield Claimer for concentrated Liquidity Positions.
    20	 * @author Pragma Labs
    21	 */
    22	abstract contract YieldClaimer is IActionBase, AbstractBase, Guardian {
    23	    using SafeApprove for ERC20;
    24	    using SafeTransferLib for ERC20;
    25	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    26	                                CONSTANTS
    27	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    28	
    29	    // The contract address of the Arcadia Factory.
    30	    IArcadiaFactory internal immutable ARCADIA_FACTORY;
    31	
    32	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    33	                                STORAGE
    34	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    35	
    36	    // The Account to claim the yield for, used as transient storage.
    37	    address internal account;
    38	
    39	    // A mapping from account to account specific information.
    40	    mapping(address account => AccountInfo) public accountInfo;
    41	
    42	    // A mapping from account to custom metadata.
    43	    mapping(address account => bytes data) public metaData;
    44	
    45	    // A mapping that sets the approved initiator per owner per account.
    46	    mapping(address accountOwner => mapping(address account => address initiator)) public accountToInitiator;
    47	
    48	    // A struct with the account specific parameters.
    49	    struct AccountInfo {
    50	        // The address of the recipient of the claimed fees.
    51	        address feeRecipient;
    52	        // The maximum fee charged on the claimed fees of the liquidity position, with 18 decimals precision.
    53	        uint64 maxClaimFee;
    54	    }
    55	
    56	    // A struct with the initiator parameters.
    57	    struct InitiatorParams {
    58	        // The contract address of the position manager.
    59	        address positionManager;
    60	        // The id of the position.
    61	        uint96 id;
    62	        // The fee charged on the claimed fees of the liquidity position, with 18 decimals precision.
    63	        uint64 claimFee;
    64	    }
    65	
    66	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    67	                                ERRORS
    68	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    69	
    70	    error InvalidInitiator();
    71	    error InvalidAccountVersion();
    72	    error InvalidPositionManager();
    73	    error InvalidRecipient();
    74	    error InvalidValue();
    75	    error NotAnAccount();
    76	    error OnlyAccount();
    77	    error OnlyAccountOwner();
    78	    error Reentered();
    79	
    80	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    81	                                EVENTS
    82	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    83	
    84	    event AccountInfoSet(address indexed account, address indexed initiator);
    85	    event Claimed(address indexed account, address indexed positionManager, uint256 id);
    86	    event YieldTransferred(address indexed account, address indexed receiver, address indexed asset, uint256 amount);
    87	
    88	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    89	                            CONSTRUCTOR
    90	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    91	
    92	    /**
    93	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    94	     * @param arcadiaFactory The contract address of the Arcadia Factory.
    95	     */
    96	    constructor(address owner_, address arcadiaFactory) Guardian(owner_) {
    97	        ARCADIA_FACTORY = IArcadiaFactory(arcadiaFactory);
    98	    }
    99	
   100	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   101	                            ACCOUNT LOGIC
   102	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   103	
   104	    /**
   105	     * @notice Optional hook called by the Arcadia Account when calling "setAssetManager()".
   106	     * @param accountOwner The current owner of the Arcadia Account.
   107	     * param status Bool indicating if the Asset Manager is enabled or disabled.
   108	     * @param data Operator specific data, passed by the Account owner.
   109	     * @dev No need to check that the Account version is 3 or greater (versions with cross account reentrancy guard),
   110	     * since version 1 and 2 don't support the onSetAssetManager hook.
   111	     */
   112	    function onSetAssetManager(address accountOwner, bool, bytes calldata data) external {
   113	        if (account != address(0)) revert Reentered();
   114	        if (!ARCADIA_FACTORY.isAccount(msg.sender)) revert NotAnAccount();
   115	
   116	        (address initiator, address feeRecipient, uint256 maxClaimFee, bytes memory metaData_) =
   117	            abi.decode(data, (address, address, uint256, bytes));
   118	        _setAccountInfo(msg.sender, accountOwner, initiator, feeRecipient, maxClaimFee, metaData_);
   119	    }
   120	
   121	    /**
   122	     * @notice Sets the required information for an Account.
   123	     * @param account_ The contract address of the Arcadia Account to set the information for.
   124	     * @param initiator The address of the initiator.
   125	     * @param feeRecipient The address of the recipient of the claimed fees.
   126	     * @param maxClaimFee The maximum fee charged on the claimed fees of the liquidity position, with 18 decimals precision.
   127	     * @param metaData_ Custom metadata to be stored with the account.
   128	     */
   129	    function setAccountInfo(
   130	        address account_,
   131	        address initiator,
   132	        address feeRecipient,
   133	        uint256 maxClaimFee,
   134	        bytes calldata metaData_
   135	    ) external {
   136	        if (account != address(0)) revert Reentered();
   137	        if (!ARCADIA_FACTORY.isAccount(account_)) revert NotAnAccount();
   138	        address accountOwner = IAccount(account_).owner();
   139	        if (msg.sender != accountOwner) revert OnlyAccountOwner();
   140	        // Block Account versions without cross account reentrancy guard.
   141	        if (IAccount(account_).ACCOUNT_VERSION() < 3) revert InvalidAccountVersion();
   142	
   143	        _setAccountInfo(account_, accountOwner, initiator, feeRecipient, maxClaimFee, metaData_);
   144	    }
   145	
   146	    /**
   147	     * @notice Sets the required information for an Account.
   148	     * @param account_ The contract address of the Arcadia Account to set the information for.
   149	     * @param accountOwner The current owner of the Arcadia Account.
   150	     * @param initiator The address of the initiator.
   151	     * @param feeRecipient The address of the recipient of the claimed fees.
   152	     * @param maxClaimFee The maximum fee charged on the claimed fees of the liquidity position, with 18 decimals precision.
   153	     * @param metaData_ Custom metadata to be stored with the account.
   154	     */
   155	    function _setAccountInfo(
   156	        address account_,
   157	        address accountOwner,
   158	        address initiator,
   159	        address feeRecipient,
   160	        uint256 maxClaimFee,
   161	        bytes memory metaData_
   162	    ) internal {
   163	        if (feeRecipient == address(0)) revert InvalidRecipient();
   164	        if (maxClaimFee > 1e18) revert InvalidValue();
   165	
   166	        accountToInitiator[accountOwner][account_] = initiator;
   167	        // unsafe cast: maxClaimFee <= 1e18 < type(uint64).max.
   168	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   169	        accountInfo[account_] = AccountInfo({ feeRecipient: feeRecipient, maxClaimFee: uint64(maxClaimFee) });
   170	        metaData[account_] = metaData_;
   171	
   172	        emit AccountInfoSet(account_, initiator);
   173	    }
   174	
   175	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   176	                             CLAIMING LOGIC
   177	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   178	
   179	    /**
   180	     * @notice Claims accrued fees/rewards from a Liquidity Position, owned by an Arcadia Account.
   181	     * @param account_ The contract address of the account.
   182	     * @param initiatorParams A struct with the initiator parameters.
   183	     */
   184	    function claim(address account_, InitiatorParams calldata initiatorParams) external whenNotPaused {
   185	        // Store Account address, used to validate the caller of the executeAction() callback and serves as a reentrancy guard.
   186	        if (account != address(0)) revert Reentered();
   187	        account = account_;
   188	
   189	        // If the initiator is set, account_ is an actual Arcadia Account.
   190	        if (accountToInitiator[IAccount(account_).owner()][account_] != msg.sender) revert InvalidInitiator();
   191	        if (!isPositionManager(initiatorParams.positionManager)) revert InvalidPositionManager();
   192	
   193	        // Encode data for the flash-action.
   194	        bytes memory actionData = ArcadiaLogic._encodeAction(
   195	            initiatorParams.positionManager,
   196	            initiatorParams.id,
   197	            address(0),
   198	            address(0),
   199	            0,
   200	            0,
   201	            abi.encode(msg.sender, initiatorParams)
   202	        );
   203	
   204	        // Call flashAction() with this contract as actionTarget.
   205	        IAccount(account_).flashAction(address(this), actionData);
   206	
   207	        // Reset account.
   208	        account = address(0);
   209	    }
   210	
   211	    /**
   212	     * @notice Callback function called by the Arcadia Account during the flashAction.
   213	     * @param actionTargetData A bytes object containing the initiator and initiatorParams.
   214	     * @return depositData A struct with the asset data of the Liquidity Position and with the leftovers after mint, if any.
   215	     * @dev The Liquidity Position is already transferred to this contract before executeAction() is called.
   216	     * @dev When rebalancing we will burn the current Liquidity Position and mint a new one with a new tokenId.
   217	     */
   218	    function executeAction(bytes calldata actionTargetData) external override returns (ActionData memory depositData) {
   219	        // Caller should be the Account, provided as input in rebalance().
   220	        if (msg.sender != account) revert OnlyAccount();
   221	
   222	        // Cache accountInfo.
   223	        AccountInfo memory accountInfo_ = accountInfo[msg.sender];
   224	
   225	        // Decode actionTargetData.
   226	        (address initiator, InitiatorParams memory initiatorParams) =
   227	            abi.decode(actionTargetData, (address, InitiatorParams));
   228	        address positionManager = initiatorParams.positionManager;
   229	
   230	        // Validate initiatorParams.
   231	        if (initiatorParams.claimFee > accountInfo_.maxClaimFee) revert InvalidValue();
   232	
   233	        // Get all pool and position related state.
   234	        PositionState memory position = _getPositionState(positionManager, initiatorParams.id);
   235	        uint256[] memory balances = new uint256[](position.tokens.length);
   236	        uint256[] memory fees = new uint256[](balances.length);
   237	
   238	        // Claim pending yields and update balances.
   239	        _claim(balances, fees, positionManager, position, initiatorParams.claimFee);
   240	
   241	        // If native eth was claimed, wrap it.
   242	        _stake(balances, positionManager, position);
   243	
   244	        // Approve the liquidity position handle the claimed yields and transfer the initiator fees to the initiator.
   245	        uint256 count =
   246	            _approveAndTransfer(initiator, balances, fees, positionManager, position, accountInfo_.feeRecipient);
   247	
   248	        // Encode deposit data for the flash-action.
   249	        depositData = ArcadiaLogic._encodeDeposit(positionManager, position.id, position.tokens, balances, count);
   250	
   251	        emit Claimed(msg.sender, positionManager, position.id);
   252	    }
   253	
   254	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   255	                    APPROVE AND TRANSFER LOGIC
   256	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   257	
   258	    /**
   259	     * @notice Approves the liquidity position and handles the claimed yields.
   260	     * @param initiator The address of the initiator.
   261	     * @param balances The balances of the underlying tokens held by the YieldClaimer.
   262	     * @param fees The fees of the underlying tokens to be paid to the initiator.
   263	     * @param positionManager The contract address of the Position Manager.
   264	     * @param position A struct with position and pool related variables.
   265	     * @param recipient The address to which the collected fees will be sent.
   266	     * @return count The number of assets approved.
   267	     */
   268	    function _approveAndTransfer(
   269	        address initiator,
   270	        uint256[] memory balances,
   271	        uint256[] memory fees,
   272	        address positionManager,
   273	        PositionState memory position,
   274	        address recipient
   275	    ) internal returns (uint256 count) {
   276	        // Approve the Liquidity Position.
   277	        ERC721(positionManager).approve(msg.sender, position.id);
   278	
   279	        // Transfer Initiator fees and handle the claimed yields.
   280	        count = 1;
   281	        address token;
   282	        uint256 amount;
   283	        for (uint256 i; i < balances.length; i++) {
   284	            token = position.tokens[i];
   285	
   286	            // Handle the claimed yields.
   287	            if (balances[i] > fees[i]) {
   288	                amount = balances[i] - fees[i];
   289	                if (recipient == msg.sender) {
   290	                    // If feeRecipient is the Account itself, deposit yield back into the Account.
   291	                    balances[i] = amount;
   292	                    ERC20(token).safeApproveWithRetry(msg.sender, amount);
   293	                    count++;
   294	                } else {
   295	                    // Else, send the yield to the fee recipient.
   296	                    ERC20(token).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);
   297	                    balances[i] = 0;
   298	                }
   299	            } else {
   300	                amount = 0;
   301	                fees[i] = balances[i];
   302	                balances[i] = 0;
   303	            }
   304	
   305	            // Transfer Initiator fees to the initiator.
   306	            if (fees[i] > 0) ERC20(token).safeTransfer(initiator, fees[i]);
   307	            emit FeePaid(msg.sender, initiator, token, fees[i]);
   308	
   309	            if (recipient != msg.sender) emit YieldTransferred(msg.sender, recipient, token, amount);
   310	        }
   311	    }
   312	
   313	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   314	                             SKIM LOGIC
   315	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   316	
   317	    /**
   318	     * @notice Recovers any native or ERC20 tokens left on the contract.
   319	     * @param token The contract address of the token, or address(0) for native tokens.
   320	     */
   321	    function skim(address token) external onlyOwner whenNotPaused {
   322	        if (account != address(0)) revert Reentered();
   323	
   324	        if (token == address(0)) {
   325	            (bool success, bytes memory result) = payable(msg.sender).call{ value: address(this).balance }("");
   326	            require(success, string(result));
   327	        } else {
   328	            ERC20(token).safeTransfer(msg.sender, ERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this)));
   329	        }
   330	    }
   331	}
```

### asset-managers/src/cow-swapper/CowSwapper.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { ActionData, IActionBase } from "../../lib/accounts-v2/src/interfaces/IActionBase.sol";
     8	import { ArcadiaLogic } from "./libraries/ArcadiaLogic.sol";
     9	import { ECDSA } from "../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solady/src/utils/ECDSA.sol";
    10	import { EIP712 } from "../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solady/src/utils/EIP712.sol";
    11	import { FixedPointMathLib } from "../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/FixedPointMathLib.sol";
    12	import { Guardian } from "../guardian/Guardian.sol";
    13	import { IAccount } from "../interfaces/IAccount.sol";
    14	import { IArcadiaFactory } from "../interfaces/IArcadiaFactory.sol";
    15	import { IERC20 } from "./interfaces/IERC20.sol";
    16	import { IFlashLoanRouter } from "../../lib/flash-loan-router/src/interface/IFlashLoanRouter.sol";
    17	import { IGPv2Settlement } from "./interfaces/IGPv2Settlement.sol";
    18	import { IOrderHook } from "./interfaces/IOrderHook.sol";
    19	import { SafeTransferLib } from "../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solady/src/utils/SafeTransferLib.sol";
    20	
    21	/**
    22	 * @title CoW Swapper for Arcadia Accounts.
    23	 * @author Pragma Labs
    24	 */
    25	contract CowSwapper is IActionBase, EIP712, Guardian {
    26	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    27	    using SafeTransferLib for address;
    28	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    29	                                CONSTANTS
    30	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    31	
    32	    // The version of the CowSwapper.
    33	    string public constant VERSION = "1.1.1";
    34	
    35	    // The EIP-1271 magic value.
    36	    bytes4 internal constant MAGIC_VALUE = 0x1626ba7e;
    37	
    38	    // The EIP-712 typehash for SwapOrder.
    39	    bytes32 internal constant SWAP_ORDER_TYPEHASH =
    40	        keccak256("SwapOrder(address account,uint64 swapFee,bytes32 orderHash)");
    41	
    42	    // The contract address of the Arcadia Factory.
    43	    IArcadiaFactory public immutable ARCADIA_FACTORY;
    44	
    45	    // The contract address of the Cow Settlement.
    46	    IGPv2Settlement internal immutable COW_SETTLEMENT;
    47	
    48	    // The contract address of the Flashloan Router.
    49	    IFlashLoanRouter internal immutable FLASH_LOAN_ROUTER;
    50	
    51	    // The contract address of the Hooks Trampoline.
    52	    address public immutable HOOKS_TRAMPOLINE;
    53	
    54	    // The contract address of the vault relayer.
    55	    address public immutable VAULT_RELAYER;
    56	
    57	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    58	                                STORAGE
    59	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    60	
    61	    // Mapping from account to account specific information.
    62	    mapping(address account => AccountInfo) public accountInfo;
    63	
    64	    // Mapping from account to custom metadata.
    65	    mapping(address account => bytes data) public metaData;
    66	
    67	    // Mapping that sets the approved initiator per owner per account.
    68	    mapping(address owner => mapping(address account => address initiator)) public ownerToAccountToInitiator;
    69	
    70	    // A struct with the account specific parameters.
    71	    struct AccountInfo {
    72	        // The maximum fee charged on the amountOut by the initiator, with 18 decimals precision.
    73	        uint64 maxSwapFee;
    74	        // The contract address of the order hook.
    75	        address orderHook;
    76	    }
    77	
    78	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    79	                          TRANSIENT STORAGE
    80	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    81	
    82	    // The contract address of the Account.
    83	    address internal transient account;
    84	    // The address of the Account owner.
    85	    address internal transient accountOwner;
    86	    // The address of the initiator.
    87	    address internal transient initiator;
    88	
    89	    // The fee charged on the amountOut by the initiator, with 18 decimals precision.
    90	    uint64 internal transient swapFee;
    91	
    92	    // The contract address of the token to swap from (sellToken).
    93	    address internal transient tokenIn;
    94	    // The contract address of the token to swap to (buyToken).
    95	    address internal transient tokenOut;
    96	
    97	    // The amount of tokenIn to swap (sellAmount).
    98	    uint256 internal transient amountIn;
    99	
   100	    // The balance of tokenIn held just before the settlement, used to detect if the swap already happened.
   101	    uint256 internal transient balanceBefore;
   102	
   103	    // The order hash.
   104	    bytes32 internal transient orderHash;
   105	    // The message hash.
   106	    bytes32 internal transient messageHash;
   107	
   108	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   109	                                ERRORS
   110	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   111	
   112	    error InvalidAccountVersion();
   113	    error InvalidInitiator();
   114	    error InvalidOrder();
   115	    error InvalidOrderHash();
   116	    error InvalidSigner();
   117	    error InvalidValue();
   118	    error NotAnAccount();
   119	    error MissingSignatureVerification();
   120	    error OnlyAccount();
   121	    error OnlyAccountOwner();
   122	    error OnlyHooksTrampoline();
   123	    error OnlyFlashLoanRouter();
   124	    error Reentered();
   125	    error SwapAlreadyExecuted();
   126	
   127	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   128	                                EVENTS
   129	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   130	
   131	    event AccountInfoSet(address indexed account, address indexed initiator);
   132	    event FeePaid(address indexed account, address indexed receiver, address indexed asset, uint256 amount);
   133	
   134	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   135	                            CONSTRUCTOR
   136	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   137	
   138	    /**
   139	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
   140	     * @param arcadiaFactory The contract address of the Arcadia Factory.
   141	     * @param flashLoanRouter The contract address of the flash-loan router.
   142	     * @param hooksTrampoline The contract address of the hooks trampoline.
   143	     */
   144	    constructor(address owner_, address arcadiaFactory, address flashLoanRouter, address hooksTrampoline)
   145	        Guardian(owner_)
   146	    {
   147	        ARCADIA_FACTORY = IArcadiaFactory(arcadiaFactory);
   148	        FLASH_LOAN_ROUTER = IFlashLoanRouter(flashLoanRouter);
   149	        COW_SETTLEMENT = IGPv2Settlement(address(FLASH_LOAN_ROUTER.settlementContract()));
   150	        HOOKS_TRAMPOLINE = hooksTrampoline;
   151	        VAULT_RELAYER = COW_SETTLEMENT.vaultRelayer();
   152	    }
   153	
   154	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   155	                          TOKEN APPROVALS
   156	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   157	
   158	    /**
   159	     * @notice Approves the vaultRelayer to spend the specified token.
   160	     * @param token The contract address of the token to approve..
   161	     */
   162	    function approveToken(address token) external {
   163	        if (account != address(0)) revert Reentered();
   164	
   165	        _approveToken(token);
   166	    }
   167	
   168	    /**
   169	     * @notice Approves the vaultRelayer to spend the specified tokens.
   170	     * @param tokens The contract addresses of the tokens to approve.
   171	     */
   172	    function approveTokens(address[] calldata tokens) external {
   173	        if (account != address(0)) revert Reentered();
   174	
   175	        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
   176	            _approveToken(tokens[i]);
   177	        }
   178	    }
   179	
   180	    /**
   181	     * @notice Approves the vaultRelayer to spend the specified token.
   182	     * @param token The contract address of the token to approve..
   183	     */
   184	    function _approveToken(address token) internal {
   185	        token.safeApproveWithRetry(VAULT_RELAYER, type(uint256).max);
   186	    }
   187	
   188	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   189	                            ACCOUNT LOGIC
   190	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   191	
   192	    /**
   193	     * @notice Optional hook called by the Arcadia Account when calling "setAssetManager()".
   194	     * @param accountOwner_ The current owner of the Arcadia Account.
   195	     * param status Bool indicating if the Asset Manager is enabled or disabled.
   196	     * @param data Operator specific data, passed by the Account owner.
   197	     * @dev No need to check that the Account version is 3 or greater (versions with cross account reentrancy guard),
   198	     * since version 1 and 2 don't support the onSetAssetManager hook.
   199	     */
   200	    function onSetAssetManager(address accountOwner_, bool, bytes calldata data) external {
   201	        if (account != address(0)) revert Reentered();
   202	        if (!ARCADIA_FACTORY.isAccount(msg.sender)) revert NotAnAccount();
   203	
   204	        (address initiator_, uint256 maxSwapFee, address orderHook, bytes memory hookData, bytes memory metaData_) =
   205	            abi.decode(data, (address, uint256, address, bytes, bytes));
   206	        _setAccountInfo(msg.sender, accountOwner_, initiator_, maxSwapFee, orderHook, hookData, metaData_);
   207	    }
   208	
   209	    /**
   210	     * @notice Sets the required information for an Account.
   211	     * @param account_ The contract address of the Arcadia Account to set the information for.
   212	     * @param initiator_ The address of the initiator.
   213	     * @param maxSwapFee The maximum fee charged on the claimed fees of the liquidity position, with 18 decimals precision.
   214	     * @param orderHook The contract address of the order hook.
   215	     * @param hookData Encoded data containing hook specific parameters.
   216	     * @param metaData_ Custom metadata to be stored with the account.
   217	     */
   218	    function setAccountInfo(
   219	        address account_,
   220	        address initiator_,
   221	        uint256 maxSwapFee,
   222	        address orderHook,
   223	        bytes calldata hookData,
   224	        bytes calldata metaData_
   225	    ) external {
   226	        if (account != address(0)) revert Reentered();
   227	        if (!ARCADIA_FACTORY.isAccount(account_)) revert NotAnAccount();
   228	        address accountOwner_ = IAccount(account_).owner();
   229	        if (msg.sender != accountOwner_) revert OnlyAccountOwner();
   230	        // Block Account versions without cross account reentrancy guard.
   231	        if (IAccount(account_).ACCOUNT_VERSION() < 3) revert InvalidAccountVersion();
   232	
   233	        _setAccountInfo(account_, accountOwner_, initiator_, maxSwapFee, orderHook, hookData, metaData_);
   234	    }
   235	
   236	    /**
   237	     * @notice Sets the required information for an Account.
   238	     * @param account_ The contract address of the Arcadia Account to set the information for.
   239	     * @param accountOwner_ The current owner of the Arcadia Account.
   240	     * @param initiator_ The address of the initiator.
   241	     * @param maxSwapFee The maximum fee charged on the claimed fees of the liquidity position, with 18 decimals precision.
   242	     * @param orderHook The contract address of the order hook.
   243	     * @param hookData Encoded data containing hook specific parameters.
   244	     * @param metaData_ Custom metadata to be stored with the account.
   245	     * @dev The initiator for a specific owner for a specific account must be set to a non zero address to use the CoW Swapper.
   246	     * Also if the Account owner is the only allowed signer.
   247	     */
   248	    function _setAccountInfo(
   249	        address account_,
   250	        address accountOwner_,
   251	        address initiator_,
   252	        uint256 maxSwapFee,
   253	        address orderHook,
   254	        bytes memory hookData,
   255	        bytes memory metaData_
   256	    ) internal {
   257	        if (maxSwapFee > 1e18) revert InvalidValue();
   258	
   259	        ownerToAccountToInitiator[accountOwner_][account_] = initiator_;
   260	        // unsafe cast: maxClaimFee <= 1e18 < type(uint64).max.
   261	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   262	        accountInfo[account_] = AccountInfo({ maxSwapFee: uint64(maxSwapFee), orderHook: orderHook });
   263	        metaData[account_] = metaData_;
   264	
   265	        IOrderHook(orderHook).setHook(account_, hookData);
   266	
   267	        emit AccountInfoSet(account_, initiator_);
   268	    }
   269	
   270	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   271	                      COW SWAP BORROWER LOGIC
   272	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   273	
   274	    /**
   275	     * @notice Executes a CoW Swap for an Arcadia Account.
   276	     * @param account_ The contract address of the account.
   277	     * @param tokenIn_ The contract address of the token to swap from.
   278	     * @param amountIn_ The amount of tokenIn to swap.
   279	     * @param callBackData The calldata to be passed back to the flash-loan router.
   280	     * @dev Only one account at a time can be included per "flashLoanAndSettle()"
   281	     * @dev The check that the solver passed the correct input parameters is done via the signature validation in "beforeSwap()".
   282	     * Both the order parameters (tokenIn_ and amountIn_) as the account_ are included in the messageHash.
   283	     * If a malicious solver modifies the input parameters, the initiator signature will no longer be valid.
   284	     */
   285	    function flashLoanAndCallBack(address account_, address tokenIn_, uint256 amountIn_, bytes calldata callBackData)
   286	        external
   287	        whenNotPaused
   288	    {
   289	        // Caller must be the Flashloan Router.
   290	        if (msg.sender != address(FLASH_LOAN_ROUTER)) revert OnlyFlashLoanRouter();
   291	
   292	        // Store Account address, used to validate the caller of the executeAction() callback and serves as a reentrancy guard.
   293	        if (account != address(0)) revert Reentered();
   294	        account = account_;
   295	
   296	        if (amountIn_ == 0) revert InvalidValue();
   297	
   298	        // If the Initiator is non zero, we know account_ is an actual Arcadia Account,
   299	        // and the initiator is set by its current owner.
   300	        address accountOwner_ = IAccount(account_).owner();
   301	        address initiator_ = ownerToAccountToInitiator[accountOwner_][account_];
   302	        if (initiator_ == address(0)) revert InvalidInitiator();
   303	
   304	        // Store transient storage.
   305	        accountOwner = accountOwner_;
   306	        initiator = initiator_;
   307	        tokenIn = tokenIn_;
   308	        amountIn = amountIn_;
   309	
   310	        // Encode data for the flash-action.
   311	        bytes memory actionData = ArcadiaLogic._encodeAction(tokenIn_, amountIn_, callBackData);
   312	
   313	        // Call flashAction() with this contract as actionTarget.
   314	        IAccount(account_).flashAction(address(this), actionData);
   315	
   316	        // Reset account.
   317	        account = address(0);
   318	    }
   319	
   320	    /**
   321	     * @notice Dummy approve function required by the settlement contract. Does nothing.
   322	     * @param token The address of the token to approve (unused).
   323	     * @param target The address to approve as spender (unused).
   324	     * @param amount The amount to approve (unused).
   325	     */
   326	    function approve(address token, address target, uint256 amount) external { }
   327	
   328	    /**
   329	     * @notice Returns the address of the CoW Settlement contract.
   330	     * @return cowSettlement The address of the settlement contract.
   331	     */
   332	    function settlementContract() external view returns (address cowSettlement) {
   333	        cowSettlement = address(COW_SETTLEMENT);
   334	    }
   335	
   336	    /**
   337	     * @notice Returns the address of the flash loan router.
   338	     * @return flashLoanRouter The address of the flash loan router contract.
   339	     */
   340	    function router() external view returns (address flashLoanRouter) {
   341	        flashLoanRouter = address(FLASH_LOAN_ROUTER);
   342	    }
   343	
   344	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   345	                            SWAPPING LOGIC
   346	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   347	
   348	    /**
   349	     * @notice Callback function called by the Arcadia Account during the flashAction.
   350	     * @param callBackData A bytes object containing callBack data.
   351	     * @return depositData A struct with the data to deposit the bought tokens in the account.
   352	     */
   353	    function executeAction(bytes calldata callBackData) external override returns (ActionData memory depositData) {
   354	        // Caller must be the Account, provided as input in triggerFlashLoan().
   355	        if (msg.sender != account) revert OnlyAccount();
   356	
   357	        // Cache the balance of tokenIn before the swap.
   358	        address tokenIn_ = tokenIn;
   359	        uint256 balanceBefore_ = IERC20(tokenIn_).balanceOf(address(this));
   360	        balanceBefore = balanceBefore_;
   361	
   362	        // Callback to flash loan router, this will settle the swap.
   363	        FLASH_LOAN_ROUTER.borrowerCallBack(callBackData);
   364	
   365	        // Verify that "isValidSignature()" was called.
   366	        // A malicious solver could modify the EIP-1271 signature, skipping the check that the orderHash is correct.
   367	        // If isValidSignature() would be skipped, tokenIn would not be transferred from this contract to the vault relayer.
   368	        if (IERC20(tokenIn_).balanceOf(address(this)) != balanceBefore_ - amountIn) {
   369	            revert MissingSignatureVerification();
   370	        }
   371	
   372	        // Calculate token amounts to be send to Account and initiator.
   373	        // No need to check that amount >= order.buyAmount, since this is enforced by CoW Swap.
   374	        address tokenOut_ = tokenOut;
   375	        uint256 amount = IERC20(tokenOut_).balanceOf(address(this));
   376	        uint256 fee = amount.mulDivDown(swapFee, 1e18);
   377	        amount = amount - fee;
   378	
   379	        // Send the fee to the initiator.
   380	        if (fee > 0) {
   381	            address initiator_ = initiator;
   382	            tokenOut_.safeTransfer(initiator_, fee);
   383	            emit FeePaid(msg.sender, initiator_, tokenOut_, fee);
   384	        }
   385	
   386	        // Approve tokenOut to be deposited into the account.
   387	        tokenOut_.safeApproveWithRetry(msg.sender, amount);
   388	
   389	        // Encode deposit data for the flash-action.
   390	        depositData = ArcadiaLogic._encodeDeposit(tokenOut_, amount);
   391	    }
   392	
   393	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   394	                            PRE SWAP HOOK
   395	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   396	
   397	    /**
   398	     * @notice Hook called before the swap to store the remaining initiator parameters,
   399	     * (since they could not be passed during triggerFlashLoan).
   400	     * @param initiatorData The encoded remaining initiator parameters.
   401	     * @dev There is no guarantee the solver includes the "beforeSwap()" hook in the settlement.
   402	     * If "beforeSwap()" would not be called during the settlement,
   403	     * then "isValidSignature()" or "executeAction()" (if "isValidSignature()" is also skipped) will revert,
   404	     * since the order hash and tokenOut will not be set.
   405	     * @dev GPv2Settlement ensures that signatures for the same orderHash (and hence messageHash) cannot be replayed.
   406	     * No need to again check for replay attacks here.
   407	     * @dev The swapFee, if non-zero is always paid to the initiator, also if the Account owner is the signer.
   408	     * While suboptimal, "isValidSignature()" is a view only function so we can't check who is the actual signer.
   409	     * The Account owner can always sign with the fee set to 0.
   410	     */
   411	    function beforeSwap(bytes calldata initiatorData) external {
   412	        // Caller must be the Hooks Trampoline.
   413	        if (msg.sender != HOOKS_TRAMPOLINE) revert OnlyHooksTrampoline();
   414	
   415	        // The swap parameters may only be set before the swap, so the sell token must still be fully present.
   416	        // Once it has been pulled the parameters are final and may not be changed. A re-supplied tokenIn balance
   417	        // is detected by the "balanceBefore_ - amountIn" check in executeAction().
   418	        if (IERC20(tokenIn).balanceOf(address(this)) != balanceBefore) revert SwapAlreadyExecuted();
   419	
   420	        // Cache variables.
   421	        address account_ = account;
   422	
   423	        uint64 swapFee_;
   424	        bytes32 orderHash_;
   425	        (swapFee_, tokenOut, orderHash_) =
   426	            IOrderHook(accountInfo[account_].orderHook).getInitiatorParams(account_, tokenIn, amountIn, initiatorData);
   427	
   428	        // Validate swapFee.
   429	        if (swapFee_ > accountInfo[account_].maxSwapFee) revert InvalidValue();
   430	
   431	        // Store transient state.
   432	        swapFee = swapFee_;
   433	        orderHash = orderHash_;
   434	        messageHash = getMessageHash(account_, swapFee_, orderHash_);
   435	    }
   436	
   437	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   438	                          EIP-1271 LOGIC
   439	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   440	
   441	    /**
   442	     * @notice Returns the EIP-712 domain name and version.
   443	     * @return name The domain name of the contract.
   444	     * @return version The domain version of the contract.
   445	     */
   446	    function _domainNameAndVersion() internal pure override returns (string memory name, string memory version) {
   447	        name = "CowSwapper";
   448	        version = VERSION;
   449	    }
   450	
   451	    /**
   452	     * @notice Returns the EIP-712 message hash for a swap order.
   453	     * @param account_ The contract address of the Arcadia Account.
   454	     * @param swapFee_ The fee charged on the amountOut by the initiator, with 18 decimals precision.
   455	     * @param orderHash_ The CoW Swap order hash.
   456	     * @return messageHash_ The EIP-712 message hash to be signed by the initiator or account owner.
   457	     */
   458	    function getMessageHash(address account_, uint64 swapFee_, bytes32 orderHash_)
   459	        public
   460	        view
   461	        returns (bytes32 messageHash_)
   462	    {
   463	        messageHash_ = _hashTypedData(keccak256(abi.encode(SWAP_ORDER_TYPEHASH, account_, swapFee_, orderHash_)));
   464	    }
   465	
   466	    /**
   467	     * @notice Returns the EIP-712 message hash for a swap order, computing the order hash from raw inputs.
   468	     * @param account_ The contract address of the Arcadia Account.
   469	     * @param tokenIn_ The contract address of the token to swap from.
   470	     * @param amountIn_ The amount of tokenIn to swap.
   471	     * @param initiatorData The encoded initiator parameters.
   472	     * @return messageHash_ The EIP-712 message hash to be signed by the initiator or account owner.
   473	     */
   474	    function getMessageHash(address account_, address tokenIn_, uint256 amountIn_, bytes calldata initiatorData)
   475	        external
   476	        view
   477	        returns (bytes32 messageHash_)
   478	    {
   479	        (uint64 swapFee_,, bytes32 orderHash_) =
   480	            IOrderHook(accountInfo[account_].orderHook).getInitiatorParams(account_, tokenIn_, amountIn_, initiatorData);
   481	        messageHash_ = getMessageHash(account_, swapFee_, orderHash_);
   482	    }
   483	
   484	    /**
   485	     * @notice Verifies EIP-1271 signature.
   486	     * @param orderHash_ Hash of the CoW Swap order.
   487	     * @param signature Initiator signature encoded as (bytes32 r, bytes32 s, uint8 v).
   488	     * @return magicValue The EIP-1271 magic value.
   489	     * @dev There is no guarantee the solver includes a call to "isValidSignature()".
   490	     * A malicious solver could modify the signature, skipping the check that the orderHash is correct.
   491	     * If "isValidSignature()" would be skipped, the transaction will revert during "executeAction()".
   492	     * @dev GPv2Settlement ensures that signatures for the same orderHash (and hence messageHash) cannot be replayed.
   493	     * No need to again check for replay attacks here.
   494	     */
   495	    function isValidSignature(bytes32 orderHash_, bytes calldata signature) external view returns (bytes4) {
   496	        // If we are not in a flash loan, return magic value for the verification of off-chain solvers.
   497	        if (account == address(0)) return MAGIC_VALUE;
   498	
   499	        // Validate order hash.
   500	        if (orderHash != orderHash_) revert InvalidOrderHash();
   501	
   502	        // Validate Signature.
   503	        // ECDSA.recoverSigner() will never return the zero address as signer (reverts instead).
   504	        // Hence if the equality holds, the "initiator" was non-zero, and "account" and "initiator" were verified during "triggerFlashLoan()".
   505	        address signer = ECDSA.recoverCalldata(messageHash, signature);
   506	        if (signer != initiator && signer != accountOwner) revert InvalidSigner();
   507	
   508	        // If order hash is valid, return EIP-1271 magic value.
   509	        return MAGIC_VALUE;
   510	    }
   511	}
```

### asset-managers/src/cow-swapper/libraries/ArcadiaLogic.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.26;
     6	
     7	import { ActionData } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/src/interfaces/IActionBase.sol";
     8	import { IPermit2 } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/src/interfaces/IPermit2.sol";
     9	
    10	library ArcadiaLogic {
    11	    /**
    12	     * @notice Encodes the action data for the flash-action.
    13	     * @param token The contract address of the token.
    14	     * @param amount The amount of token to transfer.
    15	     * @param actionTargetData The data to be passed to the action target.
    16	     * @return actionData Bytes string with the encoded data.
    17	     */
    18	    function _encodeAction(address token, uint256 amount, bytes memory actionTargetData)
    19	        internal
    20	        pure
    21	        returns (bytes memory actionData)
    22	    {
    23	        address[] memory assets = new address[](1);
    24	        uint256[] memory ids = new uint256[](1);
    25	        uint256[] memory amounts = new uint256[](1);
    26	        uint256[] memory types = new uint256[](1);
    27	
    28	        // Encode asset.
    29	        assets[0] = token;
    30	        amounts[0] = amount;
    31	        types[0] = 1;
    32	
    33	        ActionData memory withdrawData =
    34	            ActionData({ assets: assets, assetIds: ids, assetAmounts: amounts, assetTypes: types });
    35	
    36	        // Empty data objects that have to be encoded when calling flashAction(), but that are not used for this specific flash-action.
    37	        bytes memory signature;
    38	        ActionData memory transferFromOwner;
    39	        IPermit2.PermitBatchTransferFrom memory permit;
    40	
    41	        // Encode the actionData.
    42	        actionData = abi.encode(withdrawData, transferFromOwner, permit, signature, actionTargetData);
    43	    }
    44	
    45	    /**
    46	     * @notice Encodes the deposit data after the flash-action is executed.
    47	     * @param token The contract address of the token.
    48	     * @param amount The amount of token to transfer.
    49	     * @return depositData Bytes string with the encoded data.
    50	     */
    51	    function _encodeDeposit(address token, uint256 amount) internal pure returns (ActionData memory depositData) {
    52	        address[] memory assets = new address[](1);
    53	        uint256[] memory ids = new uint256[](1);
    54	        uint256[] memory amounts = new uint256[](1);
    55	        uint256[] memory types = new uint256[](1);
    56	
    57	        // Encode asset.
    58	        assets[0] = token;
    59	        amounts[0] = amount;
    60	        types[0] = 1;
    61	
    62	        depositData = ActionData({ assets: assets, assetIds: ids, assetAmounts: amounts, assetTypes: types });
    63	    }
    64	}
```

### asset-managers/src/cow-swapper/periphery/DefaultOrderHook.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { GPv2Order, IERC20 } from "../../../lib/cowprotocol/src/contracts/libraries/GPv2Order.sol";
     8	import { ICowSwapper } from "../interfaces/ICowSwapper.sol";
     9	import { IGPv2Settlement } from "../interfaces/IGPv2Settlement.sol";
    10	import { OrderHook } from "./OrderHook.sol";
    11	import { LibString } from "../../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solady/src/utils/LibString.sol";
    12	
    13	/**
    14	 * @title Order Hook.
    15	 * @author Pragma Labs
    16	 */
    17	contract DefaultOrderHook is OrderHook {
    18	    using GPv2Order for GPv2Order.Data;
    19	    using LibString for string;
    20	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    21	                                CONSTANTS
    22	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    23	
    24	    // The domain separator used for signing orders.
    25	    bytes32 public immutable DOMAIN_SEPARATOR;
    26	
    27	    // The contract address of the CoW Swapper.
    28	    address public immutable COW_SWAPPER;
    29	    /// forge-lint: disable-next-line(mixed-case-variable)
    30	    string internal COW_SWAPPER_HEX_STRING;
    31	
    32	    // Offsets to decode the initiatorData.
    33	    uint256 internal constant OFFSET_96_BITS = 96;
    34	    uint256 internal constant OFFSET_2_BYTES = 2;
    35	    uint256 internal constant OFFSET_6_BYTES = 6;
    36	    uint256 internal constant OFFSET_14_BYTES = 14;
    37	
    38	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    39	                               STORAGE
    40	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    41	
    42	    // A mapping from an Arcadia Account to a struct with Account-specific information.
    43	    mapping(address cowSwapper => mapping(address account => AccountInfo)) public accountInfo;
    44	
    45	    // A struct containing Account-specific information.
    46	    struct AccountInfo {
    47	        // A bytes array containing custom information.
    48	        bytes customInfo;
    49	    }
    50	
    51	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    52	                            CONSTRUCTOR
    53	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    54	
    55	    /**
    56	     * @param cowSwapper The contract address of the CoW Swapper.
    57	     */
    58	    constructor(address cowSwapper) {
    59	        COW_SWAPPER = cowSwapper;
    60	        COW_SWAPPER_HEX_STRING = LibString.toHexString(cowSwapper);
    61	
    62	        DOMAIN_SEPARATOR = IGPv2Settlement(ICowSwapper(cowSwapper).settlementContract()).domainSeparator();
    63	    }
    64	
    65	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    66	                            ACCOUNT LOGIC
    67	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    68	
    69	    /**
    70	     * @notice Function called by the CoW Swapper to set the Account specific information.
    71	     * @param account The contract address of the Arcadia Account to set the order info for.
    72	     * @param hookData Encoded data containing hook specific parameters.
    73	     */
    74	    function setHook(address account, bytes calldata hookData) external override {
    75	        (bytes memory customInfo) = abi.decode(hookData, (bytes));
    76	
    77	        accountInfo[msg.sender][account] = AccountInfo({ customInfo: customInfo });
    78	    }
    79	
    80	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    81	                            PRE SWAP HOOK
    82	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    83	
    84	    /**
    85	     * @notice Hook called to validate and calculate the initiator parameters.
    86	     * @param account The contract address of the Arcadia Account.
    87	     * @param tokenIn The contract address of the token to swap from.
    88	     * @param amountIn The amount of tokenIn to swap.
    89	     * @param initiatorData The packed encoded remaining initiator parameters.
    90	     * encodePacked(address tokenOut, uint112 amountOut, uint32 validTo, uint64 swapFee)
    91	     * @return swapFee The fee charged on the amountOut by the initiator, with 18 decimals precision.
    92	     * @return tokenOut The contract address of the token to swap to.
    93	     * @return orderHash The order hash.
    94	     */
    95	    function getInitiatorParams(address account, address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn, bytes calldata initiatorData)
    96	        external
    97	        view
    98	        override
    99	        returns (uint64 swapFee, address tokenOut, bytes32 orderHash)
   100	    {
   101	        uint256 amountOut;
   102	        uint32 validTo;
   103	        (tokenOut, amountOut, validTo, swapFee) = _decodeInitiatorData(initiatorData);
   104	
   105	        GPv2Order.Data memory order = GPv2Order.Data({
   106	            sellToken: IERC20(tokenIn),
   107	            buyToken: IERC20(tokenOut),
   108	            receiver: COW_SWAPPER,
   109	            sellAmount: amountIn,
   110	            buyAmount: amountOut,
   111	            validTo: validTo,
   112	            appData: getAppDataHash(
   113	                account, tokenIn, amountIn, abi.encodeCall(ICowSwapper.beforeSwap, (initiatorData))
   114	            ),
   115	            feeAmount: 0,
   116	            kind: GPv2Order.KIND_SELL,
   117	            partiallyFillable: false,
   118	            sellTokenBalance: GPv2Order.BALANCE_ERC20,
   119	            buyTokenBalance: GPv2Order.BALANCE_ERC20
   120	        });
   121	
   122	        orderHash = order.hash(DOMAIN_SEPARATOR);
   123	    }
   124	
   125	    /**
   126	     * @notice Decodes the initiatorData.
   127	     * @param initiatorData The packed encoded remaining initiator parameters.
   128	     * encodePacked(address tokenOut, uint112 amountOut, uint32 validTo, uint64 swapFee)
   129	     * @return tokenOut The contract address of the token to swap to.
   130	     * @return amountOut The amount of tokenOut to swap to.
   131	     * @return validTo The time at which the order will stop being valid.
   132	     * @return swapFee The fee charged on the amountOut by the initiator, with 18 decimals precision.
   133	     * @dev since the beforeSwap calldata has to be converted to hexString, the initiatorData is packed as tightly as possible.
   134	     */
   135	    function _decodeInitiatorData(bytes calldata initiatorData)
   136	        internal
   137	        pure
   138	        returns (address tokenOut, uint112 amountOut, uint32 validTo, uint64 swapFee)
   139	    {
   140	        assembly {
   141	            // Load first 256 bits of initiatorData and shift right by 96 bits to extract tokenOut.
   142	            tokenOut := shr(OFFSET_96_BITS, calldataload(initiatorData.offset))
   143	            // Load bits 16 to 272 (offset of 2 bytes) of initiatorData, dirty upper bits are zeroed out by casting to uint112.
   144	            amountOut := calldataload(add(initiatorData.offset, OFFSET_2_BYTES))
   145	            // Load bits 48 to 304 (offset of 6 bytes) of initiatorData, dirty upper bits are zeroed out by casting to uint32.
   146	            validTo := calldataload(add(initiatorData.offset, OFFSET_6_BYTES))
   147	            // Load bits 112 to 368 (offset of 14 bytes) of initiatorData, dirty upper bits are zeroed out by casting to uint64.
   148	            swapFee := calldataload(add(initiatorData.offset, OFFSET_14_BYTES))
   149	        }
   150	    }
   151	
   152	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   153	                            APP DATA LOGIC
   154	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   155	
   156	    /**
   157	     * @notice Returns the AppData Hash of the swap.
   158	     * @param account The contract address of the Arcadia Account.
   159	     * @param tokenIn The contract address of the token to swap from.
   160	     * @param amountIn The amount of tokenIn to swap.
   161	     * @param beforeSwapCallData The calldata of the beforeSwap() hook.
   162	     * @return appDataHash The AppData Hash.
   163	     * @dev The AppData JSON string must match the metadata passed when submitting the swap.
   164	     */
   165	    function getAppDataHash(address account, address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn, bytes memory beforeSwapCallData)
   166	        public
   167	        view
   168	        returns (bytes32 appDataHash)
   169	    {
   170	        appDataHash = keccak256(bytes(getAppData(account, tokenIn, amountIn, beforeSwapCallData)));
   171	    }
   172	
   173	    /**
   174	     * @notice Returns the AppData of the swap.
   175	     * @param account The contract address of the Arcadia Account.
   176	     * @param tokenIn The contract address of the token to swap from.
   177	     * @param amountIn The amount of tokenIn to swap.
   178	     * @param beforeSwapCallData The calldata of the beforeSwap() hook.
   179	     * @return appData The AppData JSON string.
   180	     * @dev The AppData JSON string must match the metadata passed when submitting the swap.
   181	     */
   182	    function getAppData(address account, address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn, bytes memory beforeSwapCallData)
   183	        public
   184	        view
   185	        returns (string memory appData)
   186	    {
   187	        appData = string.concat(
   188	            '{"appCode":"Arcadia 0.1.0","metadata":{"flashloan":{"amount":"',
   189	            LibString.toString(amountIn),
   190	            '","liquidityProvider":"',
   191	            LibString.toHexString(account),
   192	            '","protocolAdapter":"',
   193	            COW_SWAPPER_HEX_STRING,
   194	            '","receiver":"',
   195	            COW_SWAPPER_HEX_STRING,
   196	            '","token":"',
   197	            LibString.toHexString(tokenIn),
   198	            '"},"hooks":{"pre":[{"callData":"',
   199	            LibString.toHexString(beforeSwapCallData),
   200	            '","gasLimit":"80000","target":"',
   201	            COW_SWAPPER_HEX_STRING,
   202	            '"}],"version":"0.2.0"}},"version":"1.11.0"}'
   203	        );
   204	    }
   205	}
```

```solidity
     1	/**

     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
```

```solidity
     7	import { Owned } from "../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/auth/Owned.sol";
     8	
     9	/**
    10	 * @title Guardian
    11	 * @author Pragma Labs
    12	 * @notice Pause guardian for an Asset Manager.
    13	 */
    14	abstract contract Guardian is Owned {
    15	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    16	                                STORAGE
    17	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    18	
    19	    // Flag indicating if the Asset Manager is paused.
    20	    bool public paused;
    21	
    22	    // Address of the Guardian.
    23	    address public guardian;
    24	
    25	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    26	                                ERRORS
    27	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    28	
    29	    error Paused();
    30	    error OnlyGuardian();
    31	
    32	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    33	                                MODIFIERS
    34	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    35	
    36	    /**
    37	     * @dev Only guardians can call functions with this modifier.
    38	     */
    39	    modifier onlyGuardian() {
    40	        _onlyGuardian();
    41	        _;
    42	    }
    43	
    44	    function _onlyGuardian() internal view {
    45	        if (msg.sender != guardian) revert OnlyGuardian();
    46	    }
    47	
    48	    /**
    49	     * @dev Throws if the Asset Manager is paused.
    50	     */
    51	    modifier whenNotPaused() {
    52	        _whenNotPaused();
    53	        _;
    54	    }
    55	
    56	    function _whenNotPaused() internal view {
    57	        if (paused) revert Paused();
    58	    }
    59	
    60	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    61	                                CONSTRUCTOR
    62	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    63	
    64	    /**
    65	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    66	     */
    67	    constructor(address owner_) Owned(owner_) { }
    68	
    69	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    70	                            GUARDIAN LOGIC
    71	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    72	
    73	    /**
    74	     * @notice Sets a new guardian.
    75	     * @param guardian_ The address of the new guardian.
    76	     */
    77	    function changeGuardian(address guardian_) external onlyOwner {
    78	        guardian = guardian_;
    79	    }
    80	
    81	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    82	                            PAUSING LOGIC
    83	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    84	
    85	    /**
    86	     * @notice Pauses the Asset Manager.
    87	     */
```

### asset-managers/src/libraries/SafeApprove.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * https://github.com/Vectorized/solady/blob/main/src/utils/SafeTransferLib.sol
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { ERC20 } from "../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/tokens/ERC20.sol";
     8	
     9	library SafeApprove {
    10	    /**
    11	     * @notice Approves an amount of token for a spender.
    12	     * @param token The contract address of the token being approved.
    13	     * @param to The spender.
    14	     * @param amount the amount of token being approved.
    15	     * @dev Copied from Solady safeApproveWithRetry (MIT): https://github.com/Vectorized/solady/blob/main/src/utils/SafeTransferLib.sol
    16	     * @dev Sets `amount` of ERC20 `token` for `to` to manage on behalf of the current contract.
    17	     * If the initial attempt to approve fails, attempts to reset the approved amount to zero,
    18	     * then retries the approval again (some tokens, e.g. USDT, requires this).
    19	     * Reverts upon failure.
    20	     */
    21	    function safeApproveWithRetry(ERC20 token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
    22	        assembly ("memory-safe") {
    23	            mstore(0x14, to) // Store the `to` argument.
    24	            mstore(0x34, amount) // Store the `amount` argument.
    25	            mstore(0x00, 0x095ea7b3000000000000000000000000) // `approve(address,uint256)`.
    26	            // Perform the approval, retrying upon failure.
    27	            if iszero(
    28	                and( // The arguments of `and` are evaluated from right to left.
    29	                    or(eq(mload(0x00), 1), iszero(returndatasize())), // Returned 1 or nothing.
    30	                    call(gas(), token, 0, 0x10, 0x44, 0x00, 0x20)
    31	                )
    32	            ) {
    33	                mstore(0x34, 0) // Store 0 for the `amount`.
    34	                mstore(0x00, 0x095ea7b3000000000000000000000000) // `approve(address,uint256)`.
    35	                pop(call(gas(), token, 0, 0x10, 0x44, codesize(), 0x00)) // Reset the approval.
    36	                mstore(0x34, amount) // Store back the original `amount`.
    37	                // Retry the approval, reverting upon failure.
    38	                if iszero(
    39	                    and(
    40	                        or(eq(mload(0x00), 1), iszero(returndatasize())), // Returned 1 or nothing.
    41	                        call(gas(), token, 0, 0x10, 0x44, 0x00, 0x20)
    42	                    )
    43	                ) {
    44	                    mstore(0x00, 0x3e3f8f73) // `ApproveFailed()`.
    45	                    revert(0x1c, 0x04)
    46	                }
    47	            }
    48	            mstore(0x34, 0) // Restore the part of the free memory pointer that was overwritten.
    49	        }
    50	    }
    51	}
```
