### asset-managers/src/merkl-operator/MerklOperator.sol
```solidity
     1	/**
     2	 * Created by Pragma Labs
     3	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
     4	 */
     5	pragma solidity ^0.8.34;
     6	
     7	import { ERC20, SafeTransferLib } from "../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/SafeTransferLib.sol";
     8	import { FixedPointMathLib } from "../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/FixedPointMathLib.sol";
     9	import { Guardian } from "../guardian/Guardian.sol";
    10	import { IAccount } from "../interfaces/IAccount.sol";
    11	import { IArcadiaFactory } from "../interfaces/IArcadiaFactory.sol";
    12	import { IDistributor } from "./interfaces/IDistributor.sol";
    13	import { ReentrancyGuard } from "../../lib/accounts-v2/lib/solmate/src/utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol";
    14	
    15	/**
    16	 * @title Automatic claimer of Merkl rewards.
    17	 * @author Pragma Labs
    18	 */
    19	contract MerklOperator is Guardian, ReentrancyGuard {
    20	    using FixedPointMathLib for uint256;
    21	    using SafeTransferLib for ERC20;
    22	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    23	                                CONSTANTS
    24	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    25	
    26	    // The version of the Asset Manager.
    27	    string public constant VERSION = "1.0.0";
    28	
    29	    // The contract address of the Arcadia Factory.
    30	    IArcadiaFactory public immutable ARCADIA_FACTORY;
    31	
    32	    // The contract address of the Merkl Distributor.
    33	    IDistributor public immutable MERKL_DISTRIBUTOR;
    34	
    35	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    36	                                STORAGE
    37	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    38	
    39	    // A mapping from account to account specific information.
    40	    mapping(address account => AccountInfo) public accountInfo;
    41	
    42	    // A mapping from account to custom metadata.
    43	    mapping(address account => bytes data) public metaData;
    44	
    45	    // A mapping that sets the approved initiator per owner per account.
    46	    mapping(address accountOwner => mapping(address account => address initiator)) public accountToInitiator;
    47	
    48	    // A struct with the account specific parameters.
    49	    struct AccountInfo {
    50	        // The address of the recipient of the claimed rewards.
    51	        address rewardRecipient;
    52	        // The maximum fee charged on the claimed Merkl rewards, with 18 decimals precision.
    53	        uint64 maxClaimFee;
    54	    }
    55	
    56	    // A struct with the initiator parameters.
    57	    struct InitiatorParams {
    58	        // The fee charged on the claimed Merkl rewards, with 18 decimals precision.
    59	        uint256 claimFee;
    60	        // Array of tokens the Merkl rewards are claimed for.
    61	        address[] tokens;
    62	        // Array with corresponding cumulative reward amounts.
    63	        uint256[] amounts;
    64	        // Array with corresponding arrays of Merkl proofs.
    65	        bytes32[][] proofs;
    66	    }
    67	
    68	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    69	                                ERRORS
    70	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    71	
    72	    error InvalidAccountVersion();
    73	    error InvalidClaimRecipient();
    74	    error InvalidInitiator();
    75	    error InvalidRewardRecipient();
    76	    error InvalidValue();
    77	    error NotAnAccount();
    78	    error OnlyAccountOwner();
    79	
    80	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    81	                                EVENTS
    82	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    83	
    84	    event AccountInfoSet(address indexed account, address indexed initiator);
    85	    event FeePaid(address indexed account, address indexed receiver, address indexed asset, uint256 amount);
    86	    event YieldClaimed(address indexed account, address indexed asset, uint256 amount);
    87	    event YieldTransferred(address indexed account, address indexed receiver, address indexed asset, uint256 amount);
    88	
    89	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    90	                            CONSTRUCTOR
    91	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    92	
    93	    /**
    94	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    95	     * @param factory The contract address of the Arcadia Accounts Factory.
    96	     * @param merklDistributor The contract address of the Merkl Distributor.
    97	     */
    98	    constructor(address owner_, address factory, address merklDistributor) Guardian(owner_) {
    99	        ARCADIA_FACTORY = IArcadiaFactory(factory);
   100	        MERKL_DISTRIBUTOR = IDistributor(merklDistributor);
   101	    }
   102	
   103	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   104	                            ACCOUNT LOGIC
   105	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   106	
   107	    /**
   108	     * @notice Optional hook called by the Arcadia Account when calling "setMerklOperator()".
   109	     * @param accountOwner The current owner of the Arcadia Account.
   110	     * param status Bool indicating if the Operator is enabled or disabled.
   111	     * @param data Operator specific data, passed by the Account owner.
   112	     * @dev No need to check that the Account version is 3 or greater (versions with cross account reentrancy guard),
   113	     * since version 1 and 2 don't support the onSetAssetManager hook.
   114	     */
   115	    function onSetMerklOperator(address accountOwner, bool, bytes calldata data) external nonReentrant {
   116	        if (!ARCADIA_FACTORY.isAccount(msg.sender)) revert NotAnAccount();
   117	
   118	        (address initiator, address rewardRecipient, uint256 maxClaimFee, bytes memory metaData_) =
   119	            abi.decode(data, (address, address, uint256, bytes));
   120	        _setAccountInfo(msg.sender, accountOwner, initiator, rewardRecipient, maxClaimFee, metaData_);
   121	    }
   122	
   123	    /**
   124	     * @notice Sets the required information for an Account.
   125	     * @param account The contract address of the Arcadia Account to set the information for.
   126	     * @param initiator The address of the initiator.
   127	     * @param rewardRecipient The address of the recipient of the claimed Merkl rewards.
   128	     * @param maxClaimFee The maximum fee charged on the claimed fees of the liquidity position, with 18 decimals precision.
   129	     * @param metaData_ Custom metadata to be stored with the account.
   130	     */
   131	    function setAccountInfo(
   132	        address account,
   133	        address initiator,
   134	        address rewardRecipient,
   135	        uint256 maxClaimFee,
   136	        bytes calldata metaData_
   137	    ) external nonReentrant {
   138	        if (!ARCADIA_FACTORY.isAccount(account)) revert NotAnAccount();
   139	        address accountOwner = IAccount(account).owner();
   140	        if (msg.sender != accountOwner) revert OnlyAccountOwner();
   141	        // Block Account versions without cross account reentrancy guard.
   142	        if (IAccount(account).ACCOUNT_VERSION() < 3) revert InvalidAccountVersion();
   143	
   144	        _setAccountInfo(account, accountOwner, initiator, rewardRecipient, maxClaimFee, metaData_);
   145	    }
   146	
   147	    /**
   148	     * @notice Sets the required information for an Account.
   149	     * @param account The contract address of the Arcadia Account to set the information for.
   150	     * @param accountOwner The current owner of the Arcadia Account.
   151	     * @param initiator The address of the initiator.
   152	     * @param rewardRecipient The address of the recipient of the claimed Merkl rewards.
   153	     * @param maxClaimFee The maximum fee charged on the claimed fees of the liquidity position, with 18 decimals precision.
   154	     * @param metaData_ Custom metadata to be stored with the account.
   155	     */
   156	    function _setAccountInfo(
   157	        address account,
   158	        address accountOwner,
   159	        address initiator,
   160	        address rewardRecipient,
   161	        uint256 maxClaimFee,
   162	        bytes memory metaData_
   163	    ) internal {
   164	        if (rewardRecipient == address(0)) revert InvalidRewardRecipient();
   165	        if (maxClaimFee > 1e18) revert InvalidValue();
   166	
   167	        accountToInitiator[accountOwner][account] = initiator;
   168	        // unsafe cast: maxClaimFee <= 1e18 < type(uint64).max.
   169	        // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
   170	        accountInfo[account] = AccountInfo({ rewardRecipient: rewardRecipient, maxClaimFee: uint64(maxClaimFee) });
   171	        metaData[account] = metaData_;
   172	
   173	        emit AccountInfoSet(account, initiator);
   174	    }
   175	
   176	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   177	                             CLAIMING LOGIC
   178	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   179	
   180	    /**
   181	     * @notice Claims Merkl rewards, owned by an Arcadia Account.
   182	     * @param account The contract address of the account.
   183	     * @param initiatorParams A struct with the initiator parameters.
   184	     */
   185	    function claim(address account, InitiatorParams calldata initiatorParams) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant {
   186	        // If the initiator is set, account is an actual Arcadia Account.
   187	        if (accountToInitiator[IAccount(account).owner()][account] != msg.sender) revert InvalidInitiator();
   188	
   189	        // Validate initiatorParams.
   190	        // No need to check length arrays, as it is checked in _claim() on Distributor.
   191	        uint256 claimFee = initiatorParams.claimFee;
   192	        if (initiatorParams.claimFee > accountInfo[account].maxClaimFee) revert InvalidValue();
   193	
   194	        uint256 length = initiatorParams.tokens.length;
   195	        uint256[] memory balances = new uint256[](length);
   196	        address[] memory users = new address[](length);
   197	        address token;
   198	        for (uint256 i; i < length; i++) {
   199	            token = initiatorParams.tokens[i];
   200	
   201	            // Check that Operator is recipient for each token.
   202	            if (MERKL_DISTRIBUTOR.claimRecipient(account, token) != address(this)) revert InvalidClaimRecipient();
   203	
   204	            // Cache balances for each token.
   205	            balances[i] = ERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));
   206	
   207	            // Add account to users array.
   208	            users[i] = account;
   209	        }
   210	
   211	        // Claim Merkl rewards.
   212	        MERKL_DISTRIBUTOR.claim(users, initiatorParams.tokens, initiatorParams.amounts, initiatorParams.proofs);
   213	
   214	        // Transfer rewards to recipient and fees to initiator.
   215	        address rewardRecipient = accountInfo[account].rewardRecipient;
   216	        uint256 reward;
   217	        uint256 fee;
   218	        for (uint256 j; j < length; j++) {
   219	            token = initiatorParams.tokens[j];
   220	
   221	            reward = ERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this)) - balances[j];
   222	            // Shortcut iteration if rewards is 0.
   223	            if (reward == 0) continue;
   224	            emit YieldClaimed(account, token, reward);
   225	
   226	            fee = reward.mulDivDown(claimFee, 1e18);
   227	            reward = reward - fee;
   228	
   229	            // Send the reward to the rewardRecipient.
   230	            if (reward > 0) {
   231	                ERC20(token).safeTransfer(rewardRecipient, reward);
   232	                emit YieldTransferred(account, rewardRecipient, token, reward);
   233	            }
   234	
   235	            // Transfer Initiator fees to the initiator.
   236	            if (fee > 0) {
   237	                ERC20(token).safeTransfer(msg.sender, fee);
   238	                emit FeePaid(account, msg.sender, token, fee);
   239	            }
   240	        }
   241	    }
   242	
   243	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   244	                             SKIM LOGIC
   245	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   246	
   247	    /**
   248	     * @notice Recovers any native or ERC20 tokens left on the contract.
   249	     * @param token The contract address of the token, or address(0) for native tokens.
   250	     */
   251	    function skim(address token) external onlyOwner whenNotPaused nonReentrant {
   252	        if (token == address(0)) {
   253	            (bool success, bytes memory result) = payable(msg.sender).call{ value: address(this).balance }("");
   254	            require(success, string(result));
   255	        } else {
   256	            ERC20(token).safeTransfer(msg.sender, ERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this)));
   257	        }
   258	    }
   259	}
```

```solidity
    60	    error OnlyAccountOwner();
    61	
    62	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    63	                                EVENTS
    64	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    65	
    66	    event AccountInfoSet(address indexed account, address indexed initiator);
    67	
    68	    /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    69	                            CONSTRUCTOR
    70	    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    71	
    72	    /**
    73	     * @param owner_ The address of the Owner.
    74	     * @param factory The contract address of the Arcadia Accounts Factory.
    75	     * @param merklDistributor The contract address of the Merkl Distributor.
    76	     */
    77	    constructor(address owner_, address factory, address merklDistributor) Guardian(owner_) {
    78	        ARCADIA_FACTORY = IArcadiaFactory(factory);
    79	        MERKL_DISTRIBUTOR = IDistributor(merklDistributor);
    80	    }
    81	
    82	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    83	                            ACCOUNT LOGIC
    84	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
    85	
    86	    /**
    87	     * @notice Optional hook called by the Arcadia Account when calling "setMerklOperator()".
    88	     * @param accountOwner The current owner of the Arcadia Account.
    89	     * param status Bool indicating if the Operator is enabled or disabled.
    90	     * @param data Operator specific data, passed by the Account owner.
    91	     * @dev No need to check that the Account version is 3 or greater (versions with cross account reentrancy guard),
    92	     * since version 1 and 2 don't support the onSetAssetManager hook.
    93	     */
    94	    function onSetMerklOperator(address accountOwner, bool, bytes calldata data) external nonReentrant {
    95	        if (!ARCADIA_FACTORY.isAccount(msg.sender)) revert NotAnAccount();
    96	
    97	        (address initiator, bytes memory metaData_) = abi.decode(data, (address, bytes));
    98	        _setAccountInfo(msg.sender, accountOwner, initiator, metaData_);
    99	    }
   100	
   101	    /**
   102	     * @notice Sets the required information for an Account.
   103	     * @param account The contract address of the Arcadia Account to set the information for.
   104	     * @param initiator The address of the initiator.
   105	     * @param metaData_ Custom metadata to be stored with the account.
   106	     */
   107	    function setAccountInfo(address account, address initiator, bytes calldata metaData_) external nonReentrant {
   108	        if (!ARCADIA_FACTORY.isAccount(account)) revert NotAnAccount();
   109	        address accountOwner = IAccount(account).owner();
   110	        if (msg.sender != accountOwner) revert OnlyAccountOwner();
   111	        // Block Account versions without cross account reentrancy guard.
   112	        if (IAccount(account).ACCOUNT_VERSION() < 3) revert InvalidAccountVersion();
   113	
   114	        _setAccountInfo(account, accountOwner, initiator, metaData_);
   115	    }
   116	
   117	    /**
   118	     * @notice Sets the required information for an Account.
   119	     * @param account The contract address of the Arcadia Account to set the information for.
   120	     * @param accountOwner The current owner of the Arcadia Account.
   121	     * @param initiator The address of the initiator.
   122	     * @param metaData_ Custom metadata to be stored with the account.
   123	     */
   124	    function _setAccountInfo(address account, address accountOwner, address initiator, bytes memory metaData_)
   125	        internal
   126	    {
   127	        accountToInitiator[accountOwner][account] = initiator;
   128	        metaData[account] = metaData_;
   129	
   130	        emit AccountInfoSet(account, initiator);
   131	    }
   132	
   133	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   134	                             CLAIMING LOGIC
   135	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   136	
   137	    /**
   138	     * @notice Claims Merkl rewards, owned by an Arcadia Account.
   139	     * @param account The contract address of the account.
   140	     * @param initiatorParams A struct with the initiator parameters.
   141	     */
   142	    function claim(address account, InitiatorParams calldata initiatorParams) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant {
   143	        // If the initiator is set, account is an actual Arcadia Account.
   144	        if (accountToInitiator[IAccount(account).owner()][account] != msg.sender) revert InvalidInitiator();
   145	
   146	        uint256 length = initiatorParams.tokens.length;
   147	        address[] memory users = new address[](length);
   148	        for (uint256 i; i < length; i++) {
   149	            // Add account to users array.
   150	            users[i] = account;
   151	        }
   152	
   153	        // Claim Merkl rewards.
   154	        // Rewards are automatically transferred to the account with the current Merkl Distributor deployed on base.
   155	        MERKL_DISTRIBUTOR.claim(users, initiatorParams.tokens, initiatorParams.amounts, initiatorParams.proofs);
   156	    }
   157	
   158	    /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   159	                             SKIM LOGIC
   160	    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
   161	
   162	    /**
   163	     * @notice Recovers any native or ERC20 tokens left on the contract.
   164	     * @param token The contract address of the token, or address(0) for native tokens.
   165	     */
   166	    function skim(address token) external onlyOwner whenNotPaused nonReentrant {
   167	        if (token == address(0)) {
   168	            (bool success, bytes memory result) = payable(msg.sender).call{ value: address(this).balance }("");
   169	            require(success, string(result));
   170	        } else {
   171	            ERC20(token).safeTransfer(msg.sender, ERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this)));
   172	        }
   173	    }
   174	}
```
